Chapter 144 - Beyond Bold

Chapter 144, Beyond Bold

“Since the ten finalists have been decided, the rest will be
eliminated!” Not even looking at the pill of the alchemist who finished
in close after Vicious Pill King, Xiao Ya shouted.

This caused an uproar, one born from puzzlement, as one protested,
“Weren’t there supposed to be 20? Why only ten?”

Snapping a cold gaze at the speaker, Xiao Ya flatly explained, “I never
said there will be 20. It just so happened there were 20 top cauldrons
prepared.”

Her words sent them pondering, making them realize their false
preconceived notion.

At the start of the meeting, the judge never once mentioned how many
would enter the finals and just started the competition.

But, as there were 20 top spots standing out from the rest, they simply
took it for granted.

Realizing their own mistakes, the alchemists sighed in regret,
especially the second batch of ten. They falsely assumed there was
plenty of time and didn’t give their all, wasting their chances.

None of them considered that this was set on purpose by the Drifting
Flowers Edifice. An alchemist who did not strive to reach the top, was
unworthy to qualify.

Unless of course, he was like Zhuo Fan, with plenty of skills in their
arsenal. After all, it was a universal practice to bend the rules and
morals in any profession and let the strong ones in.

“Wait!”

The alchemist who finished after Vicious Pill King shouted his dissent.
He was intimidated by Vicious Pill King but soon calmed in his heart as
he declared his malcontent, “Judge, my pill is a top 5th-grade pill
while Elder Yan’s was a low 5th-grade pill. We also finished close
together. Reason dictates that the tenth spot ought to be mine!”

“Quiet!”

It was Zhuo Fan who got ahead of Xiao Ya. His cold eyes stared
pitilessly, “Are you deaf? This round was based on speed, not quality.
This is what you get when you can’t even understand what is required of
you. What face can you expect when you bark like a dog? Forget about who
was first or last. If this old guy finished at the same time as you,
he’d still be the one to qualify since he shouted first.”

All the alchemists were startled.

[Vicious Pill King and Grandmaster Song are in a life and death battle.
Grandmaster Song would no doubt by jumping for joy if he could kick the
old goat out.]

[Why is Grandmaster Song speaking up for his opponent?]

They were confused and so too the people on the terrace. Even Vicious
Pill King eyed Zhuo Fan with a stare.

Tao Danniang watched worriedly from the side. [Why is this brat
defending him when he was working so hard to kick him out before?] Chu
Qingcheng was also clueless, her angelic eyes fixed on his figure.

Under everyone’s rapt attention, Zhuo Fan snorted and took on a smug
attitude in his berating, “I know exactly what you’re thinking. Indeed,
yours truly wanted to kick this old guy out. But he used blood essence
to refine pills, twice, cutting away almost half of his life to finally
win his spot. And let’s not mention braving through my schemes. But even
so, I will still win the Pill King round! In the meantime, I will not
have this old coot fail from meaningless prattle. That would be a
disgrace to me as an alchemist!”

Silence as the grave.

Then, thunderous applause dominated the air, with worshiping eyes
directed at Zhuo Fan.

[Now this is the air of a true scholar!]

Open, frank, and of outstanding bearing!

Even Vicious Pill King started to feel a thread of respect for Zhuo Fan.
He inched his withered hands and slowly clapped.

Tao Danniang sighed, but felt quite prideful. [This brat is sinister and
cruel when is needed and frank when the circumstances demand it. This is
a true man, a husband worthy of that girl.]

Chu Qingcheng’s heart exploded with love.

Xiao Dandan had long been thrilled that she was trembling. It was
impossible for her not to adore such a dauntless man.

Xie Tianyang and the rest nodded in admiration. Zhuo Fan was despicable,
true; unscrupulous, also true, but was not nasty. Only evil.

And his evil nature was embraced by his domineering character, making
him an antihero!

“This man is a man of ambition, similar to myself!”

On the eastern stand, Huangpu Qingyun breathed out in lament. The others
looked at him then at each other in silence.

Finally, it was Lin Zitian who spoke, “Second young master, you took a
liking to the kid and want to employ him?”

“Absolutely not!”

He shook his hand. Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes flashed with killing intent,
“A mountain is too small for two tigers. With his ambition, he will not
deign to serve under another. He must be dealt with swiftly.

“Whether I get the Bodhi Root or not, he must meet his end today!”
Huangpu Qingyun clenched his fist, his manner of unprecedented
seriousness, “A premonition struck me just now. He must die here, today,
or Regent Estate will have an archenemy.”

The hearts of his men shuddered.

Regent Estate was the strongest of the houses and wouldn’t show fear
even when matched against the other six. [Why is it that the second
young master evaluates this third rate clan kid so highly?]

No matter how great his talent and skills were, he hadn’t the power to
fight against the Regent Estate.

What they didn’t realize was that Regent Estate’s men were most skilled
in grasping the heart of the people. If Huangpu Qingyun came to such a
clearcut decision regarding the kid’s fate, it spoke of the possible
threat Zhuo Fan could grow into and endanger Regent Estate.

The men turned to watch Zhuo Fan with deep gazes.

Only Lin Zitian, however, was uncaring as he flattered, “Ha-ha-ha,
second young master is overthinking. A third rate clan brat, regardless
if he knows some ancient refining skill or if he was even a 7th-grade
alchemist, this is only limited to alchemy. He can’t…”

Huangpu Qingyun’s piercing stare snapped at him. Lin Zitian stopped with
a shiver.

“I will say it again. This kid must die today!”

Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes flashed with absolute conviction. The others had
never seen him so determined. They could only nod, as each’s eyes
flashed with their own resolution.

In the arena, the discontent alchemist cupped his hand in shame,
“Grandmaster Song is indeed correct. I never had the right to enter the
tenth spot. Please do forgive my careless words. Having seen Grandmaster
Song’s imposing manner, I feel ashamed of myself!”

The man gave a deep bow to Zhuo Fan and left with a lowered head.

This earned more reverence from the crowd.

The man was ranked 13th in the empire in alchemy, known to nitpick on
anything and everything. Yet the same man submitted willingly.
[Grandmaster Song is of impeccable moral standing!]

Zhuo Fan would’ve cracked up if he heard them.

Moral was the least fitting trait when it came to him. It was more
accurate to call him of ruthless standing, beating others into
submission with power rather than reason…

Xiao Ya bowed in appreciation to Zhuo Fan. She had first despised him,
then was shocked by him, and now had come to respect him, with something
else mixed within.

Zhuo Fan had no experience in this field to pick up these subtle
signals. However, Chu Qingcheng was one who always followed her heart.
Thus, she noticed these signals immediately and could only shake her
head.

[An outstanding husband is not always a good thing. Too many eyes will
be on him.]

“To all grandmasters that have entered the Pill King round,
congratulations. You have a chance of getting Drifting Flowers Edifice’s
most precious treasure, the 9th-grade spirit item, Bodhi Root!”

Xiao Ya smiled, “I ask that everyone move to their respective spots.”

The last eight alchemists started to move in order. Their ability in
alchemy was clear cut as to who was strong and who was weak.

Only Vicious Pill King fell from the second to the tenth spot under Zhuo
Fan’s relentless harassment.

“Hey, old guy, give up!”

Tao Danniang felt quite thrilled to have finally got ahead of that old
coot for once.

Snickering, Vicious Pill King glared at the hag and snorted, “What are
you so excited about? It wasn’t you who did it!”

Vicious Pill King looked at Zhuo Fan, now filled with a staunch desire
to fight. He hadn’t felt like this in decades.

“Brat, I have been unequaled in alchemy all my life. But today…
ha-ha-ha. I have traveled the continent unchecked for decades and not
once have I found one worthy of admiration. But today… ha-ha-ha…”

Laughing, Vicious Pill King slowly walked to his new spot yet his voice
was still clear, “Brat, we will have a true battle today and see who
shall be the best alchemist in the empire.”

Shock pervaded the crowd.

The arrogant Vicious Pill King who saw no one as his equal, not even
Regent Estate’s leader, just acknowledged someone. On the surface, he
might seem like he cared about the Regent Estate. However, deep inside
he still couldn’t care less about them.

He was the first alchemist in the empire and had arrogance to spare.

However, this time, he met his match. Three times they duked, three
times he failed. He never suffered such a wretched defeat in his life!

Yet, now, he was far from angry, but jealous instead. It was as if he
was back in his prime, filled with the thirst for battle.

Tao Danniang was startled, getting the feeling he was looking at the
Vicious Pill King of old. She smiled and said to Zhuo Fan, “Kid, the old
coot already took you as his opponent. This is his approval of you!”

“Tch, since when does yours truly need his approval?”

Zhuo Fan’s tone was filled with coldness, “Old coot, you lost close to
half of your life in the last round! Keep this up in the next one and
you will fall!”

“My life is my own! Today, I will win against you!” Vicious Pill King
shook his hand and spoke resolutely.

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan started reevaluating the old coot.

Vicious Pill King no longer had the cruel and sinister manner from
before, but the bearing of a true grandmaster of alchemy…

Chapter 145 - Pill King

Chapter 145, Pill King

“Master, are you alright? Be careful of your wounds.”

After changing his spot, Yan Fu rushed to Vicious Pill King and looked
at him in worry. Vicious Pill King however, didn’t even acknowledge his
presence.

Bam!

Vicious Pill King slapped his face out of the blue, sending him
sprawling three meters away as he barked, “Humph, you dare finish before
your master? Did you not see how close I was to not entering the
finals?”

“Forgive me, master. I was wrong. I would’ve never considered it
possible for that punk to…” Yan Fu crawled sullenly to Vicious Pill King
but the latter’s words got stuck in his throat.

Squinting, Vicious Pill King spoke icily, “What were you trying to say?
That the punk played me to such a miserable state?”

“Never!” Yan Fu lowered his head, sweating bullets.

Shaking his head, Vicious Pill King said, “What never? Yes, I was indeed
played like a fiddle. Be it in alchemy or schemes, I failed on both
accounts! Is there anything wrong with saying it? Even the brat admitted
he could not kick me out. His plan failed. So what could I, in my sorry
state, not dare to admit?”

Yan Fu was shocked. He looked up in fright as he muttered, “Master, why
have you changed?”

“I have not changed, only returned…”

Taking a deep breath, Vicious Pill King gazed afar with eager eyes. It
was unclear if he was speaking to himself or his disciple, “An
alchemist’s mind should be set only alchemy. Success and failure are
commonplace. It does not warrant covering it up!”

Vicious Pill King looked at Yan Fu, “Disciple, do you know why I hit
you?”

“Because I dared to finish before master and shamed you…”

Before Yan Fu could finish, Vicious Pill King shook his head and
laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, over that small matter? I only blame you for taking
a spot and almost making me lose the chance to fight a worthy opponent!
I never had such an opportunity in all my life.”

Laughing again, Vicious Pill King ignored his disciple and went to the
tenth spot.

Yan Fu was startled and turned his head to look at his master.

He felt his master was unlike his usual self. His master used to
emphasize results above all else. Successful refining was rewarded,
while failure, punishment.

Under such strict guidance, he had managed to surpass Liu Yizhen’s rank
and become one of the top five alchemists in the empire.

Now, his master no longer cared about results, but to have a fair match
with the kid.

If the kid had dared threaten Vicious Pill King’s place of being the
first alchemist in the empire from the start, he would’ve been long
dealt with.

A dead man, even with neat alchemy skill wouldn’t have been able to
challenge him.

[Strange, is it because the brat helped my master out just now?]Yan Fu’s
heart was filled with questions.

He had no way of knowing it was simply a hero respecting another hero!

When formidable individuals fought, they may employ devious schemes, a
dog eat dog battle, but a win was absolute and victory, brilliant. Zhuo
Fan did not manage to kick out theVicious Pill King and openly admit his
loss.

It is fine if he failed this time. After all, there was still the next
round, which Zhuo Fan intended to dominate.

But from the gossip flying around about Vicious Pill King, it would be
impossible for Zhuo Fan. Naturally, Zhuo Fan did not take their words to
heart. He knew that these people could be used, but never relied upon.

Afterall, the sneaking and sinister way of a dowager had always been the
weapons of the weak and the scorn of the strong.

Vicious Pill King felt the same and now had his spirit aroused. He
wanted to pit against Zhuo Fan in this round and win clean and perfectly
so that Zhuo Fan would have no room to deny it.

The battle between these two heavyweights was on the field of alchemy.
Yet, it was also a fight to the death!

On the eastern stand, Huangpu Qingyun stared at Zhuo Fan, then at
Vicious Pill King, “Tell me, can Elder Yan win?”

“Of course, second young master!”

Lin Zitian jumped right in with a giggle, “Elder Yan lost the first
three rounds but from the third round, the brat used an ancient refining
skill that is taxing on the body. His best is a 5th-grade pill while
Elder Yan is a true 7th-grade alchemist. It would make no sense if he
lost.”

“En, I see!”

Huangpu Qingyun nodded, but then smiled, “However, Elder Lin, thank you
for reminding me. You said the same thing in the last round, staking
your head on Elder Lin’s victory, and how did it end?”

Lin Zitian cursed in his heart as his smile froze.

[When did I ever put my head for the likes of that old coot? Isn’t it
you who demanded it?]

His only choice was to keep those words to himself and shake his head
with a bright smile.

Laughing, Huangpu Qingyun said, “Anyway, I do not expect anything from
the old man. The loss in his first round can be said it was because of
that brat’s tricks. But he failed the second round from pee.”

Huangpu Qingyun shook his head but then cracked up when he recalled Yan
Song’s wretched look as if he swallowed a fly, “Alright, let’s take it
as the kid is quite able. But the third round, a sneeze and a fart threw
him back to the tenth spot. Is this still because of the kid’s amazing
skills?”

“Second young master, Yan Song is usually a vicious and spiteful man.
But to fail when it was most crucial, makes him unworthy of bearing
heavy responsibilities.” The 5th elder stepped forward and started
throwing stones at Yan Song.

Huangpu Qingyun raised an eyebrow, “Elder Lin, what do you have to say?”

Lin Zitian was hesitating. Second young master was clearly resentful
over Yan Song’s failures but he had always stuck up for the old guy and
their fates were tied. If he was a turncoat now, wouldn’t the second
young master never trust his words again?

Lin Zitian gnashed his teeth.

[Since I was wrong from the start, then I’ll be so till the end. I hope
this will be a chance for me and that old guy.]

He said, “Second young master, please relax. Elder Yan isn’t the only
one at fault, because his opponent is too sinister. In this Pill King
round, the requirement is definitely above the 5th grade and the kid
won’t win no matter how cunning he is. Elder Yan will be the one to take
the first place!”

Huangpu Qingyun eyed him deeply.

Not because he found Elder Lin’s words right, but that this opportunist
had a loyal side. He couldn’t help but secretly nod at that.

Lin Zitian noticed his admiring gaze and sighed, feeling proud.

[This time, I made the right call. Sigh, it’s not easy sticking close to
the ruling class…]

In the arena, Xiao Ya smiled at the ten grandmasters in their respective
spots and started the finals, “In this Pill King round, everyone has
free reign on what they make. Instead of speed, it will be the highest
grade that will crown you Pill King in this Hundred Pill Meeting!”

In an instant, some were worried while others were happy!

Huangpu Qingyun’s side laughed. It went as Lin Zitian said, with the
final round based on an alchemist’s true ability.

Tao Danniang frowned. Zhuo Fan was in the Bone Tempering Stage and could
only make a 5th-grade pill after giving his all. How was he going to
defeat the 7th-grade alchemist Vicious Pill King now?

Yet, by his appearances, Zhuo Fan seemed unconcerned. When Vicious Pill
King looked at him, his eyes were filled with fighting spirit.

After losing three rounds in a row, he figured out that the kid couldn’t
always rely on schemes. The refining of a 7th-grade pill at the Bone
Tempering Stage may be pure fantasy, but…

[Humph, this kid might actually pull it off!]

Zhuo Fan felt the old man’s eyes and waved. He didn’t think the one to
believe him the most ended up being his greatest opponent.

“Then, for the purpose of fairness, Drifting Flowers Edifice will
provide high-grade ingredients for grandmasters who are missing
ingredients.”

Xiao Ya clapped and a lovely group of hundreds of disciples pushed
cabinets in the arena.

The cabinets contained ingredients from the lowest grade to the 7th, and
even a few 8th-grade ingredients could be noticed.

Swallowing dryly, everyone, especially the alchemists, were now greedily
looking over the items.

Like a pack of starved wolves meeting a fresh lamb. Like a pack of
perverts meeting a naked and gorgeous lady!

[Damn, Drifting Flowers Edifice is filthy rich.] The sheer amount of
ingredients here was not something a third and second rate clans could
hope to obtain. Not even a first rate clan could get them easily.

“I invite the grandmasters to choose the ingredients you are lacking for
your refining. A word of caution, however, do not get greedy. You need
to refine with all the chosen ingredients, otherwise…” Xiaoya’s smile
penetrated their deepest thoughts.

Coughing lightly, the people chuckled in embarrassment then began
choosing.

In no time at all, they all finished, having returned to their spots.
However, Xiao Ya looked around and found one spot empty still.

Looking at the cabinets, Zhuo Fan was there choosing, uh, looting his
booty.

He didn’t take his time going from one ingredient to another but stuffed
a whole cabinet in his ring and moved to the next. From the 1st grade to
the 8th, he didn’t miss one. The crowd was in total shock!

[Dude, can you not so openly rob the Drifting Flowers Edifice?]

Chapter 146 - Shameless Looting

Chapter 146, Shameless Looting

“Grandmaster Song, y-you…

Xiao Ya pursed her red lips and despite knowing what he was doing, she
couldn’t outright say it. Before the three rounds, Zhuo Fan was nothing
more than a nameless silk pants, now turned number one famous alchemist.
Some token of respect had to be present when addressing him.

[Even as the first in the empire, you still need to be ethical. You
should not openly break the rules of Hundred Pill Meeting.]

Xiao Ya was watching him awkwardly. She could neither stand still nor
let him do what he wanted. This was a pickle.

Zhuo Fan’s hands paused and raised an eyebrow, “Didn’t you say these are
for us? So which is it?”

“Grandmaster Song, I think you misunderstood me.” She explained, “These
are only used as complementary ingredients to the ones you have…”

“Yeah, but I am lacking everything!”

Zhuo Fan resumed looting the cabinets.

The crowd was speechless, [You can do that?] The alchemists from before
were also shocked silly, thinking they should’ve taken some more when
they had the chance.

“Uh, judge! If Grandmaster Song can do it, then there’s no problem if I
do it too…” Liu Yizhen licked his lips, looking at Zhuo Fan and Xiao Ya
anxiously.

[If I don’t hurry up, the kid will pick them all clean.]

He was a top alchemist, but he sorely lacked ingredients.

Xiao Ya glared, “Grandmaster Liu, don’t make trouble. You’re saying you
can use them all in this round?”

Liu Yizhen let an awkward smile, then shook his head on his way to his
spot.

With how many ingredients there were, who could refine them all? He
couldn’t mess with Drifting Flowers Edifice.

Then again, [Getting a couple can’t hurt, right?]

Liu Yizhen looked again at Zhuo Fan with admiration. He was plundering
the cabinets like he was moving house. [Just which clan or sect does he
hail? There’s no way a third rate clan kid would dare perform highway
robbery right under Drifting Flowers Edifice’s nose.]

“Grandmaster Song, you need to make sure you use all ingredients you are
taking. Or there will be serious consequences!” Xiao Ya had gotten angry
and changed her tone.

Zhuo Fan’s hand slowed, then smiled inside.

[With how many there are here, how could they be refined in one go? This
amount is enough for tens of thousands of pills. Then again, so what?]

Once he got crowned as the Pill King, he’d take the Bodhi Root and haul
ass out! The Drifting Flowers Edifice could then do nothing but eat his
dust.

So, he might as well get as many treasures as he could. They’d be
breaking all ties at the end and it would be such a waste to leave these
beauties lying here!

Slowly turning his head, Zhuo Fan grinned, “How do you know I won’t be
using them all? I’ll do it in a jiffy, don’t you worry your pretty
little head about it.”

He then resumed his shameless picking.

Xiao Ya was close to crying. She never saw a more vile grandmaster in
her life.

Refining tens of thousands of pills on the spot? As if! This was
daylight robbery!

The crowd watched the darkest horse in this arena, who had displayed
alchemy skills more outstanding than even Vicious Pill King, now robbing
the cabinets of ingredients.

[To think this grandmaster has balls to rob Drifting Flowers Edifice…]

Yet, Drifting Flowers Edifice did not even try removing him from the
premises. After all, who told them to give the alchemists free reign?
And what if someone insisted he could refine thousands upon thousands of
pills?

[Although far fetched, that’s beside the point. You can only settle this
after the competition.]

Xiao Ya waited bitterly for Zhuo Fan to load up his ring.

When he stopped, Xiao Ya was overjoyed, and smiled, “Grandmaster Song,
are you ready? Then please return to your spot and begin refining.
Everyone is waiting for you.”

Frowning, Zhuo Fan turned to Xiao Ya and his ring flashed, “My storage
ring is packed, can you bring me another?”

Staggering, Xiao Ya was about to collapse. The audience’s faces froze.

[Grandmaster Song, you’re too shameless!]

“No, Drifting Flowers Edifice does not provide storage rings.” Xiao Ya
roared.

Glancing at her, Zhuo Fan snorted helplessly, “What Seven Noble Houses?
So stingy!”

Xiao Ya was close to spurting blood. Thank god she choked on words and
the blood stayed inside. She glared at Zhuo Fan with such hatred that
she wished she could tear him limb from limb.

[You took advantage of us and still dares to call us stingy? Is there
anyone in the world more shameless than you?]

Looking at the cabinets, most of them were empty, leaving only the 1st
and 2nd-grade ingredients behind. Xiao Ya was this close to bursting
into tears.

These ingredients took Drifting Flowers Edifice a whole year to gather!
Some of them were close to a hundred years old before being harvested.
Yet, all of them were swept clean by a damn punk.

Drifting Flowers Edifice aimed to show off their power by letting the
participants choose their ingredients. But then, this fool came around
and nabbed them all.

[Just you wait, brat. If you don’t bake ten thousand pills I will tear
you a new one!]

Xiao Ya glared with all her power at Zhuo Fan to comfort her bleeding
heart. Her slight, almost ephemeral respect she had for him before now
burned in the flames of rage and hatred.

[This punk is a rogue.]

Zhuo Fan had better things to do than care about her opinion. He
scratched his nose and went to his spot. [What is fame when tangible
stuff is more valuable, he-he-he…]

On the terrace, Xie Tianyang was piqued by his actions, then asked,
“Elder Jiu, I heard you and the brat came to become allies. All his
ingredients must be coming from Veiled Dragon Pavilion. Why is it that
he looks so miserably poor? He was even moved by those 1st-grade
ingredients!”

“Humph, when talking about greedy people, even a needle on the ground
can move them.” Long Kui berated.

Xie Tianyang raised an eyebrow in thought. [Well, that’s quite true.
With this brat’s character, everywhere he goes, not even grass is left.]

Long Jiu muttered under his breath but actually agreed with Long Kui’s
assessment, “What little Kui said isn’t without wisdom. This brat sure
is greedy. Veiled Dragon Pavilion may be his ally, but we can’t just
give him our best ingredients. We can only provide 4th grade at most.
But for some reason, the attendant in charge of giving him ingredients
suddenly gave 5th-grade ingredients too, and lots of them.

“We later questioned the old and loyal attendant but he would rather
take the blame for sneaking the ingredients out than to say anything.
Ha-ha-ha, that brat sure has a way with people!” Long Jiu chuckled. His
eyes however were especially dignified.

Xie Tianyang muttered, “Damn, I know this brat is vicious to everyone,
enemy and friend alike. But he can even dig out Veiled Dragon Pavilion
cornerstones?”

“That’s not quite right. The attendant is still fine, working for our
house as we speak. Even he doesn’t know what got into him at that time
to help that brat out!”

Shuddering, Xie Tianyang and Jian Suifeng looked at each other as they
sank in deep thought.

They, who had a certain understanding of Zhuo Fan, now revised their
opinion of him. [We must not, by any means, act too friendly with him
when we interact.]

[Or he’ll dig out everything from our house.]

The overseers were too focused on what happened in the arena to pay
attention to their discussion. With every empty cabinet, their hearts
bled harder.

[As the son in law to Drifting Flowers Edifices, he shows not the least
restraint when taking our things. But he even goes as far as not leaving
anything!]

Chu Qingcheng’s angelic eyes now had a rare hint of killing intent.

[Rotten brat, isn’t what’s yours mine? What are you taking everything
for? You’ll soon be returning them anyway…]

Xiao Ya took a few deep breaths to push her anger down.

Boring her eyes into Zhuo Fan, she shouted at the ten participants,
“With everyone ready, the Pill King round shall begin.”

Yuan Qi flames were ignited one after the other.

Zhuo Fan was unmoving, however. Xiao Ya gnashed her teeth and spat,
“Grandmaster Song, don’t forget, you have to refine all the
ingredients!”

Snorting, Zhuo Fan had a smile of disdain.

[You daft? I ain’t that stupid! Wait for me to be crowned Pill King,
take my prize, then skip town. What will you do then?]

Boom!

Like a roar of a huge beast, the sound from a blood-colored flame shook
everything as it reached the heavens.

The instant it appeared, the alchemists close to it had their flames
shriveled up.

Squinting, Zhuo Fan laughed coldly inside.

[Humph, that old coot finally plans to show his true skill…]

Chapter 147 - Amazing Display

Chapter 147, Amazing Display

“T-this…”

Xiao Ya jumped in fright from the sudden strange flame and turned in its
direction.

Liu Yizhen smoothened his beard as he gave a chuckling apology to his
fellow alchemists behind him, “Ha-ha-ha, terribly sorry, it is the
finals and I must give it my all. Do forgive me if I offend anyone.”

No matter how polite he made it sound, his eyes couldn’t hide the pride
he felt.

The alchemists swallowed dryly and eyed the towering flame and then, to
their own lifeless Yuan Qi kindle, feeling more and more despondent.

How were they supposed to compete when another just snuffed out their
efforts?

They watched him with hatred in their hearts but also envy. Just where
did this old guy get that flame from anyways?

With that flame, his refining might reach the 6th grade!

Xiao Ya’s eyes lit up and cried, “Grandmaster Liu’s flame must be from a
4th level spiritual beast, the Sky Blazing Python’s heart fire. I heard
the Sky Blazing Python spends its time moving underground and its core
is influenced by the earth’s fire. It is so hot it can melt anything. No
ingredient on this land cannot be refined with it. Grandmaster Liu
must’ve been holding onto it for the final round.”

“Ha-ha-ha, you sure are knowledgeable, girl. No wonder you’re the judge.
But besides a flame, one must also make use of an intricate refining
skill. I have taken out this flame to increase my rank. However, I dare
not aim for the crown.”

Liu Yizhen shook his hand with modesty, but his pride was no different
from one who thought of himself as the next Pill King.

[Hypocrite!]

Cursed the crowd, in particular, the alchemists who only had Yuan Qi
flames and were influenced by the mighty blaze.

He had a reason to be smug of course, with how strong his 4th level
spiritual beast flame was.

It not only increased his refining but also slowed down the others’ –
killing two birds with one stone. With such a flame, if two people were
of equal levels, one would have his refining boosted by two grades.

His confidence was well placed.

[Even you, Vicious Pill King! My flame will lower you from 7th grade to
6th.]

Everyone could make this educated guess just from looking at the
faltering flames around him.

Just when the crowd was focused on the battle between Vicious Pill King
and Zhuo Fan, it had now gotten even more confusing to whom the crown
would place their bets on.

Xiao Ya sighed and watched Liu Yizhen in admiration. He was the true
black horse of the Hundred Pill Meeting.

[He hid it well.]

She couldn’t help asking this though, “Grandmaster Liu, I heard that Sky
Blazing Python is very rare and strong as a Profound Heaven expert. May
I ask how you obtained its core’s flame?”

“Ha-ha-ha, that time was truly dangerous. About a year ago…”

“Humph, you’re so cocky with just a stinking snake flame?”

Just as Liu Yizhen was about to retell his grand and historical venture,
of the endless trials of hardship he had to go through, a snort stopped
him short.

Then marked by a humming, a small bluish flame flickered into existence.

Its appearance cut the size of all Yuan Qi flames in half. What was even
more astounding was the fact that even Liu Yizhen’s beast core flame
shuddered as it turned lifeless.

Crying out in shock, Liu Yizhen turned to find Yan Fu holding a raging
dark blue fire and sporting a condescending smile.

“T-this…”

Xiao Ya cried, “Is this a 5th level spiritual beast flame, from the Fire
Swallow?”

“Indeed!”

Yan Fu laughed coldly and mocked Liu Yizhen, “I have bested you in the
imperial capital, Old Liu, and I will do it again today. Don’t get
carried away in thinking the Pill King title is yours! Ha-ha-ha, how
laughable. You think you’re the only one in this world with a special
flame?”

Beet red, Liu Yizhen felt his anger boil but had no leeway to complain.

He had to admit that a top alchemist was more than capable of getting
himself a 4th level spiritual beast flame. The least of all Yan Fu, who
was Pill King Hall’s core disciple!

[Sigh, I was too naive.] In the end, who could compare with the Seven
Noble Houses?

Liu Yizhen gave a wistful sigh. Before he could rise completely, another
one came to knock him down to his place. Now recalling the smug look
from before, it only worked to color his face red.

“Uh, young master Yan, Fire Swallow is a 5th level spiritual beast that
even Radiant Stage experts have trouble defeating! How did you get its
flame?” Xiao Ya’s eyes were riveted on the flame.

Grinning, Yan Fu swept his eyes over Tao Danniang and the rest of
Drifting Flowers Edifice’s female disciples and laughed, “This flame was
bestowed by Pill King Hall to me, the greatest of its disciples. As for
how, humph, Pill King Hall needs only to want something and it will soon
have it.”

His words didn’t reach the average disciple because of the competition’s
noise, but Chu Qingcheng and her overseers heard it clearly, and glared
at him.

Even Tao Danniang’s green face turned gloomy and terrifying.

But he couldn’t care less as he began introducing it in his arrogance,
“Alchemy is the balance of yin and yang. Old Liu’s flame may perhaps be
from a 4th level spiritual beast, but the earth fire is too violent,
unfit for refining pills. My flame, on the contrary, is fire yet it
holds some water, it is also water yet it contains fire. Thus fire and
water combine and yin and yang intertwine. It is the most fitting flame
for alchemy. And only Pill King Hall’s men know how to find such a
flame, and so, the only ones who can be Pill King is…”

Suddenly, a green flame appeared before him.

The common Yuan Qi flames shrunk again, and Liu Yizhen with Yan Fu’s
spiritual beast flames were also cut down to size.

Emerging like a beast king from deep in the mountains, the other flames
prostrated before it.

Yan Fu squinted and looked at Tao Danniang’s green flame in shock,
“Y-you… that…”

“Humph, your Fire Swallow flame is best suited for alchemy? You will
first have to ask this 6th level spiritual beast flame of mine, the Moon
Fire Falcon’s flame.”

[What, a 6th level spiritual beast?]

This caused widespread shock.

Not even a Radiant Stage expert would dare mess with such a being. Just
how did Tao Danniang get hold of this marvel?

Xiao Ya grew happy inside. Tao Danniang was from Drifting Flowers
Edifice, after all, and praised, “Aunt Tao, how did you obtain the flame
of a 6th level spiritual beast?”

“Humph, girl, why ask when you already know. You think my old body has
the skill to go pull the life fire from the belly of a 6th level
spiritual beast?”

Tao Danniang cursed as she eyed Yan Fu, then the further away Vicious
Pill King. [Trying to shake Drifting Flowers Edifice’s prestige?] Then
she shouted, “This is a fire is passed down in the Drifting Flowers
Edifice to its best alchemist.”

“Girl, remember, this is not a flame that can be sought. The Moon Fire
Falcon flies thirty kilometers above and comes out at night to absorb
the moon’s yin while eating the spiritual herbs in the mountains. This
makes its flame have the essence of the moon. It can increase the grade
of a pill in refining. How can a mere Fire Swallow’s flame compare to
it?”

Under the guise of teaching Xiao Ya, Tao Danniang was in fact speaking
loudly to jab at Yan Fu.

Yan Fu gnashed his teeth but kept silent. A 5th level beast flame was a
cut short compared to a 6th level beast flame. Not to mention, the Moon
Fire Falcon ate many spiritual herbs in its life, making it far stronger
than Fire Swallow.

This ultimately made it unfit for comparison.

Tao Danniang stuck her chin out in pride and mocked, “Pill King title is
only fit for Pill King Hall, is it? Humph, punk, be careful of making
too big a boost and unable to back it up!”

Shuddering, Yan Fu glared at her as he barked, “Old hag, don’t get too
happy. I am just a junior, not your match in alchemy. But don’t forget,
I’m not the best alchemist in Pill King Hall. My master, Vicious Pill
King is.”

Yan Fu turned to Vicious Pill King and shouted, “Master, open the eyes
of these ignorant fools and let them see your true strength.”

The people turned their attention to Vicious Pill King, waiting for the
best alchemist in the empire to let out his best skill.

Only the few grandmaster alchemists who used Yuan Qi flames felt like
crying looking at the puny flames in their hands.

[Grandmasters, you’re all so rich you all have beast flames. But we are
dirt poor, using the weakest flame made of Yuan Qi.]

[Have some mercy and don’t take out an even more amazing flame or our
Yuan Qi flames won’t take it. We won’t even be able to cook rice, let
alone pills…]

Chapter 148 - Heaven and Earth Spirit Flame

Chapter 148, Heaven and Earth Spirit Flame

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

“Master…”

Yan Fu’s call echoed in everyone’s ears, but Vicious Pill King seemed
oblivious. His eyes fixed on one place only.

It happened even at Yan Fu’s second call.

Following his sight, what lay at the end was the first spot where Zhuo
Fan stood with his arms crossed and eyes closed.

In Vicious Pill King’s eyes, this opponent was the only one who could
light his competitive spirit.

Taking a deep breath, Vicious Pill King shouted, “Kid, don’t you have
any other special skills in store for this final round?”

Flashing his eyes open, Zhuo Fan shot him a look and snorted, “If yours
truly has or not, what’s it to you?”

“Quite a lot actually. I want to have a showdown with you, a fair
competition. If you’re still hiding your skills, then I shall be using
the flame that had been with me for years to win. But if this is all you
had to offer, I won’t take advantage of your plight. Even keeping my
flame hidden, I can still beat you just with a plain Yuan Qi flame.”

[Such bold words!]

The people’s hearts shivered, their faces gloomy.

If Vicious Pill King said this before, none would have anything to
comment. Just who could beat the best alchemist in the empire?

But now, after losing to Zhuo Fan three times, his words were akin to an
empty boast.

[Oh please, don’t you recall how Grandmaster Song, pissed, sneezed and
farted you out of the second spot? If not for wasting half of your
shriveled life, you’d never even be in this round!]

[It happened just a few minutes ago. Did you go senile, you old coot?]

Not only Chu Qingcheng looked derisory at him, but the rest of the
audience as well.

But Vicious Pill King only had eyes for Zhuo Fan. Anything else, even
the despising glances directed to him, were of no consequence.

Zhuo Fan squinted and snorted, “Humph, then let yours truly enlighten
you. I indeed have hidden one skill. Don’t you worry your old little
head about it and go all out. The title of Pill King will be mine
regardless.”

“Ha-ha-ha, alright. Then I shall rest easy. You are the first opponent
in decades that can make me exert all my ability in alchemy. Please,
after you.”

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan asked, “Why do you want me to go first?
Shouldn’t we both do it at the same time?”

With an ambiguous smile, Vicious Pill King showed a proud expression,
“Youngster, I’m not bragging when I say that even with your great
refining skill, you won’t finish that pill once I let out this old flame
of mine. In hope that you can exert your best, I will start after you
finish. It wouldn’t matter if I finish a bit later. This round is based
on the grade after all.”

Zhuo Fan’s mouth perked at one corner and almost laughed.

[The old coot has total confidence in his flame.] But so did he in
regards to his azure flame, his secret weapon. Just that it got him
wondering which was stronger, his azure flame or the old coot’s?

[There is no doubt. Mine is better.] It was one of those treasures that
the Demonic Emperor would covet.

Smiling, he said, “Since Elder Yan is so sure, by all means, take out
your flame and let us all widen our horizons. While also letting me know
if I should just give up right now.”

“Yeah, master, just let them see your might!” Yan Fu cheered.

Laughing, Vicious Pill King never felt more excited as of this moment,
“If you want to see it so much, then here it is.”

With a cackling laughter, a white fire burned in Vicious Pill King’s
thin hand. Then, a wicked face appeared within the flame.

That cackling laughter actually came from it.

Its appearance snuffed out all the Yuan Qi flames around. Liu Yizhen,
Yan Fu and Tao Danniang’s beast flames acted as if something dreadful
appeared and shrank to half their size, as if prostrating before their
king.

Shock was an understatement, as even Zhuo Fan’s eyelids trembled.

[Who knew this old guy was actually hiding something so valuable?]

“T-this…” Tao Danniang was scared out of her mind. Yan Fu raised his
head in pride and laughed, “Do you see that? This is the flame master
chanced upon a decade ago, the heaven and earth spirit flame, Bone Soul
Truefire!”

[A heaven and earth spirit flame?]

Sss~

Those words evoked gasps of sheer amazement from all around. The people
watched the evil face in Vicious Pill King’s hand and their hearts
sighed.

Even the alchemical disinclined knew that the heaven and earth spirit
flame was made from gathered spiritual energy of heaven and earth that
over millions of years and had gained spirituality. The flame was
actually alive, a veritable king among flames.

The 5th and 6th level beast flames were nothing compared to it.

The flame was the body while the wicked face was the spirit of the Bone
Soul Truefire. It not only could refine any kind of ingredient but also
amplify their effects and raise the grade of the pill. It was every
alchemist’s dream to have one.

Vicious Pill King was the best alchemist in Tianyu for a reason after
all. Now, no matter what secret refining skill Zhuo Fan used it, would
be of no importance.

Did you not see how the Yuan Qi flames got snuffed, they couldn’t stand
its power. Even those beast flames were shirking away.

Three things were of most importance to an alchemist, cultivation,
refining skills, and flame. When the flame was wilted from the pressure
of another, winning was impossible!

Sighing, the people turned to Zhuo Fan, shaking their heads in pity.

[How sad, an extraordinary alchemist was so close to beating the best
alchemist in Tianyu but under the flame’s suppression, failure is
imminent. If he fails here, we will lose another genius. The Heavens
must be truly jealous of geniuses.]

The thought didn’t even cross their mind if Zhuo Fan, with how young he
was, and his background, had a flame that could counter Vicious Pill
King’s heaven and earth spirit flame.

Since not even the seven houses could pass along such flames. This old
guy’s luck had to be off the charts to stumble upon the Bone Soul
Truefire.

Sensing everyone’s fear and awe of it, the white flame’s face cackled
madly in excitement. The laughter was jarring to the ear and filled with
boundless despise. Just like a ruler who won andlorded over his enemies.

He-he-he…

Tao Danniang sighed and closed her eyes. If she knew the old man to have
such a spirit item, she wouldn’t have wasted her energy and just gave
up.

Then again, now that she recalled, the one who won three times against
Vicious Pill King was none other than him.

Tao Danniang turned to Zhuo Fan and shook her head.

[Not even the brat can get out of this one…]

Chu Qingcheng frowned in worry. She was looking at Zhuo in hope he had a
way to turn it all around. But Zhuo Fan’s face never wavered. He was
always calm, as if he was in deep thought.

The overseers were beside themselves in worry. Only Long Jiu’s group was
unphased. According to Zhuo Fan’s plan, winning wasn’t a must. At worst
he’d just bolt.

On the eastern stand, Huangpu Qingyun’s group had long since started
laughing.

“The old man actually had such a treasure hidden. Losing now is
impossible, ha-ha-ha…” Huangpu Qingyun laughed, “Vicious Pill King is
definitely worthy of his title!”

The others nodded, with the happiest being Lin Zitian.

At some point, he tied his fate with Vicious Pill King over a reason not
he was sure of. But now that Vicious Pill King was at an advantage, the
second young master was excited and he was basking in the glory nearby.

“Elder Lin!” Huangpu Qingyun smiled.

Lin Zitian rushed next to him, “Yes!”

“The moment the kid loses, rush over, and take his head. Understandd?”

Startled, Lin Zitian said, “Why me? Isn’t Elder Yan supposed to do
this?”

Squinting, Huangpu Qingyun snorted, “If he were to move, Qingcheng would
be sure to block him. I do not wish to further alienate her from me.
Your Merry Woods is focusing on speed, so taking the kid’s head in an
instant is easy. Qingcheng would be enraged but would not dare to make
everything worse over a dead man.”

Realizing what he meant, Lin Zitian gave a thumbs up, “Nice, second
young master is truly wise!”

The other men felt their stomachs churning as they secretly cursed him
for being shameless.

Huangpu Qingyun’s smile seemed to say everything was dancing in his
palm.

But just then, the crowd froze in shock seeing Vicious Pill King’s flame
swayed around Zhuo as he laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, brat, now you know why I
told you to go first? Even if you have a beast flame, it won’t do you
any good with my Bone Soul Truefire out.”

“Didn’t you want to get your hands on the Bodhi Root?” Zhuo Fan was
still calm.

Taking a deep breath, Vicious Pill King seemed to recall something and
laughed, “Yes, I indeed want it. But what I want more is to win against
you fair and square. To see who among us shall be the best alchemist in
Tianyu. Defeating you because of the flame’s power is not something I
will ever accept.”

Zhuo Fan looked long at him.

[He may be shameless and despicable, cunning and vicious, but when all
is said and done he is a tough grandmaster alchemist. It’s kind of a
pity for him to be in the Pill King Hall.]

Chapter 149 - The Monarchic Azure Flame

Chapter 149, The Monarchic Azure Flame

A wicked grin plastered on his face, Zhuo Fan seemed to have something
special in store.

Yan Fu’s heart seized. He understood his master’s intention and wanted
to advise against it, but Vicious Pill King shook his hand.

“Did the old fart turn senile?” Huangpu Qingyun sensed the situation
spiraling into an undesirable direction and clenched his fists.

Lin Zitian wiped the cold sweat from his brows, his mind was on edge.

[Old coot! You’re vile and wicked, so why the hell are you doing the
exact opposite at a crucial time like this? Cut the righteous act, both
our lives are at stake here!]

Catching the eastern stand’s people’s reaction with a side glance, Zhuo
Fan swiveled his eyes on Vicious Pill King, “Old man, I appreciate the
thought, but there really is no need for that. It’s best you go ahead
and refine.”

Vicious Pill King stared at Zhuo Fan in astonishment.

Zhuo Fan’s words were backed by unfaltering confidence. He did not
propose to do it together and see who was stronger but directly urged
Yan Song to go fist.

[Does he have an even stronger flame than Bone Soul Truefire?]

[He fears that his flame will affect my own.]

Vicious Pill King’s heart trembled, but he couldn’t find it in himself
to believe that the world could house a stronger flame than the heaven
and earth spirit flame.

“Ha-ha-ha! Youngster, don’t brag. Taking your age and background into
account, the most you can afford is a 4th level beast flame. You think
it’s enough to stand toe to toe with mine?”

Vicious Pill King was probing Zhuo Fan, who only smiled.

Such action only made Zhuo Fan look more mysterious that even the rest
were at a loss for words. [You’re telling us that Grandmaster Song has a
mystical flame that can stand against your Bone Soul Truefire?]

[This would make the final round more exciting.]

[Two grandmasters, two heaven and earth spirit flames, fighting toe to
toe for the crown.]

In a blink, the crowd’s nervous eyes landed on Zhuo Fan, eagerly
awaiting his answer. Chu Qingcheng and the overseers were especially
nervous.

In terms of refining skills, Zhuo Fan was a cut above Yan Song. Coupled
with a possible heaven and earth spirit flame, this could all work to
compensate for his weak cultivation.

Only Xie Tianyang felt disdained as he laughed, “Don’t go and believe
his hosh-posh people. That brat is up to his neck in faking again. He is
in a battle of minds with the old man. I’ve seen this trick too many
times to count.”

Long Jiu and the rest nodded.

With how deep and twisted the kid’s plans went, it was very much
plausible to be a tactic of his to unnerve Yan Song.

Today’s events proved it. Yan Song himself suffered at Zhuo Fan’s
schemes again and again, making him grow cautious.

After some careful thought, he laughed, “Kid, I am frank with you but
yet you still use such petty tricks to mess with my head. The same
tactic won’t work on me again.”

“What makes you think I am?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.

“Humph, by no means do you have a heaven and earth spirit flame, perhaps
not even a beast flame. You are only pretending so as to disturb my
mind. You used these cheap tricks in the previous two rounds already,
and you want to do it again?”

Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Vicious Pill King, you have such a
low opinion of me. You take yours truly as nothing but a vicious and
petty schemer whose plans only amount to lying about having a heaven and
earth spirit flame to mess with your head? Is that what you think my
plans amount to? I’m hurt!”

Pausing, Vicious Pill King realized it was indeed so.

Zhuo Fan may have sneezed and farted, nothing but petty tricks, but it
hit right when it hurt him the most. Each and every time, his focus
crumbled at the most crucial moment. If his mind was not as strong, he
would’ve long devolved into chaos, unable to continue refining.

Compared to the last two times, Zhuo Fan’s words now were a bit
disbelieving, but not enough to affect his mind.

This only threw Vicious Pill King into even deeper confusion.

In his eyes, Zhuo Fan had become an enigma, whose every gesture and
random act were filled with intricate mysteries. Never had he
encountered such a baffling opponent in his life.

[Damn it, who’d have thought picking a fight with this punk would end up
becoming a torment.]

Vicious Pill King couldn’t come to a conclusion even after some long and
hard thinking. He just gnashed his teeth in the end and howled, “Brat,
no matter what flame you have, take it out. I want to have a fair match
with you so stop jumping at every shadow!”

“It is because I have the same wish that I do not want to reveal it. I
still insist on letting you go first.” Zhuo Fan sneered, “If I do take
it out, you might lose your desire to even compete. Starting together
would end in your loss, no doubt about it.”

His words sounded even more cocksure than Vicious Pill King’s from
before. They were so outrageous that none of the people there believed
him.

[A flame that can cow the best alchemist in the empire to surrender just
at the sight of it, does it even exist?]

Not even Vicious Pill King was that outrageous before pulling out his
white flame.

[Dude, take a closer look. He holds the lord of the flames, a heaven and
earth spirit flame. Even if you have the same kind of fire, it will only
result in a tie.]

[Even if by some off chance it is stronger, how much could it actually
be compared to Yan Song’s?]

[You’re saying your flame is so freakish that it can suppress a heaven
and earth spirit flame just as the latter suppresses beast flames?]

[Did the world even have such a thing?]

“Humph, he’s clearly faking and bragging yet none of his words sound
believable.” Xie Tianyang mocked.

Vicious Pill King laughed, “Kid, you take me for a three-year-old? The
world does not have such a savage flame. If you can take it out, then I
will directly kowtow three…”

Suddenly, his voice was choked with the appearance of an azure flame
above two of Zhuo Fan’s fingers. It was as calm as candlelight,
unimpressive in the slightest.

But this plain azure flame descended on the world like a monarch. Its
invisible pressure befell like a mountain.

The cackling Bone Soul Truefire now seemed to have found its nemesis and
scurried back into Vicious Pill King’s body, never to come out again.

Not even at Vicious Pill King’s incessant urgings.

If a heaven and earth spirit flame was so decisive, then Liu Yizhen’s,
Yan Fu’s and Tao Danniang’s beast flames were even worse.

They had no spirituality but they nonetheless trembled under the azure
fire’s pressure and died out.

When the monarch of flames descended, no common flame dared to burn!

All the fires died out in a blink, even the other alchemists’.

Only Zhuo Fan’s frail azure flame let out a soft glow.

The shock was incomprehensible. Even Vicious Pill King stared
slackjawed.

“W-what is this? The heaven and earth spirit flame ran?” Vicious Pill
King’s body was swaying. He was the owner of Bone Soul Truefire and
could feel it shivering in fear, “What flame is that?”

Zhuo Fan looked at his azure flame with a smile, “Who knows? It’s been
given to me anyway.”

His cheeks twitching, Vicious Pill King trembled.

[Why is it that I wasn’t lucky enough to have someone give me such a
strong flame?]

When he chanced upon the Bone Soul Truefire, he’d been so thrilled he
couldn’t sleep a wink for how much fortune smiled upon him. He could’ve
died happy!

But here, now, in Zhuo Fan’s presence, his bit of luck was lackluster,
to say the least.

“Now, do you still want to refine?” Zhuo Fan snickered, letting the
azure flame sway in front of him.

Vicious Pill King’s eyes reddened from envy. How the hell could he still
refine? His entire mind was set on that frail flame.

He was almost consumed by the desire to just seize it.

Zhuo Fan laughed, knowing perfectly well what Yan Song was thinking,
“Now do you believe me? Well then, Vicious Pill King, let me ask you.
Who’s the petty one?”

Vicious Pill King felt like crying.

[Goddamn it! This punk is unfathomable! Three rounds ago he spoke not a
grain of truth and now he said the most unbelievable things yet it turns
out to be the whole and unfurnished truth!]

[Curses! His plots are too sinister for me to unravel!]

Despite being filled with regret, Vicious Pill King still reddened as he
admitted, “Pardon me, Grandmaster Song. I have wrongly mistaken a
gentleman for being petty.”

“Ha-ha-ha, lighten up. It’s enough to know that I’m a perfect
gentleman.”

Zhuo Fan laughed and not only made the old man redden harder from shame
but even flaunted, “Then, wanna go ahead and refine? Or maybe,
together?”

[You joking? Refine with you? How, when any and all flames were snuffed
because of yours?]

[I get why this punk said there was no competition if both refined
together!]

Vicious Pill King sighed and admitted it despite the humiliation it
brought, “Pardons, Grandmaster Song. I was overconfident. I shall go
ahead and refine first.”

“Alright. With my generous nature, I shall let you begin.”

Zhuo Fan smiled and took back his azure flame while crossing his arms.
Even so, he couldn’t help himself from muttering, “Stingy, how
unreasonable!”

His voice may have been soft, but all heard him.

Vicious Pill King staggered. He was truly pissed but felt more aggrieved
than anything else.

[I rarely want a fair fight and what do I get? Humiliation. Being good
is not all that cracked up to be.]

He was oblivious though that as he was feeling sorry for himself. Zhuo
Fan nodded in his mind and his mouth widened into a broad and satisfied
smile…

Chapter 150 - Authority

Chapter 150, Authority

>

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

“Holy cow, he wasn’t faking! The brat did have a card up his sleeve!”

On the terrace, Xie Tianyang stumbled. Then it hit him, “Right, he used
the same azure flame against You Guiqi too. I took it as some martial
art at the time but now I see that it’s actually a heaven and earth
treasure…”

It all made sense now, how he faced Hell Valley’s profound ranked
martial art and easily overcame it.

The azure flame could easily handle a heaven and earth spirit flame so
it was only natural to be able to deal with You Guiqi’s wicked skill…

Xie Tianyang found himself looking at Long Jiu, “This brat has so much
stuff on him that makes him a walking treasury. Are you sure he’s only a
third rate clan kid?”

“Why are you looking at me for? I’m as clueless as you are!” Long Jiu
snorted then kept watching Zhuo Fan.

Veiled Dragon Pavilion had looked again and again into Zhuo Fan’s
history but they always came with the same answer. A servant that never
left the Luo clan.

Yet the night of the Luo clan’s demise marked his complete change.

A mere servant took the four-membered Luo clan and pulled it through the
crisis. Along the path of remarkable wisdom and deep schemes, he changed
the fate of the Luo clan; turning it into a future opponent for the
Seven Noble Houses.

Veiled Dragon Pavilion weren’t fools, of course, especially Long Jiu.
Their new hatred for Hell Valley was all because Zhuo Fan instigated it.

Yet, even so, they were willing to take this burden for him.

First, just as Zhuo Fan predicted, Veiled Dragon Pavilion was not about
to show weakness before their archenemy, Hell Valley. With how deep
their hatred was, adding one more debt was of little concern.

Not to mention, in the great battle of Windgaze City, making them carry
the killing of those two elders was in fact a favor. Even when he was
summoned by the Emperor, the Pavilion Lord was grinning from ear to ear.

It had been years since Pavilion Lord was this excited.

And secondly, Zhuo Fan’s power shocked every one of them to the marrow.
Even Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s highly ranked men started discussing with
Zhuo Fan when he was but a Qi Condensation cultivator.

None of them could’ve come with a more perfect plan than his.

Sowing dissension, escaping, bidding his time to land the final blow—it
all may have seemed simple tactics but their execution would’ve been far
from his.

This was something easily understood by reading the two houses’
millennia-long feud.

Moreover, Zhuo Fan was very skilled. Not only he could set up a
5th-grade array, but he also had many long lost ancient arrays.

After so many miracles, Pavilion Lord’s quick decision to cooperate with
Zhuo Fan was met with no objection. And that was only because this kid’s
actions left everyone unable to unravel his true purpose!

From the looks of it, Zhuo Fan’s change seemed to have started from that
fateful night.

Before it, he was just an honest-to-god and shy servant. After it, he
changed into the sinister and cunning steward that none in the seven
houses could compare with.

That night was the crux. But what did happen that night?

Taking a deep breath, Long Jiu was filled with confusion trying to pick
some hints by looking at the smug figure, only to sigh in the end.

[He may very well be the only one who knows the answer to this riddle…]

Totally oblivious of Long Jiu group’s comments, the overseers had long
been skipping in joy at seeing Vicious Pill King taken down a peg,
again.

Just like some 16-year-old girls, blushing to the ears.

This was the finals after all. Pushing the old man back would help in
increasing his chance of winning it.

Xiao Dandan had never seen her senior aunt and master so happy in her
life. She knew they were happy and so was she, raising her pretty face
in pride.

As if to tell the world, [Here comes my man!]

As Chu Qingcheng saw that figure growing in authority, her heart grew
with love, though still reserved enough not to be so frank about it as
Xiao Dandan. But her eyes couldn’t hide the warmth and feelings she had
for him.

On the eastern stand, Huangpu Qingyun’s elegant visage was now twisted
in rage.

Even the most oblivious of his men could see he was best left alone, if
they valued their life.

But did that mean he wouldn’t come to you by himself?

“Elder Lin!” Huangpu Qingyun squinted and snapped.

Lin Zitian shivered and stood at attention, though his heart was on the
verge of crying, “Second young master, orders?”

“Didn’t you promise me that the old fool will win? Well, where is his
win? He quoted fairness and offered to let the punk refine first, only
to be shamed further. What fairness? He wouldn’t have brought more shame
on himself if someone else did that to him…”

“Second young master, Elder Yan isn’t the only one at fault.” Lin Zitian
spoke over Huangpu Qingyun to curb his anger, or he would’ve been sent
into the fray sooner than needed. At that time, that bastard Vicious
Pill King would’ve been long gone and he unable to deal with the kid
alone. To safeguard his life, he had to speak up.

He continued anxiously, “Second young master, you saw it too. It’s not
Elder Yan who is powerless but that punk is just too… too freakish!”

Lin Zitian stammered for a long time before coming with an apt
description, “The heaven and earth spirit flame is the lord of the
flames. But who saw it coming that the brat would pull an even more
freakish flame rendering the lord of the flames inferior. None of us
did!”

Huangpu Qingyun rose his hand at first but soon put it down. He had
calmed down somewhat after those words, though his calmness was one that
inspired fear. He looked at Zhuo Fan, “Indeed, this is not on Elder Yan,
but all because that brat is… too strong!”

This was the first time Huangpu Qingyun admitted Zhuo Fan’s strength.

His men trembled. Their second young master was a man of immense pride
who never acknowledged anyone.

Yet here he was praising someone for their strength and was also quite
sincere at it.

Perhaps, Huangpu Qingyun’s anger wasn’t because of Yan Song’s setback,
but his unwillingness to admit someone could have the same authority as
him.

This was something a proud and domineering man like himself would never
allow to happen.

Therefore, they all looked at Zhuo Fan as if he was already dead.

And sure enough, Huangpu Qingyun followed with, “Elder Lin, there’s no
need to act anymore. I will kill that brat myself.”

“Uh, then what of Edifice Lord Chu…”

Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes flashed with naked killing intent, “I want to
avoid fighting with Qingcheng, but I can never find peace until I kill
the kid myself!”

His men’s hearts shivered as they nodded.

Whoosh~

Vicious Pill King let out his white flame again and Xiao Ya rushed to
stop him, “Forgive me, Elder Yan, but because of your flame and the
beast flames, the other alchemists can’t refine. So, to give a fair
judgment I can only ask all of you to refine one at a time, from weak to
strong.”

“Humph, you want me to give way to them?”

Vicious Pill King snored, “Why should I? It won’t matter even if my
flame doesn’t affect them! They don’t rise to even one hair of mine!
Giving way to them means wasting my time.”

Tao Danniang grew angry and glared at him. Yan Fu snickered at the side,
finding it only natural.

His master was the best in the empire, except the unknown kid that
sprung up from who knew where. Who else could match his master?

The alchemists, Liu Yizhen included, were livid, but facts were facts.
They had no ways to refute Vicious Pill King and could only sigh.

Xiao Ya found herself in a tight spot.

What was planned to be the finals between ten people, now became a clash
of two. Were the other eight alchemists mere decorations to make them
look good? What was the point of getting this far then?

Too bad Vicious Pill King was the best alchemist in the empire and was
dead set on his decision. The judge could do nothing.

In Xiao Ya’s moment of anxiety and stomping, a lazy voice echoed.

“Old man, since it’s a competition, give them a chance. Why do you have
to be so hard?”

This startled everyone and turned to see Zhuo Fan still with his arms
crossed and eyes closed, but smiling nonetheless.

Frowning, Vicious Pill King muttered then withdrew his flame.

Those alchemists who had it rough with just their Yuan Qi flames were
overjoyed. While the others looked at Vicious Pill King dumbfounded.

Even Yan Fu looked at Vicious Pill King as if he wasn’t his master.

Since when did his prideful master secede just like that because someone
said so? [This is mortifying!]

But the fact was, one word from Zhuo Fan was enough to make the grand
and arrogant Vicious Pill King renounce his pride.

“What’s going on? Did the old man get a personality change?” Up in the
eastern stand, Hell Valley’s fifth elder was filled with puzzlement like
everyone else.

What they didn’t notice, however, was Huangpu Qingyun’s even thicker
killing intent!

Perhaps he was the sole person here who understood authority.

It was what made others submit completely!

He wielded the same authority, an obvious fact from the people around
him that listened to his orders without question. But this authority was
bestowed by Regent Estate. As these men submitted to Regent Estate’s
power, he could only thus order them.

More clearly stated, they spoke yes while their hearts were against it.

Only Huangpu Qingyun understood that Zhuo Fan had become the man with
the most authority here. And his authority was based on the true
submission of everyone present. Vicious Pill King was the perfect
example, seceding with just some words.

It was all because from the very beginning he grasped everyone’s hearts,
letting them take one step at a time in growing their faith in him.

This was the true way of the ruling class in seizing authority.

At first Huangpu Qingyun’s killing intent at Zhuo Fan was rather hazy.
He guessed it was because of a conflict of interest. But now he clearly
wanted Zhuo Fan dead. After Lin Zitian spoke and Zhuo Fan showed a
monarchic flame, he understood perfectly why Zhuo Fan had to die.

He wasn’t as narrow-minded as others thought him to be, that he couldn’t
stand someone more powerful them him. His decision to kill Zhuo Fan was
because of the feeling he got from the latter. Every time Zhuo Fan did
something, it was like an open challenge to his authority.

How could a regent’s authority be so easily challenged?

A mountain wasn’t big enough for two tigers. With two people knowing the
way to grasp the hearts of the people, they would fight over authority
and only one would come out victorious.

Zhuo Fan had long noticed the killing intent coming from the eastern
stand, but he was unfazed as ever, even sporting a scornful grin…

Chapter 151 - Clinging

Chapter 151, Clinging

Going with Xiao Ya’s proposal, the first to start were the five
grandmasters who used Yuan Qi flames. They hastily took out their flames
and gave a sign of gratitude at the other grandmasters.

Although they were ranked among the best alchemists in Tianyu Empire,
Zhuo Fan showed up with his heaven-defying refining skill that made them
look as common as muck.

This was clearly showed through the yawns of the crowd.

Their refining resulted in three high and two mid 5th grade pills. Not
one could go higher than 5th grade.

The third round had such a grade as the target. Showing it now, in the
finals, robbed them of any chance at getting the first place.

They knew of their limits but chose to do it anyway so they could catch
the eyes of some powerful clans.

Grinning, Yan Fu patronized, “Master was right after all. Letting those
idiots go first was a total waste of time.”

He threw Liu Yizhen a side glance and sneered, “Lu old man, weren’t you
bragging about using your 4th level beast flame to freakin press us all
down into making a 5th-grade pill?”

“He-he-he, I have no intention to be Pill King. Just getting ahead of a
twerp like you and washing away the disgrace is enough.” Liu Yizhen said
as he caressed his beard.

Yan Fu seemed to have heard the biggest joke ever, “Ha-ha-ha, old man,
losing is losing. What are you doing tacking that cocky tone? Not to
mention, my beast flame is stronger than yours. And you still think of
besting me?”

“Humph, alchemy isn’t based on flame alone. Last time I lost in terms of
speed, but when it comes to refining abilities, I am above you, twerp.”

Liu Yizhen’s hand burned with his beast flame as he threw in all kinds
of ingredients. Yan Fu had a constant sneer on his face.

As seconds trickled by, the scarlet flame blazed constantly,
illuminating Liu Yizhen’s hard red face. Suddenly, Liu Yizhen spat a
blood arrow into the flame.

The fire exploded and a scarlet pill twirled in the air before he caught
it.

Liu Yizhen ignored the blood on his mouth as he gasped. He glowered at
Yan Fu and revealed a crazy smile as he showed the pill.

“Brat! Tell me, what grade is this?”

Yan Fu stared at the old man and gnashed his teeth in reply. But Xiao Ya
yelped, “Grandmaster Liu refined a high 6th-grade pill!”

[Say what?]

The audience was in an uproar. Grandmaster Liu was a 5th-grade
alchemist, but he actually managed to refine a 6th-grade pill. This was
something not even a fresh 6th-grade alchemist could pull off.

Was it really all because of the 4th level beast flame? Could it be…

Whoosh~

Yan Fu cut their second-guessing short by letting his blue flame out.
The raging tongue of flame shined in his pair of eyes as if they
themselves contained a deep fire within.

Whoosh~

Ingredients flew into it one after another, refining and mixing. He did
it with such practiced ease that it looked no different than eating,
earning no few praises.

Zhuo Fan was too awesome earlier, so Liu Yizhen and Yan Fu’s limelight
got smothered. People now bore witness to a youth, who, while not as
freakish as Zhuo Fan, was by all intents and purposes a genius of
alchemy.

He was indeed an expert alchemist hailing from Pill King Hall!

Suddenly, Yan Fu also bit his tongue and spat blood essence. It fused
with the blue flame in a blink.

Liu Yizhen’s pupils contracted as his weak body trembled. His lips
parted but no words could come out from the sheer shock that grasped his
mind.

Whoosh!

The fire vanished and a bluish pill shined. He grabbed it and showed it
to Liu Yizhen. Yan Fu was pale and blood dripped from his mouth,
painting a gruesome image when coupled with his smile, “Old man, tell
me, what grade is this?”

Looking closely, Liu Yizhen shook his head sullenly. He was now too
dejected to even reply.

Yan Fu let out an unrestrained laughter.

Xiao Ya flicked closer and looked in shock, “Young master Yan Fu refined
a low 7th-grade pill!”

[What?!]

The audience exploded. [There was now another 7th-grade alchemist in the
Pill King Hall besides Vicious Pill King? And one so young at that?]

At the side, Tao Danniang couldn’t help sucking her teeth.

[They’re both insane. They have no shot at becoming the Pill King with
Vicious Pill King around so why still refine with blood essence? Is
their grudge so deep to warrant such illogical action?]

Losing a drop of blood essence meant an injured vitality that could
persist through years. If one was careless in their recovery, it could
lead to permanent damage, worse would be stunted cultivation.

An alchemist would never use such a method unless the situation was
dire.

[Vicious Pill King did it to barely qualify. You two, however, the hell
you just up and harmed yourself for some simple refining?]

Tao Danniang cursed them inside but was in fact hesitating.

She was a 6th-grade alchemist who should’ve had no problem with these
two. But god knew what got into them, using their blood essence to
refine. Yan Fu even managed to land a 7th-grade pill.

If she too didn’t bleed, Yan Fu would win. [What goddamned face will I
have left then?]

Gnashing her teeth and stomping, Tao Danniang’s eyes flashed with
resolve and the green flame appeared in her hand.

[I’ve been at this even before you were born. You think I have lost my
touch?]

Ingredients spiraled inside the flame. When it was almost done, she also
bit her tongue and spat a blood arrow.

When the flame died out, Tao Danniang’s weak body reached for the pill
with a gleeful smile.

“Heavens! It’s a mid 7th-grade pill!”

Xiao Ya’s outcry agitated the crowd. Only Yan Fu and Liu Yizhen looked
at her puzzled.

“Old hag, we decided on settling our accounts from the imperial capital
alchemy competition. So what are you trying to pull?”

Ugh!

Tao Danniang almost spat blood in anger. But seeing the two of them
confused, her face went red and tried to cover it with a snort, “I’ll
have you know that there is a mountain beyond a mountain as there’s
someone above another. You too have a long way to go. Don’t let yourself
caught up in thinking only you two exist in this contest. You need to
set your eyes further into the distance. There are many adversaries
ahead.”

Tao Danniang sighed and through this lesson, she recovered her bearing.

But the two weren’t grateful in the least.

“Old hag, we focused on each other because we wish to settle a score.
How does this have anything to do with you?”

Yan Fu raised an eyebrow and spoke vaguely, “You think we don’t know of
mountains beyond mountains and someone above another? Aren’t they
clearly master and that brat? What’s the point of even saying it?”

Liu Yizhen nodded in full accord. [These two are prime examples. What
are you trying to teach us?]

Tao Danniang sank into silence, lost for words.

Seeing the two of them sporting wise gazes, she was itching to kick
them. [You think I’d waste blood essence to uphold my reputation if it
weren’t for you two morons doing it first in your dumb fight?]

[I wanted out of this awkward situation with my name intact, but you
bastards aren’t even giving me that.]

[Speaking of which, I can expect it from this prick, Yan Fu, since he’s
from Pill King Hall. But what of you, Liu Yizhen? So old and you don’t
know how to show some respect?]

Tao Danniang gnashed her teeth in rage.

But no one cared about her.

At this moment, all eyes were on Vicious Pill King. Despite this round
being a showdown between ten contestants, it was in fact between only
two.

Squinting, Vicious Pill King stared hard at Zhuo Fan.

Whoosh~

With an evil laughter, the Bone Soul Truefire reemerged. He was in no
hurry to throw ingredients in, choosing to spit blood essence again.

“Master, no!” Yan Fu cried.

Vicious Pill King already did this in the third round, harming himself.
If he did it again then he would be left with scarring injury, or worse,
die from severe trauma.

But Vicious Pill King no longer cared.

How often did he meet a real opponent? To defeat Zhuo Fan, his greatest
adversary, he was willing to do everything he could, even pay with his
life.

Vicious Pill King then threw ingredients in the flame, getting it
refined in an instant in the Bone Soul Truefire, mixing along with his
blood essence.

Suddenly, Vicious Pill King spat blood essence again.

This shocked even Tao Danniang. [Has the old man lost it? It may
increase the pill’s grade greatly but it will also threaten his life.]

Vicious Pill King hardly cared. His eyes filled with endless madness…

Yan Fu fell to his knees, with tears streaming down his cheeks, “Master,
what happened to you…”

Whoosh~

Only now did the ever relaxed Zhuo Fan open his eyes, watching Vicious
Pill King with an even gaze.

But noticing Zhuo Fan watching him, it got Vicious Pill King even more
excited…
