Chapter 152 - Cradle Returning Dragons

Chapter 152, Cradle Returning Dragons

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

Whoosh~

The raging flame made a clear contrast with Vicious Pill King’s wane
face. The once imposing and tough old man now appeared frail and with
one foot in the grave. His body swayed in the breeze, a moment away from
collapsing.

But he clenched his teeth and persevered. He grinned at Zhuo Fan, who
was looking back at him, with excitement.

As if to challenge Zhuo Fan, Vicious Pill King’s gestures changed and
the flame soared.

Losing blood essence three times in a day along with supplying so much
Yuan Qi had taken its toll on his aged body. Sweat began to fall from
not just his face as his hands grew paler and seemed to age with the
naked eye.

But his eyes danced in joy as he saw the pill slowly form within the
flame.

His behavior even stirred the sympathy of those who hated him to the
core, including Chu Qingcheng and the overseers.

“Vicious Pill King is vile and twisted, but one had to admit his alchemy
skill is worthy of admiration. He lives up to his name as the first
alchemist in the empire.” Long Jiu sighed in praise.

The others nodded, watching Vicious Pill King with the same feelings.

Despite being on opposite sides, a hero was worthy of respect.

Bone Soul Truefire was indeed a heaven and earth spirit flame. And in
the expert hands of Vicious Pill King, the pill was completed in no time
at all.

The pill was ready to be taken out of the inferno.

But right at this moment, Vicious Pill King spat more blood essence!

Everyone was nervous when it entered the fire. A humming spread and the
Bone Soul Truefire burned hotter.

At the same time, a pill shined brightly and flew out of the fire with a
cackle. The sound of the laughter was in fact the same as Bone Soul
Truefire’s.

“Vicious Pill King bestowed the pill with spirituality!” Long Jiu sighed
in amazement. The others looked on in shock at the incredible dancing
pill.

It was a known fact that a heaven and earth spirit flame could instill
spirituality into a pill, but doing it was a whole another matter.

In Tianyu Empire’s thousand-year-old history, there had been accounts of
alchemists possessing a heaven and earth spirit flame, but none of them
were able to refine a living pill.

This rumor came from outside the borders. But for such an alchemist to
appear even after such a long time, it was still rarer than rare. The
entire continent might not have had such a genius appearing over the
last half millennia.

But Vicious Pill King had done it!

Zhuo Fan with his dazzling performance had made the people neglect this
number one alchemist in the empire. But now he used his power to prove
he was still the best.

With a gesture, the pill entered his hand and Vicious Pill King’s hair
started swirling in the air. He slowly raised the pill in Zhuo Fan’s
direction, his eyes recovering their pride and arrogance.

He was weakened but let the people see this old man teetering towards
collapse like a lofty giant.

“T-this…”

Xiao Ya opened and closed her mouth speechless. In the end, she finally
managed to express her doubt, “Odd, the pill looks to be above the 7th
grade but not quite in the 8th. What does it mean?”

Squinting, Vicious Pill King didn’t respond. Only stared rivetingly at
Zhuo Fan.

It was an open provocation.

Chuckling, Zhuo Fan said, “It is without a doubt a 7th-grade pill,
albeit a perfect one. If you insist on defining it, you can call it a
grade skipping pill. But it is in fact this kind of pill the hardest to
refine in one’s alchemical journey. It may be a 7th-grade pill, but it’s
worth supersedes a common 8th-grade pill.”

The crowd was in complete shock!

This was their first time hearing of a 7th grade pill that exceeded an
8th grade pill. Even some low-grade alchemists were dumbstruck.

Though the 5th-grade alchemists and above were fully aware of the
reason.

There were, in fact, some alchemists who had a hundred percent chance of
refining 5th-grade pills that could touch upon how to reach the perfect
quality. But never, even after they entered the 6th grade, had they
achieved it.

Thus 6th grade pills were easy to refine, while perfect 5th-grade pills
were nigh impossible.

To them, refining a grade surpassing pill was a talent among talents.

Talent was already needed to become a high-grade alchemist, but for
refining a perfect pill one had to be a genius.

It was clear Vicious Pill King was such a man.

In an instant, the people’s image of Vicious Pill King grew
exponentially.

Vicious Pill King, however, didn’t care about such things. His eyes were
on one man only. That man was the sole person qualified to make him
stake his life in this competition.

Following his eyes, the crowd’s sight landed on Zhuo Fan. They now knew
why Vicious Pill King went all out in this refining, even risking his
life to make a perfect pill. It was all to beat the strongest opponent
he ever had.

They were all watching Zhuo Fan eager to see his reaction.

A clash between heavyweights, a match among peak grandmaster alchemists
was a rare occurrence. After today, none may get the chance to see
another again. This only worked to raise their spirits higher.

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan began pondering.

None disturbed him either in the deafening silence that ensued. Yet the
people’s eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, not leaving him for even a blink.

With gloom ever-present on his face, Huangpu Qingyun’s killing intent
only grew. The more Zhuo Fan could grasp the hearts of the people, the
more threatened he felt of his authority.

He was certain of one thing, Zhuo Fan had to be dealt with.

Long Jiu’s group frowned, waiting for Zhuo Fan’s next move. Chu
Qingcheng and the overseers watched on edge.

The strangest thing that happened was Chu Qingcheng no longer cared
about the prevalent grudge between Pill King Hall and Drifting Flowers
Edifice. Her mind was solely preoccupied with Zhuo Fan, of how he would
respond to Vicious Pill King.

In this tense atmosphere, even the crowd forgot this was an alchemy
contest, only caring about the match between two peak grandmaster
alchemists.

It mattered not who won, because they were waiting for the two of them
to give them the shock of their lives.

After a moment of deep thought, Zhuo Fan let out a long breath and his
face revealed a mysterious grin, “So that’s how it is. Let’s give it a
try.”

Chuckling, he turned to Vicious Pill King, “Any man who spat blood
essence five times is bound to die. Old man, you did it four times
today, which was quite impressive. If I don’t get it together and show
something special, I would only be insulting you.”

“You are correct!” Vicious Pill King grinned fearlessly and as excited
as before.

There was nothing more thrilling than seeing one’s greatest opponent
answering his challenge by going all out.

Zhuo Fan noticed his excitement and chuckled as he walked next to his
cauldron.

With him moving, so did the countless pairs of eyes. Zhuo Fan was now
the center of attention, the life of the party. His every gesture
stirring the hearts of many.

Rustle~

He leisurely lit up the fire and snapped his finger. Tens of spirit
stones revolved around the cauldron before falling into an intricate and
bizarre shape.

The people looked at each other dumbly.

[What is Grandmaster Song doing? Setting an array? What did that have to
do with alchemy?]

Even Vicious Pill King as well as the rest of the alchemists were
clueless of his intention. Since time immemorial, alchemy and arrays
never intersected. What was his purpose?

Ignoring the baffled audience, Zhuo Fan’s hand made a sign and chanted,
“Heaven’s gate, earth’s locks, open for me! Let thy spiritual energy
flood this array! Assist my heavenly fire in opening its eyes! Let
spirits and dragons enter this pill!”

The world quaked and with it, the Drifting Flowers Arena started to
rumble.

Everyone was rattled, not knowing what was happening.

Right then, creepy laughter echoed as dark shadows from all directions
flew towards Zhuo Fan and revolved above his head.

Then they slammed into the core of the array.

At the same time, Dragon roars echoed and dragon images flew from the
core of the array, under the gobsmacked faces of everyone.

When the world stopped shaking, the shadows were gone and the sky was
crowded by nine dragon images.

Zhuo Fan snapped his finger and threw an azure flame into the cauldron.

The dragons seemed elated as they flew around agog before slamming
inside the cauldron.

In a blink, a deeper dragon roar was heard and an azure fire dragon
burst out of the cauldron.

It was then followed by the other 8. The azure fire inside the cauldron
was now gone, absorbed by the dragons.

With his eyes flashing, Zhuo Fan grinned as his hands danced.

Hundreds of ingredients took to the sky at that moment.

“Secret pill array, Cradle Returning Dragons!”

Zhuo Fan shouted and the nine fire dragons responded with a roar before
flying into the ingredients floating about…

Chapter 153 - Dragon Transformation Array

Chapter 153, Dragon Transformation Array

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

Boom!

The thunderous roars rang in people’s eardrums. It then followed with a
resplendent light, so glaring that they couldn’t open their eyes.

Once the light died out and the nine dragons’ roars passed, all the
ingredients were gone from the sky.

But under closer attention, one could see that the nine fire dragons had
changed. Within their body made of azure flames, a line coursed through
them like a blood vessel.

But instead of blood, it was flowing with the ingredients extracts.

Instant refining!

The people watched Zhuo Fan incredulously.

They recalled Zhuo Fan’s Ninth Heaven Roaring Dragon Claw with which he
instantly refined 3rd-grade pill ingredients. But he had now achieved
the same result with hundreds of 7th-grade pill ingredients.

Such speed raised his refining skill to another level of comprehension.

Even Vicious Pill King had to admit, he could not accomplish such a
feat. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have taken this Bone Tempering brat as his
strongest adversary.

This was just the start of everyone’s shock. The greatest awe was how
the nine dragons had different colored mixtures flowing through them.

Zhuo Fan just up and separated the ingredients in the instant they were
refined.

Speed refining seemed simple, but it touched upon one’s control over the
ingredients and his flame. A stronger flame would ruin the ingredient
while a weak one wouldn’t refine them.

Regarding the difficulty of control, each successive ingredient grade
would be like vaulting heaven. This was the wall that had so many
alchemists standing before it, unable to advance.

Zhuo Fan’s instant refining needed absolute control, which was even
harder. Not even Vicious Pill King could do it.

Zhuo Fan not only did it but went a level further in his control,
separating the hundreds of ingredients into nine types.

This was something Vicious Pill King didn’t think was possible.

Some pills, especially poisons, needed the extracts divided, followed by
careful mixing. The Pill King Hall’s poisoned palm was no exception.

It turned refining into a very precise task, with every ingredient
refined independently. One blunder would add impurities and ruin the
batch.

Yet, Zhuo Fan refined nine types of ingredients in a flash. Such
accuracy was something the audience could not even begin to fathom, and
this was what got Vicious Pill King so overwhelmed.

How did the world give birth to such a mystical refining skill and such
an outstanding genius alchemist?

Hu~

As Vicious Pill King had known, this step was the hardest when making
pills. Even Zhuo Fan couldn’t help but let out a breath when this step
was completed.

The perceptive Xiao Ya knew Zhuo Fan was at a crucial step and didn’t
disturb him. Now that he relaxed, she couldn’t reign in her curiosity
any longer, “Grandmaster Song, what was that secret skill, it is no lie
to say that it shook the world?”

“Ha-ha-ha, a mere pill array, a simple little array to help in
refining.”

Zhuo Fan chuckled and turned to Vicious Pill King. His provocation,
however, was loud enough for everyone to hear him, “For a high-grade
pill to become a grade surpassing pill, it has to have spirituality.
Using blood essence to make the heaven and earth spirit flame’s
spirituality instill a spirit into the pill is one way. But that’s too
dangerous. If all alchemists did it, nine out of ten would die. Truly
idiotic!”

Vicious Pill King’s eyelid twitched, feeling the naked irony within.
This brat was teaching him a lesson. Like a senior teaching his juniors.
This stung him hard.

But Zhuo Fan’s words were correct. Vicious Pill King would’ve never
braved such danger if he was but a greenhorn alchemist.

“Then, did you also instill spirituality into the pill, Grandmaster
Song?” Xiao Ya asked in awe while looking at the nine majestic dragons.

Nodding, Zhuo Fan had a cocksure grin, “Spirituality is instilled only
by pouring heaven and earth spirituality into the pill. A heaven and
earth spirit flame has such a property, albeit incomplete. The soul of a
heaven and earth spirit flame is merely formed over millions of years
within the earth by accumulating the spirits of the earth. Just take out
the spirits and you can instill spirituality.”

“Does that mean those gray shadows were the spirits of the earth?”

“Correct. Spirits are all around us, just that they do not persist for
long, nor do they have awareness. The locations of the seven houses were
chosen with dense spiritual energy in mind. A place like that gives
birth to many spirits, but not just anyone can find them.”

Chuckling, Zhuo Fan pointed at the array, “In the long-forgotten past,
alchemy and array were one specialty. But as there were many different
sects, alchemy and arrays diverged, to the point many ancient arrays are
lost. The array that I set up today is the ancient Dragon Transformation
Array. It draws the spirits around and transforms them into dragon
spirits. Not a true dragon, mind you, but one containing just a hint of
a true dragon spirit’s might. A striking difference from a heaven and
earth spirit flame’s spirituality formed over millions of years.”

Despite the shock they were in, Zhuo Fan’s words brought them further
amazement. They had endless admiration for him.

This pill array was in no ancient book, moreover, no one had heard of it
either. But Grandmaster Song not only had vast and widespread knowledge
about all aspects but even grasped the intricacies of a pill refining
array.

Considering all the secret refining skills he displayed today, there
might not be a second one like him in the entire continent, least of all
this empire.

An Exalted of alchemy!

Vicious Pill King couldn’t be clearer on this. However, he still clung
onto a thread of hope. He may have lost in terms of refining skills, but
he won over Zhuo Fan in terms of cultivation. The possibility of victory
was still there.

Zhuo Fan chuckled, as if in response to Vicious Pill King’s thoughts.
Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and his hand signs changed.

The nine fire dragons roared and whipped their tails in the center of
the array.

Boom!

With an earth-shattering noise, the nine tails collided. They broke off
from the dragons and crumbled down into flames that ultimately mixed
together.

With another roar, the flame burst into nine dragonlings. These
dragonlings’ blood vessels were of the same color, flowing azure.

The erudite found it incredulous how Zhuo Fan refined the nine
concoctions into a single mix in an instant.

Instant refining again!

A moment of extreme importance, one that required perfect control, was
done in a blink. This got even those grandmaster alchemists peeved.

[Grandmaster Song, your refining skill is great and all, but can you
please tone it down?]

[Are you doing all the hard steps so casually just so you can rub our
faces in it? Would it hurt to take at least a second while doing it?]

They were all in envy and depression over the might of such an exotic
refining skill.

Roar!

The nine tailless fire dragons roared and charged to the center of the
array. This time, head first.

Boom!

As before, the nine tailless dragons blended into a sea of fire. The
next moment, another nine dragonlings emerged from the blaze.

And just as the first nine dragonlings, these had the same azure
bloodstream.

Eighteen roaring dragonlings were truly an impressive spectacle.

“Ha-ha-ha, time to wrap it up!”

Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed and a small bottle appeared. He
opened it, releasing a soothing smell filled with vitality.

Bodhi Jade Sap!

With trembling eyes, the grandmaster alchemists watched Zhuo Fan in
shock and puzzlement.

They all knew Bodhi Jade Sap was Drifting Flowers Edifice’s treasure. So
how did it end up in Grandmaster Song’s deft hands? Was he Drifting
Flowers Edifice’s…

It all started to make sense! But even so, the shock was immense. [Where
did Drifting Flowers Edifice find this Exalted Grandmaster Song?]

In today’s alchemy competition, he smacked the face of Pill King Hall
for no less than a hundred times.

The structure of Tianyu’s alchemy system was going to change. Pill King
Hall was no longer at the top. Such a change had countless implications.

It was a known fact that Pill King Hall was the imperial family’s pill
supplier. If they weren’t the best in Tianyu, why would the imperial
family buy from them?

People started to draw conclusions.

Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Hundred Pill Meeting was a platform for Pill
King Hall, to show off their own skills.

But how could the ordinary masses have known? Behind the scenes, Vicious
Pill King alone had almost driven the entire Drifting Flowers Edifice to
collapse. Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan was not even specifically invited by the
Drifting Flowers Edifice to deal with Pill King Hall’s Vicious Pill
King.

If the masses had known, they would most likely have the same expression
as those from Drifting Flowers Edifice?

The two overseers were smiling. Zhuo Fan might not have been invited by
them, but he was, nonetheless, Drifting Flowers Edifice’s son in law.

With Zhuo Fan at the helm, Pill King Hall would be held in check!

Chu Qingcheng was thinking the same thing. She was rejoicing that her
rash action proved to be a choice with incredible implications towards
better!

Only Zhuo Fan begged to differ. He was only doing what he had to…

Chapter 154 - Transcending Pill King

Chapter 154, Transcending Pill King

“Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. Let the dragon’s feast perfect the pill!”

Zhuo Fan’s shout was followed by a vigorous shake of the hand, sending
18 drops of Bodhi Jade Sap into the air. The 18 dragonlings acted like
cats catching the smell of fish, nabbing a drop each.

Roar!

As the dragonlings roared, their body dissolved into azure flames
followed by their heads and leaving a ball of azure fire.

Then the fire scattered to reveal upon the world a shining azure pill.
It released a soothing smell, gripping the hearts of everyone there.

“W-what grade is it to have such an astonishing effect?” The people
stared unblinking at the 18 dancing pills.

These pills had yet to renounce their dragonic nature, roaring as they
traveled the sky.

All 18 of them were clearly alive. What got people so distraught was
that while Vicious Pill King nearly gave his life to make just one, Zhuo
Fan flipped his hand and there went eighteen of them dancing across the
sky.

This feeling was something words weren’t enough to describe. Just how
many times did one need to surpass Vicious Pill King’s skill to breach
this gap?

There was no need for judging at this point. Everyone was dead set that
Zhuo Fan was the winner. And this time, his victory was perfect,
incontestable, thoroughly crushing the opposition.

Taking a small bottle, Zhuo Fan waved for the 18 pills. He put them
inside without even letting Xiao Ya take a single peek.

Xiao Ya was alarmed, “Grandmaster Song, the pills you refined…”

“No need to see them.” Zhuo Fan cut her off with a shake of his head. He
turned to the dumbstruck and collapsed Vicious Pill King and muttered,
“I won!”

Pure confidence.

The whole crowd watched the calm and proud Zhuo Fan with a sense of awe.
They looked at him as if he was their sole king.

His cocky and obnoxious attitude came back in full force as well, making
them all bend their knees.

[In alchemy, I am the first. Who dares claim my throne?]

Zhuo Fan stood there, quietly, giving the grandmaster alchemists a whole
new meaning to how small they felt.

He was a true Pill King. A Pill King with unquestionable authority!

Xiao Ya was the closest to Zhuo Fan. She bore the brunt of his aura, but
was fast to recover also, “Grandmaster Song, I’m convinced you have gone
beyond mere winning. But please, explain to us, what grade are they?”

“18 pills, all of perfect 8th-grade quality!” Zhuo Fan deadpanned.

The crowd erupted in surprise. The grandmaster alchemists knew he
exceeded their imagination, but never knew the full extent of it. How
sheerly unbelievable it all was.

Vicious Pill King could refine a perfect 7th-grade pill and he was
already at the peak of his skill.

When people saw the 18 pills, despite the shock, they only went as far
as thinking Zhuo Fan refined them as perfect 7th-grade pills. It was
more than enough to surpass Vicious by many times.

But this little prick went even further beyond anyone’s guess. He not
only surpassed him but went a full grade above.

Perfect 8th-grade pill. That was something not even a 10th-grade
alchemist could accomplish consistently, least of all 18 of them in one
breath.

Such heaven-defying skill was only mentioned in legends, hearsay. How
could it ever be a reality, here and now?

This cheeky little prick was that much of a monster?

They shouted at him in their hearts, but they could not hide the sheer
admiration and respect they held for his incredible refining ability.

Vicious Pill King himself was floored. His green hair became white under
the naked eye. He aged dozens of years in just one breath.

It was an astonishing defeat. Vicious Pill King never had suffered such
a thorough and complete loss. It left him with no chance of a comeback.

This Pill King had discovered today that his refining ability was
nothing when faced with a true expert. The despair, the grief, was
harder to bear than even death.

Yan Fu watched his master’s loss with a pained heart. He flicked a glare
at Zhuo Fan, but all he could do was gnash his teeth.

[This brat is too damn strong. Master was never his match. And I will
never get the chance to catch up to him either!]

As there was a man beyond the next, so was a sky beyond another. It was
such an apt description that no one could refute it.

He took master as his role model. Acting as brash as him, thinking his
master was the best alchemist in the world. But then came the day his
master was defeated, hopeless of even taking revenge.

Such a gap was no different from a chasm…

Tao Danniang ought to be going wild with joy seeing Yan Song’s crushed
spirit. But it never came. Every new wave drove higher than its
predecessor, who died on the sandy beach.

Didn’t Yan Song’s defeat mark the end of their generation of grandmaster
alchemists?

The world was going to be tumultuous. A warrior of the new generation
was already standing on their corpses, breaking the grounds of a new
age.

Turning to Zhuo Fan next to her, Tao Danniang was grateful.

Fortune helped them to have him as Drifting Flowers Edifice’s…

Long Jiu and the rest watched it all with a sigh.

“Goddamn it, this prick sure knows how to act. He said it wasn’t clear
that he could lose against Vicious Pill King. And the end result? Not
only did he win, but got a freaking perfect win! And not just a perfect
win, but crushed him thoroughly!”

Xie Tianyang couldn’t help cursing to high heavens despite the shock,
“For god’s sake, just look at Vicious Pill King. He got his life scared
out of him by that brat… even I feel sorry for him!”

Long Jiu nodded gravely, “The brat is beyond ruthless. He won’t let the
other have anything left. A single perfect 8th-grade pill was more than
enough to win it by a landslide, but he went as far as to make 17 more,
striking a fatal blow to Vicious Pill King. I fear he might never
recover from this trauma for as long as he lived.”

“You’re speaking of… a heart demon?” Xie Tianyang raised an eyebrow.

Nodding, Long Jiu’s eyes flashed, “Even without it, he may never get to
refine a high-grade pill in his life. That brat’s vicious retribution
leaves everyone in dread!”

They all had to nod at that.

“Then the Pill King of this Hundred Pill Meeting is… “

As the crowd raved, Xiao Ya pointed at Zhuo Fan while shouting. Before
she could finish, however, quick steps were heard approaching.

Zhuo Fan was slowly and calmly walking towards the center stage. Xiao Ya
was startled, “Grandmaster Song, what…”

“Only I have the right to declare myself as Pill King!”

Throwing that casual sentence, Zhuo Fan didn’t even look at her and
walked past her.

The crowd was in awe again, [He has the aura of a king! He is without a
doubt this generation’s Pill King!]

Xiao Ya suddenly forgot she was the judge here and blushed a bit. She
was so lost in Zhuo Fan’s flair that she forgot to do her job.

Xie Tianyang sighed enviously, “He is an expert at putting on airs. When
will I get the chance to do the same I wonder? Just one time is all I
ask.”

Under the chaotic shouts from all around him, Zhuo Fan arrived before
the stage. He swallowed when he saw the wooden box and a weight fell off
his heart.

[Chu Qingtian, wearing your cloak up to this point, I can rest at ease
to say that I have returned your sister’s debt.]

Zhuo Fan let his cloak fall and walked on stage.

The people were struck into silence. They saw the cloak spread on the
steps of the stage and the words on it and were moved.

“Heaven-toppling… Pill!”

It all started with a murmur, but it soon grew into an ear-splitting
roar. They all started to pump their fist and join, “Heaven-toppling
Pill, Heaven-toppling Pill, Heaven-toppling Pill…”

Indeed, Pill King was far beneath a man of Zhuo Fan’s caliber. In their
hearts, only this title, Heaven-toppling Pill, was fit to Grandmaster
Song’s genius.

Chu Qingcheng covered her mouth, her eyes flowing with tears.

The people acclaimed Zhuo Fan as Heaven-toppling Pill, but it was in
fact Chu Qingtian’s wish. Zhuo Fan had taken her little brother’s place
and fulfilled his cherished wish.

Her eyes on him now contained an even deeper love.

Vicious Pill King was in a daze as he heard the roars and looked at the
four words on the stage’s steps. He seemed to be both crying and
laughing, “Heaven-toppling Pill. I never thought there was a man in this
world who’d use these words. Qingtian, I have lost today at his hands,
and yours…”

Vicious Pill King seemed to have lost it. But his eyes seemed to have
realized something as they got clearer…

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan was cool, despite the turmoil banging his
ears. He did not look at the cloak again, as it had no more sway on him.

He did what he had to. He paid the favor he owed. And now followed with
his true objective.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes turned colder and reached for the wooden box on the
pedestal.

But with a sudden sound, a golden fist caught him off guard, “Punk, you
are far from worthy of taking the Bodhi Root!”

“Watch out!”Chu Qingcheng paled at the danger he was facing, but her
warning came too late.

The iron fist struck Zhuo Fan square in the chest.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes suddenly turned vicious! His act as Song Yu was done.
Now, it was time for the Demonic Emperor, Zhuo Fan, to reenter the
scene…

Chapter 155 - , True Demon Revealed

Chapter 155, True Demon Revealed

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

Whoosh~

Zhuo Fan vanished the next moment. Huangpu Qingyun’s heart was in
distress. How could a Bone Tempering kid escape his sneak attack?

Thunder rolled and Huangpu Qingyun’s heart froze, feeling danger
creeping up on him.

His only reaction was a slight tilt of his head.

Whoosh!

A flash of lightning streaked past his face, drawing blood. Huangpu
Qingyun’s forehead was soaked with sweat.

He had a keen danger sense, otherwise his head would have rolled off his
shoulders.

Bam!

He may have avoided the killing blow, but a hammer blow shot into his
belly. He felt pain down to his marrow as if a cannon shot at him.

With a rumble, he flew back and created a three meter wide hole in the
Drifting Flowers Arena wall.

It all happened in a blink. It was unclear how he was even attacked,
only to ultimately end up through the wall.

The snicker on those on the eastern stand froze. [What was going on? How
did Huangpu Qingyun lose when he was the one with greater power, when he
was the one at the advantage?]

His opponent was but a Bone Tempering kid!

Aghast, the people looked towards the center stage only to feel their
faces twitching.

Zhuo Fan was standing there in all his glory, with the Lightning Wings
flickering behind him. His leg was still high up, the clear reason
behind Huangpu Qingyun’s setback.

Those wings, could they be…

“Zhuo Fan!” Hell Valley’s 5th elder gnashed his teeth in malice. His
eyes filled with killing intent.

This was unbelievable to the crowd. They once heard of this demon Zhuo
Fan and the sensations he stirred. Of his lightning wings and his
ruthless savagery.

Who could’ve seen it coming? The one to defeat Vicious Pill King four
times, the one to transcend the title of Pill King, Heaven-toppling
Pill, the same Grandmaster Song, was in fact the one and only Zhuo Fan.

Even Chu Qingcheng and Drifting Flowers Edifice’s people were in a state
of shock. That vile and deceitful demon of a man was in fact the
pigheaded, blunt, and oafish Song Yu?

[They had absolutely nothing in common!]

Or more aptly put, Zhuo Fan’s performance was so convincing, he got
everyone dancing his tune!

“Did you know he was Zhuo Fan all along?” Peony Overseer asked Long
Jiu’s group.

Nodding, Long Jiu stroked his beard with a chuckle, “Indeed. And our
friendship with the kid isn’t shallow either!”

“What will you do now? Are you going to join him in fighting Hell Valley
and Regent Estate?” Iris Overseer frowned in worry.

They all saw Huangpu Qingyun’s power. Now that he had three other houses
helping him, they were out of their depths. But that wasn’t the worst
part. This was a turning point. Once they joined this fight, the damage
was done, and the seven house war would erupt.

With how precarious Drifting Flowers Edifice’s state was, their end was
guaranteed!

They did not want to see it come to pass. However, Hell Valley’s number
one offender, Zhuo Fan, came out of the closet. Now the seven houses
were split in sticking for Zhuo Fan or wishing to kill him.

Drifting Flowers Edifice held a grudge against the party who wished to
kill Zhuo Fan. Therefore, they could not join them. On the other hand,
Zhuo Fan’s side was the weakest, doomed to fail.

Iris Overseer and Peony Overseer were in anguish, on the verge of tears.

[You got smacked again and again so many times before, but why do you
appear now, in front of so many people? Wose, in front of your enemies!
Why are you making it so hard on us? Drifting Flowers Edifice never
offended you, so why are you looking to harm us?]

Xie Tianyang could guess what they were thinking and gestures
dismissively, “Don’t you worry now. There’s no need to join this
miserable battle. We plan on sitting back as well.”

“You won’t help him?” Peony Overseer was puzzled and glad. Puzzled since
he always said he and Zhuo Fan went through thick and thin together, but
not willing to help him now when it matters. Glad, since they could play
innocent. Since no one was going to help him, then Drifting Flowers
Edifice needn’t bother themselves with other people’s problems.

However, seeing them so callous, Xiao Dandan was fuming mad, “Humph, and
you call yourselves brothers while afraid to lend a hand when it
matters. If you won’t help him, I will.”

Xiao Dandan just started running when Peony Overseer dragged her back.

“Don’t go cause trouble, missy. That Zhuo Fan has a vile reputation. Who
knows what he was planning while hiding in Drifting Flowers City? Why
are you still treating him like your husband? And how come you’re more
infatuated then before?” Drifting Flowers City cussed.

Xiao Dandan felt chagrined, “Master, I finally found a good man and I
just can’t sit by and watch him die.”

“Miss Dandan is so virtuous, worthy of me calling you sister in law.”

Xie Tianyang giggled, “Don’t you worry your pretty little head. This is
all part of that brat’s master plan. He even warned us not to get
involved and to believe in him to see this through to the end.”

“What? Is this true? Or are you just saying this to shift the blame and
pull the wool over my eyes? ” Xiao Dandan suspected him.

The others laughed with a shake of their heads and even Peony Overseer
felt bitter.

[Foolish girl, who do you think they are? If people of the seven houses
say they won’t go save him, then that’s what they’ll do. Why would they
go and lie to a lass?]

Seeing her suspicion not in the least dispelled, Long Kui let out a
disarming giggle, “Lady Dandan, that brat didn’t want us to interfere,
afraid that Regent Estate would target us and affect the rise of his
clan. Which reminds me. This is all part of a selfish aim of his. Why
would a ruthless and devious savage such as him show kindness otherwise?
Why would he burden himself with the lives of others otherwise? This
brings me back to the chaos that happened in Windgaze City between us
and Hell Valley. He took advantage of the turmoil and killed two of
their elders, while making us take the fall…”

“You are not allowed to speak ill of my husband! Can’t you see it’s all
because of his intelligence?” Xiao Dandan cut her off with an irritated
tone.

Shaking her head, Long Kui remained silent. [What’s so good about him
anyway? What got this grown-up lady so delusional over him?]

Ignoring her martial niece, Iris Overseer looked at Zhuo Fan then at
Long Jiu, “Uncle Jiu, you say that he wants to carry this by himself.
But how is a Bone Tempering cultivator able to deal with four houses
ganging up on him and flee with his life? Will you intervene if his
death is certain?”

Long Jiu paused for a long time, then nodded with unyielding conviction,
“Yes, he is the brother I believe in without question.”

“I as well. I owe him a debt.” Xie Tianyang grinned, then chuckled at
the tall figure in the arena, “However, we are probably overthinking
things. He got this in the bag.”

“What!? He can actually escape under the eyes of four experts?” Peony
Overseer jolted, “That would make him just as the rumors spoke of, a
freak. These four are renowned figures of the Profound Heaven Stage.”

“Ha-ha-ha, he is without a doubt, a freak!” Xie Tianyang laughed, “I
also do not know if he can escape, but I know from his fight with You
Guiqi. He is no oaf. As long as he set his mind on something, he will
see it through to the end.”

They all had to nod at this and returned to watch the events unfold.

Crash!

With a burst, Huangpu Qingyun flew out of the rubble. There was dust all
over him, but otherwise, not a scratch on him.

He however knew full well how his belly hurt.

Feeling his belly carefully, Huangpu Qingyun watched the winged Zhuo Fan
solemnly.

He underestimated him for having a Bone Tempering cultivation, but in
fact, Zhuo Fan’s speed wasn’t the only one transcending stages, his
body’s power too.

As a fellow body cultivator, Huangpu Qingyun knew how difficult Zhuo Fan
could be. What surpassed this, however, was the shock of finding someone
with a more savage body cultivation method than Regent Estate’s Imperial
Tyrant Body Art.

Easing his leg down, Zhuo Fan’s face was ever the same, calm and
unfeeling. He opened the wooden box in his hands and breathed in deeply.
The root was finally his.

Grinning from ear to ear, Zhuo Fan put the box away and ignored the
flabbergast looks of everyone as he turned his attention to Hundred Pill
Meeting, “Second young master, didn’t you say something about being
unworthy of Bodhi Root? Ha-ha-ha, as you well know, as the Pill King of
this Hundred Pill Meeting, I am rightfully entitled to it.”

“You little shit, you won’t live enough to enjoy it!” Huangpu Qingyun’s
eyes exploded with killing intent.

Shrugging, Zhuo Fan chuckled a retort, “If yours truly took it, I am
least afraid of someone taking it from me!”

Whoosh!

With a sudden sound, Hell Valley’s 5th elder flashed not ten meters from
him. He glared, “Punk, you’re that Zhuo Fan who killed 7th elder! Don’t
even think of denying it. Many from Hell Valley saw those same lightning
wings when you committed the crime!”

“When did I ever say the contrary? He-he-he, then again, who else out
there is brazen enough to openly steal what one of the seven houses
covet?”

Zhuo Fan’s face slowly changed to his original appearance.

Despite knowing it was coming, the crowd was still filled with panic.
Zhuo Fan’s face was the same one on Hell Valley’s kill order.

The crowd devolved into chaos as each ran which way.

The fight between the killer of Hell Valley’s mastermind – You Guiqi –
Zhuo Fan and their 5th elder was not something these first, second and
third rate clans would dare involve themselves in.

If by some disaster, they would get killed from a stray attack, they
wouldn’t even have time to lament.

Despite such fears, they couldn’t help feeling sorry for the magnificent
Heaven-toppling Pill, Grandmaster Song, ending up to be the demon Zhuo
Fan.

Under the seven houses’ encirclement, the only ending was with one’s
head on a pike.

Regardless if he was the demon Zhuo Fan, or the freak Zhuo Fan, how
could either of them escape from the seven houses’ entrapment?

Chapter 156 - Savage Like a Tiger

Chapter 156, Savage Like a Tiger

Chu Qingcheng’s thoughts aligned with the rest.

She gazed upon the changing yet unmistakably proud face with
incertitude.

Zhuo Fan had lied to her from the start, yet he did not once do
something to disappoint her. It turned out that with his intervention,
all the crises were laid before her, unraveled, waiting for her to solve
them with ease.

She came to believe that she and Drifting Flowers Edifice owed him. Now
there was no reason for her to hold back from helping him avoid the
danger he was in.

However, that only applied if he was anyone but Zhuo Fan. After all, he
killed Hell Valley’s 7th elder.

If she chose to stand up for him, Hell Valley would soon be knocking
with a war on her door. Regent Estate and Pill King Hall would never
miss the golden opportunity either. Thus marking the end of Drifting
Flowers Edifice.

She was deep in thought for a while before coming to a decision. Chu
Qingcheng gnashed her teeth and her eyes shined with conviction as she
took a simple step.

[Death is nothing, since today is Drifting Flowers Edifice’s judgment
day. Without this man’s help, Vicious Pill King would’ve gripped the
whole of Drifting Flowers Edifice in a mere two days.]

Rather than struggle on death’s door, ending alongside the man she
admired with a bang didn’t seem like a bad way to go.

Chu Qingcheng’s gait became firm and nodded at Tao Danniang, “Aunt Tao!”

Clear on her intention, Tao Danniang sighed as she grew resolute as
well.

But right then, one red and one blue silk ribbon held them tight before
lifting them on the terrace.

“I knew you two were foolish, but thankfully I managed to stop you.”

Peony Overseer and Iris Overseer released the ribbons and sighed. Xie
Tianyang then rushed to explain Zhuo Fan’s intentions.

The two were alarmed, unable to comprehend how a Bone Tempering
cultivator could face four Profound Heaven experts. It was impossible
even to a freak like him.

Shrugging, Xie Tianyang sighed, “I’ve fulfilled my end and told you of
his wishes. If you still wish to be reckless, all you’ll be doing is
ruining his plan. His anger will be on you!”

“Let’s see him dare get angry at me!” Chu Qingcheng shouted. But soon,
she realized this was not the time for casual bickering.

With a rotten smile, Xie Tianyang spoke in circles, “Edifice Lord Chu,
you have no idea of the extent of that brat’s retribution. By the time
you find out, you’ll be left in tears. He-he-he…”

Chu Qingcheng watched the arena mystified.

At the same time, Huangpu Qingyun and Zhuo Fan turned towards the
terrace as if in sync.

Huangpu Qingyun was worried Chu Qingcheng would stick out for Zhuo Fan.
He didn’t want to fight her and now he could finally put this worry to
rest. Meanwhile, Zhuo Fan was even more concerned. If Chu Qingcheng
stood up, his plan would go up in smokes.

Two rivals were actually willing to pause over a woman.

“Brat, it’s time you pay for my 7th brother’s misery with your life!”

Suddenly, Hell Valley’s 5th elder charged Zhuo Fan. His body exploded
with power and ignited into a scarlet flame as he swung at Zhuo Fan.

The fist was filled with rage and thrown in haste, but it kicked up a
storm. Zhuo Fan couldn’t even breathe from its power, as if a mountain
was crushing him.

[5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage, and a body cultivator too!]

His pupils contracting, he although had an inkling of the man’s power,
it exceeded his expectations.

Despite being a Profound Heaven expert as well, he was in a different
league from You Guiqi. Zhuo Fan weighed it thoroughly and came to the
conclusion he was far from this man’s match in body power.

[But everyone has a shortcoming. Your flesh might be steel, but I have
two blades behind me!]

With savagery in his eyes, Zhuo Fan stood his ground. The Lightning
Wings warped into sickles and attacked 5th elder.

One hacked the flaming fist, the other his face.

Zhuo Fan was willing to accept this heavy wound if it meant the death of
his opponent.

Seeing the incoming sickle, 5th elder stomped. With an explosion, he
stopped in his tracks and flew backward.

The wings missed and with a boom, a 5 meter hole was left behind three
meters from 5th elder.

Wisps of black smoke drifted above the hole.

Feeling the icy sweat trickling down his head, 5th elder expression
turned grave. He no longer charged recklessly.

He now knew how You Guiqi met his end.

[This brat is too vicious. Not only to his enemies, but even to
himself.] It may look advantageous exchanging a wound for a kill, but he
would open himself to others, a pig ready to be slaughtered.

To make such a savage decision in a split second showed how cunning and
ruthless he was!

The 5th elder was beginning to worry about the upcoming battle. What if
the brat up and chose to take them both down?

Such an ending would be meaningless.

The worried people on the terrace watched in shock. [Is this the rumored
demon Zhuo Fan? He is indeed a monstrosity.]

Yet, the women from Drifting Flowers Edifice came to find he was
sporting one hell of a domineering air.

In this state, where Zhuo Fan was the weakest in terms of cultivation
and number, he exuded the aura of the strongest, one who looked down on
others with pride.

While Huangpu Qingyun’s team, the one with higher cultivation and
number, was bleak and distressed. Their stance looked to be the weakest
of the two sides!

The previous exchange between 5th elder and Zhuo Fan was the perfect
example. Zhuo Fan was willing to bet his life while 5th elder wasn’t
quite up to terms with staking his life on one strike. It ended as it
played, with 5th elder terrified and Zhuo Fan winning.

[I was the one to attack first but ended up scared by his sickles. How
mortifying!]

“This is how a man should be, brave. I finally found a real man. How
great that he is also my husband…” Xiao Dandan was love-struck, with
only him in her ever infatuated eyes.

Chu Qingcheng shook her head but was feeling her fair share of growing
feelings as well. [Yes, this is how my husband should be, an undefeated
hero!]

In the arena, 5th elder was aware of the humiliation. He was pissed, but
he stayed put. Zhuo Fan grinned and placed the Bodhi Root in his Thunder
Ring, “Yours truly shall no longer entertain you, buh-bye!”

Zhuo Fan punctuated with a stomp and took flight. His wings shot him
high in the sky.

“Where do you think you’re going?”

Snorting, 5th elder stomped as well, chasing after him. In mere seconds,
he overtook Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan however, expected this and the Lightning Wings shifted into
whips as they lashed at him, “Get lost!”

“Humph, you little prick, you think you’re the only one with demonic
treasures?”

5th elder had come prepared. His hand suddenly held an enormous scarlet
hammer. He used both his hands to swing it at Zhuo Fan, “If you’ve got
the guts, let’s see you bet your life again!”

“A 5th-grade demonic treasure!”

Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and shifted his wings into shields.

With the enemy having a 5th-grade demonic treasure, exchanging a wound
for a life was impossible now. His life might be the one to perish
first.

Bam!

Zhuo Fan smashed into the ground like a meteor, picking up a cloud of
dust. When it cleared, it revealed the crumbled stage.

Chu Qingcheng and the others were alarmed. Xiao Dandan even jumped to
search for his body, but Peony Overseer caught her before she could do
it.

Long Jiu’s group was looking grave.

Hell Valley’s 5th elder was a body cultivator. If this hammer strike
hadn’t outright killed Zhuo Fan, it would definitely leave a mark. If
the situation worsened, they would have no choice but offend Regent
Estate and join the fight.

5th elder floated down and smashed the ground with his hammer, making
the earth quake three times.

Huangpu Qingyun eyed the ruins, then the proud 5th elder and cackled,
“Ha-ha-ha, 5th elder is indeed Hell Valley’s expert body cultivator.
Your art is as strong as Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art.”

“You’re too kind, second young master, ha-ha-ha…” 5th elder faked
modesty. He had always been confident of his body cultivation method.
Huangpu Qingyun’s words of praises made his heart pump with pride.

Huangpu Qingyun turned to the ruins again with a chuckle, “With 5th
elder’s strength, that brat must be close to dying if not dead already.
Could I ask a favor from 5th elder? If he’s still alive, allow me to
exact revenge for your valley’s 7th elder.”

Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes flashed with naked killing intent.

5th elder knew he was after this all along and didn’t hurt earning his
favor over such a small matter. He laughed, “Others are unworthy, but if
it’s the second young master’s request, please do not hesitate to do it.
But I would like to return to Hell Valley with his head.”

“I will never forget 5th elder’s dutiful act!”

Huangpu Qingyun then walked towards the ruins with killing intent.

Since ancient times, one mountain wasn’t big enough for two tigers.
[This is your fate, that I will wring the life out of you to ease my
heart.]

Chu Qingcheng’s group stared in anxiety and worry that he would kill
Zhuo Fan.

“Uncle Jiu, do we attack?” Chu Qingcheng asked impatiently.

But Long Jiu’s lone eye stared at the ruins, still ruminating. This only
worked to add more pressure on Chu Qingcheng…

Chapter 157 - Cunning Like a Fox

Chapter 157, Cunning Like a Fox

“Humph, if you won’t go, I will!”

Chu Qingcheng had reached her limit again, flicking her sleeve as she
rushed to save him. Long Jiu and his group helplessly followed after
her.

But an explosion stopped them before they could intervene.

Huangpu Qingyun was right at the edge of the crumbled stage when it shot
into the air. A black figure flashed and a foot slammed Huangpu
Qingyun’s cheek.

Huangpu Qingyun flew for dozens of meters and was now seeing stars. The
black figure was far from finished, flickering behind Huangpu Qingyun
and hacked with two thunderous axes for his head.

Huangpu Qingyun was too caught up to even know what was happening before
finding himself face to face with death.

“Watch out, second young master!”

Hell Valley’s 5th elder swung his two fists to help him, but the figure
already retreated.

When the black figure stopped, it was unmistakably Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan had blood flowing from his mouth and sporting an infuriated
expression, only surpassed by the killing intent in his eyes.

“Dammit, so close and I would’ve had that punk’s life!” Zhuo Fan spat
blood and barked at Huangpu Qingyun.

Huangpu Qingyun was overwhelmed and his body broke out in cold sweat.

[This goddamn prick is too deceitful. He faked death among the ruble so
that I would get close enough to kill me.]

[If not for 5th timely rescue, I would’ve been a goner.]

Huangpu Qingyun grew more roiled, but feeling more appalled than ever.
Chu Qingcheng’s side was wild with joy. Zhuo Fan looked as fine as ever,
with hardly enough to be called wounded.

“Well damn. I always took the rumor of him being a freak as nothing more
than a jest. But two years after we last saw each other, this brat’s
hardheadedness reached a whole new level. With how strong Hell Valley’s
5th elder’s body was, even Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd elder would want
to avoid fighting him. They have come to blows many times over the years
but always ended in a tie. How is it that this brat is pitch-perfect
after getting a smack from his hammer? He is an abomination.”

Long Jiu said suddenly to Xie Tianyang, “Kid, didn’t you see him last
time? Just when did he get that freakish?”

Shrugging, Xie Tianyang felt downcast, “Who knew it would all happen
overnight? From the 6th layer of Qi Condensation, where he could beat
even Bone Tempering experts, he suddenly changed to the Bone Tempering
freak who killed You Guiqi!”

[Overnight?!]

They all smacked their lips. What baffling skill did the brat use to
become so dreadful?

But then they recalled how he changed overnight when the Luo clan was in
crisis at that time as well. And now he did it again, this time gaining
an unbreakable body.

“Brother, just how much are you hiding for your dear older brother?”
Long Jiu sighed as the rest watched Zhuo Fan in amazement.

This kid was a true monster. Not only his alchemy ability was top-notch,
but he was well versed in other aspects as well!

Unaware of his dear older brother, Long Jiu, labeling him a monster,
Zhuo Fan spat another mouthful of blood as he watched the appalled
Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder.

“Goddamned old fart! Your hammer almost snapped my rib. But you at least
managed to shake my organs a bit and give me a slight wound. Hell
Valley, eh? Fine then, Hell Valley’s old 5th, I’ll remember this debt.”

With a twitching face, Zhuo Fan spat the words with great rancor. Yet,
why did it sound more like a mockery than anything else?

A grand 5th layer Profound Heaven bone cultivator’s hammer blow couldn’t
kill a Bone Tempering cultivator, when it would turn any normal Profound
Heaven expert to mush. Not even Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd elder dared
to take on his hammer.

The least was a serious wound and worst, death.

But this punk didn’t even get a rib cracked, nor sported the slightest
wound.

[Just who the hell is this brat?]

5th elder had regarded Zhuo Fan highly from the start. At least at You
Guiqi’s level since he managed to kill him.

But he now realized how sorely mistaken he was.

[This punk is a monster through and through. His body is nigh
unbreakable!]

[Thank the fates he’s not in the Profound Heaven Stage and can’t use his
body to its full advantage…]

Spatting, 5th elder turned grave!

Zhuo Fan secretly laughed having figured out what was on his mind. This
was the best time to flee. And he did just that, without any useless
words, just fled.

The grave 5th elder jolted and cursed inside as he rushed to block him.

[Think I’m a fool to let you walk away after you cursed me? You won’t
get the chance! You won’t live to make my life miserable.]

He was indeed a Profound Heaven expert, catching up in an instant and
swinging his hammer on Zhuo Fan again.

But Zhuo Fan was prepared this time. Grinning, his Lightning Wings
deflected the hammer and rushed towards the 5th elder.

5th elder was in glee.

Zhuo Fan may have dodged the blow, but coming closer, couldn’t be
better.

5th elder let go of the hammer and smashed his fist towards Zhuo’s face.

The blow packed enough power to at least break a few bones this time.

But Zhuo Fan kept his cool, even snickering. He lightly stepped,
“Mystifying Phantom Step!”

Zhuo Fan vanished into thin air and popped behind 5th elder.

5th elder had no idea what occurred while Zhuo Fan used this chance to
flee.

“Kid, you won’t get away that easy!”

Suddenly, Huangpu Qingyun appeared and blocked his escape.

Zhuo Fan frowned and felt vexation get to him, [I so want to take him
down a peg but this is not the time.] They were both body cultivators
but with one stage gap. Brawling would be detrimental to Zhuo Fan.

Moreover, it would also slow down his speed if he were to use the
Lightning Wings to fend off his opponent. Afterwards, the 5th elder
would rush over during the gap and make matters worse.

With no alternative, Zhuo Fan used Mystifying Phantom Step again to
escape Huangpu Qingyun.

Huangpu Qingyun stood dumbly in mid-air. [What’s with this strange art?]
He never saw anything remotely resembling it.

However, to the dismay of the ones on the terrace, a blue figure flashed
over, curbing Zhuo Fan’s escape.

With a boom, he was kicked back before he could figure out how it
happened.

He hit the ground so hard, a wave of dust formed.

The messy Zhuo Fan clawed back to his feet. He felt his sore face as he
looked coldly.

5th elder and Huangpu Qingyun took one side around him as did the blue
figure. Zhuo Fan snickering at him, “The kick was fast, but hardly
powerful. It turns out to be an elder from Merry Woods. “

The one to get a leg up on Zhuo Fan was none other than Lin Zitian.

Taking a quick look at Vicious Pill King, he found him too drained to
join in the fight. Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were tough but had no
way to counter Zhuo Fan’s eerie movements.

Thus making Merry Woods’ speed the only way to bring the brat down a
peg.

Lin Zitian thought, [Fortune favors the bold.] He made sure to kick back
this monstrosity to win the greatest credit.

Unbeknownst to him, that kick shot him straight through the gates of
hell.

“Elder Lin, well done! I will remember this later!” Huangpu Qingyun was
vexed by Zhuo Fan’s erratic movements but now only Lin Zitian could keep
him here so Huangpu Qingyun flattered him.

Picking up on the second young master’s plan, 5th elder followed suit,
“This little prick is such a headache, having a strange movement art on
top of his strong body. If not for Elder Lin, he would’ve escaped.”

Lin Zitian was proud of his glorious achievement, but shook his head
trying to act modestly.

Peony Overseer was itching to go there and kick his butt.

[You damn old fart. It’s fine if you don’t want to help Drifting Flowers
Edifice, but you went as far as helping that bastard from Regent Estate
against Drifting Flowers Edifice’s son in law? I was a fool to waste my
feelings on you.]

Zhuo Fan had a contemptuous grin and secretly cursed him for being a
moron. Ye, even in this situation, he didn’t put him in his eyes.

He already saw through Merry Woods’ cultivation method, a useless trick,
fancy but pointless! If his disciple ruined himself with it, what was to
say of his master?

How was he a worthy enemy if he was the weakest, albeit fastest?

Zhuo Fan sneered. He only took into consideration Huangpu Qingyun and
5th elder, while throwing Elder Lin in the back of his mind.

Such clearcut disregard irked Elder Lin, stinging his prideful heart.

“Second young master, 5th elder, allow me to handle this arrogant punk!”

Lin Zitian didn’t find anything amiss and shouted. Zhuo Fan looked at
him queerly. [This opportunist sure is ballsy.]

[You know I killed You Guiqi, who was as weak as you, yet you dare
challenge me?]

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder looked at him the same way.

[Is this old man alright? Even I have to watch my every move when facing
this demon and here you are asking to do it alone?]

[Just who was the truly arrogant one here? One or two praises already
got to your head?]

Chapter 158 - Unstoppable Speed

Chapter 158, Unstoppable Speed

Sticking out his chest, Lin Zitian felt so full of himself being the
center of attention.

What he didn’t see was the suspicion in their eyes.

“5th elder, if Elder Lin wishes to fight him, let us owe him this favor
and we’ll repay it back in the future.” Squinting, Huangpu Qingyun no
longer second-guessed it and agreed with Lin Zitian.

Lin Zitian cupped his hands to Huangpu Qingyun in joy, “I wouldn’t dare.
This is something I should be doing anyway. For the second young master
to grant me this honor is enough.”

Huangpu Qingyun’s words revealed how much importance he gave himself.
Lin Zitian was overjoyed Merry Woods now had a powerful backer.

“But second young master…” 5th elder spoke with revulsion. Though his
face had an understanding smile when turned to Huangpu Qingyun.

As if the second young master cared about this pawn called Lin Zitian!
He was only used as bait to see what other tricks Zhuo Fan had up his
sleeves.

At the least, they’d make some early plans on how to deal with them.

Snickering inside, 5th elder cupped his hands at Lin Zitian, “Elder Lin,
thank you for your trouble.”

“You’re too kind, 5th elder.”

Lin Zitian’s face had a glittering smile plastered on it. Like the
bottom of the barrel got hailed as the number one genius. While Zhuo Fan
could barely contain his mockery.

[There’s no worse fool out there than a clueless lab rat!]

[Fighting such a moron is a total waste of time.]

Zhuo Fan didn’t waste words and capitalized on their inattention by
jumping backward. His Lightning Wings were primed into sharpened daggers
to break out of this encirclement.

This time he wasn’t aiming for the air, but the wall behind him.

As the wall was the closest to him, his action would leave the other
unable to react. This would ultimately allow him to escape Drifting
Flowers Arena and take to the skies.

He would be soon as free as a bird, in his own element. While also
offsetting the three’s Profound Heaven speed from catching up.

Huangpu Qingyun shouted in alarm, “Damn it! He wants to run!”

He cursed Zhuo Fan inside for his cunning nature. One careless moment
and he would slip away!

By the time he and 5th elder got to the hole in the wall, Zhou Fan had
the advantage of the open sky outside.

“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Qingyun, old 5th, we will meet again if fate allows
it.” Zhuo Fan sped up and left his laughter behind.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder gnashed their teeth but didn’t pursue.

They knew it was too late already.

But Zhuo Fan once again omitted Lin Zitian’s name.

It was clear disregard!

Lin Zitian’s grew irate, [This prick thinks of escaping with me from
Merry Woods here? Absurd!]

Whoosh!

Lin Zitian’s figure vanished. Not even Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder who
were the closest, noticed his movements.

The next thing everyone knew, he was behind Zhuo Fan and cutting off the
latter’s retreat.

So fast!

Zhuo Fan was startled somewhat. Lin Zitian was in the Profound Heaven
Stage but his speed was far above it.

[He isn’t an elder of Merry Woods for nothing. Although…]

[Since when is speed everything? You’re nothing more than a paper tiger
to me.]

Grinning, Zhuo Fan didn’t slow down at all, going straight for Elder
Lin.

This had the elder fuming with rage.

“You little shit, you will pay for your insolence!” Like an enraged
lion, Lin Zitian roared and charged as well.

But Zhuo Fan wasn’t one to mind, mocking him in fact as his Lightning
Wings were sharpened for impact, “Your funeral!”

The clash already had a conclusion in everyone’s minds.

Zhuo Fan was a monster yet only a Bone Tempering cultivator. He could
face off against the impressive 5th layer of Profound Heaven body
cultivator, Hell Valley’s 5th elder by himself. Not to mention he killed
You Guiqi in one hit.

[You, Lin Zitian, are no body cultivator, even weaker than You Guiqi.
Yet, you dare face such a freak? Truly a moron.]

“Let’s go together, 5th elder!” Huangpu Qingyun spoke.

Startled, 5th elder didn’t understand, “Second young master, we won’t be
able to save him even if we do join.”

“Fool, what saving? He might not last a hit, but as a Profound Heaven
expert he can delay that brat long enough for us to catch up!”

Huangpu Qingyun already bolted with the 5th elder laughing right behind
him.

Zhuo Fan had long guessed their plan and his mouth perked into a
peculiar smile.

Whoosh~

Just when they were about to clash, Zhuo Fan used Mystifying Phantom
Step again, only to appear behind Lin Zitian.

“What?!”

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder stopped in shock. Zhuo Fan’s cackle came
from behind Lin Zitian, “Ha-ha-ha, your plan was for me to waste time on
this idiot, right? You counted your chickens too soon!”

“Damn it, he figured it out!” Huangpu Qingyun scowled.

Long Jiu’s group now realized as well. Lin Zitian wasn’t there to attack
Zhuo Fan, but to stall him enough for the other two to catch up.

It was clearly out of Lin Zitian’s intentions, ending up used by Huangpu
Qingyun.

Regent Estate was indeed an expert in manipulation. But Zhuo Fan saw
through it with a glance, hailing his skills a cut higher.

In this three against one battle, they did not fight with only their
fists but with their minds. If one side lost either aspect, defeat was
imminent.

Long Jiu admired Zhuo Fan even greater now. If it were him in Zhuo Fan’s
shoes, he would’ve attacked Lin Zitian and fell in Huangpu Qingyun’s
trap.

But now the situation resolved and Zhuo Fan was free to leave.

However, before anyone could breathe a sigh of relief, Lin Zitian
punched Zhuo Fan as he roared, “Punk, you dare look down on me?”

“Humph, you seriously don’t know when to quit. Since you want death, I
shall oblige!”

Finding Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder stock still from the corner of his
eye, Zhuo Fan grinned. Killing intent flared in his eyes and thrust at
Lin Zitian.

Huangpu Qingyun was filled with regret.

Who knew Lin Zitian was so thickheaded, still in pursuit? If they knew,
they wouldn’t have stopped. Now, however, it was too late to go after
him again. All they could do was watch Lin Zitian throw away his life
for nothing.

Lin Zitian didn’t seem afraid of the 6th-grade demonic treasure coming
for his life. He even had time to mock, “Brat, don’t you know power is
useless when you can’t even land a hit?”

Zhuo Fan didn’t seem to catch his drift. But then Lin Zitian vanished
half a meter away from him and the Lightning Wings hit naught but air.

“How?!”

Zhuo Fan was in shock. It was impossible to move so fast without
build-up. Only his Mystifying Phantom Step could do it, allowing him to
blink short distances.

What he failed to detect, however, was the ripple in space. This was a
burst over short distances.

But this burst was so fast that not even a Profound Heaven expert’s
speed was its match.

In his shock, Lin Zitian appeared again with a mocking smile as he
punched Zhuo Fan’s chest. With Lightning Wings in mid-attack, Zhuo Fan
could only use his arm to block.

“Humph, regardless of how fast Merry Woods is, your power is nothing.
With such childish punches, not even a hundred will help. Can one man’s
punch make any difference?”

“He-he-he, ever heard of constant efforts always prevail?”

Snorting, Lin Zitian mocked Zhuo Fan but his heart was furious as he
added more power into his punch. But Zhuo Fan didn’t care, as Lin Zitian
was indeed punching like a child. The most he could do was add his Yuan
Qi on his punch to rattle Zhuo Fan’s organs.

Zhuo Fan was flabbergasted to discover this paper tiger sent him flying.
He planted into a rock and ended up buried under the rubble.

This astonished everyone around, making them reassess Elder Lin. To send
the freakish Zhuo Fan flying earned him the title of peak expert in the
Profound Heaven Stage.

Some couldn’t even believe the opportunist Lin Zitian had such power in
him.

Even Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were rooted in shock.

Rumble!

Zhuo Fan jumped out of the rubble, unharmed, but his arm looked
inflamed.

Raising his eyes on Lin Zitian, Zhuo Fan was now serious, “It seems I’ve
underestimated you, Elder Lin!”

“Humph, you better believe it! We, the Merry Woods, have become one of
the seven houses thanks to our strength!” Lin Zitian put away his fist
as his eyes flashed with pride.

All around looked at Lin Zitian with newfound respect. His figure never
looked so imposing.

Despite all that, Lin Zitian sneakily put his hand behind him and rubbed
the pain away as he sucked a cold breath.

His hand was purple…

Chapter 159 - Sinister Like a Snake

Chapter 159, Sinister Like a Snake

[Blast it! Why is his body so damn hard? How is he even human? One punch
almost destroyed my hand!]

Lin Zitian stood with hands behind his back, his head at a 45 degree up
angle, like a veritable expert.

He was looked down on most of the time and now, he finally had the
chance to show off. But what people were unaware of was that his eyes
were swimming in tears. Without keeping appearances, he’d be losing all
decorum.

He could barely hold it in!

His hand was screaming in pain…

“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Lin’s power opened my eyes! I am in awe!” Huangpu
Qingyun laughed.

The battle started with them having the advantage. Then Zhuo Fan had to
take out some weird movement that made their advantage moot. Lin Zitian
had the speed to counter it, but unfortunately, he was a paper tiger.

In spite of appearances, this Elder Lin showed he had what it took to
fight Zhuo Fan. With the three of them working in tandem, Zhuo Fan was
dead meat.

Huangpu Qingyun proposed, “Elder Lin, you have just shown your strength,
but it’s best we deal with this little prick as soon as possible! “

“Yeah, Elder Lin. It will take you too long to bring him down so I and
second young master will help you!”

Getting Huangpu Qingyun’s meaning, 5th elder urged as well in a sincere
tone. He wasn’t faking it this time.

Before, Lin Zitian was but a mere cannon fodder. But now, he was an
asset worth considering when taking down Zhuo Fan. Not only in terms of
speed, but even with his power, he managed to earn the two’s approval.

His heart moved to tears, Lin Zitian who never received such courtesy
cupped his hands, “Don’t worry, second young master, 5th elder. I will
not let him escape as long as I’m around!”

“I have full trust in you!”

Huangpu Qingyun then turned to Zhuo Fan with killing intent.

Zhuo Fan sank into a deep and heavy mood.

He could deal with them two, but adding a Lin Zitian who could strike
him into the mix and it would make living a lot harder.

He already had a plan set just for this occasion. Or he wouldn’t have
been so brazen to show himself. But that plan was a final resort. It was
dangerous so he wanted to avoid it at all costs.

The only path left for him was driving a wedge in their teamwork. As for
where to start, did one even need to ask?

Snickering, Zhuo Fan eyed Lin Zitian with an evil glint, “Elder Lin, I
was truly wrong about you. I never took you for an expert, when you are
in fact no less than Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder.”

“Ha-ha-ha, you’re late in realizing the obvious!”

Lin Zitian laughed the resentment away, now filled with nothing but
content. Zhuo Fan was a junior, true, but he was infamous in the Tianyu
Empire. He had proven himself a man of great power and ambition when he
killed You Guiqi.

Zhuo Fan’s approval made him feel like he was bursting with prestige.

Zhuo Fan eyes his vanity and upped the ante, “But you can’t blame me for
that, Elder Lin. Merry Woods isn’t exactly as impressive as the other
houses. Nor its reputation for that matter…”

“Rubbish! Merry Woods’ name has always been glorious!” Zhuo Fan’s words
began to take effect, having Lin Zitian cut him off incensed.

It only made Zhuo Fan’s devious smile wider, “From now on Merry Woods
will be known throughout the empire. But did you perhaps not hear of
those lines?”

“What lines?”

“Merry Woods, the opportunist. At a gust, it shifts between two. Today
they bow before a red dress, tomorrow, they kneel before a tree. But on
which day the wind is stronger, that no one would want the lame leg
anymore?”

Of course, these lines were a proud work of Zhuo Fan. However, they
comprised everything he witnessed in his stay at Drifting Flowers
Edifice, emphasizing Lin Zitian’s magnificent love life.

Even Zhuo Fan grew narcissistic when he heard himself. [Such literary
talent would make me a best seller!]

But to Lin Zitian’s ears, it was jarring. His face flushed and turned to
see Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder dry coughing.

But anyone could see they were laughing inside.

With rasp breath, Lin Zitian cursed, “Bullshit! Who dared started this
vilification? I will break the one who started this rumor!”

“Rumor? Elder Lin is so forgetful, avoiding responsibilities. Now that
you have a staunch supporter backing you, did you forget the fragrant
and soft legs of yesterday?” Zhuo Fan coincidently looked at the terrace
in that exact moment.

Noticing his eyes, Peony Overseer was ashamed, boring her resentment
into him.

Chu Qingcheng frowned, “Senior sister, is this…”

“Edifice Lord Chu, don’t listen to his hosh-posh. I was about to do it,
for Drifting Flowers Edifice… but he didn’t agree and we were through.
What stuff about responsibility when he didn’t do anything?” Peony
Overseer rushed to explain, but it only made it worse. Everyone was
looking at her oddly.

At the same time, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were filled with mirth
when seeing Lin Zitian.

Though more aptly, mirth filled with mockery and contempt.

Playing with women was nothing to a man, but that didn’t go the same
with ‘leaning left then right’. Regent Estate prized loyalty above all
else.

Lin Zitian’s face alternated between white and blue. His mouth parted
but he had no riposte.

Even the weakened Vicious Pill King had to sneer at such sensational
news. Lin Zitian looked as if he choked on a fly. He couldn’t spit or
swallow, stuck in the worst moment of his life.

Looking back at himself, he regretted it in his heart for talking with
this bastard.

“You little shit, I will tear you into a thousand pieces!”

Lin Zitian flew into a rage, ignoring his teammates as he charged at
Zhuo Fan. The latter was startled and moved the Lightning Wings to
attack Lin Zitian.

Whoosh!

Lin Zitian vanished again, only to appear before Zhuo Fan. Without a
choice, Zhuo Fan had to block with his hand again.

The same scene replayed, with Zhuo Fan smashing into a rock, then
covered in rubble.

Coming out of there, he saw Lin Zitian already on him, not leaving him
room to even breathe. Zhuo Fan’s arm was inflamed but he pressed on with
his wings.

It was useless. Lightning Wings were fast but not a match for Lin
Zitian’s speed.

This resulted in him being ragdolled from one rock to another by Lin
Zitian’s kicks. Lin Zitian was no body cultivator, so such attacks meant
little harm to Zhuo Fan, but such damages accumulate.

Around the 7th or 8th round, Zhuo Fan was bruised all over. Not
life-threatening but it worked to cut at his body’s strength, now
huffing for breath.

Taking seven-eight hits of this left him wounded deeply. Even his
Diamond Body would start to decline under a Profound Heaven expert’s
onslaught.

Persistent effort!

Anything hammered long enough, no matter how tough, would soon break at
some point.

The same was happening to Zhuo Fan. Despite the battering he suffered,
the staunch resolve never left his eyes.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder laughed out loud. Zhuo Fan was done for.
Without them needing to even lift a finger.

They never thought of Lin Zitian as someone that strong. He was flinging
the demon Zhuo Fan around like nothing when they were having such a hard
time with him just a few moments before.

[Ha-ha-ha, everyone has a weakness!]

Huangpu Qingyun laughed inside and shouted, “Elder Lin, leave him half
alive. Let me have a go.”

Chu Qingcheng was filled with worry, as was Xiao Dandan. Seeing Zhuo Fan
suffering, she was on the verge of crying. Long Jiu tightened his fists,
ready to jump in at a moment’s notice.

But Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan with doubt, “Something is off
here, but what?”

“Master, did you say something?” Yan Fu came next to him. Following his
gaze, he suddenly laughed, “Oh, you mean that brat. He-he-he, he will
soon die at Elder Lin’s hands and clear your resentment. He was so
haughty and insufferable just a while back and now he is getting his
just deserts, ha-ha-ha…”

“Yes, that’s it!”

Vicious Pill King muttered, “I see it now. What it felt off. His haughty
and obnoxious nature is gone.”

Yan Fu was startled, “Master, what is so bad about that? Why would he
still act cocky if he is beaten senseless?”

“You know nothing!”

Cursing, Vicious Pill King turned grave, “Even in death, a lion’s a
lion. If a king takes off his gown, he is still a king. That gaze that
said everything is beneath him will never disappear.”

“But it is gone now… no, not gone, hidden. Like a viper poised to make
use of that once chance that will take the enemy’s life!”

Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan being kicked around and cried in
fright, “Elder Lin, watch out! He is planning on taking your disciple
hostage!”
