Chapter 160 - The Plot to End Lin Zitian

Chapter 160, The Plot to End Lin Zitian

Precisely!

Everyone had eyes only for Zhuo Fan and were unable to see the bigger
picture. That whenever Lin Zitian sent Zhuo Fan flying, it brought him
one strike closer to the eastern stand.

With all the experts down in the arena, it left poor Lin Tianyu,
disciple of Lin Zitian, alone.

Lin Tianyu was watching how his master taught that man who brutalized
and humiliated him in front of so many people a hard lesson. Yet,
Vicious Pill King’s yell got him staring blankly.

[W-why me again?]

Lin Zitian also stopped from shock.

But Zhuo Fan snickered and his eyes flashed with killing intent, “Humph,
too late!”

He stomped and shot like a cannonball for Lin Tianyu. He no longer hid
his intense killing intent and released it out onto the world.

Zhuo Fan was still just a hundred meters away from Lin Tianyu. It took a
mere blink to one with comparable speed to those Profound Heaven experts
to close this distance, leaving Lin Zitian unable to do a thing.

“Lin Zitian, you seemed to have had a blast kicking me around. Now, I
will kill your prized disciple. Let’s see how you like them apples!”

Frightened, Lin Zitian knew he’d been led by the nose. But how, when he
was a highly intelligent man, yet never saw any signs pointing to this?

However, this was no time to think, his disciple was in Zhuo Fan’s evil
clutches. Lin Zitian flashed behind Zhuo Fan and punched as he roared,
“Zhuo Fan, fight me if you have the guts! Leave my disciple out of it!”

Whoosh~

Zhuo Fan vanished from his sight. Then a groan escaped his lips and his
body trembled. Lin Zitian’s rage-filled eyes went stiff.

Looking down, he saw a hand sticking out of his chest whilst holding a
slowly beating heart.

“Wish granted, ha-ha-ha…”

A sinister laughter reached Lin Zitian but all he could feel was his
body growing colder. His life ebbing away.

But his eyes were ever clouded in doubt. He struggled to look back at
the demonic youth, “Y-you, how did you match my speed…”

“Didn’t your disciple tell you? I already told him. It doesn’t matter
how fast you are when I know who your target is!”

Zhuo Fan clenched his hand and the beating heart splashed blood
everywhere. Lin Zitian’s ice-cold corpse slumped on the eastern stand.
His eyes wide as saucers, dying with regret.

Lin Tianyu wailed in fear and curled up in a corner, not even daring to
look Zhuo Fan in the eye.

“Trash! You don’t even dare look at your master’s killer?
Disappointing!” Zhuo Fan left with a snicker.

What met him were the frightened eyes of everyone else.

Merry Woods’s elder Lin Zitian was killed in one blow. But the worst was
Zhuo Fan’s casual expression when doing it. It looked like he was
squashing a bug and not a Profound Heaven expert.

And his calculative eyes looked on as if everything fell in his
predetermined plan. It was as though he was able to easily pluck the
lives of his enemy at the drop of a hat.

[Demon!]

This was the sole impression he conveyed.

“Edifice Lord Chu, I told you. You know nothing of this brat. Did you
see it just now? He is a Demon King, in the flesh!” Xie Tianyang’s
expression was grave. Although this made it the second time he saw Zhuo
Fan kill a Profound Heaven expert, the shock was in no way lessened.

Zhuo Fan’s slaughter was incomparable to any other’s. It was as natural
as a king disposing of his slave.

Such a cold and unfeeling manner made him shiver whenever he saw Zhuo
Fan strike. The same went for everyone there as well.

“This brat is worse than Vicious Pill King!” Peony Overseer’s lip
trembled, “I-I can see now why the Hell Kill Order was issued. But I
feel that the Hell Kill Order is not enough to make him feel an ounce of
fear!”

“Qingcheng, you need to think this over carefully, whether he is the man
you want to return to!” Iris Overseer sucked a deep breath and spoke her
concerns.

Chu Qingcheng muttered to herself for a while. her eyes were filled with
uncertainty, but soon hardened, “Indeed. What you all say has its
merits. But! Isn’t this the very same Demon King who saved our Drifting
Flowers Edifice?”

“Yeah, sister Qingcheng. Husband may be vile, but only to our enemies.
He never harmed us. Don’t ever think otherwise.” Xiao Dandan blurted.

Her devotion to Zhuo Fan was unflinching. Afterall, she desired to be
with him for as long as they lived. However, Zhuo Fan once said he
didn’t accept Chu Qingcheng’s dowry. So, how could she accept her then,
when she was nothing but an extra?

So Xiao Dandan had to keep Zhuo Fan in Chu Qingcheng’s heart. Otherwise,
he would not only refuse Chu Qingcheng, but the free gift as well.

The heart could only bear so much for love!

The two overseers also sighed seeing Chu Qingcheng making up her mind.
They all knew, however, there would not be one day of peace around
someone like Zhuo Fan.

Vicious Pill King watched the cold and sinister Zhuo Fan up in the stand
and sighed, “I was wrong. You didn’t aim for Lin Tianyu, but was after
Lin Zitian from the start.”

“Correct. I wanted that old coot’s life from the very beginning. Why
would I go after his trash of a disciple for?” Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Also,
I may be holding Lin Tianyu hostage, striking fear in Lin Zitian, but
would Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder care about his life? Am I someone
who doesn’t know a person’s value?”

“Ha-ha-ha, right. When a viper bares its fangs, it will strike its mark.
I was wrong in thinking Lin Tianyu was important!” Vicious Pill King
lamented and shook his head, “However, your fight leading to Lin Tianyu
was all according to your plan.”

“You’re catching on!”

Zhuo Fan raised his head and grinned, “Lin Zitian was a fool, thinking
he was in control. When in fact, every strike was predetermined. When
all paths are sealed, his only choice was the only one he saw. It was
the path I let him see. This was the conclusion I came to while I was
kicked around.”

“What a sinister brat!”

Huangpu Qingyun gnashed his teeth, “If only I noticed earlier. I and 5th
elder would’ve stepped in and save Elder Lin’s life.”

“Ha-ha-ha, don’t kid yourself Huangpu Qingyun. You’re overconfident if
you think a daft brat like you can see through my schemes. Do you think
a few books on ruling are enough to grasp the people’s hearts? Humph,
you’re far beneath me.”

Zhuo Fan laughed with scorn, “It would’ve been quite the high stakes
mind game if You Guiqi was here, but you guys, just don’t cut it!”

Clenching his fists, Huangpu Qingyun was infuriated. The great Regent
Estate’s second young master had never been patronized in his life by
his peers, to the extent of being mocked as a daft brat.

This was no different from a beggar cursing at an emperor in the middle
of the street. The emperor was no emperor if he would take it lying
down.

Or he wasn’t Regent Estate’s second young master if he let it slide.

Zhuo Fan’s mockery only grew worse when he noticed his fury, “Huangpu
Qingyun, you can’t take it? Then let me reiterate. You know nothing of
the ways of ruling, so don’t go smear mud on the true way of grasping
the people’s hearts.”

“If the three of you had gone together against me, I wouldn’t have stood
a chance. So I had to relieve you of one man, the oh so intelligent and
ambitious Elder Lin.”

Everyone was fixated on Zhuo Fan, who was telling how he led them by the
nose, and managed to kill Lin Zitian. Huangpu Qingyun’s heart was
bleeding from hatred, yet his ears were attentive to catch the details.

“First things first, a ruler needs to see talent, to be tolerant! With
how vain Lin Zitian was, all I had to do was to fling some dirt at him
and he lost control. And you, instead of appeasing him, you mocked him
from the side, making him fly off the handle. In his anger-addled mind,
he left you behind fighting me all by himself!”

The witnesses turned to see how Huangpu Qingyun would react. One thing
was clear though, he wasn’t tolerant in the least, not at all how a
ruler should behave.

To be blunt, he was not leader material.

Huangpu Qingyun sensed the change in everyone and his hatred for Zhuo
Fan grew.

Yet, Zhuo Fan just kept going, “Moving on, a ruler has control over the
situation, placing worth on the greater picture. Of all people here,
only Lin Zitian could counter my speed. But you let this valuable asset
go further and further away from you in his battle with me, out of your
range. You only had to stay close to him and he would still be alive.
This is another fault of yours.”

“Enough! It is you who killed Lin Zitian, and now you’re trying to pin
it on me? Humph, everyone knows how deceitful you are!” Huangpu Qingyun
could no longer sit still while listening to his mockery.

Smiling, Zhuo Fan scorned him, “A regent is a regent because he is
leading the people. Those that shirk responsibilities are not fit to be
regents, and are not worthy to follow!”

The people’s hearts shivered. They watched Zhuo Fan, amazed at how much
sense he made. It also worked to dampen their respect for Huangpu
Qingyun by a great deal.

They respected Regent Estate’s second young master at first, for his
strict handling of affairs, for being a ruling talent.

But Zhuo Fan opened their eyes to the truth. He was no leading material
and following him would lead them to a dead end. Even 5th elder’s eyes
changed, now sporting a different opinion.

Sowing discord!

But this sowing was hidden very deep, since he was driving a wedge
between their trust and not just based on emotions. Huangpu Qingyun’s
retinue was formed of blind followers, thinking there was nothing he
couldn’t do. If it worked, it couldn’t be better.

But Zhuo Fan’s killing of Lin Zitian fell mostly on his shoulders.
Saying he was unfit to lead at this point, whether the people believe or
not, it cut down a great deal of his prestige.

He would become someone no one wanted to follow and, most importantly,
the cooperation between Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder would falter,
making them weaker.

Zhuo Fan smiled his evil grin, as if all were dancing in the palm of his
hand…

Chapter 161 - Rumbling Blood Bat

Chapter 161, Rumbling Blood Bat

With eyebrows locked in a scowl, Huangpu Qingyun could feel the eyes on
him taking a different nuance, making his heart burn with newfound rage.

[Damn it, this punk is good in psychological warfare as well. He got
these geezers buckling with a few words. This can’t go on. He must die,
beyond any shadow of a doubt. I have to shut him up now. Will I have any
respect left, any credibility, if this keeps up?]

With his mind set, Huangpu Qingyun restrained his aura, ready to make an
overt attack at any opportune moment. [Since I can’t counter that odd
movement, I’ll just finish him off with one clean and hidden strike!’

Before his chance came, however, Zhuo Fan flitted to the closest arena
wall, aiming for a quick escape.

“Curses, again with the running!”

Huangpu Qingyun cussed, feeling his plan ruined before he could even
enact it.

He wanted to sneak attack Zhuo Fan so he dropped his aura to confuse
enemies. But Zhuo Fan took the initiative to move first before he could.

He was exasperated, [The little shit is a parasite. How is it that
whenever I’m planning something, he reacts as if knowing what it is?]

There wasn’t anyone around to tell him that this old and veteran demon,
Zhuo Fan, could tell if he had to take a dump before even he did.

And now that 5th elder’s trust in Huangpu Qingyun plummeted, his
reaction was somewhat slower than before.

This short delay allowed Zhuo Fan to arrive before the wall.

The two hurried to catch him while Zhuo Fan was having a blast,
“Ha-ha-ha, too slow. You’re far from enough to stop yours truly.”

Zhuo Fan lashed his Lightning Wings at the walls.

The wall sported a brand new five-meter tall hole, allowing sunshine to
spill inside. Fresh air rushed to him, lifting his spirits.

Zhuo Fan then stepped into the clouds. He was like a caged bird finally
seeing the wide-open skies for the first time.

5th elder gnashed his teeth. Only now did his senses come back, figuring
out that Zhuo Fan’s speech was meant to drive a wedge and affect their
state of mind.

How else could he escape from under the tight guard of two Profound
Heaven experts in an enclosed space like Drifting Flowers Arena?

[This kid is more cunning than 7th Elder!]

He may be sighing inside, but his eyes were filled with killing intent.
The more outstanding Zhuo Fan revealed to be, the more he had to put the
kid down.

[He’s already a freak in Bone Tempering Stage. What will happen when he
enters the Profound Heaven Stage then? Who in Tianyu will be able to
stop him?]

Huangpu Qingyun was of a like mind.

He had to be killed!

They looked at each other, finding determination in each of their eyes.
They rushed through the hole and engaged in the chase. Vicious Pill King
muttered to himself as he took Yan Fu through the hole as well.

The only ones left inside were Long Jiu’s gang.

Secretly sighing, Iris Overseer looked on in fright, “Demon Zhuo Fan is
beyond cunning. He played the astute Huangpu Qingyun like a fiddle. Now
I can see how he killed the Insidious Demon, You Guiqi.”

“He-he, but of course!”

Snickering, Xie Tianyang shook his head dejected, “That brat is just too
sly. Those with brains but not brawn will undoubtedly lose. Those with
brawn but no brains will never get the upper hand on him. He is the
single most dreadful thing in this world.”

“My husband is brave and wise beyond his age!” Xiao Dandan’s pride in
Zhuo Fan jumped a few notches.

Chu Qingcheng smiled without meaning to. Even her eyes glinted with
pride.

The others had to nod at her words. Zhuo Fan was a rarity on this
continent. Where could one find such a youth excelling in mettle and
mind!

Long Jiu proposed, “Let’s go as well. He is now in an open space with a
high chance of escaping, but it’s best we are nearby if things go
south.”

They all nodded and flew outside.

But a panicked cry came at this moment, “Dandan, Dandan, save me!”

His master’s corpse turned Lin Tianyu’s legs to mush, unable to even
move from fear. Watching Chu Qingcheng’s group leaving as well, he
supposed they were aiming for Zhuo Fan and got excited.

Lin Tianyu started crying as if he hadn’t seen his relatives in years.

This man truly took after his master. He was still clueless which side
was pro Zhuo Fan, and which was anti Zhuo Fan. He went and assumed Zhuo
Fan made a scapegoat out of Drifting Flowers Edifice.

So, he hurried to Xiao Dandan, gave a few bows to the seniors and wept,
“Dandan, that demon killed my master. For the feelings we had, for
Drifting Flowers Edifice and Merry Woods’ intermarriages all these
years, I plead seniors to give master justice and kill that demon.
Please avenge master!”

Long Jiu’s group was startled, then looked at him funny.

The apple truly didn’t fall far from the tree. [He’s as dumb as his
master. Did you not see us standing at the side doing nothing, with no
intention of stepping in?]

[You are one clueless kid to come ask us for help!]

Lin Tianyu was off-put when they were silent and second-guessed. They
had to be in fear of Zhuo Fan, unwilling to join thinking their houses’
well-being was on the line.

Since appealing to their morality went bust, he’d appeal to reason.

He turned grave on the spot as he spoke with zeal, “Demon Zhuo Fan
flaunts his ruthless and barbaric power. Today he killed my master,
tomorrow he will kill you. Even with second young master and 5th elder
joining hands, they may not hold him here. If he runs, it will spell the
end of the seven houses. For our brothers and sisters, I plead you to
think of your own house, of your bleak future, and join together with
second young master in removing this vile spawn from the face of the
world!”

Lin Tianyu spoke with righteousness, with valor, but the ones he was
talking to were having a ball in their minds.

[Is this kid still playing the gentleman with no crowd around to see
him?]

[Better yet, since when did the seven houses become brothers and
sisters? Are you blind to not see Vicious Pill King almost annihilating
Drifting Flowers Edifice?]

[You need to get your facts straight. Just how has this disciple been
raised to believe this nonsense? When the time comes, he is the type
that won’t even know how he died.]

They only shook their heads and ignored him as they went on their merry
way.

[He is a prime example of what a fool is!]

“Uh, miss Dandan, I find this kid upstanding, so why not take him?
Later… you’ll need to handle him well!” Xie Tianyang cracked jokes.

Lin Tianyu had no clue what this Sword Marquise Abode’s young master was
going with this.

But his words brought Xiao Dandan one thought only. [Isn’t that telling
me to whip him?] And her cheeks flushed.

Lin Tianyu saw them treating him like thin air and he downheartedly
implored Xiao Dandan, “Dandan, Merry Woods is too far and I won’t make
it in time to report. Please, you have to convince your seniors to
avenge master!”

“Do it yourself! What man are you, letting others do your job for you?”
Xiao Dandan snapped a glare at him then kicked him before storming back
to the group.

She was so perplexed. How could they both be men, with one a hero and
the other an annoying coward? He even had the nerve to ask others for
revenge when he didn’t even look the killer in the eye!

The more she compared the two, the more her love grew.

On the other hand, Lin Tianyu fell to the ground and wailed dejectedly,
“What’s wrong with asking others for revenge? How am I supposed to fight
that freak who killed master? This is not how a man…”

Outside the Drifting Flowers Arena was packed with clansmen and
alchemists, who were in the area, afraid of getting in the crossfire
between Huangpu Qingyun and Zhuo Fan.

Although they did leave the building, they were too curious to vacate
the premises.

They wanted to see for themselves the ending. How the demon Zhuo Fan,
grandmaster of alchemy, was as scary as the rumors painted him out to
be. Meanwhile, they were also afraid that they might get caught in the
crossfire and end up injured.

This was a Profound Heaven experts fight to the death, was it not?
Sticking too close would send one to an early grave.

[Sigh, everything’s so twisted.]

The Drifting Flowers Edifice’s disciples were tasked with upholding
order. Xiao Ya was among them too, lamenting. [Why is this time’s
Hundred Pill Meeting filled with fighting?]

She was thinking the Drifting Flowers Arena might even blow up from
their Profound Heaven Stage powers.

Boom!

As she was mulling, a loud explosion rang her ears.

The crowd saw a new opening in the arena wall and a winged figure taking
to the skies.

Zhuo Fan!

Startled, they began to admire how amazing he was to escape from Hell
Valley and Regent Estate.

But then, two more figures came out, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder. They
only took a blink to bar Zhuo Fan’s way.

A sledgehammer and a golden fist flew and backing Zhuo Fan into a
corner.

But with the wide open space around him, Zhuo Fan bizarre art was even
weirder, flitting back and forth like a specter.

Not even Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder’s tight blockade could hold Zhuo
Fan.

In the sky, three figures dashed around, but they always flashed past
each other, not once connecting.

The crowd had long stood slackjawed. None could reach their speeds but
they could guess how astonishing it was.

Seeing Zhuo Fan flitting around so relaxed was enough proof.

[No wonder he’s dubbed demon when he can throw off Profound Heaven
experts with his weird movements. Only a demon could move as creepy as
that.]

Whoosh!

With a sudden kick, Zhuo Fan escaped the two’s encirclement. Huangpu
Qingyun and 5th elder were now panting in pursuit but couldn’t catch up.

They were body cultivators but had no movement art. Matching their speed
to Zhuo Fan taxed their bodies.

“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Qingyun, time to count your blessings!” Laughed Zhuo
Fan.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were far from willing to give up.

Suddenly, an aged voice came, “Youngster, have you forgotten about me?”

Unable to react, Zhuo Fan was stuck. It was as though he was hit with an
artillery shell. Slamming him onto the ground, creating a ten-meter
crater in the ground.

And in his previous spot was a meter large blood-colored bat with small
eyes and sharp glints.

The crowd cried out, “3rd level spiritual beast, “Rumbling Blood Bat!”

Chapter 162 - Dire Straights

Chapter 162, Dire Straights

Rumbling Blood Bat, a seldom-seen peculiar spiritual beast.

In the world of spiritual beasts, the strong preyed on the weak. The
higher the level, the stronger they were. Yet, this creature was an
exception. It was no stronger than a 1st level spiritual beast and had
neither claws nor fangs.

It had a shocking trait though. the Rumbling Bat Wave. It was a sound
attack that struck the soul. It would leave one in a coma or, worse,
annihilate one’s soul.

After using it, it would then go and bore its fangs into the victim,
sucking blood away. It may be a mere 3rd level spiritual beast, but few
were capable of surviving its sound attack.

Not even a 4th level spiritual beast could stand up to a flock of ten
Rumbling Blood Bats.

Who cared how tough you were? Who cared how skilled you were? You’d
still die from this creature’s sound attack if your soul lacked heart.

This creature that bared Zhuo Fan’s escape was one that could strike
fear even in 4th level spiritual beasts.

Jumping out of the hole, Zhuo Fan looked up at the ten bats. He was
finally sporting a serious expression. Then looking at the speaker and
saw Vicious Pill King.

He was holding a gourd, smiling at Zhuo Fan.

“Now I see. This must be your final move!” Zhuo Fan squinted.

He’d seen the old man carry the gourd for a while now. But only
discovered it was a beast holding item.

When cornered by Iris Overseer, Chu Qingcheng, and Long Jiu not too long
ago, he was still putting a tough front because of the Rumbling Blood
Bats in his gourd.

It was smart of them to back off and not to attack then, or they
would’ve been doomed.

This old man wasn’t to be pushed around. Even after using blood essence
four times, he still couldn’t be underestimated no matter how weak he
appeared.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed in admiration.

Long Jiu’s group just came out through the hole and saw him standing
amidst ruins. They turned to the sky and paled, “Rumbling Blood Bat! And
ten of them?!”

They all turned grave.

Just when they thought Zhuo Fan had free reign of the skies outside the
arena, he was met with ten Rumbling Blood Bats. Zhuo Fan was now
cornered by two Profound Heaven experts and a 4th level spiritual beast
equivalent flock of bats.

Not even a Profound Heaven expert could pull an escape out of this,
least of all, a winged Bone Tempering expert.

Their hearts were now stretched taught.

“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Yan. In the end, you are the most reliable to block
this brat!”

Laughing freely, Huangpu Qingyun floated next to the old man. Then, he
stuck up his chin at Zhuo Fan, “Kid, let’s see you run now!”

Hell Valley’s 5th elder landed beside them, eyes flashing with cruelty.

Sighing, Vicious Pill King looked on with regret, “Song, uh, Grandmaster
Zhuo, I am in awe of sir’s wondrous refining skill. I am pained to have
you as my enemy. But I am bereft of any choice!”

His words stirred the sympathy of many clan delegates, as well as the
alchemists participating today.

The demon Zhuo Fan, who offended Hell Valley, was Grandmaster Song. Such
sorrow!

A cruel death awaited all who dared oppose the Seven Noble Houses. But
an exalted alchemist to find his end in such a wretched way, was
lamentable.

The least the crowd could do was show deep respect while sending off
this great man on his final journey…

But Zhuo Fan only snickered, “He-he-he, Elder Yan, you think too highly
of your batsies. They can scare a 4th level spiritual beasts, but in the
end, they’re a flock!”

Zhuo Fan vanished as he took flight.

The bats flapped their wings and opened their snouts. The air rippled
and a visible wave traveled at Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan sidestepped. The wave hit the ground but nothing happened. Yet,
the stones around turned to dust.

The people began to fear the Rumbling Blood Bat even more. A normal Bone
Tempering expert struck by this wave would’ve died in anguish.

But Zhuo Fan relied on his uncanny speed to dance among the attacks. He
was almost out of their encirclement.

“Damn, Zhuo Fan is too sly. He noticed that the ten bats are unable to
coordinate and slipped through the gaps in their attacks. Let’s block
him together, 5th elder!”

Huangpu Qingyun cried in panic, to which, Vicious Pill King dismissed
his words, “Second young master, don’t worry. You’ll only make it worse
if you charge along with the blood bats. I will make sure he won’t have
anywhere else to run.”

Vicious Pill King opened his gourd and made a hand sign.

A screech came from within it, followed by another flock of bats flying
to the gap Zhuo Fan was aiming for, shutting it tight.

Hum~

A dozens of times stronger ripple sent Zhuo Fan barreling into the
ground, leaving another huge hole.

When he crawled out, he sucked a cold breath at the sight.

The sky was filled with Rumbling Blood Bats. A rough estimate would give
around a hundred.

If 10 were enough for a 4th level spiritual beast, then a hundred would
even kill a 5th level spiritual beast.

A bolt of fear went through the crowd, including Huangpu Qingyun. They
were so frightened they couldn’t speak.

Not even a Radiant Stage expert could come out of this one, least of all
this Zhuo Fan freak.

“Holy! Just where did the old coot find so many Rumbling Blood Bats?
They don’t grow on trees!” Long Jiu’s mind was in a haze, “Not even the
brat could get out of this one.”

“What?” Xiao Dandan jerked, “You’re saying husband has no chance?”

Nodding gravely, Long Jiu sighed and pointed.

When Zhuo Fan was falling, Vicious Pill King made other signs and had
Zhuo Fan surrounded by the hundred bats.

If he dared fly, the bats would blow him back down.

This barricaded area seemed to belong to a different world, covered by a
hundred rare Rumbling Blood Bats. They tightened the space so much that
it became smaller than Drifting Flowers Arena.

“Damn it!” Zhuo Fan frowned as he jumped in the sky again.

Hum~

Like a pillar coming from the heavens above, Zhuo Fan was sent into the
ground without delay. His knees were touching dirt, blood seeped from
his mouth, and all the rocks around him were blown away as nothing but
dust.

“Ha-ha-ha, a hundred blood bats is so strong that even the kid’s
unyielding body is wounded. His death is in sight.” Huangpu Qingyun
laughed, watching Vicious Pill King with newfound respect, “Elder Yan,
you’ve surprised me. I never knew you hid such wonderful things.”

“Second young master, you jest. These bats were gathered over the past
thousand years by the Pill King Hall. I was only allowed to use them
because of my modest contributions to Pill King Hall.”

Vicious Pill King then turned a sad look to Zhuo Fan, “Second young
master, Zhuo Fan is, after all, a grandmaster alchemist. He may deserve
death, but leave his corpse intact.”

“Humph, I really wanted to tear him apart, but since it’s Elder Yan’s
request, I will let it go.” Huangpu Qingyun waved, pleased inside.

Nodding, Vicious Pill King made the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats open
their snouts again.

All of them struck with sound attacks at the same time.

“Ah!”

With a wail, Zhuo Fan felt his head about to explode and his mind
fading. His soul was damaged.

If not for the refining he had been through, he would’ve long had his
soul scattered.

“Blast it! I still had a way out but now it’s useless. I should’ve used
it when I had the chance! These bastards better hope I won’t get out of
here or I will slaughter them all.”

His head hurting like hell, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and held on to
his dear life. His bloodshot eyes and veiny forehead let the crowd in on
the suffering he was enduring.

“Humph, he is a freak alright. Anyone would’ve hit the dirt by now, but
he’s still holding strong.” 5th elder exclaimed.

Huangpu Qingyun laughed, his eyes sharp, “So what if he’s a freak? He’s
just slightly tougher than the average man. He’ll soon drop dead anyway.
This is for the best. Killing him here will show the world what end
awaits any who stands against Regent Estate.”

“Ah!”

Zhuo Fan’s wail never ceased, akin to a flogged wild beast. The rocks he
had been clutching had long been crushed to powder.

Vicious Pill King didn’t indulge in taking revenge, only feeling endless
regret. His greatest and most respected opponent would find himself dead
in such a wretched way.

The alchemists around also sighed. But there was no one there willing to
stand up to the seven houses.

Xiao Dandan’s face was covered in tears, pleading Chu Qingcheng with her
eyes. She bit her lip, about to intervene, but Long Jiu pulled her back.

“Not even we can save him from the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats’
onslaught. We will only throw our lives away. Let it go, there is no
point…” Long Jiu sighed at Zhuo Fan’s sorry state. Already thinking
about how to abandon the Luo clan.

His alliance was with Zhuo Fan. Without him, the Veiled Dragon Pavilion
had no reason to help the Luo clan. With Zhuo Fan dying, the alliance
agreement would fall through.

[Sigh, brother, don’t blame me. I will look after your clan, but cannot
uphold the alliance any longer. It just isn’t in the house’s benefit!]

Long Jiu sighed, while the rest lowered their heads in resignation.

Zhuo Fan was in dire straits, with no one appearing to aid him…

Chapter 163 - I Want to Kill

Chapter 163, I Want to Kill

Suddenly, Zhuo Fan’s wailing was cut short. Everyone’s heart seized with
a shiver. Qingcheng even began shedding tears thinking Zhuo Fan was
gone.

But what was so astonishing was that Zhuo Fan’s energy signature was
still there, with an azure flame in the center of his forehead.

Under its cover, Zhuo Fan started breathing eased up. The sound waves
didn’t stop, but they weren’t as aggravating as before.

“That’s…” Xie Tianyang cried, “I remember now! In his battle with You
Guiqi, this azure flame appeared as well, shielding his soul.”

Indeed, Zhuo Fan was muddled from the pain to his soul and forgot about
the azure flame protecting his soul.

Now that his soul was at its limit, the azure flame came out by itself.

With it, Zhuo Fan relaxed. Under the gentle and warm glow of the flame,
his soul began to recover.

Zhuo Fan felt how it grew and was on the verge to break through into the
Radiant Stage.

Slowly closing his eyes, Zhuo Fan remained kneeling and ignored
everything around him as he let the warmth bathe him. This was a rare
chance for his soul to advance and he wasn’t about to miss it.

The proud Huangpu Qingyun now cried in panic at Vicious Pill King,
“Elder Yan, what’s happening? He still seems to be alive!”

“Uh, he’s not dead yet!” Vicious Pill King was also confused.

“Then what is this? Why isn’t he wailing and seems to be enjoying it
instead?” Huangpu Qingyun was baffled.

Vicious Pill King rolled his eyes and shook his head, [How should I
know?]

“Elder Yan.” Huangpu Qingyun squinted, “You can’t be thinking of going
easy on him because he’s an incredible alchemist, are you?”

Incensed, Vicious Pill King snapped his glare on him, “Second young
master, please watch your tone! Haven’t Pill King Hall always assisted
Regent Estate? When have we ever shown the opposite? Aren’t we getting
the Bodhi Root for you as well?”

“Ha-ha-ha, that remains to be seen. Everyone knows Pill King Hall yearns
for this incredible treasure. Who knows, maybe you’ll just take it and
run at first chance!” Huangpu Qingyun snorted.

Vicious Pill King was so furious he couldn’t say a word and his heart
sank.

Zhuo Fan’s words may have been to break their teamwork, but they were
undoubtedly true. This Huangpu Qingyun was no leader material, he was
too narrow-minded.

5th elder walked to Huangpu Qingyun, watching Zhuo Fan assaulted by the
Rumbling Blood Bats and said, “Second young master, I think he had come
up with a way to block the blood bats. If this continues, the situation
will only worsen.”

“What do you think we should do?” Huangpu Qingyun was growing worried as
well.

5th elder revealed a wicked grin, “I suggest we attack him together. The
blood bats sealed that uncanny movement skill and we can kill him at
close range. Also, second young master, didn’t you speak of killing him
yourself to ease your hatred? He-he-he…”

“Yes, we’ll do as you say.” Huangpu Qingyun nodded, and said to Vicious
Pill King in request, when in fact it sounded more like a demand, “I’ll
be troubling Elder Yan to stop the blood bat’s attack and let us go
fight him ourselves. But remember, don’t let that kid escape again.”

Snorting inside, despite his anger, Vicious Pill King complied. Who told
the Regent Estate and Pill King Hall to sign an alliance agreement? For
lack of a better alternative, he had to obey.

With a hand sign, the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats stopped but Zhuo Fan’s
eyes were still very much closed as he kneeled on the ground. He looked
just like a man on his last leg, with his reserves spent, he was unable
to even stand up. With one exception, the azure flame still flickered on
his forehead.

“What’s wrong with him?” Chu Qingcheng asked, anxious.

With the sound attacks gone, he should’ve jumped to his feet. But he was
sitting there like a statue instead. He may be either comatose or too
weak to even move.

Both of which were the worst possibilities in such a dangerous
situation.

Chu Qingcheng pleaded Long Jiu with her eyes, “Uncle Jiu…”

His lone eye shook as he said gravely, “Wait a bit longer!”

“If he still has a scheme in play, we will not only fail to save him by
going in now, but even ruin his plan.” Xie Tianyang blurted.

The rest nodded.

They were all clear from Zhuo Fan’s handling of Huangpu Qingyun so far.
He always aimed for when his opponent was unguarded. He was unfathomable
to always seem to manage to have Huangpu Qingyun trapped again and again
without even realizing it.

Huangpu Qingyun was thinking the same thing.

Zhuo Fan looked calm, unmoving, but who knew if he was faking it
instead? They wanted to avoid his sudden assault, which could send
another one of them to an early grave.

Huangpu Qingyun recalled just how dangerous it was so far and he was
soaked in a cold sweat. His steps were even more careful as they neared
Zhuo Fan.

The alchemists and the clans’ delegates bolted before they could witness
the intricate battle of before.

To their eyes, two Profound Heaven experts, from the seven houses, were
shaking in their boots in the face of a defenseless Bone Tempering
cultivator.

They were dumbstruck!

[Dude, what’s up with that? You are the ones after his life, you are the
strongest one here, yet you won’t dare get close to an unconscious man?
You’re disgracing the seven houses, you know?]

Huangpu Qingyun’s response, if he could hear them, would be, [I know!
Damn it!]

Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Qingyun closed in on Zhuo Fan ever so
slowly, yet the sweat on his brow grew denser as well. He wasn’t afraid
of fighting Zhuo Fan.

It was Zhuo Fan’s tricky nature that left him harried.

At the end of it all, he was just scared of falling for Zhuo Fan’s trick
again!

When they finally got to Zhuo Fan, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder tested
with a punch.

Bam!

The golden fist smacked into Zhuo Fan’s face and sent him flying. Then a
boom resounded as he was buried in rubble.

Huangpu Qingyun was stumped, [Wasn’t that too easy?] Zhuo Fan didn’t
even react and he was now overjoyed. [He must be still out of it from
the bats’ sound attacks.]

“5th elder, we were right. His brain is the only thing that kept him
alive so far.” Huangpu Qingyun laughed.

5th elder nodded and grinned as he invited, “If you would, second young
master!”

The two puffed out their chest and strutted to the rubble.

The people were speechless. They were shaking in their boots before, but
now they knew he was out like an extinguished candle, a lamb to the
slaughter, they got their haughty attitudes back.

[W-what kind of people are these?]

The crowd looked at them with derision. They’d be raining mockeries if
not for them being from the seven houses.

The two were too self-absorbed in their joy to notice, and were now
going to pluck the fruit of victory.

Chu Qingcheng was panicking. Even if she acted now, it was far too late.

Long Jiu looked up at the circling bats, then around, and said through
clenched teeth, “Jian Suifeng, Iris Overseer, Peony Overseer, come with
me to deal with the bats. Kill as many as you can. Qingcheng, you go
save the kid. I hope Huangpu Qingyun will go easy seeing a familiar
face!”

Chu Qingcheng nodded with conviction.

But before they could start, another boom followed. Zhuo Fan jumped out
of the rubble and the azure flame was also gone, but his eyes flashed
with a bluish glow, as if flames still throbbed within.

“Who the hell hit me? Step up and I promise not to beat you to death!”
He twisted his neck around to the two of them with an evil grin.

Startled, Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were incredulous, “You’re fine
even after being hit by a hundred bats’ attacks?”

“Ha-ha-ha, the hundred bats’ cawing were nothing but annoying.” Zhuo Fan
showed a cryptic smile.

The people were dumbstruck. A hundred Rumbling Blood Bats were enough to
kill a 5th level spiritual beast but he was safe and sound?

[Zhuo Fan is a freak through and through.]

Vicious Pill King was also dazed from shock. Long Jiu’s group finally
relaxed.

“He is always giving us scares and worries. He has a talent to keep
turning a crisis into a blessing in disguise!” Long Jiu sighed, but Chu
Qingcheng frowned at the bats in the sky, “The danger has yet to pass.”

“No, it’s all fine now.”

Xie Tianyang smiled, “Look how his eyes changed. I only saw that look
once, when he killed You Guiqi. I will never forget that unnerving
confidence.”

They all looked and realized Xie Tianyang was right. Zhuo Fan’s entire
demeanor changed. He was like a honed sword, waiting to leave its sheath
and upturn the world.

And deep in the dark abyss that were his eyes, frigid killing intent
roiled.

Even Long Jiu, a Profound Heaven expert, shivered. Xie Tianyang laughed
and stretched, “He is itching to slaughter someone!”

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder nearby the rubble were tense. But the
hundred bats overhead worked to assure their safety, “Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo
Fan, there’s nowhere for you to run. So stand still and await your
death.”

“Run?”

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan flicked his eyes at the beasts above and
smiled, “Yeah, there’s nowhere to run now. And since none of you want to
see me running, I will do just what you want and stay put.”

“Stay… and kill!” Zhuo Fan spat through gnashed teeth, riveting his
boundless killing intent on the two of them.

The two shivered and their hearts were struck by an odd sense of fear.

The two found it hard to accept it, [How can this be…]

Chapter 164 - Discerning Field

Chapter 164, Discerning Field

Soul suppression!

It was an ability anyone with a powerful soul could use to put pressure
on those weaker than him, until they could not even stand. Zhuo Fan
didn’t reach that far but was enough to instill fear in his enemies.

This in turn caused them to feel shocked.

Although both were body cultivators, they were nonetheless still focused
on training their souls in preparation to enter the Radiant Stage. The
best example was Huangpu Qingyun, who trained in Imperial Tyrant Body
Art, refining his body with dragon power but also able to use dragon
soul to refine his own soul.

Their souls were strong, even for Profound Heaven experts like them.

However, reality showed Zhuo Fan’s soul exceeded theirs by so much, that
they felt fear. The only explanation was that this kid had the soul of a
Radiant Stage expert.

This thought crippled their hearts in fear. They stared dumbstruck at
Zhuo Fan to such a degree that not even they could think it possible.

His cultivation was merely in the Bone Tempering Stage yet could go toe
to toe with a Profound Heaven expert and even have his soul in the
Radiant Stage. Was such an outlandish coincidence even possible?

Zhuo Fan picked up on their thinking and smirked, “I believe thanks are
in order. Without the Rumbling Bat Wave’s torment, I would’ve never have
gotten such a timely chance at breaking through!”

The azure fire in his eyes died out and Huangpu Qingyun’s heart seized
with it. He felt a deep fear from the core of his being.

[That has to be it!]

The two were now certain Zhuo Fan just entered the Radiant Stage with
his soul. His soul was indeed strong but not quite there yet to kill
with intent alone.

The reason for his still position before, was because he was in the
middle of advancing.

[This freak cannot be allowed to live!]

Yelling inside, Huangpu Qingyun signaled 5th elder with his eyes. 5th
elder picked up on his decision and got ready.

They had to end him now while they still had the chance. Or when he
grasped how to kill with intent, it’d be too late!

Bam!

With no preamble, Huangpu Qingyun shot towards Zhuo Fan. His body lit up
in a golden glow and was preparing a punch.

5th elder also took out his hammer, aiming at Zhuo Fan’s head.

Zhuo Fan was suddenly overshadowed as if a mountain was about to fall on
him. Suddenly, in front of him was Huangpu Qingyun with his majestic
fist, holding enough power to break mountains and cleave seas.

In face of such devastating assault, Zhuo Fan was unphased. Two azure
glows flickered in his eyes and all he did was slant his head, and the
might fist hit nothing but air.

The golden light traced passed his ear, blowing up a whole street of
houses, yet powerless enough to not touch a single hair on Zhuo Fan’s
head.

Regarding the incoming hammer, Zhuo Fan simply jumped and was out of its
range.

The hammer boomed into the ground, caving the earth for 20 meters
around, yet only enough to reach Zhuo Fan’s toes. He was barely standing
at the edge, at peace, as if all was natural in the world.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were nervous, going at him again, with a
flurry of fists and a rain of hammer blows. There were so many blows.
Each was so fast that it should have sealed any means of escape.

However, Zhuo Fan lightly sidestepped around the attacks without even
the use of Mystifying Phantom Step. Simple footwork was enough to get
him out of any and all danger.

Throughout these hundred blows, Zhuo Fan had danced in but a 2 meter
circle, while Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were powerless to even
ruffle his clothes.

This spectacle was unheard of, much less seen, eliciting cries from the
crowd.

Two Profound Heaven experts were rendered moot in the face of a Bone
Tempering Stage cultivator. They attacked a hundred times but not once
succeeded. Even if this was staged, it was not possible to have such
uncanny accuracy.

While it was impossible to make sense of it all, it was all so clear to
Long Jiu and the rest. But they were all so shocked, so astonished, that
they only stared bugged eyed for a long time.

They were clear of this being a Radiant Stage cultivator’s ability, the
Discerning Field!

Within its range, the user could detect the most minute change. It was
also easy enough to detect an attack’s course.

This was the reason behind all his perfect evasions. While he was under
a barrage of blows, his heart was as still as water.

“This brat had reached a whole new level of freak. That’s a Radiant
Stage’s ability, yet used by a Bone Tempering cultivator…” Long Jiu was
astonished, yet his heart was pained.

How many elders of Veiled Dragon Pavilion worked their whole lives to
reach the Radiant Stage, to feel its power for themselves, yet were
unable to? Long Jiu was no exception.

However, this up and coming Zhuo Fan, still wet behind his ears, beat
them to it. It was a sense of defeat mixed with admiration that made it
so hard to swallow.

He saw Zhuo as his brother, but he could not cast out all the envy he
had. Why were they so different? Why couldn’t he do it as well?

Xie Tianyang sighed as well, “By the looks of it, our little freak came
out of his shell and became a full-fledged abomination. I wonder if he
even has a limit. Will I ever be able to reach him?

“Ha-ha, it doesn’t look like it…” Xie Tianyang shook his head in
frustration.

The others sighed and nodded.

Back to the battle, Zhuo Fan skipped around calmly, escaping the
enemies’ range. The only thing off about him was the azure glint
ever-present in his eyes.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were already panting. They could guess as
to the reason as well, but knowing didn’t enable them to solve it.

Zhuo Fan, a Bone Tempering cultivator, was armed with the Radiant
Stage’s Discerning Field, leaving them powerless to even land a glancing
blow.

“You little prick, fight me if you dare! Come on, be a man for a
change!”

Perhaps his mind was taxed, or his patience long overdrawn, that 5th
elder started cursing Zhuo Fan. He was now regretting doing it.

[Since two great Profound Heaven experts can’t finish a mere Bone
Tempering cultivator, you’re asking him to stand still? If this isn’t
ridiculous then what is?]

[You might as well ask him to tie himself up for you while he’s at it.]

His words were met with profound disdain from the crowd. The seven
houses picking on others was a common occurrence, but never had they
sunk so low.

[Humph, now I know why Grandmaster Zhuo killed You Guiqi. That old coot
was so insufferable that he couldn’t take it anymore. Hell Valley must
be the most shameless of all seven houses!]

Many whispers traveled, and none were good, holding some hint of scorn,
whether open or otherwise.

Huangpu Qingyun glared at the senile fool, [If you want to disgrace
yourself, fine. But don’t go around dragging me into your mess. Just
what is Hell Valley’s requirement for elders these days? Shamelessness?]

Zhuo Fan only quirked an eyebrow and smiled a nod, “I guess that’s fine.
Since I don’t plan on going anywhere either, I suppose I might as well
give you a sound defeat. You see this spot, I won’t move from it!”

Zhuo Fan then planted his feet a tad deeper into the ground, his face
filled with zest, “Just like in refining earlier. If my feet leave this
spot, my head will be yours!”

Sss~

The crowd gasped in fright.

[The heroism of Grandmaster Zhuo is so unmatched it got to his head!
There was nothing to fear while refining since you had that amazing
ancient secret refining art. It is all because of that, that you managed
to keep your head!]

[But this is another matter entirely. You, sir, a Bone Tempering
cultivator, although stronger than average but is still a Bone Tempering
cultivator nonetheless. For the love of god. You are facing two
shameless and despicable Profound Heaven experts head-on. They won’t go
easy on you just ’cause you’re weaker.]

[If you’re still doing with all this into account, then, it’s your
funeral!]

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder jerked but turned bewildered.

“You little prick, what are you playing at?” Huangpu Qingyun eyed him
cautiously.

And the crowd rolled their big white eyes, with some close to spurting
blood.

[Grandmaster Zhuo is rooted to the spot and all that’s left is to tie
him up. Yet, you fools are overthinking it saying it’s some sort of
scheme of his?]

[Humph, guess there’s no frickin’ relation between a man’s nerve and his
cultivation.]

[A Bone Tempering cultivator has more guts to face two Profound Heaven
experts, while you two are more scared than a mouse. You don’t get to
see this every day!]

The people could no longer stand for how despicable they acted and
scorned them despite being from the seven houses.

Huangpu Qingyun’s face was aflame, finding his own words somewhat
faint-hearted. But it was best to be safe rather than sorry in that
punk’s trap.

Laughing, Zhuo Fan didn’t even try hiding it, “Of course I have one. But
nothing overt, just something necessary.”

Zhuo Fan took out a bottle and snickered, “Don’t forget, I’m an
alchemist.”

He popped the cork and a blue gleaming pill landed in his hand with a
shake.

“5th grade pill, Bursting Pill!”

Vicious Pill King’s cried. And Huangpu Qingyun was also panicking as he
flitted back tens of meters, “He’s gonna blow!”

The scene was thrown into chaos as people scampered all over the place
for cover. They feared a Bone Tempering cultivator’s detonation would
reach them.

Long Jiu’s group was startled and perplexed. The situation wasn’t that
dire to warrant such an extreme decision as blowing himself up.

To be truthful, the Bursting Pill was in fact only useful when one did
detonate himself!

The people looked at Zhuo Fan’s calm face, still sporting that cryptic
smile of his…

Chapter 165 - Dominatin

Chapter 165, Dominatin

One, two, three… The pills fell in Zhuo Fan’s hand with a light tap of
the bottle. And with every fall of the azure gleaming pill, hearts were
strung tighter than a fiddle.

When five gathered in his palm, Zhuo Fan placed the bottle away, “Five
pills ought to be the limit.”

“Five?!” Vicious Pill King’s eyelid twitched.

A single Bursting Pill could increase one’s Yuan Qi by ten times. If the
body couldn’t take it, it would blow up from the strain. That explosion
was also ten times stronger than a simple self-detonation.

Taking these pills would turn Zhuo Fan into a ticking time bomb. It
increased his power fifty times, but the explosion would be no less than
a Profound Heaven expert’s.

The damage wouldn’t be limited to this small area either, but the entire
Drifting Flowers City. It would be swept by the shockwave, razed to the
ground.

Vicious Pill King’s heart shuddered as he shouted in fear, “Stop him, or
he’ll drag us all down with him!”

Too little, too late. Zhuo Fan swallowed the pills without hesitation.

In a blink, the wind picked up, and a rumbling echoed.

Under the frightened eyes of his audience, the space around Zhuo Fan
warped. Something seemed to seep out of his body as well, looking akin
to raw and physical Yuan Qi.

His Lightning Wings had grown twice their size.

Under constant changes, Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth as sweat trickled
down his brow. His fist clenched, his face, grim from the unspeakable
pain.

But he held on to his voice, not letting even a grunt escape.

Bam!

His body shivered and his two arms exploded in size. His forehead
sported the azure flame again, but this time bigger than before.

The azure flame now burned hotter, his wings flickered with thunder, and
his cold eyes were bloodshot. His twisted face as well looked ready to
unleash a gruesome power.

The people watched the advent of their death from afar, incredulous of
how much power he had gotten.

He rose steadily from the 2nd layer of Bone Tempering Stage under the
watchful eyes of Vicious Pill King and the rest, with constant anguish.

The stronger he got, the more bang for his buck. If his control slipped
while he powered up, the explosion would be less, but only by a
fraction.

But Zhuo Fan stubbornly hung on and his power soared.

Huangpu Qingyun was appalled, but he was crying inside. [What in god’s
name is this brat made of? How is he still holding it together?]

With a relieving sigh, just like a tornado, Zhuo Fan’s power up reached
the end. Yet, outside of everyone’s expectation, there was no explosion.

All they saw was a calm Zhuo Fan breathing in and out.

“That’s…” Vicious Pill King’s voice trembled, “I-it’s the Profound
Heaven Stage!”

The others could see the fierce aura around him and gasped. In just a
few breaths, Zhuo Fan climbed from the 2nd layer of Bone Tempering Stage
all the way to the Profound Heaven Stage.

[T-this is too astonishing!] Huangpu Qingyun and the 5th elder’s faces
were grave.

They knew now the pills weren’t to off himself, but to increase his
power.

But how could a man accomplish such a feat?

To the average man, a ten times Yuan Qi increase would burst him like a
balloon. But this brat withstood five times of that.

[Just how tough is he?]

“Monster!”

Huangpu Qingyun couldn’t help but voice it. The others also watched with
shock and awe of Zhuo Fan’s staunch body.

Making a come hither gesture at Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder, Zhuo Fan
mocked them with a smile, “Didn’t you want to fight? Well, come and get
me!”

The audacity and scorn made Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder burst with
anger. This was the first time they were ever mocked this much.

They shot at Zhuo Fan without words and Huangpu Qingyun launched a
golden fist right at his face.

“You little shit, if you have the nerve to taunt then don’t dodge and
take it like a man!” Huangpu Qingyun was goading him.

Smirking, Zhuo Fan lifted his hand, “There’s no longer a need to dodge…”

Bam!

Fists met, tearing up the air with a sharp explosion and making ears
sting from it. The two’s Yuan Qi collided and spread like a tidal wave
all around.

The pebbles and rocks around were pulverized under such raw unbridled
power.

The people were frantic in getting their Yuan Qi up to shield
themselves, but some weak Bone Tempering cultivators were flung twenty
meters away and spat blood.

The shock from a simple clash dominated their hearts. The fight was
going to be intense.

But then, their eyes widened.

They watched in shock as Huangpu Qingyun’s all-out attack was simply
blocked by Zhuo Fan. The latter didn’t even look to be trying.

Suddenly, 5th elder entered the scene from behind, swinging that hammer
right at his head.

Dong!

Screeching of metal on metal resounded and another shockwave sped away.
The audience worked to withstand it but dozens were flung into the air.

Yet, when they looked up now, their eyes were twitching.

Zhuo Fan’s face was as calm as ever, to the point of ignoring the 5th
elder completely and letting a wing lightly block the hammer.

Zhuo Fan didn’t even shudder from the blow.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder cried frantically, “Impossible!”

“Nothing’s impossible, especially when it comes to yours truly!” Zhuo
Fan gripped Huangpu Qingyun’s fist and threw him.

Huangpu Qingyun slammed into the ground, sinking inch by inch.

Not forgetting about the 5th elder either, his Lightning Wings slightly
shook and the old man flew for a hundred meters before hitting the
ground. But even so, he had to take six more steps back to stabilize.

Looking at Zhuo Fan now, the 5th elder was frightened. But his heart
couldn’t accept it and charged again. Zhuo Fan brushed his attempt off,
only staring down at Huangpu Qingyun with sarcasm, “Second young master,
remember when you talked to me about men and women? Then allow me to
inform you that this time, only those standing… are real men.”

It was naked humiliation!

Huangpu Qingyun roared and swung at Zhuo Fan. He was Regent Estate’s
second young master, how dared someone insult him?

5th elder arrived as well, smashing with his hammer.

But Zhuo Fan only laughed at their futile attempts.

His body was refined with Diamond Sand into a 5th-grade demonic
treasure. He couldn’t take these two on earlier because his Yuan Qi was
lacking in bringing about the body’s true potential.

Taking five Bursting Pill compensated for this, allowing him to use his
demonic treasure body to its full capabilities. Adding to his Radiant
Stage soul, how could these two even land a hit?

Grinning, Zhuo Fan placed a hand behind him and only used his left to
block everything and anything Huangpu Qingyun threw at him. At the same
time, he used his wings to dance to 5th elder’s hammering tune.

Clangs and dings were heard constantly, as the power behind each swing
was enough to pulverize anything around them

The sting from the explosions hurt the people’s ears but they were too
dumbstruck to mind.

Seeing how easily Zhuo Fan handled two Profound Heaven experts while
standing still was hard to believe, even when seeing it themselves.

[What is wrong with this world? Since when did there exist a Bone
Tempering cultivator who is such a monster, capable of making Profound
Heaven experts become his stepping stone? This is two on one, and they
can’t even gain the upper hand! Worst, their opponent is taking it in
stride.]

Despite their curses, they knew the truth. The Profound Heaven experts
that laid in front of their eyes were in no way weak, but this Bone
Tempering youth was simply too much of a monster!

Long Jiu’s group was stupefied.

A blink was all it took for Zhuo Fan’s power to surpass everyone’s
imagination. Their minds couldn’t cope with the impossible scene
unfolding right before their eyes.

The world flipped, the power scheme upturned, and a Bone Tempering
cultivator was playing with two Profound Heaven experts!

Chu Qingcheng and her overseers were bug-eyed. It was Iris Overseer who
first recovered somewhat to gasp, “Demon Zhuo Fan lives up to his
infamy. The monster of all freaks.”

Xie Tianyang felt like crying, “8th elder, I should go find elder
brother to train with my sword. I want to revive Sword Marquise Abode.
There’s no point in going after that brat. That dream… is just wishful
thinking!”

Jian Suifeng sighed as well.

Ever since they saw Zhuo, not only the juniors, but even the elders were
suffering a serious blow to their self-esteem…

Chapter 166 - Dauntless

Chapter 166, Dauntless

Boom~

Not for a second did the explosion stopped.

Huangpu Qingyun had now clashed two hundred times with Zhuo Fan. Adding
5th elder’s hammer blows, it made for a total of four hundred yet Zhuo
Fan had not once lost his cool.

No matter how the two attacked, they could not even scratch him.

With cold laughter, Zhuo Fan was now looking at them as if they were a
bunch of noisy children, hardly of any threat.

Hu~

Suddenly, the azure flame flickered above Zhuo Fan slowly dissipated.
Zhuo Fan’s brow was locked, finally sporting a serious face.

[Almost there!]

“Humph, have you swung enough? My turn then.”

Snorting, the ever passive Zhuo Fan just stretched his hand and gripped
Huangpu Qingyun’s wrist in a vise.

Bam!

A simple ordinary fist hit the man squarely in the belly and gave
Huangpu Qingyun the feeling as if a mountain bore through. He then
whistled through the air like a ragdoll.

Only to pass through dozens of buildings on his way and ending under a
pile of rubble.

With one down, Zhuo Fan looked askance at the ever swinging 5th elder.
One wing shifted and flowed along the hammer like a viper and latched
onto his shoulder.

The other whipped him on the chest.

Bam!

With a thunderous sound that could only be made by a crumbling mountain,
5th elder flew into the air before smacking into the ground, leaving
behind a deep hole.

When he staggered out of it, he slipped and fell down, spewing blood.

“Five… ribs broken!” 5th elder tried to bear through the pain as his
brow was marred with cold sweat.

He had never suffered this much in his entire life as a body cultivator.
Worse, just one thrash was all it took to break his five ribs.

Huangpu Qingyun faired no better. He got out of the rubble only to hit
the dirt, and spat OUT blood five times; with pieces of flesh in the
puddle.

Clutching his stomach, he was aware of the heavy wounds his organs
suffered. But his shock of Zhuo Fan’s power trumped it.

He cultivated the Imperial Tyrant Body Art yet, couldn’t take even a
punch?

The azure flame died from his forehead and Zhuo Fan eyed the two coldly.
He lightly stepped out of the footprints he made and patronized, “I gave
you not one, but two chances. It’s you who are too weak to make use of
them. You ought to be convinced of your defeat by now. So it is only
proper for me to take your lives.”

The crowd was in complete shock!

With the two of them being second young master of Regent Estate and 5th
elder of Hell Valley, they may be beaten at every turn, but only they
had the privilege of killing others whenever and however they wanted. It
was not supposed to be not the other way around. It was as if their
killer couldn’t give a rat’s ass about the seven houses’ retaliation.

But the crowd doubled back and wondered again, [Who is this man?]

Demon Zhuo Fan, killer of the insidious You Guiqi. So, why would he care
if he messed with Hell Valley, again?

When one of the Seven Noble Houses was offended, what difference would
it make if he added another?

This realization got the audience’s expectation to rise!

The Seven Noble Houses had no one to answer to for a thousand years,
until now. This was perhaps a once in a lifetime chance to see the Seven
Noble Houses finally being on the receiving end. It was high time they
got what they deserved in full.

They masked the joy they felt, silently cheering.

[Grandmaster Zhuo, you’re our man! Kill them, kill them all…]

Besides, it had nothing to do with them anyway. It wasn’t like enjoying
the show was a capital crime!

Zhuo Fan seemed to have heard their hearts and stepped towards Huangpu
Qingyun with killing intent in his eyes.

Huangpu Qingyun was downright panicking, finally getting acquainted with
the taste of fear for the very first time. He never saw someone as
powerful as Zhuo Fan, nor one to have such a matching imposing flair.

Deep down, he began to feel like a meager ant waiting to be squished.

Sweating like a pig, Huangpu Qingyun fell backward with a mask of fear
and not even trying to put on a token of resistance.

Hell Valley’s 5th elder felt just as helpless.

This freak Zhuo Fan surpassed their expectations. He wanted to go and
help but he needed power, which he didn’t possess. Also, what was he
doing going around helping Regent Estate’s second young master when his
situation was no better?

However, a seven-colored mist flew at the squinting Zhuo Fan, “Rainbow
Cloud Palm, Yan Song!”

“Of course it is me!”

Vicious Pill King propped his frail body as he used the signature
profound ranked martial art of Pill King Hall. His mouth curved into a
grin, “Grandmaster Zhuo, I admit your refining skill is thousands of
times better than mine, but your escape is nigh impossible from the
poison of my Rainbow Cloud Palm.”

“Yan Song, putting up this front will only speed your death. Why must
you throw your life away?” Zhuo Fan frowned as he shouted at Vicious
Pill King.

Grinning, Vicious Pill King raised his head and sighed, “Repaying favor
with favor!”

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and secretly nodded.

Boom!

The seven-colored poisoned mist swallowed Zhuo Fan whole.

Huangpu Qingyun was grasping straws at this point, happy to find hope in
this frail rescuer, “Thank you Elder Yan, but this brat is a freak of
nature. Can your Rainbow Cloud Palm handle him?”

“Cough, cough… no, it can only buy time!”

Using a profound ranked martial art with an already weary and damaged
body only aggravated his precarious state resulting in a vicious
coughing fit, followed by spitting blood. Yan Fu could no longer stand
still and watch him suffer, but Vicious Pill King gestured to him to
stand down.

“Second young master, the Bursting Pill has increased his power to
Profound Heaven Stage for a short while, but it comes with side effects.
As this power isn’t his to begin with, once the time is up… cough~”

“You’re saying he’ll go back to normal?” Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes shined,
his face ecstatic. He could see the dawn of victory on the horizon.

Vicious Pill King smiled, “It won’t stop there. He forced himself to
increase his power and it will undoubtedly harm his body, no matter how
tough he is. Once his boost is sapped, his body will be torn from the
inside, his power is waning. He will be nothing more than a lamb to the
slaughter!”

“We just need to hang on for a bit and victory will be ours!” Huangpu
Qingyun found hope rekindled. 5th elder was thrilled as well.

“But how long can he last?” 5th elder asked nervously, and Huangpu
Qingyun looked at Yan Song eagerly.

Snickering, Vicious Pill King’s eyes glinted at the rainbow mist, “Not
long. You may not have noticed but the azure flame wisped away from his
forehead. His time is running short.”

Huangpu Qingyun reddened with shame. The two were scared shitless and
that made them lose all reason.

Vicious Pill King shook his head, fully grasping the seriousness of the
situation, “Second young master, you can’t blame yourselves. This brat
is too cunning, seeing through you and having you buy into his fake
bravado. He is now under my Rainbow Cloud Palm and is suffering from its
poison. He will soon be too weak to put up any resistance.”

Huangpu Qingyun was immensely grateful. He could finally see the light.
Chu Qingcheng however, was frowning in worry.

Then a sudden laughter came from within the mist.

“Ha-ha-ha, you’re indeed praise worthy, Vicious Pill King. I can’t hide
the Bursting Pill’s side effect from you! Although, you are wrong about
one thing. The time I have to kill the likes of you is aplenty!”

“Humph, Grandmaster Zhuo, you can’t fool me! You had your chance before,
but now, under my Rainbow Cloud Palm’s poison, your Yuan Qi will be
sapped even faster!”

“Oh, you mean these seven poisons?”

More laughter spread from the mist, “Elder Yan, you may not recall our
discussion but, to whom this world belonged to again?”

“My answer is to men and smart people, naturally!” Vicious Pill King
didn’t know where Zhuo Fan was going with this.

With another laughter, Zhuo Fan continued, “Mine is different. The world
belongs only to the strong!”

Suddenly, black billowing energy spewed from within the seven-colored
mist and swallowed the poison mist whole. And from amidst the black
energy, Zhuo Fan strutted out like a king, unharmed and untouched.

“Impossible! Pill King Hall’s thousand-year-long research in the seven
poisons…” Bug-eyed, Vicious Pill King staggered two steps back.

All the shocks he experienced today paled to this.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Old man, do you get my meaning? I am
not saying you should lump me together with those useless broads. What
I’m saying is not to take me for a weakling, the same as them. Your
poison only works on the weak, with not one damn effect on the strong
like me.”

Vicious Pill King gasped heavier and heavier. Unknown if from shock or
anger.

But Iris Overseer was so pissed her eyes spat fire, “Who is this brat
calling weak?”

“Easy now, easy, it’s all just an act.” Xie Tianyang placated her, and
smiled, “Moreover, his words clarified that you and he have nothing
going on. This is for your own good. At least Regent Estate won’t come
finding faults with you.”

“Yeah, darling’s words are savage but he’s always looking out for us.
Not to mention, we are indeed weaker than darling!” Xiao Dandan looked
at him like a love-struck puppy. Infatuated the more she gazed upon him,
and grew in boldness as well.

Peony Overseer pinched her, “Damn girl, you’re starting to get on my
nerves…”

Chapter 167 - Invincible

Chapter 167, Invincible

Zhuo Fan dominated the battlefield. He was a living paragon, taking
dauntless steps towards the three. The murderous glint in his eyes was
razor-sharp and got them shaking from the very core.

Zhuo Fan was now the picture of indomitability, willing to slay
everything that dared bar his path, including gods. Huangpu Qingyun had
lost all will to even resist, standing there like a terrified chicken.

The three never dreamed they’d see the day when they would run into such
a dreadful foe.

For three great experts, joint together too, sinking so low was an irony
in and of itself.

Sweating bullets, Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan with nothing but
fear. He very much knew of his foe’s weakness, needing but little time
to turn all of this around, yet, he couldn’t stop the sense of
powerlessness boring deep in his heart.

This was power. He knew how to counter, but lacked the means to do so.
The power gap was a bottomless pit.

Vicious Pill King wrecked his mind about and suddenly his eyes flashed
with resolve. He took out a bottle toward the other two, “Second young
master, both of you take a pill.”

He proceeded to give each of them one.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder stared at it in shock. Zhuo Fan’s brow
also shook. He was more than familiar with it. In fact, it was the same
pill he used, Bursting Pill.

Eyes shuddering, Huangpu Qingyun’s heavy gaze landed on Vicious Pill
King, “Elder Yan, this is indeed the only way. Even if we need someone
to self-destruct to kill him.”

Huangpu Qingyun squinted at 5th elder, “5th elder, I entrust this task
to you. Have no worry, I will pay your valley a personal visit and
present my utmost gratitude to Valley Lord, in honor of your selfless
sacrifice. Regent Estate and Hell Valley will forevermore be allies!”

[When the time to blow is at hand, why the hell aren’t you doing it?]

5th elder was about to rain curses, but Huangpu Qingyun’s dead set eyes
cut him deep.

[Regent Estate is a double-crossing two-timing pack of pricks. I can bet
my life on it that Huangpu Qingyun won’t ever take Hell Valley as his
ally. Even if he does, what freaking good will that honor do me?]

5th elder wouldn’t stick his head out even for Hell Valley.

Huangpu Qingyun saw 5th elder still wavering and stared him down while
belittling him, “This brat is Hell Valley’s problem to begin with. It’s
your duty to finish him!”

5th elder’s face sank, itching to tear Huangpu Qingyun a new one.

[Hell Valley has a score to settle with this demon, but aren’t you also
aiming to kill him? And now that you find yourself lacking, you wish to
throw me to the wolves?]

Zhuo Fan shook his head and snickered.

When life and death hung in the balance, almost everyone would cling to
their only vain chance at life. Why would he sacrifice himself for the
sake of others? Everyone looked on with respect and deference towards
Regent Estate but none would ever wash their necks and spill blood for
them.

Who was that big of a fool anyway?

“He-he-he, no need to shift the blame, you’ll both be dropping dead soon
enough.” Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s fist ebbed with black energy.

Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elders shuddered and stepped back in horror.

Vicious Pill King shook his head and shouted, “Second young master, 5th
elder, this pill isn’t meant to kill you. It is to boost your power like
it did to the brat.”

“What did you say?” The two shouted in unison, watching him flabbergast.

Sighing inside, Vicious Pill King showed a trace of disappointment.
These two were great in the seven houses, but they couldn’t hold a
candle to a kid’s valor.

His face hard, he spoke, “You are body cultivators, while he is a freak
of nature, you are titans. If he could take five, how could you not even
handle one? And since death is certain, why not go for broke? Isn’t it
better to die on your terms then end up lambs to the slaughter like my
weak self?”

The two trembled and gathered up their courage as they looked at the
pill in their hands. Then they swallowed it.

Instantly, a gale blew and their Yuan Qi spiked. Overpowering Yuan Qi
coursed through their veins, eating at their flesh. The pain was
excruciating and elicited a roar from them both.

The Yuan Qi imbued roar scattered even the Rumbling Blood Bats. While
the people around covered their ears in hope of dampening the splitting
headache.

But this power couldn’t be denied, tearing at their ears and making them
all bleed.

Zhuo Fan had to take a few steps back from the raw display of power.
Vicious Pill King was pushed back more than ten feet as well, but his
breath was as uneven as before.

With how Huangpu Qingyun and 5th elder were Profound Heaven experts to
begin with, a ten times increase in power far outstripped the norm.

The increase finally stopped and the two felt the surging Yuan Qi within
their bodies. The power was intoxicating, evident from their excited
faces.

They could never believe this was their power.

Now looking at Zhuo Fan, they shed all fears and bore down on him with
killing intent.

“Ha-ha-ha, this outcome is only logical. Taking a Bursting Pill is
nothing when you’re a Profound Heaven Stage cultivator.” Vicious Pill
King laughed in glee. This was his desperate attempt at turning things
around, yet never once did he believe it would work.

Long Jiu’s group felt the two’s raw power, far exceeding Zhuo Fan’s and
were filled with concern. Zhuo Fan’s advantage was stripped and, even
worse, his time was running out.

As time passed, the two may not be able to defeat him, but his Yuan Qi
would run dry and all that awaited him was death.

Zhuo Fan couldn’t be more clearer on this. In fact, this was his main
worry.

Tightening his fists, with a burst of power, Zhuo Fan’s wings flickered
and stared down the three of them, “We all know I don’t have time to
waste. So I’ll just snatch victory with one blow.”

“Humph, couldn’t agree more. I will take your head myself.”

With great power came a great boost in ego to Huangpu Qingyun, releasing
all that he was worth. Following dragons roars, six golden dragons
swirled around him, the same as when he first attacked Zhuo Fan.

But soon, a seventh dragon was added.

“Imperial Tyrant Body Art, 7th stage!” Not only Vicious Pill King but
even Long Jiu’s group gasped.

The Imperial Tyrant Body Art was a marvel among body cultivation
methods. Each stage would transform the user body, toughening and
strengthening it in all aspects. With him advancing in such a dire
moment, Huangpu Qingyun’s power must’ve grown by no less than ten times.

In a blink, the people turned to Zhuo Fan with worry.

Huangpu Qingyun had now become the same level of freak as Zhuo Fan.

“He-he-he, you little shit, feast your eyes on Regent Estate’s Imperial
Tyrant Body Art’s true power.”

Huangpu Qingyun roared and charged. The seven golden dragons swirled
around and made all defense moot.

Zhuo Fan’s squinted fearlessly. He charged as well, although his display
was much weaker.

At the moment of impact, Zhuo Fan revealed his trademark smirk, “Kid,
when it comes to martial arts, your wretched Regent Estate has nothing
on me!”

Zhuo Fan roared, “Wraith Style’s first move, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”

Roar!

With a sky shaking roar, Zhuo Fan was enveloped in the image of a black
dragon as he clashed with Huangpu Qingyun.

The seven golden dragons and the black dragon collided, unleashing a
shockwave of epic proportion. The witnesses had to cough blood while the
weaker ones were knocked out cold.

Even Vicious Pill King was hurled three hundred meters into the air.

He never would’ve guessed Zhuo Fan was hiding so many outstanding
abilities. It was no less than Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art,
if not stronger.

When things finally settled, people relaxed. They turned to see smoke
billowing and watched dumbstruck.

Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingyun changed positions, but Zhuo Fan was as
mighty as ever, with no decrease in his aura, just like a god of war.
His eyes flashed with boundless valor.

As for Huangpu Qingyun, he was pale and blood pooled at his feet.
Looking down he saw half of his body in pieces. His innards had long
turned to dust.

“H-how can it be… so strong…”

Huangpu Qingyun’s eyes bulged out of his sockets as he peered into the
hole in his body. Then, his eyes went dead, and collapsed in his own
blood. His death was the same as any of Zhuo Fan’s victims, filled with
endless remorse.

Sss~

Gasping, the people stared at Zhuo Fan with dread. Huangpu Qingyun,
under the Bursting Pill, at the peak of his power, was killed in one
blow.

Vicious Pill King as well as Long Jiu watched, astonished at Zhuo Fan’s
new degree of power, making them reassess this youth’s level.

They thought that in Huangpu Qingyun’s newfound power against Zhuo Fan,
a tie was already an extravagant wish. But it went way beyond that,
getting killed with only a single blow.

Xie Tianyang gasped and lamented, “Now I really need to go practice my
sword with big brother…”
