Chapter 168 - Leaving By Suicide

Chapter 168, Leaving By Suicide

It was just too hard a truth to swallow.

Hell Valley’s 5th elder still sported a confident smile in his power,
just as Huangpu Qingyun before him. But witnessing the latter’s
miserable ending cut all his bravado short as he reeled back again and
again.

[No, that is no human. Not even a Bursting Pill is enough to defeat him.
I need to escape, now!]

“Second young master!”

Suddenly, four cries echoed and four figures were next to Huangpu
Qingyun and lamenting his fate. Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow at the four.
They were Huangpu Qingyun’s porters, in the 1st layer of the Profound
Heaven Stage.

However, Zhuo Fan’s soul was now in the Radiant Stage and this time,
looked at the four with a frown and suspicious eyes.

These guys were indeed of Profound Heaven cultivation but were weak as
hell, even when compared with peak Bone Tempering experts. [No wonder
Huangpu Qingyun told them to stand aside. But why are they here anyway?]

At one point in his thinking, Zhuo Fan’s vision swirled and his body was
on the verge of collapse.

[Damnation, I’m running out of time.]

Gnashing his teeth, Zhuo Fan braced himself to keep up appearances and
then flee from this place. Staying here longer than necessary would only
make it worse for him, as he wouldn’t be able to hold on for long and
fall unconscious. At that point, his head was up for grabs.

But he didn’t get the chance as the four porters roared and jumped him,
“You savage mongrel! You dare kill Regent Estate’s second young master,
we will kill you!”

“Just the four of you? Please!”

Zhuo Fan snorted, but as the four approached, his mind whirled and his
power plummeted. Bursting Pill’s effect was declining faster and faster.

Bitting his tongue to clear his head, Zhuo Fan’s wing lashed out and the
three porters were cut in two while the latter was wailing on the ground
having his arm chopped off.

Ignoring the ‘lucky’ fellow, Zhuo Fan flew away as fast as he could.

Vicious Pill King paused for a moment before yelling, “5th elder, stop
him now! His fight with second young master used up his Yuan Qi and
can’t hold on for long. We have to keep him here at all costs.”

When 5th elder was ready to slink into obscurity, he whipped his head
around and saw the three dead and one rolling on the ground. His eyes
lit up then laughed out loud.

Demon Zhuo Fan’s attacks were ruthless and precise. [How could he just
harm and not kill? His body can’t take it and didn’t have the time to
finish the last one.]

5th elder then shot straight for Zhuo Fan and swung his mighty hammer.

With his vision fading away, Zhuo Fan swayed in his flight. He watched
the incoming hammer dazed.

Chu Qingcheng was beside herself with worry, but there was not enough
time to help.

5th elder cackled, his eyes lit up with savagery, “Ha-ha-ha, demon Zhuo
Fan, time to pay for what you did to 7th elder and second young master
with your life.”

“You’re not nearly worthy enough to take my life!”

His body’s power was sapped, but his eyes never lost their ruthlessness.
Bitting his tongue again to sober somewhat, Zhuo Fan roared and lashed
with his wings like a pair of lightning whips.

Bam!

5th elder’s hands went numb from pain, with the half a ton hammer
slipping from his grip, flung away by Zhuo Fan.

Yet, 5th elder couldn’t be happier, “Ha-ha-ha, wise ass. It is you who
fell for it this time. You can’t possibly fend me off when you have no
wings to protect you and your body is too weak to resist!”

5th elder’s hand was wrought in a fierce flame and clawed at Zhuo Fan’s
chest, “High spirit ranked martial art, Back Piercing Fire Claw!”

With the Lightning Wings used to fend off the hammer, they were too far
off to recall them in time. Zhuo Fan’s chest was wide open.

With 5th elder being a body cultivator in the 5th layer of Profound
Heaven Stage and using a high spirit ranked martial art, the strike
would go straight through him.

Not even Zhuo Fan could keep his life then.

5th elder smirked while Chu Qingcheng was watching below wracked with
anxiety and powerless to help.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed coldly and said, “I already told you. You’re not
worthy enough to take my life!”

Zhuo Fan roared, “Wraith Style’s second move, Ghostly Dragon Claw!”

With another heaven shaking dragonic roar, the two claws clashed.

Something incredible happened. In that instant, Zhuo Fan ripped 5th
elder’s entire arm clean off.

Blood spurted but 5th elder took a long time for the feeling to sink in.
He turned to his arm and then fell from the sky wailing.

Only Zhuo Fan, the invincible, stood in the sky like a king. The burning
arm he was clutching, was now soaked in blood.

“Humph, no one is worthy of taking yours truly’s life!”

Snorting, Zhuo Fan once again displayed his power for all to see. He
clenched his hand and 5th elder’s hand was ripped to pieces.

[He’s just too strong!]

They couldn’t be further from the truth. Zhuo Fan’s power kept dropping
but even so, he ripped the arm off 5th elder despite the latter having
been at his peak of power, and having taken the Bursting Pill.

Such power struck the core of everyone.

Vicious Pill King had long been reduced to standing there dumbly. Zhuo
Fan’s early power was based on the five Bursting Pills.

But now that the pills’ effect was waning, how was he still invincible?

Even Long Jiu’s eye bulged out.

Who was Hell Valley’s 5th elder? An expert that clashed with Veiled
Dragon Pavilion’s 3rd elder thousands of times to a draw. The shock was
palpable, seeing his hand ripped off like it was a child’s play.

“Just how am I going to explain this to third brother? This little freak
has far surpassed him. How shocked will he be when he finds out?”

Long Jiu shook his head, turning to Long Kui and Long Jie, “Maybe,
you’ll be the one to break the news to him.”

The two had long stopped listening. They never had truly witnessed Zhuo
Fan fight for real, and were now watching dumbstruck at what their peer
was capable of.

Panting, Zhuo Fan had used too much of his energy. He snapped a cold
glare at the dazed Vicious Pill King and flew off.

Biting his lip, Vicious Pill King’s eyes roamed everywhere and after
some hesitation, he roared, “Zhuo Fan, don’t forget! I’m still around!”

The hundred Rumbling Blood Bats flew at Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan’s flight faltered and glared back, “Old fool, don’t be
obstinate. I let you go in respect from one grandmaster alchemist to
another. Don’t you come and throw your life away!”

“Humph, as I was entrusted, I shall reply with the same devotion! Second
young master is dead and only your head will keep me alive! Bluntly
speaking, either you die, or I die!”

Vicious Pill King roared as his hand made signs. The hundred Rumbling
opened their snouts and unleashed Rumbling Bat Waves on Zhuo Fan.

A huge ripple struck Zhuo Fan just like a tidal wave.

Chu Qingcheng was overwhelmed with alarm. This was a soul attack. Zhuo
Fan’s tough body was useless against it and could only resist with the
azure flame.

And when that happened, he’d be too exhausted to leave.

But Zhuo Fan wasn’t fretting.

He flicked his eyes to Vicious Pill King and made a hand sign, “Since
that is your wish, I shall oblige. Wraith Style’s third move, Necro
Dragon’s Screech!”

Zhuo Fan snapped his jaws open and roared!

This dragon roar was unlike the Rumbling Blood Bat’s wave, it came out
of Zhuo Fan’s mouth and appeared as a dragon. It flew in the air and
shook the whole world.

“T-that’s a sound martial art, and a goddamned Profound Rank at that!”
Xie Tianyang had never been so overwhelmed with shock in his entire
life. He said to Long Jiu, “Didn’t he say he comes from a third rate
clan? Just where the hell did he really come from when such an art
doesn’t even exist in the entire Tianyu Empire, or the seven houses?”

Long Jiu shook his head bitterly, “How am I supposed to know? That is
one secret only the brat knows. But there’s one absolute truth, he did
not come from that third rate clan.”

Xie Tianyang nodded slowly.

Then, the two sound waves collided.

The tidal wave and the dragon fought each other and the aftermath spread
well into the crowd below.

The previous shockwaves were from Yuan Qi, so the people could resist
it. But this time, it was a soul attack.They would hit the ground, dead
if their souls lacked in the least.

Chu Qingcheng used her soul to resist and Peony Overseer covered Xiao
Dandan behind her. But even they, Profound Heaven experts were forced to
spew blood.

With pain came shock, unable to believe that a sound martial art was
unblockable. They weren’t even the real targets of the attack and were
already suffering. It was unimaginable how astonishing its power was on
the real target.

The people began looking at Zhuo Fan with dread. Vicious Pill King was
relying on the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats while Zhuo Fan could do it
himself.

His hand made another sign as Vicious Pill King did his best to
withstand the shockwave, with dark blood leaking from his mouth. Never
had he dreamt it possible for Zhuo Fan to use a sound martial art. He
was an abomination!

He was able to hold Zhuo Fan back before, but now…

Squinting, Zhuo Fan saw through the old coot’s inability and roared
again.

The huge dragon above whipped its tail and the tidal sound wave was
dissolved. It then flew through the hundred Rumbling Blood Bats, who’s
eyes went blank as they fell on the ground like hail.

Such was irony, cruel and merciless. The powerful blood bats, prideful
in their sound waves were shot dead by Zhuo Fan’s own sound attack.

But the huge dragon didn’t stop there, passing through Vicious Pill King
as well. His mind went blank, with not even a simple thought coming to
him.

Then, his body plopped two the ground, stiffly. Yan Fu wailed, “Master!”

Zhuo Fan grinned and flew away. When his figure was gone, a mad laughter
resounded, “The great seven houses beneath the imperial family are not
able to kill one man even with seven against one. Their name is
undeserved, bringing shame to the entire world, ha-ha-ha…”

Chapter 169 - Calamitous Casualties

Chapter 169, Calamitous Casualties

Zhuo Fan was long gone yet the people still stared dumbly in his
direction.

And when they managed to gather their wits, all they heard were mournful
cries all around. The ground was littered with corpses and thousands of
wounded, the aftermath of Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingyun’s fierce clash.

The last sound wave, in particular, must’ve caused over a thousand to
fall!

Hell Valley’s 5th elder weakly got to his feet, watching dazed, his
missing arm bellowed to the sky, “Zhuo Fan!”

These two simple words were mixed with hatred and rage that any other
survivor had after this bitter battle.

Yep, after this ’bout’ Zhuo Fan’s name would be heard clearer and
further than ever, but never in a good light. He was one of the very few
notorious figures known in Tianyu since its foundation.

Demons paled to what he had become now.

Towards the bodies strung about, to the endless suffering ramming their
ears, people had only horror in their core. But at the same time, two
words were deeply etched in their minds.

[Demon Archon!]

Chu Qingcheng’s group finally came to as well, only to look on with pity
at the miserable state surrounding them and sent people to count in the
dead. Xiao Ya was soon back with a tally, and a visage painted in
sorrow.

“Edifice Lord, in the aftermath of the battle, 4862 are dead and 36019
people are wounded. This count is mainly the heavily wounded, while the
light wounded are too many to count.”

“So many!”

Iris Overseer cried and said inside, [Is Zhuo Fan the harbinger of
death? He killed so many in just one strike!]

Long Jiu’s group was startled as well.

They were aware of how insanely powerful the brat was, but not once they
thought him capable of this. It was no different than the aftermath of a
skirmish.

“And…” Xiao Ya faltered, but still said it, “Because of Hundred Pill
Meeting, many delegates of important clans have come. The number of
casualties is disastrous, with more than two thousand clans having lost
their people, and ten thousand more in critical condition.”

Chu Qingcheng’s heart tightened and was agitated, “Xiao Ya, try to calm
them down. Tell them Drifting Flowers Edifice will give them an answer
for this disaster. That we will also offer some compensation for their
losses!”

“Yes!” Xiao Ya left with a nod.

Xie Tianyang took a deep breath, “Damn, killing more than four thousand
at once. This brat is racking up enemies to an all-time high.”

“Humph, how is it darling’s fault? With how many died in the aftermath,
they should be taking up with Regent Estate for the damages!” Not once
did Xiao Dandan see Zhuo in a bad light and wasn’t one to tolerate
anyone who spoke ill of him as well.

Xie Tianyang had to admit Xiao Dandan’s words with a nod, but then he
jeered, “Oh, miss Dandan speaks true. Although… Who has the nerve to
complain to the Seven Noble Houses? Not to mention, Regent Estate is
also a victim, with four dead and a cripple.”

“Humph, since they don’t dare to take it up with Regent Estate, they
think darling is one to be pushed around?” Xiao Dandan stuck out her
chin in pride.

“Yeah, with that freak’s power, even a Profound Heaven expert would give
him a wide berth. However…” Raising an eyebrow, Xie Tianyang chuckled,
“Didn’t you listen to Vicious Pill King? The kid’s time is almost up,
and he’ll be unable to move then. Even a three-year-old could do him
in.”

That startled them.

If not for his reminder, they’d have forgotten Zhuo Fan might be lying
somewhere, weak and alone.

“Everyone, scour the place for demon Zhuo Fan. I want him alive! He will
have Regent Estate to answer to!” Chu Qingcheng ordered. The only way to
pull the wool over the other’s eyes was to treat him like an enemy.

Xiao Dandan bore her stare into Xie Tianyang with hatred, “Why didn’t
you say so earlier?”

“Would it have mattered? Those with half a brain are already searching
for him!” Xie Tianyang pointed around them with a smile, “Tell me, who
is missing here?”

Long Jiu’s group was puzzled. Only Xiao Dandan clapped, “It’s the Dong
siblings.”

Then, she took off in Zhuo Fan’s direction.

“Silly girl, why so anxious?” Peony Overseer shouted.

“How can I not be? That Dong lass has a thing for darling. I can’t let
her get ahead of me!”

The other had to laugh at that. Xiao Dandan was one innocent and chipper
young lady!

Peony Overseer’s face flushed. [You nitwit disciple, you’re enough of a
disappointment as it is. I get that you’re all googly-eyed over him but
can you at least not make a fool out of me too?]

On another note, Zhuo Fan was rushing to fly away while also keeping an
eye out for a nice corner of the world to hide and lick his wounds. All
while his sight was growing ever hazy.

Suddenly, his vision went dark and passed out. His body then
crash-landed into a small valley.

With a bang, he touched the ground and got buried in a pile of rocks.

Moon took the sun’s place in the sky, then soon, the sun rose back to
its rightful place…

For three days, Zhuo Fan laid there among the rocks, defenseless. This
was a blessing in disguise, as the wild animals would’ve dispensed with
his body by now if he was out in the open.

Rustle~

On the dawn of the fourth day, morning dew trickled from the rocks and
on Zhuo Fan’s face, rousing him from slumber.

Zhuo Fan opened his eyes and felt his whole body aching so much he
couldn’t even budge.

His original plan was to take the root and flee. He’d then divide and
conquer his pursuers, Huangpu Qingyun’s group of four, as they got
further apart from each other going after him.

Bursting Pill was saved as his last resort.

He had been trying to get away many times, but was foiled at every turn
and even got surrounded. With no choice in the matter, he ended fighting
the four of them together instead of making a break for it.

But the toll for this was hardly worth it. Sensing his body, he was sure
he was stuck here, disabled, for a month before he could even lift a
finger.

During this period, he’d be as helpless as a lamb, at the mercy of any
strong guy that chanced upon him.

Putting his life in fate’s hands wasn’t the Demonic Emperor’s style. But
no amount of lamenting would get him out of it. He was a piece of meat
ready to have its life pounded out of him!

Suddenly, slow steps were heard coming and Zhuo Fan tensed. But he was
too hurt to even sweep the area with his soul to check. He was in the
dark about the person’s cultivation and panic was slowly setting in.

Suppose it was the enemy’s Profound Heaven expert. That would curb his
short life even shorter.

Crack~

Sounds of stones clashing resounded and Zhuo Fan knew the newcomer was
digging through the pile.

Boom!

Then, the final layer was removed and a piercing sun ray graced his face
and making him unable to see his ‘rescuer’.

Then he heard a familiar voice, “Brother, I found him!”

“Dong Xiaowan?” Frowning, Zhuo Fan sighed. [If it’s the Dong guys, I’m
saved, he-he.]

“Step aside Xiaowan, I’ll get him out!”

Rocks crumbled to pieces as a powerful hand reached into the pile and
pulled the buried Zhuo Fan out into the light of day.

With a boom, his dirty body was wrested out of the darkness by Dong
Tianba and smacked the ground hard. Zhuo Fan felt something was oddly
off here.

Before Zhuo Fan even saw their faces, what greeted him was the cold
glinting steel of a 3rd-grade spiritual sword resting on his neck.

Zhuo Fan’s heart was floored, [What did I ever do to you?]

Dong Xiaowan cried, “Brother, what are you doing?”

“Stay out of this!”

Dong Tianba stared Zhuo Fan down, the sword shaking in his hand, “Demon
Zhuo Fan, I’ve been waiting to meet you for a long long time. You’re
just as they say, so cunning you made complete fools out of us!”

Zhuo Fan smiled, “Here I am, demon Zhuo Fan! I never planned to fool
you, but you never left me alone!”

“You dare talk back?” Dong Tianba’s anger spiked, “I’m asking you,
where’s my dear brother Song Yu? Why did you take his face in coming to
Drifting Flowers City?”

Zhuo Fan finally got to know what this was all about and grinned
wickedly, “I’m sure you realized the truth by now.”

“You killed him?” Dong Tianba’s hand trembled and his eyes reddened.

“Of course!”

“Why?”

Grinning, Zhuo Fan’s eyes were cold, and his tone flat, “I am a demon.
Since when did I need a reason to kill someone?”

Zhuo Fan’s remorseless eyes in killing Song Yu got Dong Tianba trembling
from anger. Roaring, his sword advanced.

“No, brother!” Dong Xiaowan threw herself before Zhuo Fan and said
nervously, “Brother, he helped us. We would’ve died if it weren’t for
him, and so would our clan. You’re not only picking on the weak, but
you’re also biting the hands that feeds you!”

Dong Tianba’s sword stopped. His hands trembled, a reflection of his
chaotic heart.

“Who dares harm my darling?” A sudden shout echoed.

A flash of red pushed Dong Xiaowan back and stood before Zhuo Fan – Xiao
Dandan of course.

“Dong Tianba, you got some nerve. You dare mess with my man?”

Chapter 170 - A Three Layers Jump

Chapter 170, A Three Layers Jump

Xiao Dandan scared Dong Tianba, jumping two steps back, causing his
sword to tremble like a leaf. He wasn’t afraid of her, but the Drifting
Flowers Edifice behind her.

“Move!” Zhuo Fan’s cold tone came.

Xiao Dandan jerked and turned her head in doubt, only to meet a pair of
frosty eyes, “Darling, this ungrateful punk wants to hurt you.”

“Are you deaf?” Zhuo Fan’s roar got Xiao Dandan shaking in her boots and
demurely moved aside.

Zhuo Fan was immobile but that didn’t curb his dominating attitude in
the least.

He spoke to Dong Tianba calmly, “I won’t lie to you. I not only killed
your good little brother, Song Yu, but his sister as well. If you plan
on taking revenge, no one’s stopping you!”

Dong Tianba was hesitating and flitted a glance at Xiao Dandan. She had
her glaring eyes riveted to him, as if to say, [Just try it!]

Zhuo Fan understood his reluctance, “This is between us, men. Women have
no place here. Listen here Xiao Dandan, if you mess with the Dong clan
because of this, then don’t ever call me darling again.”

Xiao Dandan flared, “Then you’ll accept me?”

Zhuo Fan just stared at Dong Tianba with unnerving calm.

The sword lifted at times and fell in others. Dong Tianba saw Zhuo Fan’s
eyes shift from hatred to gratitude. Recalling the time when they were
drinking like best buds, Dong Tianba threw the sword a way away with a
sigh.

“Forget it. I’ll just take it as brother’s Song Yu’s luck was the worst
to meet a Demon Archon like you.”

“Why aren’t you attacking? Is it because of Xiao Dandan? Kill her then
kill me. You two need to just keep a tight lid on this and no even
Drifting Flowers Edifice will find out about this. If you’re still
worried, I can teach you how to make a scapegoat out of another clan.
One hundred percent success guaranteed.” Zhuo Fan smiled wickedly.

His words got all three of them jumping.

Did the world have someone so kind to teach his killer not to get found
out? Xiao Dandan was morose and muttered, “Darling, I’m trying to help
you. So why do you want me killed as well?”

Turning a blind eye to this love-struck puppy, Zhuo Fan stared at Dong
Tianba with a vague smile.

Dong Tianba was vexed, “Wan’er is right. You saved us before and killing
you will bite the hands that feed us. It’s best if today ends with both
our debts being settled.”

“You’re saying… you’re letting me go for saving you?” Zhuo Fan smiled.

Nodding, Dong Tianba sighed, “What a pity, I just can’t take revenge for
my dear brother Song Yu…”

Whoosh!

Dong Tianba was cut short by a golden streak passing his ear. With a
boom, a fifty-meter tall rock was pulverized.

The golden light returned to Zhuo Fan and grinned wickedly.

The three found it to be a golden infant. It was indeed Zhuo Fan’s Bone
Tempering Stage Blood Infant!

With a sneer, Zhuo Fan’s tone was cold, “Dong Tianba, you are far from
worthy to decide my fate. My life is my own no matter the circumstances.
Suppose your sword got a bit too close, well, you wouldn’t be standing
right now.”

Breaking out in a cold sweat, Dong Tianba looked at the grinning Blood
Infant, then at the sinister smile on Zhuo Fan. The two caused his heart
to beat a mile a minute.

Demon Zhuo Fan was the one who killed You Guiqi, not someone a nobody
like him could handle.

Zhuo Fan needed but a blow and this second rate young master would be
naught but dust. It made a mockery of his earlier display of settling
their score even.

[I never had the right to choose the fate of someone who challenged the
Seven Noble Houses!]

Xiao Dandan’s eyes were more intoxicated than ever.

Her darling was so hurt he couldn’t move but the flair around him, the
boldness, made him a man among men, the best of the best, were still
there!

Dong Xiaowan wasn’t that far gone as Xiao Dandan, but among the fear and
trepidation her eyes conveyed, they nonetheless held a constant ripple
and firm gaze on him.

Not bored enough to mind the eyes of his fans, Zhuo Fan closed his eyes,
“Take me somewhere safe. I need a fortnight at the least to recover.”

“Ok, darling, I’ll carry you.” Xiao Dandan jumped at the chance, holding
no reservations.

Zhuo Fan’s silence was all the approval she needed.

Suddenly, Zhuo Fan’s ears peeled and he opened his eyes, “Wait.
Someone’s coming.”

The others looked around for any signs while Zhuo Fan got Blood Infant
back in his body.

Blood Infant was good with scaring Bone Tempering cultivators, but he
might not succeed in a sneak attack against a Profound Heaven expert.
Least of all going from the front.

Only when he paired up with Blood Infant in battles, was he invincible.

But now, he was a dead weight and Blood Infant’s success rate fell
sharply. He hid Blood Infant in his body, waiting for the right moment
to strike a killing blow.

The bushes ruffled under the anxious gaze of everyone. Then, an old man
came out.

Zhuo Fan knew who it was, Liu Yizhen.

Liu Yizhen couldn’t be happier he found Zhuo Fan, “Song, uh, Grandmaster
Zhuo, I finally found you. I’m so glad you’re alright.”

Zhuo Fan looked at the others clueless.

[Was I ever so close with this oldie? What got you so concerned about my
health?]

Zhuo Fan was baffled, seeing Liu Yizhen jumping to examine Zhuo Fan’s
state. Zhuo Fan and the rest found no ill will hidden among his actions
and let him through.

Liu Yizhen was frowning a moment later, gushing with worry, “Grandmaster
Zhuo’s meridians are damaged. You’ll need three to five months to
recover. Luckily I have the 6th-grade pill, Yang Recovery Pill. It may
not be enough to bring about a total recovery but enough to allow
Grandmaster Zhuo to at least move.”

“Yang Recovery Pill?”

Zhuo Fan was overjoyed. He knew of this pill since he was an alchemist.
With it and the Bodhi Jade Sap, he’d be up and about in no time flat.

Before the Hundred Pill Meeting, he had no 6th-grade ingredients and
couldn’t refine a Yang Recovery Pill, or he’d have done it ages ago. Liu
Yizhen’s arrival was such timely help.

Liu Yizhen saw him in glee and was even overjoyed. His hand flashed with
a bottle and presented a scarlet pill.

Xiao Dandan hovered it near Zhuo Fan for a close inspection then let him
have it when it was deemed safe.

In an instant, Zhuo Fan began glowing a blinding light from his main
acupoints as the warmth traveled through his meridians. It was so strong
that even the others around him could feel it.

It started with a twitch of his finger as Zhuo Fan slowly got the
feeling in his arm, testing its range of movements.

Liu Yizhen shouted in glee, “In less than an hour, Grandmaster Zhuo will
be able to walk.”

Zhuo Fan wasn’t one to wait as he used his only able arm to swallow a
drop of Bodhi Jade Sap.

Liu Yizhen slapped his head, “How could I forget? Grandmaster Zhuo still
has that divine treasure. You won’t even need an hour now and you’ll
make a full recovery.”

This shocked the rest.

Zhuo Fan sat cross-legged and focused on recovery.

The medicine flowed throughout his body and Zhuo Fan could feel how his
meridians recover. It went so well that they not only recovered, but
became stronger.

Bang!

With a sudden popping sound, Zhuo Fan’s ears twitched as a newfound
power roamed unhinged through him.

Dong Tianba cried, “He broke through!”

His words were followed by another pop and Zhuo Fan’s power doubled as
he even started to glow in waves. It was as if Diamond Sand was roaming
through his body.

“H-he broke through again!”

Liu Yizhen blinked his aged eyes and yelped, “This is incredible!
Breaking through twice in one breath! How many in this world would ever
have such luck?”

Then it happened again right in the middle of his speech!

“What?!”

Liu Yizhen’s voice trembled, “Doing it three times in a row is unheard
of! Grandmaster Zhuo’s title of ‘freak’ is justly deserved. Even I had
to cultivate day after day, year after year, to advance, but never once
have I done it so fast.”

Everyone around him, who heard his speech, rolled their eyes.

[How can you even compare yourself? He is a freak, a genius among
geniuses. How can an old coot, who’s not even a genius to begin with,
even dream of climbing to his level?]

Liu Yizhen realized his blunder and straightened his beard awkwardly.

An hour later, Zhuo Fan’s power withdrew within him and opened his eyes
with a flash of azure.

Every minute movement within a kilometer around him in the valley
appeared in his mind, down to the last cricket.

This was Radiant Stage’s Discerning Field!

When Zhuo Fan just entered the Radiant Stage with his soul, he exhausted
his Yuan Qi from using that dangerous pill, thus preventing him from
carefully sensing the changes the new stage brought. Now, he broke three
layers and entered the 5th layer of the Bone Tempering Stage in one
smooth motion.

His growth wasn’t limited to that of the body, but of the soul as well,
while also stabilizing it.

Just like Fang Qiubai, who had eyes everywhere within a kilometer of
him, Zhuo Fan could as well. All that was left was to practice killing
with his mere intent.

That was a Radiant Stage expert’s most dreadful ability…

Chapter 171 - Antidote

Chapter 171, Antidote

“Congratulations, Grandmaster Zhuo, for your recovery and improvement!”
Liu Yizhen gave a gesture of respect along with a smile.

Zhuo Fan shot him a glance, “Skip the small-talk and say what you want.”

Liu Yizhen’s face froze for a second, then bloomed into a broad smile,
“Grandmaster Zhuo is a man of true talent. I will no longer hide it from
you.”

“Humph, that’s all thanks to knowing there is no one in this world
helping a stranger without getting something in return! There’s no free
lunch in this world. You must be after something big to give away a
6th-grade pill.”

Zhuo Fan’s piercing gaze saw right through him. Liu Yizhen muttered
something under his breath then threw himself at Zhuo Fan’s feet,
kowtowing three times, “Disciple Liu Yizhen admires Grandmaster Zhuo’s
endless talent. I beseech Grandmaster to accept me!”

Dumbstruck, not even in Zhuo Fan’s wildest dreams did he consider the
old guy’s request being this. Scowling for a second, he said, “Give me
an empty jade slip!”

Liu Yizhen’s eyes sparkled and handed it over with glee, “Yes, master!”

Not even he expected his request to go through so smoothly.

However, Zhuo Fan closed his eyes for a brief moment then gave the jade
slip back, “Grandmaster Liu, this jade slip contains three alchemy
secret skills, my debt to you. We are now even. Don’t mention
apprenticeship again. I do not take disciples!”

[Why the hell would I take another when the first and last one almost
got me killed? Humph, teaching a disciple starves the master. This
saying couldn’t be more right. I will abide by it all my life!]

Zhuo Fan sighed, recalling that traitorous disciple of his.

Liu Yizhen wanted to plead his case, but Zhuo Fan cut him off with a
wave.

Zhuo Fan then turned to Xiao Dandan, throwing her a pitch-black ring.
Xiao Dandan was startled. Wasn’t it the same storage ring Chu Qingcheng
gave her?

“Take this back to Edifice Lord Chu. Tell her that I have paid the favor
for the medicine. She and I are now even!”

“W-what about me?” Xiao Dandan was panicking, her heart in turmoil.

Zhuo Fan perked an eyebrow and watched her funny, “It has nothing to do
with me. Do whatever.”

He took a single step and shot high into the sky, disappearing in a
flash. Liu Yizhen watched the jade slip downcast then sighed as he put
it in his ring.

Xiao Dandan looked at the sky and cried, “Waaah, darling doesn’t want
me~!”

Dong Xiaowan saw the heartbroken Xiao Dandan and lowered her head in
desolation. At least Zhuo Fan explained himself to Xiao Dandan, while
not sparing her so much as a glance.

[Am I of no value in his heart?]

Dong Tianba saw through his sister’s distress and patted her shoulder,
“Wan’er, that guy is bound to cause great chaos. There’s nothing in
common between him and us.”

Dong Xiaowan nodded, her heart clear. How could a girl from a second
rate clan deserve a hero who fought back the seven houses?

But that didn’t mean she could accept it. She looked up at the wailing
Xiao Dandan and felt envious.

He did spare this lady a glance at the least…

…

In the hazy night, among the broken-down houses of the slum, Chu
Qingcheng’s lovely figure struck a touching image standing there in the
moonlight.

She had behind her Iris Overseer and Long Jiu’s group while Drifting
Flowers Edifice’s disciples scoured the place for any sign of Zhuo Fan.

“Edifice Lord Chu, it’s been four days already. Are you sure he’d return
here?” Xie Tianyang shook off a yawn.

Chu Qingcheng was still as she watched Zhuo Fan’s fleeing direction, but
her eyes flickered with resolve, “This is where we lived together. I
know he will come here once he is safe.”

“Sigh, that only means you don’t know him. That brat is a ruthless and
stone-cold killer. When he was docile to you in that idyllic period, it
was just him playing his role as Song Yu. That wasn’t the real him!” Xie
Tianyang sighed.

Chu Qingcheng smiled, but her mind was set, “I believe in the feelings
from that time. He will not abandon me!”

[We can only hope.]

Xie Tianyang sighed, not believing in the slightest…

Tap, tap!

Suddenly, a horse’s trotting was heard and everyone looked to see a
worn-out carriage drawing near. Chu Qingcheng’s eyes shined, her heart
in bliss.

She recognized this carriage, it was Song-, uh, Zhuo Fan’s.

“He’s back!” Chu Qingcheng cried, rushing over with the others in tow.

But the people to come out were just Dong Tianba, Dong Xiaowan, and the
crying Xiao Dandan.

Chu Qingcheng realized they were the only one insie and asked, “You came
back without finding him?”

Dong Xiaowan and Xiao Dandan were downhearted and in no mood to speak.
Dong Tianba bowed, “Edifice Lord Chu, we did find him, but… he left once
he recovered. We didn’t follow…”

“What, he left?” Chu Qingcheng exclaimed in shock before he could
finish. This man left without so much as giving her an explanation? Why?

“Waaah, sister Qingcheng, darling doesn’t want us!

Xiao Dandan could no longer hold in the pain and let it out in the form
of rivers of tears. Chu Qingcheng was stunned as Peony Overseer drew her
dear disciple into a hug, “Dandan, tell me, did he do anything to you?”

Sniffing twice, Xiao Dandan gave the black ring to Chu Qingcheng and
said between tears, “Sister Qingcheng, he said he repaid the favor for
the medicine. From now on there is no relation between us.”

“What, does he have no conscience? Is he that heartless?” Peony Overseer
went into a rage, “I told you, men aren’t good for anything.”

Chu Qingcheng was lost as she took the items from the ring.

It was the spirit tablet Chu Qingcheng gave to Zhuo Fan before going to
her death. Now, Zhuo Fan returned it.

As if he didn’t recognize her as his wife.

There was also a box and Chu Qingcheng looked within with a dead gaze.

Aunt Tao snatched it and sighed, “At least he has the conscience to
leave this behind.”

Bu Chu Qingcheng couldn’t make herself care about anything, not even the
return of the Bodhi Root. All she ever felt was loss.

Except for returning the bottle of Bodhi Jade Sap, everything else was
back.

His meaning loud and clear. From now on they were strangers!

“You mean… he was using me the whole time?” Chu Qingcheng swayed as she
whispered. Yet the look on her face spoke volumes of her denial.

[I finally found a man that I love, only to be deceived in the end?]

Xie Tianyang had long seen it coming and coughed, “Edifice Lord Chu, let
me just say something, but don’t get angry. The brat told us he came to
Drifting Flowers City for the Bodhi Jade Sap. But because of the sudden
involvement of the Regent Estate, he helped you in passing. And that
only after judging that the benefits outweighed the risks. His actions
aren’t driven by kindness or compassion, so please don’t feel sad!”

Shivering, Chu Qingcheng frowned, still no willing to believe what’s in
front of her.

Iris Overseer couldn’t take it anymore and patted Chu Qingcheng’s
shoulder. She knew Chu Qingcheng was kind on the outside, but quite
proud inside. No man ever managed to get her attention.

But this time, she finally found a man after her own heart, only to be
cast away without a shred of remorse. The bitter pain was a far deeper
wound than that of flesh.

Peony Overseer had to say something as well, “How dare this punk break
our Edifice Lord’s heart? The next time I see him, I will peel his
skin!”

“Can you?” Snorting, Xie Tianyang mocked from the side.

Startled, Peony Overseer wet her dry lips as she recalled Zhuo Fan’s
freaky power and a cold shiver crawled down her spine, “I take it back.
I’ll just curse him in my head.”

The others didn’t know how to react.

“Eh, what’s this?” Tao Danniang took out a vial from the ring,
“Qingcheng, did you give him this as well?”

Shaking her head, Chu Qingcheng’s eyes were hazy, “I didn’t give him
these pills.”

Squinting, Tao Danniang’s eyes shined, “It must be his gift!”

She opened it and a thick medicinal aroma wafted about, along with the
faint roars of dragons.

“A-aren’t these the perfect 8th-grade pills refined in the Pill King
finals? Why did he give them up?” Tao Danniang started counting, “One,
two… sixteen, seventeen!”

Weren’t they eighteen?

Tao Danniang’s eyes wandered in thought when suddenly threw a pill to
Iris Overseer as she yelled, “Eat it!’

Caught off guard, Qin Caiqing was puzzled but did what she said.

Suddenly, an azure glow came from within her. Qin Caiqing then sat to
absorb the pill with eyes closed. Fifteen minutes later, a muffled boom
was heard and Qin Caiqing’s power shot up.

Under the shock of everyone there, Iris Overseer broke through.

Only after a full thirty minutes did Qin Caiqing opened her clear eyes
in joy, “Aunt Tao, not only I advanced but the Rainbow Cloud Palm left
behind by Vicious Pill King is gone!”

What?!

They all turned with hope at the vial.

The poison of Pill King Hall was infamous throughout the land, yet this
group here seemed to hold the only cure. What was even more astonishing
was that they as many as 17 antidotes to the Rainbow Cloud Palm’s
poison.

Such news would unleash a bitter fight over them among clans, with even
Pill King Hall participating.

The difference was, while the clans would come to get them, the Pill
King Hall would do its all to destroy them…

Chapter 172 - Forceful Invitation

Chapter 172, Forceful Invitation

“He is indeed an unheard of genius. I toiled for years over the pill
recipe, but this kid up and understood it. I am completely in awe…”

Tao Danniang laughed, sighed, then sank into depression. Zhuo Fan’s
godly alchemy skill left her feeling inferior in her meager
achievements.

It was a far greater blow than Vicious Pill King could ever give her.

After all, Vicious Pill King was the best in Tianyu and yet, she could
still follow his tracks. While Zhuo Fan, he had risen to unseen heights;
to the point she couldn’t even catch a shadow.

Chu Qingcheng and the rest were over the moon, “Is that true?”

“Of course. With the 17 pills the kid gave us, it is enough to get
Drifting Flowers Edifice out of this crisis!” Tao Danniang laughed.

Chu Qingcheng blinked, still finding it hard to believe this was real,
“Aunt Tao, you mean to say he unraveled the mystery of that antidote?
That pill recipe is real?”

“Yes, it is undoubtedly real. Vicious Pill King may have denied it, but
to make the antidote to Rainbow Cloud Palm, one had to at least have a
recipe. Or you wouldn’t know where to even begin.”

Tao Danniang sighed again, “But that kid is amazing, not only
understanding the pill recipe but also following it in refining. The
pill recipe was just a 7th grade, yet he made perfect 8th-grade pills.
With this, even Grandmother’s recovery is assured.”

“What, Grandmother?” Long Jiu’s group cried, “She’s still alive?”

With a vague smile, Tao Danniang shook her head, “Just a breath away
from death. But she will soon be back!”

Everyone felt uplifted by the news.

Zhuo Fan’s act was of huge consequence. Drifting Flowers Edifice’s
Grandmother was the Lady of Steel. Furthermore, he not only wrested
Drifting Flowers Edifice out of Pill King Hall’s control, he even saved
Grandmother.

From now on, Drifting Flowers Edifice’s only way was up. Regent Estate
would not find it so easy to handle this house as before!

“He is the savior of Drifting Flowers Edifice!” Long Jiu sighed, his
admiration for Zhuo Fan going up a notch. [To think this was his plan
all along.]

How else could Drifting Flowers Edifice resist their wretched ally,
Regent Estate? Drifting Flowers Edifice will soon return to being a
national power.

If Long Jiu understood this, then so did Chu Qingcheng and the others.

Sharing a look, Chu Qingcheng and the others had a newfound respect for
Zhuo Fan. Even Peony Overseer, who endlessly cursed at Zhuo Fan, felt a
little ashamed.

Regardless of what was said, regardless of how focused Zhuo Fan was on
his own directive, one thing was certain. He was the herald of Drifting
Flowers Edifice’s new dawn.

This alone made him Drifting Flowers Edifice’s greatest contributor!

“It’s no longer him owing me, but me being indebted to him. Our bond
still remains!” Chu Qingcheng smiled with a crafty look.

They were eager to get back to Drifting Flowers Edifice, remove the
poison from their sisters, and boost the morale of their troops.

Out of everyone’s notice, when the moon fell from its peak, a winged
figure watched them from a treetop. He sighed and vanished into the
night…

In another place, on the wide street, Yan Fu was shedding bitter tears
going westward on a carriage. He was returning to Pill King Hall with
the body of his master, Vicious Pill King.

No one would have ever believed this trip to Drifting Flowers City would
rob the grand Vicious Pill King of his life.

Wiping his nose, Yan Fu recalled his master’s smile, his care for his
disciple, and his grief only grew. His cloudy eyes once again began
shedding tears of sorrow.

“No, I cannot cry. I will have vindication!” Wiping his tears, Yan Fu’s
eyes steeled, “Zhuo Fan, one day I will kill you and lay master’s soul
to rest!”

Hu~

A sudden gale blew, followed by thunder. Yan Fu’s heart seized and
turned to look back. He saw a man with wings of lightning charging for
him.

“Z-Z-Zhuo Fan!”

In a blink, Yan Fu’s towering thirst for revenge was wiped clean. The
panic was so palpable from his face that he was on the verge of tears.

[Dude, I was saying one day! Not now! Why are you here? I’m not ready!
Could you at least give me at least seven or eight decades?]

But why would ever Zhuo Fan care? He always followed through with what
he put his mind to.

Whoosh~

Zhuo Fan’s arrival was swift like lightning.

With lack of a better choice, Yan Fu jumped off the carriage. He then
hopped on his feet with a serious face.

[Since I can’t avoid him, come! I am not afraid of you, even if I die!]

But Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less of him.

Boom!

With a crack of thunder, Zhuo Fan went through the carriage, which blew
into smoldering ash. As Zhuo Fan’s figure was made clear from the
wreckage, he was holding someone.

Yan Fu cursed in panic, “Zhuo Fan, you bastard! What do you think you’re
doing to my master?”

“Came to whip a corpse, ha-ha-ha…”

The air echoed with Zhuo Fan’s mockery. Yan Fu shook but all he could do
was cry, “Master, forgive me. Disciple is useless. I can’t even defend
your body. I am unfilial. I cannot stop that demon from humiliating
you…”

Zhuo Fan looked back at him with a smile. Although the kid was a cunning
twerp, not great in the least, he was loyal though.

After flying for half an hour, Zhuo Fan landed in a groove and threw
Vicious Pill King’s corpse on the ground.

Watching the aged and peaceful man, Zhuo Fan put a pill in Vicious Pill
King’s mouth then brought out his gourd. Opening it, a blood-red cute
worm wiggled from within.

“He-he-he, finally going to put you to good use!”

Zhuo Fan snickered and placed the Bloodworm in Vicious Pill King’s
mouth. He put away the gourd and started going through gestures as he
shouted, “Ha!”

In a blink, a visible ripple came from Vicious Pill King.

Shuddering, Vicious Pill King started moving and got up. His mind in a
panic, his hazy eyes looked around, “Where… am I?”

“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Yan, we can finally have a nice and quiet chat.” Zhuo
Fan made a point to give the kindest and most heartwarming smile he
could.

But all he managed to do was send Yan Song into a shivering fit. He
staggered backward, to get some to a safe distance from him.

Such a reaction was as instinctive as when a bunny met face to face with
a tiger.

If only the others were here to see this, they’d be slackjawed. The
grand and magnificent Vicious Pill King, the best alchemist in the
empire, who treaded the continent with such haughtiness, was actually a
scaredy-cat!

But any who had dealings with Zhuo Fan would find this totally
understandable. The fear that was Demon Archon, Zhuo Fan, was not
something mortals could fathom.

“D-din’t you just killed me? How on…” Staring long at Zhuo Fan, Vicious
Pill King recalled what happened four days ago. But to him, it was as if
it was just a moment ago.

Chuckling, Zhuo Fan said, “My actions are always ethical. Those that I
want to kill, they stay dead. As for the others, they won’t die if I’m
around. I made sure the sound attack was weakened before it hit you,
dislodging your soul from your body for a while. It’s akin to feigning
death. A mere Soul Restoring Pill would wake you up easily.”

Roaming his eyes in thought, Vicious Pill King found it to be true, but
still asked with no little suspicion, “Why did you let me live instead
of killing me?”

“Ha-ha-ha, didn’t I tell you? I respect you as being the first
Grandmaster of your generation. It’d be such a pity to kill you and I
find that using you is a much better alternative!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes
shined and his grin widened.

Scared out of his wits, Vicious Pill King now knew Zhuo Fan’s intention
and mocked him, “Ha-ha-ha, you think you can recruit me just ’cause you
want to? I am the best alchemist in Pill King Hall, so why would I fall
from grace and become your errand boy?”

“Nice, prideful. I just love your attitude. At least this way, you’ll
get to make plenty of pills!” Zhuo Fan condescended, adding a thumbs up
for good measure, “Sigh, guess I can’t force you!”

Startled, Vicious Pill King was puzzled. [I refused yet he’s not one bit
angry? He gave up too easily! This is not how the usual demon acts.]

“Zhuo Fan, you won’t try to persuade me?”

“What would be the point? I said all I had to say already. It’s fine as
long as you understand!” Zhuo Fan smiled like a good chap.

But then his hand made a sign.

In a blink, a bloody mark appeared on Vicious Pill King’s forehead,
causing his blood to boil. He felt his head exploding, that it was
slowly cracking itself open.

Vicious Pill King held his head and rolled on the ground from the
torture. Blood seeped from his mouth, ears, nose, and eyes.

“Zhuo Fan, what the hell did you do to me?” Vicious Pill King’s eyes
bulged out, ready to explode.

In all his years, he had never endured such excruciating pain. Even the
poisons he made paled in comparison to the torture this suffering
brought about.

He just couldn’t figure out what Zhuo Fan had done to him.

Giggling, Zhuo Fan showed him a red worm, “Elder Yan, to be completely
honest, I was afraid you might not be so inclined to go along with my
request. So, I gave you this little pet while you were unconscious. It
can make your blood to surge and expand, ending up with a bloody bang. “

Horrified, Vicious Pill King didn’t think Zhuo Fan was capable of having
such vile acts. He knew he had no escape and clung to his only hope as
he yelled, “Zhuo Fan, you’re going back on your own words. Didn’t you
say you won’t force me?”

“Yeah, I won’t ever force you. It is wholly up to your own free will if
you want to come with. But if you refuse, that takes us back to when we
were enemies. It is only right that I rid the world of my enemies, no?”
Zhuo Fan’s cold face stared him down.

Vicious Pill King’s mouth fell and felt like crying.

It was clear like ink on paper. Zhuo Fan wanted to force him into
submission, but the prick had the gall to preach him of free will, even
if it made perfect sense.

“Then end me, spare me of this suffering!”

“Tch, tch, tch, I can’t help you there. It’s my decision on how I
destroy my enemies. In your long-lived life, sir, how many enemies have
you seen teaching their killer how to kill them?” Zhuo Fan blinked with
a wide and naive smile.

Though it only helped to horrify Vicious Pill King further.

[Demon Zhuo Fan earned his name. He is entirely insidious and cruel…]

Chapter 173 - Pill House Elder

Chapter 173, Pill House Elder

“Ah!”

Vicious Pill King’s screams reached the clouds, evoking the same torment
a soul would feel when being fed upon by the horde of wraiths in the
Underworld. The good news was this was in the wild, so no human would be
scared to death by hearing his cries at night.

Zhuo Fan sat leisurely on a big rock, staring at him pitilessly.

Suddenly, Vicious Pill King had had enough. He gnashed his teeth and
gathered his Yuan Qi to blow himself up.

Of course, such an obvious move didn’t escape Zhuo Fan’s sharp eyes. He
made a gesture and all his work came undone as the energy seeped into
nothing.

“Ha-ha-ha, I almost forgot to tell you. Once the Bloodworm enters you,
you are under my complete control. Think of suicide? You need to have my
permission first!” Zhuo Fan mocked.

Vicious Pill King’s heart was filled with shock.

[Where did this Demon Archon Zhuo Fan come from? Why was he so evil? If
I had this thing, I would not need to waste time with Rainbow Cloud
Palm. Instead, I could have outright controlled Drifting Flowers
Edifice.]

The irony here was that instead of him getting to use it, Zhuo Fan used
it on him, the glorious Vicious Pill King.

“Ah!”

All Vicious Pill King could do was make his torment known through
endless shrieks and wails. His eyes bulged and blood crammed into his
skull, on the verge of popping. And that was exactly what was hoping to
happen.

Being at the edge of exploding, he couldn’t even move as the torture
only grew and grew.

He just couldn’t believe such hell existed. And Zhuo Fan’s gaze made his
fear all the more. [The malice this kid shows had never been seen in
this world, and probably won’t appear either long after he is gone.]

“K-kill me!” Vicious Pill King was as stubborn as ever, although his
eyes did contain a hint of pleading.

Zhuo Fan passed him a glance and placed an hourglass on the ground.

“Elder Yan, I don’t have time to waste on you. If you want to die, all
you have to do is wait for the hourglass to end. It’s not much, just
around 24 hours.”

[What?!]

Vicious Pill King was on the verge of tears. Wasn’t the same as saying
to let him be driven mad by pain for a whole day? He didn’t want to wait
even a minute.

[Please kill me! I beg you, sir!]

Vicious Pill King wailed inside, but not minding his plight, Zhuo Fan
ruffled the dust off himself and left.

“W-wait, where are you going?” Vicious Pill King cried.

The chance to make Zhuo Fan deliver him into the sweet embrace of death
would be higher if he was watching. But if Zhuo Fan left, he’d be all
alone in his suffering for a full day!

Imagining that horror got him shivering.

Never had he imagined this day would come, to hope for death, to be so
miserable.

He was now longing for it, growing ever impatient to get it!

Snorting, Zhuo Fan disdained, “My time is too precious to waste it on
you to kick the bucket. But I respect you too much, as the best
alchemist of your generation, to walk this path all by your lonesome
self. So, I’ll just fetch your prized pupil to show you the way to the
Underworld. He will make good company. I believe he will jump in joy
since such a filial disciple can be together with his cherished master,
ha-ha-ha…”

“What?!”

Panicking, Vicious Pill King’s eyes took an ominous glint, “Zhuo Fan, if
you touch one hair on his head, I vow to haunt you in the afterlife!”

Cocking an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan turned to look at him with a beaming smile,
“Oh dear, threatening me, are we? Well, go ahead then.”

Zhuo Fan flew away.

“Wait, wait!!”

Vicious Pill King’s anxious cries were met with silence. Then, his face
sank as he said, “Grandmaster Zhuo, young master Zhuo, I concede. I am
not your match. I will do anything you want, just let my disciple go!”

Zhuo Fan’s laughter echoed into the sky. He smirked triumphantly without
turning around, he casually responded. “When I stole your body, I had
the impression that we might become allies. So, I didn’t harm your
disciple, for your sake. But now, since we’re enemies, it’s best to
snuff any danger out…”

Vicious Pill King had gone silent.

Zhuo Fan’s meaning was crystal clear. Either he surrendered and both
disciple and master would be his buddies, ensuring their safety. Or stay
enemies and be rooted out!

He didn’t want his sole disciple to be harmed, but Pill King Hall was
his house. How could he betray it?

Vicious Pill King was plagued with indecision.

Picking up on his conundrum, Zhuo Fan grinned, “Elder Yan, do you have
any friends, lovers, or any cherished people in the Pill King Hall?”

“Why do you want to know that?” Vicious Pill King frowned.

Shrugging, Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Not much. Since we’ll be palls, it’s best
to know who they are so I’ll go easy on them if I ever meet them.”

Zhuo Fan spoke in such a heartfelt and touching tone that had Vicious
Pill King nod.

“Sigh, no need for such compassion. Our great house doesn’t only fight
with outsiders but also among ourselves. Especially when I became the
first alchemist and earned my title, the fighting only intensified. I’ve
given all my life to my house. I am not close to even the elders, only
to my disciple. I hope Grandmaster Zhuo will spare him!”

Vicious Pill King’s tone was mournful, yet sincere. Zhuo Fan nodded,
“Does that mean Elder Yan concedes?”

“I cannot, Pill King Hall is my home…”

“What home? A place filled with coldness, a place undeserving of you is
worthy of being called home?”

Zhuo Fan cut him off before he could finish, “The way I see it, Pill
King Hall is nothing more than a bank, loaning and collecting money. It
should be proud of itself to raise a great alchemist such as yourself.
But, think about it. All those years you wasted on it, is time you will
never get back. You stand on the edge of a knife. Dwell on this
reluctance of yours to leave it. Is Pill King Hall truly worthy to be
called your home?”

Vicious Pill King was shocked to the core. Zhuo Fan also calmed down the
Bloodworm and let him think it through.

Zhuo Fan wanted Vicious Pill King to surrender wholly, not be forced
into submission. He would be better off without him otherwise. Who knew
when he’d be sold out one day because of him?

“Besides, didn’t you betray Pill King Hall?” Zhuo Fan prodded Vicious
Pill King, seeing him hesitating, “What happened with Chu Qingtian and
the pill recipe? And don’t you dare tell me he was a spy, who would
believe a normal disciple could steal the pill recipe? Isn’t it more
along the lines that you gave it to him?”

Startled, Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan shocked, “H-how did you
know…”

Zhuo Fan sighed, “Because you’re too similar to the Chu Qingtian. You
are both fond of alchemy. Which alchemy master wouldn’t like a disciple
who loves alchemy as well as he does? Although you mocked Chu Qingtian
whenever he is mentioned, you have not once denounced his talent. In
fact, you even find him pitiful!”

Vicious Pill King sat dazed on the ground, powerless to move, as he
droned, “As soon as the child arrived at the door, I knew of his origin.
At the beginning, I have to admit, I held no good intentions towards
him. Furthermore, I am usually haughty and shameless. Doing whatever I
liked. But, his talent had me surprised and I could no longer bear to
hold such intentions towards him anymore.”

“So, I let him steal the pill recipe. Allowed him the opportunity to
learn it on his own. If he could understand it, then, he would’ve
surpassed me. Such a pity…” Vicious Pill King sighed with sorrow, “That
was the only time I failed Pill King Hall!”

[Humph, only by making you admit your betrayal, will you embrace it!]

[Besides, any ‘loyalist’ that had betrayed once, will definitely do it
again!]

Zhuo Fan shed some light, “Elder Yan loves his disciples, and no harm
was done even if the pill recipe was leaked, since no one could unravel
it. Furthermore, you’re dead and no one will look into this betrayal of
yours.”

“What, dead?”

“Correct. Everyone saw how I killed you. I killed you then and saved you
now, without the eyes of the public. In other words, your life is mine,
it no longer has anything to do with Pill King Hall!”

The words struck close to home. Vicious Pill King still held onto Pill
King Hall not because he cared for it, but being the place where he grew
up.

But Zhuo Fan said he died once, breaking all ties with Pill King Hall.
Now it was time to think about the future and leave the past behind.

And sure enough, Vicious Pill King’s eyes changed, hesitation growing
stronger in him.

Zhuo Fan thought it was about time to drive the last nail, “You now have
a choice. To return to being Pill King Hall’s Vicious Pill King, and
enemies to me along with your disciple so that I may kill you again. Or
accept my proposal, and become Windgaze City’s Luo clan’s Pill House’s
Elder, be reborn and shake the world!”

Vicious Pill King’s eyes flashed and laughed, “Grandmaster Zhuo’s words
are sweet. So, I’ve already died once. In that case, I am willing to
follow the great Grandmaster Zhuo into shaking Tianyu.”

Vicious Pill King looked more majestic than ever as he cupped his hands.

“Excellent!”

Nodding, Zhuo Fan flicked an azure pill to him. Vicious Pill King cried
in shock, “Isn’t this one of the perfect 8th-grade pills Grandmaster
Zhuo refined? Why are you…”

“To remove your poison!”

Zhuo Fan spoke in a heavy tone, “I already saw through that pill recipe
and improved upon it. This perfect 8th-grade pill is made based on its
instructions. It stated that to make the antidote, I first must make the
poison. I used the seven poisonous ingredients and then, seven more
detoxifying ingredients to create this. Following that pill recipe, it
was impossible to refine a true antidote. Also, the initial part of
mixing those seven poisonous ingredients was what ended up poisoning Tao
Danniang and the others.”

Vicious Pill King felt even more admiration, “Grandmaster Zhuo is
without a doubt the best alchemist. You even understood the
thousand-year-old pill recipe of Pill King Hall with one look?”

“Ha-ha-ha, you don’t need to exaggerate. It took me five days.”

Zhuo Fan waved his praise in modesty. But Vicious Pill King’s cheeks
twitched. [That’s still fast. If the Hall Leader knew, he might end up
crying…]

Chapter 174 - Luo Clan’s Calamity

Chapter 174, Luo Clan’s Calamity

Vicious Pill King no longer hesitated and swallowed the pill in one
gulp.

He realized on the spot that Zhuo Fan saw through the flaw of the pill
recipe since he could make the antidote.

The Rainbow Cloud Palm was made of seven incredible poisons that only
Pill King Hall could remove. But even that wasn’t a real antidote, just
diminishing the poison within the body so that it would no longer be
deadly. Yet as time passed, that little bit of poison would constantly
harm the body.

Anyone who used this palm was never long for this world. But to make
their house look mighty, they chose to use it anyway. This skill was a
double-edged sword.

To the point that his hair turned green as well as his eyes.

For this reason, they had planned to get their hands on the Bodhi Jade
Sap for centuries. Not for evil intentions, or swallowing Drifting
Flowers Edifice, but to use Bodhi Jade Sap and dispel the poison.

As to Regent Estate entering the fray, that happened later!

And Zhuo Fan, the Eminent Alchemist of his generation, not only
understood the pill recipe, but even refined the antidote to its perfect
form, 8th grade.

Since Vicious Pill King, a Grandmaster of his generation, knew how great
this pill was, he took it without a shred of doubt.

The pill roared in his belly like a dragon, turning into an azure dragon
power that scoured every corner of his being.

As if alive, it rooted out every scrap of poison, yet was mild on his
meridians while also increasing his Yuan Qi.

He was moved and immensely intrigued by this perfect 8th-grade pill.

Standing at the side, Zhuo Fan saw him shining in an azure glow and the
green from his originally black hair was retreating.

The wrinkles smoothed over as well, giving him a fresh and youthful air.
Vicious Pill King flashed his black eyes open, free of any trace of
poison.

Laughing, Vicious Pill King stood up. His manner grew more dignified as
his power advanced a layer. He went from the 5th to the 6th layer of
Profound Heaven Stage.

By the looks of him now, he ought to be in his forties and not the aged
geezer from before.

Sizing him up, Zhuo Fan chuckled, “Elder Yan, you truly have been
reborn. Even your acquaintances may not recognize you.”

“It is all thanks to Grandmaster Zhou’s pill. I was filled with poison
after practicing that art for far too long. Grandmaster Zhou is truly
the best in the empire!” Vicious Pill King cupped his hands in
admiration.

Returning his gesture, Zhuo Fan smiled, “We are all on the same side
now. So, there is no need to call me Grandmaster. You are an elder of
the Luo clan while I am but a mere steward. From now on, you can call me
Steward Zhuo.”

“Eh, Luo clan?” Vicious Pill King’s tone was odd, “I heard that you came
from a third rate clan, but no one said anything about a Luo clan. Then
again, thinking of Steward Zhuo’s incredible talent, the Luo clan must
be a hidden dragon, ready to rear its head and tower over all. It may
not be as renowned as the seven houses, but its might is that of a
crownless king!”

“Uh, maybe later!” Zhuo Fan chuckled awkwardly.

The Luo clan had only one Profound Heaven expert who only broke through
two damn years ago. At best, it’d be considered a second rate clan. But
with this old guy joining the fold, they’d make a good first rate clan.

But Zhuo Fan’s appetite was far from being quenched. He wanted to raise
the Luo clan above the other seven houses in ten years, to be the best
clan in Tianyu.

However, it was not a ripe time. They were far too weak. [So what? Can’t
we steal what we miss? Didn’t I do the same with this Profound Heaven
elder here?]

[Humph, if there’s a first, there’s bound to be a second.]

All in all, there was no one who could stop the Demonic Emperor from
fulfilling his cunning plans!

With a flash of insidiousness hidden in his eyes, Zhuo Fan spoke
heavily, “Elder Yan, I promise you that the Luo clan is the best in
Tianyu, second to none!”

Gasping Vicious Pill King was shocked. Not even Regent Estate had the
gall to proclaim that. But the air about Zhuo Fan made him realize this
was not a joke.

It made a believer out of him as well. With a genius like Zhuo Fan
around, any clan could become the best. He was so moved thinking that
joining such a powerful clan would raise him to even greater heights.

But how could he had known Zhuo Fan’s words only applied to the future.
Even so, he was simply thrilled.

“Gran-, no, Steward Zhuo, when will we be returning to the clan?”
Vicious Pill King was quite eager.

He was dying to see this hidden and powerful clan.

Although seeing it might be a tad bit of a letdown.

Zhuo Fan tch-ed inside, but didn’t let it show and waved him off,
“What’s the rush? We’ll get there eventually. I still have a task to
fulfill so you’ll be coming with me.”

Slightly let down, Vicious Pill King nodded nonetheless.

For such a freak, a hidden gem, a first-class troublemaker, one who
slapped the seven houses like they were children, him staying in the Luo
clan will forever be the clan’s greatest fortune.

[Such confidence he has. That means the Luo clan must be a behemoth to
stand above the seven houses. Just how many ages have they laid in
waiting, beyond the prying eyes of the seven houses and the imperial
family? They must be strong for Steward Zhuo to be with them.]

[As a new elder, I have to apply myself and not drag it behind.]

Vicious Pill King was having wonderful flights of fancy regarding this
behemoth. What escaped his notion, however, was that the great Luo clan
wasn’t hidden to conceal its strength, but so downright weak no one paid
it any attention.

Zhuo Fan knew what he was thinking yet did nothing to bring his feet
back to earth. He cared too much for the old man’s heart.

People always aimed higher and higher. The old guy may be listening to
him since a little worm worked its magic, but Zhuo Fan still needed him
to still be in an illusion. After all, Zhuo Fan needed to keep his
motivation high.

“By the way, Steward Zhuo, aren’t you afraid some ill might befall the
clan after the ruckus you made in the Drifting Flowers City?” It was
just a sudden thought and soon he was shaking his head in self-mockery.

[How can such a clan be afraid of anything?]

Zhuo Fan didn’t much care either, “Afraid of what? The seven houses are
banned from Windgaze City. And the other clans are trifles!”

“Oh, I see. The Emperor issued the order just to protect our Luo clan.”
Vicious Pill King exclaimed, looking ever eager to see it.

[For even the Emperor to watch over it, this clan must be a paradise. It
must be at least as strong as the seven houses since the Emperor ordered
for the seven houses to stay clear of this city.]

The more he thought, the more excited he was. This turncoat business
might’ve been the best thing that ever happened to him. He cracked up,
“Ha-ha-ha, then I can rest easy. Even if Regent Estate comes knocking,
they’ll only suffer. I would really like to see their looks now.”

Staggering, Zhuo Fan woodenly turned his head with a frown, “You’re
saying Regent Estate can still go in? It dares violate the Emperor’s
edict?”

“Uh, Steward Zhuo, it seems our Luo clan had been hiding for too long
and doesn’t know everything.”

Vicious Pill King chuckled, “Over the past millennium, the imperial
family had given many orders to the seven houses, but do you know why it
never had a conflict with them despite them never obeying?”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes roamed in thinking then suddenly focused, “They were
probing the imperial family’s tolerance?”

Vicious Pill King laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is indeed wise beyond
his age. Indeed, the seven houses were testing the imperial family. And
these acts only increased over the last century.”

“What was the imperial family’s reaction then?” Zhuo Fan was anxious.

“Weak, always the first to back down!” Vicious Pill King squinted, “The
current Emperor has to be the worst this empire has ever seen. The
houses may respect him, but none fear him.”

“And you even killed Regent Estate’s second young master at Drifting
Flowers Edifice. The Regent Estate will surely use this excuse to step
out of line and see the impact it has on the imperial family…”

“Let’s go!”

Zhuo Fan was troubled and cut Vicious Pill King off as he flew straight
for Windgaze City.

Vicious Pill King was startled, “Steward Zhuo, where are we going?”

“Home, this spells trouble!”

“What trouble? With the power invested in the Luo clan, not even the
imperial family dares enter its domain, least of all an outsider. The
Regent Estate is bound to suffer a great deal of pain…”

“What damn power? If I’m not there, there won’t even be corpses left!”
Shouting, Zhuo Fan sped away.

Now, he regretted blowing the situation out of proportions back in the
city. He didn’t know the delicate relation between the imperial family
and the seven houses, that they’d enter a cold war. They may be cordial
in the open, but conflicts still arose among them.

If this kept up, Windgaze City might be the fuse that would blow this
charade sky high.

If the Regent Estate wasn’t going to attack the Luo clan directly, but
the imperial family. His clan would end up sacrificed by the imperial
family to de-escalate the conflict.

The more he thought, the faster he flew. Zhuo Fan thought the imperial
family’s power was unquestionable, but it actually declined to such a
degree.

Vicious Pill King might be clueless but still dragged behind Zhuo Fan as
they sped toward the Luo clan…

Chapter 175 - Shaking the Nation

Chapter 175, Shaking the Nation

A month later, in the Imperial Capital.

In a garden of mesmerizing beauty and singing birds, the emperor sat
across from a wizen old man under a pavilion. At a closer look, it was
easy to recognize him as being Mr. Sima.

A stone table laid between them, with a chessboard filled with black and
white pieces. Mr. Sima was playing the black pieces.

The emperor held a white piece, still unclear as to the best place to
put it. When he finally placed it, he chuckled sadly, “Mr. Sima’s skill
is exquisite. I fall sorely short. But could you at least give me some
leeway as an Emperor? You won ten matches already.”

“Ha-ha-ha, Your Majesty is too modest!”

Mr. Sima chuckled, “I am only able to grasp this square foot area, while
Your Majesty plays with the whole nation in mind. How could my meager
skill ever compare? Your Majesty may have lost ten chess matches but has
resolved the land’s issues. It is I who has fallen dreadfully short!”

“Ha-ha-ha, Mr. Sima mustn’t joke. In this land, it is unknown who shall
be the true winner!”

“But Your Majesty has everything set in place and is only waiting for
the final piece, correct?” Mr. Sima let a meaningful chuckle as he
placed a black piece on the board.

The emperor’s face twitched a second as they exchanged glances. Then
they burst out laughing.

“Im-Imperial father…”

A thundering cry came from behind, shaking with it the ground in its
wake. The emperor waved the maids to clean the board, “Damn, that brat
is back again.”

“Ha-ha-ha, Your Majesty need not fret. I have come prepared!”

Mr. Sima waved for the maids to leave, as he smiled at the board, “I
brought a black iron board this time so the third prince won’t get to
disturb the match!”

The emperor smiled, “Mr. Sima is thoughtful.”

A familiar figure rolled into their sights. The fatty was jumping over
and quaking the ground with every step.

The emperor turned to the heavy weighting Yuwen Cong and lamented. [What
did this kid eat to grow even fatter in these three months?]

Bang~

Yuwen Cong ran for all he was worth at the emperor – soaked in sweat,
and filled with panic. Watching the ball growing ever bigger, the two
servant girls were feeling fear, fear for their lives that the fatty
would slip and barrel straight for them.

“Cong’er, slow down!” The emperor pointed at him impatiently.

But the warning fell onto Yuwen Cong’s deaf ears as he strained to
understand, “What did you say, imperial father?”

His eyes finally catching onto who the emperor’s guest was, had robbed
him of the attention of what was in front. A mischievous rock found
itself in his path, and the fatty was now falling to the ground like a
ton of bricks.

He found it odd as the ground only grew nearer, inertia working against
him and turning him into a veritable living ball of flesh rolling on its
merry way straight for the emperor.

The emperor stood in shock and stepped back. Mr. Sima was too out of it,
“The third prince is a man of extraordinary talent. Who else can have
such a precise shape?”

Bam!

In his sighing, Yuwen Cong found himself shooting right before him,
taking out the stone table by happenstance as well.

The black iron chessboard was also thrown to the ground and the game
scattered everywhere.

His face twitching, Mr. Sima stood agape at the ball of flesh, itching
to curse him. The ball was aiming for the match all along, but who’d
have thought to lift the chess in that dire moment?

And he even promised the chess match would be untouched. It was not only
touched, but the board was entirely thrown off.

“Mr. Sima, are you alright?” Yuwen Cong rubbed his poor spine as he
crawled on his stubby legs.

Mr. Sima’s eyes twitched and took a deep breath, “Third prince, few and
far in between had managed to shame me. You should be proud to be one of
them!”

[Eh?]

Yuwen Cong was at a loss, blinking his bean-sized puppy eyes cluelessly.
Suddenly, a bellow came from behind him, “Cong’er, how many times have I
told you that a prince must remain calm and upright. What got you so
frantic that you had to lose all decorum?”

With uncanny agility, Yuwen Cong kneeled and cried, “Imperial father,
this time it’s huge, titanic!”

“Humph, what titanic? Are you going to say the sky is falling?”

With an angry snort, the emperor flicked his sleeve at the servants to
rearrange the table and bring tea. He took back his seat and shouted
coldly at Yuwen Cong, “Over the past century, the Tianyu Empire had been
in harmony, filled with peace and prosperity. The biggest event was only
fifty years ago, when Quanrong had crossed the borders. The second is
the death of You Guiqi two months ago. What could be more grave than
these two?”

Yuwen Cong peaked at the emperor as he mumbled, “Imperial father, this
matter is indeed grave. At least far more than the situation two months
ago!”

The emperor was about to pour tea when his face turned grave, “Who was
it this time?”

“Merry Woods’s sixth elder, Lin Zitian!” Yuwen Cong was kneeling as he
reported.

Face twitching, the emperor took a deep breath and took his teacup, “Lin
Zitian, he can be said to be someone of importance, but not up to the
likes of You Guiqi. Well, he’s dead now. Oh, and who killed him?”

“Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan!”

“What? Him again?” The Emperor perked an eyebrow, “This kid only knows
how to stir trouble! First was Hell Valley and now Merry Woods. Humph,
he just doesn’t know his limits and probably will be ending up dead in a
ditch somewhere. Who knows by what lucky turn of events that he managed
to kill You Guiqi, and now he thinks he’s a bigshot around here!”

“But Your Majesty, he is the pillar of the Luo clan. Anything he does
will come back to bite the Luo clan. While your Secret Pearl Order…”

“I know, I know!” The emperor waved him off with a smile. He turned to
see Mr. Sima’s eyes flickering, as if already knowing what he was
planning, “I assume Mr. Sima is fond of talent and would like to
outstretch a helping hand, perhaps?”

“Ha-ha-ha, helping him means helping the Luo clan, which in turn, helps
Your Majesty…”

“Fine, if Mr. Sima wants to help him, then go ahead. I believe the Merry
Woods would consider Mr. Sima’s presence and will know restraint.” The
emperor smiled.

Yuwen Cong looked up at the two then blurted, “Uh, Mr. Sima I will have
to trouble you to go to Hell Valley.”

“Eh, why would I?” Mr. Sima asked.

Just killing You Guiqi got the Hell Valley to bear a deep seeded hatred
for Zhuo Fan. Going was pointless.

With a sneaky smile, Yuwen Cong replied, “Because the kid also robbed
Hell Valley’s fifth elder of his arm. The Hell Valley is a powder keg
ready to explode. Perhaps your face is great enough to fizzle it out…”

“What?!”

The emperor and Mr. Sima replied at the same time. While Mr. Sima went
slackjawed.

“You’re saying the kid took Hell Valley’s 5th elder’s hand? How is that
possible?”

Mr. Sima blinked the shock away, “That fifth elder is a powerful body
cultivator, just as Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s third elder. He is known as
the Diamondback Ape, for crushing a whole mountain. And you mean to tell
me this renowned expert got his arm ruined by an unknown kid?”

“Who is unknown? At this point, the entire Tianyu heard of this Demon
Archon, Zhuo Fan. He caused a sensation at the Hundred Pill Meeting,
fighting one against seven, yet standing invincible! While the Seven
Noble Houses turned into a laughing stock, with three dead and one
crippled!” Yuwen Cong mocked.

This came as an even greater shock to the emperor and Mr. Sima.

“Three died and one crippled… Lin Zitian died and 5th elder was
crippled. Then who are the other two?” The emperor was getting nervous,
“Who?”

“Uh, Vicious Pill King, Yan Song!” Yuwen Cong spoke with caution.

Sss~

The two gasped in shock.

A dead Lin Zitian was no biggie, but Vicious Pill King was more well
known even compared to You Guiqi, and was stronger far stronger. With
Vicious Pill King dead as well, the Pill King Hall wouldn’t rest until
either they or Zhuo Fan laid dead.

“Damn this brat! Is he looking to stir up heaven itself? He thinks that
since the Luo clan is under our protection, he can just go wherever and
kill whoever?” The emperor was imperially pissed.

Mr. Sima straightened his beard and sighed, “Guess kicking up a storm is
also a talent, of sorts. Who knew the insignificant Luo clan could bring
up such a savage? Ha-ha-ha, quite amusing!”

“Mr. Sima, don’t just go being fond of that kind of talent in front of
me. This kid went past poking a hornet nest and is now stabbing at
heaven. Messing with three houses in one swing sure is amazing. He’d
very soon find himself dead, that’s how amazing he is!” The emperor
panted with rage, “I hoped he’d be the one to revive Luo clan, but now,
I just pray he won’t end up inviting calamity and ruining the Luo clan
altogether, and my Secret Pearl Order…”

Mr. Sima chuckled and tried to mollify him, “Your Majesty, at worst,
I’ll just have to intervene and tie him down so he won’t pull any more
stunts. In the end, the three houses don’t dare to openly defy the
imperial might, going after the Luo clan.”

“Maybe not them, but one house does!” Yuwen Cong whispered with a grin.

Now the two recalled there was one more dead unaccounted for, “Who is
he?”

“Uh, imperial father, it’s best if you sit!” Yuwen Cong emphasized every
word, “Regent Estate’s second young master, Huangpu Qingyun!”

Sss~

Mr. Sima was struck dumb. The emperor was having a panic attack,
breathing in and out to finally recover his voice, “My heart… dammit!
This brat went and poked the heavens…”
