Chapter 176 - Regent Estate’s Invitation

Chapter 176, Regent Estate’s Invitation

A silence had swallowed the imperial gardens, one it had never seen
since its making. Even the birds felt the situation was dire, not making
a peep.

Yuwen Cong looked cautiously at the serious emperor sunk in deep
thought.

Mr. Sima frowned, “Your Majesty, with how thoroughly blown out of
proportion this matter is, I leave the decision to you. Perhaps giving
up on Luo clan is…”

The emperor started pacing, his brows locked tight.

After ages, he stopped. His eyes were incredibly calm, while also hiding
a deep hint of freezing killing intent.

“No, I must protect the Luo clan and the boy!”

Waving, the emperor shouted, “I have always exercised tolerance in my
ruling. But this has gone far enough. They will push me down a cliff if
I let this happen.”

“Here’s my decree. Inform Marshal Dugu to move swiftly! There’s not a
moment to lose!”

[What, the second of the Four Pillars, War God Dugu Zhantian is coming
back?]

Yuwen Cong hesitated to speak, but Mr. Sima showed his unrest, “Your
Majesty, you can’t! Marshal Dugu defends the borders. The Quanrong
wouldn’t dare to step a foot beyond the Thunder Pond with him there. The
border will descend into chaos if he leaves!”

“You’re exaggerating. For thirty years, the border had been peaceful.”
The emperor cut Mr. Sima’s advice short. His eyes flashed coldly, “I
will show my cousin, who this land belongs to. He has crossed my final
line!”

Shuddering inside, Mr. Sima knew the emperor had made up his mind and
sighed. Yuwen Cong bowed and then withdrew with the edict.

The emperor looked up, his eyes flashing as he laughed coldly…

…

Prime-minister’s residence in the Imperial Capital.

Prime-minister Zhuge Changfeng was swinging in his rocking chair with
his eyes closed in rest. Suddenly, a black figure came and whispered
before vanishing again.

Opening his eyes, Zhuge Changfeng revealed a calculative look as a smile
grew on his face, “The monkey had stirred enough ruckus in the Heavenly
Temple and made him nervous. To even have that old man return. Ha-ha-ha,
the time for the war between the seven houses and him is soon upon us.
Since this is the case, let me spice things up.”

(StarReader: Journey to the West reference. Monkey King always caused
havoc in every task Jade Emperor gave him.)

Zhuge Changfeng looked in his yard, “Elders Yin and Yang!”

“Prime Minister Zhuge, what is it that you ask of us?” One black and one
white figure flashed before him.

Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Do you know where Thunder Swarm Mountain is?”

“It is a place for one of the empire’s tree guardian sects, the Demon
Scheming Sect. There is a large barrier there. It detains the four
greatest criminals, now suffering the strikes of ten thousand lightning
bolts every day for the past 60 years!” The black-haired elder spoke.

Nodding, Zhuge Changfeng smiled, “Very good, can you go there and get
them out?”

“What?!” The two exchanged a glance, thinking they had heard him wrong.

“Prime-minister Zhuge, why would you want to? This is the matter of
Demon Scheming Sect that we shouldn’t meddle in. Not only were the four
savage disciples on the path of demonic cultivation, but held key
positions within the sect. They can’t be used.” The white-haired elder
cupped his hands.

Shaking his head, Zhuge Changfeng said, “Those four old fellows have
been stuck there for sixty years. Demon Scheming Sect couldn’t care less
anymore. As long as we keep our mouths shut about this, no one will
know. Also, I never planned on recruiting the four. Now, can you two do
it or not?”

“Of course!” The two elders nodded.

They may have not come from a great sect, but their skills have very
much sharpened over the centuries. A mere barrier couldn’t stop them.

Nodding, Zhuge Changfeng laughed, “Good, now go. The already restless
Tianyu will soon reach a boiling point, ha-ha-ha…”

Meanwhile, Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Pavilion Lord, Long Yifey, was
listening along with the elders to Long Jiu’s report – the shock
palpable.

Once Long Jiu finished, all were bug-eyed.

“You mean to say that Hell Valley’s 5th elder lost an arm?” Third elder
cried out.

Understanding his feelings, Long Jiu smiled wryly as he advised, “Third
brother should relax. The kid had taken the Bursting Pill first. If you
had taken it…”

“But you also said that the fifth elder ate it too…” Third elder’s face
sank in disappointment.

Long Jiu rushed to say, “Yeah, you’re right, but that kid ate five. If
you took five…”

“I’d be a goner!”

Third elder cut him off with a sigh. He shook his mind clear, and
continued, “Moreover, he is only in the Bone Tempering Stage. Sigh, the
young always surpasses the old. I must be getting too much in years…”

Long Jiu watched him sink into depression but didn’t know what to say to
make him feel better. [If you know what’s best for you, don’t go
comparing yourself with that little monster.]

An elder with white hair shouted, “Third elder, why are you still
hanging on to some meager honor? Did you not hear what it’s at stake
here? Regent Estate’s Huangpu Qingyun was killed!”

“True, Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art is mystical body art.
Yet, that kid blew away Huangpu Qingyun’s lower body to smithereens.
Just how strong of a body must he have to pull it off? I know that even
I fall short!” Third elder looked even more downcast.

The elders who spoke held his forehead, [Brother is hopeless.] He then
turned to Long Yifey, “Pavilion Lord, this matter concerns Regent Estate
and it’s best we do not get ourselves involved. If Regent Estate drags
us into this because of the kid…”

“But did you not hear Long Jiu? Regent Estate is targeting every other
house. Even if the matter with Zhuo Fan never happened, sooner or later
they would come knocking on our door. If we cut ties with Zhuo Fan,
we’ll only be avoiding the truth. We may soon find ourselves following
in Drifting Flowers Edifice’s footsteps.” Another elder interrupted.

“From what you say, you want us to work together with Zhuo Fan to fend
off Regent Estate? This is giving them an excuse to wipe us off the
earth.”

“That will happen even without an excuse. Can we not see how much
ambition the Regent Estate has? This will end us grounded down the same
way it happened to Drifting Flowers Edifice. I’d rather fight now than
see that happen!”

“Enough!”

Long Yifey shouted over the clamor, breaking the argument, “It is I who
agreed to become allies with Zhuo Fan, and this shall not change even
now. The kid’s display had opened my eyes, realizing he will be a great
help to us. I will say this again, as long as Zhuo Fan lives, our
alliance with the Luo clan is still in effect.”

“But Pavilion Lord, Regent Estate…”

“Enough, This is my decision!” Long Yifey’s eyes flashed, “Our alliance
with Zhuo Fan has always been followed through in the dark. The Regent
Estate has no clue this is happening. They have nothing to use against
us!”

[So that’s why!]

The other elders exclaimed, “Pavilion Lord is brilliant!”

“Humph, what brilliant? It’s called tactics!” Long Yifey let out a
bitter laughter. He may hate this kind of person the most, but for the
sake of his house, this was the best choice.

“Pavilion Lord, Regent Estate sent a letter!”

A disciple shouted from beyond the doors.

Long Yifey looked at the elders then let the man in.

[Regent Estate came swiftly!]

The disciple bowed before Long Yifey and presented the letter with the
Regent Estate words written in gold on it.

Long Yifey was startled the moment he opened it. Third elder snatched
the letter and his eyes widened, “Regent Estate will hold an assembly
half a month from now. The seven houses are to convene and plan to
remove the demon scourge!”

“You mean…”

Long Yifey nodded, “Regent Estate is playing a ferocious move this time.
The last time they did this was just three hundred years ago!”

“Yeah, but that little monster three hundred years ago had the seven
houses going crazy. While this time, Regent Estate is playing this move
just for its own benefit without even asking the opinion of the six
houses. It is basically acting as though it is the head of the seven
houses!”

Third elder spat, “The Veiled Dragon Pavilion cannot lose again in the
next Esoteric Debate!”

The others all nodded!

The other five houses received the Regent Estate’s invitation at the
same time. Suddenly, the six houses were now en route to convene with
the Regent Estate on the plan to rid the world of Demon Archon Zhuo Fan!

Achoo~

Zhuo Fan was speeding towards the Luo clan when he suddenly felt a chill
and shuddered. He rubbed his nose, “Blast it, who’s cursing me this
time? Why is it that I feel a chill on my back?”

“Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo kicked a storm in Drifting Flowers City, with
casualties in the thousands. Their grief must be focused on you.”
Vicious Pill King was laughing at his side, having a blast.

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and mocked, “Elder Yan, Drifting Flowers
Edifice’s grief is far stronger on you. Don’t you feel the chill from
the tens of thousand female disciples putting all their sorrow and pain
on you?”

Vicious Pill King chuckled sheepishly, “I’m used to it!”

Zhuo Fan grinned. None of them were good people so this teasing had no
effect on either of them.

“Wait!”

Zhuo Fan suddenly halted and Vicious Pill King asked, “What’s wrong?”

Snickering, Zhuo Fan said, “They move fast. An ambush is laid for us not
half a mile from here…”

Chapter 177 - Sneak Attack

Chapter 177, Sneak Attack

“What?” Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo Fan baffled. Then, he recalled
how in Drifting Flowers City Zhuo Fan’s soul reached the Radiant Stage
and knew Discerning Field.

And after so much time had passed, it would’ve been odd if he couldn’t
get more used to it and detect movements in half a mile.

Closing his eyes, Zhuo Fan said, “In a forest half a mile out, two
people are hiding to the West. From their energy, they must be from Hell
Valley. To the East, there are also two quick on their feet, probably
Merry Woods. And finally the two in the North with heavy air about them.
Cultivators of Imperial Tyrant Body Art are experts from Regent Estate.
And all six of them are in the 5th layer of Profound Heaven Stage.”

“Steward Zhuo is amazing to use Radiant Stage’s ability!” Vicious Pill
King praised, “Now we can just avoid them and let them wait forever,
ha-ha-ha…”

Quirking an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan snickered, “And why should we? Since they
are here, we might as well duke it out!”

“Steward Zhuo, you can’t!”

Vicious Pill King was flustered as he tried to explain, “They are
clearly prepared this time. In the Drifting Flowers City, you fought the
four of us, and, as much as it pains to admit, we underestimated you.
Not to mention, we were all from different houses, with gaps in our
cooperation. Now that the houses sent pairs, even if you take that pill
again, it will only make them drag it out then end you at your weakest.”

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan eyed him deeply. [I didn’t think the old
man would be so caring so quickly.] He said, “I was alone then, but
don’t I have you now?”

“Me?”

Vicious Pill King shook his head, “The common folk fears me for my
Rainbow Cloud Palm. But with how many there are here, only one has to
bear the brunt of my poison and I will be a goner. Later, he just has to
go get the antidote from Pill King Hall. I’m sure you are clear on this
from the moment you fought my disciple. “

Indeed, he was posing as Song Yu at the time but being relentless was
the bane of Pill King Hall’s poison. At worst, it was one life at the
price of another.

Moreover, the enemy was now working together. Even if they did get
poisoned, Pill King Hall would offer the antidote and Vicious Pill
King’s threat would plummet.

“What if you can poison them all? Won’t their power drop?” Eyes
flashing, a grin was plastered on Zhuo Fan.

Vicious Pill King didn’t seem to get it, “How can I? They’re not stupid
to sit still and take on my palm. And they’re all Profound Heaven
experts. They may not be able to use Radiant Stage’s abilities, but they
can at least discern any movements in a thousand-meter radius. The
moment we approach, they’ll spot us and we’ll have no chance of
retaliation.”

(StarReader: author mistake perhaps? First half a mile now a kilometer?)

(Silavin: Might not be. He got used to it but, he is still new. It might
be that the ability is stronger.)

“And if they can’t spot us?”

Zhuo Fan watched Vicious Pill King with a playful smile. Vicious Pill
King was baffled, then saw a red pill thrown his way.

Vicious Pill King watched it even more perplexed.

Zhuo Fan said, “This is an Energy Concealing Pill, a 1st-grade pill. For
a full day, your energy won’t be released. Unless someone sees you, or a
Radiant Stage expert actively searches for you, no one will notice.”

Zhuo Fan took one.

In a blink, his aura vanished. Vicious Pill King watched dumbstruck.

“Since when did such a marvelous pill exist in this world? How come I
never heard of it? And a 1st grade as well?” Vicious Pill King’s shock
and disbelief were understandable.

Zhuo Fan mocked, “It is an ancient pill recipe. How could you know of
it? But that’s not important, I will tell you about it later since I
recruited you to help me to make pills. The Energy Concealing Pill will
be of great importance later. For now, stick close. We will talk again
after we deal with these pesky flies!”

Zhuo Fan resumed flight.

Vicious Pill King swallowed it after a moment of shock then followed him
excitedly.

Putting aside how amazing the Luo clan was, just getting to study these
ancient pills from Zhuo Fan was a reward in and of itself.

[Following this kid was the best choice I ever made!]

Vicious Pill King’s heart was dancing in joy, the same as when he made
his first living pill…

In a hidden part of the forest, two elders in white sat on two rocks
with their eyes closed. Even so, they were always on guard, listening to
every rustle, every gust of wind.

Only when they were certain the gust wasn’t made by some expert, did
they relax.

“Third brother, will that kid really pass through here? We’ve been at
this for days and there’s still no sign of him. Did he pass us already
or took another route?” One elder muttered.

The other elder still held his eyes closed and his position on the rock,
“Mr. Leng is famed for his insight. He doesn’t make mistakes. He said
that we will meet the killer of sixth brother here, today. It will soon
be over, just be patient!”

“But all this waiting is so boring…” The other elder sighed.

Then, a black shadow moved closer, unperceived by the pair. When it got
behind them, with a thunderous roar, two wings ran the two through.

Zhuo Fan then came out of the shadow.

Spatting blood, the two elders opened their eyes and strained their
heads behind them, just to see Zhuo Fan looking down on them.

“I was afraid you two would spot me so I used Elusive Shadow Art, but
you guys always had your eyes closed. You can’t be serious even when
laying an ambush! Sigh, Merry Woods is doomed to perish!”

Under the shock of the two, Zhuo Fan twisted their necks. Then, black
energy swallowed the bodies, leaving not but ash in its wake.

The two were so dumbstruck before, still disbelieving to be caught off
guard so thoroughly.

Clapping, Zhuo Fan shrugged.

He learned from his encounter with Lin Zitian that Merry Woods’s
cultivation method boasted great speed. So he figured he’d rather deal
with these two first and remove the trouble later.

What he didn’t expect was for this pair to wait in ambush with eyes
closed. [They were clearly begging for it!]

[You mean to say killing four elders of the seven houses doesn’t warrant
any contingencies?]

[Well, they make it easier for me to do what I want, at least!]

After devouring the two experts, he could feel the Yuan Qi inside him
surging. Zhuo Fan turned to the West, at where Hell Valley’s elders lay
in wait.

[Humph, old enemies do meet often it seems!]

Zhuo Fan snickered, turned into a shadow, and began haunting his way
forward.

The elders in the West weren’t like Merry Woods, waiting idly. Their
aura was somber and watching over any sign of movement around them.

They knew Zhuo Fan for who he was and never dropped their guard for a
second.

“Third elder, the kid is late and it’s making me nervous!” An elder
watched around, ready to pounce. His hawk eyes scrutinized every inch.

The other elder was just as vigilant, but through some strange
coincidence, he always kept a hundred meters from his partner, “Fourth
elder, the kid not only killed seventh elder but even crippled 5th
elder. He is vicious to the core and hard to handle. We must not
underestimate him for being in the Bone Tempering Stage. He will be here
soon and we must work together and avoid ending like seventh elder and
fifth elder!”

“Relax, I consider this kid a veteran Profound Heaven expert!” The
fourth elder nodded with a grave expression.

A shadow was creeping in on him, listening to his words. Zhuo Fan raised
an eyebrow and mocked them in his mind.

[You don’t say. Your welcoming of your enemy is truly worthy of this
Demonic Emperor. Although, how am I to ambush you when you’re so on
edge?]

Zhuo Fan started recalling the two wastes from Merry Woods. Those guys
saved him a lot of trouble, but what about this pair?

He would be hard-pressed to get rid of these two quickly, not to
mention, they were higher than fifth elder in rank.

Sighing, Zhuo Fan began to hesitate.

Then, he heard a boom and a rainbow mist rose in the North. Everything
this mist touched, be it plants, animals, and even rocks, decayed.

The two elders looked in shock, “Rainbow Cloud Palm?”

“Why is Pill King Hall here? I thought they weren’t included in this
plan?” Third elder asked.

Fourth elder paused then waved indifferently, “He-he-he, didn’t the kid
kill their best alchemist? I heard that he stole his corpse later on.
This is one shame they can’t take lying down. I suspect they came here
willingly. Anyway, the more we are, the better the odds. “

“But why are they using Rainbow Cloud Palm…” Third elder paused then
came to a shocking conclusion.

The other elder’s eyes shined and shouted, “They found the kid. We
better hurry and help!”

But before they could even take to the skies, they saw two people
rushing towards them. The elders panicked, “Aren’t they Regent Estate’s
elders? Why are they poisoned? Was it an accident?”

In their moment of doubt, a shadow flitted behind them…

Chapter 178 - Nefarious

Chapter 178, Nefarious

Whoosh!

As third elder and fourth elder were still trying to make sense of the
Regent Estate’s elders’ poisoning, Zhuo Fan stabbed his wings towards
fourth elder’s chest.

He was run through in a blink.

He began to feel a sting in his chest, then how his body grew ever
weaker as the life ebbed out of him.

He then slumped on the ground.

“Fourth elder!”

Third elder roared but Zhuo Fan’s second wing was already coming at him.

However, these two elders matched well with each other even in their
daily lives, more so in battle. They attacked and retreated in such a
way that they always maintained a fixed distance.

This was happening now as well, making Zhuo Fan’s attack only take down
fourth elder while third elder was just too far away for him to reach in
time.

Third elder jumped backward and dodged the Lightning Wing.

He saw fourth elder’s corpse then turned his bloodshot eyes to Zhuo Fan,
thirsting for revenge.

Zhuo Fan glanced at the corpse below him then at the Profound Heaven
expert opposite of him and grinned.

“Are you that Demon Archon Zhuo Fan?” Third elder clenched his fists,
his aura exploding with immense power. He was in the 8th layer of
Profound Heaven Stage.

Not even a pill could guarantee Zhuo Fan a win in this fight.

But Zhuo Fan kept his cool at all times, nodding slightly then looking
at the dead fourth elder, “Is he your brother? You fit quite well
together.”

“What’s it to you? You killed seventh elder, fourth elder, and crippled
fifth elder. I will make sure you never leave this place alive.” Third
elder spat through clenched teeth, yet his ever raging eyes couldn’t
help but pause over his brother’s body.

Taking it all in, Zhuo Fan snickered. He then had the corpse suspended
with his Lightning Wings.

“What are you doing?” Third elder roared.

“To my enemy I will not only kill him but ruin his corpse as well,
making him die in regret!” Zhuo Fan snorted.

Third elder was about to charge, but Zhuo Fan suddenly sighed,
“However…”

Third elder stared wide-eyed.

“Seeing you brothers so close, I will let him go. After all, I also have
a brother earned from life and death struggles, only to die at the hands
of You Guiqi. If not for this, I wouldn’t have had any quarrel with Hell
Valley.”

Zhuo Fan sighed and shook his head.

Third elder was stunned, relating to this third rate clan kid and why he
became Hell Valley’s enemy. Thinking of his earlier action, he also
would’ve charged and exact revenge for his brother regardless of peril.

“Even so, you think I’ll let you go?” Third elder snorted, angry still.

Zhuo Fan snickered and raised his head to show his blazing eyes, “For my
brother’s revenge I have incurred upon me today’s disaster, but I do not
regret it. How could I ask my enemy for forgiveness? But seeing you meet
the same fate as I did, I won’t ruin his body and return it to you.”

Zhuo Fan flicked Lightning Wings and threw the corpse to third elder.

Third elder moved with haste, now looking at Zhuo Fan with a faint trace
of respect as he bellowed, “Good, we will have a man to man fight and
see who’s the real, ugh…”

Third elder stopped for some reason, feeling a chill in his heart.
Looking down, he saw a fist-sized hole in his chest that wasn’t there
before.

Blood flowed in rivers from it.

Third elder looked at Zhuo Fan in complete and utter perplexity.

[What’s going on? We didn’t even start fighting and I’m already dying?]

With a snicker, Zhuo Fan waved.

A golden light came from third elder’s back flying over next to Zhuo
Fan.

Third elder watched the golden infant closer.

“This is my demonic creature. I hid it in the body and threw it over all
so I could catch you off guard. That is why I also cooked up that little
story about my dead brother. I only killed You Guiqi for being an
eyesore.”

Waving at third elder, Zhuo Fan sent him off with his most demonic smile
he could muster, “Fare thee well, loyal and cherishing Hell Valley’s
third elder. I hope you won’t be so gullible to a stranger’s words in
your next life. Especially your enemies’, ha-ha-ha…”

Falling backward, third elder felt himself going colder, his eyes still
reflecting Zhuo Fan’s last smile.

[Demon Archon Zhuo Fan’s nefarious ploys are foolproof. No wonder even
seventh elder fell victim…]

Bam!

Third elder fell next to his brother, yet, as his mind stopped working,
those eyes were forever opened and evoked unspeakable regret!

They were sent here to end Zhuo Fan, only to fumble about and die so
miserably…

“I took too long here. Better go and help Elder Yan!”

Sighing, Zhuo Fan took back Blood Infant and flew up high. In four
breaths, he arrived above the Northern part of the forest.

The Regent Estate’s elders were now green with poison. Despite being in
the 9th stage of Profound Heaven Stage, the poison was nonetheless
effective in dropping them all the way to the 4th layer.

Yet, even in such a case, a body cultivator was still as strong as a
normal 6th layer Profound Heaven expert. Recalling Huangpu Qingyun’s
might in his 2nd layer, he realized Regent Estate’s body cultivators
were not pushovers.

“It was an accident. I made a mistake. I thought Demon Zhuo Fan was
hiding here!”

“Bullshit! Who in this world doesn’t know we are from Regent Estate,
especially with these clothes? Don’t try to play the fool. You did this
on purpose! Stay right there! We’ll break your bones and we will go

Up in the sky, Vicious Pill King fled like a frightened mouse, with the
two Regent Estate’s elders on his tail.

With how Vicious Pill King was proclaimed dead and rejuvenated a couple
decades after removing the poison, these two elders had no clue as to
who he really was.

But he wasn’t about to shout it out either. Would a traitor like him
have any resting moment from Pill King Hall and the entire empire’s
pursuit?

He may be Vicious Pill King, but he was not as skilled as Zhuo Fan, and
clearly not as bold to be hunted down by everyone.

Zhuo Fan sighed.

Where had the great and might Vicious Pill King from Drifting Flowers
Edifice gone to? Why was he such a scaredy-cat before two of Regent
Estate’s elders?

[Is it Regent Estate too strong, or Vicious Pill King just too damn
weak?]

Zhuo Fan already knew the answer, but didn’t want to accept it. Because
his troubles would grow exponentially if it was so.

“Regent Estate, I will surpass you in ten years!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes
flashed.

Spotting Zhuo Fan, Vicious Pill King laughed as if he found his savior,
“Steward Zhuo, you finally came! Save me!”

Vicious Pill King dashed behind Zhuo Fan without an ounce of propriety.

At this point, the two elders also caught up. Seeing Zhuo Fan’s
Lightning Wings, they shouted, “Bone Tempering Stage cultivation,
Lightning Wings… You’re that Demon Archon Zhuo Fan who made a mess of
Drifting Flowers City!”

“The one and only. And you two must be from Regent Estate. I take it.”
Zhuo Fan said with a chill in his voice.

They nodded, then eying Vicious Pill King behind him with curiosity,
“Now I see. Pill King Hall had turned to rely on Demon Archon Zhuo Fan.
No wonder he attacked us on the sly. You still dare say it was an
accident?”

Vicious Pill King snickered.

The two elders snorted, “Why do you think Regent Estate’s Imperial
Tyrant Body Art makes us the best among the seven houses? It’s that not
even your Rainbow Cloud Palm can kill us. We will crush you both and
fulfill our mission!”

“Humph, you’re a broken record, you know that? You’re clearly weaker now
and still prance around saying you can take us on?” Zhuo Fan snorted in
disdain.

The two elders cracked up, “Even weakened, we are more than enough to
wring the life out of you!”

“I don’t believe you. Why not try killing him first?” Zhuo Fan chuckled
and threw Vicious Pill King forward.

Vicious Pill King cried in panic, [Did Zhuo Fan just sell me out?]

The two were puzzled, but still grabbed tight to Vicious Pill King.
Feeling him trembling in their grasp, they were stumped.

Grinning evilly, Zhuo Fan said, “You shouldn’t take him for the coward
he is. He has real skill, you know?”

To prove his point, a golden glow came out of Vicious Pill King and
entered one of the elders.

The elder froze in place and one could even see how he started drying up
like a raisin. His life was swiftly leaving him.

Shell-shocked, the other elder darted a hundred meters back. Even
Vicious Pill King was just as horrified.

He never saw Zhuo Fan make use of Blood Infant, nor kill with Demon
Transformation Art. Now he was watching this all play out in utter fear,
[How can such an abominable and cruel method exist?]

Floating before Vicious Pill King, Zhuo Fan recalled Blood Infant
sneakily and laughed at the frightened remaining Regent Estate elder,
“Did you see that? Now, can you still boast about taking us on?”

The elder had his voice shocked out of him and watched Vicious Pill King
in horror.

[Forget it. That old guy is inconsequential. What matters is I get Zhuo
Fan’s head and complete my mission. I don’t need to worry myself with
that old man’s eerie skill!]

The elder took a deep breath and laughed, “Kid, you’re good to have
found such a patron. Then, I will spare your life today, but… what is
that?”

Suddenly, the elder pointed behind the two with panic.

Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King turned to look. In that blink, the elder
snickered and appeared before Zhuo Fan in a single step, aiming for Zhuo
Fan’s head.

Bam!

The elder didn’t get to touch one hair on his head, however, as a golden
light flew from Zhuo Fan and blew a hole in the elder’s chest.

Zhuo Fan turned back to see the shocked elder, “That’s the oldest trick
in the book. Don’t you know anything else? Now, I finally know what that
old saying means, all brawn and no brain!”

Chuckling, Zhuo Fan lightly pushed and the man fell like trash in the
abyss!

Vicious Pill King had long been stupefied by how easily Zhuo Fan dealt
with two experts from Regent Estate. He now understood what it meant to
kill people as easy as chatting…

Chapter 179 - Unwonted Contriver

Chapter 179, Unwonted Contriver

A bolt of fear went through his core as Vicious Pill King watched Zhuo

Now that he thought about it, everything panned out just as Zhuo Fan

Without even realizing it, the two bit the dust in but a blink.

Rather than say this was a well-thought-out and ingenious trap preset by

Zhuo Fan sighed as he looked in Windgaze City’s direction.

This wasn’t the time for such thoughts, but to settle the safety of Luo

Since Vicious Pill King didn’t know the whole story, he thought it was

A youth of remarkable talent like Zhuo Fan was willing to be a steward.

And what was a steward? The Clan Head’s right-hand man! Able to do

Seeing Zhuo Fan’s look, that staunch resolve to do everything in his

This was his first time hearing Tianyu had such a titanic clan, such a

Vicious Pill King was having a flight of fancy of epic proportions,

Delusions were bliss while reality, a dump.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed.

of the Regent Estate!”

What?!

Zhuo Fan was shocked for a second, then he started making guesses. With

Vicious Pill King stroked his beard and nodded, “I guessed as much. You

Zhuo Fan nodded.

Since he was far more shrewd than You Guiqi, then he would not contest

Chapter 180 - Paying Respects to a Radiant Stage

Chapter 180, Paying Respects to a Radiant Stage

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

Eh?

Half a mile out, a tall and buffed elderly with silver hair was flying
idly behind them. Then, his brows furrowed and a hint of shock swept his
face.

“Was I discovered?”

The elderly’s eyes flash in suspicion, then shook his head, “Not
possible. They are only a Bone Tempering Stage and a Profound Heaven
Stage. Only the likes of Radiant Stage experts can discover me. They
picked up the pace since they were hurrying. Yes, that has to be it. “

Laughing dryly, the elderly had no clue how close to home his random
guess brought him.

If these two with their low cultivation could spot a Radiant Stage, then
the latter would find themselves obsolete.

The old man used his soul to scour the place of battle and shouted,
“Damn brat, they’re so weak yet, they killed six Profound Heaven experts
of three houses, and perfectly too. He-he-he, his reputation precedes
him. The kid must have an even more valuable body cultivation method
than Imperial Tyrant Body Art.”

He licked his lips and excitement danced in his eyes as he increased his
speed.

But his act was easily picked up by Zhuo Fan as he pulled Vicious Pill
King even faster.

There was no denying it this time, the old man was spotted. Why else
would Zhuo Fan react so quickly?

Then he recalled his earlier thought about being obsolete.

His face went red in a flash and felt like slapping himself for those
needless remarks. But the way he looked at Zhuo Fan was with even more
zeal.

“He-he-he, this kid is a freak through and through. How amusing!”

The old man ramped up his speed ten times and in mere breaths, he
already caught the two in his sights, only a thousand meters out.

Startled, Zhuo Fan found his pursuer close behind and shouted, “Shit,
the old guy is almost on top of us!”

“What, that fast?”

Vicious Pill King peeked behind and paled in fright, “Why did it have to

“You know him?” Zhuo Fan asked.

Vicious Pill King nodded on the verge of tears, “Who doesn’t? Everyone
of my generation knows and fears this freak.”

“Who is he?”

“The Mad Dipper, Li Jingtian!” Vicious Pill King swallowed dryly as he

Zhuo Fan was also becoming anxious, having never seen Vicious Pill King

Just then, a booming laughter entered their ears, “Ha-ha-ha, don’t run,
I recognize you. Aren’t you that Yan Song kid? And is that little imp
next to you is Zhuo Fan? You better halt, there’s something I want to

Vicious Pill King’s face sank.

[Why is it that my face changed so much that those two Regent Estate
elders couldn’t tell who I am even when they held me, yet, you saw

Then, he realized. The old freak just scanned with his soul and

Zhuo Fan could feel the shivering Vicious Pill King and was panicking as

This guy was no pushover. Their fate would be grim once the old guy gets

His Lightning Wings flapped and doubled his speed.

“Humph, learn when to quit!”

Squinting, Li Jingtian released a ripple that shot straight for the two
with deadly precision.

[Killing with intent?]

Zhuo Fan looked back flustered as the azure flame flashed in his eyes.

Hum~

Another visible ripple was shot. Incomparable with the first, but enough
to pull up a defense against the first one.

Bam!

The two intents clashed, vibrating the space itself. A bolt of pain
shocked Zhuo Fan’s head and the azure flame appeared on his forehead.

Next, Zhuo Fan pulled Vicious Pill King speeding up as he tried to ease
the shock he felt.

His soul may have entered the Radiant Stage, but he was a long way from
being Li Jingtian’s level. When their intents collided, it forced his
azure flame out.

He was clear the azure flame safeguarded his soul. Its appearance proved
what a serious threat the old man’s intent had to his soul, despite not
meaning to kill him outright.

Even so, his soul wasn’t free from injury.

If that intent had hit, he’d be out cold and waiting for the old guy to

While he was shocked, a thousand meters behind him, Li Jingtian was

He looked as if he saw a tiger sprout wings and take off. Not only was

A tiger was the king of beasts. If it took flight, then who could stand

He felt a real threat coming off from Zhuo Fan. He could use Radiant

“Houses?”

Raising an eyebrow, Li Jingtian cracked up, “You mean Regent Estate and

Vicious Pill King’s mind shivered at this. He was planning on keeping

going to happen anytime sooner.

Li Jingtian’s smile was frosty, “Don’t think I don’t know. I saw your
fight earlier. You turned your back on Pill King Hall and threw your lot

“Uh…” Vicious Pill King was stumped, turning to Zhuo Fan for a way out.

Since going back to Pill King Hall was out, betraying Zhuo Fan was
impossible. That would make him immoral. He was Vicious Pill King, not

Sighing, Vicious Pill King admitted, “Yes, I left Pill King Hall. I will
follow Steward Zhuo to the Luo clan. Now if you want to kill me, go
ahead.”

Zhuo Fan nodded inside.

He saw Vicious Pill King as a devout alchemist foremost and a loyalist
second, a man you could count on.

Li Jingtian didn’t expect such a blunt reply and laughed, “Good! Yan
Song. You live up to your rumors. I will let you go, but this kid…”

“You want to kill me?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, staring at Li

“Where are you going with this?” Li Jingtian’s eyes flashed.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan spoke boldly, “Then let’s discuss terms for you to
join me. What Regent Estate offers you, I, Zhuo Fan, can not only meet
their offer, but double it!”

Chapter 181 - A Martial Fanatic With Honors

Chapter 181, A Martial Fanatic With Honors

[[What?!]]

Li Jingtian and Vicious Pill King were shocked silly.

Squinting, Zhuo Fan smiled, “My knowledge is shallow. Having not heard
of Elder Li’s glorious pursuits, I ask that you enlighten me.”

“Ha-ha-ha, I knew you were wet behind your ears. That’s why you spouted
those egotistical words about buying me. Although I can’t blame you,
since I haven’t gone out much for you to hear of me.”

Nodding with pride, thinking things were going his way, Li Jingtian
turned to Vicious Pill King, “However, if I were to retell old stories
of myself, all you’d be hearing is bragging. Yan Song, you tell him.”

Shivering, Vicious Pill King bobbed his head, “Right away!”

Despite the apprehension he felt, Vicious Pill King glanced at Li
Jingtian then spoke with the utmost gravity, “Steward Zhuo, Elder Li is
a man that shook the empire. You’d be hard pressed to find another grand
figure such as him in the whole of Tianyu Empire.

“Elder Li started as a rogue cultivator, no match to any of the seven
houses’ experts. However, his mind was staunch, his heart set on giving
his all in training his arts. Since he had no cultivation method, he
stole it from other clans. He began with a mortal ranked cultivation
method, slowly working his way to a spirit ranked cultivation method,
then a profound ranked cultivation method. The exploits of Elder Li are
found in every history book…”

“Oh, so, Elder Yan means Elder Li is a thief?” Zhuo Fan interrupted as
he scratched his nose.

Panicked, Vicious Pill King gesticulated wildly in his stammering, “I-I
never said such a thing…”

“Mind your words!” Li Jingtian bellowed and slapped him. Looking
somewhat awkwardly at Zhuo Fan.

He was hoping Vicious Pill King would make a proper account of his
heroic deeds, racking up his value. But this old coot went and spilled
the whole beans about his inglorious past.

All robbing would do was drop his price instead.

Li Jingtian glared at Yan Song then coughed, “Ha-ha-ha, that is an old
story, a part unworthy of attention.”

“How can it be? Without a cultivation method, your only choice was to
steal if you didn’t want to stay weak all your life. I truly admire your
courage!” Zhuo Fan smiled.

Li Jingtian’s eyes shined and his heart jumped in joy since Zhuo Fan
didn’t despise him. He laughed even harder, “Your reputation doesn’t do
you justice, Demon Archon, Zhuo Fan. You aren’t like those so-called
experts, but a man of true talent.

“Correct. In my younger days, I had to go steal renown skills and
cultivation methods from clans to become what I am now. And the more I
stole, the more enemies I gained. But I showed no fear. After
cultivating, I became stronger than any of them and killed any who
chased me down. I always fought them with the same skills I stole,
promising to hand my head over if I ever lost!”

Zhuo Fan looked at him deeply. [Isn’t that the same as what I’ve been
through in the Hundred Pill Meeting?] Zhuo Fan’s opinion of him grew
somewhat.

He was a renowned man to steal other’s belongings and achieve greatness,
just like Zhuo Fan. None of them were saints, just looking at things
from a different angle!

“Then, people started calling Elder Li as the ‘Mad Dipper’. It means to
say how arrogant I am yet so powerful none of them could do anything to
me!” Vicious Pill King put his two cents in.

Li Jingtian nodded, “So I robbed and cultivated my way to the Profound
Heaven Stage, unmatched by all. But at that point, I have reached a
chokepoint.”

“Yeah. Spirit ranked cultivation methods are too slow in the Profound
Heaven Stage and had to be exchanged. And the only ones with such
cultivation methods are the imperial family and seven houses, or the
Four Pillars. Is this how you leaned on Regent Estate?” Zhuo Fan said.

Li Jingtian shook his head, holding his head up high.

Vicious Pill King butted in, “Steward Zhuo, you may not know, but Elder
Li didn’t lean on Regent Estate, but fought his way in. Elder Li heard
of Regent Estate’s Imperial Tyrant Body Art being the best of all the
houses and wanted to take it. Five elders had to work together but even
they, with their Imperial Tyrant Body Art, couldn’t defeat Elder Li
spirit ranked body cultivation method. Even Regent Estate’s Grand Elder
Huangpu Fenglei had to intervene. Thus, he invited him into his house as
a guest elder, now Venerable. This was one of the rare events in the
history of Regent Estate.”

Vicious Pill King turned his admiration-filled eyes to Li Jingtian. Li
Jingtian’s head rose even higher, as if that was possible, as he stroked
his ego in just the right spots.

As if to say. [Look, I didn’t go there begging, it was Regent Estate who
invited me.]

But Zhuo Fan saw through everything and snorted inside.

This so-called invitation was after he became a sensation.

[Regent Estate is fraught with danger. No matter how tough you are, a
Profound Heaven expert would soon be lying dead somewhere before he
could make any kind of scene. It’s obvious he used his own strength to
recommend how fitting he was for Regent Estate.]

[If I went in, my conceived version of Imperial Tyrant Body Art would’ve
grown far stronger than theirs, thus boosting the power of Regent
Estate.]

[Nonetheless, a body cultivator who has always been engrossed in his
training yet, still had the time to develop such cunningness is a
rarity. It had to be all that chasing’s fault]

Li Jingtian looked more pleasing in Zhuo Fan’s eyes.

[This Radiant Stage guy has brawn and brain. He is a good specimen!]

Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan smiled, “In other words, Elder Li is a
martial fanatic. Doing anything and everything in your pursuit of
power.”

“You only have one life. If you don’t fight your way to rise above the
masses, it’s not worth living for!” Li Jingtian looked at the skies and
sighed.

Zhuo Fan spoke, “Now, I know what Elder Li wants…”

“Hold on, I don’t want you to see me as…”

“I have my own cultivation method!”

Zhuo Fan cut him off, “What I am unclear, however, is why Elder Li, a
Regent Estate’s guest Venerable, and knowing the Imperial Tyrant Body
Art, would come after my cultivation method?”

“Uh, kid, I am not actually…”

“Do be frank with me!”

Shooting him a glance, Zhuo Fan was completely defiant, “If Elder Li
isn’t honest, you will never get what you want from me. Since I don’t
know what you really want.”

Stammering, Li Jingtian looked squarely at Zhuo Fan with admiration. [He
is no common kid. Few are those who can meet the gaze of a Radiant Stage
expert.]

[No wonder Leng wanted me to personally deal with him.]

Li Jingtian sighed and nodded, “Indeed. I came today for a cultivation
method. Humph, I am Regent Estate’s guest Venerable, yet, they only
imparted the Imperial Tyrant Body Art up to the seventh stage, omitting
the last two. Yet, those weaker than me get to practice it without
worry.

“Ridiculous! If I had trained to the ninth stage, I’d be invincible. Not
even the imperial family’s Divine Dragons can compare. Just why have
they not given me the last stages?”

Li Jingtian let go of all his rancor, to which, the two looked at each
other and shook their heads in mockery.

This guy really was a martial fanatic, godlike even. Could Regent Estate
rein him in if he became invincible? Humph, he had always been an
outsider.

[I wouldn’t impart it either if I couldn’t control you!]

Zhuo Fan said so yet, the outline of a plan was forming in his mind.

This man could be taken into the fold. Though, he needed to fine-tune
his rash behavior and get him to fall in line…

Chapter 182 - Duping a Radiant Stage Expert

Chapter 182, Duping a Radiant Stage Expert

“Kid, I have been completely open with you. Now, it’s your turn to tell
me that body cultivation method of yours!”

He wanted to still pose as a senior, but Zhuo Fan’s bluntness was hard
to cope with. He thus reverted to his Mad Dipper, robber self.

Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan was just as calm as he smiled, “Elder Li,
how do you know my cultivation method is better than Imperial Tyrant
Body Art?”

“Humph, anyone can tell after the stunt you pulled in Drifting Flowers
City!”

Li Jingtian huffed, “Huangpu Qingyun just entered the seventh stage of
Imperial Tyrant Body Art yet, could only take one Bursting Pill. And
then there’s you, taking five of them and killing him outright. Even a
blind could see whose is better!”

Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King shared a look and nodded. Not everyone
was stupid, able to tell which was which.

Yet, Zhuo Fan still chose to shake his head, “Elder Li, you are a
renowned senior, most clear on the power the Imperial Tyrant Body Art
holds. Think it through, just how many cultivation methods are there
that can surpass it? “

Li Jingtian was at a loss.

“Ha-ha-ha, Elder Li, as you know the full recount of what happened in
Drifting Flowers Edifice, then you must also know what my other title
is!”

“Eminent Alchemist Zhuo Fan?” Li Jingtian was stunned, “You mean…”

Zhuo Fan nodded with a crafty smile, “I managed to display such power
with my body because of my cultivation method, yes, but also thanks to
the pills personally refined. Just one was enough to boost my power five
times!”

“What, is that possible?”

Body cultivators were stronger than average because of their tough
bodies. And the only way to obtain it was through arduous training, no
exceptions.

But if there was a pill that could do the same thing, where’d the body
cultivators’ advantage go?

[Does the world have such a miraculous pill?]

Li Jingtian was skeptical, but Zhuo Fan’s logic held some truth. How
else could Zhuo Fan with his Bone Tempering Stage cultivation stand up
to Huangpu Qingyun?

Li Jingtian was clearly hesitating, but then he said coldly, “Kid, give
me the pills or I’ll waste you.”

“Can’t, I ate them all. How else could I have finished off Huangpu
Qingyun?”

“Then you better make some. Aren’t you an alchemist?”

“Out of ingredients!”

“Then, I will stay with you until you get them!” Li Jingtian was
shouting now.

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan caught Vicious Pill King showing off a
peculiar smile. One that Li Jingtian clearly spotted.

“In that case, I need the blood of a red tail ice fox, a third level
beast. Let’s go to Allbeast Mountain Range.” Zhuo Fan proposed.

Li Jingtian waved him off with a smile, “Hold on. Why should we go that
far? There’s plenty of third level spiritual beasts in a nearby forest.
They aren’t as many in Allbeast Mountain Range, but should be enough for
refining.”

Frowning, Zhuo Fan had no choice but to sigh and nod, “Very well. Let’s
go.”

Turning around, he gave Vicious Pill King a look. Vicious Pill King
didn’t seem to have caught it but Li Jingtian was on guard to pick up
this particular strange behavior.

He pulled Zhuo around by the shoulder and squinted, “Kid, a third level
spiritual beast doesn’t need all three of us. Let Yan Song get it while
we wait.”

“Ha-ha-ha, I am an alchemist and pay close attention to the details when
picking any ingredient. How could I let Elder Yan go?” Zhuo Fan wiped
his brow of sweat.

Li Jingtian snorted inside. He didn’t know what Zhuo Fan’s game was, but
rumors about his cunning and treachery floated everywhere. It’s best to
be on the safe side. How many’s blood ended up in this kid’s hands just
because they looked down on him?

Li Jingtian was a veteran and saw through everything. He laughed,
“Ha-ha-ha, kid, cut the act. I said he will go alone and that’s final.
He is also an alchemist and knows what spiritual beast to pick.”

Gnashing his teeth, Zhuo Fan furrowed his brows, but sighed in the end
and took out a gourd from his ring, “Elder Yan, here are the favorite
worms of the red tail ice fox. Bait it with this and catch it quickly.”

Yan Song’s eyes lit up, catching his meaning, and nodded.

“Wait!”

Li Jingtian felt something was off, “What is this? Let me see!”

Yan Song hesitated but Zhuo Fan nodded.

Li Jingtian took the ice-cold gourd and opened it. A blood-colored worm
wiggled its way out.

Li Jingtian looked at it with a critical eye but found nothing unusual.
He gave it back to Vicious Pill King, “This fox eats worms?”

“Ha-ha-ha, who else but us alchemists know the habits of every spiritual
beast?” Zhuo Fan laughed.

When Li Jingtian found Vicious Pill King had gone ten meters away, he
shouted, “Yan Song, you have one day to bring a third level spiritual
beast. Be late and we won’t wait for you.”

Yan Song staggered in his flight looking back at Zhuo Fan and nodded.

Zhuo Fan sneered inside. Li Jingtian was quite cautious, leaving no
stone unturned. Even though he let Yan Song go, he gave him a deadline.

Now, it wouldn’t matter even if he got help, since these two would be
long gone.

[Humph, getting hounded in his younger days worked wonders for his
prudence it seems. But despite all this caution, it only sends him
deeper into my trap.]

Zhuo Fan grinned.

Around twelve hours later, Vicious Pill King carried a snow-white fox’s
body. Its tail was a vibrant red.

Vicious Pill King placed the body down and returned the gourd to Zhuo
Fan with a slight nod.

Zhuo Fan smiled, “Now, we can refine.”

“Wait!”

Li Jingtian again butted in, his eyes flashing eerily. A flick of his
finger cut the fox in two.

Li Jingtian stooped and squeezed the parts until a red worm came out.

“Now you can begin!” Li Jingtian squashed the worm to a paste.

Vicious Pill King was startled yet found Zhuo Fan calm as a well.

“So now I will refine a body pill for Elder Yan to prove my words!” Zhuo
Fan took a deep breath and used his Yuan Qi flame.

But Li Jingtian barked, “Wait. I want ten. The more you have, the
better.”

“But you can only take it once in your life! Taking any more would be
useless!” Zhuo Fan furrowed his brows.

Laughing, Li Jingtian’s eyes were sharp, “If I say you make ten, then
that’s what you’ll do. Unless you two don’t want your heads on your
shoulders!”

For lack of a better option, Zhuo Fan started refining. When the pills
were just about done, he added the ice fox’s blood.

With a hum, ten pills radiating cool air and colored red flew into Zhuo
Fan’s palm.

Li Jingtian cried in shock, “Why are they so cold yet came out of a Yuan
Qi fire?”

“Elder Li may not know that this 3rd-grade pill, Freezing Body Pill, is
a clan secret. Refined with a yin yang flame, it is hot inside and cold
on the surface. Once ingested, hot and cold will travel through the body
hundreds of times, tempering it.” Zhuo Fan explained.

Li Jingtian reached over, “Give me one!”

Zhuo Fan nodded, acquiescing his demand.

“Wait!”

Li Jingtian had a sly smile, “Give me the other nine!”

Zhuo Fan frowned but complied. Li Jingtian then pointed at the one Zhuo
Fan was holding and said with a cold smile, “Kid, eat it.”

“I told you, this pill only works once!” Zhuo Fan frowned,

Laughing, Li Jingtian’s eyes bore into him, “I know of course. But it
won’t matter if you take one more. If you don’t eat it, that this pill
must have a defect and I will kill you.”

Zhuo Fan ate it in the end.

Seeing him fine, Li Jingtian’s eyes roamed around in thought, “Kid, pick
one from these nine.”

Zhuo Fan sighed and took one.

“Give it to me!” Li Jingtian said.

Zhuo Fan complied, yet Li Jingtian shouted again, just before he ate it,
“Hold on. You eat it, Yan Song.”

“Me?” Yan Song stammered but was forced to eat it either way.

In this way, Li Jingtian made Zhuo Fan pick again and again, until only
three were left. He picked one himself then checked the two’s faces
before eating it.

Li Jingtian felt a chill seep into him, then a warmth. It was so gentle
and cozy.

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow then snickered.

[This guy is paranoid, but he took the bait anyway, he-he-he…]

Chapter 183 - Another One Comes Aboard

Chapter 183, Another One Comes Aboard

Li Jingtian entered meditation and focused on refining the pill. Zhuo
Fan and Vicious Pill King were actually just standing there looking at
him.

Six hours later, Li Jingtian stood up. Zhuo Fan smiled, “How is it,
Elder Li? Happy?”

“Yes, my body feels so free!”

Li Jingtian let a carefree laugh, but then was cut short as he frowned,
“However, why is it that my body hasn’t grown in power?”

Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “That’s normal since it was not a body pill by
any means. It’d be odd if you did get stronger!”

“What? You lied?” Li Jingtian’s rage exploded.

Vicious Pill King hunkered for cover behind Zhuo, but the latter was
still carefree, “Oh my, Elder Li, you are a veteran and a man with
widened horizons. How come you bought into this fairy tale about body
pills? Don’t you know cultivators walk in defiance to Heavens? The
greater the price the bigger the reward. Relying on pills will only ruin
you in the long run!”

“You played me for a fool?!” Li Jingtian’s eyes were red now.

Vicious Pill King shivered as he shook Zhuo Fan’s arm. He tried to make
him stop aggravating this old monster.

Zhuo Fan, however, flicked his hand free and laughed, “And, what are you
gonna do about it? You think I’m as dumb as those morons you robbed,
thinking you can just take my cultivation method? Fat chance!”

“Why you little…”

Li Jingtian was panting in rage, pointing at Zhuo Fan all the while.

The great Mad Dipper Li Jingtian was somebody, even in his early days,
that the seven houses would show some respect. But then, he met this
young pup who started cursing him.

The shame was unbearable.

No matter if he got the cultivation method or not, Zhuo Fan had to die.

Li Jingtian bellowed and slapped the two. The wave of power coming from
him almost blew the two away.

“Kid, your life ends here!”

Vicious Pill King shivered behind Zhuo Fan in fear.

[Steward Zhuo, you tricked him but your Bloodworms plan fell through, so
why are you making it worse?]

[You looked so wise with your poise and calmness, but how come why are
you hotheaded today?]

Vicious Pill King cried as he wailed inside. Who could have seen this
coming? He just got a new lease on life only to die again a month later.

[Is this the end of my poor life?]

In the middle of his lamentation and prayers, Zhuo Fan snorted and made
a sign.

“Ah…”

A shriek of pain shuddered the heavens itself. A bloody mark appeared on
Li Jingtian’s forehead that forced his palm to a stop but a hair’s
breadth away from Zhuo Fan

He then proceeded to hold his head as he collapsed in agony.

Blood flowed from his eyes, ears, nose, and mouth, dyeing the ground
red. His eyes bulged out and were ready to pop.

The wail had Vicious Pill King looking stumped. Looking back at Zhuo
Fan, he noticed the trademark wicked grin on his face.

“Uh, Steward Zhuo, did it work?” Vicious Pill King blinked.

Zhuo Fan nodded, “But of course. This coot is under my complete control.
Elder Yan, you did well today. I will remember this!”

“Great, ha-ha-ha…”

Vicious Pill King’s spirits were uplifted. He looked to Li Jingtian with
a proud gaze. [He-he-he, you finally got yours. Who told you to play
around?]

[Don’t you know any ploy before Zhuo Fan is paid back many folds?]

Vicious Pill King felt it on his own skin. But seeing the Mad Dipper of
Tianyu’s act crushed and shamed, made him chipper.

His admiration for Zhuo Fan grew as well of course

[He even managed to bring a Radiant Stage cultivator to his knees! This
boy is too much!]

“W-what’s happening to me?” Li Jingtian held his head as he rolled on
the ground, “What the hell did you do to me?

Zhuo Fan and Vicious Pill King snickered in sync.

Taking the remaining two pills, Zhuo Fan said, “Elder Li, I’m sure you
know by now. I mean, didn’t a veteran cultivator like you ever heard the
saying, don’t take candy from a stranger?”

“The pill?” Li Jingtian’s eyes widened, “Impossible. Even if a 3rd-grade
pill had poison, my Yuan Qi is more than enough to remove it. And didn’t
you take it too?”

Zhuo Fan snickered, “We did indeed. Terribly sorry, however, this pill
is completely safe. It has no poison, though it does refresh one’s body.
What is wreaking havoc in your body is this little buddy.”

Zhuo Fan presented the gourd and a Bloodworm came out.

Li Jingtian had known something was off about it, but never thought it
could be so deadly and make him stand on the edge of a precipice.

“This is my demonic creature, Bloodworm. It takes control of your blood.
I am linked with it and a thought from me is enough to plunge you into a
world of pain! It works just the same even on a Radiant Stage expert
like you and there’s nothing you can do about it.”

Li Jingtian was shocked and roamed his eyes around, all while he
expressed his doubt, “That can’t be! I scanned every ingredient you
used, even the dead fox and there was nothing wrong with any of them.
The Bloodworm was killed by me at the start. You’re saying the worm
didn’t die when being refined?”

Vicious Pill King was also curious about this. This was the reason for
his disappointment earlier. He just didn’t know how Zhuo Fan pulled off
getting this old guy to swallow a Bloodworm.

“Ha-ha-ha, I know this as well. Why else would I propose the red-tailed
ice fox?”

Chuckling, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined with wisdom, “My Bloodworm lives in
frigid pools, and the ice fox’s main property is its icy blood. So, I
had Elder Yan feed it a Bloodworm, but not to include it in the pill
later. It was all so it would lay its eggs. You might have killed the
Bloodworm, but the icy blood was filled with eggs.”

“Now I get it! Under a Radiant Stage expert’s scrutiny, they’ll notice
any hint of life in seconds. But an egg isn’t alive until it hatches.
This made Li Jingtian’s search useless.”

Vicious Pill King exclaimed while also giving Zhuo Fan a good round of
ass-kissing, “Steward Zhuo is a sage to cover all aspects. Not even the
veteran Li Jingtian could match your perfect schemes. I am in awe!”

“That’s not right. How did you make the Bloodworm grow so fast from a
mere egg?” Li Jingtian was still in denial.

With a light smile, Zhuo Fan supplied the explanation on a casual note,
“You have the potency of the pill to thank for that. As I’ve said, I
used both yin and yang fires in the refining. If I did not do so, the
yang fire would have ruined the egg in the blood. The rest is as you
already understand. Or more aptly put, felt on your own skin. The pill
freely switches from yin to yang. Sometimes the warmth of spring, and
sometimes the chill of a winter blizzard. It imitates the four seasons.
Though it may have been six hours, but to the Bloodworm, it was
equivalent to decades.

“Not to mention, this pill speeds up your pulse, all to help the little
Bloodworm grow. The pill was no body pill, but one that facilitates the
flow of blood, the Spring Pill!”

The explanation floored Li Jingtian completely.

Never had he thought this day would come. He moved unchecked across the
empire only to fall in the hands of a twerp. He could only laugh at
himself for being greedy. It was this that brought him to his knees.

But Zhuo Fan saw through him once again, “Ha-ha-ha, you must be thinking
greed got you into this mess, no? Wrong. Humans are inherently greedy.
Take away your desire, and would you still be human? Desire is fine, but
you must never ever try to take any shortcuts. There’s no such thing as
a miracle pill to make you strong. And even if there is, the price you’d
have to pay for it would be so much greater.”

Zhuo Fan then placed a jade slip at his feet, stopping the Bloodworm’s
torment as he continued preaching, “Like I said. I have my own
cultivation method. It is called Wraith Art, a mid profound ranked
demonic method of astonishing power. Train it to completion and it won’t
lack one bit to a top one. It is without a doubt stronger than even the
Imperial Tyrant Body Art. At the same time, I will also give you three
matching profound ranked martial arts.”

“If you are willing to bend a knee and join me and the Luo clan, pick it
up and become its elder. Or, you can just leave, return to Regent Estate
as a guest Venerable. I won’t stop you!”

Looking Zhuo Fan straight in the eye, Li Jingtian could pick up on his
sincerity.

He slowly reached for the jade slip as he muttered, “I first want to see
if it is real and not and if it is incomplete like what Regent Estate
had passed to me.”

Zhuo Fan smiled and nodded.

When Li Jingtian caught a glimpse of it, his eyes widened, “Bloody hell!
There’s a sound profound ranked martial art in here! This doesn’t exist
anywhere in the empire. What kind of a behemoth is this Luo clan to have
such a treasure? “

“Your decision?” Zhuo Fan smiled.

“I’m in. Who the hell wouldn’t at this point?” Li Jingtian put the jade
slip in his ring and laughed, “Kid, I’d come over to your side much
earlier if you had just shown me this cultivation method. What need was
there for all that cloak and dagger spiel? He-he-he…”

“You don’t say.” Knowing what he was thinking once again, Zhuo Fan
smiled coldly, “Wouldn’t you have killed me instead, to silence me, and
take my head for a reward?”

Li Jingtian scratched his head awkwardly from having his heart laid
bare.

[Zhuo Fan is just as the rumors say. Nothing escapes him. No wonder he
can act so calmly after killing six experts.]

[With such a talent, the clan must be of even more epic proportions. I
didn’t lose out following him.]

Li Jingtian laughed inside. He may have been forced to switch camps but
you could say he traded up!

As such, another poor and disillusioned expert climbed aboard.

Zhuo Fan didn’t mind at all. [Isn’t it a good thing if they trust the
Luo clan? Although they may perhaps experience a somewhat mild let down
when they see it.]

Zhuo Fan felt somewhat bashful at that last thought…

Chapter 184 - Seven Houses Gathering

Chapter 184, Seven Houses Gathering

The Caged Dragon City leaned onto the endless miles long Bulwark Range.
Four towering peaks, jutting cliff edges, and cloud wreathed hunks of
rocks had the city surrounded. Seen from above, the four looked like
spikes nailing down a proud dragon, dooming it for all eternity.

And this city here was where the head of the seven houses, the Regent
Estate, laid its roots.

An old man in his fifty, with sunken cheeks and pale as paper, was now
standing before the looming city gate. His hair was in a bun, just like
a scholar’s, evoking a refined and courteous air. But the bloodthirst in
his eyes ruined this image.

Two Profound Heaven experts flanked him, yet, their attitude was quite
deferred toward the old man, with a hint of fear mixed within.

Whoosh!

Suddenly, three lights flashed before them. They were none other than
Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Pavilion Lord, Long Yifey, 3rd elder and Long
Jiu.

“You honor me, Pavilion Lord Long, with your arrival. Do forgive me for
coming so late to welcome you!” The scholar half bowed to Long Yifey,
yet, there was no trace of courteousness on his face.

Long Yifey returned the greeting with haste and respect, “It is of no
importance. How could I possibly demand Sir Leng come in person? You
have given me a world of respect just by waiting for me.”

“Ha-ha-ha, Pavilion Lord Long is courteous. It is only proper I do so,
as the steward of Regent Estate!” Sir Leng cupped his hands and his lips
curled into a wide smile.

Long Yifey nodded but felt his heart in a vice.

Around a man they called Unwonted Contriver Leng Wuchang, one had to be
mindful of his every little gesture at all times, lest they reveal
something they wouldn’t want to about themselves. Lest they would
unwittingly allow him to pry into Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s secrets.

Even the other six house lords treated meeting Sir Leng with more
gravity than seeing the emperor.

Whoosh!

Three more figures arrived just then. Looking over, they were Hell
Valley’s Valley Lord, You Wanshan, along with his Grand Elder and
one-armed 5th elder. Perhaps the rage and humiliation still held him in
their grip for his features were tightened and morose.

After exchanging greetings with Leng Wuchang, and some short
pleasantries, Leng Wuchang flicked his cold eyes on Long Yifey, “Humph,
Pavilion Lord Long, enemies always seem to bump into each other. This is
the second time we meet since our audience with the emperor.”

“Ha-ha-ha, quite so. Life is fickle like that. It seems, however, after
we parted from the imperial capital, Veiled Dragon Pavilion stayed the
same, yet, I find it that not to be the case for Hell Valley.” Long
Yifey chuckled, the sarcasm clear in his eyes as well.

This open jab at Hell Valley was an obvious mockery to them losing two
great generals. First the demise of You Guiqi, and second, the crippling
of 5th elder, Diamondback Ape.

Hell Valley’s losses were tremendous, falling dreadfully short in power
compared to Veiled Dragon Pavilion.

You Wanshan’s face contorted in rage and stomped forward, his power
threatening to break out as he spat, “Long Yifey, come and see for
yourself if Hell Valley is still the same or not.”

“Humph, you think the likes of you scare me?”

Snorting, Long Yifey’s eyes were sharp, letting his power ooze out. The
two peak Profound Heaven experts’ auras clashed, putting pressure on the
two Profound Heaven experts belonging to Regent Estate into retreating.

Even though Regent Estate was crowned as the strongest house, Long Yifey
and You Wanshan were not to be taken lightly either.

Few present could push back these two elders, even in the Regent Estate.

The two sides bared their fangs, needing one last push to blow
everything up in smoke. Leng Wuchang coughed, “Gentlemen, please, this
is Regent Estate!”

Those simple words were as if spoken by a god as it shook the hearts of
the two and their aura vanishing.

They proceeded to instantly bow in apology, “Please show leniency, Sir
Leng.”

“It’s fine. Just remember that we are in Regent Estate and you are our
guests. You will make it difficult for me if you start fighting here.
Please take it elsewhere if you want to sort your differences. That’s
all I’m asking.”

Leng Wuchang’s face was as blank as ever, but the words were chilling to
the bone. His eyes even contained a hint of reprimand when looking at
them. Despite the anger welling in the two, they could only let it
simmer.

He had the monster that was Regent Estate behind him, someone none of
the six houses wanted to make an enemy of.

“Ha-ha-ha, this place sure is lively. Valley Lord You, Pavilion Lord
Long, it’s been ages!”

A laughter broke out, followed by three towering figures in green. Their
leader was a wizen old man with silver-haired while the other two were
his elders. One was red-haired and the other violet, yet, each one of
them had an eerie hint of green in their eyes.

“Hall Lord Yan Bogong?” Squinting, You Wanshan mocked them, “You seem to
be quite springy, for someone who had his best alchemist slaughtered in
cold blood.”

“Ha-ha-ha, Valley Lord You, there’s no need to provoke me!”

Yan Bogong smiled, “Pill King Hall is different from you. You always go
on a murder spree every day, with every one of your elders a mighty
general – my condolences for the loss by the way. While we at the Pill
King Hall pursue alchemy above all else. Only the best alchemist is
worthy of the Vicious Pill King title. Even if we were robbed of our
precious alchemist, we still have many more that can fit the role as
well. Just as we have many 7th grade alchemists like Yan Song. Since
they have always been in his shadow for so long, they must be letting it
all out in laughter now.”

“In short, we do not lack alchemists. Our next Vicious Pill King will
achieve just as his predecessor had, taking the title of the best
alchemist in Tianyu.”

Yan Bogong stood proud before the two, while You Wanshan cursed
silently, “A cold and cruel hell is a more fitting place for you!”

Long Yifey snorted, “Hall Lord Yan seems to be quite confident. I heard
that in the Hundred Pill Meeting held by Drifting Flowers Edifice,
before Vicious Pill King’s untimely demise, he fell utterly short to the
more skilled Zhuo Fan. Do tell, how is the best alchemist in Tianyu one
of yours now, hmm? I certainly don’t see it.”

For the first time since he came, Yan Bogong’s face took a darker tone,
his eyes flashing with bloodthirst, “Humph, and if Zhuo Fan dies? The
dead can’t compete with Pill King Hall in taking the best alchemist
title.”

“What? Zhuo Fan? Where is that devil?”

A sudden bark rang everyone’s ears. It followed with the arrival of
three figures in blue. A middle-aged man with delicate features walked
to Leng Wuchang, “Sir Leng, hasn’t Zhuo Fan been dealt with yet?”

Leng Wuchang frowned.

Merry Woods was the dumbest ally no one would ever want. [Could you
speak any louder? I don’t think everyone heard you clearly.]

Too little too late. Long Yifey could already guess as his eyes glanced
at the two.

Leng Wuchang coughed, “House Lord Lin, please mind yourself. We are all
here to strategize on how to rid the world of that devil.”

“Oh, Lin Rufeng, why do I get the feeling you already began to act?” Lin
Rufeng’s eyes searched for a clue, a tick, anything.

Lin Rufeng nodded without a care, “Damn right. That punk killed our 6th
elder. How can we not retaliate? This time, we sent two Profound Heaven
experts…”

“House Lord Lin, Zhuo Fan is most cunning. It is not appropriate for
Merry Woods to act alone. Let us all work together on this after the
Seven Houses Gathering.” Leng Wuchang intervened before Lin Rufeng’s
loose tongue could do even more damage.

Lin Rufeng was startled, [What do you mean alone? Weren’t you in it as
well?]

But Leng Wuchang’s deadly glare shut him up before he could open his
beak.

However, Long Yifey could already guess what happened. [Regent Estate
has been on the move even before the Seven Houses Gathering. And they
excluded Veiled Dragon Pavilion it seems.]

It was a clear indication that Regent Estate crossed Veiled Dragon
Pavilion from their ally list.

[This spells trouble. If the Regent Estate goal is to rule all seven
houses, they are sure to make an example out of Veiled Dragon Pavilion
by eliminating us.]

Long Yifey secretly sighed. [I can only pray for Zhuo Fan’s safety, that
he will assist us once he rises to power. You must stay alive at all
costs!]

“Ha-ha-ha, it’s been a long time since it’s been so bustling here. It
must’ve been what, a century since our last gathering?”

A sudden chuckle followed a scholarly middle-aged man with a long beard
joining them with two elders behind. And one of them was Sword Marquise
Abode’s 8th elder, Jian Suifeng.

Jian Suifeng and Long Jiu’s eyes met and they nodded at each other.

In Drifting Flowers City, Zhuo Fan pulled the strings in getting Sword
Marquise Abode and Veiled Dragon Pavilion secretly more acquainted. Long
Yifey’s eyes shined at the newcomer, finally meeting an ally, and
laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Abode Lord Sky Breaking Xie Xiaofeng, we meet at
last!”

“Pavilion Lord Soaring Dragon Long Yifey, I’ve been looking forward to
seeing you as well.” Xie Xiaofeng cupped his hands, laughing together
for a reason only they knew.

These two were house lords yet, they have never once met before but
since they were allies now, they saw each other in a better light.

Leng Wuchang’s brows trembled.

“The seven houses are almost all here. But in light of Drifting Flowers
Edifice’s unfortunate disaster that demon caused, I believe they have
their hands tied and can’t join us. Let us…”

“Who said Drifting Flowers Edifice’s hands are tied?”

A clear and powerful voice cut Leng Wuchang’s speech short. Then a bang
echoed as a golden staff with a dragon head smashed the ground.

The sight of her caused the others to widen their eyes, even Leng
Wuchang.

[The old hag still lives…]
