Chapter 193 - Vicious Pill King’s Reemergence

Chapter 193, Vicious Pill King’s Reemergence

Zhuo Fan easily picked on the three’s thoughts and jeered, “You should
all lighten up and be thankful that all of you are unworthy of me ending
you personally. Not with your meager strength. The one all of you shall
have the honor of facing is our Pill House Elder!”

Zhuo Fan patted the elder’s shoulder, “Elder Yan, they’re all yours!”

“Ha-ha-ha, don’t worry Steward Zhuo, these old goats are nobodies. I’m
more than enough for them!” Yan Song laughed, bringing out the old
Vicious Pill King’s haughty demeanor back out.

Zhuo Fan nodded and chuckled before leaving.

The three elders’ faces were pitch black. As the saying went, ‘death
before dishonor’.

Even though they were all far beneath Zhuo Fan’s match, his utter
disregard of them had their minds filled with nothing but rage.

By the way, who was this cocky uncle Zhuo Fan left them with? [We don’t
know what hole you crawl out of, nor do we care, but who do you think
you are to talk to us like that? Zhuo Fan?]

The three stared daggers at Yan Song. The latter was quite relaxed and
confident.

“Old coot, state your name. I do not kill without knowing my opponent’s
name!” You Laoliu coldly stated. The other two watched Yan Song with the
same desire, to rip him apart.

Grinning, Yan Song’s eyes glinted evilly, “Humph, I’m afraid of making
you wet your pants if I do!”

“Oh? Do enlighten us please as to what other circus clown the third rate
Luo clan has besides your freak, Zhuo Fan. Ha-ha-ha… “

The three’s laughter dripped sarcasm.

Squinting, Yan Song’s mouth curled in pride, “Then unclog your ears and
prepare to be amazed. I am Yan Song!”

[What?!]

The three were dumbstruck, with bulging eyes and everything. Especially
Pill King Hall’s Yan Zhenglan. His eyes were as big as saucers.

They all knew Yan Song fell at the hands of Zhuo Fan in the chaos of
Drifting Flowers City. How the hell did he end up here, and as Luo
clan’s Pill House Elder no less?

When Yan Zhenglan and Lin Rufeng came from their stupor, they looked at
Yan Zhenglan. He was the only one here who was most familiar with Yan
Song, being from the same house and all.

He should spot immediately if that man was the real Vicious Pill King.

After a long and hard scrutiny, Yan Zhenglan gasped, “Vicious Pill King,
Elder Yan Song! It’s really you!”

You Laoliu’s heart trembled and his face grew solemn.

[No wonder this geezer mocked us.] While he was known as the Vicious
Pill King, they were truly and utterly titleless.

“Why, Yan Song? Why did you betray Pill King Hall!?” Yan Zhenglan
shouted.

Yan Song had only mockery for him, “Vicious Pill King had followed the
natural course and died in Drifting Flowers City from Zhuo Fan. And from
his death, Yan Song was reborn. Tell me, where’s the betrayal? Besides,
with me out of the picture, isn’t the Vicious Pill King title up for
grabs? Humph, I’m not naive. Don’t tell me the Pill King Hall didn’t
break out in celebration once they heard of my death.”

Yan Zhenglan stammered in silence.

From his reaction, the others knew Yan Song told the truth. No wonder he
betrayed Pill King Hall, he had nothing holding him there, no relation
to speak of.

Scratching their nose, the elders’ eyes exposed a fierce light.

With everything clear, any argument from them would do nothing in
bringing Yan Song back. In that case, they had to go through Yan Song if
they wanted to clear the array.

But Yan Song’s old title still gripped their hearts in fear.

“Old Yan is an expert in poisons. It is my domain as well. I will hold
him, while you two flank him from the sides. We have to end this
swiftly. It will be hard to get to him once he hides behind his Rainbow
Cloud Palm!”

Yan Zhenglan signaled the two as he whispered. The two nodded.

Yan Zhenglan then shot like an arrow for Yan Song with an outstretched
palm.

A python made of purple miasma came out and threatened to bite Yan Song.

“High spirit ranked martial art, Shifting Cloud Palm!”

His mouth tracing a cold smile, Yan Zhenglan mocked, “Humph, Yan
Zhenglan, an inept like you who can’t use the Rainbow Cloud Palm dares
to play with poison around me?”

Seven colored veils of mist flew from Yan Song’s palms like dragons,
forming a rainbow storm crushing the purple python and rushing for Yan
Zhenglan.

“Humph, now, this is Pill King Hall’s real skill, profound ranked
martial art, Rainbow Cloud Palm!”

Yan Zhenglan focus sharpened and forehead started to ooze cold sweat.
However, he was in no rush because he knew that he was going to be
sacrificing himself.

Suddenly, You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng appeared left and right of Yan Song.
Yan Zhenglan laughed, “Yan Song, you’re done for! You’re exposed before
you hide in the Rainbow Cloud Palm’s poisonous mist. I may not train in
your martial art, but I know it like the back of my hand. And you will
suffer dearly for it!”

You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng had vicious grins, thinking this win was in
the bag.

When the grand Vicious Pill King fall under their attacks, who would
anyone dare call them without a title in the future?

Although, Yan Song’s face didn’t seem particularly worried. As the two’s
palms inched closer, he made a hand sign and two dragon roars echoed
out!

Suddenly, two groans came as two dragon tails jumped from the earth and
sent the two men barreling. You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng were still trying
to make sense of everything. They were just inches from striking down
Yan Song when out of the blue, their bodies were flung about like
garbage.

Just as they smacked the ground two hundred meters out, the rainbow
storm engulfed Yan Zhenglan.

Boom!

Yan Zhenglan flew a full hundred meters as he spat black blood. His body
was now filled with the deadly poisons of the Rainbow Cloud Palm.

You Laoliu and Lin Rufeng crawled back to their feet. They felt weary
for some odd reason and looked down in shock. The green vestige on their
body was evidence of poisoning.

“How?” The three roared at the same time.

Yan Song snickered with an evil glint in his eye, “Yan Zhenglan, you
aren’t useful even as bait! You take me for a sitting duck if I’m not
hiding in the Rainbow Cloud Palm mist? He-he-he, did you forget where we
are? This here is a 5th-grade array, the Poison Dragon Array that I am
able to control! Here, I can create all the poison mist I want. Your
plan failed the moment you thought it out!”

Yan Song made another sign.

Roar!

Seven dragon roars were heard as seven hundred-meter-long dragons of
different colors came from beneath his feet. Their maws were open and
the poisonous stench was easily felt coming from their fangs.

If not crushed to death in their grip first, the poison would rip them
apart from the inside out!

The three cried in alarm.

Yan Song alone was bad enough with his nefarious poison, but now, with
this 5th-grade array, he was invincible.

Not even a Radiant Stage expert could escape him, least of all them!

The three’s hearts sank as despair set in.

Yan Song cackled like mad, just as he did back in the Drifting Flowers
City. That rampant Vicious Pill King was back.

Yan Song’s ego even grew, if that was possible. Because he had the
5th-grade array, he was god. [Not even a Radiant Stage expert can take
me on! Ha-ha-ha…]

…

In another place, Sun clan’s father and daughter along with Cai clan’s
father and son finally came to Blackwind Mountain. Since flying was not
an option, they had to rely on their tiny legs to run themselves into
exhaustion.

But as they gazed upon the four light pillars, hope glimmered in their
eyes.

“Cough, cough, congratulations 6th elder for your complete success!” Sun
Clan Head panted then cupped his hands and bent his wais ninety degrees
down angle.

Sun Yufei felt awkward, “Father, there’s no one here. What are you
doing?”

“Ha-ha-ha, foolish girl, the elders are cleaning up the Luo clan and
would surely gain many contributions for this. As those experts move
fast, I fear that my nerves may get to me when the time comes to
congratulate them and my manners would slip. It’s best I practice my
performance for when it counts!”

Sun Clan Head smiled, “Yufei, let’s do it together for a brighter
future!”

Sun Yufei’s mouth twisted in revulsion.

“Congratulations, Elder Li, in returning victorious!”

Suddenly, Cai Rong bowed as well as he mocked Sun Clan Head, “If you
want a sponsor, you have to think big. Elder Li is a Regent Estate
Venerable. Everything will be ours once we earn his favor!”

“He-he-he, Xiaoting, practice along!” Cai Rong patted Cai Xiaoting’s
shoulder. A chip of the ol’ block, Cai Xiaoting’s gesture was spot on
like his father’s. Sun Yufei felt more disgusted than ever.

Sun Clan Head sneered, “Cai Clan Head, you sure are ignorant! But what
can you expect when you haven’t been in touch with the seven houses and
know nothing about them. A Venerable may be strong, but they ignore
house affairs. Only elders hold the true power in a house.

“Your ass-kissing has more worth directed at an elder. They are the ones
who can make you a vassal clan!” Sun Clan Head spoke with immense pride.

Cai Rong scowled and smoothened his beard as he sank in his thoughts.

Then, a lazy voice reached them, “Ass-kissing must be done in style. One
wrong kiss and you’ll get the gallows! I mean, won’t you offend the
Venerables if you only do it to elders? And if you flatter the
Venerables, won’t the elders feel irritated? What a dilemma. Why not
both? You may get nothing, but at least you’ll keep your heads!”

“Good point!”

Clan Head and Sun Clan Head looked at each other then bobbed their
heads. Only then they reacted, [Who said that?] And turned to look.

It was better not knowing. They cried out with such fear, one may think
they saw a ghost, “Z-Z-Zhuo Fan, why are you here…”

Chapter 194 - Total Victory

Chapter 194, Total Victory

Who knew when Zhuo Fan got there? Surely not them. But his seamless
interjection in their discussion unnerved them all.

“Ha-ha-ha, lighten up. I’m the same as you, I came here to welcome
guests!” Zhuo Fan waved the awkwardness away with a smile.

Though his smile looked dreadfully cold to the rest.

It was practically common knowledge four houses, Regent Estate included,
came here explicitly for Zhuo Fan’s head. Yet, the four Venerables and
the three elders were inside trying to break the arrays. All while he
was standing just outside for the heck of it.

The Sun and Cai people looked at him, feeling his toying with the seven
houses was worthy of applause.

Swallowing dryly, Cai Rong ventured a nervous reply, “Z-Zhuo Fan, I have
always had the Luo clan’s benefit in mind in all my actions. Hear me out
please, and leave quickly. If the Venerables come out, you won’t stand a
chance!”

“Oh, I never knew Elder Cai would, after betraying the Luo clan, care so
much for me. Ha-ha-ha, I’m touched!” Zhuo Fan raised a mocking eyebrow.

Cai Rong reddened, feeling the condescending tone, but he didn’t snap
back. His reply was one of genuine concern, “Zhuo Fan, Luo clan’s
misfortune has come because of you. Why did you come back? I am
concerned for your wellbeing. Don’t let your talent go to waste. Quickly
escape!”

Cai Rong was very concerned but still urged Zhuo Fan to leave.

Even when facing the Demon Archon, who was such a thorn in the seven
houses’ side, this third rate clan’s head was filled with uncertainty.
Or he’d long since captured Zhuo Fan and handed him over.

The Sun Clan Head was thinking along the same lines.

But since youths were rash as usual, their kids couldn’t see this logic.
Cai Xiaoting stood with his chest out as he shouted, “Dad, he’s only a
5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator. Why waste time and just go deal
with him alongside Uncle Sun? Get his head and the seven houses will
hail us as heroes, ha-ha-ha…”

“Quiet, fool! You know nothing!” Cai Rong glared at his son.

Sun Clan Head sneered as well. He didn’t know what Zhuo Fan did to get
on the seven houses’ bad side but the old fox in him knew something was
up.

It was best to stand down until all was made clear, lest he wanted an
untimely death.

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, “Oh? Taking my head you say. That’s a good
plan!”

“No no no, that was never our intention!”

Gesticulating like mad, Cai Rong was on pins and needles, “Xiaoting is a
foolish child. I promise you, we aren’t your enemies. Please leave
quickly. Leave before the Venerables are back!”

“Ha-ha-ha, them coming back?”

Zhuo Fan’s tone was unbridled, “I set those arrays and know them like
the back of my hand. If even one man escapes, my head…”

Bam!

With a loud noise, a figure flew from Poison Dragon Array, so poisoned
that his body had seven colors on him. His mouth was tight yet black
blood kept flowing from his lips, ears, and nose.

It was hard to figure out who he was, but Cai Rong knew as he cried,
“Pill King Hall’s Elder Yan!”

Zhuo Fan’s cheek twitched. He just got into his role of showing off and
then, this guy had to come out just to spite him.

Fuming mad, he stepped right before Yan Zhenglan.

The fearful Elder Yan was only thinking of escaping when he found
someone just ahead. But then dread set in when he saw his face,
“Z-Z-Zhuo Fan?”

“How did you get here?” Zhuo Fan’s mouth trembled, but anyone could feel
the coldness in his voice, the rage boiling deep within.

Yan Zhenglan shivered, “I-I took advantage of Yan Song not paying
attention…”

“It would’ve been so much better if you died inside. Now, your corpse’s
going to be in pieces!”

Sighing, Zhuo Fan’s Lightning Wings crackled and shifted into sickles.

Yan Zhenglan’s shock was still prevalent on his face as he fell in six
pieces, soaking the ground in blood.

Sss~

Gasping, the others were shocked out of their minds.

Now, they knew why the seven houses wanted to end Zhuo Fan so
desperately. A Profound Heaven expert fell apart instantly thanks to
Zhuo Fan’s skill.

Even wounded, how could a Bone Tempering cultivator kill a Profound
Heaven expert?

Cai Xiaoting felt weak in the knees, tumbling down. He hated himself for
those brash words he spoke just now. Telling his dad to deal with this
freak was the same as sending him to an early grave!

Cai Rong and Sun Clan Head were soaked in sweat.

At least, these old foxes had their wits about them from the start and
weren’t rash. If they had been anything else, their meat pile would soon
be joining the elder’s on the ground.

Whoosh!

Flashing before them, Zhuo Fan looked quite awkward, “Uh, just forget
the last part. Alright?”

“Yep, you bet. Don’t know what you’re talking about Steward Zhuo.
Ha-ha-ha…”

“Yeah, my ears must be playing tricks on me!”

The four of them shook their heads till they were dizzy. Zhuo Fan
smiled.

With a second sound, another figure popped out of Poison Dragon Array,
but this time, it was Vicious Pill King. He took in the pieces of Yan
Zhenglan, and the cold faced Zhuo Fan, catching the gist of it all.

Scratching his head, Yan Song giggled, “Thanks, Steward Zhuo for helping
me get rid of that one. It would’ve been much harder for me alone!”

“Elder Yan, you let one escape with your skill?” Zhuo Fan smiled coldly.

Yan Song’s scalp felt numb, “Steward Zhuo, I was careless. He was also
an alchemist, so…”

“Elder Yan, do you have any idea what I was just about to promise these
guys? A head… ha-ha-ha. So tell me, whose head is it going to be?”
Ignoring his words, Zhuo Fan’s cold glare stared him down.

Shivering, Yan Song knew this time, it was serious.

Steward Zhuo was flaunting before these guys but then, his show deflated
like a balloon, and so did his prestige. Of course he’d be pissed.

Swallowing dryly, Yan Song had a cruel smile for them, “Steward Zhuo,
that’s easy! Isn’t it just some heads? Aren’t there four heads lining up
for the taking?”

“Good point. With them dead, no one will know about your blunder!”

“Yep, yep…” Yan Song smiled and nodded.

Cai Rong’s group was scared out of their wits. They kneeled and begged
forgiveness. While also cursing them inside, [What kind of damn
unreasonable freaks are these people?]

What they didn’t know was this vicious demon wouldn’t have made a name
for himself if he was reasonable.

Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan waved, “Forget it. Don’t scare these shrimps.
Elder Yan, what of the other two?”

“Dead!” Yan Song was solemn.

Nodding, Zhuo Fan turned to the four, “Alright, take these four in. I
want to leave them for that snot-nosed brat to handle. And teach him how
to be a Clan Head!”

“Understood!”

Vicious Pill King pointed in finger at them and the four were chained,
soon flying behind him as he entered Poison Dragon Array.

Hum~

A ripple spread and the Blackflame Array in the South opened to reveal
Luo Yunchang and the rest. Li Jingtian was leisurely walking behind
them.

Zhuo Fan eased a breath seeing everyone safe. The battle was now over.

“Big bro Zhuo!”

Luo Yunhai cried and skipped over for a fierce hug. His tears soaking
Zhuo Fan’s clothes.

Zhuo Fan noded with a smile, feeling warm and fuzzy inside.

Looking up, he found Lei Yuntian and Captain Pang looking at him with
fervent gazes. The two nodded, and Zhuo Fan laughed, “Old Pang, I’m
relieved to see you still kicking!”

Captain Pang knew what he meant and laughed as well, “Steward Zhuo, if I
am to die, I will do it fighting for the Luo clan. Never will I waste
away in training!”

Then Zhuo Fan turned to Lei Yuting with a smile, “Miss Lei, how are the
people I asked you to train?”

Lei Yuting huffed and gave him a sound slap in return.

Zhuo Fan was stunned. [What did I say?]

But then he saw her teary eyes.

“Damn you, bastard! You finally came back and instead of asking if I was
fine you went straight to business?” Lei Yuting wailed.

Zhuo Fan blinked, [That does make a lot of sense.] So he smiled,
“Ha-ha-ha, Miss Lei, how have you been?”

Bam!

Then another slap graced his face. Zhuo Fan was now floored. [What the
hell? I asked how you are so what’s the problem? You want me to pay
respects to your whole family?]

Lei Yuting glared instead, “Too little, too late!”

Reeling from the blow, Zhuo Fan was almost coughing blood at this point.
[This girl’s too fickle I can’t make sense of her heart!]

The others smiled at his misfortune. Li Jingtian joined them, never
having seen the cunning Steward Zhuo so soft hearted.

Shaking his head with a sigh, Zhuo Fan really couldn’t get her. [It’s
best I don’t talk at all.]

When they separated, Zhuo Fan looked to see Luo Yunchang fumbling
towards him with a pale face.

Zhuo Fan frowned, “Young miss, are you hurt?”

Luo Yunchang only locked eyes with him, as if to see straight through
his heart. Ice cold hands touched his face, as her eyes stared at him
with emotion, “Zhuo Fan, welcome home!”

Luo Yunchang’s eyes closed and collapsed in his arms.

“Young miss!” The others were worried.

Zhuo Fan stood there in a daze.

The Luo clan was considered his clan since rebirth. But he never once
saw it as his home. When Luo Yunchang said those words, they struck a
chord in his thawing heart…

Chapter 195 - Mean Steward

Chapter 195, Mean Steward

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

The warm glow of the morning sun spilled through the window and into the
pink room. Luo Yunchang’s eyes trembled open but the glaring sun’s rays
made her squint.

“Young miss Luo, are you awake?”

Luo Yunchang turned to see Lei Yuting’s servant, Xiao Cui. She was
happily bringing in piping hot stew.

Luo Yunchang weakly got up, as Xiao Cui placed the bowl on a nearby
table.

Luo Yunchang nodded gratefully for her help, “Xiao Cui, where’s sister
Lei?”

“Miss and Steward Zhuo are in a meeting! She told me to watch over you.
She also had me make this stew for you…”

“Zhuo Fan…”

She didn’t seem to have heard her as Luo Yunchang shivered having
recalled something. She then broke out in a wide smile, “Yeah, he’s
back. I’m going to see him!”

“Slow down, young miss Luo. You’re still very much weakened. Please have
this stew first. Steward Zhuo isn’t running anywhere.”

“I don’t care. I want to see him!”

Luo Yunchang was so excited all the fatigue left her as she jumped out
of bed. Xiao Cui sighed, left with following after her out of worry.

The two soon arrived before Blackwind Mountain’s hall, hearing Zhuo
Fan’s familiar voice from within.

“Elder Lei, how is your cultivation?” Zhuo Fan asked as he browsed the
books.

Lei Yuntian replied in disappointment, “I am muddled, and have not
advanced one layer in two years. But I feel I will break through soon…”

“Muddled indeed!”

Zhuo Fan’s cold tone cut his frail tone short. But his eyes were still
checking the reports, “Thought it’s not your fault. It is hard for
someone as old as you to advance.”

Lei Yuntian forced an embarrassed smile. [Steward Zhuo is so blunt, not
sparing any feelings.]

Lei Yuting saw her godfather put on the spot and slapped the table in
anger, “Zhuo Fan, where are you going with this? While you were gone for
the last two years, we had to look after the Luo clan. And now that
you’re back, the first thing you do is point fingers.”

“And you!”

Zhuo Fan threw a book before her as he spoke coldly, “When I came back
yesterday you said I cut straight to business instead of greeting you.
That I was cold! So I spent all day catching up with what you have been
doing over the years. But today, I need to resume my role as the
steward!”

Snapping his eyes on her, Zhuo Fan pointed at the book, “I told you to
form a shadow corp before leaving to become our hidden ace as well as
our eyes and ears in Tianyu. Why is it that all you managed to contact
are some small towns and some villages? You didn’t place anyone in the
capital, not to mention the seven houses’ cities!”

“Humph, you think it’s that easy?” Huffed Lei Yuting, “Ten times I’ve
sent people into Hell Valley’s city, but they were seized every time.
Thankfully, they were loyal to us and died rather than say anything. Or
Hell Valley would’ve been upon us a year ago!”

“Oh, did you not see how it’s done when I got into Drifting Flowers
City?” Zhuo Fan raised a taunting eyebrow.

Lei Yuting spat through gnashed teeth, “Don’t you even start. Just when
I was close to forgetting. Steward Zhuo had gone out for the glory of
the clan, but never forgot to spare certain someone his feelings, quite
carefree I might add! If my men had even half your skills, they would
have infiltrated the whole empire by now, even the palace.”

“Uh, whatever you may think, I did it all for the clan!” Zhuo Fan
scratched his nose.

Captain Pang grinned, adding his two cents to smooth things over,
“Ha-ha-ha, young miss Lei misunderstands. Brother Zhuo’s thinking is
unfathomable. I’m sure Brother Zhuo had a good reason for letting those
rumors appear. Look, didn’t he bring back two experts like he promised?”

“And you, Old Pang!”

Zhuo Fan butted in before Lei Yuting could nag some more.

Captain Pang was startled, and swallowed drily, feeling cold sweat down
his spine. Now it was his turn it seemed. None of them knew the refined
Zhuo Fan, who planned to put the Luo clan back on its feet, would be so
mean.

Because Captain Pang cultivated the Wraith Art, the vibe coming from him
was that of a fiend. But before Zhuo Fan, he was nothing more than a
mouse in front of a cat.

Although the two were like brothers, Captain Pang still shivered
whenever he saw Zhuo Fan acting high and mighty. [Who knows what fault
this kid will find now?]

“Uh, brother, I…”

“Done awesome!” Out of all expectations, Zhuo Fan beamed. He was happy
as well, while the rest, sullen. [What did Captain Pang do that is so
awesome?]

[Our efforts aren’t lower than his!]

Zhuo Fan elaborated with a grin, “When I gave you the Wraith Art I
didn’t even think you’d survive. You not only survived but even exceeded
my expectations.”

[Then why the hell did you give it to me then?]

Captain Pang’s face twitched, not knowing if he should be glad or
enraged. [You gave it to me thinking I’d die?]

Knowing what he was thinking, Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, “Ha-ha-ha,
don’t you worry now. You are reborn as one of Luo clan’s pillars!”

Captain Pang nodded solemnly. Defending the Luo clan had been his aim
all along…

Having talked with his men, Zhuo Fan looked at the small figure at the
side.

The bored Luo Yunhai noticed his eyes and shivered. He felt danger in
his gaze, as if a viper was out to get him.

“He-he-he, big bro Zhuo, I’m still a child. Cut me some slack!” Luo
Yunhai opened his big naive eyes like an oversized kitten.

Too bad this trick didn’t fly with a Demon like Zhuo Fan.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan looked like a ghost from the Underworld, “You rotten
brat, how’s your cultivation?”

[Why ask when you already know?]

Luo Yunhai felt a shiver down his spine, “Uh, big bro Zhuo, I’m in the
9th layer of Foundation Establishment. On the verge of breaking
through!”

He also gave Captain Pang a sign, who added, “Steward Zhuo, young master
Yunhai has only been cultivating for two years. To reach such a level is
a feat worthy of a genius!”

“Oh, not bad indeed. How many hours a day did you cultivate?” Zhuo Fan
nodded with a smile everpresent.

Luo Yunhai’s eyes darted around then raised six fingers, “Six hours!”

Captain Pang was startled, then nodded, “That’s right, young master
Yunhai cultivated in earnest!”

“Good, then from now on you’ll do it for 20 hours a day.” Zhuo Fan’s
smile was wide as ever, causing the others to gasp.

Wouldn’t the poor kid die of exhaustion training for so long?

Luo Yunhai was dumbstruck. He immediately shouted his complaints, “Big
bro Zhuo, I’ll die!”

“Hardly. By feeding you pills each day, death will long be forgotten!
Plus, as the days pass you’ll get used to it!” Zhuo Fan laughed.

He recalled how his master did the same for him.

His lower lip trembling, Luo Yunhai was on the verge of tears, “But that
would leave me with only four hours to rest. What about playing?”

“Who told you you have four hours to rest?”

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan added, “Two hours is enough, while the rest
is for reading books! How are you going to be a Clan Head if you’re
stacked in all the right places except in the head?”

Luo Yunhai’s eyes rolled into his skull and slumped in his chair.

The others sighed secretly. Zhuo Fan wasn’t mean to just them but even
to children. No wonder he was called Demon Archon in the outside world.

Vicious Pill King and Li Jingtian were staying quiet, but hearing Zhuo
Fan’s verdict, even they shivered.

Then they looked at Luo Yunhai with all their sympathy. [Is it a
blessing, or a disaster? No one can tell.]

The cruel steward set his eyes on the poor child. He was dead set on
making him the Luo clan’s next in line. Yet, his future wasn’t as
glorious as any true future clan head, but one of a miserable childhood.

But with Zhuo Fan’s wicked planning and the kid’s talent, his future was
bound to be limitless.

This could be counted as his only blessing.

After a few more words, Zhuo Fan told them to withdraw, leaving only
Vicious Pill King and Li Jingtian behind. As for Luo Yunhai, he walked
out like a zombie, feeling like the whole world abandoned him.

Such a young child was showing such despair.

Zhuo Fan ignored him as he poured himself some tea, “Young miss, since
you’re already here, you might as well come in …”

Chapter 196 - The Four Tigers of Tianyu

Chapter 196, The Four Tigers of Tianyu

With graceful steps, Luo Yunchang gestured Xiao Cui to stay as she
entered alone. Her softened gaze had been on Zhuo Fan all this time.

Zhuo Fan smiled as he rose, “Young miss, are you better?”

Luo Yunchang didn’t speak, only nodded slightly.

Zhuo Fan took a deep breath out of awkwardness. He gestured to the other
two and smiled, “Ha-ha-ha, let me introduce you Elder Yan Song. He will
be Luo clan’s Pill House Elder. The other is Elder Li Jingtian, the
elder in charge of the arrays. As long as he operates the 5th-grade
arrays, no one can break through them!”

Blinking, Luo Yunchang now realized there were two more people there and
rushed to greet them.

The elders returned her greeting as well.

And yet, Li Jingtian still had pride in his eyes, while Vicious Pill
King was downcast.

Zhuo Fan’s face turned solemn, “Are you perhaps not satisfied?”

Vicious Pill King was the one who replied, “Steward Zhuo, the Luo clan
you describe is not at all as we’ve seen! We just found out that the Luo
clan has no elders and that is only around a second rate clan…” Vicious
Pill King sighed.

What he thought to be a titan in hiding, stronger than the seven houses
was more along the lines of a damn frickin’ third rate clan!

Li Jingtian sighed as well. He could feel the loyalty of this clan, but
the reality failed to rise to his expectation, by a huge margin.

Zhuo Fan glared at them, “I never said anything about the Luo clan’s
extent when I invited you in. You accepted my invitation of your own
free will…”

“But Steward Zhuo, you said the Luo clan is the strongest clan in
Tianyu…”

“Are you saying it’s my fault?” Zhuo Fan cut Vicious Pill King off and
scared him with his sudden reply.

Luo Yunchang bowed again, “Elder Yan, Elder Li, first of all, I would
like to express my deepest gratitude for joining the Luo clan. I know we
are a small clan, unfit of your greatness, but please believe me, With
Steward Zhuo, and you, the Luo clan will become better and stronger. We,
the Luo clan will not disappoint you. If you still want to leave, I will
not stop you…”

Luo Yunchang’s heartfelt words touched the two.

“You two old coots better goddamn suck it up!”

Then came Zhuo Fan’s cold tone. While Luo Yunchang’s words were that of
a fairy, Zhuo Fan’s were that of a demon wanting to feast on their
flesh.

“You may dislike how weak the Luo clan is, but I promise you, in five
years, I will make the Luo clan rise to the level of the seven houses.
And in ten years, It will exceed them! If you want to leave, hump.
Getting into the Luo clan is easy, but getting out will be done through
the mud, cold and very much dead!”

Shuddering, the elders could feel Zhuo Fan’s bloodthirst. Just looking
at him, they knew he wasn’t kidding.

If they tested Demon Archon’s anger, today may very well be their
funeral.

Sweating, Li Jingtian and Vicious Pill King dropped to one knee, “Young
miss, Steward Zhuo, we were only joking. Don’t take it to heart.”

Luo Yunchang was shocked. She may be the young miss but how could she
receive such gestures from the elders? Not to mention, one was in the
Profound Heaven Stage and the other in the Radiant Stage.

She rushed to get them up, “Please rise elders, this isn’t proper!”

But Luo Yunchang could do nothing if they refused.

Sneaking a glance at Zhuo Fan, they noticed his ever stone-cold face and
lowered their heads. He may be quite courteous to them usually, but when
it came to such principles, he was dead serious.

If they couldn’t appease Zhuo Fan’s anger, their lives were forfeited
today.

Luo Yunchang turned to Zhuo Fan and said, “Zhuo Fan, you…”

Squinting, Zhuo Fan spoke, “I will let this matter rest here on account
of young miss. But I better not hear of this again. Now, leave!”

“Thank you, Steward Zhuo. Thank you, young miss!”

Sighing, the two bowed again and ran outside. It seemed they had to get
much closer with this young miss of theirs.

She may be frail, but she could keep that steward in check. [Our very
lives depend on it!]

Luo Yunchang was left stunned at how quickly the two bolted. She had no
idea Zhuo Fan could control a Profound Heaven expert and a Radiant Stage
expert.

The two experts were like shy kids before Zhuo Fan.

What she didn’t know was that if she could control the Bloodworm as well
as he does, she’d receive the same treatment. Forget about whining, they
wouldn’t even make a peep!

Turning to Zhuo Fan, Luo Yunchang revealed a broad smile, “Zhuo Fan, why
do I feel you’re more amazing than two years ago? I almost can’t
recognize you. But weren’t you a bit harsh on them? Sister Lei and the
others worked hard all this time…”

“I know, and I am very pleased with their progress. They gave their all
and exceeded my expectations!” Zhuo Fan’s smile was no longer cruel.

Luo Yunchang was even more puzzled now, “Then why did you…”

“Ha-ha-ha, as leaders, one must mind both gratitude and show of power! I
know how grateful you must have been for their hard work, so when I came
back I showed them power! How else would they know who is the leader of
the Luo clan?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes were deep.

Luo Yunchang hesitated, “But they are family, going through thick and
thin alongside us. Must we be so hard on them?”

“People change with time. If your power does not change, then you must
be wary of everyone around you! Today, they may be your most loyal men,
and tomorrow, your worst enemies. Just like how the seven houses were
subjects to the empire at its founding, now they are a danger to it!”

Zhuo Fan grinned with cruelty. Luo Yunchang watched him long and
stammered, “Zhuo Fan, you’re truly frightening. Will there also be a day
when you’ll become our enemy?”

“Perhaps!” Zhuo Fan chuckled.

“I would rather die at your hand than see you as one!” Luo Yunchang’s
eyes flickered.

Zhuo Fan trembled and sighed, “Who can tell what the future holds?”

Silence swept the hall, bringing a morbid atmosphere with it.

It was now that Luo Yunhai rushed in tears to Luo Yunchang, “Sister,
that’s not important right now. Big bro Zhuo wants to kill me! Resting
for only two hours is impossible…”

Startled, Luo Yunchang recalled how her brother was the most hardworking
of them all, “Steward Zhuo, don’t you think twenty hours a day is a
bit…”

“You don’t have to say it, young miss, I am doing it for his own good. A
bit of sweat now will save a lot of bloodshed later! Or you can just
stop him from following the wishes of your father…”

“Yunhai, stop complaining and follow Steward Zhuo’s schedule!” Luo
Yunchang snapped at the child.

Luo Yunhai’s eyes rolled into his skull and passed out.

Before Zhuo Fan came, his life was still bearable. Now that he was here,
he entered hell.

Zhuo Fan shook his head…

Meanwhile, at the foot of Blackwind Mountain, four tall and stout
figures stood.

One was in a blue robe and cowl, with a twin mustache, and holding a
light sword.

Another wore a scholar crest and waved a golden fan. His eyes were so
calm as if even the world burning wouldn’t affect his tranquility.

The third man was brash and big, with fiery hair and eyes holding sparks
within. One look was enough to tell anyone he was a powder keg primed to
blow.

As for the last, he was unlike the first three. He was twice as broad as
a normal man. From his bulging muscles, one would instantly consider him
a body cultivator. Yet his narrow eyes were quite delicate. Standing
there, he looked no different than a firm mountain.

The four watched the four guarding arrays and their eyes shined in
shock.

“No wonder godfather sent us thousands of miles here to their rescue!
This place already houses an amazing figure!” The man in blue turned to
his side to ask, “What do you think of these arrays?”

With a snap, the second man opened his fan and spoke calmly, “The
intricacies of these arrays are hard to grasp. But as long as a Profound
Heaven expert or higher is in control of them, not even the four of us
can escape!”

“Blast it! Then we’ve traveled all this way for nothing? They clearly
have their defenses up!” The red-haired man shouted.

The man in blue berated, “Third brother, orders are orders. And they
were given by the Marshal himself. Whether this place is a volcano, or
an impenetrable fortress, we still have to go in. Have you forgotten the
taste of the Marshal’s cane when you entered a drunken rave last time?”

The red-haired man stammered but remained silent.

The man in blue nodded, then cupped his hands towards Blackwind Mountain
as he shouted, “The four generals under Marshal Dugu extend their
respects to Luo Clan Head!”

His lofty voice traveled for miles, straight into Zhuo Fan’s ear.

His ears piqued, Zhuo Fan’s eyebrow rose, “Why has War God Dugu, second
of the Four Pillars, sent his men all the way over here? Could it be…”

Chapter 197 - War God’s Advent

Chapter 197, War God’s Advent

“Young miss, take the kid to his training. I’ll go take a look!” Zhuo
Fan looked to Luo Yunchang.

She gave a nod then dragged Luo Yunhai out by the ear. The Marshall of
Tianyu may have come, and despite the ever-present shock, Zhuo Fan was
here to assuage all her worries.

Regardless of the magnitude of the coming storm, nothing could last long
in the face of Zhuo Fan’s meticulous planning. This belief had evolved
into blind faith in the man, a faith deep-rooted in the hearts of all
Luo clansmen.

Dragged away and through glistening eyes, Luo Yunhai’s last cry at Zhuo
Fan was, “Big bro Zhuo, you single-handedly ruined my life!”

“You twerp who hasn’t ever grown hair down there, what ruin?” Zhuo Fan
teased. He turned to look down Blackwind Mountain and took slow steps
downhill.

Hum~

With a ripple, the Poison Dragon Array’s miasma parted. Zhuo Fan walked
before the four as he sized each one of them, “I am Luo clan’s steward,
Zhuo Fan. And sirs…”

“Oh, we are the four generals under Marshal Dugu. Hearing of the Luo
clan’s peril, he ordered us to rescue you. Greetings, I am Dugu Feng!”
The man in blue cupped his hands.

The man with the fan did as well, “I am Dugu Lin!”

“Dugu Huo!” The redhead stout fellow rumbled a reply.

As for the last and the biggest man, “Dugu Shan!”

“Wind, forest, fire, mountain? The Four Tigers of Tianyu?” Zhuo Fan
cried as he started making calculations in his mind.

(Starreader: reference to four phrases from Sun Tzu’s The Art of War:
“as swift as the wind, as gentle as a forest, as fierce as fire, as
unshakable as a mountain.”)

He had heard his fair share of stories regarding the renowned Four
Pillars. Second of the Four Pillars, Dugu Zhantian, was married to his
military career. He had no children, but four godsons of great bravery
and power. Given their talent, they weren’t the least bit lacking to the
geniuses raised inside the seven houses. Perhaps even surpassing them.

The four had repeatedly rendered great military services that earned the
people’s gratitude in the form of the Four Tigers of Tianyu title.

Dugu Feng, the eldest, was swift as the wind and excelled in surprise
attacks – nicknamed Storm Tiger. Dugu Lin, the second, was as gentle as
a forest, knowing the art of war by heart. For his calmness of mind, he
was known as Crouching Forest Tiger. Dugu Huo, the third, burned like
fire, and was just as blazing in temper as well. For his boldness, he
was known as Raging Tiger. Dugu Shan, the fourth, was as steadfast as a
mountain, hard as stone. Proficient in defense, he was known as Mountain
Tiger!

No endeavor the four had worked on ever failed. They were almost
matching the God of War in their renown.

Many times, the emperor expressed his desire to lift them to the ranks
of commanders, and joined Dugu Zhantian in becoming Tianyu’s Five
Marshals, only to refuse each time. They would rather stay as Marshal
Dugu’s tigers, rather than be alone as Tianyu Empire’s four lion kings!

They were always inseparable from Dugu Zhantian. If the four of them
arrived, then Dugu Zhantian…

Checking his surroundings, Zhuo Fan’s obvious thoughts were easily
noticed by Dugu Lin who tapped the fan in his palm, “Steward Zhuo,
there’s no need for you to look. We are the only ones here. Our orders
carried us thousands of miles to rescue you all. Marshal Dugu and his
forces are running a little late, I’m afraid.”

“Oh, so Marshal Dugu is gracing us with his presence!” Zhuo Fan nodded
and laughed, “I understand. Then I shall inform the young miss and young
master post haste. You may return!”

Zhuo Fan waved as he left. The four were startled, even shocked.

The four of them were hailed as the Four Tigers of Tianyu everywhere in
the empire, with even the seven houses bound to showing them some
respect. But here, in this backwater Luo clan, not only were they not
allowed entry, the door was slammed into their face. To top it all off,
he even said he’d inform someone.

Wasn’t this a little bit too absurd?

Rage had stirred in the hearts of the four. Dugu Huo, who had a
notoriously fiery temper, cursed on the spot, “What kind of steward are
you to act so unreasonably? We came all this way to help you yet not
only you did not show any appreciation, you even slam the door behind
you. That is no way to treat a guest!”

“Guest, you say?”

Zhuo Fan quirked an eyebrow, turning his head to give them a closer eye,
“You’re telling me you came to save us and I’m supposed to believe that?
We just had a hard battle on our hands not a couple a days ago, with
blood and bodies everywhere. Letting you in might drown the Luo clan in
flames!”

The four gasped. So the steward wasn’t slighting them, but was overly
cautious. That reason was enough to dampen their rage.

Dugu Feng cupped his hands again, “We are Marshal Dugu’s four generals.
He has always been a frank and open person and we are under strict
orders. We are not the enemy here. Are you perhaps doubting Marshal
Dugu’s integrity?”

“Marshal Dugu is a pillar of our empire, in charge of defense, which my
clan admires him greatly. Our young miss and young master burn incense
and pray every day for Marshal’s health, to keep our nation safe!”

Zhuo Fan cupped his hands at the heavens, shouting with zeal, just like
a true Dugu Zhantian fanboy. His action earned the nods of the four,
even approval points.

[It’s good that the Luo clan holds our godfather in such high regards.
It makes our trip worthwhile.]

Then, Zhuo Fan flipped his tune out of the blue. His face was cold, his
eyes accusingly, “And how am I to know you are the real Four Tigers of
Tianyu? Have you seen how many copycats have cropped up nowadays?”

“Please look over Marshal Dugu’s token!” Dugu Feng quickly offered a
copper badge. But Zhuo Fan didn’t even glance at it, only curled his
mouth, “Like I said, there are many copycats around these days. If you
yourself can’t prove who you are, what good would a token do?”

“Hey, stop messing around, punk. Us Four Tigers of Tianyu have roamed
the empire for so many years, but not once has there been a case of
someone copying us. You only have your ignorance to blame for not
knowing who we are. You won’t let us in, is that it? Wanna see how I
make my way through, breaking those arrays of yours?”

Dugu Huo barked, having reached his already short limit of his slight
patience. Zhuo Fan staggered back, putting on a perfect fearful face,
“See, see?! You now show your true colors and still dare pretend?
Marshal Dugu’s army runs under strict orders, bearing the love of the
people. How can there be such brash people wanting to barge into
someone’s home in his army? You’re no different from bandits!”

“You…” Dugu Huo gnashed his teeth.

Dugu Feng frowned and shouted, “Third brother, stop nagging. Are you
going to stain Marshal Dugu’s name by charging into one’s home?”

Dugu Huo glared at Zhuo Fan with burning hatred, but his feet remained
in place.

Dugu Feng bowed, “I apologize for my third brother’s lack of courtesy.
Please do not take it to mind, Steward Zhuo. Can you trust us now?”

“Trust? Humph, you almost had me there, but fortunately, I caught on to
your game. Is that how Marshal Dugu’s generals behave, playing the good
guy bad guy routine?”

Flushing red, the four were left speechless. Even Dugu Huo found it so
embarrassing that he forgot to complain.

Zhuo Fan snorted, “Didn’t you say Marshal Dugu is on his way. We’ll just
have to wait for him to prove your identities.”

With that said, Zhuo Fan vanished into the Poison Dragon Array, and the
miasma blocked the four’s sight.

They wanted to shout at him but he was already gone.

The four were left downcast behind.

Who’d ever seen it coming? They, who were revered even in the seven
houses, were now forced to stand on the doorsteps of some backwater Luo
clan.

And they couldn’t complain either. The clan just went through a hellish
battle and their nerves were taught. And best of all, the Luo clan was a
die-hard fan of the Marshal. How could the four burst in and ruin their
godfather’s image?

Sighing, Dugu Huo turned to Dugu Feng, “Big brother, what do we do now?”

“What else? Stay in a Windgaze City’s tavern.”

“But how are we going to give a full report to Marshal when we can’t
even get in to assess the situation?”

“We’ll report facts!” Dugu Lin shot Dugu Huo a glare, “Luo clan is more
than it seems. It’s best we wait for Marshal’s personal intervention!”

The other’s hearts chilled recalling the four 5th-grade arrays and
nodded.

Putting aside this place having such astonishing arrays, the fact the
order was sent for the four tigers to come here was proof enough of the
real threat that the Luo clan was under.

Yet, even after going through such a gory battle, it was clear from
their steward’s appearance that the clan wasn’t suffering so much. This
pointed out that the Luo clan was more than met the eye.

Being generals themselves, the four could tell of this mysterious clan’s
power.

In another part, Zhuo Fan returned to the hall and convened with the
rest. Great changes happened throughout the clan as entire rooms were
thrown into chaos.

He made the four tigers back off just so he could make preparations.
Since the Four Pillars were here, there was no way they were gonna miss
this chance of leaning on a great mountain.

Yep, it was all about clinging to power. Although, different tactics
were needed depending on the target. Zhuo Fan’s methods weren’t as crude
and tasteless as those narrow-minded Cai and Sun clans.

He wanted Dugu Zhantian to be eternally tied to the Luo clan.

Luo Yunchang watched the people rush about as they were close to tearing
down the whole of Blackwind Mountain. She turned to Zhuo Fan in
puzzlement, “What… this…”

Zhuo Fan said before she could continue, “Young miss, you’re just in
time. Tell that kid to switch from cultivation and hit the books for the
next few days!”

“Read, what?” Luo Yunchang was dazed.

Zhuo Fan grinned, “Just some matters of circumstances, like war books…”

Achoo~

Not a hundred mile out of Windgaze City, a wizen man rode his large
horse when a sudden sneeze caught him off guard and a shiver ran through
him, “Guard, how long until we reach Windgaze City?”

Everywhere around him was crawling with thousands upon thousands of
soldiers. A general close by reported, “Marshal, we will arrive in three
days!”

The old man nodded, but the frown never left him, “I have come out of
countless battlefields with honors, so why is it that this small
Windgaze City is putting me on edge…”

Chapter 198 - Welcoming

Chapter 198, Welcoming

Three days later Zhuo Fan was in a small room, checking Luo Yunhai’s
progress in reading.

Suddenly, the earth began to rumble like a huge earthquake. Zhuo Fan
raised a brow, focusing his attention outside, only to be shocked at
what he saw.

[What an aura. He is indeed the God of War!]

Zhuo Fan rose to his feet and shouted, “Everyone to your stations! The
Luo clan’s safety for the next few years at stake here!”

“Understood!”

The men outside the room replied, having already gotten ready as they
scrambled. Zhuo Fan turned to Luo Yunhai with his devious grin, “Kid,
you’re up now. You better had learned your part!”

Luo Yunhai’s face sank, “Big bro Zhuo, do I have to?”

“What do you think?”

The room was soon engulfed in Zhuo Fan’s evil cackling…

Outside Windgaze City, the Four Tigers of Tianyu were already waiting
for the orderly and impeccable military procession marching towards
them. It was like a dark cloud without an end.

The shaking of the mountains was due to the huge army. On the
battlefield, any man, even a Profound Heaven expert would shudder in
face of such might.

Leading the army was a huge man on a horse, his beard swirling in the
wind. Despite reigning in his power, his mighty air and unbending nature
were hard to conceal.

He was the second of Tianyu’s Four Pillars, Marshal of Tianyu’s armies,
God of War Dugu Zhantian!

He was in the 6th layer of the Radiant Stage, yet the whole of Tianyu
considered him the strongest. His four godsons were also peak Profound
Heaven experts.

Just based on the loyalty of his million men, not even the Regent Estate
would dare slight such a man! Despite Regent Estate having experts with
higher cultivation than him.

Once Dugu Zhantian sent an order, his million soldiers were like an
unstoppable flood of steel. Even Regent Estate’s Venerables would have a
hard time dealing with such a barrage.

To unite all these weak soldiers, to make them act as one, that was what
it mean to be a true God of War!

For this reason, the seven houses were afraid of the Marshal, the head
of the Four Pillars, Zhuge Changfeng!

Who told them to allow him to amass such power? In this case, drowning
one with numbers couldn’t be a more apt description!

“Generals welcome Marshal!” The four gave a deep bow.

Dugu Zhantian nodded, “What’s the situation? Is the Luo clan safe?”

“The Luo clan is at peace!” Dugu Feng spoke heavily.

Dugu Zhantian nodded a sigh, “It’s good we arrived in time. We did not
fail His Majesty. Was there anyone making it hard on them?”

“Uh, before we arrived, it would seem that the Luo clan had suffered a
sneak attack!” Dugu Feng mumbled.

Dugu Zhantian raised an eyebrow, his eyes staring back at him, “What?
Then how are they? What are their losses? What about the attackers? Any
prisoners? What of Luo Clan Head…”

Dugu Zhantian shot questions nonstop at the bitter looking four.

How could they know when the Luo clan had slammed the door in their
faces? Dugu Feng braced for reprisal as he reported, “Marshal, we are in
the dark…”

“What?!”

Dugu Zhantian blew his top, “Then what have you been doing over the past
few days, idling? Feng’er, that’s unlike you at all!”

They’ve been stationed at the borders for decades to prevent the
Quanrong armies from invading. Yet, the emperor decreed him to go to
Windgaze City’s rescue. He knew this matter was of utmost importance.

So, on his march here, he sent his four most trusted generals ahead to
provide timely assistance. Only to find them idling about these past
three days, and knowing absolutely nothing!

And these were Dugu Zhantian’s Four Tigers no less!

“Humph, you must have let the wine get to your heads and caused a scene.
I’ll settle your punishment later!” Dugu Zhantian flared, almost wanting
to do it now if not for delaying his rescue operation.

Dugu Lin bowed flustered, “Marshal, please hear us out!”

Having been told the ins and outs of the matter, Dugu Zhantian was
staring dumbstruck.

“There are four 5th-grade arrays in this backwater area?” Dugu Zhantian
blinked and started scouting ahead with his soul sense. And sure enough,
he found four arrays surrounding Blackwind Mountain blocking his search.

Dugu Zhantian was shocked, “No wonder the emperor told me to come in
person. There must be a mighty figure among them.”

Sighing, Dugu Zhantian turned to the four, “Now that you couldn’t enter,
I no longer blame you!”

“Marshal, who said we can’t? If not for big brother stopping me, I
would’ve torn down those damn arrays long ago!” Dugu Huo roared.

Dugu Zhantian berated, “You’re a disgrace! How dare you charge into
people’s homes without an explicit order? If you had dared charged
inside, I would’ve had your damn head for defying orders!”

“Uh, Marshal, I was only venting. Don’t take it seriously…” Dugu Huo
ducked his head in shame.

The other three secretly snickered.

Dugu Zhantian cut in, “Marshal, the Luo clan’s steward said he will let
us in after you arrived. He must mean for you to personally go inside!”

“Eh?”

Dugu Zhantian burst out laughing, “I have come at the order of the
emperor to take a look at this Luo clan as well. But since there’s a
mighty figure inside, I would also like to meet him!”

He dismounted and strode towards Blackwind Mountain, “Pass my order. The
army is not to disturb the people and are to set camp ten miles
Southeast of here!”

“Understood!”

The entire army roared, while the four rushed to follow him.

Dugu Zhantian went next to Dugu Zhantian, “Marshal, that steward is
extremely cautious. He will ask a ton of questions and will not hold a
polite tone. Please do not get angry when you deal with him.”

“Humph, you think my temper is short like you rascals?” Dugu Zhantian
laughed and Dugu Huo grumbled inside, [Your rage is more explosive than
mine!]

Dugu Lin slapped his fan, “Third brother, that steward didn’t do it out
of caution. He wants to see the Marshal in person. As to why, we shall
soon find out soon.”

“Ha-ha-ha, Lin’er is the most cool-headed among you, and can see things
differently. He is right, the Luo clan must’ve wanted to see me. Then, I
will just have to see for myself what’s so great about this clan,
ha-ha-ha…”

Dugu Zhantian walked with his domineering air, soon arriving at
Blackwind Mountain.

“Tianyu’s Marshal, Dugu Zhantian greets Luo Clan Head!” Dugu Zhantian
bellowed.

Hum~

The Poison Dragon Array’s miasma dissipated and Zhuo Fan came out. But
this time he had a look of complete respect.

He bowed, “I am Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan. Welcome, Marshal Dugu, and
the four generals!”

“Oh, so you’re that steward? I heard you’re quite cautious, not trusting
even my token in the hands of my generals. Why then do you believe who I
am at the mere sight of me?” Dugu Zhantian grinned, clearly mocking Zhuo
Fan’s earlier attitude.

But Zhuo Fan acted the fool, “Marshal Dugu is the God of War. Who’d dare
impersonate you? Even if someone did, none could copy your aura honed
after numerous victories, nor the thick killing intent on you for
slaughtering countless men.

“Is there any other true man, a man old but holding strong still, in
Tianyu? I could feel and hear from afar the might you possess. Only
Marshal Dugu is capable of making my energy surge in my veins. My
respect to you is like a flood, an unstoppable river, like a never
ending sea, a mighty… “

“Fine, fine, I get it!” Dugu Zhantian cut his rambling short.

He wanted to test the kid and see his true intentions, but then, he saw
him engage in this foolery, going as far as worshiping the ground he
stepped on. It was so enrapturing, that even he felt a chill and had to
stop it.

If this went on for any longer, he’d be hurling for days and nights.

The four were dumbstruck. None saw it coming. Zhuo Fan this time was a
thorough ass kisser, blowing their wish of questioning out of their
minds.

Dugu Zhantian had seen his fair share of fawners like Zhuo Fan, but
never wasted time with any. Whenever they spoke, it was always followed
by a long endless string of adulation.

Dugu Zhantian took a long look at him, “This backwater town has many
experts it seems, even this young steward. I am in awe. Then, little
brother, is it possible to see Luo Clan Head?”

“He’s eagerly awaiting!”

Grinning, Zhuo Fan bowed and Dugu Zhantian strode forward.

The Marshal could see this was all arranged by that mighty figure. He
could feel getting closer and closer to him. What he didn’t know was
that mighty figure was that young steward.

The four generals followed closely, with Dugu Huo jutting his chin and
muttering next to Zhuo Fan, “Humph, now do you believe us?”

“Of course, I was too blind to see your greatness. I beg your pardon!”
Zhuo Fan smiled.

Dugu Lin looked at him deeply but shook his head in the end.

He was Dugu Army’s strategist and knew something was off about Zhuo Fan.
But he just couldn’t dare believe all of this was orchestrated by such a
young pup.

Or he would be the second coming of Zhuge Changfeng…

Chapter 199 - My Godfather, My Rock

Chapter 199, My Godfather, My Rock

“Please, after you, Marshal!”

With Zhuo Fan as guide, they passed through the Poison Dragon Array,
reaching the peak of Blackwind Mountain. Instead of a lavish clan
dwelling, they were greeted by simple gates of a barracks.

They could even hear faint cries of kill from beyond.

Frowning, the five were quite puzzled. [What is the Luo clan up to now?]

With a smile, Zhuo Fan gestured, “Ha-ha-ha, please don’t take offense,
Marshal. We have just recently gone through a bloody attack and are
still tense. Our guards especially, training day and night. Will God of
War be willing to say a few words to our young blood? The whole clan
would be most grateful.” Zhuo Fan bowed again.

Dugu Zhantian nodded slowly. He first wanted to know what the Luo clan
was cooking up, and second, to know how deep they hid their assets.

For the emperor to view them so highly and pull him from the borders in
rescuing a nameless clan, he had to see for himself what they really
were.

Following Zhuo Fan through the gates, the five arrived before Luo clan’s
manor. What had them all in shock was that there were no buildings
around, only tents. They looked akin to an army ready for war.

That was Zhuo Fan’s ingenious plan was all about. He tore down all
buildings for tents to stir Marshal Dugu’s sympathy and make him feel at
home.

With how Dugu Zhantian spent years on end on the battlefields, he’d be
more at home in a tent than between four walls.

This was also a form of flattery, to conform to one’s tastes, covert as
it was.

Sure enough, Dugu Zhantian trembled as he nodded. Zhuo Fan no longer
spoke, having a sly grin on his face instead.

They soon arrived at Luo clan’s training area, where Captain Pang was in
the middle of practice with his guards. Most of them were still
children, but their every strike was filled with zeal and their eyes
burning with power. They look strikingly similar to veterans after
decades of war.

Not even Dugu Zhantian could remain unfeeling seeing such a scene. Just
what could those ten-year-olds have possibly seen to harden their gaze?

As an experienced commander, with decades of war behind him, he knew how
to turn a batch of fresh recruits into dauntless warriors.

But never in his wildest dream did he expect to see this in a backwater
clan. The world was filled with marvels!

He was now burning to know who was this great figure behind the Luo
clan.

Unbeknownst to him, this burning zeal in the eyes of the youths was
thanks to the Wraith Art they trained in.

As for those kids whose spirits were crushed, they lay dead, with bones
crushed and bodies mauled. What he was seeing were those that came back
from the brink of death, standing at the peak. How could they not be
dauntless!

“Marshal, our third rate clan just went through a disaster and only the
surviving few are training now. You must be thinking it’s a sorry
sight.” Zhuo Fan sighed in feint modesty.

Dugu Zhantian shook his hand, “No no, hardly. The kids may not have
cultivated, but their eyes are those of elites. If these are just your
survivors, then your main guard unit that fell must’ve been a monster.
How could such a mighty guard ever need rescuing?”

Zhuo Fan blinked and smiled.

[This Marshal is pragmatic. I see now why he is acclaimed as a God of
War. He is an upright and just man.]

Zhuo Fan nodded secretly, having understood more about the Marshal’s
nature.

“Then Marshal, please feel free to point out some tips.”

“No need! I would not dare show my meager skill before you!” Dugu
Zhantian laughed, “Steward Zhuo, I only wish to meet with your Clan
Head. Such a man has set four 5th-grade arrays, and still trained such
young warriors. I’m truly eager to see him!”

The four behind him were shocked.

Marshal was the God of War, with countless figures wanting to meet him.
But now, it was the other way around. It was he who wanted to see
someone else.

Just who was guiding the Luo clan? How could the mere training of some
guards move the grand Tianyu’s God of War?

The four sighed as they turned to look at the guards again. These small
few children were indeed far stronger than their own elites, it’s no
wonder…

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and grinned, “Since Marshal is so eager, please
come with me. Our Clan Head is also waiting.”

Zhuo Fan entered the biggest tent as the others rushed to catch up to
him. How could they have known all of this was Zhuo Fan leading them by
the nose…

“The art of war is of vital importance to the State. It is a matter of
life and death, a road either to safety or to ruin. Hence it is a
subject of inquiry which can on no account be neglected. The art of war,
then, is governed by five constant factors, to be taken into account in
one’s deliberations, when seeking to determine the conditions obtaining
in the field. These are: The Moral Law, Heaven, Earth…”

(Starreader: excerpt from Sun Tzu’s Art of War.)

A bright voice read.

Dugu Zhantian’s faltered his steps, “That’s the Art of War. Who is
reading?”

“Oh, I almost forgot. Young master had been training for twenty hours.
He needs some rest!” Zhuo Fan slapped his forehead and rushed in another
direction. He was unconcerned about the others following him, though.

Dugu Zhantian’s group followed either way.

They arrived at a small yard where a youth held a bowl on his head and
in horse stance. His knees and hands also held a bowl, but the surface
of the water was unperturbed.

What laid under his butt was a shining dagger. If his legs slacked for
even a second, he’d tear himself a new one. Despite the danger, he was
still reciting the Art of War.

Dugu Zhantian was puzzled, “Steward Zhuo, he…”

“Ha-ha-ha, Luo clan’s young master, Luo Yunhai!”

Zhuo Fan chuckled, “From young to old, all of Luo clan admires Marshal
Dugu. All of us adhere to military doctrine. Especially the young
master, who is training while studying, hoping to one day to serve under
the Marshal!”

Dugu Zhantian blinked, [Why is the Clan Head of this Luo clan with his
impressive soldiers wish to be under me? Everything about this clan is
mysterious. Just what are they after?]

Zhuo Fan probed with a smile, “Marshal, will you accept our young
master?”

“Uh, of course. If the youth wishes to serve his nation, to enter the
battlefield…”

“Perfect!”

Zhuo Fan’s yell cut him off. He then pulled Luo Yunhai up, “Yunhai,
don’t just stand there, Marshal Dugu wants to take you in. Go and pour
him tea!”

“Right away!”

Luo Yunhai ran like the wind, like a bird out of its cage. [Finally out
of that damn position. I almost couldn’t take it!]

Dugu Zhantian felt dizzy, [Wait, you’re going to make me accept him
here?]

“Uh, Steward Zhuo, that was…”

“Marshal Dugu needn’t say anything. My Clan Head would be immensely
pleased to know you showed such care for young master. He will be
grateful for all his life. You may not know it, but this was our Clan
Head’s cherished dream…”

Zhuo Fan held Dugu Zhantian’s large hand, with tears in his eyes. Dugu
Zhantian wanted to refuse, but now he didn’t have the heart to go
through with it.

[Isn’t it just a soldier? He isn’t half bad either. Perhaps he’ll earn
some merits in the future. It’s just taking one extra recruit anyway.]
Sighing, he nodded in the end.

Then a screech came, “Marshal Dugu, it’s actually you?”

Luo Yunchang appeared who knew when and was shaking from excitement.

Zhuo Fan’s face was twitching. [Tone it down on the boasting!]

“Steward Zhuo, she…”

“Uh, let me introduce you. She is our young miss, Luo Yunchang!” Zhuo
Fan brought her before Dugu Zhantian and explained what happened.

Luo Yunchang’s eyes lit up, jumping in joy, completely out of her modest
and virtuous character.

Zhuo Fan’s mouth twitched as he whispered, “Alright now, don’t push it!”

Luo Yunchang reigned in her excitement then apologized to Dugu Zhantian,
who didn’t seem to mind.

But the four generals looked particularly close at Luo Yunchang.
Especially the third brother, whose eyes were practically burning.

Zhuo Fan laughed inside.

[Yep, she is no less than Diaochan. And Luo Yunchang is also a rare
beauty.]

(Starreader: Fictional character in Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Diaochan is one of the four beauties of ancient China. She is a maid of
Dong Zhuo who charmed Lu Bu into assassinating him in 192. )

Zhuo Fan turned to Dugu Zhantian, “Marshal Dugu, taking young master in
is the greatest joy that ever graced the Luo clan. Why not make it even
better by becoming kin?”

Kin?!

Stunned by those words, the four generals looked at Luo Yunchang with
blushes. Dugu Zhantian rubbed his beard and looked expectantly at her,
“I don’t know if Clan Head will agree…”

“No worries, dad would definitely agree. It is his cherished wish!” Luo
Yunchang rushed a reply.

Dugu Zhantian saw his godsons bashful but hardly refusing. Dugu Huo had
it worse, like a volcano ready to blow.

Dugu Zhantian recalled how his godsons had fought by his side for
decades and thought it was time for them to start a family. So he
nodded, “Since Clan Head agrees, then I’m more than happy to do it!”

The four generals clenched their fists, so excited they were trembling.
But who was the one to marry this young miss?

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed and showed a sly smile.

Luo Yunhai now came with the tea and saw Zhuo Fan nodding. He kneeled as
he offered the teacup to Dugu Zhantian.

Dugu Zhantian’s mind was filled with the joy of a wedding, taking the
cup in passing.

But at that moment, Luo Yunhai’s voice slammed into their ears, “Luo
Yunhai greets godfather!”

Pff!

Dugu Zhantian staggered, as he spat out the tea he just drank…

Chapter 200 - I Want a Sister In Law, Not a Brother!

Chapter 200, I Want a Sister In Law, Not a Brother!

“W-w-what did you just call me?” Dugu Zhantian’s old eyes bulged and
pointed a trembling finger at Luo Yunhai with a shocked face. The four
generals were dumbstruck as well.

Marshal only agreed to take him as a soldier. How did it jump from that
to being a godson?

Luo Yunhai had a genial face as he cupped his hands in respect, “Is it
wrong of me to call you godfather?”

“Yeah, ol’ Marshal, didn’t you say it yourself that you wanted to be
kin? The grand Marshal Dugu is going back on his word over such a
trivial matter?” Zhuo Fan secretly snickered.

Dugu Zhantian was bug-eyed. It took a while to get over his shock and
turned from Luo Yunchang to Luo Yunhai.

[True, Steward Zhuo only spoke of being kin, not carrying to elaborate
on its type.] For Luo Yunhai to call him godfather, was also a type of
kin.

But since only Luo Yunchang was there at the time, they believed it
could only be through marriage.

And the next thing they noticed was that Luo Yunhai was kneeling there,
and offering the teacup. Wasn’t his actions clearly done for a godfather
ceremony? [Sigh, how could I be so careless?]

Dugu Zhantian rested his forehead, and said to Zhuo Fan bitterly,
“Steward Zhuo, then what you meant by kin, was in fact…”

“Yes. Did Marshal perhaps think otherwise?”

“I thought…” Looking at Luo Yunchang, then at his four godsons, Dugu
Zhantian sighed in resignation, “The same.”

The four generals’ faces crumbled with his last words. Zhuo Fan clapped
with joy, “Ha-ha-ha, outstanding. Then young master, hurry and kowtow
three times to your godfather.”

“Yes!” Luo Yunhai shouted, more than eager in his obeisance.

Dugu Zhantian sighed bitterly with a shake of his head. He wanted to
give his godsons a sister in law, only to end up giving them a younger
brother instead.

He was left with no alternative, since he already accepted. If he were
to switch facts now and say he wanted the girl instead, wouldn’t it be
the same as robbing the common people’s women?

He was Dugu Zhantian, who had an illustruous military reputation, a man
pursuing honesty and bravery as well as maintaining a strict order in
his ranks. Was he just going to throw it all away just like that?

[Let it be. With his talent and Luo clan’s elite army, in two years of
training under me, he ought to turn up as another tiger, no?]

Dugu Zhantian looked on the bright side. His face then turned serious as
he looked at Luo Yunhai, “Yunhai, today, you take me as your godfather,
so you must follow the rules of the Dugu house. I am a man that
separates private and public matters. Now that you are in the Dugu Army
and if I am still in armor, you must address me as Marshal. Disobey any
military rule and I will punish you according to the martial law, no
exceptions. Your four brothers can attest to that.”

“Yes, godfather. Uh, Marshal!” Luo Yunhai cupped his hands in glee.

Dugu Zhantian nodded pleased, [Clever boy.], “Furthermore, as you are
now my godson you are not to shame my name. Or your head shall fall!”

“Yes, Marshal!” Luo Yunhai grinned and shouted.

Zhuo Fan smiled and cupped his hands, “Congratulations, Marshal, for
getting another bright godson. I am most certain our young master will
not let you down.”

He then turned to the four generals, his smile ever present,
“Congratulations, generals, you have now an outstanding brother. Young
master shall be indebted to you looking after him, ha-ha-ha…”

Turning from the beaming Luo Yunchang, a fairy upon this mortal world,
to the grinning Zhuo Fan, the four looked bitter and depressed.

[Enough blabber! We have enough brothers as it is, millions in fact! We
don’t need more, all we wanted was a sister in law!]

Dugu Huo had it worse, feeling such disappointment that his eyes
glistened with tears.

[Goddamn wretched Luo clan! You ignited our desires without us knowing
and you give us a little brother instead?]

[I feel like crying! I’ve been in the field of battle for decades and
now I don’t wanna go back…]

Knowing exactly what they were grumbling about in their minds, Zhuo Fan
gave Luo Yunchang a thumbs up as he laughed inside. [Who knew the young
miss knew how to work her charms? She got the four of ’em hooked without
so much as an eye batting.]

Luo Yunchang stuck out her head in womanly pride and returned Zhuo Fan
an enchanting smile.

This only worked to fuel the lamentation in the four men’s hearts.

“Steward Zhuo, now that I have Yunhai as godson, don’t you think it’s
time I see your Clan Head?” Dugu Zhantian asked.

Shuddering, Zhuo Fan sighed a nod, “Indeed, I do believe Clan Head
wished he could meet Marshal for a long time.”

Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang showed sullen faces.

Dugu Zhantian’s group was startled, following them in silence.

Not fifteen minutes later, they reached a large tent. Zhuo Fan allowed
them to enter first. What they saw left them speechless.

On the table in the middle of the large tent stood a lonely spirit
tablet. It was actually inscribed with Luo Clan Head’s name.

“Clan Head, your most esteemed and revered Marshal Dugu has come to see
you. You must be so happy.” Zhuo Fan’s knees hit the ground, wailing to
high heavens.

Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang had tears streaming down their cheeks.

Unlike Zhuo Fan, theirs was no act, but genuine pain. The loss of their
father happened two years ago and this spirit tabled was very much real.

How could they not feel sorrow when gazing upon the spirit tablet?

Dugu Zhantian’s group was stunned. They never would’ve thought the
battle of Windgaze City just now was so disastrous it robbed them of
their Clan Head.

They had come too late.

Shaking his head, Dugu Zhantian and the generals felt their pain, paying
their respects as well by burning incense. Their hearts were bleak
thinking the Clan Head died not a few days ago.

“Steward Zhuo, if you don’t mind me asking, are the four 5th-grade
arrays outside due to Clan Head?” Dugu Zhantian asked after showing his
respect.

Zhuo Fan jumped to his feet and held his head high, “It is indeed so.
Clan Head was but a Bone Tempering cultivator, but that didn’t stop him
from reading the starry sky and the land’s layout, grasping arrays and
alchemy alike. Those arrays were personally placed by the Clan Head.”

“Clan Head was a truly extraordinary man. I see why His Majesty sent me
to your rescue!” Dugu Zhantian sighed.

Regarding the intricacies of a 5th-grade array, not even a Radiant Stage
expert could claim to understand them fully. But as a mere Bone
Tempering cultivator, the Luo Clan Head could set four 5th grade arrays.
He had to be the genius of the millennium.

[A pity that he was only in the Bone Tempering Stage and was too weak to
control the arrays fully and repel the stronger invaders.] Dugu Zhantian
could even imagine Clan Head’s last moments. He sighed, “A true pity. If
only he was still alive, I would’ve asked him to join my army as
general. He would’ve been a great help to my army in fighting back the
Quanrong.”

Zhuo Fan’s eyebrow flickered and clicked his tongue inwardly. [Thank god
I wasn’t stupid enough to say I set them up, or they’d be hauling me to
the borders. That would be dreadfully scary!]

“And who was the filth that dared attack the Luo clan, making you suffer
so much, and even kill Clan Head?” Dugu Zhantian’s killing intent
spiked.

He was only sent here by the emperor to protect the Luo clan. As for the
enemy, he had no idea who it was.

Zhuo Fan snickered inwardly, [Perfect.] and sobbed, “Marshal does not
know how cruel and terrifying they were. We had a hundred thousand
people on Blackwind Mountain, now reduced to less than ten thousand.”

The sorrowful siblings jumped in fright, looking at Zhuo Fan with
horror.

Nothing seemed beneath this guy, no act to foul, no ditch too filthy.
The siblings thought to themselves. [When were there ever a hundred
thousand men on this mountain? Better yet, we couldn’t feed them even if
there were!]

Dugu Zhantian was boiling mad, “Such bastards slaughtering common folk
live in my country? Now that I’ve returned to court, I will make sure to
uproot this evil from our nation and bring it to peace!”

“Please godfa-, Marshal, bring justice to the Luo clan!” Luo Yunhai
bowed.

Luo Yunchang rushed to do the same, “Please Marshal, bring us justice!”

“Be at ease, I do not tolerate such meaningless slaughter. I will have
them taste the fist of justice for you.” Dugu Zhantian flicked his
sleeve and roared.

Dugu Feng grabbed Luo Yunhai and Luo Yunchang’s arms and helped them to
their feet. But his eyes never left Luo Yunchang, “Ha-ha-ha, even if
Yunhai wasn’t my brother, The Four Tigers will never let such criminals
live.”

The other three were gnashing their teeth in frustration.

[That’s eldest brother for you. Swift to act. How come we didn’t think
of it? But there’s plenty of chance to pursue her, now that Luo Yunhai
is our little brother.]

They then started crowding around her and extended their clutches,
justifying it with sympathy. While their eyes glared at Dugu Feng as if
to say, ‘Let the girl go! It’s my turn!’

But then Zhuo Fan passed through and took Dugu Feng’s wretched hand as
well as the three clutches with ardent passion, “We couldn’t thank the
four generals enough.”

“Ha-ha-ha, it’s only proper…”

Taking their hands back in annoyance, the four still had a smile, but
their hearts were vexed. [We want to cope a feel of that young miss you
got over there, so why the hell a rotten steward butts into our
business?]

[Humph, such a killjoy!]

Watching them with a cold eye, Dugu Zhantian was pondering. [As their
godfather, I have the final say in not only the peace on Tianyu, but to
what lady fits them as well.]

“Steward Zhuo, who are they, where do they come from? I will immediately
send my troops to flatten them all!” Dugu Zhantian bellowed with
majestic power.

Zhuo Fan cupped his hands, “Marshal Dugu is a true God of War, in power
and manners. I will be straight with you. One of those fiends was Hell
Valley. I am certain that Marshal’s army can uproot every single one of
them, raze their nest to the ground, restore peace…”

“Wait wait wait, come again?” Dugu Zhantian stammered, his scalp numb as
cold sweat trickled down.

Zhuo Fan held his head high and spoke clearly, “It was Hell Valley! Why,
is it perhaps difficult, Marshal?”

Dugu Zhantian’s face twitched

[Difficult, he says. That couldn’t even begin to describe it! Since when
was it so easy to act against the seven houses?] He was from the Four
Pillars, but he couldn’t just up and march on the seven houses! That’d
start a civil war!

Dugu Zhantian held his forehead and sighed.

[I got too carried away with boasting!] Who’d have thought the reason
why the emperor would send him over was to repel the seven houses? It
was only natural, since only the Four Pillars could reign in the seven
houses of Tianyu.

[Why didn’t you say anything, Your Majesty? Now I can’t go back on my
word after boasting about it!]

Finding the hopeful gazes of Zhuo Fan, Luo Yunhai, and Luo Yunchang, for
the first time ever, Dugu Zhantian flushed in embarrassment, trying to
look elsewhere…
