Chapter 216 - Exploit

Chapter 216, Exploit

“So according to you, Zhuge Changfeng, openly defying an imperial edict
is a trifle?” Dugu Zhantian spoke coldly with a booming voice, “If
everyone does it, what would become of the imperial family’s dignity?”

Brushing away his outburst with a smile and a wave, Zhuge Changfeng
shook his head, “Marshal, ease your anger. That is not what I meant at
all. Defying the imperial edict has and always will be a serious crime.
But in the case where the ruler is rash and tyrannical…”

“Say that again!?” Dugu Zhantian barked.

Zhuge Changfeng waved his hand with a dismissing smile, “Ha-ha-ha,
Marshal need not be angry. I wasn’t speaking of His Majesty. His Majesty
is an upstanding ruler. Even more than that, right?”

The emperor’s heart shivered, he and Sima Hui both snorting inside.

The three were putting the squeeze on the three house lords just to
avoid this particular mess. Only so they could hold one over the Regent
Estate. But now, Zhuge Changfeng had breached this topic and the emperor
couldn’t stay silent.

The emperor gave a curt nod for them to elaborate on the reason behind
this mess.

The three house lords straightened their backs and cupped their hands,
“Your Majesty, all that transpired is due to one man, Windgaze City’s
Luo clan’s steward, Zhuo Fan.”

You Wanshan then followed with painting Zhuo Fan in a gruesome way and
with flourishing detail.

The emperor simply sat there in his throne. He long knew of Zhuo Fan’s
‘adventures’ so why tell him again? Yet despite knowing, the emperor let
Zhuo Fan cause all the trouble he wanted.

But now, all he wished was to avoid and bury this topic for good.

Once You Wanshan finished, Huangpu Tianyuan continued, “Your Majesty,
this vile spawn defies the seven houses’ dignity. I beseech Your Majesty
to lift the ban on Windgaze City and allow us to exact capital
punishment on this wretched beast, to show the nation how upright Your
Majesty is! “

This time the emperor was in a real bind. Instead of having the three
houses turn on Regent Estate, the latter got to strike against the Luo
clan and ruin his plans!

Tap, tap!

The emperor rapped his fingers on the armrest in deep thought, “Due to
the havoc the Hell Valley and Veiled Dragon Pavilion had inflicted on
the people three years ago in Windgaze City, I have elected to turn it
into a forbidden ground. But I see that overlooking one man has caused
endless suffering once again. My heart is in pain.”

They all knew where he was going with this, sporting large winning
grins.

And sure enough, the emperor continued with, “I shall not look into your
first offense, but you are not to step into Windgaze City again. If you
want to catch that beast, you will have to wait for him to come out!”

“Your Majesty’s heart is with the people. The empire rejoices in having
you!” Huangpu Tianyuan’s group cupped their hands in heartfelt
admiration, but the sneer on their faces was plain to see.

This hidden battle between emperor and Regent Estate ended with the
former’s complete defeat.

Not only did he not seize Regent Estate’s weakness, with the three
houses getting away scot-free, what was worse, he was unable to defend
his chess piece, Windgaze City, almost throwing it to the wolves.

The emperor’s might faded, earning the ridicule of all!

“Thank you, Your Majesty!” You Wanshan bowed like the rest and then
showed the same respect to Huangpu Tianyuan, “Thank you, Estate Lord
Huangpu!”

The emperor felt he was choking on something where neither choice of
swallowing or spitting out was any good. He resolved to just stare at
them with all the anger his eyes could muster.

Huangpu Tianyuan simply ignored it and half bowed, “Your Majesty, we are
most grateful for your mercy. We shall take our leave.”

He didn’t care if the emperor had other intentions, he simply turned
around and left. It was a clear disregard of the emperor’s position. And
yet the emperor could only glare with hatred.

“Hold on!”

The people turned to see Monochrome Chess Sage stomping over, with fire
in his eyes, at High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei, “It’s been so long, Sir
Huangpu. Would you care for a game of chess?”

Not letting the other respond, Sima Hui directly launched a chess piece
at Huangpu Fenglei.

A great power suddenly pressed on everyone’s shoulders.

The house lords were all peak Profound Heaven experts but just this
meager chess piece had them all feel as if a mountain was bearing down
on them. They couldn’t even step back, blood draining from their faces.

Divine Dragon Sima Hui’s attack was terrifying!

Yet Huangpu Fenglei simply stepped before them without fear. He extended
two fingers and caught the piece as if it was nothing, dispelling the
pressure with his gesture.

Squinting, Sima Hui didn’t expect for Huangpu Fenglei to be so strong as
to take his attack so easily!

With a grin, Huangpu Fenglei spoke, “Mr. Sima’s chess skill is
exquisite. How could a martial artist such as I compare with a chess
sage such as you? I would only disgrace you by playing!”

Huangpu Fenglei then flicked the chess piece back.

A pressure far greater than before came down on Sima Hui and the
emperor.

Sima Hui took a rushed step forward to protect the emperor and was going
to use two fingers as well. But the power was too great and forced him
to take a step back.

Looking aghast at Huangpu Fenglei, Sima Hui said, “After not seeing each
other for so many decades, Mr. Huangpu’s power has greatly increased!
I’m afraid I may no longer be your match!”

“You’re too kind. Mr. Sima is far more talented than I. Only, Mr. Sima
indulges in chess while I merely work hard in my training!”

With a mocking laughter, Huangpu Fenglei gave Huangpu Qingyun’s group a
look. They all joined his laughter as they left this great symbol of
imperial power that was the palace!

Sima Hui’s brow had faint sweat watching them go. He looked down to see
how deep an imprint his foot left when he withdrew.

Huangpu Fenglei’s power was dreadful to force a Divine Dragon to leave
such a mark on the floor!

Bam!

The emperor shot to his feet and knocked over a candle stand as he
cursed, “These traitorous mongrels have gone too far! They come to my
palace, asking for my obedience?”

“Calm down, Your Majesty!”

Sima Hui advised, “With Zhuge Changfeng here, our reasons are moot in
front of a man with his oratory skills. That is why I tried going after
Huangpu Fenglei to make them cower. But who’d have thought Huangpu
Fenglei’s power trumps mine, further diminishing your prestige. It was
my miscalculation. Please forgive me, Your Majesty!”

The emperor didn’t speak, his eyes shining with a dark look.

Dugu Zhantian smoothened his beard and sighed, “This plan was to use the
three houses and strike a blow at Regent Estate’s arrogance. Or at least
drive a wedge between them. But now, Regent Estate came to their rescue,
further making them stand with the Regent Estate. All our hard work was
exploited by Regent Estate! Now that the Regent Estate is together with
three houses, they will be even harder to deal with…”

Sima Hui nodded, while the emperor was pacing in deep thought.

Then the emperor’s eyes shined, “Mr. Sima, isn’t the Esoteric Debate
around the corner?”

“Indeed Your Majesty. It shall take place in five years!” Sima Hui
nodded, then started, “Your Majesty, you don’t mean…”

Smiling, the emperor nodded, “Hasn’t the Regent Estate flaunted being
the head of the seven houses since he always took first place in the
Esoteric Debate? If he comes short in any way this time, their dignity
would take a heavy blow. And the seed of doubt would be planted in the
other houses, that its power had declined!”

“But Regent Estate’s every generation has been filled with geniuses.
Especially this one, with even some freaks mixed among them! The other
houses have their own fair share of talents, but none can compare.
There’s even rumors that one among them can break the shackles of
Radiant Stage, becoming the peak of power in Tianyu. Just what junior
could have such potential…”

Sima Hui’s brow was locked, to which the emperor snorted, “Speaking of
freaks, is there any little freak more rampant than that guy?”

“Your Majesty, you mean… Zhuo Fan?” Sima Hui and Dugu Zhantian spoke in
unison.

The emperor nodded with a sneaky smile, “It’s time for that brat and the
Luo clan to pay back for sheltering them. They need to just cut the
Regent Estate down a peg at the Esoteric Debate and I will declare the
Luo clan as the eighth noble house to keep Regent Estate in line!”

Sima Hui and Dugu Zhantian were speechless.

Zhuo Fan had shocked them again and again, but the Luo clan’s foundation
was thin. This eighth house would find it hard to stay afloat when it
was even weaker than Drifting Flowers Edifice, threatened to be
swallowed by the other house. Yet the emperor was hoping to use it to
counter Regent Estate.

None of them knew that Zhuo Fan had already made preparation to
strengthen the foundation of this flimsy clan…

In another place, Zhuge Changfeng’s group left the palace with scorn on
their faces. Especially the three house lords, who were pushed into a
corner by the emperor, were now wild with joy.

And just like the emperor, they were in complete awe of the Regent
Estate and Huangpu Fenglei.

[Holy molly, how many are there that can push back a Divine Dragon?]

“Zhuge Changfeng, thank you for making all of this happen!” Huangpu
Tianyuan cupped his hands.

Zhuge Changfeng smiled and spoke in the same cold tone, “Ha-ha-ha,
there’s no need to thank me. Wasn’t it all planned by your steward, Leng
Wuchang?”

Zhuge Changfeng then left with a smile. The Yin and Yang elders caught
up to him, having kept their distance so far.

You Wanshan didn’t quite understand, but Leng Wuchang’s face changed,
turning to Huangpu Tianyuan.

Correct, all was planned by Leng Wuchang, including the three house
lords’ detainment by the emperor. It was all done so he could save the
three houses at the best moment, and become more reliant on the Regent
Estate.

What was once a scheme privy to only he and Huangpu Tianyuan, it was
seen through by Zhuge Changfeng in an instant.

Watching Zhuge Changfeng’s shrinking figure, Leng Wuchang and Huangpu
Tianyuan felt an odd chill. No wonder Zhuge Changfeng was the head of
the Four Pillars, he was frightening…

Zhuge Changfeng himself was sporting a mystifying smile.

“Prime Minister must be glad!” The white-haired elder smiled.

Zhuge Changfeng nodded, “I just saw a bunch of fools getting happy
having scored an empty victory! But, ha-ha-ha….”

The elders were puzzled.

Zhuge Changfeng was quite vague, “But, Yuwen has ruled these lands for a
thousand years for a reason! To not even see through a chess player’s
unfathomable skill, he still dares to play with cloak and dagger? So
this is the extent of Unwonted Contriver, ha-ha-ha… “

Chapter 217 - The Suicidal Life and Death Art

Chapter 217, The Suicidal Life and Death Art

Four figures fell on Blackwind Mountain, Zhuo Fan and his three elders.

Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian watched in awe the impressive sight formed
by the mighty four 5th-grade arrays.

[Luo clan is outstanding to this extent that it’s no wonder its steward
is so cunning and able. But how come we never heard of it?]

The two looked at each other puzzled.

Zhuo Fan knew all too well what dwelled on their mind, but didn’t dispel
their doubts, only made a path through the arrays with a sign. He took
the lead and the others rushed to follow.

Once back in the clan, Zhuo Fan called for a general meeting to
introduce their newest elders.

The two elders were presented with the sight of people no stronger than
ants. Knowing they could kill these people with their thumb, it
instilled a deep sense of disappointment in the old couple.

Though after having received Zhuo Fan’s cruelty, it curbed their
characters so as to not let it show.

Only when Zhuo Fan introduced Luo Yunchang did their eyes shine.
Recalling Li Jingtian’s words, they showed utmost respect for Luo
Yunchang. Xue Qingjian even held her shoulder, “Young miss you are the
picture of beauty, like an angel from above. I can’t help but rue the
day a rotten punk would have you for himself, oho-ho-ho…”

Luo Yunchang blushed and shook her head, but her heart was grateful as
she sneaked a peek at Zhuo Fan. She also found the two elders quite
likable.

They were Radiant Stage experts yet so calm and mild, unlike the
arrogant stereotype everyone knew.

Though clueless this was all brought about by Zhuo Fan’s thorough and
unyielding discipline.

The man in question was right now frowning. [Why are these two who
always snapped back with how great they are in Tianyu suddenly fawning?
And why at Luo Yunchang?]

Turning to Li Jingtian, he caught the latter looking elsewhere entirely.
[This has nothing to do with me….]

“Now that introductions are out of the way, the others may return to
their tasks.” Zhuo Fan’s clap left only Luo Yunchang and the four elders
behind.

He turned to the couple, “You two will be watching over the Blackflame
Array in the South and the Ice Shadows Array in the North. I will later
tell you how to wield them! Working alongside Elder Yan and Elder Li’s
arrays, the Luo clan will never know defeat!”

“Understood!” Qiu Yanhai and Xue Qingjian cupped their hands.

Luo Yunchang was overjoyed knowing the four experts would turn the
mountain into an impenetrable fortress. Not even a seven houses siege
could make her worry now.

“Also…”

Zhuo Fan’s hand flashed and offered a jade slip, “As you are now Luo
clan’s elders, I shall treat you as one of us. Here is the secret Life
and Death Art. I find it quite suitable to you two!”

Qiu Yanhai took the jade slip, amazed by what it contained.

Knowing what they were gonna say, Zhuo Fan smiled, “This is no
cultivation method or martial art, but a way to combine your strengths.
A limitless improving method!”

“What?!”

Brushing off their shock, Zhuo Fan continued, “This Life and Death Art
means treading the fine line between life and death on the edge of a
knife. At the collision between two opposing forces, world destroying
power lies! But once control over it slips, death becomes you. This
leads to this art going by a more common name, the Suicidal Secret Art!”

“What are you doing giving it to them for? That’s too dangerous!” Luo
Yunchang spoke in their defense.

The couple was almost moved to tears.

[Li Jingtian didn’t lie. Getting close to the young miss is a must if we
want to live!]

But Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Young miss needn’t fret. If others trained
in this art, they’d have a fate worse than death. But I saw how the two
elders’ fire and water arts combine, how seamless they work together.
They are able to conform to the other on the fly, understanding each
other’s hearts. In fact, they may understand the other even better than
they do themselves. The two’s attributes may be in conflict, but they
are nevertheless able to control the clashing force between fire and
water. There’s a 50% chance they’ll succeed!”

“Fifty?!”

The couple was nervous, and Luo Yunchang jumped in fright, “That’s too
little!”

Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Nothing ventured, nothing gained. The greater
the danger the bigger the return. I’m sure you two know this fully well.
After all, you fought Tianyu’s experts off decades ago. I can also
guarantee, this method has infinite growth. The greater your control,
the more powerful you become. You can one day reach the point when you
can face all five Divine Dragons together!”

Widened eyes and gasps of shock were heard all around!

Imperial family’s Divine Dragons were the strongest in Tianyu. Not even
if their cultivation matched could they defeat one, least of all five.

These were not false promises, as Zhuo Fan never was one for empty talk.

Li Jingtian snapped his excited eyes on the jade slip, his martial
fanatic side rearing its head, “Uh, what if, suppose, I train it?”

“Elder Li, this was given to us by Steward Zhuo. So don’t go against his
decision!” Qiu Yanhai guarded the jade slip, watching Li Jingtian as if
he was an archenemy to the couple.

The two loved each other, but having been in the martial world for so
long, the promise of power could hardly be denied. Hearing the return of
the Life and Death Art being so gargantuan, they’d take it even if it
was just a third chance of success.

How could they have ever reached the 5th layer of Radiant Stage if they
didn’t have this bit of boldness?

Though Li Jingtian’s eyes never faltered from the jade slip.

Zhuo Fan dismissed his fervent greed, “Elder Li, it’s not for you. I’ll
be blunt. Train it, and die!”

“What nonsense is that? With my talent, my aptitude, my power, I am
better than them in everything!” Li Jingtian rebuked.

Zhuo Fan shrugged and turned to the two.

The couple was now eagerly combing through the information in the jade
slip. Fifteen minutes later, they looked dumbfounded, sporting an extra
red face.

Li Jingtian was startled and impatient, “Well, spit it out, is the art
so intricate not even you two can unravel? Give it here, let this old
man have a look!”

“Beat it! It won’t do you any good even if you do look!” Xue Qingjian
glared at him. Qiu Yanhai lowered his head in embarrassment, “He-he-he,
Steward Zhuo, just where did you pick a dual cultivation art? You’re
putting us on the spot!”

Dual cultivation art?

Li Jingtian’s eyes bugged out as he stammered.

Zhuo Fan cracked up, “Ha-ha-ha, Life and Death Art needs two people that
are closer to each other than their relatives yet of opposite
cultivation methods. Only this can bring out its power. If your feelings
are true, they will be conveyed and fruit will blossom. If all you have
is lust, death follows! Elder Li, you and me are lone wolves, it doesn’t
suit us!”

Li Jingtian only smirked. The couple felt quite shy at this point, then
blushed harder as they looked at each other.

“Steward Zhuo, we also… can’t cultivate it!” Qiu Yanhai twiddled his
thumbs, “Uhm, me and Qingjian never actually done… that.”

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan asked, “You’ve never done it for decades
yet are so in tune with each other? Then what are you waiting for?”

Luo Yunchang clapped, “It’s been ages since we had a wedding in the Luo
clan. Please let me arrange it all for the elders on a most auspicious
day!”

The couple’s faces went redder, acting like shy teenagers.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened and shouted, “What auspicious, what arrangement?
That’s so quaint and cliche! Just get it on already and train that art!
Blast it, for decades you’ve been around a belle, yet never tapped that
fine booty. Shame on you! She even dolled up for decades for you in
vain. So get your ass in gear already!”

Bam!

Zhuo Fan kicked Qiu Yanhai’s ass, but the old geezer wasn’t the least
bit angry. He took Xue Qingjian’s hand and left giggling, “Qingjian,
it’s Steward Zhuo’s order. I don’t have a choice. For the sake of the
clan, we must bear through this hardship, ha-ha-ha…”

“Pervert!” Xue Qingjian rolled her eyes, yet left with her blushing head
lowered.

Luo Yunchang watched the loving couple in envy. She turned to Zhuo Fan
with a pout, “You say that, but you are no different!”

Zhuo Fan looked at her, oblivious.

Li Jingtian laughed, “Steward Zhuo, you shouldn’t waste…”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes snapped to him before he finished, scaring him from
continuing.

[So you do understand. Young miss, I did my best to help you up to
here.] Li Jingtian started looking elsewhere.

All of a sudden, Yan Song started flattering Zhuo Fan, “”Steward Zhuo,
please give me an art too. I…

“Didn’t I give you refining skills?” Zhuo Fan asked.

Yan Song scratched his head, “Ha-ha-ha, now that you mention it. But I’m
a cultivator first, before an alchemist, one with dreams of greatness…”

“Fine fine, I understand perfectly!” Zhuo Fan offered a jade slip, “I am
not too fond of poisons, but since you’re with me, I will be sure to
give you what you deserve. This here is a high profound ranked martial
art, Nine Nines Fantasy Palm. It also contains the formula for making
the world’s 81 strangest poisons.

“Beside the myriad of palm attacks, it also wields 81 poisons, each with
81 variations. Each change conforms to any man, to any environment, ever
evolving. In short, the poison’s only cure is if you remove it yourself.
It is thus named, Lord Over Life and Death. Take it and go!”

Yan Song took the jade slip with trembling hands and fervent gaze, “This
is leagues above the Rainbow Cloud Palm. It’s incomparable. He-he-he,
Steward Zhuo, you are so amazing and grand. I knew I made the right
choice following you!”

“Cut the flattery, just make sure to give your all in your tasks!” Zhuo
Fan waved him off.

Li Jingtian stroked his chin. [What is up with today? Steward Zhuo is
handing treasures left and right! Forget the odd couple, he’s even given
Yan Song something after just one word of pleading.]

[Should I also get my game on and act as cute as possible to squeeze
Steward Zhuo of some goodies?]

But he shook his head in the end. He knew very well when to stop. It was
better to do it after he trained Wraith Art to peak first.

But then, a sudden shout came from outside Blackwind Mountain, “Brother,
I came to visit!”

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and shook his head after knowing who it was…

Chapter 218 - Acting Bestowed Elder

Chapter 218, Acting Bestowed Elder

Zhuo Fan ended the meeting with a shake of his hand, sending the elders
into obscurity. He had no intention of showing the world Luo clan’s
experts.

He turned to Luo Yunchang with a smile, “Young miss, I would like you to
kindly welcome our honored guest.”

Luo Yunchang had no idea who dropped by, but since Zhuo Fan wished her
to go, she would gladly do it. And of course, since she was a young
miss, she had a role to play.

Her dainty hand raised, Luo Yunchang softly spoke, “Steward Zhuo, please
help me to our guest!”

He rolled his eyes, [She’s no disabled seventy year old hag, what help?]

Nevertheless, towards this silly request, Zhuo Fan didn’t flare out, as
to not receive this pampered miss’ tongue lashing. So he took her
outstretched arm.

It would never ever cross the past Zhuo Fan’s mind to do such a thing.
But now, Zhuo Fan found the rough edges of his character had smoothed
over, somewhat. Particularly in the case of young miss, where he caved
quite easily!

[Goddammit! How can I still be a Demonic Emperor?] Zhuo Fan cursed but
wasn’t that angry, quite happy in fact. As if enjoying the moment.

Luo Yunchang stole a glance at the forced Zhuo Fan and giggled a sweet
laughter.

The two thus descended, passed the arrays and off the mountain. What
greeted them was another mountain, uh, more aptly put, a mountain of a
man!

Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened.

Not from being impressed by the newcomer’s imposing manner, but from
recognition. In fact, he was Zhuo Fan’s brother who he liked a lot!

They were speechless because, [How can any human get so fat?]

Yes siree, the ‘man’ before them was the third prince of the empire, his
sworn brother, Yuwen Cong. The man looked like a veritable wall blocking
the view of the two, hoisted on two thick and trembling legs.

Today was sunny and warm, but Yuwen Cong’s head was soaked in sweat, and
kept on sweating buckets.

“Brother, you finally came! I almost… couldn’t take it…” Yuwen Cong
gasped, wiping his head again and again with a handkerchief, only to be
dripping wet the next second. The servant rushed to replace it.

On his right was another familiar face to Zhuo Fan, Jade Flute Divine
Sword, Fang Qiubai. Having long given up on this bloke of a disciple,
Fang Qiubai was watching the four 5th-grade arrays in shock and awe.

The two were leading twenty yellow dressed elders. Their chests stuck
out, their manners filled with power. They looked like no servants of
the third prince, more like guards.

Zhuo Fan found his face twitching seeing the sweat soaked Yuwen Cong and
sighed, “Oh please. It’s your fault for running all the way here, fatty!
“

“Can you blame me? I wouldn’t have gone all out if it weren’t for
imperial father’s edict!” The fatty sighed and started fanning himself
with his hand, “Hurry and take me up the mountain. It’s too hot here!”

Right then, around ten people came around him to lift him up after a
strenuous effort, taking one toiling step after another.

And each step left behind a deep mark.

These servants weren’t experts, just in the Qi Condensation Stage. But
seeing how even they were having the worst time of their lives carrying
the fatty, Zhuo Fan muttered, “Fatty, you’re goddamn fatter!”

“Don’t say it! Imperial father is in a bad mood. Every time that
happens, he takes it out on me and leaves me suffering. I was too
stressed to even eat or drink yet the next thing I know I’m up to 400 kg
in weight. Oh, the horror!”

He sighed each time he slapped his belly. This act of his made the men
below him stagger. Their bent backs were creaking.

Luo Yunchang couldn’t bear to look a second more. Zhuo Fan was
speechless.

[You don’t eat from stress yet still gained so much weight? How damn fat
will you be then if you’re in a perky mood? How much will you eat?]

“You’re a true marvel!” Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed.

The fatty snickered, “Thank you, but you’re just the same. We brothers
are the marvels of the world! “

Zhuo Fan’s mood sank, [Are you showing off or making yourself look
goddamn better than me?]

So Zhuo Fan switched targets to Fang Qiubai, “Mr. Fang, it’s been a long
time. Do you perhaps not care what becomes of this fatty?”

“Not in the least!”

With a lazy wave, Fang Qiubai smiled, “A noble man has noble qualities!”

Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes, [I was wondering what made this fatty so
feisty without caring about consequences. It’s all because his master
encourages it.]

[Truly, if the base is crooked, the top is out of whack!]

“By the way, Zhuo Fan, you’ve been stirring quite the storm lately,
throwing the whole Tianyu in chaos!” Fang Qiubai eyed him, “But that’s
understandable. You can’t survive without going out of line. There may
have not been a Luo clan today if it weren’t for you monkeying around!”

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan took a long look at him, feeling his words
held another meaning.

But instead of continuing, he laughed, “Let’s talk it out inside!”

Then he started flying up Blackwind Mountain. Finding the fatty way too
slow, Fang Qiubai lifted him along with a wave.

The servants found themselves lighter and fell on the ground in bliss.
They cursed, [carrying that damn tub of lard will get us killed!]

As for the elders in yellow, they followed as well.

Zhuo Fan and Luo Yunchang took the weary servants too. The servants
finally had the leisure to not mind the weight.

At the peak of Blackwind Mountain, the fatty was working his damndest in
wiping the sweat off himself under a pavilion. Fang Qiubai was at the
side, with poise and grace.

Seeing Zhuo Fan coming up with the servants, the fatty beckoned, “Hurry
up and fan me!”

The servants shook their heads and started working hard at the fatty’s
side.

Now the fatty was finally feeling like himself, letting the occasional
cry of appreciation.

Zhuo Fan shook his head, [This fatty wasn’t like this three years ago.
Why is he so sleazy all of a sudden?]

What had him truly baffled however, [Why aren’t the old guys joining in
with the servants?]

Zhuo Fan pointed, “Fatty, aren’t they yours as well? Why are they
standing around idle?”

“How could they be? Do you know what their cultivation is?” The fatty
eyes widened.

Zhuo Fan blinked, “Profound Heaven!”

“Yes, Profound Heaven experts. How could I have them do such a thing? It
will be too humiliating for them.” The fatty spoke upright.

Zhuo Fan thought so as well. He recalls how he would often insult the
Radiant Stage experts when he beckons them but never asked them to pour
tea for him. It was simply overkill. He found no point in respecting
anyone whose talents were of no use.

[Am I not one to respect talents and make use of their abilities fully?]

[Ha-ha-ha, probably not.] Since he always saw others with a cynical eye
and never showed any respect. Anyways, who in the mortal domain was
worthy of the Demonic Emperor’s respect?

Zhuo Fan shook his head, [With different statuses there are different
attitudes!]

Just then, fatty struggled to walk to him and smiled, “Brother, to be
honest, these Profound Heaven experts aren’t mine, but yours!”

“Mine?”

“Uh, no no no, that’s not right either. You’re just Luo clan’s steward.
How can they be yours? I mean to say that they are elders who my
imperial father offered to the Luo clan. Your clan just got a gift
falling into your lap and it’s rise is just around the corner. Well, are
you happy? He-he-he…” The fatty laughed at Zhuo Fan’s dumbstruck face.

Luo Yunchang’s eyes shined in glee, “They will all be Luo clan’s…”

Before she could properly enjoy this gift of twenty Profound Heaven
elders, Zhuo Fan spoke dully, “Fatty, even if the Emperor bestows us
these Profound Heaven elders, we will first have to see if they are fit
for the Luo clan!”

The fatty was totally clueless what he was getting at.

Luo clan, a third rate clan, had a sudden windfall of twenty Profound
Heaven experts and they should be wild with joy! Even a first rate clan
would be dancing around and thank the emperor by now.

So why was this Zhuo Fan so cold, even trying to reject them?

If he only knew Zhuo Fan had three Radiant Stage experts in the bag,
he’d probably take the twenty elders back that instant.

[Damn, how mortifying! We have Radiant Stage experts, so of course we’d
outright refuse some Profound Heaven experts. Not to mention they are…]

Fang Qiubai eyed Zhuo Fan with a deep gaze.

Zhuo Fan walked before the elders and sized them up. He found they were
quite strong, but nothing outstanding, while also detecting a great deal
of pride.

The kind that hinted at, ‘If I am second, no one dares say they’re
first!’

Zhuo Fan frowned, [What’s there to be cocky about when you’re not even
in the Radiant Stage?]

Pacing around, he spoke, “As of now, you are Luo clan’s elders. I am the
steward, Zhuo Fan. You are to listen to every one of my instructions,
besides young miss…”

“Humph, a puny steward minds me? Luo clan sure is an oddity!” One of
them complained before Zhuo Fan finished.

Zhuo Fan’s face went cold in a flash.

Luo Yunchang shrugged and turned her head, not in the least interested
in their fates.

There was no cocky elder in the Luo clan, not one! That was because this
place housed an even more outrageously conceited steward. You could
offend anyone in the Luo clan, but may god help you if you stepped on
the steward’s toes. Humph, your funeral!

[You’re on your own now. Zhuo Fan’s power goes unchallenged here!]

They were oblivious to this iron rule, but they’d do it anyway even if
they knew, since they came by the grand order of the emperor. Though,
they were most certainly gambling with their lives at this point…

Chapter 219 - How Is That a Rule?

Chapter 219, How Is That a Rule?

“Who said that? Step forward!” Zhuo Fan roamed the group with a critical
eye.

A thin elder moved, sneering at Zhuo Fan, “Humph, you snot nosed brat…”

Pa!

Zhuo Fan instantly cuffed the man, making him stumble, “That’s Steward
Zhuo for you!”

“Y-you…” The elder was dumbstruck, too angry to even speak clearly.
Forget about him being a Profound Heaven expert, just based on his age
alone, receiving a slap from a brat was a downright disgrace!

The blood rushed to his head and charged Zhuo Fan, “You damn punk, you
think you’re great? I will teach you a lesson for daring to raise your
hand against an imperial guard!”

But then he groaned and went bug-eyed. His breathing grew fainter and
his head forever lowered.

His chest was now sporting an extra fist hole through his chest. Zhuo
Fan glanced at his dripping bloody hand, painting a marvelous work of
art!

Sss~

Gasping, the other elders watched Zhuo Fan in shock. How was this 5th
layer of Bone Tempering kid able to kill one of them so easily??

Luo Yunchang yelped and covered her eyes. The fatty’s face twitched and
said, “Brother, I knew you were awesome, but these were bestowed to you.
You can’t just kill them!”

Fang Qiubai’s eyes trembled, watching Zhuo Fan with an even more curious
gaze.

This Divine Dragon had heard rumors aplenty regarding Zhuo Fan, but
seeing was believing.

With Zhuo Fan’s mere cultivation, the feats he pulled against others
higher than him left people shocked.

Zhuo Fan frowned and ignored the other’s unusual gazes as suspicion grew
in his mind. [This geezer is clearly in the Profound Heaven Stage yet
his speed and power are lackluster.]

He was planning on making an example out of this one for the rest of
them, by leaving him a heavy wound. But it ended with him getting killed
instead.

[It’s as if he’s…]

Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined faintly azure, releasing a short range
soul scan to scour these acting elders while hiding from Jade Flute
Divine Sword’s notice.

Sure enough, these guys were all posing as Profound Heaven experts,
while their power was far below the threshold. Just like Huangpu
Qingyun’s four porters in Drifting Flowers City.

If you’d must define these guy’s power, that’d make them fake Profound
Heaven experts.

But this fake stage was only privy to a Radiant Stage expert, while all
others couldn’t tell the difference. [In a nutshell, they’re goddamn
props!]

Sighing, Zhuo Fan barked, “Fatty, you tricked me! These are no Profound
Heaven experts! You brought me fakes! Just take them away already!”

Fatty cried, “You know?”

“Cut the act. I am not blind enough to not see a real Profound Heaven
expert from a fake.” Zhuo Fan glared, “Are you looking to see me loose
out when I’ll be facing other houses with these fake Profound Heaven
experts that are no more than some Bone Tempering pups?”

The fatty scratched his nose in embarrassment, “Uh, it’s just so you can
look the part. When others see these twenty men, they will be
intimidated… “

“Spare me the nonsense, and give it to me straight. Where did you get
these weirdos?”

The fatty scratched his face in silence.

Fang Qiubai chuckled, “Let me explain it. Their talents were meager,
imperial guards with slim chances to even enter the Profound Heaven
Stage. They couldn’t even take two hits from a real Profound Heaven
expert even if they did enter it. So the imperial family had a project
to raise many of such people into Profound Heaven experts through pills.
But it failed. They have the air of a Profound Heaven expert but not the
power to back it up.

“But as Cong’er said, even these props have use. Two decades ago,
Quanrong was about to invade Tianyu. His Majesty was scared of war,
losing his subjects and wealth and pushed tens of thousands of fake
Profound Heaven experts to the frontlines, scaring away the Quanrong.
Ha-ha-ha, you have to admire His Majesty’s wisdom!”

Face twitching, Zhuo Fan watched speechless. [No wonder he’s the weakest
in the empire’s thousand long history. He doesn’t do anything, he just
poses.]

Though he had to admit, mixing lies with truth was an ingenious tactic.
[But it has no damn use in a war between houses…]

Zhuo Fan threw the fake experts a look, then sighed, “Fatty, when you
give something, make sure it has some use, alright? Even ten real
Profound Heaven experts would do!”

“What, ten? We got none!”

Crying out, the fatty persuaded like a cheapskate, “Bro, real Profound
Heaven experts are the creme de la creme in any clan. How can they be
raised so easily? Veiled Dragon Pavilion has nine, and of Hell Valley’s
12, you killed six. Our imperial family is also short on them. Imperial
father can’t dispense any!”

Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Then if he wants to bestow something, let him give
something real. These fakers are not only cocky, they even start posing
in my face. Take them back!”

“Uh, that’s unlikely. How can we go against an imperial edict? If you
really do this, I cannot bear the responsibility. Imperial father won’t
budge either. Also…”

Fatty turned to those fake elders and shouted, “Also, you! If you go
back, your heads will fall!”

They instantly fell to their knees, pleading.

But Zhuo Fan shook his head still, finding it hard to accept, “They have
no skills. With you here, of course they’ll beg, but once you leave,
they will return to their haughty attitude…”

“I see, brother. Don’t worry, leave it to me!”

The fatty cursed at them, “You bunch of good for nothing bastards, you
have been bestowed to the Luo clan as elders and must follow its rules
to a fault, especially steward’s orders. Also who are you to say no?
You’re just a bunch of fakers! Let me tell you, this brother of mine,
steward Zhuo Fan, has fought Hell Valley, kicked around Drifting Flowers
Edifice, punching and smashing any and all from the seven houses. The
number of Profound Heaven elders from the seven houses under his belt
exceeds ten!

“You must be wondering, how is he still alive? Power! If you had his
power, of course you’d defy him. If you don’t, then you better goddamn
listen or just drop dead!”

The fatty’s ‘pep’ talk did the trick and the fakes watched Zhuo Fan in
shock.

Not once did they think this brat was such a monster, to openly defy the
seven houses.

No wonder he acted so high and mighty with them, even daring to kill one
bestowed by the emperor. The Luo clan’s steward being powerful seemed
valid.

They’d always lived in the palace and knew nothing of Zhuo Fan’s
exploits. So they instantly prostrated half into fatty’s howling speech.

Of course they were nothing compared with such a man of power. What
right they had to still act tough? Luo Yunchang was overwhelmed with
emotion, but mostly watched Zhuo Fan in joy.

“What do you think, brother? They’ll listen now!”

“Cough, Cough…” Ignoring the smiling fatty, Zhuo Fan faked a cough and
stuck out his chest as he spoke to the fakes, “As you’ve been bestowed
by His Majesty, and seeing how important it is to third prince, I will
accept, albeit reluctantly, such fake Profound Heaven experts.”

The fatty was over the moon, as were the rest. Their mission was now
complete, and were exempt from the emperor’s punishment.

“However…”

Zhuo Fan’s tone turned heavy, “You are to abide by Luo clan’s rules if
you are to stay! First, the most important of all, only me, steward Zhuo
Fan, is allowed to show off! Whoever dares to show off before me will
find their life cut short!”

They all turned dumbfounded, [How is that a rule?]

The fatty’s face darkened and twitched, “Young miss Luo, does the Luo
clan really have such a shameless rule?”

Luo Yunchang bobbed her head and held her mouth, yet her stomach hurt
from how hard it was to stop from laughing.

The fatty was speechless.

“Second, when you are outside the clan, I am the first and foremost who
show off, and when it’s your turn to do it, it must by all means be a
cut below mine! Failure to comply means death!”

They all held their foreheads. [So this is the Luo clan? Is this how its
steward acts? It’s just so hard to fathom! Are these what you call
rules?]

Luo Yunchang was laughing so hard she laid on the table. The fatty
patted his fat cheeks helpless and Fang Qiubai watched it all engrossed.

“Third,” Zhuo Fan continued, “You are to obey my every order without
question. When I say you kill, you comply. Otherwise, death!”

They shivered when he reached this point and nodded.

They may have submitted, but Zhuo Fan could see the doubt in their eyes.

To someone like Zhuo Fan, it was this doubt that spoke of the problems
ahead.

Zhuo Fan cracked jokes with his first two rules just to ease them into a
false security. While the third rule was to test them.

And just as he saw, the third rule was accepted with some hesitation.

If they were indeed bestowed by the emperor, the latter would’ve ordered
them to obey the Luo clan to the letter. So the third rule ought to have
been received instantly.

But they hesitated. This proved they had a different aim being here, and
this sudden rule caught them off guard.

Zhuo Fan showed a crafty smile, “This makes you Luo clan’s elders. Grand
Elder will take you now!”

“Elder Lei!”

Lei Yuntian flashed before Zhuo Fan and cupped his hands, “Steward Zhuo,
orders?”

“These are elders bestowed by His Majesty. They will be under your care.
You have to take good care of them!” Zhuo Fan grinned evilly.

Lei Yuntian was happy so many experts joined. But Zhuo Fan’s ‘good care’
painted a very clear image as to Zhuo Fan’s intention regarding these
fakes. To not let them wander off and to keep his eyes on them.

Nodding, Lei Yuntian took the elders with a solemn look.

The elders were sadly mistaken that they were now in the clear, having
entered the Luo clan, when in fact they would be under tight
surveillance. What was more, neither the fatty nor anyone else there
knew this would happen. The fatty then saw Zhuo Fan return to being
seated at the pavilion along with him and the rest.

“Brother, besides the third rule, the first two will have me killed!”
Fatty patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder laughingly.

Zhuo Fan spoke solemnly, “Without these two, how can there be a third
rule, ha-ha-ha…”

Fatty joined in, thinking the first two rules were to establish Zhuo
Fan’s prestige for the third one. But then he looked at Zhuo Fan
seriously, “Then let us get to the matter at hand. Luo clan’s steward,
Zhuo Fan, receive this edict…”

Chapter 220 - Esoteric Debate

Chapter 220, Esoteric Debate

“Long live the Emperor!” Luo Yunchang bowed, while Zhuo Fan remained
still, “Speak!”

Fatty’s fat face twitched helpless, “Brother, this is the imperial
edict. Looking on with such contempt would have you labeled a traitor
and your head chopped!”

“Whatever, only we are here anyway. With Mr Fang not looking to be a man
indulging in gossip, if you won’t tell it, no one will. Moreover, it
won’t matter even if you did. For the Emperor to issue me an imperial
edict, that only means he needs me. How could he kill me over such
trifles?” Zhuo Fan shrugged.

The fatty was lost for words, [Zhuo Fan is indeed a man who can see
through anyone.] The emperor wouldn’t do anything even if this guy lay
in bed when receiving the edict.

But where would the imperial family’s dignity be then?

The fatty looked bitterly at Fang Qiubai, “Master, how is this guy any
good?”

“Ha-ha-ha, extraordinary people need to be handled extraordinarily. So
you don’t need to mind this empty courtesy!” Fang Qiubai caressed his
beard.

Sighing, the fatty could only nod.

Luo Yunchang rushed to her feet and pouted at Zhuo Fan’s side. He
noticed with amusement this new side of the always serious young miss,
“Young miss, with your temper, you can’t be so frivolous around such an
important event as receiving the imperial edict.”

“Humph, what frivolous? What would be the point in kneeling if you
don’t? And you’ll be dealing with anything that arises anyway!” Luo
Yunchang snorted and stuck out her chin.

Zhuo Fan laughed and praised, “That’s our young miss alright!”

This was the Luo clan Zhuo Fan wanted, the best clan in the world. They
had to aim for the heavens themselves as well. How could that come to
fruition if they’d buckle just from some yellow paper from some emperor?

The fatty was almost crying, [Zhuo Fan is ruining the Luo clan!]

When he came here three years ago, the Luo clan was filled with respect
and saw the imperial family with reverence. But now, they were tough and
stubborn, with even the ever cautious young miss acting like this. They
didn’t yet make the part to face the seven houses but they already
started to show the same defect as them.

[Just how the Clan Head was, so too did the clan act. And just how their
steward behaves now, that’s what the clans will turn into.]

The fatty shook his head, dispensing with the courtesy as well,
“Nevermind then, it’s a verbal order anyway. I’ll be straight with you.
The Emperor intends to have you participate in the Esoteric Debate and
take the Regent Estate down a peg!”

“The Esoteric Debate?”

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow. He looked at Luo Yunchang, finding her just
as clueless as he was!

The fatty raised his bloated head and showed a cocky grin.

[He-he-he, you were so cocky before, so feisty, when you are in fact
nothing but boors! It’s now my turn to show off!] The fatty laughed and
preened, “Esoteric Debate is held once a century, a gathering of the
most elite clans. With the Luo clan not being even a third rate clan, a
mere cannon fodder for all these years, it is perfectly normal for you
to be ignorant!”

“Is that so? Then why is the Emperor inviting our small clan? Please
report to His Majesty, third prince, that after hearing your words, Zhuo
Fan feels sorely lacking and ashamed to participate in this grand
summit. Tell him to find someone more worthy of his attention.” Zhuo Fan
flicked the nonexistent dust of his clothes.

The fatty caught Zhuo Fan’s arm in panic, “Don’t, brother! Imperial
father will kill me if I go back like this! It is my fault for trying to
show off. Right, I will definitely frame Luo clan’s first rule on my
wall to remind myself every day you will be the only one to show off.
Please find it in your heart to forgive this foolish brother of yours… “

The fatty was begging Zhuo Fan in tears, his swag gone like the wind.
Luo Yunchang giggled and Fang Qiubai shook his head.

“Fine, do continue!” Zhuo Fan was only playing around with the third
prince. He knew when to quit.

The fatty sighed and no longer dared messed around, “Brother, to tell
the truth, the Esoteric Debate is really not some place where elite
clans gathered, but where houses bet on their honor to avail themselves.
It is a slaughterhouse. A clan can rise to the top in one step, or fall
to their ruins in another. Many first rate clans would find themselves
worse than even third rate clans! Brother, you must be vigilant if you
still want to go!”

“Oh, why do you say that?” Zhuo Fan frowned in doubt.

With a sigh, the fatty’s green and beady eyes shined with a deep gaze,
“This goes back to the founding of the empire, of the time when the
seven houses were in constant conflict with each other. There was no
open war between the seven houses, but none was willing to back down to
anyone. To settle the disputes among them, Tianyu’s founding emperor
signed an agreement with them. Anyone below thirty years of age was
going to compete in order to settle whose house would become the head of
the seven houses. These youths would also one day represent their houses
in the future. Their power predicted their houses’ power under their
rule!

“The seven houses thus no longer took arms and their ranks divided. This
was the inception of the Esoteric Debate. Gradually, more and more
outstanding clans who wished for greatness joined. They were chosen by
the seven houses and imperial family to participate. This is how the
current Esoteric Debate came to be.

“Yet, no matter how many clans joined, it was still the seven houses
that came on top. The others would simply be fighting for the chance to
be their vassals. It slowly turned into a bizarre situation. For the
sake of their reputation, the seven houses weren’t into this debate to
the death, while the vassal clans fought to the bitter end for their
masters. The survivors would thus be looked kindly upon by the houses,
and also receive their support. While the rest would become mountain of
bones for the other to rise on!”

The fatty’s tone contained mockery, pity, but most of all anger.

The seven houses’ existence robbed the rest of the clans their chance at
greatness, reducing them to mere expendable pawns. The Esoteric Debate
held each century left Tianyu stagnant, its power never reaching new
heights.

While the seven houses’ power kept on growing.

To him, the seven houses were Tianyu’s cancer!

Zhuo Fan sensed his hatred and nodded, “Then what does the Emperor
expect of me? Defeat Regent Estate?”

“Uh, that’s hardly feasible for a fresh clan like yours. You’re just too
weak!” The fatty smiled wryly and dismissed his words, “Regent Estate
dares call itself the head of the seven houses and harbors the ambition
to swallow the other houses because it never once lost in the Esoteric
Debates. Imperial father wishes for you to harass Regent Estate and
throw them off their game. Regardless of which other house takes the
head title, it would give Regent Estate a severe blow to their
prestige!”

Zhuo Fan’s brow trembled and shot the fatty a look, “Harass? You want me
to lower myself in doing such a trifling matter?”

“Ha-ha-ha, brother, I know you’re great. But you do not understand them.
Even interfering would be a tough problem for many other people.”

Chuckling, fatty gave him a yellow ribbon of silk, “This was the roster
for the last Esoteric Debate. See for yourself.”

Zhuo Fan looked at the names of the seven houses’ disciples in shock.
Especially since there were so many familiar names.

The fatty pointed out each one, “The seventh name, from Drifting Flowers
Edifice, must be quite familiar to you. Grandmother Chu Bijun is
renowned among the seven houses. But despite her bravery, she was too
weak. Drifting Flowers Edifice was dead last among the houses in the
last Esoteric Debate. As if to point out it would in fact become the
weakest in this last century among the houses.”

Zhuo Fan nodded. Watching the names, many issues started making sense.
It showed the precise power of every house lord, extrapolated into the
probable power each clan had in the near future.

“The 6th name, Merry Woods!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes skipped it the moment he
saw it!

[Humph, nothing notable about a claptrap spouting opportunist
pre-copernican obscurantist with no backbone to speak of!]

“Fifth name, Sword Marquise Abode, led by Jian Suifeng…”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes twitched and frowned. Since Sword Marquise Abode came in
fifth, then its power was also in fifth among the houses.

The next name had him widen his eyes, “Fourth, Veiled Dragon Pavilion
with Long Jiu and the other elders. Third, Hell Valley, with You Guiqi
participating as well. Second, Pill King Hall’s group led by Vicious
Pill King. And first, of course, was Regent Estate..”

Zhuo Fan’s heart sank.

All his allies were dead last while the top ranks were held by Regent
Estate’s loyal dogs. They were not only weaker than the head, but weaker
than everyone else.

Picking up on his thoughts, the fatty laughed and patted his shoulder,
“Ha-ha-ha, there’s no need to fret, brother. Thanks to your evil ways,
these houses’ power is no longer what it used to!”

“What do you mean?” Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined. He knew he wrecked Hell
Valley, but what of Pill King Hall?

Fatty chuckled, “The ranking of the last Esoteric Debate is like this
because of some amazing figures that appeared at the time. Hell Valley’s
third spot was all thanks to 5th elder. Diamondback Ape’s power pushed
back Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s third elder in accordance with You Guiqi’s
master plan. Without these two, Hell Valley would be far weaker than
Veiled Dragon Pavilion!

“Then there’s Pill King Hall in second place. They had Vicious Pill King
to thank for that. His poison was so deadly no one dared approach him.
Without him, they wouldn’t have gotten ahead of even Merry Woods…”

The fatty trailed off, but Zhuo Fan got the picture. Hell Valley and
Pill King Hall’s powers were mostly sapped, since their pillars were
cruelly and mercilessly killed, or ruined, by Zhuo Fan himself.

So of course the two no longer were what they used to.

Fatty grinned, “There were many illustrious names in the last Esoteric
Debate. You Guiqi, this mastermind, was publicly acclaimed as the first
genius among the twenty Profound Heaven experts of the seven houses
joining the debate. Then there was Vicious Pill King, the alchemist of
the millennium. Uncle Jiu also showed great prowess as well, known for
his Purple Lightning Gold Eye…”

Zhuo Fan nodded, secretly rejoicing.

It was great that his first Profound Heaven expert kill was You Guiqi,
avoiding many future headaches.

With You Guiqi alive, plotting from the shadows, his head would’ve hurt
like hell by now. But wasting You Guiqi was the same as cutting Hell
Valley’s power in half.

Thinking clearly now, his trip to Blue Expanse City was downright
ingenious. [As for Vicious Pill King, he-he, I sure scored big…]

Chapter 221 - The Six Dragons and Phoenix

Chapter 221, The Six Dragons and Phoenix

“Now that you have seen where the seven houses stand, you need to pay a
closer look to your strongest opponents in the next Esoteric Debate!”

The fatty handed another yellow silk ribbon on a heavy tone, “These are
the widely acclaimed geniuses of today from the seven houses. The Six
dragons and One Phoenix!”

“Six Dragons and Phoenix?” Zhuo Fan perked an eyebrow. That thin silk
caught his interest. He recalled having heard of this title in the
Drifting Flowers Edifice, when he shelved that info for later. Only to
now realize these were the candidates for top power holders in their
houses for the next century!

Fatty continued, “The Six Dragons and One Phoenix goes back a thousand
years. Along the course of history, these seven had always been the
strongest talents at each debate. No matter how great the disciples of
other sects and clans were, they still couldn’t compare. In fact, they
fell dreadfully short. In other words, the future of the seven houses is
in their hands, their power reaching higher than their predecessor, and
slipping ever so slightly out of the imperial family’s control with
every generation. This is why the Regent Estate is in a haste to unify
the seven houses now. Any more delays would make this ambition too
costly to achieve, if not impossible!”

Zhuo Fan nodded.

The seven houses’ growth wasn’t just a plague on the imperial family,
but on Regent Estate as well. If this went on, Tianyu would find itself
one day split in seven, with the imperial family still there only to
keep up appearances. But among the houses, the statuses would change,
one no longer being the head of the seven houses. With the empire
divided, unification would hardly be achievable again.

Zhuo Fan watched the silk ribbon in earnest.

“The phoenix here is represented by Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Edifice
Lord, Ascending Ice Phoenix, Chu Qingcheng!”The fatty’s finger rested on
Drifting Flowers Edifice, “Some say Chu Qingcheng has the beauty to
destroy nations and incredible talent as well. She was entrusted with
the power of Edifice Lord since young. With her strong character, her
aloof disposition gives the impression the men would only dirty her!
Nevertheless, her power is very much real, surpassing many of the seven
houses’ elders… “

“You saw her?” Zhuo Fan interrupted him with a smile.

The fatty sighed, “You can say that I have and haven’t. When she was 16,
I once went to Drifting Flowers Edifice. That fine figure, the grace,
the pose, are all otherworldly. Many years have passed since, but I
still recall that view as if from a dream. Ah, such a pity her face was
always covered. Despite staying for one short month, she only shot me a
glance. She is truly deserving of being called an icy beauty!”

“Is that so? But I’ve seen her!” Zhuo Fan nodded.

Fatty nodded out of reflex, then froze and cried, “What, you did? You
saw her, even… her face?”

“What else would I be seeing?” Zhuo Fan grinned.

The fatty threw him a look of envy as he rushed to ask, “How does she
look? Do the rumors do her justice?”

“Ha-ha-ha, as if. Regardless if she’s a fairy, an immortal, or even
goddess, no amount of words are enough to encompass her visage. Your
imaginations could never fathom the extent of her beauty!” Zhuo Fan was
once again putting on airs as if it was his second nature.

The fatty swallowed dryly and glared at Zhuo Fan. [Why is it that this
punk always gets the good stuff? How many men ever saw Chu Qingcheng’s
face? I didn’ get the chance to see it, yet this darn kid could?]

Luo Yunchang was sulking with puffed out cheeks, “Zhuo Fan, is she that
pretty?”

“Absolutely. I have the three days spent with her as testament of how
accurate my description is!” Zhuo Fan nodded.

But it only helped fuel Luo Yunchang’s anger while the fatty shouted out
of envy, “What, you lived with her for three days? Doesn’t she loathes
men?”

“Uh, that… depends on the man. I mean, everyone is different. You can’t
go saying because she was cold to you when you met that she’s an icy
beauty. Brother, this may possibly be a little harsh, but take it from
me. If I were a woman, even I wouldn’t want to be seen with you!”
Patting the fatty’s shoulder, Zhuo Fan sighed.

The fatty was sullen, his mouth twitching, [Goddammit, can you not cut
me so deep then make a joke out of it…]

“Although,” Zhuo Fan’s eyes sharpened, “Chu Qingcheng’s talent truly is
amazing, but it may not be as monstrous as you’d think. She couldn’t
even beat Huangpu Qingyun. If these Six Dragons One Phoenix are the
same, I can handle them easily.”

Zhuo Fan was pretty darn egotistical, yet the fatty didn’t jump to
criticize him. Since Zhuo Fan kicked a storm in Drifting Flowers Edifice
and escaped unharmed still, he was entitled to some bragging rights!

It was now that the ever silent Fang Qiubai coughed, “Kid, if you really
think so, you’d have the shock of your life five years later in the
Esoteric Debate!”

“Oh, what makes you say that?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow, his eyes
snapped on the Divine Dragon.

Fang Qiubai squinted, “Having been to Drifting Flowers Edifice in
person, you must know by now their situation. I’ve met that girl as
well. Her talent is outstanding, but the chaos around her had stalled
her cultivation, making her fall behind other houses’ disciples. You
said that she couldn’t match Huangpu Qingyun, but let me tell you this.
When Chu Qingcheng was twenty and fought Huangpu Qingyun, I happened to
be the judge. How do you think it ended?”

Zhuo Fan frowned.

“Ha-ha-ha, Huangpu Qingyun suffered a total defeat in one move!” Fang
Qiubai laughed, “I could see then that this girl’s talent surpassed a
Divine Dragon’s. And the other houses’ disciples are no different.”

Zhuo Fan nodded, not daring to slight them again.

“Furthermore, with Drifting Flowers Edifice having regained Chu Bijun’s
support, that girl can now focus on cultivating. I am eager to see how
far she can reach in five years time. But the other houses’ disciples
will most likely go even higher. I look forward to see this time’s
Esoteric Debate, ha-ha-ha…” Fang Qiubai laughed at the sky.

Zhuo Fan gasped, his gaze unprecedentedly hard.

[If there’s any truth in Fang Qiubai’s words, then these Six Dragons and
One Phoenix will probably exceed my clan’s elders by then.] He was going
to face the same level of freak as him.

Fatty nodded seeing Zhuo Fan’s dead serious face, “Among the six
dragons, Merry Woods has the Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng. Merry
Woods has the most uncanny speed among the houses. And Lin Rufeng’s is
even more so. He fleets about the trees like the wind, gone before you
even know it…”

“From Sword Marquise Abode hiels Golden Armored Sword Dragon, Xie
Tianshang. Sword Marquise Abode is an item refining house, also
specialized in sword arts. Xie Tianshang is many times stronger than his
younger brother, Xie Tianyang – a true sword genius. Sword Marquise
Abode’s sole profound ranked martial art, Flowing Space’s Nine Forms is
so intricate that many elders can’t even grasp it fully their entire
lives. Then they say that this kid had done it at nine, unconceivable…”

Zhuo Fan listened engrossed as the fatty got him acquainted with every
dragon. When fatty reached Regent Estate, his hands trembled, his gaze
hard.

“Brother, none of them can ever amount to the one I’m about to tell you
next. Regent Estate’s eldest young master, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord,
Huangpu Qingtian!”

Taking a deep breath to compose himself, fatty resumed, “His younger
brother, Huangpu Qingyun, you’ve met. But if you compare the two, the
younger brother looks totally average and the same goes for the five
dragons. This is the true genius among geniuses, a freak among freaks.”

“And it is this man we know the least about. But one thing is certain,
the five dragons and one phoenix are not his match!”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened, his heart jumped!

[Just now you said the five dragons and one phoenix are incredible,
making me cautious, but then you go and tell me none of them can hold a
candle to the sixth dragon. Just what kind of horror is that guy?]

The fatty patted Zhuo Fan’s shoulder and sighed, “Now do you get it?
Brother, it’s not that easy to interfere with Regent Estate as you may
think. Next to these freaks, the so-called demon Zhuo Fan everyone talks
about falls short…”

Squinting, Zhuo Fan took a deep breath, “No worries. At the next
Esoteric Debate five years later, you will see a brand new Zhuo Fan and
Luo clan. But first, there are some things that require my immediate
attention. I hope the imperial family can keep the Luo clan safe in the
meantime!”

Eyes shining, fatty and Fang Qiubai shared a look and smiled a nod.

“Rest assured, brother. Train in peace and prepare for the Esoteric
Debate. Leave the Luo clan’s safety to us. Also, if you stand out enough
in the Esoteric Debate, imperial father will use this chance to hail you
to the rank of Noble House. Then, Regent Estate will find it much harder
to touch you when it has to go through the imperial family first!” The
fatty just promised any other clan’s most cherished dream, but also
entrusting him with a near suicidal mission no clan would ever want.

Zhuo Fan nodded and sighed.

[Fortune has always favored the bold. In the thick of danger,
opportunity avails itself. And this Esoteric Debate is Luo clan’s best
chance to shoot straight for the moon…]

Chapter 222 - , Thunder Swarm Mountain

Chapter 222, Thunder Swarm Mountain

The two had explained everything thoroughly to Zhuo Fan before leaving.

Seeing them go, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, “Young miss, gather everyone. It
is time we go to Windgaze City!”

Luo Yunchang looked at him deeply before nodding.

Not much later, they all gathered, except the Grand Elder, who was
watching over the newcomers.

Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan took the main seats, overlooking them as they
explained what fatty said.

Even though shocked, everyone was sporting a serious face. The imperial
family’s task was of monumental proportions. It wanted this fresh clan,
not even a decade old, to fight against the seven houses with a thousand
year old legacy, each.

This was a fool’s errand!

Even Li Jingtian was frowning.

“Elder Li, you’ve been living in Regent Estate until now. What are, in
your opinion, my chances with Huangpu Qingtian?” Zhuo Fan asked.

The others settled down, awaiting his answer.

Li Jingtian shook his head, “None whatsoever!”

The eyes of others widened, their hearts jumped, and Zhuo Fan frowned.
Li Jingtian’s assessment was undoubtedly reliable, giving Zhuo Fan
further shock.

“Old Li, Steward Zhuo isn’t your run of the mill. Wherever in Tianyu
have you seen any other Bone Tempering cultivator kill a dozen Profound
Heaven experts in Tianyu? You’re saying that twerp Huangpu Qingtian
still holds a candle to our great Steward Zhuo?” Xue Qingjian giggled a
flattery.

However, Zhuo Fan shot her a glare, “Sister, sucking up has no place
here. Please take this matter seriously, or I’ll take what you said as
wishing for my demise!”

Xue Qingjian zipped her mouth on the spot. She could feel the coldness
in Zhuo Fan’s tone.

This also made the others tremble. The usual rampant and obnoxious Zhuo
Fan actually knew to be cautious at crucial times.

His act earned their admiration. He wasn’t one influenced by some cheap
words of flattery, keeping his cool when it was needed the most.

Li Jingtian secretly approved, “Steward Zhuo, to be blunt, third prince
and Fang Qiubai didn’t see the real him, only speaking based on mere
hearsay. But even if they had seen him, they’d have the same impression.
Poise of a king and a talent of a freak!”

Zhuo Fan squinted, “Go on!”

“As Elder Xue mentioned, Steward Zhuo’s Bone Tempering cultivation is
enough to kill Profound Heaven experts. But I feel the need to enlighten
everyone here that Steward Zhuo isn’t the first to have done this. Ten
years ago, Huangpu Qingtian, in his 2nd layer of Bone Tempering Stage,
easily defeated Regent Estate’s Profound Heaven elders. As you all know,
their elders are unlike You Guiqi and the others. Every one of them
trained in Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”

“How is that possible?!”

Even Zhuo Fan couldn’t help but cry out. His victories over Profound
Heaven experts were thanks to his Lightning Wings and Diamond Sand body.
He never thought it possible for a second method to exist into making
another reach such power.

Li Jingtian read this from his reaction and smiled dejectedly, “They are
the freaks roaming this world. It’s as if they were born to trample
everyone else under their feet. Before I left, he had always been under
the High Venerable’s tutelage and I am unsure of his progress. But no
question about it, he is in the Profound Heaven Stage just as Huangpu
Qingyun. At least in the 5th layer! His real power is hard to fathom… “

Up to this point, Zhuo Fan had been in a constant frown. He never once
saw it possible for one man’s exceptional talent to reach such an
incredible level. Thus, he refused to believe one man’s talent could be
so monstrous!

“Taking into account Old Li’s opinion, does this mean Steward Zhuo has
not even a glimmer of hope in beating him?” Qiu Yanhai turned to Zhuo
Fan in worry.

He was no longer hating Zhuo Fan for forcing them to join, on the
contrary, he was completely grateful. Without Zhuo Fan, he and Xue
Qingjian wouldn’t have grown so powerful so quickly.

Zhuo Fan was their matchmaker and was worried for his safety.

Chuckling, Li Jingtian said, “That may hardly be the case. What I spoke
of was in terms of strength. It just means Steward Zhuo is unable to
face him head on. Others are clueless to Steward Zhuo’s tricks, but
which elder among us isn’t clear on how he operates? Remember how every
one of us joined the Luo clan!”

They all looked at each other and burst out laughing.

Indeed, the dread of Zhuo Fan wasn’t based on power, but a shrewdness
similar to You Guiqi’s. It involved schemes hardly anyone could pierce!

Taking that into account as well, then Zhuo Fan’s chances were through
the roof…

Yan Song praised, “This Esoteric Debate may very well be the strongest
since its inception. Thank my lucky stars I joined the one last century,
or I may as well turn into cannon fodder in this one!”

The others cracked up again, to which Zhuo Fan just smiled. But one name
carved itself in his heart, Huangpu Qingtian!

“Elders, do any of you know of a place with thick thunderclouds in
Tianyu?”

One voice spoke, “Why does Steward Zhuo ask?”

With a flash, Zhuo Fan held a flickering egg. He smiled, “This is why!”

“6th level spiritual beast, Thunder Skylark’s egg!” They all cried in
shock.

Li Jingtian watched Zhuo Fan in envy, “He-he-he, Steward Zhuo has many
hidden treasures, even a 6th level spiritual beast’s egg. If it hatches,
we will have a beast that will even give a Radiant Stage a run for his
money!”

“Yeah, we toiled long and hard, yet only managed to get 5th level spirit
animals. Who knew Steward Zhuo would hold a 6th level spiritual beast?
This is a rare treasure even for a Radiant Stage. Steward Zhuo’s methods
are flawless!” Xue Qingjian and Qiu Yanhai admired him.

With a dismissive wave, Zhuo Fan smiled, “Please, enough with the
buttering. I only obtained this egg through chance. And because it was
damaged, I had to go to Drifting Flowers Edifice and use Bodhi Jade Sap
to restore it. Then various things cropped up and had no time to mind
it. Only recently I managed to restore it. But to make it hatch, I must
find a place with thick lightning bolts!”

“Easy, just set up a thunder gathering array!” Xue Qingjian shrugged.

Zhuo Fan shot her alternative option on the spot, “The lightning will be
too feeble and also costly! I want to incubate it in a natural
thundercloud. This is all so its power will reach its peak!”

Li Jingtian and the rest nodded.

Incubating it with poor lightning bolts would only waste this grand 6th
level spiritual beast’s potential.

They knew what was on Zhuo Fan’s mind. This was another ace up his
sleeve in dealing with Huangpu Qingtian. The hatching of this spirit
animal was of great import.

“If we’re speaking of a natural place engulfed in thunderstorm all year
round in Tianyu, only one place comes to mind…” Li Jingtian caressed his
beard.

Xue Qingjian was frantic, “No way! That’s a forbidden area! We already
have our hands full with the seven houses. Isn’t that enough trouble as
it is?”

“What place are you talking about?” Zhuo Fan was quite piqued.

The elders exchanged a glance and said together, “Thunder Swarm
Mountain!”

“Thunder Swarm Mountain? What’s wrong with it?”

“As Steward Zhuo can imagine, it is a place where lightning strikes
everyday, all day. It’s skies blanketed with thick thunderclouds. This
place had been like this ever since the founding of the empire!” Li
Jingtian spoke.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, “Perfect. I’ll have my egg hatch there!”

“You can’t!”

Xue Qingjian cried in panic, “Since sixty years ago, one of the empire’s
three guardian sects, Demon Scheming Sect exiled four criminals there to
receive thousands of thunder strikes a day. If we go there and release
the four by mistake, we’ll be offending the Demon Scheming Sect and
suffer their wrath.”

Zhuo Fan squinted, “Are you saying the four criminals are being guarded
by the Demon Scheming Sect?”

“Uh, not at all! Demon Scheming Sect just left them there and ignored
them ever since. They thought none would dare risk offending them and
let the four out.”

“What bloody reason is there to fear then? Even if we do let them out by
mistake, we just have to haul ass out of there with none the wiser!”
Zhuo Fan snickered.

Xue Qingjian was startled, [That’s true. But won’t that be too vile? If
Demon Scheming Sect ever finds out, we’re done for.]

But how could the bold Zhuo Fan be so cowardly? If he’d be panicking
over every trifle, how could he have ever risen to be a Demonic Emperor?

Zhuo Fan slapped his thigh, settling on taking Li Jingtian to Thunder
Swarm Mountain.

This used to be in preparation for Lightning Canyon, but now became a
means to deal with Huangpu Qingtian as well.

But before he set out, he entrusted an unbelievable task to Yan Song and
Lei Yuting. This task would decisively affect Luo clan’s place in
Tianyu…

Chapter 223 - The Abominable Four Scheming Demons

Chapter 223, The Abominable Four Scheming Demons

Whoosh!

Two figures flashed among the clouds. They were Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian
on their way to Thunder Swarm Mountain.

“Elder Li, how much longer?” Zhuo Fan rubbed his Thunder Ring.

Li Jingtian calculated, “By my estimates, we should arrive in three
days!”

“Good!” Zhuo Fan flapped his wings and tripled his speed, “The faster we
get there, the better!”

Hu~

Then, a sudden attack came at them in the form of a shadow. Zhuo Fan had
no time to stop, about to smash into it.

Li Jingtian intervened, however, and grabbed Zhuo Fan’s neck. He then
placed Zhuo Fan behind him, but the shadow sped straight for them.

“Ghostly Dragon Claw!” Li Jingtian shouted.

Bam!

With a devastating sound, the shadow was sent flying while Li Jingtian
stood unphased, tall and proud. Yet he couldn’t stop his red hand from
shaking.

“Elder Li, are you alright?”

Zhuo Fan looked on carefully, while Li Jingtian was frowning, “Don’t
worry. That item is a spiritual weapon, most likely a 5th-grade one. If
not for being a body cultivator, I might’ve ended up dead.”

Sighing, Zhuo Fan nodded, then breathed easier.

“Hi-hi-hi, you must be someone to have blocked my 5th-grade spiritual
weapon, the bone staff with your bare hand. It looks like I caught
myself a big fish!”

A creepy snicker accompanied the appearance of a man not hundred meters
from the pair, holding a black item in his hands.

Under a closer look, Zhuo Fan could see that the black item was a two
meter long black staff with a human skull at the ends. The wielder
however was a hideous pygmy. The evil air wafting from him made one’s
nerves tighten!

“3rd layer of Radiant Stage!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened as he and Li
Jingtian cried at the same time.

The pygmy was excited all of a sudden and gesticulated in joy,
“Hi-hi-hi, now you know how great I am so be good and surrender and I
may be kind enough to spare your miserable lives!”

“Humph, a mere 3rd layer of Radiant Stage expert dares show off before
me?” Li Jingtian stomped forward and released his mighty power.

The pygmy was cowered back again and again by the display and gasped,
“What, you’re in the 6th layer?”

“Ha-ha-ha, how the hell did you live so long to reach the 3rd layer of
Radiant Stage when you attack without even scouting your opponent
first?” Zhuo Fan mocked, “It’s my turn to ask the questions. Who are you
and why did you attack us?”

The pygmy cackled after sparing Zhuo Fan a second glance, “Ha-ha-ha, a
puny 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivator thinks himself worthy of
hearing your grandpa’s name?”

“You little shit that is neither human nor monster, dares to call
yourself my grandpa?” Zhuo Fan’s face was vicious as he glared, “Elder
Li, no more questions. Deal with this midget and let’s be on our way!”

“With pleasure!”

Li Jingtian had long found this pygmy’s attitude annoying. [Zhuo Fan
shows off because he is the steward of a clan, and he has both ambition
and power within himself. While you, a filthy little shite, too ugly to
even look at, and weaker than me to boot, dare do the same?]

[You have another thing coming!]

So Li Jingtian eagerly went on the offensive the instant Zhuo Fan gave
the order. The pygmy wasn’t scared by Li Jingtian’s charge, however, and
started twirling his bone staff.

Bang~

Metallic clashes rang all around. Li Jingtian didn’t use a weapon, but
as a body cultivator, he honed his body into a weapon in and of itself.

Every one of his strikes was no lesser than one coming from the bone
staff.

And since the two of them were of different cultivation layers, the
pygmy was on the retreat with every blow from Li Jingtian, despite
holding the advantage with a spiritual weapon.

He wielded the black staff with uncanny movements, avoiding all attacks,
but when his energy reserves were up, only death would welcome him.

“Blast it, I really hit a snag this time!” The pygmy started cursing
from exhaustion. Then, clenching his teeth, he suddenly jumped to gain
some distance.

But Li Jingtian realized his attempt at running aways so he shouted and
struck the black staff fiercely with his hands. This time, however, as
the the black staff danced, the pygmy was shrouded in black energy,
while the bone staff started letting out eerie screeches.

The next second, the vile energy took the shape of a skeleton as it
cackled at the two.

“This demonic cultivation method is beyond vile!” Zhuo Fan frowned. He
never thought this weird pygmy would be a sinister demonic cultivator.

But he wasn’t worried. When it came to sinister demonic methods, the
Wraith Style used by Li Jingtian was by far one of the most wicked out
there.

“Hi-hi-hi, you didn’t expect this, did you? I am a dreadful demonic
cultivator! With this low profound ranked martial art of mine, Demon
Shadow Bone Staff, I will swallow your body and soul. Scared now?
Ha-ha-ha…” The pygmy crackled from within the shadowy skeleton. Li
Jingtian only grinned, “Moron!”

“What, you still dare take me on? Then die!”

The pygmy sure had a screw loose, though he had quite the sharp pair of
ears on him. The mockery in Li Jingtian’s words earned his rage,
charging at him with the image of the skeleton.

But Li Jingtian only smirked without an ounce of fear, just as a black
dragon image engulfed him.

“You blind little shit, let me show you true demonic martial arts.
Wraith Style’s first move, Soaring Demonic Dragon!”

Roar!

With a reverberating roar, Li Jingtian’s power surged and charged at the
skeleton image. In a totally anticlimactic way, the skeleton image up
and vanished without even a sound.

Pff!

The pygmy spurted blood and was sent flying just as his staff snapped in
two.

A 5th-grade spiritual weapon was broken by using brute force alone. The
Mad Dipper combined with Wraith Art was a force to be reckoned with.

Looking at his broken black staff, the pygmy realized the error of his
ways. He really kicked a wall this time. His eyes began to show fear.

“Wait, hold on, I give. Please let me go!” The pygmy started wailing and
begging for his life.

Li Jingtian turned to Zhuo Fan for opinions, only to see him looking
elsewhere and letting him handle it. So Li Jingtian looked at the pygmy
with a cruel grin, “It’s far too late now, you little shit!”

Li Jingtian laughed and slapped his chest. The pygmy wailed, “Brothers,
your big brother is about to die. Come save me!”

“Who dares kill my brother….”

An ear-piercing cry resounded and startled Li Jingtian into seeing three
shadows flying at him. They were on him in a flash.

The creepy display the four put on and their pygmy appearances was

Chapter 226, Even Sages Are Idiots, Sometimes

Violent Demon heard Zhuo Fan’s demand and nodded, all while his brothers

The four looked at each other and sneered, with Violent Demon growing

“Four lunatics is more like it!” Li Jingtian mocked.

Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, getting pissed as well.

[You’re the narrow minded ones! I have studied the demonic path my

But these four blokes turned the method into a purpose. They couldn’t be

“Uh, dumb luck!” Violent Demon mumbled.

Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Elder Li, waste him!”

“Ah, wait, wait, I’m being honest here!”

Violent Demon looked at Zhuo Fan on the verge of crying, [Why is this

Who knew we’d lose and had to promise to look for ingredients in his

Especially those in the Profound Heaven Stage or above. Their rings must
be loaded with ingredients…”

“So, you saw us flying there and just up and threw your black staff at

complete the bet, but who knew we’d fail right at the start! Such a dumb
luck, waah~…”

Violent Demon started bawling like a kid which threw the other three

Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian were stumped.

[These little twerps are weirdos, no kidding.] One minute they were
savage, the next they played the victim, like wronged children.

“Fine fine, don’t cry. Whoever cries, I’ll waste him!” Zhuo Fan shouted
and the tears grounded to a halt. Zhuo Fan shook his head inwardly, [I
just can’t tell when they’re being real or just faking it.] But he still
had some doubts that needed clarified, “You guys know when to concede

“Of course. We are demonic heroes, when have we ever been anything but
trustworthy?” Violent Demon puffed up his chest and spoke
self-righteously, the other brothers followed suit.

Looking him in the eye, Zhuo Fan walked to him and squinted. The four
looked back cautiously, their hearts in their throat.

Li Jingtian came before Zhuo Fan and said, “Steward Zhuo, can we trust
anything that came out of their mouths?”

Zhuo Fan nodded and said, “Their heads may be screwed on wrong and

Zhuo Fan nodded, but his face was dead serious.

Like this, the two stood there in silence for a while. Zhuo Fan was

As for the four demons, they were watching the duo nervously, worried

Finally, Li Jingtian couldn’t help but voice his confusion, “Steward

“Hardly. Since Demon Scheming Sect threw them away and ignored them for

“Then Steward Zhuo wants to…”

Sighing, Zhuo Fan took out the Bloodworm gourd and frowned, “I no longer

Li Jingtian watched him oddly and blinked in awkwardness, “Uh, Steward
