Shuddering, Zhuo Fan went beet red and face slapped himself.

Zhuo Fan blushed hotter, even avoiding Li Jingtian’s gaze, “Elder Li,

Chapter 227, - Godly Tactic

Chapter 227, Godly Tactic

With that settled, Zhuo Fan had Li Jingtian release the four and restore

Before they could make sense of anything, a blood mark appeared on their

The four forwent their haughty attitude in favor of rolling on the

Zhuo Fan sauntered over and sneered. Then, explained the deal with the

“If you want to live, listen closely…”

Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and Li Jingtian’s mood sank.

[These little shits have no shame at all!] They were the most immoral

Zhuo Fan lamented inside and his hand sign changed, relieving the four

He finally figured out why Demon Scheming Sect ignored these dunces for

Though they had one redeeming quality, they were strong.

With the Luo clan on the rise, it needed strong experts. Once the clan’s

The unity tactic only worked when four people were intrinsically

Violent Demon trained anger to the point of being berserk. Once he

Because the other three’s power came nowhere near the first!

“Secret!” Zhuo Fan smiled mysteriously…

Chapter 229 - Tianyu’s Strongest, Invincible Scamp

Chapter 229, Tianyu’s Strongest, Invincible Scamp

brother, I won’t take you for an ignorant child since you’re a Radiant
Stage expert. Are you going to force me into servitude?”

“He-he-he, pillagers belong in prison, so it’s only fitting they do some

“But that was done by those four. What’s it got to do with me?”

“Eh, want to hit me? Ha-ha-ha, good. But let me warn you. I have no wish

Zhuo Fan walked back to Li Jingtian but his eyes were more and more
serious as he watched the kid.

He may be in the 2nd layer of Radiant Stage, but the kid was as calm as
ever even in the face of four people one layer stronger and another,
four layer stronger. He was confident in his victory.

And how the Four Scheming Demons were so scared of him, his power
couldn’t be judged based on his low cultivation.

Zhuo Fan whispered to the four demons, “How is his power? Is he strong,
weak?”

The four demons looked at each other and Violent Demon said cautiously,
“He is very strong, but still not able to beat me. The fact is, this kid

Li Jingtian nodded, bloodthirst setting into his gaze.

seemed as if the space couldn’t hold his power. The rocks around him
were pulverized as well!

“So strong!”

Even Zhuo Fan admired Li Jingtian. This martial fanatic was a true fit
for Wraith Art. Its power was displayed fully in the hands of this man,
showing shocking phenomenons.

But the bad feeling never left Zhuo Fan. The kid was just too calm, not
putting Li Jingtian in his eyes.

[What’s going on? Even a peak Radiant Stage would show some reaction.
But the kid…]

Yawning just as Li Jingtian got to him, the kid’s reaction to this
expert’s incredible display of power was to extend a hand.

Pff!

A groan had everyone watch slackjawed. Li Jingtian’s mighty power was
stopped as simple as that, by a boy’s hand.

The black dragon image threw a fit behind Li Jingtian, wanting to break
out of its shackles, but the kid had the dragon powerless under his thin
arm.

Even the world started taking different hues.

On one side, Li Jingtian’s power was still going strong, causing a
veritable storm to blow over, while on the other, there was only peace
and serenity behind the boy. Even sunshine warmed the gentle nature. The
black dragon’s onslaught held no sway here.

“How is this… possible?” Zhuo Fan watched agape. This may very well be
the very first time someone thoroughly shocked him.

Li Jingtian was sweating buckets, doing his damndest in getting out of
this child’s hold.

It was the same as a crazed bull meeting a hundred meter tall cliff.
Regardless of the raw power it had, it couldn’t budge the cliff one
inch.

The kid grinned, “First attempt!”

The kid grabbed Li Jingtian’s arm and just threw him.

Boom!

A huge rock was blown to rubble. Zhuo Fan and the four demons were
shocked and jumped in the air.

Once the dust settled, the view made them gasp.

The huge rock was flattened in an instant, and Li Jingtian struggled to
crawl from beneath the rubble. He spat blood and fear crept into his
gaze.

Only he who met the kid head on knew the dread he instilled.

In front of the weird kid’s eyes, he looked like a baby, easy to kill as
if lifting a finger. This was his first time ever Mad Dipper experienced
such powerlessness.

Zhuo Fan and the others were watching bug-eyed in fear and shock. None
saw it coming, that a pup had such insane amount of power. Not even in
the Sacred Domain Zhuo Fan saw such freaks.

Li Jingtian was in the 6th layer of Radiant Stage and a body cultivator
genius while using a profound ranked martial art. He had enough power to
face a peak Radiant Stage expert. But today, before a mere boy in the
2nd layer of Radiant Stage, he was powerless.

The kid didn’t use any kind of martial art, only the power of his hand
to topple and throw Li Jingtian.

[What kind of freaky power is this?]

Zhuo Fan paled, watching the air with a blank mind. There, the kid
happily sat in mid-air, “With the mountain ruined, I’ll be waiting for
you on that peak. Don’t forget, three days. Oh, and your ten
ingredients?”

Zhuo Fan wiped his brow, shivering as he took the ingredients for the
boy. The kid was delighted as he took them, “You’re not bad, kiddio. The
more ingredients you find, the Invincible Scamp, Gu Santong, will reward
you heavily!”

Then he vanished into thin air.

Zhuo Fan bobbed his head on and on, and only after hitting his chest did
the shivering stopped. He sighed, “God, that monster is insanely
powerful!”

“S-Steward Zhuo, who did he say he was?” The wounded Li Jingtian swayed
in his flight to Zhuo Fan. His eyes were incredulous.

Zhuo Fan frowned, “He seemed to have called himself, Invincible Scamp,
Gu Santong! What, you know him Elder Li?”

“Holy mother of god! No wonder I lost so miserably! Of all the rotten
luck, why did I have to meet that devil? How could I be so blind!” Li
Jingtian slapped his head, regretting so much he was close to tears.

Zhuo Fan asked hurriedly, “Just who is this Gu Santong?”

“Hi-hi-hi, for Steward Zhuo to not know even the likes of Invincible
Scamp Gu Santong, you must be dumber than a rock!” A creepy snicker came
from behind Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan’s temple popped a vein, his mouth twitched and glared at the
four demons, “You knew who he was and what he was capable of, didn’t
you?”

“Damn right we knew. We are demonic heroes, knowing all the experts in
Tianyu! With how renown this devil is, how couldn’t we recognize him?
You think everyone’s a bonehead like you?” Violent Demon snickered and
laughed at the two’s misfortune.

Zhuo Fan tightened his fists and cooled his anger, “Then, did you make
us come here on purpose, and face that devil? Moreover, that bet was
fake, right?”

“Hi-hi-hi, of course! We are demonic heroes, never done a good thing in
our lives. We were so angry when that devil suppressed us and had no way
to vent. But got you to join in too, and seeing you suffer brings a tear
of joy in my eyes! And have you ever seen a demonic cultivator holding
one’s end of a bet? You got served, ha-ha-ha…”

The Four Scheming Demons danced in joy and made a mockery out of Zhuo
Fan.

Zhuo Fan popped another vein, red from anger. Never thought the clever
him, the cunning him, would be had by a bunch of schmucks. [God damn
it!]

Ka!

Zhuo Fan’s finger moved and made a sign. The four were now sporting
bloody marks on their forehead, wailing on the ground from pain and
begging for mercy.

But Zhuo Fan held no pity for them. [If I don’t put these little shits
in their place, they’ll be the death of me!]

Li Jingtian watched the four’s pain in silence.

They were total retards. They knew their lives were in the hands of
another yet still dared to fool him. They only had themselves to blame
for this. Now that they were also caught in the middle with Invincible
Scamp Gu Santong, he knew they were in deep trouble now!

Li Jingtian frowned and sighed…

Chapter 230 - The Legend of a Monster

Chapter 230, The Legend of a Monster

“Steward Zhuo, we know our wrongs. Spare us!” Sly Demon rolled on the

Third bro, Sly Demon, who wished for nothing more than to see the chaos

The four thus entered their routine squabble, making it all so lively.

Zhuo Fan’s face twitched from all the ruckus, popping a third vein. He

“It seems a bit of pain is not up to your standards. Then how about we

Pff!

The four demons spurted blood and turned blood red all over as they

Zhuo Fan panted, almost blowing his top at the four. When he calmed

Shaking his head, Li Jingtian sighed, “I am not clear either, but

“What, three hundred years ago? How is he looking so young if he’s so

Li Jingtian was also puzzled, “I am not sure either. I only heard rumors

Violent Demon shouted his mockery, while the other demons’ wailing at

Violent Demon’s creepy laughter seemed to mock the seven houses, “Demon

Having recalled the bitter experience, Violent Demon started crying

Zhuo Fan nodded satisfied.

Violent Demon shook his head and said, “It’s so damn baffling that even

Zhuo Fan almost fell and his eyes started spewing flames of rage as he

Zhuo Fan’s hand stopped in mid sign.

The four demons had some screws loose, most of the time, but Sly Demon

[From the Sacred Domain perhaps?]

Zhuo Fan spoke, “Go on!”

Violent Demon continued, “The kid always had this appearance, that of an

Stage at the time. But after three hundred years, he is still as young,

slow I might add. What never changed all this time is him holding the

“Oh, that baffling?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan ‘s heart was filled

If this kid was an old monster, did he perhaps use cultivation to keep

But who was dumb enough to keep himself as young as a child? They’d

This seemed to have made Zhuo Fan recall a veil-covered face and the

He was aiming to become an overlord on the demonic path, how could he

“Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo sure is evil, thinking about plunging the world

Violent Demon mocked Li Jingtian.

Li Jingtian nodded, breaking out in sweat just thinking about it.

In their clash, Gu Santong didn’t even punch, only threw him like
nothing and already gave him a deep wound. If it were a punch instead,
his life would’ve been forfeited.

[Such outstanding power!]

Taking a deep breath, Li Jingtian shuddered from the memory and fear

This never happened in all his long years as Mad Dipper!

Zhuo Fan understood his state of mind and paled as well. He patted Elder

“Hi-hi-hi, then Pill King Hall requested assistance from Regent Estate

[Say what?!]

Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened in shock. He recalled how everyone spoke of this

[Just what kind of power does he have? How could he fight against an
entire nation and only as a damn Profound Heaven expert…]

Chapter 231 - The Third Divine Dragon

Chapter 232 - A Stubborn Heart

Chapter 232, A Stubborn Heart

The five Divine Dragons of the imperial family, the strongest in Tianyu.

And yet, the highly placed members of the seven houses had limited
knowledge about them, limited to Jade Flute Divine Sword Fang Qiubai and
Monochrome Chess Sage Sima Hui. The house lords were the only ones
entitled to the matters pertaining three centuries ago, that the
Invincible Scamp Gu, the devil who pushed Tianyu on the brink of
collapse, was now a Divine Dragon.

But this resolution only brought more problems than solved.

Zhuo Fan squinted at the four demons, “Since the imperial family is
rearing this behemoth, what is it doing getting scared of the seven
houses?”

“He-he-he, Steward Zhuo, you clearly know nothing. That last Immemorial
Sage was the strongest in Tianyu, on the brink of breaking out of the
Radiant Stage’s shackles and reaching the Void Consciousness and
becoming undying! A pity he met Gu Santong, that little monster.
Regardless of how strong he was, he couldn’t stand the kid’s ten
punches. But even so, thanks to his consciousness on the brink of
becoming void, he endured the kid’s onslaught for a full hour before
having his soul scattered.

“Gu Santong admired his dedication, who was willing to stake his soul in
winning the bet. This was how the man protected Tianyu’s imperial family
and forced the kid to stick to his promise. But Gu Santong was no fool
either. He resigned to only protecting the imperial family and nothing
more. Thus, he was the imperial family’s strongest shield, but not their
spear, ignoring any orders. Even so, the imperial family still won.
Would anyone dare disobey them, when they had him on their side?

“Of course, his existence was never accepted by the seven houses. If he
went berserk again, what would become of the seven houses? So, they went
to the emperor again and again for a resolution or they would be leaving
the empire! For lack of a better choice, the imperial family could only
ask for the kid to make a vow as a Divine Dragon to not attack the seven
houses unless provoked. Also, the imperial family will have him under
strict supervision. He is not to step one foot outside the Imperial
Capital without the Emperor’s explicit approval.

“With how Tianyu lost its backbone in that war, if the seven houses
withdrew, the empire was open to foreign invasions. And the kid had no
choice but to agree to this and protect the imperial family through the
oath! The seven houses begrudgingly compromised as well, and the
imperial family changed his title into Invincible Scamp. As if to mean
all that happened was just a kid throwing a tantrum. But now, the
Invincible Scamp who’s been locked away for three centuries by the
imperial family was set free by the Emperor!”

Violent Demon and the three demons wore their brows in a frown.

Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian nodded and sighed. Gu Santong was indeed
savage, but also honorable, far more than these little shits.

Zhuo Fan squinted at the four, and snickered, “Is that all?”

“Uh, pretty much. Now then, Steward Zhuo, you have the boundless honor
of listening to the legends of the much greater, much more heroic four
demons than even the likes of Invincible Scamp Gu Santong! Correct,
those four are without a doubt yours truly, the demonic heroes, Four
Scheming…”

“Not interested!”

With a sneer and a sign, the four demons started wailing in torment as
they tousled the ground.

Among the screams of pain they voiced their doubts, “Steward Zhuo, what
did we do this time? Is this how you repay us?”

“Nothing bad, in fact you did exemplary work. I’m only dishing out
premeditated punishment…” Zhuo Fan snickered and cackled.

The four’s hearts were in grief as they shouted, “Steward Zhuo, you’re
breaking your promise. You said you’ll forget about everything if we
told you about Gu Santong!”

“Tch tch tch…” Zhuo Fan mocked, “We’re all demon cultivators here,
right? Since when can you believe anything we say? You’re morons to have
trusted me in the first place!”

Pff!

Li Jingtian almost burst out laughing.

It was the four little shits who duped Zhuo Fan in the first place, and
now he was paying them back in spades. [Steward Zhuo isn’t one to take a
loss, regardless how small.] The Four Scheming Demons were on the verge
of tears.

Zhuo Fan returned their mocking words right back at them, leaving them
speechless.

Being tricked made them feel anger, sorrow, pain, the works. [My head
hurts, my face hurts, my whole body hurts!]

They could only resort to begging now. But Zhuo Fan turned a deaf ear to
their pleading, speaking to Li Jingtian with a smile, “Elder Li, do you
know what I’m thinking?”

“He-he-he, Steward Zhuo wants Gu Santong?” Li Jingtian’s eyes lit up.

Nodding, Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined with exceptional greed, “I’ve never
wanted a subordinate as much as I want him!”

“But if the imperial family finds out you’ve stolen their cornerstone
from under their feet…” Li Jingtian was worried.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan mocked, “With Gu Santong in the bag, what good will
it do to them if they know? They couldn’t handle his power three
centuries ago, but can they now?”

Li Jingtian laughed!

Zhuo Fan launched into the air, flying for Gu Santong’s mountain, “Elder
Li, look after them. I’m going to probe the devil. I am going to confirm
some suspicions of mine.”

“Steward Zhuo, don’t worry. Leave this to me, ha-ha-ha…” Cupping his
hands, Li Jingtian turned to four, their wailing music to his ears…

Whoosh!

Zhuo Fan landed on the peak. He saw Gu Santong sitting on the edge of a
cliff with his dainty feet dangling and enjoying the sunset.

Seeing him approach, the kid’s eyes lit up, “Oh, you’re back so fast.
Did you already get an ingredient?”

“Ha-ha-ha, yep!” Zhuo Fan nodded.

Gu Santong was caught by surprise and cheered as he jumped to Zhuo Fan,
“How are you so fast? Take it out and let me see.”

Zhuo Fan’s hand shined and revealed a purple leaf.

“Another 5th-grade ingredient!” Gu Santong was overjoyed, eager to dig
in since the smell was intoxicating.

Without preamble, he bit into it as he praised Zhuo Fan, “You’re not bad
at all. Far better than the others. Those four couldn’t get one in three
days, but you found one in an instant! Ha-ha-ha, you did well. I won’t
forget it!”

“Oh, and how will you repay me?” Zhuo Fan smiled.

Gu Santong hesitated, his eyes darting all over before holding out two
fingers in all seriousness, “I’ll give you two more attempts. You just
have to defeat me once and I’ll let you all go. With the old guy using
one, you are left with eleven!”

“Ha-ha-ha, so this is your reward!”

Zhuo Fan chuckled and shook his head as he cursed the brat in his head.

[This punk was corrupted by the strongest Immemorial Sage alright,
giving fake rewards. Blast it, if I could beat you, what need do I have
of you to let me go? We’d be leaving anyway!]

[But since we can’t, more attempts only means getting beaten by you even
more. Are you taking us for fools?]

[You’ll get yours, oh don’t you worry. In a jiffy, I will put your
cheeky ass in place. I’ll show you how it’s really done!]

Zhuo Fan snickered, “Then I’ll be going to get more and more attempts!”

“Go, go! Work hard now!” Gu Santong waved him off, as if Zhuo Fan was
nothing to him but a precious ingredient dispenser.

Zhuo Fan left with a smile and returned fifteen minutes later to Li
Jingtian. The Four Scheming Demons rushed to beg for mercy, but Zhuo Fan
didn’t even spare them a glance, “Elder Li, the kid’s only redeeming
feature is his brawn. Easy to handle!”

“Eh, what do you mean?” Li Jingtian’s asked eager.

Zhuo Fan showed two items. One was the Bloodworm gourd, the other, a
glowing ingredient more precious than a mere 5th grade.

Zhuo Fan took a Bloodworm from the gourd and placed it on the
ingredient. The worm then disappeared deep inside it.

Li Jingtian still didn’t understand, but Zhuo Fan explained, “In your
fight with the kid, I noticed how he never used Discerning Field despite
being in the Radiant Stage. So I tested him again with a 5th grade
ingredient. Seeing him gobble it up like candy, we’ll give him this
Bloodworm spiked ingredient and then…”

The two shared a look and sank into a choreographed evil snicker.

In the middle of the four’s cries Wimp Demon was about to say something
but Violent Demon’s glare cut him short.

The other two demons along with Violent Demon snickered. But their
mockery of the pair didn’t sound much different from their wails making
it fall under Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian’s radar…

Whoosh!

Zhuo Fan went to Gu Santong again.

Gu Santong was suspicious now, “How are you so fast? Did you get another
one?”

“Yep!” Zhuo Fan nodded.

Gu Santong was overjoyed, “You’re the very definition of an expert, not
like those four snails. Give it here and I’ll give you… ten attempts!”

“Ha-ha-ha, much obliged!”

Smirking, Zhuo Fan presented the ingredient and Gu Santong cried in joy,
“It’s a 6th-grade ingredient. You’re incredible!”

Zhuo Fan only smiled, but he mocked him inside.

[To make you take the bait and drop your guard, I’m even giving you a
6th-grade ingredient! Curses, I didn’t even get that many off of
Drifting Flowers Edifice!]

[But it’s fine. Using it in exchange for such a powerful expert is
bloody worth it!]

His eyes shining, Zhuo Fan licked his lips, staring closely at Gu
Santong. As long as the brat ate it, then he would have the strongest in
Tianyu at his fingertips.

Even Zhuo Fan couldn’t control his excitement as his heart hammered in
his chest.

But Gu Santong didn’t eat it and frowned, “Eh, there’s something off
about this ingredient!”

Bam!

Zhuo Fan’s heart hit rock bottom, watching on nervously. [Did the brat
find out…]

Chapter 233 - Complete Loss

Chapter 233, Complete Loss

“How can a genuine 6th-grade ingredient have problems?” Zhuo Fan
scratched his nose as worry crept in his heart.

Scrunching his nose, Gu Santong frowned and split the ingredient in two
with his fingers. A red worm was seen wiggling further into the
ingredient, but Gu Santong picked it up.

“What is this?” Gu Santong’s set his eyes on Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan was shocked inside, but didn’t show it. If the kid found out,
he’d be pulverized with a flick alone!

Zhuo Fan knew he couldn’t admit it even in death. He had to play
innocent, “Strange, how did a worm get inside an ingredient?”

“Yeah, ingredients are worldly treasure so how could this grand
6th-grade ingredient caught a worm?” Gu Santong stared Zhuo Fan down.
But could only shake his head in the end having not detected any
abnormalities. He killed the bug and ate the ingredient, “Whatever,
anything is possible in this world! But be more careful next time you go
pick ingredients.”

Zhuo Fan nodded, and hightail it out of there with a soaked back.

How did this kid, without a Discerning Field, find out about the
Bloodworm?

Luckily the kid didn’t doubt him or he’d be a goner!

Recalling Li Jingtian’s heavy wounds after a mere throw, Zhuo Fan
swallowed dryly as he flew away.

Yet Gu Santong still sat there on the cliff, chewing ingredients with a
frown. [How is it that an ingredient caught a worm?]

Whoosh!

Zhuo Fan returned like lighting to Li Jingtian. The latter was eager to
know the result, “Steward Zhuo, how was it?”

“Can’t you tell from my face?” Zhuo Fan spoke glumly.

Li Jingtian knew Zhuo Fan was depressed, “You mean the kid used the
Discerning Field for the first time?”

“As if!”

Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed, his brow in a constant frown, “And
this is what worries me. Without using his soul to investigate, how the
hell did he find the hidden worm? If I can’t understand this, any future
attempts will be pointless!”

Li Jingtian sank in thought as well. The four demons suddenly stopped
yelling as they tried muffling their laughter. But the pain got too much
and soon resumed their tenor symphony.

Zhuo Fan couldn’t care less, however.

“Steward Zhuo, should we try with eggs?” Li Jingtian proposed, “We may
not know what trick he used, but not even Discerning Field can find the
eggs. I refused to believe he is any different!”

Zhuo Fan slapped his thigh, “We’ll do it like you said Elder Li! But
this time it will cost me heavily!”

Gnashing his teeth, Zhuo Fan’s hand revealed a three-foot-long red and
white root.

Li Jingtian shouted in shock, “7th-grade ingredient, Yin Yang Moon Fire
Root!”

“Correct. This ingredient is hot on the outside but cold inside. This is
one of the few ingredients with yin and yang in harmony. Because of it’s
rarity, it is even valued higher than an 8th-grade ingredient.”

Stammering, Zhuo Fan caressed the red hot root yet ice cold whiskers
with a bleeding heart, “I got it when I was in Drifting Flowers Edifice
and couldn’t bear the thought of using it in the competition. Yet, I am
now using it to house some worm eggs. When the kid takes it, it’s the
same as eating a Spring Pill, quickening the growth of the worm!”

Seeing him so reluctant, Li Jingtian patted his shoulder, “Steward Zhuo,
you know what they say, nothing ventured, nothing gained. Think about
it, a 7th-grade ingredient in exchange for the Invincible Scamp, no
matter how you see it, it’s totally worth it. I’m sure you can see it
with your cunning mind!”

Zhuo Fan’s gaze hardened and nodded, “Yes, this is not just a mere
exchange but a great deal!”

Zhuo Fan let a Bloodworm into the ingredient, then soon after put it
back in the gourd.

Now the ingredient was filled with Bloodworm eggs.

Taking a deep breath, he looked at the ingredient with hope and smiled,
“Everything rests on you now!”

“Good luck, Steward Zhuo!” Li Jingtian cupped his hands.

Zhuo Fan nodded and flew to Gu Santong.

He was there in a flash.

Startled, Gu Santong turned to Zhuo Fan, “You’re damn quick, you know
that? Those four fools have nothing on you! What did you find this time?
Take it out…”

But he couldn’t finish as the sight of the ingredient in Zhuo Fan’s
hands had him wide eyed, “7th-grade ingredient! You actually found a 7th
grade ingredient?”

“Just lucky, I guess!” Zhuo Fan nodded.

Gu Santong took it and drooled. He was moved to tears, “A 7th-grade
ingredient, oh I haven’t had one in three centuries. Those bastards in
yellow only know how to starve me with wretched 1st and 2nd grade
ingredients. It took me three hundred years to reach the 2nd layer of
Radiant Stage…”

Gu Santong lamented his grief, while Zhuo Fan nodded inwardly.

Now he knew who he was talking about. They were the Imperial Capital’s
guards. He found another big secret as well. His cultivation didn’t rely
on training, or maybe training did very little. Only eating ingredients
increased his strength.

[Curses, if I take him in, I’ll go broke before I get to raise him!]

On second thought, [I might not need to feed him anyway since he is
already invincible. Yeah, no problem.]

Then, it suddenly occurred to him.

[The Imperial family definitely has high grade ingredients. Yet, over
the last centuries they’ve only been feeding him 1st and 2nd grade.]

[Was it done on purpose to hold this monster’s growth in check?]

[So the more power he has the harder it is for the imperial family to
control him!]

Squinting, Zhuo Fan realized Gu Santong was unlike the rumors painted
him as the strongest in the empire. At least the imperial family seemed
to have a way to keep him in check.

Otherwise there was no reason to stunt his cultivation for so many
years.

Zhuo Fan took a deep breath. As of yet, he was unsure if this conjecture
was real or not, but he couldn’t ignore it either or he’d be suffering
at the hands of the imperial family sometime in the future.

The imperial family still had uses for them and they were relying on the
imperial family, but who was to say when all of this could just go belly
up?

[In short, there are no everlasting friends. Anyone can become an
enemy!]

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed coldly!

Eh?

Gu Santong suddenly frowned and cried out. He looked at the ingredient
and shook his head, “This one is also fishy. Why are all the ingredients
you find so queer?”

His heart drumming in his chest, Zhuo Fan swallowed dryly, “Ha-ha-ha,
what could possibly be wrong?”

Gu Santong snapped the ingredient in two and pointed, “See that?”

Zhuo Fan saw the core of the ingredient in shock.

Gu Santong broke it right where the Bloodworm laid its eggs. The middle
of this 7th grade ingredient was white as the moon and released a deep
chill. But in this whiteness, there were some greyish dots, Bloodworm’s
eggs.

The average man would definitely miss them even with scrutiny. Not even
a Radiant Stage expert searching it with his soul could find them – Li
Jingtian bore testament to that.

Yet this little monster actually did it! Not only found them, but even
accurately struck their exact spot. Even Zhuo Fan had to admire his
prowess!

[This ain’t the time to gawk!]

Wiping his brow, Zhuo Fan squinted and faked, “Uh, what are you saying?
I can’t see anything!”

Gu Santong pointed his childlike finger, “See these dots, they don’t
match the ingredient. They are in fact closely resembling the worm in
the last ingredient. They must be its eggs.”

Zhuo Fan’s heart sank and his legs almost gave.

[He looks like a clueless brat, but his eyesight is spot on. He can even
see similarities between the eggs and the Bloodworm!]

Zhuo Fan was gripped with fear. [If the kid blames me for the worm and
the eggs, a single hit from him will reduce me to pulp!]

But that didn’t happen as Gu Santong waved the eggs off the ingredient
and started chewing it.

He chewed as he smiled, “I can’t blame you for this, just like the
ingredient with the worm in it. How can I throw away a 7th grade
ingredient? I don’t mind taking it, ha-ha-ha…”

Gu Santong laughed brightly, and Zhuo Fan felt his heart bleed.

[Ahhhhh! Not only I lost a fortune but I couldn’t get the kid either. I
lost everything!]

But as he was mourning the loss, Gu Santong’s words drifted over, “Hey,
you’re really good at finding ingredients. So why don’t I shorten the
time? One ingredient every two hours, a 7th-grade one!”

Stumbling, Zhuo Fan was close to spurting blood. He had no one to blame
but himself!

Giving the kid so many ingredients ended up with him admitting defeat.
And instead of getting him wrapped around Zhou Fan’s fingers, the kid
asked a 7th grade ingredient per two hours! [He’s killing me!]

Not even he had so many on hand…

Chapter 234 - Godlike Nose

Chapter 234, Godlike Nose

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

In a place filled with rubble, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian sat glumly on a
big stone. Four were howling in the background, completing the picture
with the odd twist and turn as pain stabbed through them!

Zhuo Fan sighed at the sky and stood, “I need to go give the imp another
ingredient! If this keeps up, I’ll lose everything…”

“Steward Zhuo, can’t we just flee? Why must we suffer at his hands?” Li
Jingtian frowned.

Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Flee? I am not giving up. I already lost six
7th-grade ingredients, but still can’t find that brat’s weakness. If I
leave now, all of that will go to waste. Humph, I’ve never once suffered
so much in a deal!”

Li Jingtian understood him. Now was time to go all out against this
Invincible Scamp Gu Santong. Zhuo Fan refused to believe he couldn’t
subdue him, not after wasting so many ingredients on the prick.

So Li Jingtian only shook his head, unable to figure out what Gu
Santong’s trick is to leave even the cunning Zhuo Fan out of options!

But just then, creepy laughter resounded.

Zhuo Fan looked back in reflex to see the four demons wrecked with pain
yet slipping a sneer among the tortured faces.

It was an odd sound for sure, the combination of groans and jeers coming
out of those twisted faces didn’t seem natural. You couldn’t tell if it
was crying or laughing.

But their eyes spoke enough for Zhuo Fan to pick on their naked mockery!

“What are you laughing at?” Zhuo Fan snapped, “You know, don’t you?”

The creepy laughter grounded to a halt, and the four turned around and
wailed in pain once again. Zhuo Fan tightened his fists.

This was silent protest. Zhuo Fan could bet his ingredients that the
four knew something!

“Speak, and your mistakes shall be crossed out. Or I can promise you
will go through such pain you can’t even begin to imagine!” Zhuo Fan
squinted and spoke with bloodthirst.

Wimp Demon shuddered, but Violent Demon’s glare stopped him from saying
anything, “Damn fourth bro, did you forget how he played us? If you say
one word, I will… ah!”

Violent Demon couldn’t finish as Zhuo Fan’s hand sign ramped up the
pain. He could only flop around from agony.

The other demons were startled and Wimp Demon was downright shaking,
“Steward Zhuo, Gu Santong’s nose is very sharp. It doesn’t matter what
you do to the ingredient, he’ll always find out!”

“Nose?”

His eyes widening, Zhuo Fan turned to Li Jingtian. Then his sign changed
and Wimp Demon’s pain up and vanished.

Wimp Demon moved around in joy.

Zhuo Fan spoke, “Wimp Demon, tell me all you know!”

Wimp Demon held Zhuo Fan in fear and nodded, “Gu Santong isn’t only
outrageously powerful, his nose is more so, godlike even. The last time
we gave him an ingredient, we laced it with poison, but he sniffed it
out instantly and beat us to a pulp. Then we thought of fleeing, but he
could easily sniff us out in a thousand miles, giving us another
beating. Then… there is no then. We searched seriously knowing we can’t
escape his evil clutches and looked for ingredients for him…”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes twitched, but he believed him!

He was amazing enough to sniff out the poison out of an ingredient. But
to track them down in a thousand mile radius, that was godlike.

Even Radiant Stage’s Discerning Field paled in comparison!

Now the pair knew why Gu Santong let them go about searching for
ingredients without minding them. No matter where they went, he’d find
them!

“He can smell the Bloodworm and its eggs? Is that it?” Zhuo Fan was
incredulous, “Such an insanely sharp nose. Is he perhaps looking down on
Discerning Field?”

Li Jingtian’s face was grave as well, “Steward Zhuo, does that mean
escaping is impossible?”

“Uh, I urge you not to flee, or you’ll only suffer instead!” Wimp Demon
warned.

Zhuo Fan took a deep breath and nodded. Gu Santong was even more amazing
then he thought. Now not only striking back at him was impossible, even
fleeing was out.

Zhuo Fan was glum.

But he showed a smile to Wimp Demon, patting him, “Wimp Demon, you’re a
nice guy. Far better than those idiots. You’ve been tousled by the
Bloodworm enough, go take a rest.”

“What?!”

Wimp Demon whooped in joy while the other three demons cried in dissent,
“No way! Didn’t you say demonic cultivators don’t stick to their word?”

Grinning, Zhuo Fan mocked, “It’s no promise, but a reward!”

Then he ignored the three. The only thing on their mind was regret, [How
could I be so stupid to miss this chance?]

Wimp Demon puffed his chest, strutting among the three demons crying out
in agony. The three demons glared at him with envy and hatred!

Li Jingtian was speechless, and held Zhuo Fan’s methods in even more
admiration.

These four little shits were immune to soft and hard methods, even their
thinking was screwed up. The only way to get them in line was with the
carrot and the stick!

Li Jingtian sighed, “Steward Zhuo, these four little shits had dragged
us into a swamp that’s hard to get out of!”

“But I don’t think it’s such a miserable encounter. At least we now know
Gu Santong’s ace!” Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes flashing as he watched the
peak Gu Santong stayed on, “In this world, what we fear the most is the
unknown. Now that we know what his trick is, we just gotta think hard of
how to counter it. No one is invincible, even monsters! “

Li Jingtian’s heart shuddered and looked at Zhuo Fan with hope.

[That’s how a true man of ambition is. He can remain calm even in the
face of Tianyu’s strongest! A pity such a talent is not a Clan Head…]

Rumble!

With a sudden loud noise, the sky dimmed.

Zhuo Fan sighed, “It’s about to rain. I’ll hand the ingredient over to
the kid then think of a way to deal with his skill. I must have him
under me!”

“If Steward Zhuo said it, then it’s as good as done!” Li Jingtian
caressed his beard. He now had blind faith in Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan shook his head and set off. From the peak came Gu Santong’s
angry voice, “Damn heaven, what lightning? Tone down the noise!”

Zhuo Fan was startled, then frowned in thought.

He heard a howl as a visible sound wave came from the peak and shot at
the sky. In a blink, the thunderclouds scattered and the sky brightened.

There was no cloud seen for thousands of miles!

Li Jingtian was shocked, “Gu Santong is amazing! With a mere shout, he
unleashed an even stronger ripple than I do with Necro Dragon’s
Screech!”

Zhuo Fan scowled, his eyes spacing out in thought, “The kid had always
been calm around us, not showing even a bit of anger…”

“He-he-he, guess we weren’t worthy to make him angry!” Li Jingtian
grinned.

“But, why was he raging at the thunderclouds?”

Li Jingtian shook his head, “Maybe he hates lightning?”

“Or is it fear?” Zhuo Fan squinted.

Li Jingtian shuddered, “Steward Zhuo, you mean…”

“Perhaps his weakness is lightning!”

Zhuo Fan made a hand sign and the demons’ torture stopped, letting them
catch their breath.

Zhuo Fan said, “Get ready, we’re going to Thunder Swarm Mountain?”

“But we’re still in the kid’s palm. Whatever for are we going to that
damnable place?”Violent Demon shouted.

Zhuo Fan glared and his finger moved, “My word is law, so cut the crap.
Or else…”

“Fine fine, we’ll listen to Steward Zhuo. We won’t complain again!”
Violent Demon lifted his hands in defeat.

Zhuo Fan nodded. He flew to Gu Santong and was soon back again, “Let’s
go!”

“Uh, what if Gu Santong comes after us?” Violent Demon hesitated.

“I told the kid we’ll be going a bit further for his ingredients and
that there’s an 8th-grade ingredient there but we’ll be needing three
days. He instantly agreed! By the time he figures out he’d been had, our
trap will be ready!” Zhuo Fan snickered evilly.

Four Scheming Demons asked in unison, “Trap?”

“We will lure Tianyu’s strongest, Invincible Scamp Gu Santong into a
trap!” Zhuo Fan grinned, his eyes burning with resolve…

Chapter 235 - The Thunder Array Trap

Chapter 235: The Thunder Array Trap

Editor: Silavin

Rumble~

On top of a tall mountain, from South to North, from West to East, four
cliffs stood! These cliffs were eternally shrouded by dark clouds with
rumbling thunders striking them at any given moment.

But the way these bucket-sized lightning bolts slammed into the four
cliffs was akin to lightning dragons. They struck them and then returned
back to the clouds to begin the cycle anew!

From afar, it looked like a nest of lightning dragons roaming around the
cliffs!

“Is this Thunder Swarm Mountain?” Zhuo Fan asked as he watched the
spectacle.

The Four Scheming Demons nodded with a pained face having vividly
recalled the torment they had to endure inside. Violent Demon found it
difficult to even speak, “We’ve been stuck in there for sixty-odd years,
having lightning pass through us every second of every day! If it
weren’t for that dumbass leaving a hole behind, we might still be in
there. Those were the worst years ever, waaah…”

Violent Demon cried as he pointed at the cliffs. The other demons were
also tearing up.

Li Jingtian’s face twitched. He used to feel sad and bitter as well, but
when the four described it, he felt disgusted instead.

[Didn’t someone just save you? Why aren’t you seeing him in a good
light? Do such people even exist, that would even call their rescuer a
dumbass?]

Zhuo Fan stood unflinching in the face of those crocodile tears. His
eyes ever shined as he gazed at the cliffs, “He isn’t a dumbass at all.
In fact, he didn’t poke a hole in the barrier out of carelessness!”

“Eh? He let them go on purpose?” Li Jingtian cried.

Zhuo Fan nodded, “This barrier may be fitting this place, raised on top
of this natural array, but it is very intricately and painstakingly
placed to leave almost no loopholes. That cliff, for example, is one
such hole. Only an erudite could see it! “

“What, on purpose? Then how come we didn’t see anyone when we got out?”
The four stopped crying on the spot and looked at each other baffled.

They looked inwardly for an answer, but there didn’t seem to be anyone
on friendly terms with them besides those in the sect. Who could be so
kind as to let them out?

Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan smiled, “He must’ve done it for his own
reasons. But he never would’ve imagined he helped me instead! Ha-ha-ha…
Don’t dwell on it. What’s crucial is that we set up an array and bait Gu
Santong inside!”

“This 6th-grade array is slightly damaged. Once I fix it, its power will
double!” Zhuo Fan pointed at the cliff.

Li Jingtian nodded and frowned, “Steward Zhuo, are you sure the kid will
enter? What if he sees the array and waits for us outside instead? We
won’t be able to hold on then!”

“No worries. Others will hesitate while he will jump straight in.
Because he is the Invincible Scamp, undefeated throughout his life. He
never suffered defeat which makes him cocky. And cockiness leads to
neglect! I believe there’s not a best Radiant Stage sucker out there as
this Gu Santong!” Zhuo Fan cackled with confidence.

Li Jingtian gave a thumbs up, “Steward Zhuo sees through everyone. My
admiration for you knows no bounds!”

“Enough sucking up to me! I am certain he’ll go in, but I can’t gauge
his power, making success uncertain. But with this natural 6th-grade
array and with us controlling it, success will be ours. Otherwise…” Zhuo
Fan frowned and sighed.

Four Scheming Demons jumped over and shouted, “What do you need us to
do?”

“Your job is to go in the array and distract Gu Santong!”

“No way! We have had enough of this array. Even in the Demon Scheming
Sect, everyone was against us controlling arrays! That’s blatant
discrimination!” The four demons demanded fairness.

Zhuo Fan’s face darkened.

[You damn idiots! Of course no one will let you. They were afraid you’d
go messing it all up and you’ll go farther than mere discrimination
against them.] His face was solemn, “I’m also discriminating against
you. But don’t you dare friggin’ meddle with the array as I work on it.
And you’d better listen to every one of my orders when Gu Santong gets
inside and give your all while doing it. Or else…”

Zhuo Fan’s finger moved, sending the four demons shivering into bobbing
their heads.

Then, they instantly switched to an aggrieved expression and kicked the
stones at their feet in dissent. [Why is everyone hell bent against us?
We are four demonic heroes, what’s not to like?]

Li Jingtian laughed wryly at the four’s lonely figures. Zhuo Fan didn’t
know if he should laugh or cry at these buffoon’s antics!

…

Three days came and went, soon revealing Gu Santong landing at the foot
of Thunder Swarm Mountain. But the mountain was different than before,
its black clouds gone.

It was a particularly sunny afternoon, with birds singing on this barren
Thunder Swarm Mountain. Only the occasional flickers on the rocks bore
testament this place was once flooded with lightning.

But Gu Santong saw none of that. He only sniffed and shouted, “You
bastards have taken advantage of my trust and good nature. Get the hell
out right now! I don’t have much time to waste here. If you don’t go out
to get me ingredients I’ll be bitter all my life. Who knows when I will
get to eat so many good ingredients?

“Listen up. I know you’re on that mountain. Get out right now! I am
pressed for time so I will forgo your transgression! Don’t make me come
after you, or you’ll be sorry…” Gu Santong’s childish voice reverberated
for miles.

But no reply came from the mountain.

Gu Santong was pissed, “Fine, have it your way. It’s on you! See how
I’ll put you in your place once I get my hands on you!”

With a loud sound, Gu Santong charged straight into Thunder Swarm
Mountain’s center. But just as he arrived in between the four cliffs and
wiggled his nose in search of their location, a fierce gale blew!

Black clouds started rolling in swiftly, submerging the cliffs in
darkness. Then, peals of lightning flashed within the dark clouds,
surrounding Gu Santong in the middle.

Gu Santong’s eyes widened and cried, “An Array?”

Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian hid in the tallest and shortest cliffs’ caves,
controlling the array. They snorted at Gu Santong’s shock again and
again.

[He-he-he, Invincible Scamp, your day has come!]

Rumble!

A thunderous sound came from above and a lightning dragon spiraled
around the four cliffs, setting up the barrier to seal in even a Radiant
Stage expert.

Gu Santong shuddered and frowned. He covered his ears and cursed, “You
bastards, is it not enough you set up an array, but did it have to be a
thunder one?”

Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian cracked up.

[Ha-ha-ha, only thunder can keep you little freak in check, who is
scared of it!]

“Elder Li, this is just the start. But be careful, the lightning may
have a heavy impact on him but I don’t want to kill him. I want him
alive!” Zhuo Fan transmitted words to Li Jingtian.

Li Jingtian nodded and laughed, “I got it, Steward Zhuo. We can’t have
those ingredients go to waste. I know what to do!”

The two changed hand signs as they laughed.

Rumble!

With another loud sound, hundreds of lightning fell from the sky
straight for Gu Santong.

Boom~

With a cacophony of explosions, Gu Santong’s frail figure slammed into
the ground, kicking up dust.

Zhuo Fan stopped, worried for his safety as he shouted, “Wait, why isn’t
he resisting? You’re telling me lightning is fatal for him? That’s bad.
I don’t want him dead!”

“Steward Zhuo, should I go take a look?” Li Jingtian suggested.

Zhuo Fan hesitated. When the dust cleared, the two saw something
incredulous. A huge hole in which Gu Santong was slammed.

But the child in question was unscathed, covering his ears and raining
curses. His face was filled with loathing but otherwise, not a scratch
on him.

“No way! Lightning should be his weakness!” Zhuo Fan was incredulous and
shouted, “Abominable Four Scheming Demons, keep him busy and show me how
he handles the lightning. Elder Li, raise the power!”

“Understood!”

The four shouted and the demons gave a creepy snicker as they shot for
Gu Santong in a series of afterimages. Li Jingtian and Zhuo Fan were
shifting through the hand signs.

Hi-hi-hi…

Hearing their jeer, Gu Santong sniffed and looked at the afterimages
with loathing, “I knew you were messing around here. I could smell you a
mile away! Shut down the array! I hate lightning the most!”

“He-he-he, lightning is the little monster’s bane. We won’t stop it so
what are you gonna do about it?” Violent Demon laughed, his afterimage
shifting to Gu Santong to land a punch.

But Gu Santong still held his ears and stood unmoving, despite his mouth
spitting out endless curses.

Then Violent Demon’s face sank as he held his hand and cussed,
“Goddammit! The kid’s hard as a rock. My hand almost got ruined!”

Rumble!

Just then, thousands of lightning struck Gu Santong…

Chapter 236 - Invincible Fist

Chapter 236, Invincible Fist

Boom~

Lightning struck Gu Santong constantly, smashing him into another hole.
Even a peak Radiant Stage expert would have a hard time facing such a
hit!

Yet, Zhuo Fan was still unclear if all of this was enough for the likes
of Gu Santong. He was Invincible Scamp, the strongest in Tianyu!

His eyes fixed on the settling dust, Zhuo Fan’s heartbeat quickened.
When the dust cleared, his eyes widened and gasped.

Gu Santong was still covering his ears and standing there, unharmed. But
his face took a darker shade, out of anger.

“Four Scheming Demons, how did he take on the lightning? You should’ve
seen it clearly from your angle!” Zhuo Fan roared through the
transmission.

Four Scheming Demons turned into gray afterimages around Gu Santong as
they reported in fear, “S-Steward Zhuo, this kid didn’t stop one
lightning. Each bolt was a direct hit but he is still standing there
like nothing happened…”

“What?!”

Four Scheming Demons’ report froze Zhuo Fan, “You mean to tell me
lightning doesn’t do a damn thing to this kid? Was my assumption wrong?”

“Steward Zhuo, what now? He is just standing here in the array but we
can’t do anything to him. Something bad is bound to happen if this goes
on. And once he gets out, he’ll want to settle the score! We’ll be
finished!”

Squinting, Zhuo Fan said, “Elder Li, the lightning isn’t his weakness,
but he always shouts profanities at it. I was wrong, he just hates
lightning. But this 6th-grade array is built on a natural
formation.Let’s use all we have on him. No matter how ridiculously
powerful he is, it’ll be worth it if we can wear him out even a little!

“Alright!” Li Jingtian agreed.

Zhuo Fan sighed.

Despite saying that, he had a feeling they’d fail from the moment he set
up the array. As this was all based on the premise his guess was right,
that Gu Santong was weak to lightning. He was now holding the fates of
everyone in his hands. He knew there was only a fifty percent chance of
success!

But he wanted to get Gu Santong so badly that he was willing to gamble
on that measly fifty percent, using even the lives of others. But even
in this case he had a failsafe.

Just escaping was also fifty-fifty!

If Gu Santong bore through it as well, they were dead! This was indeed a
very risky move from his part, totally opposite for his usual style!

“Steward Zhuo, I’m ready. How are you?” Li Jingtian sent over.

Zhuo Fan sighed, and his hands moved, “I as well. Begin!”

The two’s signs synced!

Thunder rolled and lightning flickered. From the deep and rumbling dark
clouds, tens of thousands of lightning bolts barreled down. That immense
power caused even Thunder Swarm Mountain to shake. It meant that even
the 6th-grade array was having a hard time withstanding such might.

The Four Scheming Demons were slackjawed, crying out in fear as they
retreated!

They no longer dared staying close to Gu Santong. The lightning this
time may very well smash them to bits!

Gu Santong, with his ears covered, looked at the thunder with pure
loathing and anger!

“Gu Santong, if you still stand after this, then you must be my karma
coming back to bite me!” Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan gnashed his
teeth and his hand sign changed.

Boom!

Hundreds of thousands of lightning bolts rained down. They twisted
around each other and formed a lightning dragon that coiled around each
cliff as it roared.

Such destructive power seemed to wish for the annihilation of the whole
world. Zhuo Fan was certain that the lightning dragon would turn this
Thunder Swarm Mountain and everything in a hundred miles barren. Only
the array controllers would survive.

He never hoped it would come to this!

But he was the Demonic Emperor, rising on top of a mountain of bones! If
he wanted Invincible Scamp’s power, mercy for some miscellaneous
creatures had no place here!

Roar!

The entire sky was roaring as it came crashing down!

Gu Santong felt the sheer brutality aiming at him, forced to squint at
the eye-piercing light. His ears rang from the sudden explosions and
only now, finally, his hands released them, forming a small fist.

Then…

A punch soared straight for the lightning dragon’s head, releasing an
odd ripple.

Gu Santong didn’t even put the lightning dragon in his eyes. His face
was calm, yet the ripple he released flew like a meteor, pushing back at
the lightning dragon.

Every place the ripple touched, lightning crumbled!

People would be shocked to see how it began with the lightning dragon’s
head, turning it into specks of light. The ripple then shot past the
lightning dragon and exploded way up high!

The rumbling and black thunderclouds were sporting a mile wide hole in
their center, allowing for the sun’s warm glow to pass through!

Pff!

Groaning, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian spat blood, thoroughly stupefied.

Gu Santong struck the picture of a god of war, in the middle of the sun
shining down on him from the wide hole in the sky. The two of them were
lost for words.

“Invincible Scamp is crazy strong! No wonder he could face the entire
empire and still win!” Zhuo Fan sighed, “It’s my loss this time! Elder
Li, patch up the thunderclouds, it’s time to bolt! Invincible Scamp is
out of my league! Or maybe, we’ll just get him on a better occasion!”

This was the first time Li Jingtian saw Zhuo give up. But the image of
Gu Santong easily withstanding a 6th-grade array left him shuddering.

[Only an extraordinary man could control such a freak! Zhuo Fan and
Huangpu Qingtian are also freaks but they have a long way to go to be
monsters!]

Li Jingtian smiled dejectedly and copied Zhuo Fan’s sign in patching the
hole in the sky. They then sent the order for retreat to the four
demons.

They no longer used the array to seize Invincible Scamp, but to buy
time. They would never get out of this alive otherwise!

This may very well be the first time he and Zhuo Fan felt so utterly
powerless.

Especially Zhuo Fan, with his cunning mind and foolproof plans. They all
were rendered powerless in the face of that kid!

Absolute power indeed trumped over any ploy!

But seeing the looming black clouds gathering, Gu Santong roared, “You
six bastards, I told you already that I hate lightning. Yet, you dare
continue?”

With a snort, Gu Santong stomped!

With two steps, Thunder Swarm Mountain’s four cliffs shook ceaselessly.
Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian wobbled, shaken to their core.

But the next thing had them swept by panic.

Gu Santong tightened his fists at the side, as if focusing his power.
Then he struck!

Hum~

Another ripple spread everywhere, making everything it touched quake.
With Gu Santong at the center, all around him crumbled to dust.

The ripple looked slow when in fact had incredible speed, leaving
nothing but dust in its wake!

Zhuo Fan cried out, “The kid’s power is insane. He can shake space
itself with a punch alone! Run, the 6th-grade array can’t do anything to
him. We can’t deal with him! Go underground, there’s no escaping it!”

Li Jingtian paled from shock.

He knew Gu Santong was godlike, but now it was no longer an exaggerating
description. The kid shook off the 6th-grade array as if it was a
breeze, an array that held Radiant Stage experts for tens of years
prisoners.

[How is he even human?]

They didn’t get to make two steps as the ripple passed by them and into
the horizon!

Boom!

Anything in a hundred miles was pulverized. Once the dust settled, the
sight was overwhelming and impossible to fathom.

As far as the eye could see, in any given direction, down to the last
blade of grass, all was just gone! Gu Santong leveled a hundred mile
wide circle in a blink.

As to Thunder Swarm Mountain and the black clouds, it looked as if they
never even existed in the first place.

Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian crawled from underground, shivering at this
sight. The four demons came out as well and stood agape, scared to the
core.

Wimp Demon was holding his head as it shook like a leaf. He wanted to
bury his head, anything, so long as it rid that little monster’s image
out of his head.

Gu Santong was an abomination! If not for Steward Zhuo’s timely advice,
they’d be nothing but dust by now!

Violent Demon lamented inside.

[Invincible Scamp is a real freak. We can’t mess with him ever again no
matter how Steward Zhuo tortures us. We must never agree to such a
reckless plan ever again!]

The four vowed to themselves. Though clueless they all were to the fact
Gu Santong was standing right behind them with a cold face. Bloodthirst
flashed in his eyes as he looked at their dusty backs…

Chapter 237 - Sophistry

Chapter 237, Sophistry

“I got you now, you bastards!”

A chilling voice crept from behind the four. Their body froze and looked
back in reflex to see Gu Santong’s furious gaze.

Scared out of their wits, the four shivered as they lowered their heads,
not daring to look him in the eye.

Gu Santong scratched his nose, sweeping the four with a cold eye and
snorting, “Who was it that threw the punch on me? Step forward!”

“He did it!”

The four didn’t even lift their heads as three demons pointed straight
at Violent Demon.

Violent Demon felt like kicking these bunch of ignoble bastards’ arse,
but he was weak as a kitten before Gu Santong’s stern gaze. He then
showed a miserable and crying smile, “It’s not my fault, I never
would’ve done it if I wasn’t compelled!”

“Oh, who forced you then?” Furrowing his brow, Gu Santong fists
tightened.

Swallowing dryly, Violent Demon squeaked, “It’s…”

Creak!

Violent Demon shuddered in that instant and his jaw froze open, but
could not utter a sound. As if something was shoved down his throat.

Then, a cheerful cry entered their ears, “Gu Santong, you’re finally
here. Thank the heavens, I thought we’d never see you again!”

Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian staggered their wretched bodies over. While Li
Jingtian’s face was tense from anxiety, by contrast, Zhuo Fan’s was that
of joy, as if guileless. He even went as far as give Gu Santong an old
fashioned cozy hug.

The four demons now knew why Violent Demon was choking on his own voice.
Zhuo Fan’s Bloodworm was doing its thing!

These two had the life of the four demons in their hands. And offending
any side now was certain death no matter how they sliced it. So the
three demons buried their heads in the dirt to avoid looking at anyone.

Violent Demon’s face twitched and shivered. He was fearing for his life.
Thinking Zhuo Fan would take his life to protect his own.

Getting out of Zhuo Fan’s hug, Gu Santong stared at him with resentment.
Zhuo Fan was startled and faked innocence, “What’s wrong?”

“Why did you run? Why did you set up a lightning array here?” Gu Santong
snapped at him. Li Jingtian swallowed dryly, his whole body frozen,
while the four demons shivered.

Only Zhuo had a downright shocked expression, “What are you talking
about? Who set an array?”

“You didn’t set the lightning array?”

“As if! You think we’d still be trapped with you if we could?” Zhuo Fan
rolled his eyes.

Gu Santong was speechless, the four demons startled, all while confusion
predominated to all present.

“You’re saying you’ve been trapped in there as well?” Gu Santong spoke,
his tone still carried anger, albeit subdued.

Sighing, Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Of course, or we’d have long returned
with the ingredient!”

“What, you’ve been trapped here just to get an ingredient?” Gu Santong
cried, now his anger deflated.

Zhuo Fan nodded, running his mouth, “Gu Santong, do you know why there’s
a 6th-grade lightning array here?”

Gu Santong shook his head, a telltale sign he bought into Zhuo Fan’s lie
completely.

“Because there’s a precious 8th-grade ingredient here. Someone used the
array to protect it!” Zhuo Fan spoke, “To help you get that ingredient,
we had to go into the lion’s den, and barely got out alive. But
thankfully you got here just in time! But why do you say we ran away?
Didn’t I tell you we’ll be going on an ingredient hunt?”

“Uh, that’s…” Gu Santong blushed, fiddling with his hands, like a child
caught with his hand in the cookie jar. Somewhat aggrieved and somewhat
guilty.

They were braving danger for his sake, yet he was here casting blame on
them – for shame!

Zhuo Fan sighed, giving Li Jingtian a look, and the two showed a
carefree smile. Gu Santong sure was an abomination, but pure as a child,
and more importantly, easy to fool.

The Four Scheming Demons were struck dumb.

They had feared the kid for his power. But even after three centuries,
he was still but a child, easy to dupe. Why didn’t they think of that?

But Gu Santong’s shyness only lasted a second as he pointed at Violent
Demon with a frown, “Why then were they moving around the array so
freely, even giving me a punch? You were clearly against me!”

Shuddering, they all felt shock and fear, with the four demons lowering
their heads.

Li Jingtian’s brow was soaked, his lips dry, and looked anxiously at
Zhuo Fan for help. [He may be a child at heart and mind, but everyone
knows the chaos he caused Tianyu three hundred years ago!]

[It’s not that easy to dupe him after all!]

This was Zhuo Fan’s plan all along. If they couldn’t hold him with the
array, then they’ll throw in a play. They’d fake being victims as well,
braving the danger of death for the kid’s sake.

This worked to explain why they were in the array, and also scored
sympathy points with the kid. Without any real evidence, even if the kid
was dubious, he couldn’t just trash them when they were giving their all
in finding him ingredients!

So, Zhuo Fan and Li Jingtian never once showed themselves as the array
worked, just so they could enact this play, and give themselves a way
out.

Who’d have thought however, that the Four Scheming Demons Zhuo Fan asked
to keep the kid busy went as far as punching him!

Now this was throwing a wrench in his act…

[Steward Zhuo, how about we throw these little shits to the wolves?]

Li Jingtian spoke with his eyes.

Zhuo Fan squinted, as the four demons looked nervously at him. They
could feel it in their bones how his next words had the power to save
them and condemn them.

If Zhuo Fan made them scapegoats, they’d have no chance at all, except
at a swift death.

At this very moment, no one moved.

Gu Santong stared at Zhuo, waiting for his answer. Li Jingtian was also
looking at him, waiting for his decision. Four Scheming Demons were
begging him with their faces, their miserable and pitiful faces.

Eveyone’s lives rested on him!

“Uh…”

Zhuo Fan finally opened his mouth, and instead of answering, he gave Gu
Santong a question, “Do you know arrays?”

“Nope!” Gu Santong was blunt

“I guessed as much! That’s great!”

“Eh?” Gu Santong glared at him and Zhuo Fan rushed to say, “Ha-ha-ha,
don’t misunderstand. I only want to explain to you clearly so as to not
weigh your conscience with innocent killings!”

Zhuo Fan rubbed his chin as he began, “Arrays are graded from one to
twelve according to their power. As for their type, they are trapping,
killing, and bewildering arrays. That thunder array was of the killing
type. But it also had a trapping array hidden. Did you notice?”

Gu Santong nodded. He knew the second he got in the array he’d have to
smash his way through if he wanted out.

“But did you notice the bewildering array as well?” Zhuo Fan gave a
vague smile.

Gu Santong shook his head, “You’re saying a bewildering caught me?”

But then he snorted, “No way. I didn’t feel any illusions around me.
What I see may be fake, but my nose has never let me down. That guy hit
me and I caught him red handed…”

Being pointed at, Violent Demon shivered in fear. In that moment, he was
more of a wimp than Wimp Demon.

Everyone looked at him with derision, [This is the first goddamn time
I’m hiding behind forth bro!]

But in the face of all this, Zhuo Fan waved it off, “I didn’t say you
were caught in an illusion, but he was. Let me ask you this. Did you
four really attack Gu Santong?”

Shuddering, the four reacted to Steward Zhuo’s meaning. He was giving
them a way out!

So they shook their heads and bowed, “We thought you were someone else!
Please forgive us!”

“Is that so? Then who was that little monster you kept raving on about?”
Gu Santong stared them down.

The four pointed at Zhuo Fan on the spot, “Him!”

Zhuo Fan’s face twitched and his anger boiled. Wasn’t that saying they
wanted to kill him? But this was not the time to bicker with these four
morons!

Gu Santong looked dubious at him, “You’re also a monster?”

“Uh, before meeting you, they indeed called me that!” With an awkward
chuckle, Zhuo Fan’s fists crunched and Lightning Wings unfolded behind
him, “Can anyone do this?”

Gu Santong’s eyes twitched, “I see. I always thought you used a flying
demonic treasure when in fact it is tied to your body. You’re indeed
monstrous enough!”

That ended that.

Gu Santong was still dubious, but could find no plausible excuse to beat
the crap out of them.

Everyone else gave Zhuo Fan a big round of thumbs up, in admiration for
his sophistry, and putting an end to this deadly situation.

Zhuo Fan sighed and rejoiced inside. [Thank god we met Gu Santong. If it
was anyone else, this blatant lie wouldn’t fly and would’ve got us all
killed instead. All because they harbored doubts.]

Anyone would rather kill a thousand innocents than miss the culprit!

This was where Gu Santong was different. Zhuo Fan knew he guarded the
imperial family for three hundred years all for the sake of a promise.
But only after being his prisoner did he fully understand that to this
kid, words were gold, and he needed a good reason when handling anyone.

When he slaughtered half the empire’s cities, that was because others
pushed him. He didn’t start it!

So Zhuo Fan made a heroic, reckless and gutsy gamble. But even this had
only a fifty-fifty chance. If Gu Santong was still stubborn they could
only resign to their fate and the kid’s temper.

Thankfully, the kid was quite moral, not swinging around his weight
without proper reason!

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan smiled. But then Gu Santong suddenly
said, “Hold on, since you all did this for an ingredient, where is it?”

They all froze up again.

An 8th-grade ingredient was a heavenly treasure. How were they supposed
to just find it?

Gu Santong’s glare once again descended…

Chapter 238 - Lightning Canyon Appears

Chapter 238, Lightning Canyon Appears

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

“If there’s no 8th-grade ingredient, then all of this is a lie cooked up
by all of you!” Gu Santong eyed each one with suspicion.

Violent Demon was frantic, “You fist leveled everything in a hundred
miles! That ingredient is dust by now…”

“Bullshit!”

Gu Santong cursed, “An 8th-grade ingredient is a worldly treasure,
possessing spirituality. If you could think of burrowing underground at
a crucial moment, then so could it!”

“T-then it must’ve fled!” Wimp Demon whimpered.

Gu Santong snorted, “More bullshit! My nose can pick up its scent even a
thousand meters below. How the hell can it escape my notice?”

“T-t-then…” It was Sly Demon’s turn to take the stands and patch the
growing hole in the lie. But he stuttered so greatly, none of his words
made sense, despite how much his eyes showed he wanted to.

Gu Santong snorted, eyeing them with thick bloodthirst, “Humph, without
the 8th-grade ingredient all you’ve said so far was a big fat lie. You
are the ones who set up the lightning array!”

They were all nervous now and chilled to the bone.

“Hold on!”

Zhuo Fan shouted with a pained face, “The 8th-grade ingredient is indeed
real. It truly wanted to flee but I managed to grab it just as the
lightning array crumbled. You didn’t pick up its scent because I placed
it in my ring!”

Zhuo Fan’s hand revealed a glowing ingredient. The sweet smell it
released worked to sooth everyone’s weary minds!

Gu Santong was dumbstruck. The 8th-grade ingredient was real.

Even if he didn’t believe Zhuo Fan, he now had no choice but to. The
proof was incontestable!

The six’s reason for rushing into the array held strong. What they did
in the array, only they knew, and no matter how they explained it, Gu
Santong would never find the truth.

But now, he no longer cared.

With an 8th-grade ingredient in hand, what’s the big problem being
trapped in an array by them? This compensation was enough if he even had
to go through a second array.

Licking his dry lips, Gu Santong scratched his head in embarrassment,
“Ops, I’ve been wrong about you, guys. You really gave it all for my
sake. Then, is this 8th-grade ingredient mine?”

Zhuo Fan was silent, having to go through great difficulty to squeeze a
nod.

Gu Santong then took it and threw the ingredient into his mouth and
started chomping, “In fact, even if you did set the array up, it’s all
water under the bridge. If every array has an 8th-grade ingredient, I’d
jump in head first, ha-ha-ha…”

“Rest easy, our efforts weren’t for nothing!” Zhuo Fan smiled, but was
crying inside. His heart bled with every chomp!

He got that 8th-grade ingredient from Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Hundred
Pill Meeting, and only the one. He was keeping it for a special
occasion, alright? Who’d have thought it’d be wasted on Gu Santong to
calm his anger? But it was either that or his life!

This was Zhuo Fan’s first time losing out to such an extent.

While Gu Santong was gorging himself with the ingredient, Li Jingtian
slipped next to him and patted him, “It’s only a worldly possession,
Steward Zhuo! Only by being alive will you get to have more of them!”

“Yeah, I never knew Steward Zhuo had an 8th-grade ingredient. What’s
more, Steward Zhuo loves us so much, he gave it up. We are touched!” The
Four Scheming Demons sniffed.

Zhuo Fan glared instead, “Shut it, I’ve made an investment in you and I
expect you to pay me back ten fold at the least! We’ll first placate the
devil then we’ll think of something later!”

“Yes!” They all nodded obediently. Especially the four demons, who
looked at him with just a hint of respect. Unlike before when there was
only fear…

Rumble!

A sudden thunderous noise traveled for thousands of miles.

Zhuo Fan frowned and looked around, “Isn’t Thunder Swarm Mountain
flattened? Where is that noise coming from?”

“Maybe it’s a real thunderstorm!” Li Jingtian scratched his beard.

But Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Unlikely. The kid’s two fists silenced
everything in a hundred miles, even removing clouds. So where’s this
lightning coming from without any clouds around?”

Li Jingtian found Zhuo Fan’s explanation to be reasonable.

“Steward Zhuo, look, something’s off with the kid. Did you poison the
8th-grade ingredient?” Sly Demon shouted and pointed at Gu Santong.

Zhuo Fan saw Gu Santong covering his ears and crouching his shivering
body. Even his most delicious treat, the 8th-grade ingredient, laid
half-eaten on the ground.

Violent Demon cried in joy, “Steward Zhuo, you’re amazing, of ultimate
cunningness to have dealt with the kid. Tell us, how did you poison him?
Our plans have always been foiled by that godlike nose…”

“Knock it off, I didn’t do anything!”

Zhuo Fan glared at them then turned to Gu Santong, “It doesn’t look like
somethings wrong with the kid. So it must be his mental state!”

“Eh?”

Li Jingtian raised an eyebrow, but after a bit of mulling he cried,
“It’s fear. How come the great Gu Santong actually knows fear?”

“What?” Zhuo Fan was startled and Li Jingtian explained, “When I was
teaching brats in Regent Estate, I was very strict. So much so, some
weak minded ones caved in just at my voice alone, taking the same
posture as he is now. I’d usually go on and kick out anyone I’ve seen
behaving like this. Without guts, I was not going to waste time on
them!”

“You’re saying… he’s scared? But what could drive such fear into this
little monster?” Zhuo Fan’s heart was perturbed as well.

Rumble!

The thunder only grew in intensity and Zhuo Fan looked startled at the
sky.

Then a bolt flashed out of the blue and the sky darkened as black as
night, as if a huge hand swept over the area. Next, purple lightning
began to fall nonstop.

Each place they hit was turned to dust, wafting everywhere.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened, and cried, “Lightning Canyon!”

Correct, this was one of the continent’s three danger zones, Lightning
Canyon! It was the place Zhuo Fan had been aiming for all this time, the
Heavenly Emperor’s remnant!

Long Jiu once told him about it and has been preparing himself since.
But having met with one strange and unavoidable event after another, he
had to put them on hold.

And now…

With a flash, the Thunder Skylark’s egg appeared in his hand. His eyes
looked at this flickering egg with a bitter face.

He felt regret, [Why haven’t I hatched this egg the moment I got here?
Now that Thunder Swarm Mountain is gone, how do I do it?]

But even if he had, the chick wouldn’t be of any use in the Lightning
Canyon!

[If only I hatched it sooner. It would’ve matured after a few years.] It
was as if fate dictated it was not his time to enter Lightning Canyon!

Watching the purple lightning falling from the clouds, Zhuo Fan sighed
and flew away from them, “Let’s go!”

The other five were quick to follow!

They all heard of the notorious Lightning Canyon’s danger. Going in was
suicide! The best way is to get out of here following Zhuo Fan!

Luckily, Lightning Canyon just showed up and their speed was more than
enough to get them in the clear.

But they flew for a bit and Zhuo Fan looked back all of a sudden,
“Where’s the brat, Gu Santong?”

He found that the bold and powerful Invincible Scamp was reacting like
any child would in this situation. He was shivering and closing his
ears, losing all reason out of fear.

“Ha-ha-ha, the kid is afraid of lightning! Where’d all that fierce
attitude go?” Violent Demon mocked.

The other demons joined him, but Zhuo Fan was pausing in thought. Then,
he exclaimed, “I get it. He isn’t afraid of lightning, but afraid of
purple lightning. We were wrong from the start! “

“Hi-hi-hi, Steward Zhuo, you’re kidding. Who on earth isn’t afraid of
purple lightning? Even those Sect Leaders of ours would bolt at the
sight of it!” Violent Demon laughed.

Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan’s eyes were fixed on Gu Santong, “This kid is
different. The others had the bravery to run, but the kid is lacking
even that. Just what is his connection with Lightning Canyon?”

Zhuo Fan suddenly said, “Elder Li, you and the demons leave. I’m getting
him out!”

“No, Steward Zhuo!” Li Jingtian was anxious, “Lightning Canyon is about
to descend and you’ll be soon crushed to death. You can’t risk it!”

“Yeah, Steward Zhuo, let that punk die for all we care! Wasn’t he
almighty? Let’s see him handle purple lighting for a change!” Violent
Demon spat and the demons nodded.

The four demons had been nothing but trouble so far, but ever since Zhuo
Fan saved their lives by paying an 8th-grade ingredient, their view
changed. They held Zhuo Fan with favor, albeit slightly.

Zhuo Fan was gratified but his mind was made, “Elder Li, if anything
happens to me, take care of these four. Don’t let them turn the clan
upside down!”

Zhuo Fan shot for Gu Santong.

“Steward Zhuo!”

Li Jingtian shouted, but all he could see was his vanishing figure among
the purple lightning.

Gnashing his teeth, he eyed the demons and flew away, “Let’s go!”

“What about Steward Zhuo?”

“He’ll be back!” Li Jingtian’s eyes were firm…
