Chapter 239 - Azure Flame Guard

Chapter 239, Azure Flame Guard

Whoosh!

The purple lightning bolts spun a spider’s web as they hammered the
skies, it was as if the heavens were becoming fragmented. Then, a
lightning bolt fell before Gu Santong.

Zhuo Fan saw the shivering child among the lightning and cried, “Gu
Santong, stop daydreaming and run! Don’t you want to live?”

“S-save…” Gu Santong shook his head and stuttered.

“What?” Zhuo Fan shouted.

“Save… me!” Gu Santong showed his pitiful face, his eyes filled with
tears.

Zhuo Fan was shocked. Never would’ve thought it possible that the great
Gu Santong’s nightmare was purple lightning. He truly became a child
gripped by fear.

Frowning, Zhuo Fan showed a particular grin. Then he grabbed the kid and
flew away!

Wasn’t it obvious he should fulfill his request?

Zhuo Fan had been going all this time about having the kid under him,
but since the kid was a tough nut to crack, how could he succeed?

Only now. at the kid’s weakest, the best chance presented itself. This
was the sole reason why Zhuo Fan braved the danger of rescuing him.

Otherwise, with his rotten character, he wouldn’t be caught dead saving
anyone!

This was the opportunity of a lifetime, to have the strongest in Tianyu
at his behest.

When the stakes were high, so was the return. And only through this
grave risk might he be able to gain an invincible subordinate!

Zhuo Fan laughed coldly inside, [Gu Santong has been keeping a promise
for three hundred years after losing one lousy bet. Now that I save him,
won’t he give his all in repaying me?]

[He-he-he, with Gu Santong behind me, let’s see how those Regent Estate
bastards dare lift even a finger against me!]

Zhuo Fan could already see the future, one in which the seven houses
were at his feet!

Too bad though, what man proposes god disposes. This time, his risk may
very well be fatal!

With a shocking boom, the fragmented sky was now thoroughly wrecked,
revealing a huge black hole in the sky.

Purple lightning fell by the thousand, pulverizing anything it touched.
And the storm kicked up by the lightning sent everything in that black
abyss.

Zhuo Fan was flying with all his power when a sudden power gripped him,
slowly sucking him into the black hole. Like an invisible hand, it
wanted to throw him into that endless abyss.

Heart in a vise, Zhuo Fan picked up more speed with his wings.

But he didn’t gain one bit of ground, falling ever deeper among the
purple lightning storm.

Zhuo Fan’s anxiety grew and grew and his brow was soaked. The situation
took a dire turn for the worst. Thus he turned to the scared Gu Santong,
“Gu Santong, we are about to be sucked in. Is there anything you can
do?”

Gu Santong had been shivering all this time, with fear robbing him even
of his voice.

But even if this was his normal state, his first reaction was to roll
his eyes. [Oh please, you’re the one doing the rescuing, remember? Now
you’re asking me for help? You’d think I’d be shivering here doing
nothing if I had a way out?]

Sighing, Zhuo Fan knew the kid was out for the count, scared witless by
the purple lightning. He only had himself to rely on.

But everywhere he looked was purple lightning. Besides lightning, there
was only more lightning. And all while the sucking abyss was doing its
best to devour them among the tight curtain of lighting. The lightest
touch would stop their hearts.

[Is this how I’ll lose the gamble and my life? In the Lightning Canyon?]

Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, unwilling to give up for a second. He was
still working his damndest in getting out of there.

Boom!

Suddenly, a purple bolt smashed into his back, forcing him to spit
blood. Losing his balance, he drifted deeper into the bottomless pit.

Wiping his blood, Zhuo Fan rejoiced, “Thankfully, it’s only a 3rd Heaven
purple lightning, just like brother Jiu’s, or I’d be a goner!”

But he didn’t finish his words as a second lightning fell. This time his
whole body shivered. His Diamond Sand and unbreakable body was sporting
cracks, and blood spilled from the force of the lightning!

“What? A 4th Heaven purple lightning?”

Gasping, Zhuo Fan looked up to see the big hole was getting increasingly
closer. And the closer it got, the stronger the lightning.

If a 6th Heaven lightning struck him, he would be pulverized in body and
soul!

Zhuo Fan was out of his depth this time. He was about to die a second
time at a moment’s notice if he didn’t come up with something, and fast.

It was time to exert the power he gathered all these years!

But the crucial thing was, Nine Serenities Secret Records’ secret
technique could not be used so frequently. Each subsequent use would
break the tie between the soul and his consciousness. After all, he was
making use of another’s soul.

There may very well not be a next rebirth. Afterall the type of
grievance he needed may have vanished from the world.

Zhuo Fan was reborn this time, but regarded his life with utmost
seriousness. It may very well be his last!

Taking a deep breath to cool down. Zhuo Fan started thinking about a
plan of action. He gnashed his teeth and settled on taking out the
Thunder Skylark’s egg.

His original plan was to use the newborn Thunder Skylark to control the
lightning’s power, and let it absorb it. Even if it could only absorb
the 6th Heaven it would buy him enough time to get inside this place.

But now, he only had an egg, that may very well be unable to take a
single lightning before crack open like a melon.

But desperate times called for desperate measures!

Zhuo Fan held the egg in one hand and Gu Santong in the other, flung
straight for the Lightning Canyon’s black hole. He was carefully
controlling his flight as he looked for the right approach.

Boom!

With a thunderclap, a purple lightning shot straight for Zhuo Fan. His
eyes squinted and shouted, “4th Heaven purple lighting!”

He lifted the egg to let it take the brunt.

Perhaps it was their connection, or it was just plain first in its path,
but the purple lightning struck the Thunder Skylark’s egg. It was as if
it acted as a beacon.

But the enormous power having slammed into the egg made it shudder, on
the verge of breaking. Zhuo Fan used Demon Transformation Art post
haste, taking the rest of the lightning power into him and refined it!

Perhaps the egg still had some magic left in it as by some miracle, it
cushioned the lightning’s power. Zhuo Fan shuddered but he was otherwise
unaffected.

This worked to lift his mood, [This could work!] But what worried him
most was the power of the purple lightning. Even with the Demon
Transformation Art, he couldn’t refine all of it. Some of its power
wasn’t much of a threat to him, but if he let that power roam around his
body, it would only get worse!

[I have to find the right path inside. If lightning doesn’t strike me
down first, I’ll die from overexposure!]

Zhuo Fan felt numb. He sensed the places where the purple lightning
traveled inside him and his face grew grave.

Boom~

The closer he got to the black hole, the purple lightning struck with
greater intensity and frequency. Zhuo Fan pushed through the pain and
lasted so far, but more and more unrefined lightning power gathered
inside him, wreaking havoc. As the damage on his organs intensified,
blood started leaking from his mouth!

Boom!

Another purple flash signaled a fast approaching lightning, “5th Heaven
purple lightning!”

This was one power that could crush even a Radiant Stage expert!

Zhuo Fan operated the Demon Transformation Art to the max. Black energy
covered the egg, waiting for the moment the lightning struck it to
refine it.

But, the lightning scattered the black energy in an instant. Its power
flew unencumbered through the egg and into his body.

Pff!

Blood and gore spewed out of his mouth, Zhuo Fan having suffered a heavy
blow. He was incapable of refining such powerful lightning in time and
was taking its toll on him.

He was now on the brink of collapse. So weak he couldn’t handle another.

But when it rained, it poured.

As if that strike was the curtain’s call, another lightning slammed
down. Zhuo Fan was now pale, looking at the incoming attack bitterly.
His eyes having lost its last thread of hope, “Blast it, another 5th
Heaven purple lightning! I’m finished!”

He looked at the shivering Gu Santong, and patted his head, “Who’d ever
knew this would happen, that I would ultimately die saving a kid? I
mean, I wouldn’t be suffering so much if I haven’t saved you. Is this my
fate, all because of greed?”

Zhuo Fan shook his head and sighed, “But I do not regret it. Few are the
chances a man gets at life! I have failed this time, but even if it will
be the next time, I’d still choose this path. I only hope… there will be
a next time!”

Clenching his eyes shut, Zhuo Fan held Gu Santong close, yet he looked
quite at peace.

He was a man of ambition, but even in the face of death, he would
welcome it with open arms!

Pff!

Suddenly, an azure flame flitted from his forehead, covering the two of
them in its glow. It was then when the purple lightning struck.

The oddest thing happened. When the lightning touched the flame, it was
melted down in a flash. One could see with the naked eye how the purple
lightning was rendered useless..

Chapter 240 - Will to Live

Chapter 240, Will to Live

Slowly opening his eyes, Zhuo Fan found he was still in one piece. But
the shock of his life was the azure fire surrounding him. Never had he
thought his azure flame outstripped even the might of the terrifying
purple lightning!

That mystery expert in the Allbeast Mountain Range once again popped in
his mind.

He never did figure out why was that person entrusting him with the
azure flame. But now, he guessed it was to help him get into the
Lightning Canyon!

But for which reason? Was there something in the Lightning Canyon he
wanted but couldn’t get it himself?

Zhuo Fan was filled with doubts but he shook them away.

This was not the time for flights of fancy. That was for later,
including whatever scheme that man may have in play. After all, his life
was on the line right now.

Zhuo Fan swiftly got his bearings, looking for a way out of this thunder
shower. But what he saw gave him goosebumps. The purple lightning was
endless, and since he didn’t know how long the azure flame lasted, he
had to hurry!

Boom~

Lightning fell like rain on the azure flame. From the 5th Heaven all the
way to the 8th, the flame was unaffected. Only it’s intensity seemed to
have dropped a little.

Zhuo Fan held Gu Santong and flew deeper into the black abyss. But as
far as the eye could see there was only purple lightning and nothing
else.

Zhuo Fan was growing restless from the severe problem he was in!

Boom!

Suddenly, another lightning smashed into them. Zhuo Fan couldn’t keep
his body straight and felt numb. The azure flame as well was greatly
diminished.

“9th Heaven purple lightning!”

Zhuo Fan gasped. This was the one that worried him the most, the 9th
Heaven purple lightning. Even the mysterious azure flame couldn’t hold
for long under such onslaught.

If the azure flame guard fell through, they were finished!

Knowing the greatest threat was here, he scoured the place for a way
out. Roaming his eyes everywhere for even the slightest loophole in the
curtain of lightning.

But even he, a Demonic Emperor expert in arrays, couldn’t find one
thread of hope. It was clear at a glance that a great expert set this
up, to prevent any other intruders.

This was the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant after all, one of the three
strongest emperors in antiquity. How could this puny Demonic Emperor
hold a candle to him?

Slapping his head to get rid of such thoughts, Zhuo Fan was pushed to
the edge, his nerves wound tight as he looked for an exit, to no avail.
Facing the endless array the Heavenly Emperor placed personally, he felt
utterly powerless.

Boom!

Another 9th Heaven purple lightning struck, marking the drop in the
azure flame’s intensity. He even started feeling the purple lightning’s
power on his skin. His azure guard wouldn’t last long like this.

Zhuo Fan sighed.

His early thinking was too naive. It was a pipe dream using Thunder
Skylark to resist 6th Heaven purple lightning to explore the Heavenly
Emperor’s remnant. Even with the azure guard protecting him from the 9th
Heaven purple lightning, he was deep within the abyss but could not find
its entrance.

The great Heavenly Emperor’s array was not something the Demonic Emperor
could just break out of!

Even the most outstanding Nine Serenities Emperor would need days to
figure it out. But he didn’t have days, not even hours!

There was no way a measly Bone Tempering cultivator ever could pull it
off!

Zhuo Fan slapped his head. His previous act of defying Gu Santong was an
act of bravery. But now, it slowly started to resemble suicide.

Because he was now entering Lightning Canyon in advance, instead of
later. If he couldn’t break out of it this time, then he could never do
it anytime.

By coming here now he only hastened his death!

[Ah, azure flame, you came at such a perfect timing all to say ‘I told
you so’, didn’t you? If it weren’t today with Gu Santong, but later
alone, it wouldn’t make a difference still, right?]

Zhuo Fan lamented, “In the end, I was too conceited. Thinking with the
Demon Emperor’s legacy I could rule the world and even looked down on
the Heavenly Emperor’s array. I am such a lame joke! At least no one
knows me for the Demon Emperor that I was, or I’d be the world’s biggest
laughingstock…”

Zhuo Fan shook his head, downcast, his eyes losing their light, uncaring
of the relentless hammering the purple lightning did.

Suddenly, a flash of red came from deep within the black abyss.

Zhuo Fan turned his head to see it and found it very small but it had no
purple lightning around it!

His eyes lit up and Zhuo Fan shouted, “Right, brother Jiu said that he
was suddenly swept by this purple thunderstorm and entered by chance.
That means Heavenly Emperor’s array isn’t perfect. And this loophole
wasn’t left intentionally by the creator but by someone who actually
broke a hole into it!”

Zhuo Fan looked at the red glow with more attention, filling him with
joy.

Correct, that red light was a loophole and following it would take them
in. But if they followed it in, they’d enter the remnant!

[He-he-he, am I supposed to just flee now that I reached thus far? Of
course I’ll go in and make a thorough investigation inside! Who knows
when such a god sent chance will be presented to me ? Whether or not
I’ll find the loophole again in this huge array is the real question!]

Zhuo Fan lost his dispirited gaze and turned ecstatic, “What’s so great
about Heavenly Emperor? Wasn’t it already broken into by someone?
Ha-ha-ha… “

If only Heavenly Emperor could hear him now, he’d be going blue from
anger and spitting back in reply.

[You damn rotten shameless punk! Why are you getting so smug? You didn’t
make the hole, did you?]

Speaking of the hole’s size, it was far too small to enter.

Worse yet, the hole even had purple lightning all around it that he
didn’t dare touch!

To enter, he had to enlarge it from afar, and then go in through the red
light. This way, the purple lightning would stop bothering him.

The crux of it all was, how can he proceed? He didn’t think punching and
kicking would just up and open a Heavenly Emperor’s array. That’d be
ridiculous!

[Then again…], Zhuo Fan’s eyes landed on the curled up Gu Santong.

[Kid, time to pay up!]

Laughing inside, Zhuo Fan started rattling the kid, “Gu Santong, we are
in grave danger, with only one chance at survival. See that red light?
That is the exit. Punch it, make it big enough for us to go through!”

“No no no, I’m scared of that lightning!” Gu Santong held his ears and
jerked his head.

Zhuo Fan barked, “I’m scared too, but are you more scared of them or
death? And even if we are to die, let’s all go out with a bang and no
regrets!”

Gu Santong was startled but still shivered.

Zhuo Fan smiled and tousled his hair, his tone softer, “It’s fine. I’ll
hold you close. Even if we die, I’ll go first! I won’t ever let go of
you, so you don’t either. When life hangs in the balance we must hold
nothing back!”

[Particularly about letting me go, alright? If not for your sake, punch
for me. Please?]

Zhuo Fan didn’t voice his thought, but he made a great impression on Gu
Santong!

Gu Santong regarded him deeply, his heart warm and fuzzy. His frightened
body no longer trembled and looked at the red light and nodded.

Then, with a shout, he lifted his childish fist and punched!

Hum~

A strange ripple came from Gu Santong’s fist, as if a large dragon shot
forth. It was so excessive that even the purple lightning was warped in
its wake as it shook the very fabric of space.

Boom!

The red light grew and turned into a man-sized hole, sending out a red
pillar of light this time.

Where it shined, no purple lightning dared go near it!

Zhuo Fan was ecstatic and rubbed the kid’s head, “You were brilliant,
kid!”

Gu Santong grinned like an innocent child!

But then, a purple lightning slammed into Zhuo Fan. The azure flame
shuddered and up and vanished.

The remaining lightning power snaked its way into Zhuo Fan and forced
him to spat flickering blood. His face paled.

“Are you alright?” Gu Santong cried.

Suddenly hugging the kid, Zhuo Fan showed a weak smile, “It’s fine. I
told you, I’ll be holding on to you as long as I have a breath in my
body. There’s nothing scary about this purple lightning!”

Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and flew towards the red light. But when he
entered the cover of the light, he blacked out. All while his arms still
held Gu Santong close.

The two floated like that among the red light, with only Gu Santong
aware, moved seeing Zhuo Fan’s pale face…

Outside of the purple storm, not long after Lightning Canyon came, it
vanished again.

It left behind absolutely nothing. Gu Santong’s two fists at least left
dust, but the Lightning Canyon annihilated everything.

It reshaped the land in its wake, leaving behind a place where not even
dust remained. And where the purple lightning struck the earth, it left
boiling lava!

Li Jingtian and the four demons sent a soul ripple to search the area
but found no trace of Zhuo Fan and Gu Santong!

“Steward Zhuo and that devil had to be destroyed body and soul!” Sly
Demon sighed.

“Waaah, Steward Zhuo is so pitiful! Why did he have to die with that
devil?” Wimp Demon sniffed, “Steward Zhuo was so good to us, not
abandoning when it mattered most!”

“Yeah, unlike our Sect Leader, who would use us as pastries in a
heartbeat!” Violent Demon sighed in sorrow as well. But soon he grinned
and laughed, “Well, look on the bright side. Aren’t we free again?
Ha-ha-ha… “

The three demons froze then jumped in joy, “Yeah, yeah…”

Li Jingtian’s face was glum, his brow twitching as he barked, “Who told
you that lie? Now that you’re in the employment of the Luo clan, you
won’t get out so easily!”

“Humph, think you can scare us? Who do you think you are, Steward Zhuo?”
Violent Demon mocked.

Snorting, Li Jingtian’s fingers moved, “You think only Steward Zhuo can
control the Bloodworms? Think about it, why would Steward Zhuo leave you
in my care if not for teaching me how to control you?”

Shuddering, the demons watched him vigilant.

“Humph, you don’t believe me? Want a taste to refresh your memories?”

“Uh, no no no, we believe you!” Just as Li Jingtian was about to do it,
the demons begged. Then they bowed with lamenting faces, “Elder Li, we
will listen to you!”

Nodding smugly, Li Jingtian glared ,”That’s better. Now let’s get back
to Windgaze City and guard the Luo clan. I still have to ask Young Miss
to confer you the rank of elders. Or if you stay in my care I’ll put you
on latrine duty!”

“Uh, we will be elders!” The four shouted in panic as they flew to
Windgaze City.

Seeing them go, Li Jingtian sighed at the empty space behind, “Steward
Zhuo, staying with you for so long, I’ve picked up a few tricks. Don’t
worry, no matter where you are, I believe you’re still alive. I’ll look
after these clowns and await your return! “

Li Jingtian then followed after the demons, leaving behind the desolate
place…

Chapter 241 - I’ll Be Your Father!

Chapter 241, I’ll Be Your Father!

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

Boom~

The crackling of lightning never stopped jarring his ears, rousing the
weakened and pale Zhuo Fan.

Above, all he saw was a dome of blackness, with only a hazy red light
shining down on the earth around him.

Earlier, they jumped inside that hole in the sky after following the
curtain of red light, the same one that kept changing positions! Looking
further, one could see above the red curtain, the purple lightning
raining havoc like dragons all around and towards it.

But once the lightning touched the red light, it bounced back.

The red light was a haven, freeing this patch of earth from the
lightning’s deadly assault!

“Is this… Heavenly Emperor’s remnant?” With a faint smile, Zhuo Fan was
heavily wounded but that didn’t stop the joy he felt. He was finally
here.

Looking around, all he saw was yellow rocky outcrops everywhere.

It didn’t look like much, but he wasn’t disappointed in the least. It
was the person that made a mountain known, not the hunk of rock itself!
Even if the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant was a wasteland, it still hid
treasures!

Zhuo Fan crawled to his feet, eager to begin searching. He tried getting
up but then found something heavy on him.

Gu Santong was holding on for his dear life, his small face in tranquil
sleep.

Gu Santong was stirred awake and wiped the drool for his face. He opened
his hazy eyes and gave an innocent smile, “Ha-ha-ha, you’re awake!”

Zhuo Fan smiled a nod.

But then, another lightning roared nearby and Gu Santong was frightened
into burying his head in Zhuo Fan’s chest, his hands holding onto Zhuo
Fan for his dear life!

Zhuo Fan shook his head, never imagining Invincible Scamp would be such
a shy kid.[It is understandable if we were outside, but why are you
acting all scared here when you know the lightning can’t touch you?]

“Uh, Gu Santong, we’re safe here. You should let go and let me look
around!”

“Don’t wanna!” Gu Santong shook his head, holding him tighter, “I’m
scared of purple lightning. Holding you feels safe!”

Zhuo Fan smiled dejectedly and shook his head, “Oh please, you’re much
stronger than me, so how can you feel safe next to me? It’d make more
sense if I was the one holding onto you!”

Chapter 242 - Ancient Sacred Beast, Soaring Qilin

Chapter 242, Ancient Sacred Beast, Soaring Qilin

Pff!

In the middle of laughing, Zhuo Fan’s eyes bulged, he shivered and,

When the blood hit the ground, it exploded and left a black mark.

Gu Santong cried, “Godfather, are you alright?”

“I’m fine. This purple lightning is just too powerful!” Zhuo Fan wiped
the blood, and panted with a grave look in his eyes.

The purple lightning exceeded his calculations. The part that he failed
to refine with Demon Transformation Art roamed around his body just now
and caused disaster in its wake.

But he had no way to stop it either. This was akin to slow acting
poison. He knew it ravaged his body, and would one day rob his life, but
couldn’t do anything about it!

Looking further, at the rocks and yellow sand, Zhuo Fan took a deep
breath and stood up, his face hard, “Santong, help me search for
anything suspicious!”

He knew the purple lightning was one of Heavenly Emperor’s abilities and
the emperor must have had to have a way to dispel it. He had no choice
but to scour Heavenly Emperor’s remnant and find that cure.

Gu Santong nodded genially and helped Zhuo Fan up, “Uh, godfather, you
can just call me young Sanzi. That’s how my old dad used to call me.
Anyone who was friendly with me called me that!”

Zhuo Fan nodded, smiling weakly, “Alright, young Sanzi. Go scout ahead!”

“Understood!”

Gu Santong cupped his hands, and skipped away. Having recognized Zhuo

ego, even ignoring the ceaseless rumbling above.

Since Zhuo Fan was right behind him, he had nothing to fear!

The duo had been wandering this endless stretch of yellow sand for over
six hours but still couldn’t reach the end. Zhuo Fan ceased his walk and
frowned.

Gu Santong stopped as well and looked back, “What is it, godfather?”

“Young Sanzi, don’t you feel we’ve been going in circles?” Zhuo Fan

Gu Santong’s eyes widened and rushed to him. “What, a bewildering
array?”

“How could I’ve been fooled by it…” Gu Santong pouted. Basing his
confidence on his previous shallow experience, he had nothing to fear

Gu Santong lifted his small fist and struck!

Hum~

But the usual sight of seeing a ripple level a hundred miles of land
didn’t appear. The ground just shook a bit then quietened.

Gu Santong was dispirited, “This can’t be!”

This never happened before, not once.

Zhuo Fan shook his head, having already guessed it.

This was not your average array, but one set up by Heavenly Emperor, one
of the three strongest emperors of ancient times. If a little monster
could simply force his way through, then the Heavenly Emperor would’ve
been an empty title.

[If he could break this array so easily, what would then be the point of
finding some Heavenly Emperor’s remnant when I could straight up take

“Young Sanzi, save your energy. Come here!” Zhuo Fan shook his head
seeing him punch everywhere, “Young Sanzi, I want you to be honest with

Gu Santong shook his head puzzled.

Zhuo Fan frowned, “Then why are you afraid of purple lightning? Did you
see it before?”

“I haven’t!” Gu Santong paused then shook his head in the end, “How
strange, this is the first time I’m seeing it yet I felt instinctual

like the common lightning, which I hate but am not scared!”

This was odd. According to Zhuo Fan, the kid had to have a connection
with Lightning Canyon, but now…

Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan mulled it over, “Can’t be. No one has
instinctual fear against anyone, not to such extent at least. Was it

Zhuo Fan asked, “Young Sanzi, who is your master to have trained you so

“I don’t have a master!”

“Then how did you reach the Profound Heaven Stage three centuries ago?”

“Uh…” Now that he stopped to think about it, Gu Santong said puzzled, “I
don’t know. For as long as I can remember, I’ve been in the Profound
Heaven Stage. I had no one to call a friend, looking for ingredients

Zhuo Fan was shocked as a radical conclusion crawled into his mind.

[What if… this kid isn’t human?]

Zhuo Fan licked his dry lips, he himself was scared by that thought.

The average human became stronger through diligent cultivation and
understanding of the Heavenly Dao. But there were some creatures that
were naturally strong, like the spiritual beasts. And those that assumed
human form, were a cut above mere spiritual beasts…

Zhuo Fan didn’t dare to finish that thought. If it was true, then wasn’t
the Mortal Domain, the place unanimously despised by all experts from
the Sacred Domain, a place to be reckoned with?

Recalling the mysterious expert in the Allbeast Mountain Range only

“Godfather,” Gu Santong turned his bright eyes to him, “I’ll use my

Zhuo Fan shook his head in dismay.

[It worked outside because there were all kinds of scents coming from

sand.]

[If this array had such a weakness, Heavenly Emperor would’ve been taken
for a fool, locked up and had his cell key thrown away!]

Before he could say anything, Gu Santong wiggled his nose and said, “I

What?!

Zhuo Fan was bug eyed, letting himself be pulled by the child.

Zhuo Fan found a three inch jutting rock. A kick could send it flying

Before he could make sense of it all, Gu Santong jumped over and picked

Whoosh~

The surroundings suddenly changed. They were walking downward when the

This place was but half a mile wide, with a black still sky, but the

Startled, Zhuo Fan eyed the red pillar closely.

That look alone made him jump in fright.

It was hundreds of meters tall, jutting out of the ground like a
mountain. It even passed the black sky! The purple lightning not once

Zhuo Fan clicked his tongue. [What is this thing? How can it withstand

The fact this pillar was standing strong even in the face of this, it

[This scent, the spiritual energy is mixed with something wild. It must

Zhuo Fan gasped as a chill crawled up his spine.

[You’re telling me this pillar isn’t made of metal but from a sacred

Zhuo Fan started combing through the Nine Serenities Secret Records in

“During the ancient times, five sacred beasts ruled the skies,
undefeated. Not even peak Emperor Stage experts could fight them. Their

“And one of the five ancient sacred beasts is the Soaring Qilin!” Zhuo

None of the ten famous emperors of antiquity ever expected Soaring Qilin
would end up here. And by the looks of it, it was clearly dead, with
only the Soaring Qilin’s leg still firmly planted in this place!

Its killer was no secret either, the owner of the 12th Heaven Purple
Lightning Gold Eye, Heavenly Emperor!

[Could this perhaps not be the Heavenly Emperor’s remnant, but his
slaughterhouse instead…]

Chapter 243 - Heavenly Emperor’s Ultimate Art, Divine Void Eye

Chapter 243, Heavenly Emperor’s Ultimate Art, Divine Void Eye

Bang~

The shaking earth pulled Zhuo out of his train of thoughts. He turned to

With the shaking of the pillar, so too did the whole space. The bolts of

“But… I can’t stand it seeing it struck by the purple lightning. I just

Startled, Zhuo Fan turned to the Qilin’s leg in thought.

[They say blood is thicker than water.] And Gu Santong’s every action

[Is he perhaps related to one of the five ancient sacred beasts, the

Zhuo Fan sighed and ruffled the kid’s hair, “If you do not wish for it
to cry from Heaven, stop.”

Gu Santong didn’t understand.

Zhuo Fan smiled, “It is nothing if I die, but if you die, the pillar
would also feel sad. No one wants to see his descendants die in vain!”

“You mean… he is my kin?” Gu Santong widened his teary eyes in shock.

Nodding, Zhuo Fan continued, “You feel unbearable sadness the moment you
saw the Qilin leg being struck down by lightning. Don’t you think the
owner of this leg would feel even sadder it’s leg couldn’t protect you

Gu Santong looked at him deeply and no longer attacked the pillar.

Pff!

Suddenly, Zhuo Fan spat blood that scorched the ground again. Gu Santong
cried in panic.

Zhuo Fan waved his hand bitterly, “The purple lightning keeps ruining my
body. I hoped to find the art to dispel it in Heavenly Emperor’s
remnant, but… “

Sighing, Zhuo Fan said, “It looks like I survived the entrance only to
die inside!”

“Godfather, you’ll be fine, We just became kin!” Gu Santong was anxious.

He finally found someone who cared for him, only to see him die. Gu
Santong was so heartbroken, tears began to fall again.

Zhuo Fan shook his head in dismay. He was an evil man who rarely did
anything good, yet even so, someone was crying on his deathbed. He felt

The irony here couldn’t be more obvious. This godson of his who was

Squinting, Zhuo Fan sighed and put his storage ring on Gu Santong’s
finger, just like a legacy, “This ring has many ingredients. Take it! I

“Godfather…” Gu Santong’s tears glimmered, touched to the core.

Zhuo Fan wiped his tears away and took out the Thunder Skylark’s egg,
“After my death, you will be lonely. Take this bird to help you brave
the times… “

He didn’t finish as chirping was heard.

Zhuo Fan was startled, “Are you kiddin’ me? It’s hatching now? How…”

Shriek~

With a loud crack the egg burst and revealed the head of a small chick,

It looked different from any common Thunder Skylark, it was purple. And

Gu Santong cowered to the side at its sight, while Zhuo Fan stood agape,
“Un-frreaking-believable! It can use the 1st Heaven purple lightning at
birth! This Thunder Skylark is a variant… “

Eek~

The chick blinked its beady eyes at Zhuo Fan, taking him for its mother.
It cried out in joy and flapped its wings as it leaped at him.

It couldn’t fly yet, having just been born, staggering its frail body
over and rubbing its head on him.

Zhuo Fan was out of it looking at the blinking chick. Then he cursed,
“You little poultry, you got the most out of this trip to Lightning

lightning. I am looking forward to seeing how high you can reach!”

“Godfather, grab it! Don’t let it come near me!” Gu Santong was hiding
behind the Qilin leg and shouting in fear.

Zhuo Fan laughed, “Young Sanzi, what are you afraid of? Its purple

“Come here. Since I’ve cared for this cheeky thing so much, it can be

Zhuo Fan was being childish. He knew Gu Santong was scared of purple

Gu Santong shook while trembling.

Zhuo Fan laughed, [Ah, I’m not long for this world anyway. Teasing

Gu Santong threw rocks around the pillar at it. But the chick’s gait was

In fact, it thought big bro was playing with it and was skipping over in

Gu Santong’s pitiful face was on the verge of tears. It kept throwing

Perhaps from being pushed into a corner seeing the rocks were of no

Gu Santong went for it but was shocked to find he couldn’t lift it.

This was stranger than fiction. With his power, he couldn’t lift a small
rock? So he stabbed his hand into the dirt and strained into pulling
this odd rock.

But what came out of the ground was a rock the size of a man, looking
funny in the hand of a child like Gu Santong. What’s more, the kid found

Zhuo Fan cried out in shock but Gu Santong was in the throes of fear as

The chick cried out and flapped its wings. Fear was a powerful motivator

The large rock shook the earth and left a meter wide hole around it. The

[Big bro wasn’t playing around with me, he truly hates me!]

Zhuo Fan shook his head at Gu Santong’s fuming appearance. He was about

He inspected it in detail.

The large rock looked like a huge egg, smooth and shiny enough to see

within, and could even make out the shape of a human.

“Imparting Stone!”

Zhuo Fan cried out in excitement, “This is an amazing treasure!”

The Imparting Stone was exceedingly rare in the Sacred Domain. It is
used by Masters to pass down secret arts to their disciples or family
members.

Usually, the Imparting Stone would be passed down from the previous clan
leader to the next one. The new leader would smash the stone and thus
gain the inheritance.

The inheriting process also destroys the Imparting Stone. When the
leader reaches the end of his life, he would leave all his knowledge
into another Imparting Stone for the next leader.

This way, the legacy of a clan would live on!

But never did he think this isolated world would house such a treasure.

[Who’s memories did this Imparting Stone contain?] Was it the Qilin’s or
Heavenly Emperor’s? If they were Heavenly Emperor’s, he’d struck gold.
It may even contain the way of removing the purple lightning from his
body!

Zhuo Fan was eager to try it, “Young Sanzi, break that rock!”

Gu Santong thought Zhuo Fan was scolding in a roundabout way, “If you’re
going to scold me, do it to my face! I know I shouldn’t use such a large
rock on a chick. Since you took it as your son, he is my little brother,
so I wouldn’t cross the line. But don’t use the rock as an excuse!”

Zhuo Fan laughed, “I am content knowing you own up to your mistakes, but
I’m not scolding you here. I only want you to help me break that rock so
that I may live!”

Gu Santong’s eyes shined and was in glee knowing he could save Zhuo Fan!

So with a boom, the Imparting Stone was blown to pieces by Gu Santong’s
mighty fist. A multicolored mist drifted out of it!

Within it, a human shape appeared, around 20 years old but with a
dignified expression. Purple flickered on his left eye while his right
eye was as deep as the abyss.

Looking any longer, one would feel sucked in.

“The leader of the ten ancient emperors, the Heavenly Emperor!” Zhuo Fan
gasped.

The person was tranquil, his gaze looked ahead but it gave the
impression it overlooked all of creation, “Junior, as you were fortunate
enough to open my Imparting Stone, you must be kin. I shall impart to
you my ultimate magical art, Divine Eye of the Void. Pay close
attention…”

“What, the Divine Eye of the Void? I struck the motherlode, ha-ha-ha…”
Zhuo Fan shuddered from joy and couldn’t hold back the laughter…

Chapter 244 - First Stage of Divine Eye of the Void

Chapter 244, First Stage of Divine Eye of the Void

When people spoke of Heavenly Emperor, one of the three strongest
ancient emperors, they always mentioned his greatest abilities, the
Purple Lightning Gold Eye on his left, and the Divine Eye of the Void on
his right! The Divine Eye of the Void was also the first magical ability
he comprehended when he entered the Emperor Stage. It held such
unbelievable power that not even Purple Lightning Gold Eye could come
close.

Zhuo Fan was stoked. For fear his two brats would interfere, he even
gave them a sign to keep quiet, yet his eyes and ears never missed
anything the image revealed.

This was a once in a lifetime chance. Missing a single word would leave
him with endless regrets!

“The Divine Eye of the Void is a supreme ocular magical art. Place your
attention on the word void. It is another word for emptiness. Only in
emptiness can one have space. And to be one with the emptiness is a
virtue. Afterall, all space is emptiness and not emptiness at the same
time.”

Heavenly Emperor’s image stood tall as he imparted the art. Zhuo Fan
didn’t even blink, afraid of losing even a minute gesture.

Gu Santong and the chick could feel how important this was to Zhuo Fan
and stood quietly at the side.

For three days and three nights, Zhuo Fan hadn’t moved, hadn’t spoken,
hadn’t even blinked for how engrossed he was.

The Heavenly Emperor ended with, “I have imparted you with the 12 stages
of Divine Eye of the Void! You now hold inside you the power to make our
clan supreme, all you need to do is will it. Regarding my second magical
art, Purple Lightning Gold Eye, it was born out of this Divine Eye of
the Void. If your talent is not lacking, it will come to you with time
without having the need to train it. If you lack in any way, seek out
the other Imparting Stone of mine to help you train it. But if you wish
to follow in my footsteps and reach my power, stop here! Take what I’ve
given you and use your own abilities to attain comprehension of it…”

The mist dissipated and the Heavenly Emperor’s figure faded away,
leaving behind the pieces of the Imparting Stone. These pieces had now
turned to useless hunks of rocks!

Zhuo Fan frowned.

Gu Santong asked, “What’s wrong, godfather?”

“Nothing, just that the last phrase was odd. As if he didn’t want his
descendant to train in the Purple Lightning Gold Eye!” Zhuo Fan’s eyes
squinted.

Gu Santong laughed at the sky and mocked, “What does it matter what he
wanted? It all comes down to your decision to train or not.”

“Of course I want to. That’s one of his masterpieces!” Zhuo Fan widened
his eyes.

“Then what are we waiting for? I’ll help you search for it!” Gu Santong
jumped right into scrounge through the rocks on the ground, looking for
another Imparting Stone.

Zhuo Fan shook his head in the end.

The Heavenly Emperor didn’t want for his descendant to train the Purple
Lightning Gold Eye, but deduce it by himself instead of blindingly
following the teachings of others. And yet, he was still afraid his
descendant was unable to achieve it so he left the training method for
the Purple Lightning Gold Eye behind.

Zhuo Fan, however, was not Heavenly Emperor’s descendant, so there was
no point in abiding by Heavenly Emperor’s teachings!

[Who cares? Waste not want not. It’s here anyway so I might as well use
it.] But what struck him as odd, was that the image clearly intended to
leave it all for his descendant. So how on earth did it end up being
taken advantage of by this down on his luck, rebirthed Demonic Emperor
who stumbled his way inside?

Looking at the jutting Qilin leg, Zhuo Fan was in deep thought.

[He-he-he, who the hell cares? Since it fell in my lap, if I don’t take
it, who will?]

Zhuo Fan grinned, and scoured the place with Gu Santong. The chick was
skipping around at the side, chirping oddly.

[What is daddy and bro doing? Looking for worms to eat?]

The chick hopped into the fun!

An hour later, most of the place was turned upside down but no sign of
anything that remotely resembled another Imparting Stone. Zhuo Fan was
curious, [Does this place have only the Divine Eye of the Void Imparting
Stone?]

Then he facepalmed and cursed, [I’m such a fool!]

How could he forget about Long Jiu?

Long Jiu said he’d been sucked into the purple lightning storm, and
punched everywhere. In sheer coincidence he entered through the gap in
the array and smashed the Purple Lightning Gold Eye’s Imparting Stone by
chance.

So when he was listening to that strange voice he’d been training Purple
Lightning Gold Eye without even realizing. But in his frantic state, he
forgot the training method to the art, thus making the art lost.

Zhuo Fan shook his head, [I can’t decide if it was bad luck or dumb
luck!]

His dumb luck was because of the ridiculously low chance of any of those
events ever happening to him. Furthermore, in a row too. And bad luck
since he was clearly being taught an ultimate skill, yet, he was too
much of a chicken to keep it together to remember it!

Zhuo Fan sighed, then recalled Heavenly Emperor’s words. [It may perhaps
be a blessing in disguise.]

“Young Sanzi, we can stop now. The Purple Lightning Gold Eye isn’t fated
for me. Let it go!” Zhuo Fan sighed and chuckled.

Gu Santong said, concerned, “But can you alleviate your wounds with only
that Divine Eye of the Void? As the saying goes, whoever started
something must also have a way of ending it. The purple lightning is
harming you so the Purple Lightning Gold Eye must cure you as well!”

Zhuo Fan shuddered, felt warm and fuzzy inside.

He only wanted the Purple Lightning Gold Eye to boost his power. But Gu
Santong’s main priority was to cure him.

[I may have cheated him into the fold, but he’s starting to really grow
on me.]

“It’s of no importance. The Divine Eye of the Void is enough to cure
me!” Zhuo Fan smiled and beckoned his two sons over.

Gu Santong still felt somewhat repelled by the purple lightning chick,
but he was doing his best to accept this little bro of his.

Zhuo Fan patted their heads and spoke solemnly, “Young Sanzi, and you
too little bird, uh I’ll just call you Qiao’er. Your dad is going to set
up an array and enter seclusion to heal and train. I do not know when
I’ll come out. You will be staying here but don’t wander off outside of
the light’s curtain!”

“Worry not, godfather, I won’t!” Gu Santong waved, his face showing fear
as he looked at the purple lightning outside.

But Qiao’er, cocked its head, oblivious. Zhuo Fan had no time to
explain, handing it over in Gu Santong’s care as he immediately set up
an array. He sat cross legged in its center and closed his eyes.

Months flashed by!

The next thing he knew when he opened his eyes was that still purple
lightning streaked sky. The change he felt inside was the only testament
time even passed. With an incredible release of power, his right eye
sported a golden ring flashing on and off, with streaks of purple
flickering now and then.

He removed the array with a sweep of the hand and Zhuo Fan stood up.

“Eh, you’re out?” A childish voice came from behind, “Godfather, are you
cured now?”

“Of course!” Zhuo Fan smiled, and turned to Gu Santong, “Not only cured,
but new and improved. Now we can leave this place. I will show both of
you my power as we fly out of here!”

Face twitching, Gu Santong sighed, “Godfather, when you boast, at least
make it reasonable! You took five years to get to the 9th layer of Bone
Tempering Stage. How can you fly us out when you’re not even in the
Profound Heaven Stage? I actually have more hope on Qiao’er!”

Gu Santong pointed at the sky and shouted, “Qiao’er, dad is out!”

Shriek~

With a sharp cry, a three meter long purple bird was soaring above the
red curtain. The endless booms of purple lightning struck its body but
could do nothing to it.

Zhuo Fan went slackjawed, “I-is that Qiao’er? He’s already a 4th level
spiritual beast and can produce 4th Heaven purple lightning! But how is
it that the 12th Heaven purple lightning outside has no effect on him?”

“I was also worried at first, but he must be of the same nature as the
purple lightning.” Gu Santong shrugged, “Those purple lightning never
once harmed him. He absorbs them by instinct and then releases it
without any consequences!”

Zhuo Fan was blinking in shock.

[My godson is a monster, and my spiritual beast is also a goddamn freak
of nature. Not even a 12th Heaven purple lightning fazes him!]

[But that’s only obvious. I reckon I have also stepped into the ranks of
monsters. I may have been called a ‘monster’ by others, but now, I’m
sure I can even surprise young Sanzi, ha-ha-ha…]

Zhuo Fan turned his smiling face to Gu Santong, “Young Sanzi, did you
eat all the ingredients I gave you?”

“Ages ago, and Qiao’er ate half! I haven’t had an ingredient to eat for
three years now and couldn’t get out as well. I’m starving here…” Gu
Santong rubbed his stomach dejected.

Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder, “No worries, dad will take you out now!”

“Yeah, right! A 9th layer Bone Tempering cultivator? Even if you did
have to heal first, you’re too slow in advancing.” Gu Santong teased,
then sighed, “My hopes are all on Qiao’er. He isn’t afraid of purple
lightning and once he finds the right way out of here, he’ll bring me
plenty of ingredients, he-he-he…”

Zhuo Fan’s face sank, [How can I let a son look down on his father?]

So he coughed to get Gu Santong’s attention, “Young Sanzi, how can you
be so cruel to your old man? You’re making me look bad! Come, throw me a
punch. I will show you what I can do. Cultivation isn’t everything!”

Gu Santong looked at him oddly, “Dad, be serious. Not even a Radiant
Stage expert can take my punch!”

“Cut the chatter and bring it on! I said that I’ll show you my power and
that’s what I’ll do!” Zhuo Fan shouted.

Gu Santong sighed and extended a finger, [Dad is so stubborn that I have
no choice but play with him. Sigh, I just hope I don’t overdo it!]

Gu Santong simply flicked.

A ripple shot like an arrow straight for Zhuo Fan.

Gu Santong had controlled his power to the bare minimum, but Zhuo Fan
couldn’t even take this lightly. Yet he was standing there unfazed for
the attack to approach swiftly.

“Watch out, godfather!” Gu Santong cried in panic, [Why didn’t I hold
back more? Even if dad is a body cultivator, his level is just too low
and this will leave him a pulp!]

His shock didn’t end there as Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden and
vanished into thin air.

When he appeared, he was behind Gu Santong!

“Divine Eye of the Void’s 1st stage!” Zhuo Fan snickered. Gu Santong was
shocked!

Because the moment Zhuo Fan was gone, he lost all traces of him. Not
just sight, but smell and hearing as well, all senses failed to detect
him as if he was no longer in this world!

[This can’t be…]

Chapter 245 - Getting Out

Chapter 245, Getting Out

“Young Sanzi, here comes my punch!”

Before Gu Santong could get his wits about him, Zhuo Fan shouted. Gu
Santong mocked in the end, “Dad, dodging is easy, but punching…”

Starting with a flicker, a purple lightning shot for him.

Gu Santong’s eyes widened and instinct screamed at him to dodge behind
the pillar with a jump. The lightning crossed space in a flash, striking
the pillar with a boom!

Gu Santong peeked out and saw Zhuo’s fist wrapped in purple lightning,
“G-godfather, how can you use purple lightning?”

“Ha-ha-ha, that’s thanks to Divine Eye of the Void!” Zhuo Fan flicked
his hand, being smug after seeing young Sanzi’s reaction. He finally got
to show off in front of his godlike adopted son of his, “The Divine Eye
of the Void pays emphasis on the void part. It’s main use is control
over space. The first stage allows me to switch places anywhere in my
soul search’s range. And…”

Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed golden and Gu Santong’s ring appeared on
his finger, “Allows me complete control over inanimate items, changing
their location. Ha-ha-ha, young Sanzi, since you ate all ingredients
from it you won’t be needing my storage ring anymore!”

Even Gu Santong couldn’t help but gawk at the explanation and display of
such an outstanding art. This was the first time in the life of
Invincible Scamp to show such a shocked face.

“Won’t that make you invincible, since no one can hit you?” Gu Santong
blinked.

Scratching his chin, Zhuo Fan nodded, “You can say that, but not quite
either. If the first stage of Divine Eye of the Void is so invincible
what would be the point of the remaining 11 stages? In truth, this is
only control over space. If space is sealed, or I’m inside another
space, I’m finished!”

“T-then what’s with the purple lightning? How…” Gu Santong stammered.

Zhuo Fan grinned and his right eye flashes purple, “After training
Divine Eye of the Void to the 1st stage, my right eye can open up a
pocket dimension. Those purple lightning remnants that wrecked my body
and couldn’t be removed are now stored in that pocket dimension. To use
them at my discretion!”

“That is why I said cultivation isn’t everything! I may have used most
of my time on healing and comprehending the 1st stage of Divine Eye of
the Void, but true power is a whole other matter!”

Zhuo Fan grinned, leaving Gu Santong dumbfounded!

Despite Zhuo Fan not having gone through immense changes in the past
five years, training in a remarkable art turned him into a freak
nonetheless. If Gu Santong hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn’t
have believed it!

Going out like this, he’d be like a wolf hiding among sheep, ready to
strike at any so called expert out there. Who’d ever suspect a 9th layer
of Bone Tempering cultivator to have such an insane trump card!

“T-then what of the 2nd stage, godfather? Let me see it!” Gu Santong was
eager to witness even more of Divine Eye of the Void’s power.

Blushing, Zhuo Fan coughed drilly, “Uh, Divine Eye of the Void is very
hard to understand. Even I only learned the first stage after so long…”

Gu Santong’s face sank in disappointment before he even finished.

Zhuo Fan scratched his head, helpless, [The kid’s face changes tune
faster than the weather!] But then he said something that brightened Gu
Santong’s day, “But since this space has the same origin as my Divine
Eye of the Void, we can now leave this place. Young Sanzi, you’ll get to
eat more ingredients!”

“Awesome!”

Gu Santong jumped ten feet in joy, already back to his cheerful self. He
heard Zhuo Fan say that before but didn’t believe him one bit.

Now, after Zhuo Fan’s demonstration, he was very much a believer.

Qiao’er also flew before Zhuo Fan and circled Zhuo Fan in jubilation.

Zhuo Fan laughed and repeated his explanation before showing his Thunder
Ring, “Don’t resist as I place you in my ring. We will then shortly
leave this place and get you out!”

Qiao’er flapped its wings in joy. It felt very close to the Thunder Ring
since it was refined from its mother and entered it without complaint.

Gu Santong was hesitating, “Godfather, wait a moment!”

Gu Santong turned to the pillar, fell to his knees and knocked his head
on the ground three times, tears streaming down his face, “I do not know
who you are, but I know you’re my kin. I don’t know how you died, but I
feel heartbroken over your death. I am leaving now, leaving you alone.
Take care of yourself!”

Gu Santong wiped his face and went to Zhuo Fan. He didn’t look back, in
fear he might not want to ever leave.

Putting Gu Santong in the ring, Zhuo Fan looked at the pillar and
sighed, “Soaring Qilin, I am not a good man, and I do not wish to go
between you and the Heavenly Emperor. As a Soaring Qilin, you’re a
heaven sent ingredient for me. How could I not want you? But, as this
child’s godfather, I still hope I can ease his pain…”

Sighing, Zhuo Fan’s eye flashed with light and struck the pillar!

With a bang, the pillar swayed and fell.

With its collapse, the red curtain vanished as well. The purple
lightning above the black sky rushed to Zhuo Fan like jackals, wishing
to tear him limb from limb.

But Zhuo Fan was calm as ever. He placed the Qilin leg in his ring then
his golden eye flashed, right as the purple lightning was about to hit
him, vanishing from this world.

The next thing he knew, he was outside the hole he used to enter into
this space. But the lightning didn’t hit him as he vanished again.

Thus, in the sea of purple lightning, a flash of golden could be seen on
and off growing further and further away. And the purple lightning could
do nothing to stop it.

When they reached the edge of the Lightning Canyon, Zhuo Fan’s golden
eye flashed one more time.

Whoosh~

His last stop was in a thick forest. Looking up, the bright moon hung in
the sky bathing this corner of the world in its moonlight.

“Finally out, but where am I?”

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan tasted freedom again. With Lightning
Canyon wandering the continent he was hard pressed to pinpoint his exact
location.

[Who cares anyway? It’s fine as long as I’m out.]

He took Gu Santong and Qiao’er out of his ring and the kid was ecstatic
to finally be out again.

This was Qiao’er’s first time seeing the real world, and cried in joy.
It flew everywhere, curious to explore it!

“Young Sanzi, I have a gift for you!”

Zhuo Fan showed the kid a tender smile. Gu Santong asked ecstatic,
“What, did you have more hidden ingredients in your ring?”

Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You little twerp, you picked my ring clean of
them. Where could I find any? I think you will find this far more
attractive!”

Zhuo Fan then showed the Qilin leg that was still flickering with
lightning!

Gu Santong had tears in his eyes as he expressed his gratitude, “You got
it out…”

“Of course. I know how much you care for it and don’t want it to be
hacked by purple lightning. Since I have the power, of course I’ll help
you!”

“Thank you!”

Gu Santong wiped his tears and bowed deeply. Zhuo Fan was truly the
spitting image of his former godfather, bearing the same amount of care
for him as well.

He valued Zhuo Fan far more greatly now, more than even his real
parents.

This perhaps was one of Zhuo Fan’s very rare acts of kindness. He always
looked at Gu Santong and thought how to use him. But the kid’s pure
heart touched him, making fatherly love blossom in his cruel and dead
heart!

Gu Santong went to the Qilin leg, felt its rough surface and even hugged
it, feeling the warmth.

He then came to Zhuo Fan with a request, “Godfather, will you look after
it for a while?”

“Why won’t you…” Zhuo Fan asked, but saw Gu Santong’s sad face and could
easily guess.

Gu Santong was forced into a promise to defend the Imperial Capital and
wasn’t even allowed to eat the ingredients he liked so much. How could
he be allowed a storage ring then? It would soon be discovered and
confiscated if he took it with him.

Zhuo Fan sighed, “Alright, but you best take care and not be so hard on
yourself. If you ever find yourself in mortal danger, forget about that
promise. Your life is more important!”

“Yes!” Gu Santong smiled brightly.

Zhuo Fan returned his smile and stashed the Qilin leg away.

“By the way, godfather. It’s been five years since I was allowed to
leave the Imperial Capital. I need to report back, but where will you
go?” At the moment of their separation, Gu Santong still felt reluctant
to leave.

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan put on a diabolical grin, “Since it’s
been five years, it’s the right time for the Esoteric Debate to start.
I’m going there to liven the mood! Let’s see if those legendary Regent
Estate freaks can live up to the expectation, ha-ha-ha…”

Chapter 246 - Emergence of Dragons

Chapter 246, Emergence of Dragons

Drifting Flowers City, at the entrance to the stone room behind Drifting
Flowers Edifice. Grandmother, with Iris and Peony Overseer, were
waiting. Under the warm sunlight, among the refreshing chirping, they
were the only ones whose faces showed no change, their eyes fixed on the
stone door.

Rumble!

With a heavy sound, the heavy stone door opened and four figures
emerged. The first wore a silk cover, but her delicate figure and her
graceful poise couldn’t be hidden. Her eyes were enough to make anyone
in the world flustered and intoxicated by her beauty.

And behind her were three old women. They looked calm, but clearly
excited.

Chu Bijun’s brow jumped and she sent three silver needles at the woman.
But the woman only lifted her delicate hand casually.

A sudden chill came then and a wall of cold mist formed. The three
needles rapidly lost speed and ended up falling on the ground into
frozen pieces!

Grandmother sighed in praise, “Qingcheng, you’ve greatly improved, as if
reborn. If not for neglecting cultivation for the past decade, you’d be
no weaker than the other houses’ chosen in the Esoteric Debate!”

Indeed, this person who came out after a long five years of seclusion
was Chu Qingcheng. She was no longer as weak as she was five years ago.
She was like a towering glacier, worthy of the title Ascending Ice
Phoenix!

“You’re too kind, Grandmother! It is all thanks to our three Venerables
helping day and night with my training. I am grateful, Venerables!”

Chu Qingcheng slightly bowed at the three old women behind her, and so
did Grandmother and the overseers. The Venerables spoke, “It is the
least we could do as Drifting Flowers Edifice’s Venerables. Qingcheng’s
talent is remarkable, only needing to stimulate her potential. She did
the rest!”

The four once again bowed, and the Venerables closed the stone door with
a wave. Chu Bijun walked to Chu Qingcheng and looked her up and down.

“8th layer of Profound Heaven Stage, good good! We will show the world
the power of Drifting Flowers Edifice in this Esoteric Debate!” Chu
Bijun’s eyes shined.

Iris Overseer smiled, “With Qingcheng, we will show them who Drifting
Flowers Edifice is. Let’s see them try to take women lightly again!”

“Ha-ha-ha, true, but…” Chu Bijun frowned, “We must also make our
standing clear! We must strike at Regent Estate’s arrogance in this
Esoteric Debate! Or they will strike back at us many times harder!”

“Yes, that is why, Qingcheng, you must work together with Veiled Dragon
Pavilion and Sword Marquise Abode, our two allies. I have talked with
them and have reached an agreement!” Iris Overseer said, “As four of
your opponents, Pill King Hall, Hell Valley, and Merry Woods, they have
all sided with Regent Estate. The Seven Noble Houses are now split in
two factions! This is why the Esoteric Debate this time will be so much
crueler, so much more savage!”

Chu Qingcheng frowned in worry, “Regent Estate’s monster, Huangpu
Qingtian, is hard to deal with already. And now that we are three
against four…”

“Ha-ha-ha, don’t worry. It will definitely be four against four. I heard
that the Luo clan will be joining in as well. They were but a third rate
clan before and must be planning on standing abreast to us by passing
the first two rounds of elimination. I wonder though, who’ll they be
sending…” Grandmother considered.

Chu Qingcheng’s eyes lit up, “Luo clan will come?”

Already clear on who Chu Qingcheng had her mind on, Grandmother shook
her head, “It’s unclear if he will be there as well. He’s been missing
for five years already. It is a bad omen. Not even his clansmen know
about his whereabouts. So the support we can expect from the Luo clan is
minimal!”

“What, he’s gone? How? Why?” Chu Qingcheng didn’t care if the Luo clan
helped them, and was only worried about Zhuo Fan. Grandmother shook her
head.

[Such deep love is like a poison, making one forget even oneself!]

Iris Overseer sighed, “I heard he was last sighted where Lightning
Canyon appeared five years ago. Then, he vanished. We can only assume…”

Chu Qingcheng trembled and shot down that idea, “Impossible, he will be
fine!”

Peony Overseer cursed instead, “That foul and ungrateful prick, how does
his fate have anything to do with us? He didn’t value your feelings, not
one bit!”

Chu Qingcheng’s eyes grew hazy, her heart in a mess. Grandmother spoke
gravely, “Qingcheng, whether he comes or not, I hope you will keep your
distance from him. I met him once. His ambition is unhealthy, much
greater than we can imagine. Such a man is very attractive, but also one
who can easily harm women. In his heart, women are burdens. Beings he
finds no value in. For your own sake, don’t get too close!”

Chu Qingcheng was silent, alone with the bitterness in her heart.

[But I can no longer go back…]

In another part, deep in Sword Marquise Abode, there lay a stone gate on
the verge of opening. Two youths came from within, Xie Tianyang and a
youth with white temples. His eyes were cold like a blade.

There was also the on and off flicker in his eyes, but if one looked,
he’d feel two sharp swords stabbing him. The pain would be too much to
keep one’s eyes focused on him.

He was none other than Sword Marquise Abode’s leading talent, Xie
Tianyang’s elder brother, one of the six dragons, Golden Armored Sword
Dragon Xie Tianshang!

“Tianshang, Tianyang, you’re out!” Xie Xiaofeng laughed and patted their
shoulders.

Xie Tianyang snickered, “Dad, I’ve mastered our house’s entire martial
art, Flowing Space’s Nine Forms. I can now marry Ning’er!”

Xie Tianshang gave a curt nod, walking past Xie Xiaofeng and to the
training area, “I’m off to practice. Later!”

Xie Xiaofeng felt helpless watching his sons.

The eldest was a martial fanatic, always thinking about training, never
getting close with anyone. While the second was a love-struck fool, the
only thing on his mind was marriage. If he hadn’t been smart and tricked
him into lifting the sword for her, he probably never would’ve had.

Xie Xiaofeng sighed, [It’d be great if they were combined into one!]

Jian Suifeng came from behind, “Abode Lord, don’t worry, Tianyang’s
temper will smooth over time. As for Tianshang, he only has one person
in mind. He won’t stop until he defeats that person!”

“You mean the Regent Estate’s monster?” Xie Xiaofeng sighed, “Forget it,
I don’t want my son to tangle with that monster. It will only bring us
shame!”

Jian Suifeng nodded and sighed…

In another part, in the rear gardens of Veiled Dragon Pavilion…

A youth in fine green clothes was taking a walk and showed an infatuated
look, “Ah, the air is so much better outside. Bliss!”

“Eldest young master!” Long Jiu rushed over anxious, “When did you get
out? Why wasn’t I informed of this?”

“He-he-he, if you had you’d be throwing some congratulatory feast to
ruin my mood! It was better to come here and get some peace!” The
youth’s smile turned odd, “By the way, Uncle Jiu, what of little Kui and
little Jie? How come I don’t see them?”

“Ha-ha-ha, they’re hard at training!”

“Ai, when will they come out?” The youth asked.

With a vague chuckle, Long Jiu said, “Eldest young master, you’ve been
in seclusion for a decade. There are many things you have missed! If
you’d have witnessed the battle of Drifting Flowers Edifice, you’d have
been as stimulated as them!”

“What do you mean?” The youth rose an eyebrow.

But Long Jiu only smiled in response, [Kids these days won’t work hard
without a well placed stimulus…]

Similar occurrences happened in the other houses as the Six Dragons and
One Phoenix came out of seclusion to join the Esoteric Debate.
Especially…

In Caged Dragon City, people gathered outside a secret room on the
mountain behind Regent Estate. As the stone gate moved, two people were
made known to all. One was a calm youth, his every step at ease and
firm. His incredible air made even the Profound Heaven elders step back
in shock.

Behind him was High Venerable Huangpu Fenglei with pride in his eyes.

“High Venerable, any progress?” Huangpu Tianyuan asked.

Huangpu Fenglei caressed his beard with a smile, “I oversaw his training
personally. He is the pinnacle in the world, second to none!”

“High Venerable, that is hardly the case!”

The youth’s cold tone came in rebuke, “My current self isn’t taught on,
only my nature. And father, your words are pointless!”

Shuddering, everyone watched Huangpu Tianyuan speak with such crass and
lack of manners. Yet all nodded, [This is the air of a lord!]

Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Tianyuan chuckled, “Seeing you so
confident, I won’t ask any further. I believe that in the Esoteric
Debate you will bring shock on everyone’s faces. Let them see that
Regent Estate’s power shrouds the seven houses!”

“Father, you’re wrong again. I am not confident, just my nature! I do
not need to amaze them for Regent Estate to shroud the houses. My very
arrival turns it into reality! The unification of the seven houses, that
impossible matter, will be completed with my ascension!”

Huangpu Qingtian was calm and someone rushed to put a golden cape over
his shoulder. His natural grace and demeanor looked down on every single
being.

Even Huangpu Tianyuan felt anger inside. The youth was clearly unfilial.

But this was Regent Estate, and they trained themselves to have lordly
flairs. It didn’t matter if the father and son fought over the Estate
Lord position, what mattered was the ability to have it! One’s
leadership applied to the entire house, even to the Estate Lord.

Leng Wuchang came to Huangpu Tianyuan and bowed, “Eldest young master,
it is good to be confident, but one must also be wary in every taken
action, lest you’d meet with utter failure!”

“Oh, and where are you going with this?” Huangpu Tianyuan glanced by.

Smiling Leng Wuchang said, “A fiend had recently appeared in Tianyu, by
the name of Zhuo Fan. It pushed back the seven houses and killed dozens
of our elders. Even the second young master fell victim. I heard he will
be joining in the Esoteric Debate. Please remain cautious, eldest young
master!”

“Humph, second brother was worthless. He got what he deserved, killed by
a nobody. As for those elders, they are even bigger fools! But for that
kid to kill so many and still live, that makes you the biggest fools of
all! Are you telling me he’s as invincible as that Gu Santong from three
hundred years ago?” Huangpu Qingtian snapped coldly.

Leng Wuchang shook his head, “Gu Santong is a monster seen perhaps once
a millennia. But he is not like Gu Santong. Gu Santong may be unbridled,
but gullible. While that kid’s treachery runs deep, expert at gathering
people to stand by his side. The reason why we’ve failed to get his head
is because three houses have formed an alliance with him. He is also
relying on one of the Four Pillars, War God Dugu Zhantian and even the
imperial family is protecting him. Our hands were tied…”

“Oh, a schemer you say?” Shaking his head, Huangpu Qingtian said, “Fine
then, since you’re all so worthless, I will personally end that man in
the Esoteric Debate!”

“Eldest young master, please exercise extreme caution. Every single one
that has underestimated the kid has died in agony!”

Leng Wuchang bowed, but his words earned a snort from Huangpu Qingtian,
“Sir Leng, I admire your talent greatly, but please, do not lump me
together with you fools! By the way, once I have that kid’s head, the
title of Estate Lord… Oh, father, isn’t it about time for you to step
down?”

Trembling, Huangpu Tianyuan’s face was a mask of darkness and rage!

This was his ‘good’ son, the strongest talent in the seven houses, the
head of the six dragons, one that at this crucial time, was only
thinking of how to snatch his father’s position, the Heaven-shaking
Dragon Lord Huangpu Qingtian…

Chapter 247 - The Biggest Underdog

Chapter 247, The Biggest Underdog

June 22, 2021

<< Index >>

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Silavin

Five months later, at the Imperial Capital, the Emperor was reviewing
reports in the study.

Suddenly, a black figure knelt at his side. Hands cupped in respect,
black figure spoke “Your Majesty, Dragon Cloud City’s report on the Luo
clan has come!”

“Deliver!”

The Emperor spoke, but didn’t spare the man a glance. The man offered
the report with both hands.

The Emperor took one glance at it and threw it back into the man’s face,
“Every damn report over the past five years has been either all quiet or
all normal! The Luo clan is set to make waves in the Esoteric Debate,
but where is that Bone Tempering Stage kid? How the hell are you even
getting your intelligence?”

“Please sooth your anger, Your Majesty! I’ve been at fault!” The man was
on the ground in a blink, shaking like a leaf.

The Emperor caressed his beard, but the fire in his eyes was like a
smoldering volcano. Oddly enough, he soon restored his calm.

Yet this only worked to instill greater fear in the man’s bones!

“Is there anything on that Zhuo Fan?” The emperor’s tone was cold.

The man shook his head, “Nothing, Your Majesty!”

“And what of Divine Dragon Gu Santong?” The emperor followed.

The man was on the verge of tears, “Unknown, Your Majesty!”

“You’ve been searching for five years but can’t find anything about Zhuo
Fan. That rampant guy Gu Santong must still be stirring trouble
somewhere and yet you can’t even find a trace of him! Humph, why am I
even raising you worthless mongrels? You can’t do anything!” The
Emperor’s eyes flashed with bloodthirst.

The man kowtowed three times, pleading, “Your Majesty, please quell your
anger. I am incompetent! Please spare me!”

“Out!” The Emperor flicked his sleeve.

The man kowtowed three more times and bolted, “Thank you, Your Majesty,
thank you…”

The Emperor took a deep breath and lifted his head, “Gu Santong and Zhuo
Fan are missing. Can this piece of information even be trusted? Did they
perish in the Lightning Canyon?

“It’s fine if Gu Santong is gone from this world. It might actually be a
blessing! But Zhuo Fan? He is yet to fulfill his task. His death would
be such a waste! But this boy brings too many surprises. He lifted up a
wretched third rate clan to one that is brimming with power! A miracle
really! But I just can’t tell if the Luo clan can still complete the
task without Zhuo Fan, ha-ha-ha…”

The Emperor chuckled quite cheerfully, like a sly rogue.

Just then, a guard fell to his knees before the emperor, “Your Majesty,
Divine Dragon Gu Santong has returned!”

Ugh!

The laughter came to a grunting stop, and the emperor sighed,
“Understood!” But his good mood was gone.

[Ah, the worst trouble is yet to come…]

Meanwhile, before the great gates of a city, a familiar figure appeared.
He looked up and read the imposing words on the wall, Dragon Cloud City.

Rumor had it that the imperial family, Yuwen clan’s efforts to raise an
army to found the empire in historic times all began from this place. As
such, every single Esoteric Debate was held here.

“I got held up for too long in the Lightning Canyon. I hope I made it in
time. Hope those guys didn’t get themselves wiped out again!” Zhuo Fan
sighed under his black cloak as he entered the city.

There were soldiers all around the city, but that did not stop anyone
from milling about.

This city afterall was a gathering place of the empire’s most
distinguished houses and clans. Everyone was free to come and go or even
join the Esoteric Debate if they wished.

But the army was tasked with breaking any conflicts among these clans,
most of all among the seven houses. Once a fight broke out, it was easy
to plunge the entire empire into unrest.

This made the soldiers stationed here ready to act at a moment’s notice.

The only one in the whole empire able to shake the seven houses was none
other than the second of the Four Pillars and Tianyu’s Marshal, God of
War, Dugu Zhantian!

Though meeting this big man was the last thing on Zhuo Fan’s mind.

Inside the city, Zhuo Fan was shocked. The place was packed, like a sea
of people. It was more packed than Drifting Flowers City at the time of
the Hundred Pill Meeting!

Then again, how many clans did the Hundred Pill Meeting attract? The
Esoteric Debate, however, drew in all the clans that hoped for a swift
rise to fame and power. The difference was obvious.

He didn’t have the time to let the sights distract him. His top priority
was to get back to the Luo clan and ascertain the situation.

But only after a few steps, a ruckus entered his ears. “Windgaze City’s
Luo clan has landed their 27th win, advancing into the second rate
clans’ finals and becoming this Esoteric Debate’s biggest underdog! “

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan looked towards the speaker but only found a
small tavern. So he stepped in to learn more.

The thick smell of wine and clamor struck his face the moment he stepped
in. Some guys with bare arms were shouting and waving their fists
around, god only knew why.

There was a betting table in the tavern and a score table on the far
wall had the name of every clan on it. People at the table were
constantly placing bets.

Of course, not everyone was betting.

Zhuo Fan saw that the board had the seven houses’ names on it as well as
their representative genius.

“Ascending Ice Phoenix – Drifting Flowers Edifice, Forest Fleeting
Dragon – Merry Woods, Golden Armored Sword Dragon – Sword Marquise
Abode…” Zhuo Fan muttered every word, but then he screamed, “Soaring
Demonic Dragon – Blackwind Mountain? Who the hell came up with this?”

The dealer from the table saw Zhuo Fan amazed and smirked, “Hey dummy,
what hole did you crawl out of? Haven’t you ever heard of Windgaze
City’s Luo clan on Blackwind Mountain? Of their Soaring Demonic Dragon
Zhuo Fan?”

Zhuo Fan’s mouth was agape. He scratched his head, [When did this
Soaring Black Dragon stuff get started?]

Seeing his puzzlement, the dealer sighed, “You’re really ignorant! When
Demon Archon Zhuo Fan wrecked Drifting Flowers City, everyone and their
uncles learnt about him! Now that we know he represents the Luo clan in
the Esoteric Debate, of course he stands on par with the Six Dragons and
One Phoenix. This is why people call him Soaring Demonic Dragon.
Apparently, it is the name of the martial art he used!”

“Bullshit!”

A buffed guy started arguing, “Complete and utter bullshit! The Demon
Archon Zhuo Fan did use the Soaring Demonic Dragon in Drifting Flowers
City to kill Regent Estate’s second young master, but his nickname has a
totally different meaning! His Soaring Demonic Dragon title implies that
he wants to break through to Heaven, and challenge the seven houses’
thousand year long authority! You know nothing! So don’t go about
talking rubbish!”

Zhuo Fan nodded, finding this second explanation far more plausible.

[God damn it! Who the hell dares to say that Heaven stands above me?
I’ll rip them to pieces! This is more my style. Ha-ha-ha, yours truly
likes Soaring Demonic Dragon!]

But his joy ended as soon as the dealer barked back, “Cut the crap!
Demon Archon Zhuo Fan may be great, but do you think he has it in him to
contest the seven houses? The seven houses’ status in Tianyu has been
unshaken for a thousand years. Haven’t you heard? Luo clan has the Sword
Marquise Abode, Veiled Dragon Pavilion and Drifting Flowers Edifice
backing them! I reckon that even if the Luo clan climbs high enough to
enter the fight between the seven houses, it will only fight as a vassal
clan of the three houses!”

Bam!

Zhuo Fan slapped the table, his face twisted in grimace, “Who the hell
told you that Luo clan is their vassal? Get your head straight, Luo clan
will become an independent clan, competing on the same level as the
seven houses. It will not cower behind some other house for safety! Just
wait and watch!”

The two looked at Zhuo Fan puzzled. [What’s his connection with the Luo
clan? Why is he so fired up in protecting this underdog?]

But they didn’t have the time to talk back and curse Zhuo Fan for being
a mental case as an aged voice laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, indeed. Luo clan
should aim for the best clan and challenge the unwritten rule that has
held on for millennia. If not, like every single time, the Esoteric
Debate would end with only the seven houses competing. Wouldn’t that be
too boring? “

Shuddering, Zhuo Fan looked back to see three elders. Every one of them
was wearing a cloak to hide their features.

The elder in the middle revealed his piercing eyes and grinned, “Steward
Zhuo, I’ve long wished to meet you my soul brother! I am Prime Minister
Zhuge Changfeng. Care to join me for a chat?”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes widened and he looked at him deeply.

He never thought that the head of the Four Pillars, Zhuge Changfeng
would personally grace him with his presence! Glancing at the two elders
on his sides, from their mighty aura, he could tell they were rare
experts.

With a deep breath, Zhuo Fan nodded. Zhuge Changfeng grinned and made a
flourish. The two then walked side by side to a table.

The two elders stood behind Zhuge Changfeng and their eyes flashed,
sending an energy to envelop the table. The noise around them slowly
ceased and their words were never heard by the people outside.

Yet to the untrained eye, the four looked like they were having a casual
chat. The dealer and the big man looked baffled for a minute and then
ignored them.

Zhuo Fan was shocked and became wary of the two elders. No average
Radiant Stage expert could just set up a barrier so casually. Not even a
peak one!

The two must’ve trained in some special cultivation method. They weren’t
to be taken lightly.

Thinking about Zhuge Changfeng, he may only be in the 2nd layer of the
Profound Heaven Stage, but he was surrounded by many powerful people. He
was a man no one from the seven houses dared underestimate.

His name as the head of the Four Pillars was well deserved…
