Chapter 248 - Wise Men’s Talk

Chapter 248, Wise Men’s Talk

“Steward Zhuo, you must be wondering why I was looking for you.” Zhuge
Changfeng’s beard trembled.

Zhuo Fan nodded, but his only reply was a fixed stare.

Zhuge Changfeng held him in greater admiration.

In fact, just by answering, Zhuo Fan would’ve fallen in his trap.
Regardless of the content, Zhuo Fan’s reply would’ve given him the
rights to lead the conversation and, ultimately, Zhuo Fan by the nose.

But Zhuo Fan kept silent, thus keeping his right to speak.

It may be some minor detail, but to a leader of Zhuge Changfeng’s
stature, it was very important. Right of speech translated into power.
If one’s right to speak was taken away, then that person was at a
disadvantage.

On this aspect, Zhuge Changfeng was an expert, and he admired Zhuo Fan’s
response greatly, “Steward Zhuo, your rumors do not do you justice. I am
in awe after meeting you!”

“Prime-minister Zhuge is exaggerating. Your illustrious name has given
me far more shock!” Zhuo Fan laughed.

Zhuge Changfeng sighed, “Wise men speak plainly. Let us dispense with
the tricks. Or we’ll be at it for three days and still not finish.”

“Ha-ha-ha, Prime-minister Zhuge is quite open so I shall do the same!”
Zhuo Fan nodded cheerfully.

Zhuge Changfeng went straight to the point, “Steward Zhuo, I fear that
someone may have instigated the Luo clan’s participation in the Esoteric
Debate.”

“Oh, what makes you say that?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.

Zhuge Changfeng replied, “We are both men who look at things from all
perspectives. I am certain that with you as its steward, Luo clan’s rise
beyond the seven houses would only be a matter of time. But your coming
out in the open has been far too soon. With Steward Zhuo’s cunning, I
believe you are not a man looking for short term gain. I surmise that
you’ve been forced, or perhaps, lured into a choice that you could not
refuse!”

Zhuo Fan was impressed.

[Zhuge Changfeng is amazing, able to understand everything.] Indeed, Luo
clan jumping into the Esoteric Debate and starting a fight with the
seven houses was far too soon.

Earlier he was quite pleased with Luo clan’s power, but even he couldn’t
be as bold as to declare that this fight was a sure win!

He chose this situation so he wouldn’t lose the imperial family’s
support, or worse, offend them instead.

Saying that he was lured was accurate. Forced? Also correct. These
assumptions were both correct. Above all, Luo clan’s power coming out in
the open at this moment allowed Zhuge Changfeng, possibly the only
person in the empire, to surmise that Luo clan would one day surpass the
seven houses.

This guess couldn’t be called brazen, but calamitous!

And Zhuo Fan was hoping to see the day when Luo clan would reach such a
level. But now, no one out there would ever believe it, except Zhuge
Changfeng.

Even Zhuo Fan had to admire his foresight. If it were anywhere else,
even he wouldn’t make such an absurd guess!

“Head of the Four Pillars, Prime-minister Zhuge is truly wise. I admire
you!” Zhuo Fan’s flattery was sincere.

Zhuge Changfeng chuckled, “Steward Zhuo is too kind. This old bag of
bones has been soaked in this world for far too many years, thus gaining
some thoughts about its revolutions. I fall utterly short to young
Steward Zhuo wisdom. Carrying on your shoulders, the honor of the entire
clan, you’ve earned my respect, ha-ha-ha…”

“Then Prime Minister Zhuge is saying…”

“To watch your back!” Zhuge Changfeng’s eyes shined, his voice solemn.

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan looked a little lost.

Clearly knowing his heart, Zhuge Changfeng chuckled, “I can tell what
Steward Zhuo is thinking. Yes, my words are full of suspicion. Who on
earth would be so selfless, so caring for their fellow neighbor? And
yes, I have a reason. But rest assured, Steward Zhuo, you are not my
enemy. In fact, he may very well be yours too!”

“Oh, care to elaborate?” Zhuo Fan started.

Zhuge Changfeng twirled his white mustache, his eyes shining, “I am sure
Steward Zhuo is more than familiar with the saying, when two fight the
third wins. So will you be among the first two, or the third?”

Zhuge Changfeng shook his head, “I’m sure the wise Steward Zhuo has
caught on my meaning by now!”

Scratching his nose, Zhuo Fan looked him in the eye and showed a broad
smile.

Zhuge Changfeng read his intent, and only smiled in reply.

The two shared a smile full of countless implications, and nodded.

“Ha-ha-ha, talking with smart guys is so refreshing and easy! Steward
Zhuo, I have said my piece and I’ll be leaving. But before I do, please
be kind enough to fulfil this selfish request of mine and explain
something to me.” Zhuge Changfeng rose to his feet and cupped his hands.

Zhuo Fan smiled, “I don’t see why not.”

“I am the Empire’s Prime Minister, Leng Wuchang is the Regent Estate’s
steward, and you sir are Luo clan’s steward. This makes the three of us
cut from the same cloth, with each of us scheming and lording over
people. Myself and Leng Wuchang are both selfish, and luckily our
interests are shared for now, and not set on a colliding path. But
considering your talent, why would you pick the Luo clan? I can tell
that sir is not doing this out of sympathy, or any kind of feelings. It…
escapes my capacity to understand!”

Zhuo Fan’s eyes trembled and he took a deep breath, before showing a
crafty smile and emphasizing every word, “Because my ambition is far
greater than yours!”

The head of the Four Pillars, for the first time, trembled and his fists
clenched.

The Yin Yang elders saw this and for the first time looked at Zhuo Fan
with shock and ill intent. The thick bloodthirst they oozed couldn’t be
concealed.

But Zhuo Fan was still composed, only his right eye flashing golden.

“Wait!”

On the brink of war, Zhuge Changfeng put a stop to the hostilities. The
elders calmed down and Zhuo Fan relaxed.

But Zhuge Changfeng was perplexed and said to Zhuo Fan, “I may not know
the extent of sir’s ambition, but I nevertheless look forward to that
day, and hope that it won’t all come crashing down instead.”

Zhuge Changfeng signaled the two elders and left.

A good distance from the tavern, one elder snorted, “Prime Minister, why
did you stop us? His words were far too rude!”

“No, I don’t think that was mere boasting!” Zhuge Changfeng furrowed his
brow, “However, what is his aim? With his ability, it’s only a matter of
time before he becomes an overlord. But instead he chooses to be bogged
down by that burden, Luo clan. To what end? Sigh, this kid is the first
one I cannot see through!”

The Yin Yang elders shared a glance but didn’t say anything, in fear of
disturbing him. But for some reason, Zhuge Changfeng was frowning
constantly, leaving the elders at a loss.

[When were the rash words of some pup ever of any value?]

In another part of Dragon Cloud City, at the largest fighting stage,
thunderous applause resounded!

On the stage, Luo Yunchang’s tall figure breathed heavily. Her lithe and
demure figure, wrapped tightly in clothes, painted a fine picture. Every
man there was drooling at her curves!

Even more so when those beads of sweat worked to emphasize her enticing
body lines!

But her 5th layer of Bone Tempering cultivation cut short any errant and
lustful desire. Just now, the young lady had dispatched four 4th layer
Bone Tempering experts, while she herself remained unharmed.

Next to her stood a cold youth of about sixteen and in the 3rd layer of
Bone Tempering Stage. Despite his young age, he was famed throughout the
empire.

Marshal Dugu’s fifth godson, Tianyu’s Five Tiger’s youngest, Swooping
Dragonic Tiger, Luo Yunhai. Everyone and their uncles had heard of him.
Being at Dugu Zhantian’s side and fighting next to his four brothers for
more than two years, he had proven himself in battles becoming a real
man of valor.

Circling them were ten people around Luo Yunhai’s age, but their eyes
held a far more staunch look. They released constant dark energy and
their iron forged bodies glowed.

They were of similar cultivation, but in a true life or death fight,
they could render peak Bone Tempering experts heavily wounded, if not
outright dead.

They were the Luo clan’s guards that Zhuo Fan entrusted Captain Pang
with training.

This was only the tip of the iceberg and even the guards were enough to
strike fear in many.

The thought of seeing these monsters fully grown sent chills down the
crowd’s spine. And to avoid people acting in fear and envy, the Luo clan
chose to only bring these ten youths.

If others had known that Luo clan would raise so many freaks and still
hide their cards, they’d have long snuffed it in the cradle.

Regardless of the what ifs, Luo clan had nevertheless caused widespread
shock to all who bore witness to this obscure clan.

Just now, these Luo clan’s 12 fought with a renowned second rate clan’s
hundred. Yet none of them was injured heavily even when the opposition
had peak Bone Tempering experts among them.

This forced people to see Luo clan in a different and frightening light.

Not to mention Luo clan’s strongest had yet to take the stage. That
rumored Soaring Demonic Dragon, how outrageous was he?

Chapter 249 - In Sights

Chapter 249, In Sights

“The Victory of this second rate clan battle goes to the Luo clan!”

A Profound Heaven stage expert in a robe flew on stage and gestured at
Luo clan’s 12.

The crowd broke out in a thunderous applause.

“This is Luo clan’s 28th win. I cannot believe they are a third rate
clan!”

“Yeah, and their best man is yet to appear as well. People say their
steward, Zhuo Fan, is on the same level as the Six Dragons and One
Phoenix. He is hailed as Tianyu’s seventh dragon, Soaring Demonic
Dragon!”

“What? If Luo clan is so strong, why haven’t I heard of it? Why is it
stuck being a third rate clan?”

“……”

People displayed immense shock in the stands, while many were whispering
about the mysterious power behind such a strong underdog.

Meanwhile, a few familiar faces stood at the highest point in the
stands. The veterans of the martial world would instantly recognize
these shocking figures.

Weren’t they the seven houses’ representatives, Six Dragons and One
Phoenix?

“Ha-ha-ha, what third rate clan? That brat duped us! Even facing a top
second rate clan they won cleanly. If this was a third rate clan, who
would be a second rate one? Right, Ning’er?”

The woman was none other than Xue Ningxiang, from the newest Sword
Marquise Abode’s vassal clan, the Xue clan.

She wasn’t paying attention to Xie Tianyang however, having eyes fixed
on the stage, “Why isn’t big brother Zhuo here? Isn’t he joining?”

“Ning’er, why do you always have to mention him? It hurts!” Xie
Tianyang’s mood went sour.

Xie Tianshang sitting next to them, sheathed his cold blade in the
scabbard and said, “It seems the rumor is true. The Soaring Demonic
Dragon is no longer a part of this world!”

“What rumor?” Xue Ningxiang was anxious.

Xie Tianshang spoke coldly, “Five years ago, they say Zhuo Fan chanced
upon Lightning Canyon and is buried there. What a pity, I really hoped
to meet such a highly praised man. Now I can no longer see his strength
for myself…”

“Brother!” Xie Tianyang cut him off but it was far too late. The damage
was done.

Xue Ningxiang’s tears threatened to burst as she shook her head,
“Nonsense, big brother Zhuo can’t be dead…”

“Uh, Ning’er, calm down. He’s only missing. No one has found his body
yet…”

Xie Tianyang was trying to patch things up but Ning’er glared, “Brother
Tianyang, why didn’t you tell me?”

Xie Tianyang sighed, “I didn’t want to see you so sad…”

“Ha-ha-ha, just for that? You should’ve told her sooner rather than
prolong the agony! Don’t you know that prolonged longing will only make
a woman’s pain deeper?”

The three looked back to see Long Jie and Long Kui along with an
exuberant youth walking up to them.

Squinting, Xie Tianshang’s scabbard crackled in his hand, “Veiled Dragon
Pavilion’s Abyss Dragon, Long Xingyun! We finally meet.”

“Please don’t. We’re all allies here. Don’t pull your sword at our first
meeting!” Long Xingyun noticed Xie Tianshang’s thirst for battle and
waved frantically.

Xie Tianshang snorted and tightened his grip on the hilt of his sword,
suppressing his battle lust, “Humph, sorry. I can’t help but want to pit
myself against an expert when I meet them. Please disregard my
rudeness!”

Long Xingyun was sweating. He had heard of this martial fanatic, but he
didn’t think his illness was so serious. [You aren’t going to go after
me after chopping the enemy, are you?]

Sighing, Long Xingyun turned to the Luo clan on stage, “I’ve heard of
the Soaring Demonic Dragon Zhuo Fan’s resounding name and hoped to see
him. A shame I will never have the chance!”

“Why do you say that? You also believe big brother Zhuo is dead? His
body hasn’t been found!” Ning’er shouted.

Shaking his head, Long Xingyun turned solemn, “The lives that Lightning
Canyon robs are left without a corpse. If his fortune was the same as
Uncle Jiu, surviving that disaster, he would most likely appear here.
But after 28 fights, he is still missing. The first 27 fights were
nothing, but the last one was only won by using all they had, even if
they were unharmed. If he didn’t appear even now when it matters the
most, I fear he’s gone from this world!”

Shuddering, Xue Ningxiang was far from just believing this, but her
heart knew the truth. With everyone around telling her so, she couldn’t
help but think the same as well.

And this only worked to make the pain worse.

Xie Tianyang clenched his fists and bit his lip, hating himself for
being powerless.

“By the way, do you guys think that the Luo clan without Zhuo Fan is
worth being our ally?” Long Xingyun suddenly spoke.

Xie Tianshang shuddered and spoke, “In my eyes, ally or whatever doesn’t
matter. Whether they are worthy of a challenge or not matters!”

“Ha-ha-ha, that’s a martial fanatic for you!” Long Xingyun laughed and
admired him.

Xie Tianyang was glum, “I don’t care what you think. Me and Zhuo Fan are
brothers and even if he isn’t here, I hope to see Luo clan leave this
place safely!”

“Uh, second young master sure is milder among the two!” Long Xingyun
smiled, “But Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s ally is Zhuo Fan. Without him
around, the agreement is void. Whether the Luo clan can hold on to the
agreement, it will rest solely on their performance. I fear, however,
that they will never achieve it.”

Long Xingyun gestured to the front, “Look, without the care of that
demonic dragon, most of the savage dragons have them in their sights.
Second young master, are you capable of stealing the dinner from the
claws of those savage dragons?”

Xie Tianyang’s group turned to look in shock.

Four figures suddenly showed up across from them!

“Hell Valley’s Specter Dragon, You Yushan!” Xie Tianshang’s eyes
trembled at the sight of a man in grey.

“Merry Woods’s Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng!” Xie Tianyang
looked at another gravely.

“And also Pill King Hall’s Plague Dragon, Yan Bangui!” Long Xingyun
pointed at a youth with half a face purple, “They say he went insane
cultivating his poison and this is the result. And with his poisonous
constitution, even without Yan Song or Yan Fu’s achievements in alchemy,
his mastery of poisons far exceeds Vicious Pill King’s. He is a fearful
man!

“But, far from the strongest!”

Long Xingyun’s face turned grave and even a hint of fear was present as
he gestured at the last man, “The real monster, Regent Estate’s
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian, is present as well!”

Ka!

A sharp sound came from Xie Tianshang’s scabbard, his eyes glinting.

Long Xingyun smiled dejectedly, [This martial fanatic, does he not know
what dreadful existence that man is? How is he so eager to challenge him
at first glance?]

[I just can’t tell if these blockhead allies of mine are a blessing or a
calamity!]

Meanwhile, Huangpu Qingtian’s four also glanced their way but were calm
as water. Even Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes only spared them a cursory
glance.

“That Zhuo Fan still hasn’t shown himself!” Huangpu Qingtian stared at
the Luo clan.

Lin Xuanfeng giggled, “Eldest young master, are you that eager to smash
someone?”

“No, I’m only curious why Sir Leng holds him in such high regard!”
Huangpu Qingtian crossed his arms, “This world is yet to see a man
worthy of my attention. I hope that kid would make an exception!”

“He-he-he, Eldest young master is truly a hero among heroes. You must
really want to fight that kid!”

Lin Xuanfeng jumped right in with his ass kissing, only to get a sharp
look from Huangpu Qingtian in return, “Lin Xuanfeng, watch your tongue.
This world doesn’t have anyone worthy fighting with either. Only some
temporary targets need destroying! I only want to see if that man is
worthy of killing him myself. If he can’t even amount to that, he will
be left to you guys to handle!”

Lin Xuanfeng shivered and nodded.

The other two sneered, [This brat is usually crafty, but this time’s ass
kissing only reached the feet! He-he-he…]

Picking up on the two’s mockery, Lin Xuanfeng’s felt rage inside. Then
his eyes lit up and proposed, “Eldest young master, why don’t I test the
Luo clan. Zhuo Fan is bound to show up then. And if he doesn’t, we’ll
simply end them.”

“Do it!”

Huangpu Qingtian’s curt nod cut him off. Then the other laughed as he
vanished.

Xie Tianshang’s group watching from afar was also gone. Huangpu Qingtian
paused, “You two go as well. Perhaps the six dragons’ fight will happen
earlier!”

“Understood!”

The two glanced at each other and were gone, leaving only Huangpu
Qingtian standing alone with a sharp gaze.

This was all in response to Leng Wuchang’s judgment of this time’s
Esoteric Debate. It may just be a guess, but was enough to make this man
take it seriously.

Because Leng Wuchang had never said something like this to him ever
before.

That implication of not wanting to see Zhuo Fan was a lie! As a man of
great power himself, even if conceited, he had to make things clear.
Only by snuffing out the cradle would allow ultimate peace to descend…

Chapter 250 - Picking a Fight

Chapter 250, Picking a Fight

“Young miss, young master, good work!”

The people began commending the shocking power of the Luo clan’s 12 with
a round of applause as they left the stage. Captain Pang rushed over and
expressed his thanks as well for the two’s work, watching them with
great regret.

If only he was younger, he would be joining and fighting alongside them
as well.

Luo Yunchang nodded, not able to speak from how weary she was.

Captain Pang didn’t dally any more and led them to a bench to rest. He
then turned to the ten guards with praise, “You’ve done well today. I
will surely remember it!”

The ten youths nodded, but their faces showed not a twitch, as if they
were frozen in time.

Luo Yunhai panted and sighed as well, “Captain Pang, just how did you
train them? These young guards are even more dauntless than most people
I’ve seen in the army.”

“He-he-he, young master, there are some things you don’t know. These
guys are trained by me according to Steward Zhuo’s training regimen. He
said that great soldiers are good when fighting back, but these fellows
are men willing to lay down their lives for the Luo clan when it matters
the most.”

Captain Pang sputtered with great pride the feats of these kids. But
then he froze and looked at the silent Luo Yunchang in distress.

Luo Yunchang’s hand tightened and her eyes glistened in tears.

Luo Yunhai glared at Captain Pang, “We asked about their training, so
why are you talking about sacrifice…”

Captain Pang slapped himself till he was red, then cursed, “It’s my
rotten mouth to blame for making young miss feel such sorrow again.”

“Captain Pang, I don’t blame you.”

Luo Yunchang stopped him from blaming himself, “Five years without so
much as a word. Elder Li did say that he is definitely alive, but from
the look on his face, not even he believed those words. If he were still
alive, there was bound to be some news at this point, not total
silence.”

Tears started trailing down her cheeks.

Luo Yunhai felt her pain as Captain Pang sighed, not knowing how to
reply. The Luo clan didn’t want to accept Zhuo Fan’s death, but they had
no choice in the matter.

At that time, the entire clan was in mourning.

How did that saying go? Misery loves company. Their so called allies had
changed their stance, and their support was waning.

They were abandoned when the clan needed the most help.

Many times Luo Yunchang wished to show the world their Radiant Stage
experts. Zhuo Fan was gone, but the clan still held strong.

Luo clan had the power to face the seven houses!

But Luo Yunchang was reminded every single time of Zhuo Fan’s decisive
stance, of keeping their cards hidden even from one’s allies. This made
her snuff out that reckless thought.

She thus burned with even more desire, to prove to them who Luo clan
was, in the Esoteric Debate. Especially to their allies, that they are
worthy of their constant support.

No matter what, she had to lead the Luo clan into the final battle.

Taking a deep breath, Luo Yunchang wiped her tears and steeled her will.
She stood up, “Come, Grand Elder is waiting for us!”

Luo Yunhai and Captain Pang looked startled at the leaving delicate
figure.

With Zhuo Fan gone the past half a decade, and Luo Yunhai in the army,
all the weight of the clan rested on the young miss’ shoulders. And the
talks with their allies were the most taxing.

She didn’t have Zhuo Fan’s cunning, nor his brashness. But on this path,
her weak and fearful self slowly rose to the challenge, meeting the
houses head on. Within the fake civility, with all that back and forth,
she grew to be an imposing figure.

But only she knew the taunts, mocking, and misery she had to endure.

Sighing, Captain Pang and Luo Yunhai followed after her. The three soon
arrived with the ten guards at the exit of the fighting stage.

Lei Yuntian was there waiting for them, along with the Profound Heaven
fakes.

“Yunhai, Yunchang, congratulations! You won 28 times in a row!” Lei
Yuntian cupped his hands.

Luo Yunchang raised an eyebrow, “Uncle Lei, you knew we’d won even when
you were outside?”

“Of course. With such a resounding applause, how could I not know? I’ve
heard it so many times these days that my ears have swollen. Ha-ha-ha…”
Lei Yuntian was cheerful.

Luo Yunchang chuckled as well as they walked with him to their
accommodations.

“Uncle Lei, how about we make a different sound tomorrow, since your
ears are swollen?”

“No need. I like this one very much, ha-ha-ha…”

They talked with the setting sun behind them, cheerful about tomorrow’s
victory. Among the ten young guards behind them there were also the
Profound Heaven fakers.

Their power wasn’t much to talk about. Even one of the young guards
could finish them off. But that swag and pose had their intended
purpose, to shock and awe the bystanders.

[Holy hell, the Luo clan is truly an underdog. They raised 20 Profound
Heaven experts! They are as strong as the seven houses.]

Though none realized, looks could be deceiving. These elders were paper
tigers, mere toys to scare children. But just as Fang Qiubai said
before, showing them off was their strongest suit…

Whoosh~

Suddenly, a breeze passed by Luo Yunchang’s charming figure. She felt
her ear and her face changed!

“What’s wrong, Yunchang?’ Lei Yuntian asked.

Luo Yunchang was confused, “M-my earring’s gone!”

“Sister, did you lose it?” Luo Yunhai looked around and shouted,
“Everyone, my sister lost her earring. Please help us find it!”

They all started looking around for the young miss’ earring.

Just then, a funny laughter reached them, “Ha-ha-ha, idiots, here it
is!”

Ding~

A sharp ringing sound was heard and they all looked in the direction of
a creepy man in robes holding an earring.

Luo Yunchang cried, “T-that’s mine!”

“Merry Woods’s Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunchang was
quite shocked.

All eyes were now on that man. Was this one of the strongest disciples
in Tianyu, one of Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Forest Fleeting Dragon?

The cheerful mood had long been replaced with heavy silence. Even those
twenty Profound Heaven fakes felt their scalps go numb. These guys were
no match for the Six Dragons and One Phoenix. Even if they weren’t
fakes.

Even among Profound Heaven experts, the Six Dragons and One Phoenix were
the best.

Why was this Lin Xuanfeng suddenly approaching them? Was he picking a
fight? [What are you doing picking a fight with us? Aren’t you from the
seven houses, aren’t you afraid of shaming yourself?]

This was on everyone’s mind.

Lin Xuanfeng looked at Luo Yunhai in provocation, “Such a remarkable
godson that old guy Dugu Zhantian has gained. You recognized me with
just one look?”

“Of course. We may be soldiers, but the godfather has told us about the
renowned figures in Tianyu.” Luo Yunhai straightened his back and
shouted, “And you? What do you think you’re doing? This is Dragon Cloud
City and it is time for the Esoteric Debate. The houses and clans are
forbidden from making a ruckus. Are you challenging Marshal Dugu’s order
and is that why you’re blocking our way?”

“He-he-he, stop scaring people with that old guy’s name. I’m not
everyone!” Lin Xuanfeng mocked, “Kid, do you know why the old man told
you about Tianyu’s strongest? It was to warn you that even he can’t
offend some people. It was something for you to watch out for. That
order is for the average clans only, not for us, the seven houses.”

Luo Yunhai seethed from anger, “You dare to openly go against his order?
See when I report to Marshal and he puts you in your place!”

“Ha-ha-ha, you gullible pup. I just told you, that old man won’t
interfere!”

Laughing, Lin Xuanfeng flashed right in front of Luo Yunchang in the
next blink. He took in her perfume, shook her other earring, and
snickered, “Gorgeous, mind spending the night with me?”

Blushing, Luo Yunchang’s face was a mask of anger as she sent a slap,
“Pervert!”

Whoosh~

Lin Xuanfeng was back to his original place before the slap made
contact, “Ha-ha-ha, this is all Luo clan amounts to? You could not even
find someone good enough to touch my clothes, but you dare showing off
in Dragon Cloud City?”

“Men, together!” Lei Yuntian snapped.

His cultivation was now in the 5th layer of the Profound Heaven Stage,
reaching Lin Xuanfeng in a blink and striking with his finger.

As for those Profound Heaven fakes, they had no choice but to join as
well.

In the face of the incoming finger, Lin Xuanfeng only grinned. Then the
oddest thing happened.

He vanished into thin air and the 20 Profound Heaven fakes behind Lei
Yuntian were knocked out one at a time.

Lin Xuanfeng then returned to his spot, but Lin Xuanfeng’s finger still
hadn’t arrived. He let out a bored yawn and with a light grip, snuffed
out the lightning on the finger, “Too slow, I’ve already finished
fighting!”

Lin Xuanfeng’s kick sent Lei Yuntian flying.

Spurting blood, Lei Yuntian fell before the siblings. Only now did the
20 Profound Heaven fakes collapsed, actually lasting a second more than
Lei Yuntian.

They had long been knocked out!

Such speed!

Gasping, Luo Yunhai’s face turned solemn. He knew Lin Xuanfeng was fast,
but even he didn’t think it’d be to this extent. It was as if he defied
the laws of time and space.

He didn’t catch any of Lin Xuanfeng’s movements, and it looked as if he
had always been standing there. But he knew that Lin Xuanfeng had put
everyone out of commission in a flash.

Without a second thought, Luo Yunhai jumped in front of his sister. Luo
Yunchang was solemn as well, glancing at Captain Pang and getting ready
to face their great enemy.

The power of the six dragons wasn’t something they could contend with.
They were all wishing from the bottom of their hearts that that person
would come. Ironically, this was where the both side’s thoughts aligned,
with Lin Xuanfeng hoping for the same thing.

Chapter 251 - Dragon and Phoenix Battle

Chapter 251, Dragon and Phoenix Battle

“Is the Soaring Demonic Dragon truly dead? I mean, this would never have
happened if he wasn’t. Unless of course he is the biggest coward out
there!” Giving others a mocking glance, he punctuated with a sneer.

Luo Yunchang’s heart trembled. [He’s after Zhuo Fan!] The guy assumed
Zhuo Fan was watching from the shadows around here somewhere and decided
to stage this play to draw him out.

When in fact the reality was much much crueler. Zhuo Fan wasn’t even
here to begin with.

The Luo clan wallowed in mourning and Luo Yunchang snapped back in
indignation, “Since when did an outsider get the rights to butt into the
affairs of our steward?”

“Ha, looks like you hold Zhuo Fan in quite a high regard! Although,
would it even make that much of a difference if he were here? A nobody
who some no-name clans call Soaring Demonic Dragon, one who can barely
stand up to our level, the level of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix,
doesn’t deserve my attention!”

With a spark of cruelty in his eyes, Lin Xuanfeng flashed right in front
of Luo Yunchang’s face.

The group jerked back in fright. [He’s so fast! Too fast!] They didn’t
even sense him move.

Especially Lei Yuntian, who sucked in a cold breath. Both were of an
equal stage in strength, that of the Profound Heaven. And common
knowledge told him a difference in speed could exist but not to the
extent of a gulf. Yet Lin Xuanfeng’s brazen display proved that the six
dragons were in a league of their own, even if they were only Profound
Heaven experts.

Snickering, Lin Xuanfeng touched the smooth and delicate chin of the
frightened Luo Yunchang, “Young miss Luo, if we were to take this
somewhere private, wouldn’t that Steward Zhuo end up working under me in
the end? Are you willing to come along?”

“Don’t touch my sister!”

Luo Yunhai snapped, sending a flying kick at him. Lei Yuntian and
Captain Pang joined him by punching.

Lei Yuntian flickered like lightning while the dark energy around
Captain Pang turned him into an unstoppable raging machine.

“Get your filthy hands off young miss!”

Lin Xuanfeng couldn’t care less about their bravado, to the point he
even disregarded them completely. With Lei Yuntian leading the charge,
Lin Xuanfeng simply swished his wrist and Captain Pang tumbled forward.

Captain Pang rammed into Lei Yuntian and the two coughed blood in their
flight.

To the mere 3rd layer of Bone Tempering Luo Yunhai, this was even more
disdainful. A simple rise of his leg followed by a casual step ended the
kid’s attack.

Ah!

Luo Yunhai’s wailed out of pain from having his leg bone bend under the
guy’s foot. Luo Yunchang rushed over, “Yunhai!”

She didn’t make it however, as Lin Xuanfeng was quick in seizing her
wrist and grinning like a demon, “Young miss Luo, will you cooperate
now?”

Luo Yunchang bit her lip, her eyes teary as she clenched her fists in
hatred.

Seeing her so stubborn, Lin Xuanfeng snickered as he put more weight on
his foot.

Ah!

Luo Yunhai made his pain known again. But he cut off his screams
abruptly despite the agony. He chose to hold it in, although it was
clear from his purple face that it took all he had not to keep
screaming.

He couldn’t scream, or his sister would have no choice but to agree and
the Luo clan’s name would go up in flames. His training in the Dugu Army
taught him how to shed away the weak young master persona and become a
true man of principle.

“Oh, quite the tough one I see.”

Raising an eyebrow, Lin Xuanfeng eyed him viciously, and put more power
in his stomp.

The sound of crushed bone jarred everyone’s ears, but Luo Yunhai only
gnashed his teeth as sweat soaked him. No matter how much it hurt, how
pale he got, he didn’t make a sound.

Lei Yuntian and Captain Pang were enraged at this, yet couldn’t even
twitch as their bodies were seriously hurt as well. As for those
Profound Heaven fakes, they were rooted in place and shivering from
pain. They had no intention of showing off anymore. After biting the
dust once, they simply closed their eyes shut.

Even as imperial guards they had never offended the seven houses, least
of all now.

Although the young guards had guts, even they’d think twice after being
knocked out cold from just one slap.

Luo Yunchang felt her brother’s pain, so much so her teeth were
threatening to break under the strain of her clenched jaw. She was
caught in the middle, whether to choose her clan’s honor or save her
younger brother from the torment.

Lin Xuanfeng roared as he yanked her wrist, “Talk! Are you going to give
in and make me Zhuo Fan’s master or not?”

“Humph, are you worthy?” Luo Yunchang scoffed back, “Compared to him,
you’re nothing but discarded dung, unfit to even carry his shoes!”

Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes twitched and he backhanded her, “Have it your way
then, skank!”

Luo Yunchang showed no fear at the incoming blow. The others wanted to
help but were unable to even move.

All they could do was watch him humiliate their young miss.

Whoosh!

And right then, a white ribbon shot at Lin Xuanfeng. He was forced to
give up on his attack and flickered away. The ribbon passed through the
air and went back.

The source was tens of meters away from the Luo clan’s siblings.

Lin Xuanfeng spat back as he watched the white ribbon fly away,
“Ascending Ice Phoenix Chu Qingcheng, this is none of your damn
business. Beat it!”

“Humph, Drifting Flowers City will never allow anyone to harass women!”

A white figure along with Iris and Peony Overseers walked over. Her
elegance and her demeanor, both pictured her as a celestial. Not even
her veil could mask the outstanding beauty she possessed, to the extent
that it left even Luo Yunchang speechless.

[Is this Chu Qingcheng? She is just like a goddess!]

Then she noticed the two overseers and her whole face lit up, “Sister
Iris, Sister Peony!”

When Zhuo Fan was reported missing, perhaps because they were all women,
while meeting with her allies, Luo Yunchang and the two hit it off. The
two liked Luo Yunchang as well, treating her like an angel.

Unlike that devious and devilish Zhuo Fan.

It was only natural that the three were practically sisters now.

The overseers rushed to her in worry, “Yunchang, are you alright?”

Luo Yunchang nodded her head with a smile and went to help her brother
and Captain Pang. The overseers supplied them with pills to offer
relief.

Chu Qingcheng only stared daggers at Lin Xuanfeng.

Lin Xuanfeng scratched his nose as he said in good nature, “Chu
Qingcheng, this is no Drifting Flowers City, so try to keep your nose
out of another’s business.”

“Habit!” Chu Qingcheng scoffed and chuckled in mockery.

Lin Xuanfeng laughed back coldly, “Then you’ll have to forgive me for
what I’m about to do.”

Lin Xuanfeng flickered, putting Luo Yunchang and her group on edge.

Iris and Peony Overseers held her hand to ease her worries.

Only this time, Chu Qingcheng intervened. A white mist rose between her
hands, swiftly spreading around. Wherever the mist passed, a layer of
ice formed.

Lin Xuanfeng slowly became suspicious as the mist coiled around his
figure. His speed was clearly affected as everyone had no trouble seeing
him anymore.

Shocked, Lin Xuanfeng got some distance between them. He trembled a bit
and the ice sheet on him crumbled off, but the fear in his eyes was more
than apparent.

“Frost Domain! Did your soul reach the Radiant Stage?” Lin Xuanfeng
cried incredulously.

He felt how Chu Qingcheng’s frost spread along her Discerning Field and
acted as a barrier. Any that stepped foot in it, would find it
impossible to escape her notice, regardless of speed.

It was a sign of imminent breakthrough into the Radiant Stage.

Once her Frost Domain became an invisible divine sense, that would be
when she’d attain the true form of Discerning Field. And, just like Zhuo
Fan, she had the prospect of entering the Radiant Stage.

As for killing with intent, it wasn’t that far away either.

His face growing colder, Lin Xuanfeng said, “I heard you wasted ten
years of your cultivation. Who knew you’d recover so fast. Chu
Qingcheng, you are worthy of being among the Six Dragons and One
Phoenix, albeit barely. I extend my admiration!”

“Then get lost if you know what’s good for you! I am in no mood of
stirring something up before the true battle between the seven houses!”
Chu Qingcheng glanced over.

Lin Xuanfeng was pissed and his face was a mask of hatred. Then he broke
out into a grin, accompanied by him snickering, “Chu Qingcheng, you’re a
bit full of yourself. Not even you are enough to deal with me!”

Whoosh!

With a boom, Chu Qingcheng felt a wind on her back and felt a slap
coming her way.

The two palms met and Chu Qingcheng put all her power in it to repel the
attacker. When she noticed her palm, it was covered in green.

It was lucky that she had formed a layer of ice beforehand. The ice made
from Yuan Qi fell on the ground, sizzling like acid and releasing a foul
stench.

Chu Qingcheng held her nose and jumped back startled, “What dreadful
poison!”

Looking up, she noticed the attacker was a man with half his face
purple, and said, “Plague Dragon, Yan Bangui!”

Chapter 252 - The Dread of Huangpu Tianyuan

Chapter 252, The Dread of Huangpu Tianyuan

“Ha-ha-ha, you old poisoner! About time you showed up. Any later and I’d
have had to go all out!” Lin Xuanfeng roared in laughter walking next to
Yan Bangui while raising a taunting look at Chu Qingcheng.

Yan Bangui was simply silent. The only sign he had that seemed to
acknowledge the man was the bloodthirsty cold stare.

Heart jumping, Chu Qingcheng grew serious. Six Dragons and One Phoenix’s
power was the strongest in the Profound Heaven Stage. Besides Huangpu
Qingtian, there wasn’t much of a difference in the other six’s power.

She could deal with Forest Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng, but her hands
were tied with Yan Bangui in the mix. The others picked up on this and
grew nervous.

Lin Xuanfeng puffed up his chest and laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Ascending Ice
Phoenix, now that we are two against one, I reckon what your chances
will be?”

Chu Qingcheng tightened her fists in response.

“Ha-ha-ha, you’re among the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, yet you have no
shame going two against one? What will you say to three against two
then?”

The others jerked and saw Long Xingyun and Xie Tianshang’s groups
arriving.

Xue Ningxiang looked at Luo Yunchang. She gathered her courage and
showed a bashful smile, “Young miss Luo, are you alright?”

Luo Yunchang chuckled a nod, but was quite perplexed. [Who is this girl?
I don’t even know her so why does she care so much about me?]

But when she noticed the Thunder Ring, she realized that Zhuo Fan wore
the same one, “T-that ring…”

“This is our engagement ring!” Xie Tianyang butted in, showing his own
without an ounce of shame.

It was precisely for this occasion that he had Zhuo Fan make one for him
as well.

Glaring at him, Xue Ningxiang stammered an explanation, “Young miss Luo,
don’t misunderstand. This is nothing between us. Brother Zhuo simply
gave a token to each of us!”

“Oh, I see!” Luo Yunchang nodded in disappointment and vexation. [That
guy never gave me anything…]

Chu Qingcheng’s ears perked up and she whipped her head back, feeling
quite down herself.

[Grandmother said he is heartless, yet he suddenly grew a conscience?
Humph, damn philanderer…]

Long Xingyun got next to Chu Qingcheng and stared at their opponents, “I
wonder, who among you will spar with me?”

“Humph, stand back and leave them all to me!”

Xie Tianshang stepped in front, his sword sheath moved and his piercing
gaze landed on his enemies. Like sharp blades, the two had a very real
cold and sharp feeling on their necks!

Long Xingyun almost facepalmed, [This guy’s martial fanatic obsession is
out again. Though this is a very good opportunity to see how reliable he
really is!]

While their side got bolstered, the enemy’s side was tense.

Now that the tables had turned, they were the ones at a disadvantage.

“Ha-ha-ha, it’s three on three in fact!”

A laughter followed when a gray figure popped out before Lin Xuanfeng.
Their tension eased.

Chu Qingcheng frowned and spat, “Specter Dragon, You Yushan!”

“It is I!” You Yushan nodded and turned to his own allies, “Eldest young
master was right, Six Dragons and One Phoenix were bound to fight
earlier.”

“Ha-ha-ha, in this case, we are even. What’s there to fear?” Lin
Xuanfeng cackled, having recovered his cockiness.

Chu Qingcheng’s side waited solemnly.

With a metallic sound, Xie Tianshang’s sword left its sheath, “You two,
pick someone else. These three are mine!”

“Young master Xie, can you take them on all by yourself?” Chu Qingcheng
frowned in worry.

Hardening his gaze, Xie Tianshang made up his mind, “How else can I
challenge Huangpu Qingtian?”

“Brother Xie, I don’t care about the other two, but leave You Yushan to
me!” Long Xingyun stepped up with a hard face, “Veiled Dragon Pavilion
and Hell Valley’s grudges can only be settled amongst ourselves!”

“Ha-ha-ha, perfect. I was thinking the same thing. Let’s see what Veiled
Dragon Pavilion’s Abyss Dragon is made of! I’ll make sure whether Hell
Valley has overestimated you or not!”

You Yushan laughed, with sparks flying as their gazes met.

The scene was close to a breaking point. It was missing but a spark to
devolve in an all out war.

But then a shout came, “Stop!”

Whoosh!

Four men appeared between the two sides, eliciting murmurs from the
others, “Four Tigers of Tianyu!”

“Seniors, Marshal Dugu forbids any grudge fights in Dragon Cloud City.
The seven houses are no exception. Please comply!” Dugu Feng cupped his
hands at the six, his tone very cold.

And yet another shout came, “Brother Yunhai…”

Dugu Huo noticed Luo Yunhai on the ground and knew at a glance that his
leg was broken. His short temper was already burning as he raved, “Who
did this?”

“Third brother, it was Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunchang spoke in a pleading
voice, “Please, elder brother, help us!”

Dugu Huo’s face heated up as he roared like a beast, “Anyone who harms
our family is dead! Eldest brother…”

“Quiet!”

Dugu Feng cut him off with a glare, then continued, “I hope that we can
all let this matter rest! If Marshal were to step in himself, it won’t
simply end with words!”

The rest stared at him fixedly, then nodded slowly.

Dugu Zhantian was the second of the Four Pillars. They had to show him
some respect after all.

“Fine. It’s such a pity though, that I didn’t get to show them my
prowess. We’ll just have to wait for the decisive battle of the houses
then!” Lin Xuanfeng shrugged and mocked. They hadn’t lost in this
exchange anyway.

The rest looked at each other and nodded as well.

Dugu Feng eased his breath and walked to Luo Yunhai, “Yunhai, please
forgive me.”

“No, I understand that the eldest brother had to dissolve the
situation!” Luo Yunhai’s eyes were firm.

Past five years in the Dugu Army had him grown accustomed to the meaning
of military. In order to reach an objective, sometimes personal honor
had to be sacrificed.

Taking a deep breath, Dugu Feng patted his shoulder, feeling his pain as
well.

His little brother was pushed around and what did the eldest brother do?
Nothing! All because of his orders. He was a soldier first and foremost,
a Dugu Army’s general!

The other tigers sighed as well, filled with just as much rage as him.

“Oh, isn’t the situation over yet?” A sudden voice came, lofty as an
emperor’s. Carrying might with every word.

They all turned to see the most dreadful among the six dragons.

Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian!

“Eldest young master, this is what happened…” Lin Xuanfeng looked like a
dog as he explained in brief.

Huangpu Qingtian nodded, yet his face was always calm. He stepped
forward and said, “Since Zhuo Fan is a no-show, hurry up and kill the
Luo clan! If such a crucial event doesn’t warrant his coming, he must be
dead for sure!”

The others jerked in fright. Huangpu Qingtian was going to go against
Dugu Zhantian’s orders and kill the Luo clan.

“Young master Huangpu, Marshal is against any grudge fights. Are you… “

Dugu Feng blocked his path and shouted, but Huangpu Qingtian only had
disdain for his attempt, “Grudge fight, war, they all describe armed
conflicts between two equally strong sides! But none of you are even
worthy of a grudge fight. So erasing someone weak doesn’t violate any
order.”

[Such crass!]

The people were shocked once again by this man’s egotistical behavior.

Whoosh!

Suddenly, a sword light came down from above, straight for Huangpu
Qingtian. Xie Tianshang was filled with fighting spirit as he shouted,
“Huangpu Qingtian, I’ve waited ten years for this! Flowing Space’s Nine
Forms – Splitting Heaven!”

“Ten years? Then you waited for nothing!”

He walked just like before, and yet in the face of the upcoming sword
attack, he only replied with a casual palm attack.

Boom!

The sword wave splintered and an almighty power slammed into Xie
Tianshang’s chest and sent him flying while coughing blood.

The way Huangpu Qingtian put away his hand was as if he flicked away a
pest, a mosquito – so casual, so dismissive. Not even his gait changed!

Sss~

All watched in stunned silence how he dominated Xie Tianshang. Not even
Xie Tianyang conceived it possible for his invincible brother to be so
easily dealt with by Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord.

Everyone said Huangpu Qingtian was a monster, but how could there be
such discrepancy from the rest of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix? The
others couldn’t even put up any resistance.

The hearts of everyone sank in despair! Huangpu Qingtian was an
untameable mountain as he stepped towards them.

Although slow, his step carried such power that it was as if he was
stepping on everyone’s hearts, crushing their spirit and will…

Chapter 253 - Demonic Dragon’s Appearance

Chapter 253, Demonic Dragon’s Appearance

The heavy pressure pressed down on all and they flinched back again and
again. Yet Huangpu Qingtian was still strolling forward, like a king on
a mission!

The air was excruciatingly thick, hard to even breathe. The dread on
everyone’s face only increased with every sound of Huangpu Qingtian’s
steps.

Monster!

It was on everyone’s mind, yet none dared say it.

Lin Xuanfeng, Yan Bangui, and You Yushan observed coldly. The stronger
Huangpu Qingtian was, the more at ease they were, and respectful!

“Huangpu Qingtian, think this through, or you will suffer the
consequences!” Dugu Feng wiped his brow.

Among his peers in Tianyu, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord was the first to
scare this leader of tigers.

Nodding, Huangpu Qingtian never missed a beat, “Relax, I’m not after
you, the five tigers’ lives. I still have to show consideration for
Marshal Dugu! As long as you come out unharmed, he will not charge into
Regent Estate! So taking Luo clan’s young miss’ head with me won’t make
that old geezer snap.”

The four tigers felt eerily afraid and worried.

Huangpu Qingtian was not only high on his horse, but quite astute as
well, a schemer and plotter.

He grasped Dugu Zhantian’s bottom line, and knew when to stop just shy
from it, even if he was about to cause a massacre.

Correct, Dugu Zhantian cared most about his five godsons. He was tough
on them, true, but he cherished them dearly as well.

If anything were to happen to them, the old guy would flip and march his
army regardless of consequences. Everyone had a bottom line, and the
second of Four Pillars, Marshal of 3rd Army was no exception.

Even though Luo Yunchang was the dear sister of his fifth godson, not
even for her would he go into action. She had nothing to do with him.

Knowing this, Huangpu Qingtian acted unrestrained and unfeeling to
others.

“Young miss Luo, run! Go find the Marshal. You’ll be safe there. Go
while we hold him off!” Dugu Lin whispered.

Luo Yunchang was worried for Luo Yunhai.

Dugu Lin said, “Don’t worry, Yunhai is our brother and godfather’s
godson. Huangpu Qingtian won’t ever touch him. Go, we won’t be able to
hold him for long!”

Luo Yunchang took one last look at her brother and nodded. She was
relieved but still hesitant.

Just then, a soft hand grabbed her into a run. Looking back, it was
actually Xue Ningxiang.

“Sister Luo, brother Zhuo always called me a burden! Let’s see him say
that again after I save his clan’s young miss!” Xue Ningxiang stuck out
her charming and cute nose as she smiled.

Seeing this cutie, Luo Yunchang’s worries drifted out of her.

She didn’t know how Zhuo Fan got to meet this girl, but the girl was
like an angel, easing her worries…

Lin Xuanfeng snickered from afar, “Running, is it? Did you ask me
first?”

“Wait, don’t sour the eldest young master’s mood!” You Yushan blocked
him with a sneer.

He now realized that without Huangpu Qingtian’s explicit approval, none
could do anything. When the man was on the prowl, only horror would’ve
awaited him for meddling with his hunt. Lin Xuanfeng wiped his brow and
nodded.

You Yushan beamed in reply.

[Thanks, dude. If not for you, I would’ve been a goner!]

[No thanks necessary. I’m not doing it for you either. With Huangpu
Qingtian’s temper, I fear you’ll take me down with you.]

You Yushan snickered.

Back to Huangpu Qingtian, he didn’t much care if the two girls broke
into a run and shook his head, “A hare always thinks it can outrun its
hunter, only to find its efforts go in vain.”

Huangpu Qingtian punctuated with chasing after the two.

The four tigers rushed to intercept with four palms, “Wind, forest,
fire, mountain – Imperial Army!”(StarReader: 风林火山，千军万马 is
original. If you have a better suggestion, I’m all ears.)

Boom!

As if a dam broke, the power swept everything like a literal army.

Although it was only four palms, it was as if tens of men joined hands!
Not even Huangpu Qingtian could ignore it, feeling the sudden and
forceful might boring down on him.

Huangpu Tianyuan’s grinned, “A formation! A pity, it’s too low grade.”

And he punched.

Without any preamble, just this plain punch contained almost godly
power. The boom sent the four tigers flying as they bled from their
mouths!

Now they felt on their own skin why Xie Tianshang was so badly wounded
after just one attack. Because Huangpu Qingtian was no human. [How can
our peer, in both age and cultivation, have such power?]

But the crux of it all was, their so called stalling was pointless.
Huangpu Qingtian simply barreled through them unimpeded in his chase
after Luo Yunchang. It was as if stepping on ants in passing!

Whoosh!

Suddenly, a whistle announced the incoming claw attack, below Huangpu
Qingtian’s belt. It was so devious, so sneaky, it caused everyone to
gasp!

“Veiled Dragon Claw!”(StarReader: 潜龙勿用. I have no clue if it’s a
declaration of an attack or huangpu saying it’s useless.)

Long Xingyun’s eyes glinted as he arrived in the man’s path. Huangpu
Qingtian laughed coldly, “Veiled Dragon Pavilion gets worse by the day.
You only got so far through underhanded and crafty methods!”

“He-he-he, and? This is what I know best!” Long Xingyun snickered, not
minding it in the least.

Huangpu Qingtian disregarded him and was planning on kicking him away.

It was then he found it odd that his leg didn’t move. A shining ice
sheet crept up his legs and rooted him in place.

He then saw a dainty palm, filled with mist shooting from above. Chu
Qingcheng!

Unable to move, Long Xingyun clawed him from below, and Chu Qingcheng
attacked from above. It was the perfect combo to subdue an enemy’s
movements while also unleashing a pincer attack!

Squinting, Huangpu Qingtian snorted fearlessly, “I see. You laid a trap
for me with Frost Domain while the four tigers blocked my path! Not bad
at all, I will give you that much. But…”

Pa, pa!

Two loud noises echoed as Chu Qingcheng’s palm slammed into his head and
Long Xingyun’s claw hit from below. Although despicable, it was a strong
attack nonetheless!

And yet, no one expected what happened next.

Two peak Profound Heaven experts could do nothing against one with equal
cultivation!

Chu Qingcheng and Long Xingyun stared in shock and sucked a cold breath!
[Just how strong is this monster?]

Huangpu Qingtian curled his lips, “A pity, you are too weak and
overestimate your strength!”

Despite his words, his eyes flashed.

Then, with a boom, his body exploded in a golden light and roared like a
dragon. A golden dragon rose from him, sending the pair flying and
coughing blood.

It then circled back into his body.

“W-what is that thing?” Long Xingyun watched Huangpu Qingtian perturbed,
as did the rest.

It was as if his body held a guardian.

Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “It is the heritage of an emperor.
You are not worthy to know!”

Huangpu Qingtian then chose to ignore him, leaving him sitting on the
ground in shock and bleeding at the mouth.

Whoosh~

With no one left to block him, Huangpu Qingtian went after the girls.
They looked back in shock, to find Chu Qingcheng, Xie Tianshang, and Luo
Yunchang, as well as the Four Tigers of Tianyu wounded on the ground and
unable to even get up on their feet!

Despite the intense fight, it only took a second. The gap was so
insanely wide that all that effort didn’t stall Huangpu Qingtian for
even a fraction of a second!

[How is there such discrepancy between him and the other Five Dragons
and One Phoenix?]

The two were now panicking from fright! Huangpu Qingtian was like a
relentless monster. No one seemed to be able to escape his clutches!

“Ning’er, watch out!”

Xie Tianyang roared, as he and Long Jie with Long Kui jumped in front.
But what could they do when Five Dragons and One Phoenix could do
nothing?

The answer? Nothing.

With a mere flick, Huangpu Qingtian sent them flying, landing heavily on
the ground.

Snickering, Huangpu Qingtian extended his hand, “Young miss Luo, this
palm of mine will splatter the both of you! If Zhuo Fan doesn’t show
even now, he is definitely dead, or maybe just a lily-livered good for
nothing coward!”

“Rubbish! You’re the real coward! Brother Zhuo is a hero!” Ning’er
cursed.

Luo Yunchang was giving her all to run, but still nodded at Ning’er’s
words.

Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “I hope so too, but at this point he
seems likelier dead than alive.”

Huangpu Qingtian struck with his palm. It looked casual, but the might
behind it was that of a mountain.

The girls were scared to even run, watching the incoming palm with fear.

Everyone wanted to help them, somehow save them, but no one had the
strength.

“Sister!” Luo Yunhai cried and crawled.

“Ning’er!” Xie Tianyang was doing the same with clenched teeth.

Huangpu Qingtian looked on coldly as his attack approached the girls,
“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan is really dead after all. A shame you all had to die
for nothing. As he defied Regent Estate, I had no choice but to waste my
time with this puny Luo clan. You only have Zhuo Fan to blame for your
fates. It was he who cut your young lives short!”

Luo Yunchang and Ning’er remained silent.

Xie Tianyang punched the ground, reminded of how powerless he was back
in Blue Expanse City and cursed, “That bastard Zhuo Fan! Why does he
always wash his hands off every offense he ever does. Now Ning’er is
giving her life away for nothing! Bastard, come out if you have any
shred of conscience!”

Lin Xuanfeng’s group found his cursing entertaining, “So Zhuo Fan really
is dead. Or this would never have happened!”

“No, Zhuo Fan is not dead!” Luo Yunchang shouted back.

Huangpu Qingtian’s attack was about to hit the girls, “Then call him
out! Show me that he’s alive! But it’s too late now. No one can save you
from my attack!”

Tears streamed Luo Yunchang’s face, “Zhuo Fan, if you can hear me,
please come! At least let me see you one last time!”

She was on the brink of death yet no response came. Lin Xuanfeng’s group
laughed harder at her futile attempt and treated her like a fool.

Ning’er held her close instead, even if her heart had the same feeling.

“Useless! Die in peace!”

Whoosh~

Huangpu Qingtian’s palm attack sped up and the girls felt their breaths
caught in their throat, picturing the gory mess they would soon become.
Luo Yunchang closed her teary eyes, in pain and sorrow.

[Why couldn’t I see Zhuo Fan one last time?]

Ning’er was praying for a miracle, the same miracle that saved her in
Blue Expanse City!

[Will anyone save us?]

Crack~

Suddenly, Xie Tianyang and Ning’er’s Thunder Ring flickered and the two
cried.

“Zhuo Fan!”

“Big brother Zhuo!”

Boom!

Too little, too late. Huangpu Qingtian’s palm struck down, destroying
even the ground below them!

Xie Tianyang watched the aftermath in a daze, slumping powerless as
tears flowed from his eyes.

It was now that a carefree voice entered their ears, “Were you looking
for me?”

Chapter 254 - Another Monster

Chapter 254, Another Monster

A shiver ran through Huangpu Qingtian and his knuckles turned white. He
turned, like the rest, to where the voice came from.

To see a figure in a billowing black cloak, wielding a sword of
unmatched edge, yet sheathed for now. But that could not hide the dread
and power it instilled in the hearts of all present!

Especially when he held two girls in his arms, the same ones Huangpu
Qingtian was about to kill.

[How?]

The mangled bodies and the torn limbs were nowhere to be seen. How were
they still in one piece? [Did this man just do the impossible? Did he
save them without even Huangpu Qingtian noticing?]

[That’s absurd!] Who could ever pull such a feat such as saving someone
from right under Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord’s nose, and at the last
second too!

Not even the feeting feet Lin Xuanfeng could pull it off.

[Who the hell is this guy?]

Eyes filled with shock and intrigue graced the black figure. Not even
Huangpu Qingtian could stop his eye from twitching. It was a rare sight
to see him lose his voice.

Because it had never happened to him, ever…

Once the haze passed, Luo Yunchang was still trying to make sense of
everything. One second she was staring death in the face, and the next
she was in the arms of a robed man.

Xue Ningxiang didn’t fare any better, but the familiar flickering forced
her eyes on the man’s hand, on the sparkling Thunder Ring, “Big brother
Zhuo, you’re alright!”

Her words earned the gasp of the crowd.

Easing them down, Zhuo Fan smiled and pulled back his cowl to reveal the
same familiar face that some cherished, some hated, and some reviled.

Yes sir, he was the one and only Soaring Demonic Dragon. Who made sure
to leave chaos in his wake wherever he went, Zhuo Fan!

Smiling to Xue Ningxiang, Zhuo Fan showed a rare calmness, “Ning’er,
it’s been a while!”

Xue Ningxiang nodded a smile, lowering her bashful face. Xie Tianyang
was still crawling and couldn’t for the life of him decide which was
better, life or death. He was thrilled that Xue Ningxiang was safe and
sound. But the deep gaze Xue Ningxiang gave Zhuo Fan made him feel his
life was over!

[Ning’er, why have you never looked at me like that?]

Bam!

Zhuo Fan stumbled forward and held his butt. He snapped back irate,
“Young miss, what’s wrong? We haven’t seen…”

His words soon stopped though. Because Luo Yunchang was looking at him
with teary eyes and a reproachful glare.

“You are asking me? What about you? Where the hell did you run off to
for the past five years? I was worried sick!”

Luo Yunchang raved, but she couldn’t mask the joy bursting from her
chest as she forgot where she was and jumped into his arms, her tears
falling nonstop.

She wanted to hold him close to her heart and never let him go.

Zhuo Fan was caught unprepared, not knowing how to even respond, but
ultimately deciding to hug her back.

Xue Ningxiang felt a stab of pain from deep within her heart. She should
be happy to see Zhuo Fan again, so why the pain? But the sight of this
young miss holding Zhuo Fan so close seemed to make her heart frantic!

Chu Qingcheng was no different.

Zhuo Fan was the husband she recognized back in Drifting Flowers City,
and here he was, spreading his love! However reasonable and perfectly
natural her brain told her this reunion was, her heart was another
matter entirely. The pain was far greater than any wound she had ever
received!

Two women’s love aside, the Four Tigers of Tianyu felt their hearts
literally crack!

[Young miss Luo pined for someone else. That makes the five years we
carried a torch for her go down the drain. We even fought among each
other over her! This blasted and rotten Steward Zhuo is a clan thief in
the truest sense! He even stole young miss’ heart!]

And yet, worries soon gave way to joy.

Watching such a touchy reunion, Xie Tianyang’s mouth split into a wide
grin! [As long as Zhuo Fan has a woman, Ning’er will be devastated. The
perfect time to make my move.]

[Whether it is Chu Qingcheng or Luo Yunchang, who cares? Ha-ha-ha…]

Xie Tianyang was laughing his heart out, on the inside, totally
forgetting the precarious and quite deadly situation they were in
seconds ago.

“For even a 5th layer of Bone Tempering woman to kick your ass, Soaring
Demonic Dragon’s reputation is undeserving!” A brash and cocky voice
burst Luo Yunchang’s bubble of happiness.

She came crashing down to reality, reminded of the danger they were in.
She jumped away from Zhuo Fan, wiped her tears and, like the perfect
image of a little girl, dodged behind him, “Steward Zhuo, keep me safe!”

Her coy voice was enough to melt the four tigers’ ice cold hearts, which
were now bursting out of their chest in rage and rancor directed at the
newly arrived man, Zhuo Fan. [What does young miss Luo sees in that
Steward Zhuo? Isn’t he beneath her?]

Glancing back, Zhuo Fan was puzzled, [Since when did this lass learn to
throw a hissy fit? It’s not a bad idea, though.]

“Ha-ha-ha, eldest young master, this guy doesn’t look like much. He’s
only in the 9th layer of Bone Tempering Stage. He couldn’t even break
through to the Profound Heaven Stage! Fighting him will only harm your
image so allow me to do the honors!” Lin Xuanfeng laughed.

Huangpu Qingtian nodded.

[The brat is right. If this is all Zhuo Fan amounts to, there’s no need
for my intervention.] But in case Zhuo Fan was pulling his punches, it
might not be so bad to let this dumbass test the waters.

Huangpu Qingtian smiled, “Suit yourself. I’ll allow it!”

“Thank you, eldest young master!” Lin Xuanfeng snickered at Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and turned to Luo Yunchang, “Who’re these
guys?”

Luo Yunchang gave a rushed explanation. Getting the memo on who was who
here, Zhuo Fan realized how powerful Huangpu Qingtian was. He alone
dealt with Zhuo Fan’s three allies and the Four Tigers of Tianyu, yet
was still so composed.

[Actually, he’s dreadfully powerful and Zhuo Fan would never have fought
him in the past. As for now, he-he…]

Zhuo Fan grinned deviously, his brain already cooking the beginnings of
a plan. Luo Yunchang brightened. Being so long in Zhuo Fan’s presence,
she knew his tells, and the confidence he showed now was more than a
little reassuring.

So without further ado, she singled Lin Xuanfeng out, “Steward Zhuo,
ignore the others and teach this prick a lesson he never forgets!”

Zhuo Fan asked puzzled, “What’s so special about him?”

“H-he had errant intentions about me!” Luo Yunchang was wishy-washy,
holding his sleeve and acting like a big child. It unleashed a cuteness
overload attack on everyone’s heart.

Zhuo Fan blinked, giving her another look. [Young miss has changed. She
finally started to work out her naivety.]

And since the young miss had spoken, it was a steward’s duty to comply.
Whether it request was real or not was besides the point.

Zhuo Fan switched his tone in the blink of an eye and stared down Lin
Xuanfeng, “Forest Fleeting Dragon Lin Xuanfeng, you must be tired of
living! You had the nerve to go after my young miss!”

“He-he-he, and? It’s not my fault that Luo clan has no men…”

Pa!

He didn’t get to finish his sentence as something knocked him flying! He
went through four houses before getting buried under the rubble.

Zhuo Fan was a whole hundred meters away, his eyes aflame as he lowered
his hand, “Bastard, you dare say that with me here? Go to hell!”

The silence was deafening.

They stared slack jawed at him. Even Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord was
stunned!

[What just happened? They were a hundred meters apart. How did Zhuo Fan
slap him away?]

The one under the rubble was from the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Lin
Xuanfeng! The fastest man in the Profound Heaven Stage! Be it an attack
or a hidden weapon, anything thrown at the guy was easily dodged.

That was all thanks to his speed! As for melee attacks, you couldn’t
even touch the man.

Yet here was Zhuo Fan, flicking his hand and sending this speedster
flying. If that wasn’t shocking, what else was?

But what was really on everyone’s mind was [How did he do it?]

No one noticed anything. He moved so fast, it went beyond their
perception, including Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord’s!

If a monster like him couldn’t catch what happened, didn’t that make
Zhuo Fan a monster himself?

Their eyes watching Zhuo Fan turned from shock to fearful.

Xie Tianshang muttered to himself before sighing, “Soaring Demonic
Dragon’s reputation precedes him, what an oddity!”

Long Xingyun was dazed, “I now know why father allied with the Luo clan.
Why Little Kui and Little Jie were so driven to cultivate! This monster
gives too great of a shock. But will only cultivation be enough to catch
up to these two monsters?”

Long Xingyun shook his head. Chu Qingcheng watched the imposing figure
with a deep gaze. But then recalling his ties with the other girls
ruined her mood…

Chapter 255, - Almighty Ability

Chapter 255, Almighty Ability

Rumble!

Lin Xuanfeng rose from under the ruins with a bloody mouth and spat what
seemed to be blood along with a tooth mixed in it. He looked towards
Zhuo Fan, but this time he wasn’t as carefree as before.

[Soaring Demonic Dragon is a mystery in and of himself.] He didn’t even
get a chance to react and was sent flying.

What’s more, Zhuo Fan did it offhandedly. If he hadn’t pulled his
punches, would he even be alive right now? More importantly, the
opponent’s speed was creepier than his. The speed he prided himself with
turned out to have no use whatsoever!

Lin Xuanfeng’s fear of Zhuo Fan only grew stronger.

You Yushan and Yan Bangui rushed over, while looking at Zhuo Fan
distraught. They had heard the rumors about the infamous Zhuo Fan, but
seeing was believing, of how demonically dreadful he was.

[No wonder this guy caused chaos among the seven houses, yet was living
nice and happy. His power is even weirder…]

With a dismissive wave, Zhuo Fan acted as if all was natural, and turned
to Luo Yunchang, “Young miss, will you be content with such a
punishment? Should I give him a kick as well?”

Lin Xuanfeng’s heart jumped and he shivered a step back. Having gone
through that light slap, the Forest Fleeting Dragon of the Six Dragons
and One Phoenix was shaking in his boots.

No one would ever believe it was possible, but the truth was undeniable!

Huangpu Qingtian scared him into submission with diplomacy and might.
Zhuo Fan, on the other hand, did it through brutality! They were at such
a level, not even the Six Dragons and One Phoenix could mess with any of
them.

Luo Yunchang now picked up on Zhuo Fan’s words. His display was so
frightening that even she was dazed, “Uh, no need. He only lacked
manners when speaking with me. A slap is enough!”

Lin Xuanfeng eased a breath, grateful even. [Young miss Luo, you’re the
best!]

But Luo Yunchang’s next words had him on the verge of wetting himself
from fear.

“As for the matter regarding Yunhai…” Luo Yunchang pointed at her
brother on the ground and then pleaded Zhuo Fan with big eyes, “Steward
Zhuo, they harassed your young master. You can’t let this matter stand!”

Zhuo Fan’s face hardened, noticing the half grownup Luo Yunhai had his
leg broken and his bloodthirst spiked, “Who did this, young master?”

Luo Yunhai shook his head helplessly.

With Zhuo Fan missing god knows where, his sister had to take over clan
matters.

Her gentle and kind sister had gone through so many negotiations with
her allies that it had changed her initially weak standpoint to the
unbendable one of today.

Having negotiated so much, patting down, faking and being stubborn came
easy! [She has turned as tough and as unreasonable as brother Zhuo!]

Especially sharp in using her female attributes to look weak and have
others do the work for her, or drive a wedge. [Now that big bro Zhuo’s
back, she feels left out, yet still couldn’t hide all the charm she
gained from those years of handling the clan’s negotiations.]

And Zhuo Fan? Everyone here knew Zhuo Fan never took things lying down.
He was even more cunning and insidious than Luo Yunchang! Looking at it
in a different way, Luo Yunchang’s style was all thanks to Zhuo Fan’s
influence!

Luo Yunhai, having lived in Dugu Army, knew how to gauge a situation and
when to stop. He waved, “It’s nothing, brother Zhuo. I’m happy to know
you’re alright and that you came back!”

“What nothing? Yunhai, has the army messed with your head? Forget about
enduring it like we did before. Brother Zhuo’s back and we’re not about
to take this anymore. Right…” Luo Yunchang turned to see a shocked Zhuo
Fan looking back, as if he didn’t recognize her. She blushed and went
back to being a meek and cute kid, “Isn’t that right?”

[Young miss, have you lost it?]

Blinking, Zhuo Fan broke out in sweat. When did the young miss become so
shrewd? But that didn’t mean he didn’t like the change.

In a world where strong prey on the weak, compassion would only get one
killed. Regardless of the fact whether it was a good reason to fight
back or not, he still had to do it to some extent. That was Zhuo Fan’s
creed and style.

The world wasn’t ruled by reason, but by might!

Zhuo Fan’s eyes flashed, “Listen to your sister. When I was gone, I
couldn’t help even if I wanted to! But since I’m back, there will be no
compromises, or I’d be a steward for nothing!”

They all could sense the thick bloodthirst in his voice. Luo Yunhai was
silent.

All men shuddered inside, admiring Zhuo Fan’s flair. While the girls
swooned. Even the always ticked off Peony Overseer had to admit he
struck a reliable figure with unmatched charm!

“Never mind. Yunhai must be troubled as well!”

Luo Yunchang sighed and once again changed her style as she clung to
Zhuo Fan’s arm and grumbled, “He did it. He broke Yunhai’s leg!”

“Him again?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan swiveled to Lin Xuanfeng, “It
seems a slap was too light for you!”

Swallowing dryly, Lin Xuanfeng reeled two steps back, soaked to the bone
in sweat. Yan Bangui and You Yushan were vigilant on either side of him.

Of this generation, besides Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, only Zhuo Fan
could instill such fear in them!

Pa!

Huangpu Qingtian’s light step put him right in front of Zhuo Fan, “Had
enough?”

“Oh, you want to stop me?” Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan showed his
trademark evil grin.

Huangpu Qingtian was as calm as ever, not minding Zhuo Fan’s tone the
least, “You’re overthinking things. No one has managed to surpass me,
and you’re no different!”

The crowd watched all tensed up. [Huangpu Qingtian is on the move!]

And this was the first time that he acted out of his own initiative to
block someone. He didn’t say it, but his stance was clear. He
acknowledged Zhuo Fan’s strength!

Only when facing a true opponent would he stand in front of them!

His earlier attacks were casual because none of them were worthy of his
attention. Zhuo Fan was the exception!

This only worked to put pressure on the crowd, eagerly watching the two
monsters’ first contact.

Xie Tianshang was bitter and lonesome. All the martial fanatic in him
ever wanted was to have a face to face match with Heaven-shaking Dragon
Lord.

A pity he was sorely lacking in power!

Lin Xuanfeng’s group breathed easy. [With the boss taking a stand, this
kid will no longer threaten us!]

And yet…

Scratching his head, Zhuo Fan grinned at the casual Huangpu Qingtian,
“You think so?”

Whoosh~

Zhuo Fan vanished!

Huangpu Qingtian didn’t have time to even appreciate the novelty of the
situation as Zhuo Fan’s chuckle came from a hundred meters away. He was
right before Lin Xuanfeng!

“Ha-ha-ha, kid, you hurt my young master. Pay up!”

Lin Xuanfeng was scared witless. When did he get past Huangpu Qingtian
and come here?

He couldn’t even get one step away as Zhuo Fan’s purple lightning
enveloped leg hit him squarely in the gut. He flew for tens of meters.

The purple lightning was torturing his body until he spat blood. His
organs were in a seriously damaged state!

Sss~

An all around gasp was heard. His allies, Yan Bangui and You Yushan
stood rooted in fear at Zhuo’s display.

But after Lin Xuanfeng was kicked off, they struck back with a palm.

Zhuo Fan vanished again, appearing next to the twirling Lin Xuanfeng in
the sky and clutched his leg with a demonic smirk, “Kid, you broke my
young master’s leg. I think taking away yours sounds pretty fair!”

Lin Xuanfeng was panicking inside. He didn’t even get to beg as Zhuo Fan
followed through with his threat.

“Ghostly Dragon Claw!”

Rip!

Blood spurted like a fountain, followed closely by Lin Xuanfeng’s wail
of agony. Zhuo Fan threw away the leg he just tore off.

Huangpu Qingtian was shocked. This is the first time his face changed
and he wanted to help. But then a voice came from behind him, “Young
master Huangpu, weren’t you going to stop me? What are you doing showing
me your back then?”

Shuddering, Huangpu Qingtian felt a trickle of sweat on his scalp. He
turned stiffly to find Zhuo Fan still there, calm and snickering.

While on the other end, Yan Bangui and You Yushan found that the target
of their attack had been switched to each other. They were sent flying
and blood spilled from their lips.

However, that wasn’t as important as the looks Zhuo Fan was getting.

Zhuo Fan did all that in a breath. It wasn’t a stretch to call it an
instant. He came and went three times in that short timespan.

He kicked Lin Xuanfeng, then ripped his leg off, and finally came back
to his original spot. He did all that to those three men! Because it all
happened too fast, Huangpu Qingtian had no way of even intercepting.

It was the same as Zhuo Fan proclaiming [Nothing is out of my reach!]

The looks of shock were as if they saw an abomination. Even Huangpu
Qingtian was doing it. For the first time ever, this man felt powerless…
