Chapter 256 - Hindrance

Chapter 256, Hindrance

Wiping his brow by instinct, Huangpu Qingtian seemed calm, but turning
to Zhuo Fan, he had lost his casual stance and became grave.

Although he was a very conceited person, it didn’t stop him from
admitting that today he had met his match.

“It seems I can’t let my guard down around you!” Huangpu Qingtian’s tone
dropped and he stared at Zhuo Fan like a hunter.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “Oh, so that’s what you’ve been missing so far?
Are your ready now?”

With another creepy grin, Zhuo Fan was gone.

He popped before Yan Bangui and slapped him while cackling, “Then I’ll
go after your sidekick’s head this time!”

Yan Bangui panicked. He never thought Zhuo Fan would pick on him. He got
flustered while defending and released his poison!

Since when could a hastily made plan repel Zhuo Fan’s long ready palm
strike? Moreover, his poison hardly worked on the likes of Zhuo Fan who
could just use Demon Transformation Art to dispel it!

But before his attack could land, Zhuo Fan squinted and was gone.

Boom!

Huangpu Qingtian was looking at rubble. It was where Zhuo Fan and the
two girls had stood but was now littered with dust. Zhuo Fan reappeared
a hundred meters away holding the girls while giving Heaven-shaking
Dragon Lord the evil eye.

Huangpu Qingtian snickered back, “Like I said, you can’t get past me!”

Zhuo Fan clenched his jaw and his fists. Huangpu Qingtian was no
muscle-brain and quite cunning as well!

Zhuo Fan wanted to relieve Yan Bangui of his cumbersome head as an
affront to this man. But this guy knew he couldn’t give chase and
settled for targeting Luo Yunchang and Xue Ningxiang.

Forced to save them, regardless of how fast one was, he had to abandon
his tricks!

Yan Bangui was scared out of his mind as he watched them. He didn’t want
his fate to have such an untimely ending.

The fright was so intense, he felt he had lost a decade of his lifespan!

You Yushan was affected as well, seeing the two dragons on the brink of
a war and bolted. Only the crippled Lin Xuanfeng was left behind wailing
on the ground!

Not that anyone had a mind to pay him any attention when they were
focused on the two monsters. They all wanted to know who was going to be
the champion in the Esoteric Debate!

Anticlimactic as it were, finding the result so early…

Holding a girl in each arm, Zhuo Fan’s eyes glared with anger at Huangpu
Qingtian. If earlier he was just messing around, he was now focused.

The girls caught onto the situation and ran far away to not disturb
their battle.

Huangpu Qingtian grinned in excitement, sensing the change in Zhuo Fan.
Facing an opponent like Zhuo Fan couldn’t be more thrilling. Wrapped in
a golden light, his power surged and he was putting pressure even on Chu
Qingcheng’s group despite how far they were.

Huangpu Qingtian’s power dominated the scene, just like how a king
showed his presence!

Zhuo Fan’s stance paled somewhat, but the faint black energy rolling
about, the flickers of purple in his eyes, spoke of a deep power laying
hidden, waiting for the emperor to come close so he could wring his
neck!

It gave everyone a feeling of danger never sensed before.

The onlookers felt their heart in their throats, yet they couldn’t budge
an inch.

“Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”

Huangpu Qingtian shouted and nine golden dragons twisted around him
before shooting for Zhuo Fan.

Seen from afar, it was as if the sky was coming down to pulverize the
earth. Such mighty power could be felt even by the audience!

[Is this how much of a freak he has become? Is this the level of Huangpu
Qingtian’s profound ranked martial art?]

All swallowed dryly in shock, waiting nervously for Zhuo Fan’s reaction!

Laughing, Zhuo Fan’s eyes had a golden ring with purple lightning
streaking in them, and charged as well!

Roar!

A draconic roar followed the image of a black dragon growing around Zhuo
Fan. But the streaks of purple lightning around it caused the earth to
rumble incessantly. It was as if the end of days was coming!

While others cried in shock, Huangpu Qingtian’s eye trembled. Because of
the power Zhuo Fan displayed.

This martial art was no weaker than his 9th stage of Imperial Tyrant
Body Art!

As far as the eyes could see the two mighty powers created a stark and
conflicting contrast.

Huangpu Qingtian was bathed in golden glow, like an emperor gracing the
world with his presence. Zhuo Fan, however, was in the form of a black
dragon wrapped in purple lightning, threatening to tear the world
asunder!

If Huangpu Qingtian was a natural born emperor, Zhuo Fan was his
antithesis, a necrotic dragon ready to defy any ruling that was imposed
on him!

“These two are fated enemies!” Xie Tianshang sighed.

The others nodded.

They were unclear, however, who was it that would come out on top.
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord or Soaring Demonic Dragon?

They all looked perturbed at this scene. Perhaps the Esoteric Debate
would be cut short here and now. Perhaps Regent Estate’s millennium long
reign would come to an end!

The six houses were witnessing history in the making!

“Soaring Demonic Dragon!”

“Imperial Tyrant Body Art!”

Roar! Roar!

With two mighty roars, Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian’s dragons were on a
collision course. But, a third roar resonated from between them,
followed by a blue glow.

The two were forced to slow down their attacks!

Because the blue glow came from none other than the second of Four
Pillars, Marshal Dugu Zhantian’s 6th grade spiritual weapon,
Dragonslaying Crescent Blade!

A mighty figure drifted from the sky and landed between the two. He
caught the two’s wrists and flung them into the air.

Bam~

Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian’s outrageously powerful martial arts hit
nothing and instead each of them were buried in rubble!

When they crawled out and got their wits about them, the aged and mighty
Dugu Zhantian stood in all his majestic form before them!

“I will have no grudge fights in my Dragon Cloud City! You two bastards
take me for air?”

Dugu Zhantian’s eyes snapped on Huangpu Qingtian, causing his breath to
catch in his throat.

He was prideful, but no fool! He was overbearing among peers, and even
if he skipped stages, he’d only fight the average Radiant Stage expert.

In the face of Dugu Zhantian, the general who reeked of blood and
battle, he was subdued!

“I won’t ever violate Marshal Dugu’s orders again!” Huangpu Qingtian
admitted his wrongs. His face was calm however, like a king’s!

Dugu Zhantian’s anger had nowhere to vent since he didn’t want to tangle
with Regent Estate. So he turned to Zhuo Fan and barked, “Zhuo Fan,
where do you think you’re going?”

The man in question was skulking away, like a thief in the night. He
sighed at having been caught, but putting on a bright smile the next
instant, he said, “Ha-ha-ha, Marshal Dugu, how’s it going? Please show
consideration for my young master. He’s right over there!”

“Cut the crap! I knew you were still alive and have been waiting for
this!” Dugu Zhantian mocked him the instant he spouted hypocrisies, “But
where did you run off to this time, what trouble have you stirred up?
When did you arrive? And how is it that you’re already giving me
trouble?”

“Uh, today, actually.”

Zhuo Fan scratched his head shyly. But then he squinted and pointed at
Luo Yunhai, “Ol’ Marshal, this is totally not my fault! Look at my young
master, your godson! Someone broke his leg. I was only doing my duty as
the Luo clan’s steward.”

[Say what?!]

Dugu Zhantian took in the sorry state this place was and found his five
godsons on the ground, with Luo Yunhai feeble from the blood loss due to
a broken leg.

Dugu Zhantian’s eyes went bloodshot as he roared, “Who did this? I’ll
never let you go!”

“They did it, Marshal Dugu! Please give our young master justice!” Zhuo
Fan pointed fingers instantly, at Huangpu Qingtian, of course. Zhuo Fan
was the picture of a good servant having the backing of his faithful
master.

Luo Yunchang added her two cents in the form of a grieving sister,
“Please godfather, please give my brother justice!”

Taking a deep breath, Dugu Zhantian’s eyes spat fire as he glared at
Huangpu Qingtian…

Chapter 257 - Killing With Intent

Chapter 257, Killing With Intent

“Huangpu Qingtian, why have you harmed my godsons?” Dugu Zhantian barely
contained the beast raging inside.

Huangpu Qingtian was calm, “Because they were in my way!”

“And why were they in your way?”

“They carried out Marshal’s orders to prevent me from having a grudge
fight.”

Tightening his fists, Dugu Zhantian’s eyes spat fire, “In other words,
they aren’t at fault here!”

“No, they aren’t.” Dugu Zhantian was about to blow a gasket. Huangpu
Qingtian said coldly, “I also said that they are not fit to enter a
grudge fight with me, not when they’re so weak. Therefore it does not
fall into defying Marshal’s order! As for my fight with Steward Zhuo,
that was indeed a grudge fight. But your five sons were already downed
by that point. So it can be said that they weren’t hurt from doing their
duty.”

Huangpu Qingtian knew Marshal Dugu was a man of integrity so he used
sophistry! Saying that the five tigers had voluntarily, and of their own
volition, stepped in his way and he thus inadvertently harmed them while
running through them!

Although pedantic, Dugu Zhantian was no moron to not notice the way he
shifted blame. His eyes only grew colder as his knuckles popped, “What
you’re saying is that my godsons were wounded without your intention?”

“Precisely so. They ran into me and wounded themselves!” Huangpu
Qingtian jutted his chin and spoke righteously.

“And what of my fifth godson? What happened to his leg? And don’t go
saying he broke his leg running into you!” Dugu Zhantian’s eyes were
bloodshot, his voice rumbling and thick with bloodthirst.

Shaking his head, Huangpu Qingtian said, “That wasn’t me, it was Lin
Xuanfeng. Out of respect for you, Marshal, I was extremely lenient on
your godsons!”

“Where’s that Lin Xuanfeng then? I have a score to settle with him!”
Dugu Zhantian’s eyes darted around.

With a slow stretch of the hand, a finger pointed out the gasping Lin
Xuanfeng. Huangpu Qingtian said, “Marshal, there’s no need for that now!
Steward Zhuo had, in front of everyone, taken matter into his own hands
on behalf of his master. Is Marshal still going to continue?”

Ugh!

Dugu Zhantian spotted the pool of blood in which the pale face of the
crippled Lin Xuanfeng lay.

His anger washed away in an instant!

The guy was on his last leg, quite literally, given the circumstances.
And even if saved, he’d be left a waste. His fate was far worse than his
godson’s!

He suddenly felt awkward, even in the wrong. As if he was the accuser in
this case, especially when they were worse off than his side by a dozen
times!

Zhuo Fan, of course, didn’t think so. Availing of Dugu Zhantian’s
presence, he was giving his very best in blowing this sky high, “Ol’
Marshal, don’t listen to his lies. You have no idea of the cruelty and
harassment he put us through! When I arrived, the four had ganged up on
my young master, humiliating and trampling him!

“My loyalty to my master is unquestionable, coming to his rescue at
once. But I was also a victim of their assault. It was impossible for me
to fight the four alone, leaving me riddled with wounds. Out of
carelessness and sheer coincidence, they made a mistake and lost a leg.
But we are the victims here, we were the ones abused! Please give us
justice, Marshal!” Zhuo Fan’s voice took a mournful and stuttering tone,
filled with pain and agony, “They saw our clan small and weak and
decided to harass us. They are low and despicable people!”

Pff!

Everyone there spurted blood. Even Huangpu Qingtian’s face twitched.
Even he, with his upbringing, was finding it hard not to flip out.

[What’s with this guy? He twists everything!]

Although cunning, his speech was based on sophistry. Yet never had he
seen someone of Zhuo Fan’s ilk, running his mouth and spouting such
outrageous lies!

[You rotten bastard! Look around you! Look at the witnesses! How can you
be so despicable?]

Despite his perfectly reasonable thinking, Luo Yunchang also picked this
time to add oil to the fire, “Steward Zhuo downplayed it slightly, out
of worry for the Luo clan, but this is indeed the situation. Please help
us, Godfather!”

Pff!

With another round of blood from the crowd, all eyes were on Luo
Yunchang, [The hell? What is young miss Luo doing copying Steward Zhuo?]

[Sigh, another one falls under Zhuo Fan’s bad influence!]

It was followed by a round of sighs and head shaking, [Oh, you poor poor
thing. Coming from an upright clan yet unable to escape this man’s
devious corruption!] Luo Yunchang and Zhuo Fan shared a sly grin!

Face twitching, Dugu Zhantian already had a taste of Zhuo Fan’s
grandstanding and wasn’t buying it this time. [Then again, this is the
perfect chance to get back at Regent Estate.]

So, Dugu Zhantian nodded, “I see, Huangpu Qingtian. I have banned grudge
fights and yet you all started harassing the weak with numbers. A much
viler act than a mere grudge fight. Is this what you thought of my
orders? I will take this matter to each of your houses and get a
thorough explanation from them!”

“Marshal, you only heard his side…” Huangpu Qingtian was flustered for
the first time.

Raising an eyebrow, Dugu Zhantian’s eyes gleamed, “Oh, one-sided?
Ha-ha-ha, alright then, let’s see what the witnesses say!”

Dugu Zhantian turned to the ones on the ground and asked, “What Zhuo Fan
said, is it true?”

They looked at each other, clearly getting his drift. Since Dugu
Zhantian was siding with Zhuo Fan, of course they nodded.

Especially the Five Tigers of Tianyu. These guys were quite frank and
upright but not dumb. Of course they’d help their kin!

Face twitching, Huangpu Qingtian was swept by anger. [They’re clearly
aiming for us!]

“Marshal, I thought you were a righteous man, but now I see…” Huangpu
Qingtian clenched his fists and jaw.

With a bright smile, Dugu Zhantian mocked, “See what? You heard them. Is
there anything you would like to add?”

“Humph, they are clearly siding with Zhuo Fan while on our side Lin
Xuanfeng had his leg ripped out!” Huangpu Qingtian was finding it hard
to restrain his towering anger, evident from his loud voice.

Dugu Zhantian roared back, “You have one victim while they are all down!
So who’s side is the real victim here? Who was it that harassed others
with their power? Are you so damn blind?”

Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes twitched. He had never been so furious in his
life.

Most of all, never ever had he been taken advantage of!

Yet here, against Zhuo Fan, he could do nothing as the man had spun a
trap around him. Even Dugu Zhantian was against him!

He, who had always seen himself as a king, an emperor, was now reaching
the limits of his patience!

“Soaring Demonic Dragon, your title sure is apt in going after me,
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord. Humph, we’ll just have to see how you will
end!” Huangpu Qingtian squinted then up and left.

He knew arguing any longer would be a waste of time.

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow and pointed at him, “Marshal Dugu, you’re
just gonna let him go? He just threatened me! My poor little life is on
the line here…”

Hum~

A sudden ripple spread and Dugu Zhantian jumped in front of Zhuo Fan,
releasing a ripple of his own.

A boom reverberated as the space warped visibly.

Huangpu Qingtian snorted at Zhuo Fan in anger, “Soaring Demonic Dragon,
you’re lucky this time. But when the Esoteric Debate starts, when the
seven houses battle, hope you’ll have the same amount of luck then!”

And he took his two allies while dragging Lin Xuanfeng with them.

Dugu Zhantian looked at him in shock, “This kid, he is a peak Profound
Heaven expert yet can use killing with intent that only a Radiant Stage
expert can use. He truly is the number one talent in Tianyu. His future
is limitless!”

The others jerked in fright. Huangpu Qingtian had long surpassed them.
He was on a whole different level!

The next time they meet, they might not even come out alive. Against
killing with intent, no amount of speed would help.

Zhuo Fan only chuckled, “A mere bluff!”

Dugu Zhantian towered behind him and cuffed him, “What damn bluff?
That’s power! Do you have any idea how dangerous that was? I know you’re
a body cultivator and perhaps can win in a brawl against him, but that
was a soul attack, killing with intent! You’d never even realize when
your life was taken from you!

“I see no way for you to win against that monster!” Dugu Zhantian eyed
them and sighed.

The others frowned and sighed as well. Zhuo Fan had given a thread of
hope to all, but now it was all crushed to dust.

No one beneath a Radiant Stage could survive an intent attack.

Zhuo Fan had his freaky ability but not even that would save him.

Yet the man in question hardly cared, he had stopped caring for as long
as five years ago…

Chapter 258 - Conscription

Chapter 258, Conscription

Dugu Zhantian had some soldiers take the wounded to the marshal’s
residence for immediate treatment. Yet none of them noticed a spindly
figure further away, watching them.

Upon closer look, one would identify him as Unwonted Contriver Leng
Wuchang, Regent Estate’s steward!

Leng Wuchang twirled his mustache as he kept watching, Zhuo Fan in
particular, “This kid is not as heartless as I thought…”

It had been six hours since they arrived at the marshal’s temporary
residence in Dragon Cloud City. Time in which the wounded were placed in
a side wing and administered pills.

Luo Yunchang and Ning’er, the only ones who came out unharmed from this
ordeal were the caretakers. As for Zhuo Fan, he was there as well,
expressing his heartfelt thanks to his three paralyzed allies.

“Thank you all for such hard work. If it weren’t for your help, our
clan’s line would’ve been severed!” Zhuo Fan held each of their hands.

Long Jie and Long Kui felt odd seeing the kind and gentle smile on his
face.

They had been arduous in cultivating these past five years, just so they
could bridge the gap between them and this monster. And yet he just
showed up and instead of getting closer, they had only fallen farther
behind.

Even though this guy was still a shameless Bone Tempering cultivator,
how could his power be classified as one?

As this was Long Xingyun’s first time seeing this freak in the flesh and
in action, he was quite moved, “Brother Zhuo, now I see what my father
was thinking. Only after seeing you have I realized how much time I’ve
been wasting.”

“Sigh, youth is wasted on the young. But even so, you should live your
life to the fullest and take some time off to enjoy it. Ha-ha-ha, don’t
take it to heart!” Zhuo Fan patted his shoulder.

But the more he paid attention the more Long Xingyun felt it was fake.
[Is this your way of consoling me?]

Xie Tianshang’s eyes were filled with fighting spirit, wishing nothing
more than to jump on his legs and have a go with the man, “Zhuo Fan,
once I’m healed, how about we have a match?”

Zhuo Fan blinked, completely not getting what he was going for, “We just
met and never have I gotten on your bad side, so why do you want to
fight me?”

“Ignore him. My elder brother is a martial fanatic. He wants to fight
any expert that catches his eye!” Xie Tianyang jabbed. Having known Zhuo
Fan for so long, he had no qualms whatsoever.

Zhuo Fan nodded, [Ah, another one. I see, I see. Just like Elder Li.
It’s best that I keep my distance.] He wasn’t so idle as to waste time
sparring with a martial fanatic every day.

So Zhuo Fan gave him a wide berth, going over Xie Tianyang.

“Hey, wait, you didn’t answer me…”

Xie Tianshang watched Zhuo Fan with a fervent gaze. He was sorely
wishing right now that he could just jump and exchange hundreds of moves
with Zhuo Fan. But would Zhuo Fan listen? He treated martial fanatics as
basket cases.

Tangling with him would only net Zhuo Fan a huge waste of time.

And so, Xie Tianshang’s grumblings were firmly and undoubtedly ignored.
Zhuo Fan walked next to his little brother instead, and knocked his head
a few times, “Brother Xie, you did a good job today. I must say, you
sure gave your all for Ning’er.”

“Zip it. My life belongs to Ning’er!” Rolling his eyes, Xie Tianyang was
quite frank, making the nearby Xue Ningxiang blush and glare back. She
was clearly signaling not to spout such things around Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan laughed carefree.

Xie Tianyang’s eyes turned serious, his voice tinted with worry, “Zhuo
Fan, do you always stand out wherever you go? You’ve got my Ning’er to
swoon over you every time she sees you. Can’t you tone it down a little
so I can have a shot?”

Shuddering, Zhuo Fan remained silent.

Xie Tianyang seemed to be joking, but how could Zhuo Fan not sense the
worry within. If this went on, the three’s relationship would become
more complicated or, worse, break apart!

Zhuo Fan sighed after a moment, “Sorry, that’s how heavens made me. If I
don’t show off, who else will? Just focus on getting better!”

Patting his shoulder, Zhuo Fan left with a stiff smile.

Xie Tianyang laughed dejectedly. He knew Zhuo Fan had yet to make a
decision on this and was making a tactical retreat. Or was it an attack?
Although he made himself seem ruthless, who could guard against feelings
creeping up on oneself?

He went around spreading thanks to all the clan’s helpers, including but
not limited to the four tigers. But the tigers saw him as an enemy,
something he couldn’t wrap his head around as to why.

[I stole no wife of yours, so what the hell is with the glares?]

But when he reached the final patient, he spun on his leg and walked
away.

“Stop!”

The charming voice came from Chu Qingcheng, who was watching him in
reproach, “Y-you aren’t going to even talk to me?”

Iris and Peony Overseers were staring daggers. As if accusing him of
abandoning his wife!

“Uh, thank you Drifting Flowers Edifices, for helping our clan in our
desperate hour…”

“That’s not it and you know it!” Chu Qingcheng cut him off, “I just want
to know why. Why didn’t you see me one last time before leaving Drifting
Flowers City?”

Steeling himself, Zhuo Fan said, “I killed and took what I needed. I
fulfilled my goal and had no reason to stay.”

“No reason at all?” Chu Qingcheng blinked. Her pretty eyes demanded an
answer.

Zhuo Fan didn’t know how to respond. Then a sudden giggle came, “Steward
Zhuo, Marshal is calling you. Leave things here to me!”

Luo Yunchang came over with a smile, faking obliviousness. Saved by the
bell, Zhuo Fan grabbed the excuse like his lifeline and bobbed his head,
“Then I’ll go right now. Young miss, take good care of them!”

And he was gone, despite the doe eyes Chu Qingcheng was giving him.

Luo Yunchang turned a hard stare at Chu Qingcheng, “Edifice Lord Chu,
Steward Zhuo is a boor. If he has hurt you with his words or actions,
please forgive him. I’ll be taking care of you in his place!”

Luo Yunchang’s words were full of propriety and good nature, but the
true meaning was, [He’s mine!]

Chu Qingcheng had taken care of Drifting Flowers Edifices for so many
years since an even younger age than Luo Yunchang. How could she not
hear the veiled threat? She laughed coldly, “You’re far too kind. Zhuo
Fan’s transgressions are too grave to measure. How could I possibly ask
Clan Head to take the blame? I will have Zhuo Fan supply me with the
appropriate resolution. But thank you for your offer, young miss.”

I.e. [This is between me and Zhuo Fan. You’ve got no business here, so
scram!]

Sparks were flying off between them soon after.

The others looked away from the cat fight and lamented.

[Sigh, this is a woman’s war. It’s best we don’t get caught in between.]
But Xue Ningxiang looked on in distress, feeling somewhat excluded…

Going back to the culprit behind all this, Zhuo Fan was speeding towards
Marshal’s house across from the wounded ward in jubilation. [Perfect
timing!] He was truly caught in the trap back there.

Who would have thought facing Chu Qingcheng was more exhausting than
fighting Huangpu Qingtian! He’d rather go against a hundred Huangpu
Qingtians than see Chu Qingcheng again.

But when he entered Marshal’s home, the old guy laughed heartily,
putting him on high alert.

“Ha-ha-ha, you came, kid. Sit, I have something to tell you!” Dugu
Zhantian laughed and gestured at the chair nearby.

Zhuo Fan was on guard as he eased into the chair. Dugu Zhantian’s
critical eye from his seat of honor had Zhuo Fan’s hair stand on end.

“Uh, Ol’ Marshal, you wanted to see me?” Zhuo Fan broke the silence.

Dugu Zhantian grinned, “It’s nothing much, just your conscription!”

“Conscription?” Zhuo Fan shook his head vehemently, “No no no. I am not
army material. Find someone else!”

Glaring, Dugu Zhantian’s beard trembled as he cursed, “Cut the crap! Who
on earth is born a soldier? Even that brat Yunhai got trained into shape
by me! With your talents, a year tops, and you’ll be taking my job!”

“If you’re so confident, go find someone else. Why do you want me?” Zhuo
Fan shook his head.

Dugu Zhantian sighed and his eyes were glazed with worry, “It’s easy to
train an army, but it’s so hard to find a good array master! In the
field of war, there are many array masters using their skills in the
form of formations. We are sorely lacking in array masters and that has
made our recent losses disastrous!”

“Don’t look at me. I’m a meathead. I don’t know anything when it comes
to arrays or formations!” Zhuo Fan made up a lie.

But Dugu Zhantian wouldn’t have it. He had looked into the kid before
calling him. Such a flimsy lie wouldn’t fly with him, “He-he-he, oh
please. I already know everything. Your old Clan Head has long been dead
and you are the one running the show. Including the four 5th grade
arrays!”

Dugu Zhantian’s eyes shined when he reached this point. He was sorely
lacking an outstanding array master and wanted to have Zhuo Fan without
fail. The latter felt trapped in the old guy’s gaze and didn’t know how
to get away.

He felt like crying.

This was exactly why he wanted to slink through Dragon Cloud City and
never cross paths with the Marshal. He already saw this coming and
wanted to avoid it for as long as possible…

Chapter 259 - The God of War’s Fright

Chapter 259, The God of War’s Fright

“Ol’ Marshal, I truly cannot do this. Please find someone else!” Zhuo
Fan shook his head and rose to leave.

Whoosh~

In a flash of blue, the Dragonslaying Crescent Blade was nailed in front
of him, followed by, “Why?”

Zhuo Fan was in despair, [Isn’t it obvious? I don’t want to!] Since he
was asked for a reason, Zhuo Fan had to oblige. So he stuck out his neck
and refused, “They say that a good man doesn’t enlist…”

“Bullshit!”

In reply to his most eloquent words, Dugu Zhantian spat in his face,
“Those are the words of friggin’ morons. Zhuo Fan, you are a wise man,
so how can you lower yourself to a commoner’s thinking? Also, did you
not take the helm of the Luo clan after the Clan Head’s death, looking
after the siblings? Why then?

“I only see loyalty. Kid, your actions speak for yourself, of your
loyalty and devotion! So what’s the problem with being loyal to one’s
nation. Isn’t that the same? It should be the same thing to you! Why do
you insist on avoiding enlisting?”

The walls were quite thin here and the wounded next door heard Dugu
Zhantian’s raving loud and clear. [Dugu Zhantian wants Zhuo Fan in the
army!]

[But can he rein in this Soaring Demonic Dragon?]

Luo Yunchang and Chu Qingcheng thought this as well. Even though their
glaring never faltered, their ears were idle to pick up on the Marshal’s
shouts!

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan gritted his teeth. [This old guy just
won’t quit.] And sighed, “Marshal Dugu, we are neither friends nor
enemies. Please refrain from dragging me into this hell!”

“How is the army and fighting for your nation, hell?” Dugu Zhantian was
stunned.

Zhuo Fan squinted and roared, “As they say, after three years in the
army, even an ugly broad would look like a courtesan! This will deal a
devastating blow to my standards and ruin my prospects to raise a
family!”

Pff!

The girls in the wounded ward stifled their giggles. While Luo Yunchang
and Chu Qingcheng sure had an active imagination, evident by their red
cheeks.

Then their eyes met and jealousy reared its ugly head. [Which one of us
is that punk going to take to raise a family?]

The Four Tigers of Tianyu and Luo Yunhai were awkward, to say the least.
They’ve been in the army for five years. Did that mean their standards
were out of whack?

But Dugu Zhantian’s shout came soon after to save their image, “More
crap! Where the hell did you hear that nonsense? How could three years
lead to such a drastic change?”

The five in the ward nodded. [Well said, Marshal!]

Dugu Zhantian then followed with, “That only happens after five years!
My four godsons need six years, by the looks of them, to see any girl a
babe. As for Yunhai, it’s too soon to tell!”

The five wanted to crawl into a corner and die. The feel of the others’
eyes on them only made it worse!

[Godfather, enlist him if you want to, but why in god’s name are you
dragging us into this?]

[It was fine and all if these old army stories helped but all you are
doing is making yourself look bad! Us as well!]

[What a rotten godfather!]

The five sighed and buried their heads in the pillows…

Dugu Zhantian was being serious now, “None of that matters. Didn’t I
tell you? You’ll be a soldier for one year then be my staff officer.
Those things don’t apply to you!”

“Why not make me one from the start?” Zhuo Fan scratched his head.

Dugu Zhantian squinted and snapped, “Impossible! In my army one needs to
do military service. One can only be promoted based on merits. How can I
just make you one from the start? Everyone will object. But don’t worry,
once in the corps, I’ll give you plenty of chances to show your ability
and you’ll be promoted in no time!”

Zhuo Fan sighed. Seeing Dugu Zhantian so stubborn, like a hustler, he
left Zhuo Fan without a way to deal with him.

“Fine, fine, but on one condition!” Zhuo Fan nodded in the end.

Dugu Zhantian’s eyes sparkled, “Name it! I’ll do my best to accommodate
you! “

“Uh, Ol’ Marshal, would you be so kind as to lend me your status for a
short month? I could get used to being a Marshal myself!”

“You think the army is a game?” Dugu Zhantian shook his head, but then
he eyed Zhuo Fan skeptically, “What for?”

“What else? To sweep the land and pacify the empire!” Zhuo Fan roared
his loyalty.

Dugu Zhantian said in a rush, “Stop messing around. This army can’t move
as you wish!”

“He-he-he, it’s fine. Won’t I have the appropriate rank a year later? At
that time, I can just kill and smash whoever and whenever.” Zhuo Fan
giggled.

Panicking inside, Dugu Zhantian now realized he had only paid attention
to Zhuo Fan’s talent and not his many remarkable ‘feats’.

[I can’t take the same approach I took with Luo Yunhai when teaching
him. Or when he gets the army at his beck and call, he’d leave the
nation wide open for attack!] His eyes were swiveling, unclear what
choice was best here.

[No, I can’t have him fly through the ranks. I’ll have to stamp out his
rebellious nature in the army!]

Zhuo Fan had a knowing grin, “He-he-he, I know what you’re planning. But
no matter, I’m the best there is when it comes to roping someone to my
side! It won’t take me even a year to turn the three million Dugu Army
into the Zhuo Army. At that point, being a General or not would hardly
make a difference!”

“You don’t say. I am giving my all here, but who knows when we will have
to face Regent Estate on the field of battle. But if you think you can
wrest control of one of the Four Pillars, the empire’s army, then be my
guest.”

Zhuo Fan laughed, “I have never thought about it like that. But now,
Marshal, you have to enlist me! Even if you have your whole army
infected with gayness rather than some twisted broads, I’d still go for
it!”

“No!”

It seems someone had a change of heart. Dugu Zhantian was frantically
shaking his hands and sweating buckets!

[That was close! I almost welcomed the devil with open hands!] Granted
he was talented, but if there was one thing he truly excelled at, it was
blowing things out of proportion! [In the off chance I can’t tame him,
the Dugu Army will be under his thumb and will corrupt the empire’s
greatest weapon!]

[I better reconsider whether to let this guy in!]

Dugu Zhantian said bashfully, “Uh, Zhuo Fan, since you find enlisting to
be such a pain. I won’t force you…”

“No, I think it’ll be a blast, Ol’ Marshal…”

“No no no, I’ve never forced anyone to do anything in my life. It’s best
you stay and look after the Luo clan. Oh right, the three house lords
are here as well. I better go see them!”

“What about my enlistment…”

Zhuo Fan shouted after the scampering Dugu Zhantian.

Zhuo Fan watched the mighty and awe-inspiring Dugu turn into a scaredy
cat with a snicker.

[Tch, I get far more out of developing the Luo clan than stealing your
three million army!]

[Then again, having Dugu Army by my side is not bad either!] Zhuo Fan
mused, his eyes flashing.

Dugu Zhantian just left the room and turned to the wounded ward.

It seemed that Sword Marquise Abode, Veiled Dragon Pavilion, and
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ leaders were also present. They all saluted
Dugu Zhantian, “Thank you Marshal for coming to their rescue!”

“No thanks needed. This is my responsibility. Although someone else
saved them in the end, while I was only a mediator!” Dugu Zhantian
waved.

The leaders chuckled.

Grandmother then frowned, “Marshal, I was meaning to ask. Are you intent
on conscripting Zhuo Fan? Could I ask you to postpone it until after the
Esoteric Debate?”

“Of course. As for conscripting, I still need to consider it. there’s no
need to fret!” Dugu Zhantian stated.

Zhuo Fan’s vision of the army had scared the crap out of him!

[The kid seems capable of anything! He may very well have a way of
turning the Dugu Army into his personal army!]

And he wasn’t about to give his army away just for one array master!
Dugu Zhantian was thankful he came back to his senses and avoided a
disaster!

Zhuo Fan took this moment to enter and greet the house lords.

The three nodded in reply. They could finally breathe easier seeing him
safe and sound.

To be blunt, there would be no Luo clan without Zhuo Fan, the truest
underdog. Luo clan wouldn’t stand a chance in the Esoteric Debate,
whether as an ally or enemy.

But with Zhuo Fan back in town, the clan was in full force.

“Steward Zhuo, the entire Luo clan is injured. We can’t make it to
tomorrow’s fight! Will you, as their steward step forth?” Grandmother
smiled widely, hoping to see the miracle that was Zhuo Fan in action
after a five year break.

Shrugging, Zhuo Fan said, “Of course, it is my duty to represent the Luo
clan! It is time for the Luo clan to stand abreast with all of you!”

“That will depend on Steward Zhuo’s first battle!” Long Yifey raised an
eyebrow.

They all looked at each other and burst out laughing, all eager to see
Zhuo Fan put on a good show tomorrow…

Chapter 260 - We Will Kill Zhuo Fan

Chapter 260, We Will Kill Zhuo Fan

The next day, Dragon Cloud City’s fighting stage was enveloped by a
roaring crowd shouting their cheers.

On the stage, two youths stood thrilled and panting, surrounded by
either dead or wounded people.

“The winner of today’s battle hails from Crescent Sword City, the Xue
clan! They are advancing to the final battle!” A Profound Heaven expert
stepped on stage and gestured at the youths.

The crowd exploded with applause, raising the excitement of the two.
They left the stage and walked to their cheering clan.

“Big brother, second brother, congratulations!”

Xue Ningxiang gave them a hug and a sweet smile.

The two were Xue Gang and Xue Lin. After the horrors of Blue Expanse
City, Xie Tianyang saved them and their clan became Sword Marquise
Abode’s vassal.

It was the only way they could have joined the Esoteric Debate.

“Gang’er, Lin’er, you’ve done well. You are now ready to join the final
battle and help Sword Marquise Abode’s young masters in their fight!”
Xue Wanlong laughed with pride, “Remember, never let down our clan and
protect the two young masters!”

Patriarch Xue Dingtian nodded at the side.

Thanks to Xie Tianyang, their clan was under Sword Marquise Abode’s
wing, cared for and well supplied. But this left them uneasy, and they
were going to use this chance to repay their help! This was the reason
for joining the Esoteric Debate.

Xue Gang and Xue Lin nodded, filled with battle spirit.

Xie Tianyang stood next to Xue Ningxiang, sighing, “Uncle, why did you
let the brothers join such a cruel battle? This time’s battle will be
far more deadly and vicious than any of the past ones. I fear…”

“Second young master, I have made my decision. We cannot go on receiving
Sword Marquise Abode’s grace without giving anything back. Please give
us this chance to show our gratitude!” Xue Wanlong cupped his hands.

Xie Tianyang sighed.

The Profound Heaven expert on the stage suddenly said, “The next fight
will be between Drifting Flowers City’s Dong clan and Flood City’s Yu
clan!”

Two familiar figures walked on stage. Xie Tianyang’s eyes brightened,
“Who knew we’d see them here?”

“Aren’t they brother Dong and sister Wan’er? You know them as well?” Xue
Ningxiang was startled.

Xie Tianyang looked at her instead, “Ning’er, how do you know them?”

“Drifting Flowers Edifices and Sword Marquise Abode are allies. We met
when the two houses gathered for negotiation. Brother Dong is somewhat
frivolous, but Wan’er is very nice!” Ning’er smiled, “How do you know
them? Disciples of the seven houses hardly ever meet with people from
second rate clans.”

“Uh, we met in Drifting Flowers City. I hear that Dong Xiaowan and the
kid have something going on between them.” Xie Tianyang grinned,
thinking of having a little payback.

Xue Ningxiang looked closer at Dong Xiaowan and muttered, “No wonder she
never said anything when the topic about who she likes came up…”

Correct, the two Dong siblings were those Dongs.

Because of their ties with Zhuo Fan back in Drifting Flowers City and
having gotten familiar with Drifting Flowers Edifices’ leaders, the Dong
clan had been on a swift rise. They had long outstripped the title of
vassal clan and moved to Drifting Flowers City to become their trusted
aide.

The old master of the Dong clan couldn’t be happier and stated that they
had to go and see their most treasured benefactor in the flesh.

Of course, such a thing wasn’t so easy to achieve, not with how busy
Zhuo Fan was. If he wasn’t blowing something up, he was beating the life
out of someone. The likes of him could hardly squeeze a meeting between
his murderous rampage and endless mayhem.

Thanks to Drifting Flowers Edifices’ help, Dong Tianba had entered the
Profound Heaven Stage, displaying his majestic air on today’s stage. In
but half an hour, he and his sister won over their opponents and arrived
next to their clansmen and friends.

“Young master Xie, uncle xie, sir Xie, brothers Xie, how do you do?”

Dong Tianba cupped his hands in pride. Dong Xiaowan bowed as well with a
smile. The others nodded, while Xue Gang had eyes only for Dong Xiaowan
and her charming smile.

Everyone could tell what he was thinking.

“Brother Xue, how have you been? I never thought our clans would enter
the final battle. We will be fighting alongside it seems, ha-ha-ha…” A
portly man came over.

Dong Tianba and Dong Xiaowan cupped their hands, “Dad!”

Xue clan greeted in kind, but only when he saw Xie Tianyang did the old
man greet back.

He was the Dong Clan Head.

Dong Clan Head pointed at Xue Gang, “Young master is of great talent.
Could I be so bold as to ask if you’re married?”

“Uh, no.” Xue Dingtian smiled, his meaning clear.

Dong Clan Head nodded and smiled at his daughter, “What a fine
coincidence, neither is my daughter. I find our clans so friendly that I
was wondering…”

“Dad!” Dong Xiaowan gave him the stink-eye and was sullen.

Xue Ningxiang could see herself in her and shook her head. The two
already had someone and were not going to just change their minds at the
drop of the hat.

Meanwhile, the Profound Heaven expert on the stage said, “The next fight
is between Sun Spire City’s Hong clan and Blue Expanse City’s Sun clan!”

Shuddering, the Xue clan turned to the stage. Blue Expanse City used to
be their turf while being Hell Valley’s vassal. Since betraying their
patron, Blue Expanse City fell under another clan’s jurisdiction.

Bluntly put, the Sun clan was their replacement, Hell Valley’s brand new
lap dog.

The Sun clan only sent a man and a woman to fight against fifty Bone
Tempering experts led by two Profound Heaven cultivators.

Such power among second rate clans made it a seeded clan, closely
approaching the qualifications to be a first rate clan.

Against such strength, the Sun clan sent merely two, a really odd pair.
Their eyes released a bloody glow, and closely resembled monsters rather
than humans. Not even their appearances could be distinguished.

The sight of them standing there sent shivers among many. As if they
were demons who sprang out of hell. But upon closer look, they were only
peak Bone Tempering cultivators.

“He-he-he, two peak Bone Tempering cultivators want to mess with fifty
experts?” The leading youth snickered, “From your demonic look, living
must’ve been hard and you’ve come for the sweet release of death, right?
Ha-ha-ha…”

The others laughed as well.

That demonic man however was wrapped in black energy as it suddenly
jumped from him with a roar.

A veritable fountain of blood bloomed, while the Hong clan youth fell
with a perplexed look.

He was still wondering how a peak Bone Tempering cultivator killed him.

Sss~

The others gasped. Hong clan’s laughter died and watched the pair of
enemies in shock.

How could a fresh Profound Heaven expert die in one blow?

[A sneak attack for sure!]

With a shout, the fifty men from Hong clan stormed the pair. The two
only had a creepy grin as they turned into black mist and roamed among
them.

The slaughter began. Not of the pair, but of those fifty experts as the
two crazed monsters were unleashed upon them.

Wails, sobbing, and horror grated on the audience’s ears. In just
fifteen minutes, they were the only ones standing, while the corpses
around them had their throats ripped out.

Blood soaked into the arena and the dead stare of the bodies gave a
glimpse into the cruelty they had just suffered.

Xue Ningxiang had long since covered her eyes. Xie Tianyang’s brow was
furrowed, [What made these guys act with such brutality?]

The girl on stage suddenly snapped her head back and pointed at the Xue
clan with a nasty grin, “Traitor of Hell Valley, you will die in the
final battle, by our hands. None of you will live. We will cleanse the
Hell Valley of its traitors! Your time will soon come, hi-hi-hi…”

The Xue clan felt a shiver run down their very core.

This pair was way too abnormal. Not just the sons, but even the father
and patriarch felt their hair stand on end.

Xie Tianyang stepped up and shielded Xue Ningxiang as he roared, “Stop
barking! I would like to see you try and touch the Xue clan!”

“Second young master Xie, our house lord’s son will deal with you and we
will deal with the traitorous Xue clan!” Snickering, the girl threw her
head back.

The creepy way she talked and her posture only worked to deepen one’s
fear.

The man next to her said, “Don’t forget our main objective, the Luo
clan. Xue clan is just a side dish!”

“You’re after the Luo clan?” Xue Ningxiang was worried.

On the other hand, Xie Tianyang felt relief. A few days back he would’ve
been worried as well, but not now.

Because the Luo clan had recovered their pillar, the Demon Archon Zhuo
Fan.

With him around, these weirdos looked like imps in comparison. Going
after the Luo clan was a death sentence.

But the man saw Xue Ningxiang’s distress and reveled in it, “Yes, we
will find the Luo clan and slaughter them all! Especially that Zhuo Fan.
We will tear him limb from limb!”

Xue Ningxiang’s pure heart was stuck in her throat, vexed over Zhuo
Fan’s safety.

[Brother Zhuo, two bad men are after you!]

While Xie Tianyang almost burst out laughing, [Dude, have you even seen
Zhuo Fan? Have you seen his power? What is your boasting based on, hot
air? Not even a moron will believe such a lame joke!]

But then he saw Xue Ningxiang sick with worry and amended his thoughts
with a twitch of his cheek, [Ning’er excluded.]

She was no moron, just naive…

Chapter 261 - Limelight

Chapter 261, Limelight

“Look, Hell Valley’s men are here!”

Someone from the crowd shouted and everyone turned their heads to see
You Wanshan and his elder detail. He stood on the highest point with a
sombre look, flanked by You Ming and the rest of their other disciples
participating in the final battle.

As this place was the fighting grounds for third and second rate clans,
with how not even first rate clans would come here to watch, least of
all the seven houses, there were no honorary seats for them.

What stirred the biggest shock was the sudden appearance of Hell Valley,
taking seat at the highest position. They could see the whole stage from
there, but it was also a strategic position to emphasize the usual
disdain the seven houses had for these puny clans.

But what was up with this sudden arrival? Who had caught their eye?

Were they going to enjoy the show alongside them, or was there a new
star on the rise no one knew about? If it was the latter, who was this
person and what was he capable of to garner such ostentatious audience?

The crowd grew restless with their speculations.

Sun clan’s creepy guy noticed You Wanshan’s imposing figure and showed a
morbid smile, “See? Valley Lord You came to personally watch us crush
your clans. This is how much Hell Valley values us!”

“Yeah, we’re not like those Xue traitors. Valley Lord finds us
indispensable!” Sun clan’s creepy girl showed a morbid smile herself.

Xue clan only gave the duo a cursory glance, while being concerned about
Hell Valley’s real intentions. Hell Valley came to cheer for the Sun
clan? How is that even possible, when they have never shown such care
for any vassal before?

Xie Tianyang mocked, “Cocky brats, You Wanshan isn’t so bored as to
watch a couple of aberrations.”

“Say that again! What else would Valley Lord You be here for? There’s
only us around who is Hell Valley’s vassal!” The girl roared.

Xie Tianyang shrugged.

The seven houses only ever cared about each other and never about some
squirming ants trying to get some praise. [You’re disillusioned if you
think he came here to cheer for you!]

And then another sudden cry of shock came, followed by another
unexpected arrival.

And while Hell Valley’s men were emitting deadly auras, the newcomers
were graceful women with thin veils.

Drifting Flowers Edifices!

Grandmother was in the lead as Chu Qingcheng was still nursing her
wound. Behind her were her entire overseer contingent and the Drifting
Flowers Edifices’ disciples participating in the final battle.

Even Xiao Dandan was among them, darting her eyes around and looking for
her special someone.

[He-he-he, here comes another lovesick lass. That punk will be so
annoyed], Xie Tianyang snickered. Dong Clan Head puffed up his chest and
took on a prideful air, “Ha-ha-ha, I didn’t expect Drifting Flowers
Edifices’ overseers to come support us. Our Dong clan is so cherished.
We may be Drifting Flowers Edifices’ trusted aide, but to receive such
care, ha-ha-ha…”

The guy was grinning from ear to ear and making the Xue clan envious.

His position seemed to be so high that even the Edifice Lord came in
person.

Only Xie Tianyang sighed.

[It seems narcissism is an inherent trait of these vassals, not just
aberrations are susceptible to it but even normal people. What in the
hell gave you the idea that the seven houses came to see you
specifically?]

Then came the third cry of the day. Xue clansmen watched overwhelmed
with joy.

Why? Because Sword Marquise Abode’s Xie Xiaofeng was leading Xie
Tianshang and his elders over.

Patriarch Xue Dingtian was touched to the core as he showed off to the
Dong Clan Head, “Ha-ha-ha, Clan Head, Sword Marquise Abode values us
quite a lot as well…”

“Wait!”

He didn’t get to finish his haughty words, as Xie Tianyang interrupted
him, “Everyone, I know fully well my words may sound crass, but could
you cool off for a second and stop with the self-important attitude?
Those house lords haven’t even looked at you once, so how can you say
they’ve come for you?”

The sudden wake up call made them realize the wisdom in his words.

[If not for us, then who?] This was a fighting stage for the seven
houses’ vassals!

Xie Tianyang shook his head.

If there was anything the seven houses paid attention to, besides each
other of course, was strength. [Who else but that punk could stir up so
many of them to come here?]

While they were vexed by this conundrum, Pill King Hall appeared with a
fourth cry. Yan Bogong led Yan Bangui and Yan Fu with his elders over.
They were soon followed by Merry Woods’s House Lord Lin coming with his
elders and a bouncing Lin Xuanfeng.

After a night of healing, Lin Xuanfeng’s wound was closed. Even though
he hopped about with a pale face. The audience was amazed, [Is this
Forest Fleeting Dragon, one of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix? Why does
he have only one leg? How would he fleet through the forest now?]

Few were aware of the circumstances regarding Forest Fleeting Dragon’s
misery. How the vile Soaring Demonic Dragon ripped his leg clean off!

But the biggest shock of all was what came next.

The head of the seven houses, Regent Estate!

Huangpu Tianyuan was leading the group, with Regent Estate’s steward,
Leng Wuchang on his left, and his eldest, the head of Six Dragons and
One Phoenix, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord Huangpu Qingtian on his right.
Behind them was a team of Profound Heaven elders, thirty in number!

The frightening display made everyone’s hair stand on end. The other six
houses also paused at their entrance.

Regent Estate’s power was unquestionably the highest among the houses!

It had the ambition to swallow the others for good reason. It would’ve
been a waste of their might if they didn’t aim for at least this much.

Under the riveting gazes of the crowd, Huangpu Tianyuan made his way
forward with a regal air and boundless power that stopped anyone from
breathing within three hundred meters.

Only when Regent Estate took the foremost position did the man slowly
withdraw his power, but the damage, or deterrence, was done. In his
wake, the people were left shivering and gasping.

That was enough to rouse up even the narcissistic trio of clans from
their arrogance. The presence of all the seven houses had nothing to do
with them at all.

Thinking about what loudmouths they were seconds ago, they started
blushing like crazy.

The Dong, Xue, and even the Sun clan’s aberrations were stiff and
awkward.

This only helped to fuel their curiosity. Why were they all here? For
whom?

Xie Tianyang knew it all along of course.

The Profound Heaven expert on the stage stood on pins and needles under
the stare of all those mighty figures. He shakily took out the roster.

He was the king of this stage, but not anymore. ‘Cause now he was a
bottom feeder among all these big shots!

He swallowed down while shaking and shouted, “The next fight will be
between Zephyr City’s Wan clan and Windgaze City’s Luo clan!”

Every head turned to the dark entrance of the stage to see the greatest
underdog in this Esoteric Debate, Luo clan!

Even though the Luo clan’s 28 strong men were quite something, the more
they advanced the harder it became. Case in point, they left the last
battle while supporting each other.

Their opponent, the Wan clan, was a renowned second rate clan. It even
had three Profound Heaven youths.

The crowd was eagerly awaiting for the Luo clan, but their prospects at
winning were slim at best.

Tap, tap, tap…

A light noise was heard as Luo Yunhai was coming out on crutches,
leaning on his sister towards the stage.

The crowd’s shock passed and was replaced by sighs.

They all saw Luo Yunhai’s valor and might, fearless as a tiger. And this
tiger was an indispensable force in the Luo clan’s team.

Yet now he had an unexplained wound, which only crippled their chance of
victory even more.

Wan clan’s twenty strong men were already on the stage and were now
snickering. [Victory’s ours!]

But then a plain figure slowly made itself noticed by walking behind the
siblings. He caught the attention of all the houses.

Regent Estate, Hell Valley, and their other two allies bore a deep
hatred for Zhuo Fan. They suddenly released a deadly aura that made the
audience shiver.

[It all makes sense now. The seven houses came for him!]

Playing with his flickering Thunder Ring, Zhuo Fan walked without a care
in the world. His deep gaze, his far off look seemed to find everyone
beneath him.

This was how Zhuo Fan followed after Luo Yunchang, with a charming and
faint smile.

The biggest shock was received by those who didn’t know Zhuo Fan.

[Who is he? Why are the seven houses here for him?]

Dong Tianba and Dong Xiaowan went slack jawed. They never ever thought
they’d meet him here.

Dong Xiaowan in particular, her gaze was filled with complicated
emotions. Joy, sadness, and a hint of relief…

Xue Wanlong and Xue Dingtian were shocked as well. They never thought
that the young brat they met in Allbeast Mountain Range would appear
here.

“S-Soaring Demonic Dragon!”

The shout had caused another round of shock among the crowd as their
eyes never strayed from Zhuo Fan!

[He is the Luo clan’s strongest? The same Soaring Demonic Dragon on par
with Six Dragons and One Phoenix?]

The Luo clan’s main force has come out in the open!

The crowd watched eagerly, thrilled to witness a good show…

Chapter 262 - Cheerleaders/Groupies

Chapter 262, Cheerleaders/Groupies

“Old Pang, stay here and look after them.” Zhuo Fan spoke behind him to
Captain Pang and the young guards before walking on stage alone.

The crowd wondered, [Alone against Wan clan’s 20 strongest?] But then
recalled that he had a title akin to the Six Dragons and One Phoenix and
got excited at the prospect.

This was what everyone wanted to see. The extent of power one man
possessed to make the seven houses pay so much attention to.

“Brother Zhuo, fingers crossed!” Xue Ningxiang cheered with an adorable
face.

Staggering for a second there, Zhuo Fan waved back slightly with a
smile.

Dong Xiaowan waved as well, but found him not even noticing her and was
peeved, “Ning’er, are you and brother Zhuo close?”

“He saved my clan’s lives!” Xue Ningxiang nodded, but then found Dong
Xiaowan gloomy and mumbled, “Uh, sister Wan’er, sorry…”

“It’s fine. He never even looked at me anyway.” Dong Xiaowan shook her
head sullen.

Dong Clan Head gleaned something out of all of this and asked Dong
Tianba, “Is that youth who I think it is?”

Dong Tianba nodded and sighed.

His sister had been lovestruck since back in Drifting Flowers City. Her
crush never spared her a glance, while she pined for him every moment.

[I can’t tell if she is foolish or silly.]

“Darling, good luck! Crush them all!” A cute voice came from Drifting
Flowers Edifices’ side and slammed into the ears of the audience. Xiao
Dandan was practically jumping in her seat, gesticulating wildly to make
sure he saw her.

Zhuo Fan held his head, [What’s this idiot doing here? Is Drifting
Flowers Edifices so understaffed? How is she fit to join the seven
houses’ final battle with her cultivation? Cannon fodder is more like
it!]

Pulling Xiao Dandan back down, Peony Overseer cursed, “Why can’t you act
proper instead of some lovesick maiden?”

“Humph, me and darling have already tied the knot. He’ll come around!”
Xiao Dandan pouted, still clinging to her hope.

Sighing, Peony Overseer said. “This girl has lost it.”

On the other hand, Xie Tianyang was laughing his head off, using this
chance to gossip with Xue Ningxiang, “Ning’er, see that? This punk is a
womanizer. He got another one just like that! And I can attest to having
seen them kissing in public myself… “

Xie Tianyang laughed inside, [Time to cash in on the scheme I cooked
back in Drifting Flowers Edifices.]

Xue Ningxiang’s eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, having a sinking and
uncomfortable feeling in her heart.

The looks Zhuo Fan got from the audience were odd, to say the least.

[This kid’s the bomb. He goes around the seven houses, spreading chaos
and destruction, while not forgetting to sow the seeds of love!]

[Lady Killer Demonic Dragon is far more appropriate!]

“Steward Zhuo, you are a true man of mercy, to show such restraint in
your travels!” Luo Yunchang towered behind Zhuo Fan with a sweet smile.
And yet the killing intent in her eyes made her close to a demon.

Zhuo Fan shrugged it off, “I only did what I had to. The rest was a
force of circumstance, out of my control.”

“Force of circumstance you say?” Luo Yunchang teased and held his face.

Zhuo Fan was caught off guard, “What are you doing?”

“Force of circumstance.” Grinning, Luo Yunchang looked at him longingly
and smooched him.

Zhuo Fan felt her soft lips but didn’t get to relish in the sensation as
Luo Yunchang swished her head away blushing. But the look in her eyes,
was that of a blissful maiden.

“Steward Zhuo, good luck!” Luo Yunchang batted her eyes at him then shot
a glance towards Drifting Flowers Edifices.

Chu Qingcheng’s eyes were spitting fire right about now. Her teeth
crunching so hard even Grandmother could hear.

Xiao Dandan was having a hard time swallowing down her anger. She was
ready to jump at that hussy’s throat. Fortunately, Peony Overseer was
there to rein her in.

“Who is she? How dare she force herself on darling?”

“That’s their clan’s matter. It has nothing to do with you.” Peony
Overseer sighed.

Xiao Dandan whined, “That’s my darling! Of course it has…”

Xie Tianyang found the ever sweet and cheerful Xue Ningxiang wearing a
mask of anger and sorrow.

[This is a cat fight only a man can stir. But why do I get the feeling
even my cute and lovely Ning’er wants to join the battlefield as well?]

The audience was even more shocked, [That’s no Demonic Dragon, that’s a
Love Doctor I tell you!] While actually, they felt jealousy and anger,
[Being a skirt-chaser is a skill as well.]

Huangpu Tianyuan twiddled his mustache with a cold eye, “Sir Leng, who
among these girls is his Achilles heel?”

“They all have a crush on him, but he ignores them completely. It’s too
soon to tell if any of them can be called his weakness. This needs
further observation.” Leng Wuchang’s eyes flashed.

Huangpu Tianyuan nodded.

Zhuo Fan was out of it for a second there, then saw Luo Yunchang’s rosy
cheeks and rubbed her head, “Young miss Luo, you’re not getting weird on
me, are you?”

“You’re the weird one. Now get on stage!” With a glare, Luo Yunchang
pushed him forward.

With that charming and touching look, she made quite a number of hearts
skip a beat in the crowd.

Zhuo Fan shook his head and went on.

Just then, two figures wrapped in black energy popped up in front of
him. The Blue Expanse City’s Sun clan duo!

Looking at the two creepy aberrations, Zhuo Fan was stunned, “You need
something?”

“Hi-hi-hi, Zhuo Fan, you can’t tell who we are?” The man let out an
eerie laughter, followed by the girl.

Zhuo Fan shook his head, “Sorry, I’ve sinned so much I don’t keep track
of how many I’ve wronged. If you’re here for revenge, kindly wait your
turn. I’ll be with you in a second to send you to the afterlife!”

“Hi-hi-hi, Zhuo Fan you’re as arrogant as ever. But we aren’t the same
as before. This time it’s you who dies!” The man’s eyes flashed bloody
red.

Zhuo Fan nodded, “I get it now. I’ve never seen such ugly freaks in my
life. Going through such a nasty makeover, of course I couldn’t
recognize the current you!”

The crowd erupted in laughter.

Even the girls who were glaring at each other giggled, breaking off
their cat fight. Only the duo on stage was pissed.

“Zhuo Fan, that’s enough!”

Another shout came and two more figures wrapped in black smoke appeared
as they landed in front of Zhuo Fan. They were old men in the 5th layer
of Profound Heaven Stage.

But their faces were as creepy and disturbing as the duo’s.

“Zhuo Fan, you’ve mocked and derided us ever since we met. It’s because
of you we look like this. Today, we will take your head as revenge!” One
of the old men said savagely.

Luo Yunchang frowned, “You came for revenge but we do not even know how
we’ve offended you.”

“Humph, Yunchang, have you forgotten? Destruction of our clan, being
cast out, are these not reasons enough?” The old man spat.

Luo Yunchang was still puzzled, but Zhuo Fan caught onto something and
mocked, “Oh, so it’s you. Who knew you ended up so pathetic and turned
into freaks. Now that you’ve lost all reason to live, you’ve come to me
for reincarnation?”

“We came to kill you, or die together!” the old man’s mind was set.

Snickering, Zhuo Fan said, “Even if you came to kill me, you ought to
get in line. After I deal with the ones on stage, I don’t mind finishing
off the lot of you as well.”

The four nodded.

As the saying went, know thyself and your enemy and you’d be
ever-victorious. It payed to know what the other party was capable of.

So the four cleared a path for Zhuo Fan to go on stage.

By now, the 20 strong fighters on stage were grave. They had lost the
mockery and disdain they had for the Bone Tempering Zhuo Fan.

They just found out that he can stand tall like Six Dragons and One
Phoenix and changed their thinking.

How were they going to beat such a monster? Heck, not even a first rate
clan could do him in!

But since they were on stage already, the fight was unavoidable.

They came to Esoteric Debate in hopes of coming under the wing of the
seven houses after all.

This made every fight a chance to show their spirit and worth. A chance
they would never miss.

“Soaring Demonic Dragon, come!” Wan clan’s leader cupped his hands,
ready for battle. He was sweating buckets, but that didn’t stop him from
braving through the fear.

“Wait!”

Zhuo Fan smiled, “My Luo clan will definitely enter the final battle and
this is too much of a hassle. So in order to move things along, let all
clans, from third to first rate step in. If I lose, we walk. If I win,
we’ll go straight to the final battle, fighting with the seven houses!”

Sss~

A round of gasps echoed. He wants to fight every clan, alone? That was
just too outrageously cocky!

His words only sparked anger in every clan present. While only the seven
houses looked on calmly.

They were the only ones who knew all too well of Zhuo Fan’s cunningness
and deceit…

Chapter 263 - A Shocking and Devastating Strike

Chapter 263, A Shocking and Devastating Strike

The clans were outraged at Zhuo Fan’s haughty declaration while also
terrified of the one they called Soaring Demonic Dragon.

The Profound Heaven expert directing the fights said to Zhuo Fan, “This
isn’t in the rules!”

“What matters is strength, that’s how one earns their right to
participate in the final battle!” Grinning, Zhuo Fan stuck out his chin
as he turned to the seven houses, “And it’s a perfect time to show them
who they’re up against!”

Such ego to consider himself the seven houses’ equal!

He instantly earned the disdain of the crowd. While those that knew of
his exploits with the seven houses thought, [The kid sure is qualified.]

Huangpu Qingtian stepped forward and watched the stage coldly.

The appearance of Regent Estate’s eldest young master shocked them all.

They soon heard a clear and mighty voice ringing in their ears. The
words had such impact they almost had a heart attack.

“Do as per his wishes. But…” Huangpu Qingtian drew his arm over the
crowd, “I declare that anyone who brings me Zhuo Fan’s head, their clan
will become Regent Estate’s vassal!”

Sss~

After a round of gasps, a deathly silence ensued. The clans were so
overwhelmed they couldn’t dare believe their ears!

[This is godsent!]

One little head was enough to skip the cruel and deadly Esoteric
Debate’s last battle and just come under Regent Estate’s wing.

What they didn’t know however was that this dream was closer to a
nightmare than reality.

But the promise of greatness robbed their minds of what was to come.
Their eyes were fixed on Zhuo Fan, wishing they were already holding his
head!

All they were waiting for now was that Profound Heaven expert’s signal
and they’d be onto him like wolves.

No one even stopped to think that this free meal could be too hard to
even chew. Was Zhuo Fan’s title of Soaring Demonic Dragon, on par with
Six Dragons and One Phoenix, for naught?

“Young master Huangpu, you’re sending them to their deaths!”

Zhuo Fan was carefree as he showed an evil grin to Huangpu Qingtian.

Huangpu Qingtian responded with the same smile, “Isn’t this what you
wanted?”

Then they laughed.

Zhuo Fan wanted to cause a sensation alright, to establish Luo clan’s
position in the upcoming final battle. So the more people that jumped on
his sword the better. While Huangpu Qingtian never once believed these
second and third rate clans had any good seeds among them to even harm
Zhuo Fan.

He was using them to see Zhuo Fan’s limit and develop contingencies.

Each side understood the other’s intent flawlessly, all while using each
other.

It was a win-win scenario. The only losses here would be just your
run-of-the-mill rock for brains suicidal morons.

The seven houses noticed this as well and they were stunned looking at
the laughing duo.

[These two are devious and cruel men of ambition. They gaze far into the
horizon!]

In this Esoteric Debate, the winner would come from one of them.

But as the world wasn’t big enough for the two of them, they had to
settle their score here and now. Or the world would be plunged into
chaos at their hands, ripped apart and burned to cinders.

The house lords watched them with glinting eyes.

The Esoteric Debate was going to revolve around these two monsters,
Huangpu Qingtian and Zhuo Fan. Each leading his own faction of houses,
something unheard of in the past Esoteric Debates.

The battle for unification was underway and nothing or anyone could stop
it. All that was left was to see who had the last laugh!

This was something privy to the seven houses only. Those crickets
downstairs only knew how to fight among each other for scraps…

The presiding Profound Heaven expert got his nod of approval and flew up
high, soon followed by his clear words.

“Luo clan’s qualifying fight for the final battle begins!”

Roar!

The clans flung themselves like mindless beasts at Zhuo Fan. They were
all spectators turned opportunists. What used to be innocent bystanders,
were now fired up by the smell of blood and glory.

They were all just one gory head away from becoming the foundation of
their clan’s endless fame. Who could fight the temptation? Perhaps they
were lucky enough and would even get it.

And the number who thought so was by no means small.

As such, the referee’s words were marked by a veritable flood of people
storming the stage. It was close to ten thousand people, with plenty of
Bone Tempering and Profound Heaven experts joining as well!

The Wan clan already on stage was overwhelmed.

Zhuo Fan was their opponent but, as things stood, did they even have a
snowball’s chance in hell to rob the guy’s head from the masses?

Luck was with them in that regard, being so close and all. Yet when they
looked deep into Zhuo Fan’s bottomless gaze, the 20 strong men found
themselves frozen.

The incoming tide behind them was oblivious, rushing onwards like
clueless children swept by the promise of reward as they launched
attacks on Zhuo Fan.

The thousands of people swallowed Zhuo Fan until he was no longer
visible.

Xue Ningxiang was worried, “Will brother Zhuo be fine?”

“Totally. With that punk’s luck, not even the seven houses can do
anything to him, let alone these pests!” Xie Tianyang comforted Ning’er
but he was nonetheless frowning, “But isn’t thousands of people at once
perhaps an overkill? The punk is amazing, sure, but there is also the
danger of dying from exhaustion. Why is he waiting them out? Why isn’t
he thinning the crowd?”

“Hi-hi-hi, no matter how strong, he is all alone against the tide! He is
finished!” A creepy laughter jarred his ear.

The audience, or what was left of it, turned to the creepy man to hear
him say, “A shame we are already under Hell Valley and cannot throw our
lot with Regent Estate. We would’ve been in there cashing our luck
otherwise.”

“En, true!” Dong Clan Head nodded.

Wan’er glared at him.

Dong Clan Head shook his head as he looked at the sea of people on the
stage, “These are cruel words, but that is reality. Regent Estate’s bait
is too enticing for anyone to resist. Not even the kid would’ve thought
his egotistical words would stir such a reaction.”

“Even if he dies, he only has himself to blame.” Dong Clan Head sighed,
as did Xue Wanlong and Xue Dingtian.

Xue Ningxiang and Dong Xiaowan watched on, plagued with worry. Dong
Tianba and the Xue clan’s youths were frowning. But only Xie Tianyang
had a mocking smile.

[Egotistical? Of course he is!]

[But have you ever seen how cautious he is? How could a brash and
obnoxious kid ever manage to toy with You Guiqi?]

Xie Tianyang was not one bit worried for Zhuo Fan’s fate.

He knew Zhuo Fan showed cockiness on the outside but never actually did
something unless he had a plan set in motion.

Hu~

An invisible ripple spawned in the center of the stage, swallowing it
whole.

The force of it had Huangpu Tianyuan squinting. He watched as the tide
of people on the stage had blank stares before collapsing.

All the contestants dropped on the ground one at a time, with the crazed
and thirsty greed frozen on their faces.

Those outside the stage stopped in their charge, watching the stage
tensely.

Zhuo Fan touched the buffed guy in front with his finger and let him
collapse.

The ground around him was littered with bodies, not that he cared,
stepping over them in his conquering march.

Like a king, he was stepping on the bodies of his enemies as he took his
throne.

Xue Ningxiang and Dong Xiaowan were overjoyed while Dong Clan Head, Xue
Clan Head were shellshocked.

“What just happened? What’s wrong with them?” The shock on everyone’s
faces was palpable.

Zhuo Fan was uncaring, looking over the leftovers, still standing and
cocking his finger with a nasty grin, “There’s still a thousand left.
Come and take my head if you want it.”

Swallowing dryly, they were now faltering. Their previous high had
passed, as did their courage. The sight of an evil and grinning Zhuo Fan
in the middle of thousands of bodies tended to do that to a feeble mind.

“Killing with intent!” Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes trembled.

His quiet voice spread everywhere among the deathly silence.

In an instant, everyone looked at Zhuo Fan in shock.

[Isn’t that a Radiant Stage expert’s ability? Why is a Bone Tempering
cultivator wielding it?]

The fear in their eyes couldn’t be more pronounced.

This was why so many people dropped lifeless without even a chance to
fight back. The one that killed them was on par with a Radiant Stage
expert…
