Chapter 273 - Great Haul

Chapter 273, Great Haul

Bang~

Zhuo Fan pummeled the entrance wall. The gonging sound was eerily
similar to someone knocking on a metal door.

The girl looked on dazed, from a very safe distance. [This punk has
nerves of steel, I’ll give him that. Or is he plain indifferent to the
6th level spiritual beast just waiting for him inside.]

[Speaking of his insensitivity, was he that easily taken in by my
charm?]

The girl looked at him closer, [Something isn’t right here.]

Splash~

Then, the sound of water was heard and a meter long water serpent swam
out of the cave. It shook as its body expanded.

It was back to its five hundred meters long size in a blink, which
created a huge splash as he hissed at the two humans.

Hiss!

The stench licked his cheek and Zhuo Fan clutched his nose as he sized
the snake.

[This guy ate Shaping Spring alright.]

The girl was waving her hand down yonder in panic. Not out of worry for
Zhuo Fan, of course, but his death would mean her venture would abruptly
end with a big fat zero haul.

[Why is this brat just standing there? Is he scared shitless? God damn

The girl gnashed her teeth in annoyance.

The venomous serpent thought the same, laughing out loud and looking
with contempt.

[This brat must be so naive to knock at my home. Now that he has basked
in my royal glory, he’s scared witless. Ha-ha-ha, it’s only natural.
Even I am in awe of my glorious self most of the time, ha-ha-ha…]

Glancing at the delusional snake, and its wagging tail, Zhuo Fan could
read him like a book. He grinned as he simply flew inside the cave.

“Guard this place and don’t come in without my say.” Zhuo Fan belittled
this useless thing and just waltzed in.

The venomous serpent was out of it from shock. [What did he just say? To

The serpent was enraged. No one ever ignored it, least of all claim its

[Oy, punk, do you have any idea whose home this is? Do you have a death
wish?]

Hiss!

The venomous serpent got closer to Zhuo Fan and hissed in his face.
Covering him in drool, it hoped to knock some sense into him with its
almighty majesty.

The girl was soaked from fear. [Run you fool!]

Yet Zhuo Fan only had disdain in his eyes. He wiped the drool from his
face, and glared, “Behave.”

Pff!

The venomous serpent almost spat blood. It had never met someone so full
of themselves to ignore it and even belittle it. It was royally pissed.

The girl was scared witless.

[You behave, brat! You’re pissing it off by telling it to watch the

Some of us still need to get in, you know?]

[The guy’s brains are on the fritz!]

She sighed. She could practically see the kid torn into pieces by the
angry venomous serpent.

And that was what the serpent was about to do.

[Holy friggin’ balls! I’ve seen many dauntless, but none so boneheaded
to not even care for their lives. They look for death or, better yet,

[You’re dead meat, so cut the act. Humph, as you wish, this king will
send you off.]

Licking its sharp fangs, the venomous serpent hissed and went on to
swallow him whole. With how the red mouth was covered in poison, Zhuo

The girl closed her eyes and looked away. She couldn’t bear the horror
that followed.

Yet Zhuo Fan was cool as a cucumber as the azure flame flashed in his
eyes.

Hum~

A ripple wracked the venomous serpent.

Scared, the huge serpent froze in its place.

He was soaked in sweat, even as his maw was right on top of Zhuo Fan,
with fangs bared and all. And yet he just didn’t chomp.

The look in Zhuo Fan’s eye got him so terrified, it started shivering.

“You’re so feisty to not listen when you’re ordered.” Zhuo Fan shook his
head as he went in like he owned the place.

Leaving the venomous serpent behind like a statue, scared and
dumbfounded.

[W-what power was that?]

The serpent’s heart was frantic.

Spiritual beasts cared a lot about levels, more than the strength even.
A 6th level spiritual beast’s pup was no stronger than a 3rd level
spiritual beast but no 4th level spiritual beast would dare attack it.

It was their inborn majestic aura doing its thing. No low level
spiritual beast messed with a higher one, ever. It was etched in their

As a 6th level spiritual beast, it was invincible here. A king lording

But it finally got his due in the form of Zhuo Fan. The guy flexed his

[Damn it all to hell! What was that?] He held such power that it made

The venomous serpent was sweating buckets. It was just like a beggar

If it was told to guard the door, that was what it’d do. What was so bad

It went to such an extent that the snake swam out of the cave and didn’t

While the girl who had struck Zhuo Fan off as a dead man, sneaked a peak

[What the hell? Since when were vicious venomous serpents so meek? It’s

[How in bloody hell did a Bone Tempering cultivator do this? Does he
also have a secret beast taming art?]

The girl cocked her head, glancing at Zhuo Fan going further in with

[This brat isn’t as dumb as he looks. He may very well not have needed

strong and all, why is he hiding it? Is he planning to take it all for
himself?]

The girl panicked and stomped in anger. Her wish to go in there herself
was curbed by the venomous serpent guard at the door.

This time she was close to blowing a gasket. She had wasted a month
staking out this place, only to let another person reap the reward.

[I was hustled!]

She then pouted and slumped on the ground, sulking…

Back to Zhuo Fan, the man in question soon arrived at the end of the
cave. The view here shocked him senseless.

The cave was your average hole in the mountain, opening into a room a
thousand square meters in size, but the dazzling scene was breathtaking.

He came here for Shaping Spring and actually found so many high grade
herbs. There were a hundred 8th grade and at least a thousand 7th grade
herbs!

Such haul could contest with the seven houses’ stores.

If not even imperial family’s!

[Holy mother of god! True wealth truly comes from nature.] He assumed
these were all gathered by the snakey, but why didn’t he eat them? [To
last him through the winter?]

[More for me, I guess! He-he-he…]

Without further ado, and not caring for the beast outside, he pocketed
all herbs with a wave. He even went to every corner and made sure he
didn’t miss anything.

Zhuo Fan cackled like mad for such a great haul.

It echoed along the cave walls and traveled outside.

Venomous serpent’s heart sank and tears fell from his eyes.

The girl heard the cackle as well and almost sank into depression.
[Those were supposed to be mine!]

Having already scouted the cave with her pet fish, she knew what a
jackpot that cave held. She didn’t tell Zhuo Fan about it in fear he’d
want a bite as well.

And now? He didn’t just take a bite but swallowed it whole.

The girl was wallowing in misery, tears threatening to burst out of her
clear eyes…

Chapter 274 - Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd Stage

Chapter 274, Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd Stage

Whoosh~

Zhuo Fan drifted around in the cave, waving his ring in every direction.
He could feel joy bubbling out of him with every precious ingredient
being tucked away in the safe confines of his ring.

He just came to Beast King Mountain and had already made a killing.
[This is the best goddamn omen of all!]

Zhuo Fan cackled, his sound chilling the snake and human outside to the
bone.

After he had made sure nothing was left unappropriated, Zhuo Fan began
his search for Shaping Spring in earnest. His soul sense spread to every
corner.

Then Zhuo Fan rushed deeper. Standing next to a hot spring, he watched
the bottom of the spring in shock.

An all natural hot spring! It was ten meter wide and had hot water
coming out from the wall in front. But what was truly amazing was the
thick white layer at the bottom of it.

Zhuo Fan knew right away that this was Shaping Spring.

[Isn’t it a bit too much?]

Not even he had hoped to find so much of the underground miraculous
treasure. Just a vial of the stuff could buy you a town!

He’d be happy with just a bowl. But he didn’t just get a bowl, he
instead got a whole tub!

He could literally bathe in it.

Zhuo Fan shuddered from excitement. Thinking back on this mountain, he
realized that only after billions of years of accumulation could have
gathered so much of Shaping Spring.

There would’ve been even more of it if not for a certain snake sampling
it.

[This is enough as it is. Anyways, one shouldn’t be too greedy. It’s bad
for health.]

Zhuo Fan chuckled at his egotistical thinking. Any who heard him
would’ve spat blood. [If you’re not greedy then the people in this world
are all altruists.]

[Humph, greedy pig!]

Plop!

With a laugh, Zhuo Fan jumped right in. He sank until the Shaping Spring
reached his waist.

Zhuo Fan quirked his eyebrows in glee.

[So deep!]

There was even more of the Shaping Spring than he thought was possible.

Zhuo Fan went right down to business. Taking out bottles and filling
them with the stuff before throwing them into his ring.

Zhuo Fan’s face always sported that dumb grin throughout this ‘ordeal’,
smiling from ear to ear.

[I hit pay dirt coming to this Beast King Mountain. It’s totally worth
it even if I don’t get that Brimming Sacred Pill. Ha-ha-ha…]

Zhuo Fan’s laughter echoed throughout the cave.

Bam!

While he was hauling his booty, he touched upon something. It didn’t
sound like a rock, but something hollow.

He groped around blindly before taking out a blue vial. Zhuo Fan looked
at it curiously.

[Why is there a vial here? Is collecting baubles another one of the
serpent’s hobbies?]

But the writing on it left him stupefied, “My luck can’t be that good,
right? Did I actually stumble upon a Brimming Sacred Pill?”

Yes sir, the vial had those exact words on it. The cap even had a seal
on it to not leak its fragrance and attract spiritual beasts.

Zhuo Fan started flipping it.

Fang Qiubai threw five such pills into Beast King Mountain at the start.
This one must’ve flown through an underground river and chanced upon
this place, with the snake totally oblivious of it.

Zhuo Fan sighed, [I’m so lucky even I’m scared.]

The odds of finding a Brimming Sacred Pill among Shaping Spring was a
true close to zero chance.

But was he one to waste such an opportunity? Hell no! He threw it in his
ring and resumed hauling his loot. It took him half a day of ‘grueling’
work to capture it all, down to the last drop.

The venomous serpent outside was swimming around, peeved. [Just what are
you doing in my home? Couldn’t you at least leave some for me? Waaah~]

Uncaring and unfeeling for the heartbroken snake outside, Zhuo Fan had
no idea about the meaning of restraint. He took one last look at the
spotless walls, and nodded in satisfaction that he didn’t miss anything.

Woe was the poor snake. It was now a millionaire turned pauper, wrung
dry by Zhuo Fan.

If it’d only seen this spotless place, it’d be crying his lungs out.

Not that the greedy Zhuo Fan ever cared, mind you.

Zhuo Fan now took his time to inspect the Brimming Sacred Pill. He
uncapped it and swallowed it.

With enemies coming out at every turn in the Esoteric Debate, he was
hard pressed to find such leisure again, giving him enough time to
refine the pill. It’d be best to stay in here, under the snake’s watch
and grow stronger.

Boom!

An explosion of soul power happened the instant he swallowed it. As if a
sea was unleashed in his head, his mind threatened to burst.

Zhuo Fan never thought the pill would be so outrageously strong. Finding
it painful even for him to absorb such a vast amount.

Nevertheless, he was happy as he channeled it into his right eye. With
his soul at the Radiant Stage, increasing it a few more times would
hardly help him in this battle.

His focus was on reaching the Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage with
the help of the Brimming Sacred Pill!

The 1st stage had incredible power and made him practically invincible,
but the 2nd stage was even more so, as it covered his deadly weakness.

His victory in this final battle solely rested on it!

Zhuo Fan’s right eye burned hot as the golden ring in it flickered.
Slowly, a second golden halo came into existence beyond the first.

Even if blood spilled from his eye, even if the pain was excruciating,
he braced for it and remained staunch!

If he hadn’t missed his chance in Dragon Cloud City, it wouldn’t have
been such an ordeal. But now, forced by circumstances, he chose to power
his way through, multiplying his agony instead.

He couldn’t even spare the attention to care though. Even as he bled
from his eye, even as he was soaked in sweat, he still remained firmly
seated on the ground.

Over the next couple of days, Zhuo Fan was in constant frown and veins
bulged on his forehead. He was still suffering through the pain and felt
the breaking point drawing ever nearer.

He reached his limit on the afternoon of the third day. He was teetering
on the edge, just as the second halo formed in his right eye.

An invisible wave shot to the skies the next moment. A simple glare
actually made a small hole straight through the whole five hundred meter
tall mountain above him like it was nothing!

The bright sky, the warm sunlight, passed through it and shined upon the
gleeful Zhuo Fan. He was spent and weary, but thrilled.

Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation!

The power to break through any space!

Even trapped in an array or space, he’d now have no problem blowing his
way out all thanks to a little help from something called Divine Eye of
the Void’s 2nd stage.

“Ha-ha-ha, awesome! I am truly invincible now!” Zhuo Fan cackled, but
fell the instant he tried getting up.

He guessed that he would have to wait as tending to his soul came first.
A great deal of his soul power was used on breaking through and it was
now time to use the rest to cultivate.

So he sat cross legged again.

The next day, his soul spread around and found everything to be far
clearer. He realized the range had increased to two miles and flew out
of the cave.

He had struck the motherlode coming to Beast King Mountain!

Whoosh!

Shooting out of the cave with a thunderclap, he ignored the snake and
took to the skies.

With his nemesis finally out, the venomous serpent shrank his size and
entered the cave.

The empty and spotless place left him wailing in rage.

The hoard he grew throughout his life was gone, just like that. Even
Shaping Spring was picked clean. He licked the hot spring and found not
a drop remaining.

The snake wailed, [He is worse than a bandit!]

But then he noticed the bright sky above and almost fainted from anger.

[Blast it all to hell! Have you no restrain?]

[You already cleaned me out and now you go as far as punching holes in
my home? What did I ever do to you ? Waaah~]

Chapter 275 - Ruler of the World

Chapter 275, Ruler of the World

Whoosh!

Thunder cracked across the bright sky, announcing Zhuo Fan’s
lightning-fast flight, his face pleased as punch.

What was that saying? One good deed deserves another. [Yeah, that’s the
one. I saved that annoying lass and nature replied in kind from her
bountiful bosom. I’ll have to rethink my approach and spread kindness
from now on, ha-ha-ha…]

Zhuo Fan cackled.

Then he spotted the same girl not far ahead. She figured he was going to
take off and waited for him outside.

“Oh, miss, do you need something?” Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow.

Fuming mad, she said, “Hand it over!”

“Hand what over?” Zhuo Fan played dumb.

The girl barked, “Shaping Spring and those herbs! Think I am so stupid
not to realize what you’ve been doing in there? But I am a woman of
morals so I won’t bicker. According to the laws of the cultivation
world, half belongs to me by right!”

“Bint, no can do.” Zhuo Fan shook his head, “You said giving you half is
fair, but why would I ever do that?”

The lady played the kicked puppy card, “B-but I found it!”

“First come first serve!”

“If it weren’t for me, you’d never get them! So give me my fair share!”
The girl panicked.

Zhuo Fan smiled, “Did you forget I saved you? To repay me you showed me
the treasury. Now we’re even, buh-bye.”

Zhuo Fan left laughing, but the lady blocked him again with a snarl,
“You damn bastard! Out of respect for saving me, I wasn’t going to argue
with you and split the haul evenly. But you just don’t know when to
quit!”

Her 2nd layer of Profound Heaven cultivation exploded, glaring at Zhuo
Fan with the clear intent to fight him over it.

Zhuo Fan yawned, “Missy, power isn’t always limited by cultivation
stages. Once we fight, your hopes are dashed.”

“Humph, damn egomaniac, enough bluffing! You may have subdued the 6th
level spiritual beast but I’m no spiritual beast. I also know taming
arts and they only work on spiritual beasts. Stop trying to scare me, it
ain’t going to work.”

She then punched straight for Zhuo Fan’s face. The fierce power of the
fist came barreling down towards him, backed by her 2nd layer of
Profound Heaven cultivation.

It had no effect on Zhuo Fan, however, still calm and uncaring as he
vanished. The girl was left speechless.

The next second she found her wrist yanked behind her back.

“Ah!”

She then started crying from pain, “Y-you’re breaking my arm. Let go…”

Zhuo Fan shook his head and let go.

She jumped ten meters away and looked at him perplexed.

[How did he do that?] He was clearly in the 9th layer of Bone Tempering
Stage yet overpowered a 2nd layer of Profound Heaven cultivator in both
power and speed. She felt like a mouse in the claws of a hawk. [This
doesn’t make sense!]

[It’s too damn freaky!]

Only now did she recall Zhuo Fan’s words.

[This guy is a bloody monster!]

The girl gnashed her teeth and a flick of the hand revealed three
roaring 4th level spiritual beasts ready to pounce at Zhuo Fan.

Zhuo Fan raised an eyebrow curiously, “You’re not half bad, I’ll give
you that. You don’t see that everyday, a lady having three 4th level
spirit animals.”

“He-he-he, scared?”

She stuck her chin out in her boasting, “Let me tell you, I have a dozen
spirit animals, but these three are my most cherished ones and they even
know how to fly. I would have drowned you in my spirit animals if we
were on the ground instead!”

Zhuo Fan looked at her oddly.

Most people in Tianyu focused on personal power, with hardly any
interest in rearing beasts. That made spirit animals a rarity. You were
hard pressed to find even high stage experts having one.

But this girl here was quite average in cultivation yet had over ten
spirit animals. It was Zhuo Fan’s first time meeting someone who
specialized in rearing beasts.

His odd looks however were taken as fear by the lass, who cackled, “It’s
too late to be scared now. But if your apology is heartfelt enough and
you give me those items, I may be inclined to spare your miserable life.
I will even forgive your earlier transgression!”

“Whatever gave you the idea that I’m scared? Did you forget how that 6th
level spiritual beast acted in front of me? Just like a kitty. And you
think some 4th level spiritual beasts will do? Ha-ha-ha…” Zhuo Fan
sneered.

The girl snapped, “C-cut your boasting! Who knows what you really did to
that serpent? But it can only be something similar to my own taming art,
a soul attack. But these three pets of mine are linked with my soul.
Their master’s orders are paramount. It will be impossible for you to
tame them!”

“Oh, shall I give it a shot?” Zhuo Fan snickered.

The naked contempt he showed only earned her ire, “Attack! Show him your
power!”

Roar!

The three beasts were extremely loyal, jumping on Zhuo Fan the moment
they were given the go signal. Yet nothing could unnerve Zhuo Fan.

The three were right on top of him, ready to tear him to pieces when his
eyes flashed azure.

And, just like the 6th level spiritual beast before, the three pets
froze and starting sweating like pigs.

[Mommy! Who the hell is this big shot? Why is he so scary?]

Without further ado, the scared witless beasts bolted with tail between
their legs, swift as the wind.

It took a long time for the truth to worm itself into the girl’s mind,
sheer absurdity of it all. She then shouted for her pets to come back.

But would they listen?

What master’s orders were paramount? Life was infinitely more precious!

[Blast it, is the master’s brain on the fritz? Why would we ever face
such horror? To die?]

The girl shouted herself hoarse, but her pets were long gone,
infuriating her.

Then she sobered up and shuddered from fear.

Zhuo Fan drifted towards her with his mocking smile, “It seems being
linked with your pets ain’t all sunshine and rainbows. With the three of
them horrified, their master is ought to feel some of that fear
herself.”

“W-who the hell are you?” The girl froze, watching him in horror.

Now she knew why the 6th level spiritual beast held this man in such
fear, and her pets were no different.

Because this man didn’t use something as trifling as his soul to subdue
them, but instilled a sense of utter dread in their very being, that
even robbed them of the thought of fighting back.

[But how?]

Why would vicious beasts show such fear towards one simple man? Such a
ludicrous story was never heard anywhere in the world.

But this guy did it with ease! [Just who is he?]

Zhuo Fan smiled and answered her doubts, “I will one day rule this
world!”

With a laugh and flap of his wings, he was gone. He left the girl
shivering and staring dumbly in shock.

This mystery man had tangled with her so many times and left her with a
bone deep impression. Those final words were etched in her mind.

She would scoff if it was anyone else saying them, but for some reason,
hearing them from Zhuo Fan made her believe he could do it.

[How could Tianyu have such a dreadful man?]

The girl was filled with trepidation.

Whoosh!

Two black-robed men flashed in front of her.

“Lian’er, is something wrong?” One asked, while the other followed with,
“Young miss, are you alright?”

She only looked at them with fear in her eyes, “Brother, Tianyu isn’t
something we can just attack. It’s best that we fall back…”

Then her vision blurred and she fell unconscious. The two held her in
worry, calling out to her.

[What did she mean?]

Chapter 276 - Plight

Chapter 276, Plight

“Young chief, young miss is only shaken up. You don’t need to worry.”

The night sky was brightened by the moon’s glow and dazzling stars. In a
dusky cave crackled a bonfire, shining its light onto the hundred
black-robed figures, all with heads down and in solemn silence.

A white mustached old man glanced at the girl resting near the fire with
a youth at her side.

The youth asked, “She is in extreme shock, but why? I’ve known my sister
for all my life. She grew among spiritual beasts and is very brash. Just
what could have scared her so much?”

“Well…” The old man frowned, then sighed, “It is different for everyone.
I am sorry this old man can’t be of any help.”

The youth sighed and waved the old man away.

It was now that the resting girl’s eyes fluttered and she said weakly,
“B-brother…”

“Lian’er, you’re awake!” The youth grabbed her wrist in happiness. The
other black-robed men rejoiced but did not disturb them.

“Lian’er, what happened to you? You are strong enough to wander the
Beast King Mountain for months. So why did you suddenly black out? That
was dangerous!” The youth looked at her in concern.

Lian’er nodded, her eyes glistening as she said anxiously, “Brother,
don’t attack Tianyu. It holds our natural enemy and if we attack rashly
we will suffer greatly. Our clan will be ruined!”

The youth looked at her puzzled. So she propped her weak body up and
began retelling her encounter with Zhuo Fan from start to finish.

The youth was shocked, “What, Tianyu has such a mystical power to cower
spiritual beasts?”

The faces of everyone around them fell.

This news was a nightmare!

“Tianyu is a true dragon among men. We can’t underestimate it!”

Taking a deep breath, the youth stood and paced around with a frown,
“We, the Quanrong, are experts in rearing beasts, able to sweep the
lands with our beast army. Not even that God of War, Dugu Zhantian,
dares face us. Only with the help of his arrays and formations can he
stand on equal ground to us. But if Tianyu has someone capable of
instilling fear into beasts, to the point they’d go against their
master’s orders, our beast army will collapse in a heartbeat.”

The others nodded, having reached the same dreadful conclusion. This
news broke Quanrong’s strongest advantage, robbing them of any means to
attack.

“Young chief, allow this general to purge this danger from the world!” A
strapping middle-aged man cupped his hands.

From the powerful waves he released, this man was clearly a Radiant
Stage expert!

Mulling it over, the youth shook his head in the end, “No. Tianyu is in
the middle of its Esoteric Debate. We need to use this chance and
inspect the Teleportation Array from the shadows. The slightest mistake
on our part will endanger our entire operation.”

“Brother, you still want to do it? But that guy…” Lian’er spoke in
worry.

The youth came to a decision, “All the more reason. If we can’t conquer
Tianyu, we will never get the chance again and will lose every future
war!”

They all nodded solemnly.

Lian’er sighed, “But brother, is that man truly trustworthy? Can we
really take Tianyu in one move?”

“Ha-ha-ha, Lian’er and everyone needs to relax. There is no better spy
in Tianyu than that man.” The youth cackled. As if the world was his
oyster…

Back to Zhuo Fan, he was still flying among the clouds in search of Luo
Yunhai and the rest.

Suddenly, his nose twitched and he changed directions.

Blood!

Whoosh!

Zhuo Fan landed near a river soaked in blood and bodies coming from
upstream.

The wounds on the bodies clearly showed they were man made. A great
battle must be underway upstream and he rushed to investigate.

His Discerning Field was strong enough to scout two miles ahead in great
detail. He could even see what was behind those two mountains in front.

Zhuo Fan bypassed them with his senses and saw a great deal of men
gathered at the mouth of a valley. From their signatures, he easily
identified them as Luo Yunhai, Xue Ningxiang, and other second and third
rate clans.

Outside the valley entrance were the vassals of the Regent Estate’s
faction, forcing Yunhai’s group into the valley. He had no clue who they
were but their leader couldn’t be more familiar. Zhuo Fan snickered, “Oh
my, now a cripple goes out hunting? You must have a death wish.”

Quite right. The man leading the attack on Luo Yunhai was Forest
Fleeting Dragon, Lin Xuanfeng. Albeit a one-legged dragon, but he still
had the power to shock everyone.

His dragon title was shaky now, but to the average Profound Heaven
expert, he was undefeated.

Lin Xuanfeng looked coldly at his enemies and shouted, “Listen up! I
only care about the Luo clan to settle a grudge. I don’t have time to
waste on extras so get lost. Or you could just follow Luo clan to their
grave!”

The men were tense and glanced at Luo Yunhai.

It was obvious Lin Xuanfeng was taking it out on the Luo clan for having
Zhuo Fan rip his leg clean off. Their grudges had nothing to do with
these second rate clans.

Although vassals of Drifting Flowers Edifices, Sword Marquise Abode, and
Veiled Dragon Pavilion were allies of Luo clan, they were nonetheless
far from willing to pay the ultimate sacrifice in defending them.

Luo Yunhai knew this as well as he said solemnly, “Our meeting was pure
chance, friends. There’s no need to implicate youself as well. If you
wish…”

“Useless cripple, our fate lies with the Luo clan. You don’t scare us!
Why don’t you pick on big brother Zhuo if you have the guts!”

The charming voice cut Luo Yunhai off, with a brash and arrogant tone.
Her allies were scared witless.

[Young miss!]

[If you want to defend Luo clan and die, go right ahead, we won’t stop
you. But could you please not drag us into this as well? And why are you
even mentioning that guy’s name, are you trying to piss off Lin Xuanfeng
some more?]

[How are we supposed to face that whirlwind, Lin Xuanfeng?]

They all felt like crying, having their lifeline cut off without
remorse.

Xue Gang and Xue Lin looked at Xue Ningxiang with a shake of their
heads. They knew she liked Zhuo Fan, but going as far as ticking off Lin
Xuanfeng was the worst case scenario.

Luo Yunhai looked at Xue Ningxiang, moved, “Sister Ning’er, thank you…”

“What thanks? Without big brother Zhuo around, it falls to me to keep
you safe!” Xue Ningxiang patted her chest with a prideful face. She was
happy as long as she could do anything for Zhuo Fan.

And yet her brothers were crying inside.

[Damn brat! How can you look after someone when you’re constantly being
looked after? Moreover, Luo Yunhai and his ten guards are stronger than
any of us. How can we even protect them?]

Luo Yunhai scratched his nose, “Uh, I am grateful for sister Ning’er’s
good intentions. But it’s best if I take big brother Zhuo’s place and
look after you.”

Ning’er patted Luo Yunhai’s head and smiled, “Never mind protecting me,
since big brother Zhuo is surely just around a corner, ready to jump in
and save me.”

Luo Yunhai was puzzled.

Ning’er showed her Thunder Ring with a smile, “Each time I’m in danger,
the Thunder Ring flashes and that means big brother Zhuo is here!”

Luo Yunhai sighed at how innocent and naive she was, even delusional
some might say.

[It would be best if big brother Zhuo comes in the nick of time. But if
you think he’s going to show up each time you’re in danger, won’t you
treat your life as a joke?]

Her brothers knew this as well and tried reasoning with her, but Xue
Ningxiang turned a deaf ear.

A girl’s fairy tail was impossible to dispel!

Xue Ningxiang’s choice of words sure got the obvious reaction out of Lin
Xuanfeng. He was pissed and filled with bloodthirst.

“Young master Lin, we…” His men glanced at him.

Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes were bloodshot as he barked, “Ignorant brat! Just
kill them all and be done with them!”

His roar resounded in Luo Yunhai’s group’s ears, scaring them. Only Xue
Ningxiang was closely watching Thunder Ring for any signs, waiting for
that spark of hope…

Chapter 277 - Breakout

Chapter 277, Breakout

“Kill!”

The war cry signaled the enemy’s charge into the valley entrance. The
thick bloodthirst in the air was that from a stampede of enraged bulls.
The pressure was too great even for a Profound Heaven expert to hold on,
making it harder to breathe.

They all turned pale as paper. Not only was the enemy outnumbering them
many times over, but they even had the strength advantage. How were they
going to come out of this one?

Even Luo Yunhai, who alongside the four tigers saw charging armies on an
almost daily basis, was affected. Their side was at a gross
disadvantage.

Be it in terrain or numbers, none of it worked in their favor. In war
tactics, this situation could only be overcome by forcing one’s way
through if one wanted to get out alive.

His jaw set, Luo Yunhai turned to his side teetering on the verge of
collapse and shouted, “Everyone, don’t all of you have someone here you
wish to protect?”

That caught their attention. Luo Yunhai’s eyes flashed, “They may
outnumber us but they are rabble! I can help you get your loved ones out
safely. They will be in the center while we form a circle around them as
we break out of the enemy attack. We will likely lose our lives but our
loved ones will have the highest chance at survival!”

The dead eyes of his group finally sparked with a glimmer of hope.

“Brother, go in the middle, I’ll protect you!”

“Foolish child, I’m the big brother, how can I let you give your life
for me? It is my duty to keep you alive!”

“Brother…” The younger brother’s eyes glistened…

“Sister, stay close to the center and don’t fall behind!” Another
brother patted his younger sister’s shoulder.

“Brother in law, go in the middle. I’ll get you out for sure!”

“Silly boy, how can I live if you died? How will I face your sister?”
The man said to his wife’s younger brother.

…

They soon shed the fear instilled by the enemy’s war cry and their
hearts held a deep feeling of warmth, spurring on their will to fight to
the death.

Luo Yunhai nodded, grateful that his plan worked. Next up was the fight!

Looking back at the savage enemy marching over, Luo Yunhai took a deep
breath and like a true Marshal, he took in the entire battlefield to
make use of.

Zhuo Fan would be so proud if he could see this boy having grown up.

Because Luo Yunhai’s words were the right tactic for a Marshal to use in
this critical situation.

He had to kindle the will to fight in his men.

If he said something along the lines of ‘fight alongside me to survive’,
the effect would hardly be noticeable.

Everyone considered their lives as the number one priority and they made
sure to treasure it. But how could they overcome their fears in the face
of that relentless tide marching towards them?

Even if he could make them fight for their own sake, it was a flimsy
reason bound to crumble at first contact. Death would follow all the
same at this point.

But Luo Yunhai was sharp in figuring out these people had loved ones
mixed in this group. He appealed to their humanity, their conscience,
their responsibility, and drove them to war.

Although this meant cutting their effective fighting force in half, the
ones doing the protecting would give their absolute best, and more, to
make sure their loved ones lived to see tomorrow.

To instantly turn these random groups of people into a cohesive unit
bent on fighting to the death was the sign of a great general Luo Yunhai
had the hopes of becoming.

“Yunhai, stay behind me. Sister will protect you!” Xue Ningxiang’s
beaming face graced his eyes. She even flexed to back up her claim.

Luo Yunhai let out an awkward chuckle, “Ha-ha-ha, I am grateful for your
kindness, but I am the one commanding this charge. It’s more important
that I stay in front as well!”

Xue Gang and Xue Lin hoisted the overconfident, and delusional, Xue
Ningxiang behind, “Ning’er, don’t be willful. He’s stronger than you.
Listen to your brother and stay in the middle. Let your brothers get you
to safety!”

Xue Ningxiang pouted, then her eyes sparked, “Then I’ll stay behind
Yunhai. That way I can protect him when he needs help!”

Helpless, they had no choice but to agree. Behind Luo Yunhai could also
be said to belong to the center of the group, somewhat.

But Xue Gang and Xue Lin were not leaving her sides. Anything could
happen in the spur of the moment, especially on the battlefield. They
had to protect her.

Similar scenes happened all around them as the people were determined to
get their loved ones out alive. Luo Yunhai formed them into ranks, and
as he stood in front of them, an old man stepped forward.

“Young master Luo, I’ll be at your side to protect you. If I am to fall,
please send my words to Grandmaster Zhuo. My greatest regret is that I
wasn’t good enough to have him as my master…” The old man shook his
head.

Zhuo Fan would have a nice dumbstruck face if he was here. Wasn’t this
old guy the same Liu Yizhen, who competed alongside Yan Song in the
Hundred Pill Meeting?

He wanted to be Zhuo Fan’s disciple, but Zhuo Fan wouldn’t hear it.

But how did he end up here then?

Luo Yunhai sighed, “Grandmaster Liu is so determined. If not for sir’s
guards, we’d have long been mere corpses on the ground. As long as we
get out alive, I will think of a way to make big brother Zhuo receive
you.”

“Thank you, young master Luo!” Grandmaster Liu nodded sadly, “Let’s talk
about this after we survive. Either way, being able to show my respect
to Grandmaster Zhuo by helping him is gratification enough.”

Luo Yunhai nodded, [Grandmaster Liu is so honest and righteous!]

Kill~!

The howls of war drew nearer. Luo Yunhai faced the enemy as the leader
of his men, waiting. When the enemy was at the hundred meter mark, he
led his own charge, “For our loved ones, charge!”

Roar!

Thunderous shouts echoed his own battle spirit and they rushed on like a
tide. The enemy was baffled at the sudden development, even as the sides
clashed.

Boom!

Their morale sank to half in a blink. As if a spear pierced the great
skies and left a massive hole, so did the force go through them like
butter.

The enemy looked dumbstruck, even the enraged Lin Xuanfeng. He was
watching speechless as the wedge formation went through his group.

[They’re a hundred against my thousand. How can we not even block their
charge?]

The wails and miserable cries rang in his ears. He looked in time to see
his men flailing their bleeding arms and leg stumps in agony. The enemy
was reaping through his men like a dragon. His men couldn’t put up even
a token of resistance and it only drove him madder.

“For goddamn sake! What use do I have for any of you if you can’t even
do this much? A bunch of damn wastes is what you all are!”

The man next to him stammered, “Young master Lin, t-this isn’t our
fault! They suddenly used military formations. They are only a hundred
but we can’t even get close to them! Each time we approach it’s like
we’re facing four or five of them! It’s baffling!”

“Humph! Whats baffling? It’s just some army tactic!” Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes
flashed eerily, “Now that I think about it, that Luo clan’s brat
followed Dugu Zhantian for five years. It’d be odd if he didn’t know at
least this much. Blast it all to hell! We can’t let Luo clan get any
stronger!”

Spatting, Lin Xuanfeng hopped and was gone. Then he flashed in front of
the wedge formation.

“Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunhai shouted.

Snickering, Lin Xuanfeng mocked, “Brat, you think you’re so great now
that you’ve been by Dugu Zhantian’s side for a couple of years? You take
me for a weakling? Think you can get away alive with just this?

“He-he-he, first I’ll break your army, then I’ll break your skull!” Lin
Xuanfeng snickered and was gone again.

Before anyone could react, he flashed in the middle of their formation
and a blue tornado sprung up. It grew until it swallowed them all,
careening them into the air and breaking the formation.

Luo Yunhai looked up from the ground in shock.

Even after Zhuo Fan ripped his leg off, Lin Xuanfeng had the power to
face so many people. He really was one of the Six Dragons and One
Phoenix, Forest Fleeting Dragon!

He broke their formation and flung them scattered among the enemy. They
were doomed!

Luo Yunhai’s heart sank, his final hope leaving him. What was left was
to wait and have their lives reaped…

Chapter 277, Breakout

August 3, 2021

<< Index (Patreon)>>

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Elitecoder

“Kill!”

The war cry signaled the enemy’s charge into the valley entrance. The
thick bloodthirst in the air was that from a stampede of enraged bulls.
The pressure was too great even for a Profound Heaven expert to hold on,
making it harder to breathe.

They all turned pale as paper. Not only was the enemy outnumbering them
many times over, but they even had the strength advantage. How were they
going to come out of this one?

Even Luo Yunhai, who alongside the four tigers saw charging armies on an
almost daily basis, was affected. Their side was at a gross
disadvantage.

Be it in terrain or numbers, none of it worked in their favor. In war
tactics, this situation could only be overcome by forcing one’s way
through if one wanted to get out alive.

His jaw set, Luo Yunhai turned to his side teetering on the verge of
collapse and shouted, “Everyone, don’t all of you have someone here you
wish to protect?”

That caught their attention. Luo Yunhai’s eyes flashed, “They may
outnumber us but they are rabble! I can help you get your loved ones out
safely. They will be in the center while we form a circle around them as
we break out of the enemy attack. We will likely lose our lives but our
loved ones will have the highest chance at survival!”

The dead eyes of his group finally sparked with a glimmer of hope.

“Brother, go in the middle, I’ll protect you!”

“Foolish child, I’m the big brother, how can I let you give your life
for me? It is my duty to keep you alive!”

“Brother…” The younger brother’s eyes glistened…

“Sister, stay close to the center and don’t fall behind!” Another
brother patted his younger sister’s shoulder.

“Brother in law, go in the middle. I’ll get you out for sure!”

“Silly boy, how can I live if you died? How will I face your sister?”
The man said to his wife’s younger brother.

…

They soon shed the fear instilled by the enemy’s war cry and their
hearts held a deep feeling of warmth, spurring on their will to fight to
the death.

Luo Yunhai nodded, grateful that his plan worked. Next up was the fight!

Looking back at the savage enemy marching over, Luo Yunhai took a deep
breath and like a true Marshal, he took in the entire battlefield to
make use of.

Zhuo Fan would be so proud if he could see this boy having grown up.

Because Luo Yunhai’s words were the right tactic for a Marshal to use in
this critical situation.

He had to kindle the will to fight in his men.

If he said something along the lines of ‘fight alongside me to survive’,
the effect would hardly be noticeable.

Everyone considered their lives as the number one priority and they made
sure to treasure it. But how could they overcome their fears in the face
of that relentless tide marching towards them?

Even if he could make them fight for their own sake, it was a flimsy
reason bound to crumble at first contact. Death would follow all the
same at this point.

But Luo Yunhai was sharp in figuring out these people had loved ones
mixed in this group. He appealed to their humanity, their conscience,
their responsibility, and drove them to war.

Although this meant cutting their effective fighting force in half, the
ones doing the protecting would give their absolute best, and more, to
make sure their loved ones lived to see tomorrow.

To instantly turn these random groups of people into a cohesive unit
bent on fighting to the death was the sign of a great general Luo Yunhai
had the hopes of becoming.

“Yunhai, stay behind me. Sister will protect you!” Xue Ningxiang’s
beaming face graced his eyes. She even flexed to back up her claim.

Luo Yunhai let out an awkward chuckle, “Ha-ha-ha, I am grateful for your
kindness, but I am the one commanding this charge. It’s more important
that I stay in front as well!”

Xue Gang and Xue Lin hoisted the overconfident, and delusional, Xue
Ningxiang behind, “Ning’er, don’t be willful. He’s stronger than you.
Listen to your brother and stay in the middle. Let your brothers get you
to safety!”

Xue Ningxiang pouted, then her eyes sparked, “Then I’ll stay behind
Yunhai. That way I can protect him when he needs help!”

Helpless, they had no choice but to agree. Behind Luo Yunhai could also
be said to belong to the center of the group, somewhat.

But Xue Gang and Xue Lin were not leaving her sides. Anything could
happen in the spur of the moment, especially on the battlefield. They
had to protect her.

Similar scenes happened all around them as the people were determined to
get their loved ones out alive. Luo Yunhai formed them into ranks, and
as he stood in front of them, an old man stepped forward.

“Young master Luo, I’ll be at your side to protect you. If I am to fall,
please send my words to Grandmaster Zhuo. My greatest regret is that I
wasn’t good enough to have him as my master…” The old man shook his
head.

Zhuo Fan would have a nice dumbstruck face if he was here. Wasn’t this
old guy the same Liu Yizhen, who competed alongside Yan Song in the
Hundred Pill Meeting?

He wanted to be Zhuo Fan’s disciple, but Zhuo Fan wouldn’t hear it.

But how did he end up here then?

Luo Yunhai sighed, “Grandmaster Liu is so determined. If not for sir’s
guards, we’d have long been mere corpses on the ground. As long as we
get out alive, I will think of a way to make big brother Zhuo receive
you.”

“Thank you, young master Luo!” Grandmaster Liu nodded sadly, “Let’s talk
about this after we survive. Either way, being able to show my respect
to Grandmaster Zhuo by helping him is gratification enough.”

Luo Yunhai nodded, [Grandmaster Liu is so honest and righteous!]

Kill~!

The howls of war drew nearer. Luo Yunhai faced the enemy as the leader
of his men, waiting. When the enemy was at the hundred meter mark, he
led his own charge, “For our loved ones, charge!”

Roar!

Thunderous shouts echoed his own battle spirit and they rushed on like a
tide. The enemy was baffled at the sudden development, even as the sides
clashed.

Boom!

Their morale sank to half in a blink. As if a spear pierced the great
skies and left a massive hole, so did the force go through them like
butter.

The enemy looked dumbstruck, even the enraged Lin Xuanfeng. He was
watching speechless as the wedge formation went through his group.

[They’re a hundred against my thousand. How can we not even block their
charge?]

The wails and miserable cries rang in his ears. He looked in time to see
his men flailing their bleeding arms and leg stumps in agony. The enemy
was reaping through his men like a dragon. His men couldn’t put up even
a token of resistance and it only drove him madder.

“For goddamn sake! What use do I have for any of you if you can’t even
do this much? A bunch of damn wastes is what you all are!”

The man next to him stammered, “Young master Lin, t-this isn’t our
fault! They suddenly used military formations. They are only a hundred
but we can’t even get close to them! Each time we approach it’s like
we’re facing four or five of them! It’s baffling!”

“Humph! Whats baffling? It’s just some army tactic!” Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes
flashed eerily, “Now that I think about it, that Luo clan’s brat
followed Dugu Zhantian for five years. It’d be odd if he didn’t know at
least this much. Blast it all to hell! We can’t let Luo clan get any
stronger!”

Spatting, Lin Xuanfeng hopped and was gone. Then he flashed in front of
the wedge formation.

“Lin Xuanfeng!” Luo Yunhai shouted.

Snickering, Lin Xuanfeng mocked, “Brat, you think you’re so great now
that you’ve been by Dugu Zhantian’s side for a couple of years? You take
me for a weakling? Think you can get away alive with just this?

“He-he-he, first I’ll break your army, then I’ll break your skull!” Lin
Xuanfeng snickered and was gone again.

Before anyone could react, he flashed in the middle of their formation
and a blue tornado sprung up. It grew until it swallowed them all,
careening them into the air and breaking the formation.

Luo Yunhai looked up from the ground in shock.

Even after Zhuo Fan ripped his leg off, Lin Xuanfeng had the power to
face so many people. He really was one of the Six Dragons and One
Phoenix, Forest Fleeting Dragon!

He broke their formation and flung them scattered among the enemy. They
were doomed!

Luo Yunhai’s heart sank, his final hope leaving him. What was left was
to wait and have their lives reaped…

Chapter 278, - Void Annihilation’s Power

Chapter 278, Void Annihilation’s Power

Ah!

The cries of agony pierced the skies as the enemy began its slaughter.
With their formation broken and outnumbered ten to one, their hopes of
surviving were dashed. Just like a mouse squeezed around by a mighty
dragon.

Their will to fight had collapsed, replaced by utter despair.

Luo Yunhai gnashed his teeth and got onto his feet. He wanted to
reorganize his ranks. He wasn’t about to give up as long as there was an
inkling of hope.

But as soon as he got to his feet, he was kicked flying, with blood
flowing from his lips.

Coughing blood, Luo Yunhai glared at the cocky and snickering Lin
Xuanfeng, “He-he-he, brat, you’re finished! So behave and wait there for
me to take your head and present it to Zhuo Fan. I wonder what face
he’ll make, ha-ha-ha… “

“Humph, let’s see you try! You think the next time he’ll stop at one
leg?” Luo Yunhai retorted in mockery.

Lin Xuanfeng’s mood sank dangerously low.

His life was smooth sailing, the pride of Merry Woods. No one ever
showed any disrespect to someone of his talent. Then he met Zhuo Fan,
and everything spiraled out of control, him becoming a laughing stock.

His leg was ripped off and hence he suffered endless ridicule that had
affected his state of mind to such a degree that it had cast a shadow
over him. Not even he wanted to admit such a disgrace happened to him.

And yet Luo Yunhai went on poking his sore spot, earning his wrath,
“Damn punk! You think we can’t deal with that Zhuo Fan? Humph, let me
tell you, we’ve long been ready to end him. He’s living on borrowed
time. You’re the first to go and the bastard will soon follow you to
your grave!”

Lin Xuanfeng lifted his Yuan Qi soaked palm, winding up for the finale.

Luo Yunhai was worried, his fists clenched, but not over his safety. It
was for Zhuo Fan’s.

He sensed from Lin Xuanfeng’s tone that those words weren’t empty
threats. They may very well have grasped Zhuo Fan’s weakness. He had to
warn Zhuo Fan before it was too late.

How was he going to do that though, when he was too powerless to even
protect himself?

Luo Yunhai’s inner conflict left him in a mess.

Lin Xuanfeng took it as fear, “Ha-ha-ha, here I thought you’d be a man
of courage having followed Dugu Zhantian for years, but deep down,
you’re just a spineless coward. Don’t worry, I’ll leave your corpse
intact, out of respect for Dugu Zhantian.”

Lin Xuanfeng launched his palm attack like a fierce storm.

“Stop! No one can harm the Luo clan’s young master!” An aged voice
shouted, just as a red hot flame shot for Lin Xuanfeng.

Lin Xuanfeng only snickered.

Liu Yizhen came to the rescue, with his 4th level spiritual beast flame.

But his flame looked nothing more than a candle to Lin Xuanfeng, “You
senile old fool dare mess in my affairs? Get lost!”

Thump!

A flick of the hand had a blue wind scatter the flimsy flame to nothing.
Liu Yizhen spat blood and collapsed, pale.

Grinning, Lin Xuanfeng turned to Luo Yunhai, “No one’s gonna save you
now!”

“Stop!”

It was a delicate voice this time. Xue Ningxiang popped out of nowhere
and stood between them, “You’ll have to go through me first!”

“You again!”

Squinting, he clearly recalled Xue Ningxiang shouting cripple left and
right, “Humph, don’t you worry. Once I’m through with him, you’re next!”

“Ning’er!”

Xue Gang and Xue Lin rushed over but Lin Xuanfeng’s flick of the hand
left them sprawling and heavily wounded.

With a twisted smile, a promise of cruelty that was to come, Lin
Xuanfeng’s Yuan Qi exploded, “And stay down!”

“Humph, we won’t die. Big brother Zhuo will save us!” Xue Ningxiang
faced him without an ounce of fear.

Lin Xuanfeng jerked, looking around frantic, “Zhuo Fan, where? Is he
close?”

Xue Ningxiang laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, how the mighty have fallen. I knew
you’re scared of big brother Zhuo!”

Luo Yunhai shook his head.

Apparently, Zhuo Fan did more than simply pull a leg. He had also
scarred the guy mentally!

“You damn brat dare to lie to me! Zhuo Fan would never stand still in
this situation if he was here!” Lin Xuanfeng’s anger flared. Two brats
got the best of the grand and mighty Forest Fleeting Dragon. They had
scared him just by mentioning Zhuo Fan. He would never hear the end of
it if word got out.

Lin Xuanfeng’s eyes looked at Xue Ningxiang with bloodthirst, wishing
nothing more than to wring her pretty neck, “Blasted bint! You two’ve
been a pain in my rear from the moment we met!”

Lin Xuanfeng’s hand was wrapped in a blue wind and slapped at Xue
Ningxiang’s chest.

Luo Yunhai was too hurt to try and stop him. He could only watch the
sinister palm inching towards Xue Ningxiang’s chest.

“Big brother Zhuo!”

Xue Ningxiang cried, her eyes focussed on the dead Thunder Ring. Then
she closed her eyes and prayed for a miracle.

Luo Yunhai could only sigh. Zhuo Fan was no god. It was impossible for
him to watch over her around the clock like a guardian angel.

Xue Gang and Xue Lin crawled on while bleeding in a desperate attempt to
reach her. Why was their foolish sister so zealous in her faith? The
last two times were sheer coincidences.

[Zhuo Fan won’t always watch over you when you need him the most. So why
are you so stubborn?]

Lin Xuanfeng laughed, “Zhuo Fan won’t come brat! Die, ha-ha-ha… “

Though clueless, their entire drama was laid before Zhuo Fan’s eyes two
miles out thanks to his soul sense.

He saw how Xue Ningxiang and Luo Yunhai were together and he also saw
Lin Xuanfeng’s strike closing in on them.

Zhuo Fan’s right eye flashed with two golden halos and an invisible beam
shot out, passing through any and all obstacles, straight for its
target.

Divine Eye of the Void’s 2nd stage, Void Annihilation.

Whoosh!

It shot fast as light, passing through everything like they were
nothing.

In the middle of the slaughter, a hum became apparent as a sudden hole
appeared on the men in its path without any warning.

Blood flowed even as the men were oblivious to their doom. It was just
too fast, too sudden.

Lin Xuanfeng’s hand was inches from Xue Ningxiang when the hum passed,
robbing him of his hand. It left behind a bleeding stump.

Lin Xuanfeng was too dumbstruck to even react.

[W-what was that? Why is my hand gone?] He didn’t even feel a thing. One
moment it was there, and poof, gone the next. It was faster than getting
it chopped off.

Xue Ningxiang and Luo Yunhai were equally baffled.

Lin Xuanfeng stiffly looked around to see a line of men with oddly
missing parts of their bodies, bleeding out.

Looking further, he saw a hole in the valley’s side, black as night.
Zhuo Fan used Void Annihilation from two miles away to rob his hand and
anything in its path.

It was an all powerful ability able to target anyone regardless of
distance!

Zhuo Fan’s enemies would never know rest if they knew he possessed such
divine might. Or the moment they drop their guard, their chest would
sport a sudden extra large hole!

Not that Lin Xuanfeng knew that. He only looked at the black hole in
dread. [This is too freaky! What the hell was that? Who could possibly
kill so many men in a blink?]

It even exceeded Forest Fleeting Dragon’s reaction and robbed him off
his hand! What kind of godly skill was that?

In the middle of their shock and despair, Zhuo Fan used his Yuan Qi to
shout, “God damn it, Lin Xuanfeng! You dare touch my people, you
bastard? Don’t move a muscle, I’ll be right there to rip your head off
myself!”

His yell passed through the black hole and into the valley, so loud it
even quaked mountains.

It was as if the two mountains spoke. Such awe-inspiring power scared
everyone present into freezing and paling.

[Are the mountains threatening us?]

[Balls! Did our battle wake up a local god?]

Only Lin Xuanfeng recognized the voice. He shook like a leaf. He would
never forget the owner of that voice in his life, the same Soaring
Demonic Dragon who ripped off his leg…

Chapter 279 - Godlike

Chapter 279 - Godlike

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Elitecoder

The silence was deafening.

The unanimous reaction to this ludicrous situation was one of utter
shock and amazement. Then they all started shivering, Lin Xuanfeng
included.

Their eyes turned to the shaking mountains, words stuck in their throat.

Only Luo Yunhai and Xue Ningxiang were happy. Ever since the shout came,
they knew with utmost certainty that Zhuo Fan had come through for them!

“Uh, young master Lin…”

The man next to Lin Xuanfeng began speaking, wanting to ask for
suggestion as to their next course of action, only to notice that the
dude had bolted.

[Rotten useless Lin Xuanfeng! Who was it that shouted the loudest while
charging? Who was it that cursed us as good for nothing?] And yet, when
it came to running, no one was faster.

[I spit on you! How can such a yellow-bellied lily-livered rat be in the
Six Dragons and One Phoenix?]

The man looked around to find everyone loosing their will to fight. It
was only natural when one stopped and thought about the monster coming
to Luo clan’s rescue, the same freak who scared Lin Xuanfeng away.

[So why should we stay here, to die?]

Without further ado, he shouted, “Retreat!”

Roused up, the men followed behind Lin Xuanfeng without any complaint.

The winning side from a moment ago, was now running away miserably. They
even forwent their wounded, selfishly holding their lives as the number
one priority.

Luo Yunhai sighed, “Big brother Zhuo is amazing to the extreme. One
shout is enough to scare them away. It’s even more effective than our
wedge formation.”

Xue Ningxiang nodded cutely, her eyes blazing! She hadn’t even seen his
figure, yet Zhuo Fan’s valor and might thoroughly turned her into his
number one fan.

Xue Gang and Xue Lin shook their heads. Zhuo Fan’s timely save was more
than welcome, but that sister of theirs sank even deeper into her
unhealthy obsession of him.

No doubt about it, Xue Ningxiang’s belief that Zhuo Fan would be there
to save her every single time was now firmly engraved into the very core
of her being.

This delusion was far from healthy.

Her brothers shook their helpless heads.

Ning’er hadn’t once listened to their advice so far, and the repeated
near saves, courtesy of Zhuo Fan, only worked to make her go against
them even more…

Ha~

The two sighed…

Then they followed up with the usual glee of finding their lease on life
extended and looked after the wounded. Fifteen minutes later, a
thunderclap signaled the landing of a black figure.

They were greeted by none other than Soaring Demonic Dragon, Zhuo Fan!

Surveying the battlefield, Zhuo Fan cursed, “That blasted Lin Xuanfeng
ran again! The next time he won’t be so lucky. I’ll make sure to pull
his other leg and get him to crawl like a beggar!”

The people were scared, but the reverence was obvious from their
expressions.

Of Tianyu’s youngest generation, only Soaring Demonic Dragon dared
challenge Six Dragons and One Phoenix. If it were them, not in a million
years would they even conceive such a radical and preposterous idea, not
to mention suicidal.

It only made them see Zhuo Fan in a new light, holding him in complete
admiration.

This was a truly fearless man, a man of courage and endless valor!

Ignoring these peasants, Zhuo Fan’s eyes snapped to Xue Ningxiang and
Luo Yunhai in glee, “Are you alright?”

Xue Ningxiang shook her head, bashful, “Don’t worry, big brother Zhuo,
I’m fine. I knew you’d come and save me!”

She then touched her Thunder Ring.

Zhuo Fan chuckled and waved, as the Thunder Ring on his own hand
glinted.

“Big brother Zhuo, Grandmaster Liu already gave me a healing pill. I’ll
soon be back to full health.” Luo Yunhai smiled with a pale face.

Raising an eyebrow, Zhuo Fan turned to the old man, “Grandmaster Liu?”

“Ha-ha-ha, Grandmaster Zhuo, it’s been a long time!” Liu Yizhen bowed.

Zhuo Fan was puzzled, “What are you doing here? Didn’t Esoteric Debate
have the 30 years age ban? Grandmaster Liu, how old are you really?”

“Uh, Grandmaster Zhuo I am not a participant, nor did I know Beast King
Mountain was to be the location for the Esoteric Debate’s final battle.
It was pure coincidence!” Liu Yizhen explained.

Sizing him up, Zhuo Fan was very much doubtful still, “Really now?”

“Honest to god. It must be fate for me and Grandmaster Zhuo to meet
again!” Liu Yizhen’s genial response came.

Zhuo Fan snickered, “Oh please, cut the act. What fate could possibly be
tying us?”

Liu Yizhen hanged his head.

Luo Yunhai interjected, “Big brother Zhuo, we were lucky to have
Grandmaster Liu here or many more would’ve perished. He is Luo clan’s
benefactor. I heard he is very eager to take you as his master, what
if…”

“Liu Yizhen, it’s been so long yet you’re still dead set on this idea?”
Zhuo Fan cut him off with a stare on Liu Yizhen.

Liu Yizhen nodded furiously, “Yes. Grandmaster Zhuo’s alchemy is the
pinnacle among all the alchemists I’ve seen. To be your disciple is my
lifelong wish!”

“In that case…”

Zhuo Fan squinted, “Fine. We are short on hands and your timely arrival
is most welcome. If you can protect the Luo clan in this Esoteric
Debate, I will be inclined to reconsider your request, in favor of your
rendered services.”

“I will do my very best and live up to Grandmaster Zhuo’s expectations!”
Liu Yizhen bowed.

Zhuo Fan nodded.

Luo Yunhai was thrilled and cupped his hand to Liu Yizhen, while also
gleeful that he managed to sway Zhuo Fan.

Liu Yizhen replied in kind, grateful to him for making the cold Zhuo Fan
as seven years ago give him some attention.

In this manner, Liu Yizhen joined the Luo clan, looking after the
wounded. Since Zhuo Fan had nothing to do, he stood guard at the valley
entrance.

It was because of this man that the men could heal in peace.

Soaring Demonic Dragon was on par with the Six Dragons and One Phoenix.
There was no one out there who could make them feel safer.

Zhuo Fan stood guard for ten days, waiting for the others to heal…

But while the battle on this side ended, another was on the brink of
erupting.

In a lush part of the forest, a towering jade reaching the hight of two
people was standing next to a large tree. Upon a closer look, it bore a
striking resemblance to those National Elemental Stones. It was
precisely the wood type array to send them back.

On either side of it were two armed forces.

On one hand was Drifting Flowers Edifices’ Chu Qingcheng, Sword Marquise
Abode’ Xie Tianshang and Veiled Dragon Pavilion’s Long Xingyun with
their people. The other side was led by Regent Estate’s Huangpu
Qingtian, Hell Valley’s You Yushan, and Pill King Hall’s Yan Bangui.

All they needed was a spark to throw this place into the chaos of war.

Their standoff was clearly visible beyond the wood exit array, as Dragon
Cloud City’s every major clan and house watched in trepidation.

Huangpu Tianyuan snickered, speaking high and mighty yet casually at the
same time. “The Brimming Sacred Pill will be ours. No surprise there,
ha-ha-ha!”

You Wanshan and Yan Bogong nodded in pride.

[It feels so good, so overbearing, to stand by Regent Estate!]

Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion, and Sword Marquise
Abode’s house leader looked like they were on pensive. They had no
choice but to admit the battle was going to be completely one sided.
Huangpu Qingtian’s presence alone turned the tide of this battle out of
their favor.

The Brimming Sacred Pill was before the wood exit, and it was Chu
Qingcheng’s group who found it first. Yet none realized Huangpu
Qingtian’s faction tailing them.

The fight over the Brimming Sacred Pill was on the brink of igniting,
but their faction had no hope of overcoming the other, not with
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord in the mix.

“Damn monster!”

Grandmother gnashed her teeth, while Huangpu Tianyuan laughed
unrestrained.

Zhuge Changfeng was only twirling his mustache in thought, “Indeed. One
side has a freak of nature, while the other’s side own monster has yet
to come. Things don’t bode well for them. Surrender is advised.”

That got a rise out of the crowd.

[Yeah, Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord is there and Zhuo Fan is no where in
sight!] From what they heard of the two monster’s first contact, Zhuo
Fan could hold his own against Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord.

But where was their most important piece at this crucial time?

The people started to regret. [What ally is he if he doesn’t show up
when needed?]

Achoo~!

Facing the morning sun, Zhuo Fan was struck by an incomprehensible bout
of sneezing that sent his whole body shivering.

“What the hell? Who’s the bastard talking behind my back?” Zhuo Fan
rubbed his nose in anger…

Chapter 280 - The Power of One

Chapter 280, The Power of One

Tap~

Huangpu Qingtian’s every step instilled dignity and nobility, neither
forced nor rushed. Chu Qingcheng’s group was unnerved, taking steps back
in contrast.

The pressure was so big, each of his step made them back away faster.

Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion, and Sword Marquise
Abode had thousands of people behind them, yet faced with but a single
man, they all shirked further back. A truly laughable and ridiculous
scene.

Yet to the parties involved, humor was the last thing on their minds.
When faced with the head of Six Dragons and One Phoenix, Huangpu
Qingtian, all they could feel was fear and dread.

You Yushan and Yan Bangui had thousands behind them as well that just
stood there, watching the other faction with contempt.

In the face of Huangpu Qingtian, anyone would end up a sorry sight.

If they switched places, You Yushan’s group had no doubt in their mind
they would end up the same way.

As to why the situation devolved in such a way, it all came down to Chu
Qingcheng’s group’s rotten luck. Or maybe having known so little about
Regent Estate, yet insisting on making an enemy out of them…

“How long are you going to shirk back?” Huangpu Qingtian stopped at some
point, with a beaming and noble smile, “Hand over the Brimming Sacred
Pill and I’ll let you go.”

Frowning, Chu Qingcheng gnashed her teeth in silence. Her allies
clenched her fists at the naked scorn.

Handing over what the three houses found was total humiliation.

Long Xingyun muled, [It’s best we’re flexible.] And smiled, “Young
master Huangpu, is this how Regent Estate’s eldest young master carries
himself? You’re no different from a shameless bandit at this point.
There are four Brimming Sacred Pill out there so why are you after ours
in particular?”

“Ha-ha-ha, Long Xingyun, I knew you’re a smooth talker, preaching
sophistry. True, Regent Estate isn’t too keen on robbing you, but did
you forget? This here is the Esoteric Debate, where might makes right.
Everything belongs to the strongest!”

With a snicker, Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes flashed with greed and snatched
at the air, “That is why all of them will be mine. You better hand it
over now, or…”

“Or what, fight?”

Xie Tianshang snapped as he shot in the air, drawing his sword and
releasing such shocking energy it reached the skies. The sword energy
shuddered all who looked at it, feeling as if ten thousands swords were
about to pierce them.

Even Yan Bangui and You Yushan turned serious, eying him with a sigh.

[Xie Tianshang is a true sword talent.] It was their first time seeing
sword energy reaching such a level.

Thinking about it, they were no match for him in a straight out fight.

Long Xingyun looked at the hovering figure stunned. [It had been what, a
few days? How did he get so strong?]

And yet…

Huangpu Qingtian’s calm demeanor left Long Xingyun sighing.

[Compared to this monster, Xie Tianshang had a long way to go.]

But even so, they had to fight regardless.

Long Xingyun shot his hands forward. Energy hummed off his hands and
released a powerful attack.

There was a dragon roar echo and when the energy was upon Huangpu
Qingtian, it shot for the ground.

The earth beneath Huangpu Qingtian exploded as a dragon opened its maw
to swallow him.

“Profound ranked martial art, Sea Upturning Dragon Palm!” Long Xingyun
roared.

He didn’t finish as a loud boom splintered the huge dragon into
nothingness. Huangpu Qingtian shined golden as he walked out of the
attack, looking down on all creation.

Pff!

Long Xingyun coughed blood, having just been injured internally.

Xie Tianshang clutched his sword and shot for Huangpu Qingtian. The
piercing light of his sword tip was as dazzling as the night’s stars.

It pulverized anything it touched and left only this outstanding light.

This was Sword Marquise Abode’s profound ranked martial art Flowing
Space’s Nine Forms’ strongest attack, Extinction.

When this sword flew, everything was erased!

Abode Lord Xie Xiaofeng watched in awe and pride, his house’s strongest
move being unleashed just beyond the wood National Elemental Stone.

The son had surpassed the father.

With how much stronger the move was than his own, he was certain his son
would become an even more remarkable Abode Lord than himself.

Huangpu Tianyuan mocked, “Abode Lord Xie, to be so prideful of your
son’s meager achievements, aren’t you perhaps thinking so little of
him?”

Xie Xiaofeng snorted, “I know of Regent Estate’s eldest young master’s
godlike talent, but I’ll have to say that not even he can take this
attack without consequence.”

“Oh? We shall see.” Grinned Huangpu Tianyuan, and his elders joined him
in mocking the man.

Xie Xiaofeng’s heart seized in fright, turning to see the shocking scene
beyond the wood stone.

As the glaring sword attack came closer, Huangpu Qingtian merely pointed
at the dazzling dot of light.

Boom!

The space cracked and seemed to have been torn open. A bright golden
light met with the sword attack, swallowing it whole.

The almighty sword attack, crumbled under the finger’s power and forced
Xie Tianshang into a bout of spitting blood. He was on his knees, even
if having received but a light wound.

“H-how?” Xie Xiaofeng cried.

Huangpu Tianyuan laughed, “Abode Lord Xie, I told you, my son’s talent
is in a league of its own. Speaking of power, he has surpassed his
father since five years ago!”

[Say what?!]

They were still trying to process this development yet now they found
Huangpu Qingtian had long since surpassed the current Estate Lord?

It was a known fact that Regent Estate had the best talents in Tianyu,
capable of holding their own if it ever came to face the other six
houses. Huangpu Tianyuan was of an even greater talent and a peak
Profound Heaven cultivator as well. That made him the strongest Profound
Heaven cultivator in Tianyu.

Yet here he was stating Huangpu Qingtian surpassed him since five years
ago. Even more so when that Huangpu Qingtian wasn’t even at peak
Profound Heaven Stage.

Now that he was at peak Profound Heaven Stage and mastered killing with
intent, did that mean he could face a Radiant Stage expert?

[H-how on earth can one beat that?]

The faces of others sank as they cursed this rotten monster.

Huangpu Tianyuan looked awfully proud standing there, but his heart was
bleeding, cursing his monster of a son as well. It was this monstrous
talent that threatened his Estate Lord position.

It may very well come to be that once the Esoteric Debate was over, his
son would be entitled in his demand for him to hand over his throne.
That was one outcome he never hoped to see.

It went so far that he even hoped his son would die at Zhuo Fan’s hands.

Of course, there was no way he’d be so open as to share his thoughts.
Huangpu Qingtian was the hope of all Venerables, if not the entire
Regent Estate.

Any that dared to even show a hint of dissatisfaction with him would be
culled on the spot, Estate Lord included. The Venerables would make sure
of that.

Huangpu Qingtian was the apple of Regent Estate, their hope for the
future. And they weren’t about to let it be snuffed out!

Huangpu Tianyuan looked on at the prideful and imperial figure beyond
the wood National Elemental Stone with killing intent.

…

Huangpu Qingtian put his finger away and laughed at the kneeling Xie
Tianshang, “Ha-ha-ha, how amusing. Who knew you could grow so strong in
such a short time? You’re way stronger than those two behind me. Pledge
yourself to me and you won’t regret it!”

They all looked shocked. This was daylight talent ‘robbery’!

“He-he-he, I am from Sword Marquise Abode. It is not my choice who our
allies are!” Xie Tianshang laughed, happy Huangpu Qingtian was finally
giving him some time of day.

Huangpu Qingtian shook his head, “Stubborn fool! Whether the seven
houses or the whole world, it will be ours! Those old geezers will soon
find themselves between four walls and six feet under. Why would you
care about their decisions? Just agree and the entire Sword Marquise
Abode will agree as well. “

Huangpu Qingtian turned to Chu Qingcheng and Long Xingyun, “You two as
well. Swear yourself to me and the Esoteric Debate will end here and
now. The seven houses will be eternally one!”

Not just Chu Qingcheng’s group was shocked, but even Dragon Cloud City’s
side’s clan elders watched Huangpu Qingtian incredulous.

It was the leader of a clan that made decisions, not their top disciple.

Yet this Huangpu Qingtian not only circumvented his Estate Lord, but
even spat in the face of the rest of those geezers. This was a gross
lack of respect, a power play and disregard for the others above his
station.

This was something no one, not even young masters of other houses, would
dare to utter.

Yet Huangpu Qingtian did this out in the open. He didn’t even care that
he was stealing his father’s position.

They all turned to see Huangpu Tianyuan’s face ashen from anger. While
the elders couldn’t care less. They even nodded!

At that point, people realized that this was perhaps the true power of a
monarch…
