Chapter 289 - The Second Pill’s Location

Chapter 289, The Second Pill’s Location

“Report!”

A shout caught their attention. A man was rushing over sweaty and in
ragged garments.

He fell to one knee before them, “Y-young masters, we have found the
second Brimming Sacred Pill’s location.”

“Eh?” They all perked up. Zhuo Fan’s advice did the trick but even so,
they were still yearning to go out there and get the pill themselves.

Was it that easy to just let this chance pass by? It held the promise of
getting a new Radiant Stage expert in their house and increase their
power significantly.

Then came their united reply, “Where?”

“Fifty miles out, Killing Blood Marsh!” The man cupped his hands. He
truly rendered a service worthy of a reward, “Five days ago, we were
tasked with finding young master Zhuo. By happenstance, we stumbled into
a vial of Brimming Sacred Pill in that place. Whether a coincidence or
not, the pill is now deep in the nest of a 3rd level spiritual beast,
Blood Croc. We opted to report rather than risk our lives.”

Blood Croc?

That put a damp on their joyous moods.

The Blood Croc was a pack spiritual beast, and very territorial. Despite
a mere 3rd level spiritual beast, their numbers deterred even a Radiant
Stage expert from approaching.

The easiest way to establish their strength was to look at how big this
nest was.

Long Xingyun spoke, “How many?”

“Oh, forgive my forgetfulness. It is around thirty thousand heads!” The
man stammered.

Sss~

The shock was easily seen on everyone’s faces.

Thirty thousand Blood Crocs. Not even ten Radiant Stage experts or a
hundred Profound Heaven experts could come out unharmed out of such a
scuffle. Least of all their rabble of two-three thousand men.

The instant they charged, the Blood Crocs would tear them to pieces.

Thus they all turned their heads to Zhuo Fan to see his take on this.

The man in question was eerily calm, dissing the trouble with a wave,
“Lead the way.”

“Brother Zhuo, you can do it?” They looked on in hope.

With a vague smile, Zhuo Fan was playing coy, “Ha-ha-ha, we’ll know when
we get there.”

And proceeded to walk southwest. Being all mysterious worked, making the
rest follow him in shock.

No wonder a puny and forgotten Luo clan reached such a height. This guy
was overpowered. He always came through despite adversities.

Luo Yunhai, Xue Ningxiang and the hundred people Zhuo Fan brought
followed him the instant he made a move. For the first two it was an
obvious choice, as for the hundred people, vassals to different houses,
they went after Zhuo Fan like sheep after a shepherd.

Besides, what difference would it make if they were behind Luo clan when
the houses they were vassals to were all allies? [You should at least go
with your master even if so!]

They couldn’t help it though, not when Zhuo Fan was a beacon of safety,
willing to follow him everywhere with unflinching determination.

Too bad the lucky Luo clan had yet to become a house, or these guys
would’ve switched camps on the spot.

“The kid is taking everyone from us. I can already see how the Esoteric
Debate ends. With half of our vassals willing to follow Luo clan.” Long
Xingyun sighed.

Xie Tianshang shrugged, “That’s how charisma works. Be it a mighty
emperor or just a clan head, they all have to have some amount of
personal magnetism. We all do! But in Zhuo Fan’s case, while ours is but
a mere glint, his shines like a radiant star!”

Xie Tianshang followed closely as well. Long Xingyun chuckled right
behind him. Chu Qingcheng thoughtfully watched the prideful and solitary
figure in front before coming too.

The wood exit was soon barren of people, all going for the Killing Blood
Marsh.

The audience beyond the wood National Elemental Stone found the
entertainment waning and returned to the seats Dugu Zhantian provided.

All while speculating how Zhuo Fan managed to relieve Huangpu Qingtian
of the pill.

It was clear by his appearance that no blows were traded, so how…

The man in question was now taking a stroll. Perhaps the exhaustion of
the past few days never left him and only made him grow weary,
culminating in this slow pace.

Yet it only worked to put Long Xingyun’s group on edge. They were
itching to get to the Killing Blood Swamp first. It was funny how the
Esoteric Debate of this century had been reduced to an 8th grade pill
hunt.

Zhuo Fan was not in the least bit hurried, taking his sweet time. While
he was at it, he had the others scout the surroundings as they made
their way forward.

The way he saw it, Brimming Sacred Pill was merely a reward to the
winner of this final battle. It made little sense to look for it when
the exits and keys held a far greater importance.

With them on his hands, he had to find a way out, especially for a
certain useless bunch. It just so happened to be working fabulously in
easing his burden too.

So he toned down on his speed, using this time to have the rest search
for the keys. Long Xingyun’s group found it incomprehensible. They
wished nothing more than to charge in and get that 8th grade pill.

“Big brother Zhuo, I found a key!” Xue Ningxiang skipped over in glee,
presenting a red crystal.

Zhuo Fan saw the fist sized red crystal. It was cold to the touch,
telling him this was the yin key of the fire exit.

All he had to do now was find the yang fire key and Xue Ningxiang would
be home free!

Leaving him room to go all out to his heart’s content.

Zhuo Fan brightened and patted her cute head, “Well done, Ning’er!”

Xue Ningxiang giggled, at which Long Xingyun sighed, “Miss Xue, finding
a Brimming Sacred Pill would be so much better. You won’t just be doing
a great service to us houses, but even hold youself in favor!”

Zhuo Fan merely shook his head. Xue Ningxiang would have none of that,
“Humph, I won’t even go for some mystical pill. That’s your delusion. I
only care about what big brother Zhuo wants!”

Shuddering, Zhuo Fan looked queerly at her.

He never said what was on his mind even after being in contact for the
past few days, yet Ning’er easily found out what he wanted. While not
even his allies could, this genial and harmless lass…

Long Xingyun shook his head, “Miss Ning’er, you’re wrong. With how
strong Brother Zhuo is, why would he want a bunch of keys? Only cowards
would look for a way out. While a man of virtue like Brother Zhuo must
be far more interested in the Brimming Sacred Pill. Am I right?”

Long Xingyun turned to Zhuo Fan, talking as if it was the norm.

[Damn you, of course I want the keys to dump your sorry asses. Stop
mooching off of me! Only Ning’er truly knows what I want.]

Zhuo Fan cursed inside, but couldn’t refute Long Xingyun’s bright smile.

[Maybe for my reputation’s sake, or they’d go calling me coward instead.
If I explain it, they’ll think I’d be a hindrance and affect our
alliance.]

Zhuo Fan could only nod, “Yes, brother Long makes perfect sense.
Brimming Sacred Pill is far more important than some keys. “

Long Xingyun looked smug and taunted Xue Ningxiang with his eyebrow. She
was saddened on the spot, looking at Zhuo like a kicked puppy, “I still
think I’m right. Big brother Zhuo wants…”

“Uh, Ning’er, don’t feel sad. The thing is this key…” Zhuo Fan was
frantic in his explanation, but then stopped. A yellow light aimed for
his face tended to do that.

Zhuo Fan easily caught it and found it to have the same feel as the red
crystal, albeit yellow. Zhuo Fan was overjoyed, “The yin metal key!”

Zhuo Fan turned to look from where the crystal came. [Who did me such
great service? Explain!]

But Zhuo Fan twisted his head away awkwardly soon after.

Chu Qingcheng bore her cold haze into him, coming over to Xue Ningxiang
and taking her somewhere, “Come, let’s go after the other keys!”

“But big brother Zhuo said he doesn’t want them!”

“Stop paying attention to his hypocrisies!” Chu Qingcheng snorted.

Zhuo Fan felt a cold shiver, [There’s two of them now who can understand
me!] Long Xingyun was watching the two women perplexed, “That’s odd.
It’s normal for a naive girl like Ning’er to mistake Brother Zhuo’s
intentions. But Edifice Lord Chu is a refined and ambitious woman, so
why is she wasting time looking as well?”

“Ha-ha-ha, you’re asking me?” Zhuo Fan let out a dry laugh, masking the
sigh in his heart.

He was your typical lone wolf, with hardly anyone catching on to his
thinking. But now two women showed up at the same time defying all
logic.

[Is this the legendary bosom buddy?]

A chuckle escaped his lips. He, a cold-stone demonic cultivator, was
oblivious to matters of the fairer sex as a close friend and yet, [This
feeling ain’t bad. Ain’t bad at all.]

Zhuo Fan resumed walking for the Killing Blood Marsh, leaving a puzzled
Long Xingyun behind.

What should have taken five days, thanks to Zhuo Fan taking it easy,
they arrived after ten. But not for nothing, considering the riches he
fetched along the way. Of the ten total keys, they found four, with the
metal key the only complete one. All that was left was to look for the
metal exit.

Be that as it may, the slow march had its downside. Someone beat them to
it…

Chapter 290 - Acting Commander

Chapter 290, Acting Commander

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Elitecoder

A sudden red sandy beach spread out for miles and miles. All they could
see beyond red, was more red. And what made it worse was the queasy
feeling when the smell wafted into their noses.

This was the lair of the 3rd level spiritual beast, Blood Croc.

This beast left their lair in packs to hunt, then dragged their quarry
back to mangle and feast on their kill. This made for a gory sight as
well as the endless gushing blood. This led to their domain soaked in
red and made impossible for anything else to grow.

Hence the name Killing Blood Marsh.

The group looked amazed, certain this place was the lair of Blood Crocs.
What was truly baffling was in fact the lack of Blood Crocs on their way
here. Not to mention they took their time.

With a frown, Long Xingyun voiced his doubt at the scout, “Did you
actually see any Blood Croc here, or even the Brimming Sacred Pill?”

“Yes, young master Long. I’d never lie to you. When I got here earlier I
saw thousands of Blood Croc and even caught a glimpse of a vial in their
midst.” The man pointed.

Long Xingyun believed him and pressed on after a quick look at the
others.

But they soon had to stop again and shudder. Their faces grew grave and
their eyes revealed shock.

[What’s this monster doing here?]

They were at the edge of a sunken area, with a familiar figure in its
center. Despite looking at his back, they had no trouble recognizing
him.

“Too slow. I’ve been waiting here for ages!” Huangpu Qingtian made a
show out of turning around and directed a snicker Zhuo Fan’s way, “I’ll
let you hog the first pill, for now. But the second one is mine,
ha-ha-ha…”

The faces of everyone sank. [Does that mean the second pill already
landed in Huangpu Qingtian’s hands?]

[How did he find out? He knew our objective and waited us out?]

[Is there a spy among us?]

The horror of the situation dawned on them. In this perilous area, any
internal conflict would have devastating repercussions.

With a mole within their midst, the dangers would grow exponentially.

All of them started looking at their neighbor with a critical eye and
became on guard. Any trust they had had gone up in smoke.

The tri-house alliance was on the verge of crumbling.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan said, “There’s no need to doubt. It was I who told
him.”

“You?!”

Xie Tianshang was the first to complain and looked at him with thirst
for battle, “Why?”

Rolling his eyes, Xie Tianyang provided the explanation, “Big brother,
that’s him talking nonsense. With him being the strongest, if he wanted
to be a spy, he’d have done it from the start. Why waste time with this
convoluted ploy?”

“Uh, then…” Xie Tianshang didn’t get it.

Luo Yunhai chuckled, “Big brother Zhuo is trying to say that doubting
each other will be buying into the enemy’s trap and make us weaker. We
will talk later about the spy matter. Now it’s time for all of us to
unite and fight!”

They all nodded and attached greater importance to Luo clan.

The sinister and deceitful Zhuo Fan wasn’t the only one with a full
grasp of the situation. Luo clan’s future Clan Head was also wise. He
lived up to his name as the fifth godson of Dugu Zhantian.

Taking this into account, Luo clan’s rise was imminent!

The three houses’ top disciples nodded in praise as well. Although the
Luo clan had ridiculous growth over the years, so much so they felt
scared, they were nonetheless eager to see what would become of this
fledgling clan.

In the eyes of the crowd, the clan head and servant glowed with
unprecedented brightness…

“Big brother Zhuo, something’s off here!” Luo Yunhai glanced at his
surroundings as he whispered to Zhuo Fan, “This place is prone to
ambushes. We need to be extra cautious.”

Nodding, Zhuo Fan gave the area a once over, “In your eyes, how do you
think they’ll do it?”

“A frontal assault with a pincer move, followed by an ambush from
behind.” Luo Yunhai’s eyes were firm, convinced of seeing through the
other’s scheme.

Zhuo Fan smiled, “You’ve learned well from that old geezer. You haven’t
let me down. You and your team deal with the back ambush while I will
handle the front. “

Zhuo Fan then shot forth with a calm look.

Luo Yunhai was startled then nodded.

He knew the frontal assault was the enemy’s main force. What Zhuo Fan
chose was the hardest and most dangerous mission.

Then again, recalling Zhuo Fan’s dreaded power and mystical abilities,
Luo Yunhai set his mind at ease.

“Where is Zhuo Fan going?”

Xie Tianshang was left clueless, as were many others. He was about to
chase when Luo Yunhai stopped him, “I ask of you all to listen to my
orders, lest we be routed!”

After the shock subsided, they looked at him in derision.

They all admired Luo Yunhai, but not to the point they’d be in awe of
this young man who lacked the almighty power Zhuo Fan had.

Which among these future house lords would ever let a runt tell them
what to do?

If there was anyone from Luo clan who they’d ever accept, it would be
Zhuo Fan! But letting a tyke boss them around?

Humph!

All he got was snorts.

Luo Yunhai’s face grew grave, knowing there was nothing else he could
do. Every aspect of him, be it experience or power, lacked in making
these houses’ geniuses trust him, let alone listening to him.

But it was at this crucial moment a cold, yet charming, voice echoed,
“Is it Zhuo Fan’s decision?”

Luo Yunhai looked up startled, to see Chu Qingcheng’s cold and critical
eye. He nodded.

She looked back at the man’s imposing figure walking in front of them
and sighed, “Then what is your plan?”

That got a reaction out of the crowd. [The grand Edifice Lord Chu is
actually listening to a damn kid?]

[You may fancy Zhuo Fan and want his favor, but don’t go throwing away
Drifting Flowers Edifices’ reputation!]

Surely they all hung on Zhuo Fan’s every word. The mighty Soaring
Demonic Dragon could fight toe to toe with Huangpu Qingtian, no? So what
reason did they have to treat a brat the same way?

The other two houses refrained from commenting.

To Xue Ningxiang, the world’s number one innocent, more like delusional,
missus, the intricacies this decision held to the other houses went
right over her head as she shouted, “Yunhai, I’ll listen to you! You got
us out of that impasse last time. You may not be on big brother Zhuo’s
level, but you’re still stronger than these guys, who only know how to
lose!”

Restraint was not in Xue Ningxiang’s vocabulary, making Long Xingyun and
Xie Tianshang’s faces aflame. Ever since they came to Beast King
Mountain they hadn’t won once. Nor lost with dignity.

And that was the truth of it. All they ever achieved since coming here
was a big fat nada.

They felt ashamed even more now, with Xue Ningxiang there to poke their
wounds. It also had something to do with Xie Tianyang being her shadow,
safeguarding her every step of the way. If it was any other vassal clan,
even with Sword Marquise Abode’s amiable stance, they’d still get a
trashing.

Would any lord allow their vassal to act like so?

“Ning’er, don’t say that. Leave them with some dignity!”

They were all on the same side after all, practically brothers. Xie
Tianyang had to curb Xue Ningxiang’s willfulness. He then turned to Xie
Tianshang, “Big brother, all of us house disciples are usually focused
on cultivating. Fighting alone is out of the question, but when it comes
to joining a team, it’s best we leave it to Yunhai. If I know that punk
Zhuo Fan well, he never did things he wasn’t sure of. So let’s go along
with his decision.”

Luo Yunhai nodded in gratitude at Chu Qingcheng, Xue Ningxiang and Xie
Tianyang. Then turned nervously to Xie Tianshang.

Xie Tianshang squinted but gave his consent, “What would you have us
do?”

Luo Yunhai was overjoyed. He finally had Sword Marquise Abode’s support.

Long Xingyun saw how two of his allies caved and shrugged, in lack of a
better option, “Since Drifting Flowers Edifices and Sword Marquise Abode
approve, I will also listen to you.”

Luo Yunhai was excited.

He had now become the tri-house alliance’s acting commander. He had the
power to move thousands of people, that of the thee houses and their
vassals.

As long as Huangpu Qingtian didn’t butt in, he was certain nothing could
stand in the way of him and his army.

Luo Yunhai put on a serious face and spoke, “From my discussion with big
brother Zhuo we’ve concluded that we are surrounded. We will have to
break through the encirclement. Listen up, everyone, the vassals are to
split in three groups, those belonging to each houses.

“The Drifting Flowers Edifices division will form a column, awaiting my
order to attack our behind. The other two will form our flanks as we
move in tandem. Keep cool and don’t break formation as you fight. Be
mindful of your position in the formation to not let it crumble.” Luo
Yunhai shouted with confidence.

He knew full well that Zhuo Fan was the sole reason they listened. But
come the aftermath of the battle, he was certain their views will
change.

[My five years in the army weren’t a waste.]

Luo Yunhai vowed…

Chapter 291 - Charge

Chapter 291, Charge

Zhuo Fan went over to Huangpu Qingtian, his gait casual, his tone calm,
just like seeing an old pal, “Young master Huangpu, since this is the
second round, you should’ve told me. Where’s the pill then?”

“Ha-ha-ha, please. It’d be the same as dangling the Brimming Sacred Pill
in your face. Now that I’ve seen what Steward Zhuo can do, let’s see you
try getting it now!” Huangpu Qingtian raised a taunting eyebrow.

Zhuo Fan shook his head. There was no point in doing anything, not when
he had no clue of the item’s location.

“Young master Huangpu, since you won’t tell me, take it as my loss this
time. Let’s meet again in round three!” Zhuo Fan waved and was about to
retreat, as if scared.

Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “Steward Zhuo, I admit that I have no way of
stopping you from leaving. Nor do you have a way of stopping me. But I
can’t say the same for them.”

Hinting at Luo Yunhai’s army, Huangpu Qingtian snickered with a light
clap.

Furious roars filled the marsh, storming for the group of allies from
both sides. Just as Luo Yunhai predicted.

The attack was formed of two armies led by Yan Bangui and You Yushan,
respectively. There was no sign of Lin Xuanfeng.

The guy was double the cripple, true, but a Profound Heaven expert
regardless. He wasn’t about to miss out on springing an ambush.

With such an obvious answer, Luo Yunhai easily predicted the guy was
waiting for them to retreat in his direction.

“Nice, you live up to the name of Tianyu’s Fifth Tiger!” Xie Tianshang
showed his admiration. His opinion of Luo Yunhai grew a notch.

The same went for the others.

If not for Luo Yunhai’s tactic, the sudden charge of so many enemies
would’ve crushed them where they stood. Some would chose to flee and run
into Lin Xuanfeng’s team, sealing any means of escape.

Luo Yunhai may be weak, but his art of war was leagues above anyone from
Six Dragons and One Phoenix!

Luo Yunhai just shook his hand. The praise didn’t get to his head as he
kept his cool in dealing with the sudden dual charge, “Listen up. Only
act when I give the signal!”

They all nodded, fully trusting Luo Yunhai.

Huangpu Qingtian watched it all with a smile, “Steward Zhuo, your allies
look positively rooted in fear. They huddle together like lambs, about
to break, flooded by my men.”

“Isn’t it what you wanted anyway?” Zhuo Fan smiled back, completely
confident of Luo Yunhai’s abilities.

Squinting, Huangpu Qingtian felt something amiss.

His side had ten thousand men doing the charge and even laid down an
ambush. While the tri-house alliance numbered three thousand at best,
outnumbered five to one!

With them holding the field and numerical advantage, anyone would think
this battle was in the bag. So what did Zhuo Fan based his confidence
on?

Huangpu Qingtian would find out soon enough.

“Kill!”

With an earth shaking roar, Luo Yunhai pointed behind him and his army
followed.

Yan Bangui and You Yushan’s armies were stunned in bafflement.

[We haven’t even made contact, so why are they charging behind? The
ambush hadn’t sprung yet either!]

The two were oblivious to its meaning and took it as a good thing.
Regardless of what trick they pulled, it would only work to show a hole
in their formation. [This will make things easier, killing them down to
the last man!]

The two only grew excited in their charge.

How could they have known their crass assumption couldn’t be farther
from the truth?

Luo Yunhai’s army did charge, but its flanks did their job in keeping
the center shielded. Despite the flanks clashing with the enemy, they
showed no weakness in their defense as they also didn’t engage in a
heated fight, moving with the center’s charge as well.

Yan Bangui and Yan Bangui’s armies found themselves in the worst
situation. They felt as if each man was facing five people. Just as they
attacked the front, a sudden retaliation came from the back.

The tri-house alliance moved like the sea, crushing the enemy armies in
waves. Amidst the turbulent waters, Yan Bangui and You Yushan found
their numbers culled.

As for the lucky survivors, they landed far behind the battle, looking
on at the endless strings of corpses left by the alliance’s charge.

They had the numbers, they had the flanking, but now they had the
biggest losses. While Yan Bangui and You Yushan looked positively glum,
Huangpu Qingtian gnashed his teeth.

[You’ve got your ass handed to you even when five to one?! Just what do
I keep you idiots for anyway?]

You Yushan’s back tingled from Huangpu Qingtian’s seething bloodthirst
and he gave the signal to Lin Xuanfeng.

A three-pronged attack ought to save them from a gruesome and cruel
death, no?

But as Lin Xuanfeng eagerly led his five thousand men to beat someone
when they were down…

He heard a loud boom and his army was blown away. Luo Yunhai’s vanguard,
Drifting Flowers Edifices, was mowing his men like grass.

His only reaction… slackjawed.

[What. The. Hell?]

[Weren’t we supposed to catch a fish in a barrel at this point? Why the
hell do I still see them holding strong?]

[How the hell does a huge fish like this just slip right past you?]

[Yan Bangui and You Yushan, are you more useless than manure? What are
you doing letting a pristine army charge here? How am I supposed to stop
them?]

While he was here cursing his allies, the duo cursed right back.

[You damn cripple! Is this how you lead an army? Are your men meant as
cannon fodder? I don’t expect you to stop them, but you could at least
curb their charge somewhat!]

[You’re 100% garbage is what you are! You got what was coming to you
when Soaring Demonic Dragon took an arm and a leg!]

As the trio cursed each other like no tomorrow, Luo Yunhai had no
problem punching his way through the encirclement.

Zhuo Fan laughed from pride.

When it came to armies, ambushes were the norm. This couldn’t have been
a better test for the fledgling Marshal. The way Luo Yunhai set his army
was the typical echelon formation, excelling in counter attacking the
pincer attack and allowing high mobility.

This formation puts a price on speed above all else. Once it was formed
and picked enough speed, nothing could stand in its way.

Zhuo Fan flicked a grin to Huangpu Qingtian, “Young master Huangpu, my
guess is that it wouldn’t be so hard for them to get away.”

Face twitching, Huangpu Qingtian looked ahead with a scorching gaze. He
wished nothing more than to kill those three wretched allies of his.

The reason for one’s defeat wasn’t an unbeatable enemy, but wretched
allies.

[Those morons have higher numbers yet were still smacked around. All
they managed to do is drag my reputation through the mud. They’re
nothing but utter imbeciles!]

Taking a deep breath to quell the surging anger, Huangpu Qingtian
laughed coldly, “Ha-ha-ha, Steward Zhuo is erudite in pen and sword.
You’ve had this planned all along…”

“No, no, no, there was no planning. They did it all by themselves. One
must give credit where it’s due, and not take it for oneself.” Zhuo Fan
cut him off with his snide remark.

Which only got Huangpu Qingtian even more worked up.

Zhuo Fan’s deceitful character was common knowledge, so losing to him
was hardly shameful. But those three sods of his lost to the likes of
some broads from Drifting Flowers Edifices. To make matters worse, it
was the tyke from Luo clan leading them.

With his allies having lost any semblance of dignity, it was quite
sensible for their leader to blow a gasket.

Grating his teeth and fuming mad, Huangpu Qingtian’s face took on a vile
tone, “Steward Zhuo, I never wished to drag them into this. You leave me
no choice but to…”

“What, go and snap their necks yourself? Ha-ha-ha, you’ll have to go
through me first.” With his trademark evil grin, Zhuo Fan’s urge for
battle flared.

Huangpu Qingtian nodded, “Our fight is foreordained. But first, let’s
see if you can save them!”

Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes flashed with cruelty and roared at the sky.

“Ooh~!”

Shockingly enough, Huangpu Qingtian’s mere shout sounded closer to a
dragon than a human.

Zhuo Fan squinted, but his reply was a calm gathering of eerie power in
his eyes.

That dragon roar was a special martial art, just like his Wraith Style.
They both originated from dragons!

But no man could ever release a dragon’s roar, short of being a dragon
himself.

Zhuo Fan shook that thought away, finding it utterly ridiculous. A true
dragon had the power of at least Gu Santong.

Despite being called a monster, his might had yet to shed the realm of
mortals. [So why then…]

Zhuo Fan’s train of thought was cut off when the earth rumbled with a
dreadful sound…

Chapter 292 - Blood Croc Army

Chapter 292, Blood Croc Army

Boom~

As the rumbling continued, the sound only grew louder. Not even the
chaos of battle could drown it.

Luo clan and Drifting Flowers Edifices stopped their charge. So too did
Yan Bangui and You Yushan cease attacking their flanks.

Ally and enemy alike watched dumbstruck at the source of the noise. What
dreaded creature could make such a ‘riveting’ entrance?

Roar!

They got their answer in the form of an endless stampede of blood-red
creatures crawling towards them from behind Huangpu Qingtian. Regardless
of where one looked, all they saw was a crawling red mass.

Now that they got a closer look, the creature was a fanged blood
crocodile of five meters in length. They were pack animals crawling on
the ground, yet that didn’t stop them from having incredible speed and
tough bodies like peak Bone Tempering experts.

“3rd level spiritual beast, Blood Croc!”

Everyone cried out in alarm. Who wouldn’t, when watching ten thousand
Blood Crocs marching towards them with relentless force.

A lucky few Profound Heaven experts would just fly out, while the rest
were doomed to be ripped limb from limb in the jaws of a croc.

Luo Yunhai turned grave, “Godfather told me the Quanrong are expert
beast masters, sweeping the battlefield with their beast army. This army
can use formations and could hold its own at a numerical disadvantage,
but I never imagined Huangpu Qingtian would resort to the likes of this.
This is bad!”

“What, Huangpu Qingtian called them?” Long Xingyun snapped his head at
the smirking figure, just as the Blood Crocs simply bypassed him. Now a
believer, his face sank, “This monster is already strong enough, but now
he can call upon a beast army as well? We can’t fight them. Our only
choice is to run or get trampled!”

The others took one last fearful look at Huangpu Qingtian and nodded.
Huangpu Qingtian’s talent had reached a godlike level!

But was running that easy? Sure, the few flying ones could take some
passengers, but what about the other couple thousand?

They were fated to end up as broken corpses under the Blood Crocs’
stampede.

Chu Qingcheng frowned and sighed.

Yan Bangui, You Yushan and Lin Xuanfeng snickered as they flew away with
their Profound Heaven experts, uncaring to the fate of the rest.

Xie Tianyang looked at Zhuo Fan’s broad and straight back, “Our fate now
rests solely in his hands.”

Everyone looked at Zhuo Fan in frustration and helplessness.

Zhuo Fan’s abilities were eerie, to say the least, of great power, but
could one man stop the flood?

They held no hope in Zhuo Fan.

Even Luo Yunhai, always confident of Zhuo Fan’s invincibility, faltered,
“I and big brother Zhuo had anticipated the enemy launching a frontal
assault. It was our ignorance that led us to assume they’d be men and
not thousands of Blood Crocs! Humans are susceptible to fear. A bit of
trick here and there from big brother Zhuo would be enough to buy us
plenty of time. But when facing a horde of savage spiritual beasts, they
won’t falter for anything…”

“Damn it! Is there no other way?” Xie Tianshang cut him off in anger.
His eyes were burning from rage, “Huangpu Qingtian is inhuman!”

The others got what he was saying.

Yes, he was inhuman. No man was able to subdue a Blood Croc horde and
use it for himself. No one would be so cruel to his fellow men, to even
throw away his own men’s lives to be ground beneath the marching horde
of his beasts.

Then it dawned on them, [Eh? Isn’t that strikingly similar to Zhuo Fan?]

They turned to him now. The man was taking a deep breath and looked on
heavily. Like a cold-blooded monster, he also possessed power no man
could.

But how much could this monster slow the horde down? [We don’t ask for
much, just enough to let us get out alive.]

They held little hope for Zhuo Fan pulling through for them, but they
still did hope!

His talent was unseen in this world as well, but he was a human like the
rest. How could he possibly slow the beast flood down?

Well, one delusional girl thought this was right up his alley. Xue
Ningxiang clenched her fists and said, “No worries. Big brother Zhuo can
do it…”

She had now crossed the point of no return, becoming an eternal Zhuo
Fan’s, uh, fan. She didn’t care about hows or whys, just as long as Zhuo
Fan did something, everything would be alright.

Funnily enough, she was right!

Luo Yunhai begged to differ however. Zhuo Fan had no problem dealing
with a bunch of men charging over, but as for spiritual beasts…

In the face of the ravenous flood, Zhuo Fan looked like a dinghy
floating about, ready to tip at any jolt.

However, this dinghy was quite calm, and smiling, “Young master Huangpu,
who knew you can tame beasts.”

“Ha-ha-ha, you’re too kind. It is but a mere parlor trick.” Huangpu
Qingtian acted casual but couldn’t hide the conceit in his eyes from
Zhuo Fan.

As Zhuo Fan took pride in his blinking art, Huangpu Qingtian was
confident of his beast taming skill.

It was akin to providence. As if Heaven went out of its way to lay
everything at this king’s feet so that no man, or beast, could defy his
righteous conquest.

Zhuo Fan could tell what he was thinking and grinned, “Young master
Huangpu, you sure are confident in your ability.”

“Not confidence, but a given!” Huangpu Qingtian smiled with his head
held high. The Emperor declared, “In this world, be it armies, the
ground beneath their feet, the officials, and even these savage beasts,
all are fated to bow before their true king!”

[Show off!]

Zhuo Fan’s inner outcry summed it up nicely. While his reply was a snort
and shake of the head, “What do you say to a wager then?”

“On what?” That got Huangpu Qingtian’s attention. [The kid has time to
bet when his life is at stake? What’s he up to?]

Bang! Zhuo Fan drew a heavy line with his foot, sneering at Huangpu
Qingtian, “I wager your beast army won’t cross it. Even if just one of
them does, I lose.”

“Pretentious!” Huangpu Qingtian only had anger for his haughty boast.

He knew what Zhuo Fan was capable of, but never once believed the punk
had the power to quell the beast tide of tens of thousands! Huangpu
Qingtian only managed to do it with that little secret deep within him.
As for power alone? Impossible.

Zhuo Fan’s crass words undermined his authority. Was the ability of a
regent that easily dispelled?

Zhuo Fan only mocked him, “Well then, oh young master Huangpu, do you
accept? The stakes are the Brimming Sacred Pills we each hold. The
winner gets the other’s pill!”

Huangpu Qingtian mulled over the trickery Zhuo Fan planned to include in
this wager, but still held supreme confidence that nothing the punk did
could change anything. As such, for honor and hubris, he nodded, “Show
me then your futile attempts to stop tens of thousands of spiritual
beasts!”

“My pleasure!” With a crafty grin, Zhuo Fan turned to the charging Blood
Croc tide.

Filled with barbaric and unrelenting savagery, these Blood Crocs had
only one answer to this suicidal kid, gaping maws filled with teeth and
sharp claws.

Chu Qingcheng, Xue Ningxiang and the rest watched on unnerved. Huangpu
Qingtian had a cold smile, calm and uncaring to the lonely man facing a
flood.

Hum~

Zhuo Fan’s eyes then flashed in a strange light.

The Blood Crocs were about to tear into him, with one of them even
having his head in its maw. It only needed to chomp and that would be
the end of Zhuo Fan.

But the Blood Crocs’ eyes shrank in fear. Under the astonished looks of
the bystanders, the beast army began to shiver.

Roar!

A mewling cry from somewhere among them signaled the rest of the Blood
Crocs to turn tail and scamper from whence they came.

The wild eyes and stumbling gait only hinted at the horrors these beasts
had seen. They were even faster in retreat!

This spectacle left everyone slackjawed. Chu Qingcheng was dumbstruck,
Xie Tianyang was shell shocked, You Yushan was speechless, Lin Xuanfeng
jumped out of his skin and, naturally, Huangpu Qingtian was floored.

He still had a clear picture in mind, of Zhuo Fan being torn apart, only
to be replaced with an image of a cowering beast army.

What made it worse was the unknown element of how he’d done it.

Huangpu Qingtian stood there like a statue, his eyes lost, mindless of
even the fleeing spiritual beasts zipping by…

Chapter 293 - First Contact

Chapter 293, First Contact

“What… just happened?”

You Yushan was floating about in the air, looking dazed at the
scampering blood tide. When he finally managed to return to his senses,
he said to his two allies, “Wasn’t that eldest young master’s trump
card?”

The two were still out of it by the looks of it.

Huangpu Qingtian had laid it on pretty thick with his boasting. That
once Blood Crocs came into play, the tri-house alliance would be left in
mangled pieces. They were so excited to see Zhuo Fan finally falling
short in something, getting with the program of suffering like everyone
else.

The boasting got them hyped as well, eager to see Zhuo Fan in tears.

That wasn’t meant to be however, not when the sure kill method was
running away at top speed.

The three sank into depression, followed closely by the sharp decline in
Huangpu Qingtian’s grandeur.

Even Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord got the same treatment as them. He
boasted and flounced, sure, but do that in front of Soaring Demonic
Dragon and you’d get bitch slapped.

[He had met his bane!]

Luo Yunhai’s side was on the verge of breaking down at the sight of the
savage beast tide. They felt the end coming, their future robbed.

But looking at it now, they knew the earlier panic was quite pointless.
There was no need to fear, as long as Zhuo Fan was here!

The acting commander of the tri-house alliance shook his head at the
casual Zhuo Fan, “Sigh, it seems even I don’t know big brother Zhuo
well. He shrugged the beast army of tens of thousand like it was
nothing.”

“Forgive me, friends. I have made the grievous mistake of doubting big
brother Zhuo’s abilities. With how Huangpu Qingtian can do it, it’s
quite obvious big brother Zhuo can do it too. It’s a fallacy to think
otherwise!”

Luo Yunhai gave a solemn bow to the vexed crowd.

It made sense though. Having gone through so many events with Zhuo Fan,
there was one undeniable truth all of them should’ve figured out by now.
Nothing was impossible for him.

If even he met with an impossible conundrum, then all hope was lost.

Huangpu Qingtian could control spiritual beasts? Humph, then so could
Zhuo Fan. The basis? He was Zhuo Fan, of course.

In the blink of an eye, Zhuo Fan’s fan club found its ranks greatly
bolstered.

One had to admit that even a fan was right, sometimes. Just look at Xue
Ningxiang, bouncing around with unbridled joy, “See that? What did I
tell you?”

Chu Qingcheng shook her head. Although her love rival, she still found
her innocence pleasing to the eye.

Xiao Dandan’s eyes had hearts in them, watching Zhuo Fan with an
intoxicated leer.

Zhuo Fan’s cold tone gave her quite the scare back then, but with him
striking the alpha male pose, she threw that fear out the window. Dying
by his hand would be a dream come true at this point.

[I’d rather be a ghost by a hero’s side than the wife of a lousy bum!]

The lust was strong with this one. Xiao Dandan simply wanted to gobble
Zhuo Fan up. Dong Xiaowan saw the other’s galls in envy.

They all fought over Zhuo Fan’s attention, but not her. She was of low
status and being unable to follow her heart left her in misery…

“These monsters are capable of anything!” Xie Tianyang glanced at Xue
Ningxiang’s red face with jealousy.

The others paused for a second then nodded unanimously.

One man controlled a beast tide while the other shooed it away with a
wink. Could a human being ever do that?

The two became a beacon of shock and awe to every onlooker.

Zhuo Fan reigned totally supreme. He did have the upper hand and all…

Rumble~

Amidst the ever shaking earth from the fleeing Blood Crocs passing him
by, Huangpu Qingtian’s face twitched. His fists scrunched up and he spat
through gnashed teeth, “Stop! I command you all to stop!”

Not one Blood Croc minded his rave. They had bigger things to worry
about.

[You moron of elephantine proportions. You’re merely a king on earth and
can command some of us, but that man is an emperor over everyone. You
don’t compare!]

[Go home, wash up, and sleep tight!]

No Blood Croc who passed him showed any intent of ever stopping, even if
he roared himself hoarse.

Roar!

Huangpu Qingtian was pissed. He released a dragon roar deep enough to
resound even through the deaf Blood Crocs.

Zhuo Fan looked on with a quizzical look.

Only now did the Blood Crocs stop and look at him.

Huangpu Qingtian smiled in joy, having regained some semblance of his
regality. But then the Blood Crocs lowered their heads again and
scampered off like naughty children.

The man’s eyes were bloodshot and his anger exploded.

He was a king and no one defied him. Especially not some mongrels!

Thump!

An iron fist lashed out and blood blossomed. The punch blew up the head
of a Blood Croc.

“Stop or die!” Huangpu Qingtian wailed with his hand dripping blood.

Not that it had any effect. The Blood Crocs didn’t give a rat’s ass
about his commands.

In a fit of anger, he blew up five more Blood Crocs but the beasts took
it in a stride, running as fast as their legs could carry them.

As anger gave way to despondency, this king found himself dethroned,
standing there in absent shock as the Blood Crocs streamed by…

“Why won’t they listen? I am their king!” Huangpu Qingtian muttered
under his breath in bewilderment.

All this while the Blood Crocs ignored him. He didn’t strike a kingly
figure anymore, but that of a beggar now that he had lost his throne. He
was a nobody!

The rest of the Six Dragons and One Phoenix, foe and ally alike were
watching it all in stunned shock. The day had finally come for the
mighty Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, Huangpu Qingtian, to be lost and
despondent.

The defiance of his orders thwarted by Zhuo Fan’s ability had a far
greater impact on this proud and majestic king. It was too much for even
him to bear!

The watchful shadow from the sides sighed, “These two are natural
enemies. Yet each is a genius seen once every ten thousand years. The
death of even one of them would be such a tragedy. Should I… take them
both?”

He threw away that thought with a shake of his head and snickered,
“He-he-he, nah. The world isn’t big enough for both of them. Their fight
is preordained. It’s only a matter of time. The most sensible choice is
to let them go at it and pick the winner, hi-hi-hi…”

No one knew such a creepy and uncertain element had snuck its way into
the Esoteric Debate.

Zhuo Fan scratched his nose, feeling quite disappointed in himself, “Uh,
Young master Huangpu, don’t be so down. There’s no shortage of people
who had and will lose to me. By the looks of it, I seem to be the winner
in this little wager of ours. Will you honor our deal?”

With all the Blood Crocs gone, Huangpu Qingtian raised his head to
reveal a crazed pair of eyes as he snapped, “Humph, my word is gold.
What do you take me for, a welsher?”

Huangpu Qingtian took out a vial from his chest. Zhuo Fan knew it to
have the Brimming Sacred Pill.

Huangpu Qingtian was afraid Zhuo Fan would snatch his ring again so he
hid it in his clothes.

Any cultivator out there had the means to store their things, be it
rings or bags. It was arguably the safest place to keep, unlike on your
own body.

But Huangpu Qingtian’s thinking went the other way around. He chose the
most important item to hide on himself. The most dangerous place was
also the safest. It even caught Zhuo Fan off guard.

Zhuo Fan would never have found it even if he snatched all the storage
rings.

Zhuo Fan laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, Young master Huangpu is so crafty. I never
saw it coming. I was still of a mind you gave it to that cripple for
safekeeping! “

“Humph, you take me for a fool to leave it on him after the first pill?”
Huangpu Qingtian flicked and the vial flew at Zhuo Fan, “Humph, take
it!”

Whoosh!

The vial shot through the air, leaving eerie sounds as it passed. Even
space shimmered.

Zhuo Fan felt a sudden immense pressure slam into his shoulders just as
it neared. It even made the likes of him stagger.

Startled, Zhuo Fan threw his hand forward to block it.

Thump!

The impact had him slide five meters and even found his arm that caught
the vial numb.

He was shocked to find what a mere flick could do. No wonder Chu
Qingcheng and the other two lost against Huangpu Qingtian even though
they joined hands.

[This guy is a monster, a monster body cultivator!]

Besides Gu Santong, he would definitely be the most outstanding talent
of the younger generation.

Zhuo Fan knew that even his Diamond Body was a far cry from Huangpu
Qingtian’s physique!

[Elder Li was right, this guy is a true monster, stronger than me.]

After this first true contact with Huangpu Qingtian, Zhuo Fan now
realized the full extent of the power the head of Six Dragons and One
Phoenix wielded…

Chapter 294 - Release the Beasts

Chapter 294, Release the Beasts

Whoosh!

A black figure blocked Zhuo Fan.

He was still staggered from the previous blow when another strike came
out of the blue.

Squinting, Zhuo Fan blocked the strike with his hand.

Boom!

The immense power of the strike cracked earth under him, caving it for a
hundred meters around. But it hardly mattered compared to the pain
coming from his arm. It was on the verge of being broken!

Astonished, Zhuo Fan found himself face to face with a sinister looking
Huangpu Qingtian, his eyes beaming with murderous intent.

“Zhuo Fan, I can’t let you live!” Cackling, Huangpu Qingtian spun a kick
into Zhuo Fan’s waist, aiming to split him in two, “You’re the first to
ever rile my desire to kill!”

His brow shuddering, Zhuo Fan faced the sky splitting leg. Since he
couldn’t block, he had his right eye flash golden.

Instant movement!

Whoosh!

Huangpu Qingtian had cut Zhuo Fan in half, only to find it was his
afterimage. While the man himself got some much needed distance between
them, gasping for breath.

He didn’t anticipate Huangpu Qingtian would ever resort to sucker
punching him. What he did just now must’ve really pushed the guy’s
buttons and had now driven him mad with the sole purpose of slaughtering
him.

The onlookers from farther away were astonished.

This was the third time Zhuo Fan and Huangpu Qingtian were at each
other’s throats. First in Dragon Cloud City, cut short by Dugu
Zhantian’s meddling. Second was pill stealing, though no one was there
to witness exactly how it went down. And as the saying went, third
time’s the charm. They truly let loose in this round, no holds barred.

The result? Zhuo Fan’s prospects at winning just hit rock bottom. He was
on a total defensive. And if not for that mystical ability of his, he’d
be a goner.

Huangpu Qingtian’s overwhelming dominance crushed Zhuo Fan!

Not even Zhuo Fan could face this monster.

Gnashing his teeth, Xie Tianshang was tense. You Yushan, however, was
cackling mad. Both side’s leaders had monstrous talent, but when it came
to measuring fists, Huangpu Qingtian won by a landslide. Zhuo Fan had no
way to fight back!

The uninvited guest in the shadows nodded, “Huangpu Qingtian has the
advantage in body, but Zhuo Fan is far more flexible and crafty. He is
better by far. And this is when he isn’t even in the Profound Heaven
Stage. If the two were of equal cultivation, this fight would’ve ended a
long time ago. “

Huangpu Qingtian drew the same conclusion, which only fueled his desire
to kill to new heights.

Zhuo Fan presented himself as a real and tangible threat to him. He
never got the same feeling from the other Six Dragons and One Phoenix,
and only looked at them with disdain even when forced to deal with their
cooperation.

On the other hand, Zhuo Fan was a great threat to him. Even more so now
that he saw Zhuo Fan cower the Blood Croc horde and trampled all over
his royal face.

It was a wake up call. That Zhuo Fan was the same as him, qualified to
be king.

With a cold glint in his eye, Huangpu Qingtian barked, “Zhuo Fan, is
your art only good at running away?”

“Yep!” Zhuo Fan was blunt as a birch stump, not forgetting his evil grin
as he counted on his fingers, “Running, assassination, scouting, spying,
and let’s not forget my favorite, ring stealing. It has quite wonderful
applications, don’t you think?”

That only pissed Huangpu Qingtian off. He was looking to mock the man
into attacking.

But Zhuo Fan was way too calm, ignoring the cheap taunt and making a
kingly comeback. His desire to murder Zhuo Fan on the spot spiked again.

The shadow nodded. He knew how to appreciate talents.

Detached from everything and looking at things with cool and critical
eyes were the makings of a great arriviste. At the same time, Huangpu
Qingtian’s image fell a notch in his eyes.

The shadow slowly began to be partial towards Zhuo Fan, finding him to
be the better seed…

Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Qingtian found himself in distress. Zhuo
Fan was unlike Chu Qingcheng and the like. He could come and go as he
pleased, with no one to stop him. He was the biggest headache there ever
was when made an enemy.

That magical art gave him an insurmountable advantage.

So Huangpu Qingtian pointed at his allies and barked, “What are you
gawking at? Kill them already!”

The trio woke up with a start. Why had they stopped? [We gotta box them
in.] Thus they gave the signal.

Luo Yunhai’s echelon formation was still shaken from the Blood Croc
horde and their momentum slacked. They were losing.

With the enemy surrounding them, the couple thousand army had sunk into
despair against the ten thousand enemies. Few were of Chu Qingcheng’s
level to escape, while the rest would find their lives driven into the
mud.

Panicking, Luo Yunhai commanded, “Three round formation!”

In an instant the three divisions became rotating barrels, blocking the
enemy’s onslaught. You Yushan wasn’t worried though. This formation was
a defensive one. They would just have to whittle them down with numbers.

Grinning, the three looked on coldly.

Zhuo Fan frowned a bit. As long as his friends were stuck here, he was
going nowhere and would sooner or later end up just as dead.

You Yushan leading the ten thousand army not only entrapped Chu
Qingcheng’s group but also bogged down Zhuo Fan – two birds with one
stone.

“Ha-ha-ha, Zhuo Fan, see how I trample them!” Huangpu Qingtian
snickered.

He was forcing Zhuo Fan to face him.

Squinting, Zhuo Fan sported a cold smile, “You’d lower yourself to such
an extent? Moreover, you’d have done it already if you wanted to.”

“Ha-ha-ha, indeed. I despise them, but now that you’re here, things have
changed. I’ll take great delight in tearing them apart before your very
eyes.”

Zhuo Fan tensed and secretly sighed. Just like he thought. Huangpu
Qingtian left them alive, just so he could restrain him.

But the cold smile never changed, “Young master Huangpu, do you really
think I’d let them drag me down?”

“Oh? But isn’t your young master with them as well?” Huangpu Qingtian’s
eyes glinted, having seen through him. He charged for the armies.

It was also then when a wind whistled straight for him.

This was what he was waiting for. He blocked the kick with his hand,
releasing a metallic sound.

Looking closer, he found Zhuo Fan eying him coldly.

“He-he-he, finally decided to attack.” Huangpu Qingtian gave a crafty
smile from having found Zhuo Fan’s achilles’ heel. He threw a
devastating punch.

The blow had the power of a mountain behind it.

Zhuo Fan vanished, letting the punch pass him.

The earth caved in tens of meters over a kilometer as a result of the
massive impact.

It kicked up a cloud of dust and shocked even the clashing armies from
the immense power display.

What power could do this?

Zhuo Fan was sweating now. Blocking that would’ve earned him a quick
trip down under.

He looked at his friends helplessly, forced to clash this monster head
on.

Huangpu Qingtian cackled at the floating Zhuo Fan, filled with scorn, “I
wonder for how long can you stop my advance!”

Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth and charged.

The effect each time was minimal, barely stalling Huangpu Qingtian’s
progress. His teleports saved him from the worst, but there was no way
to escape unscathed.

Huangpu Qingtian was inevitable. He royally took one step at a time
towards his target as he unleashed his power.

The sight of Zhuo Fan being played around like a mouse left the others
in despair. Not even their last hope could stop the mighty
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord.

But only Chu Qingcheng saw through it and said nervously, “It’s for us.
Huangpu Qingtian is forcing Zhuo Fan’s hand. We have to get out of
here!”

It dawned on them what a disgrace they were. They became Zhuo Fan’s
shackles.

“But how are we supposed to break out when we’re outnumbered? What do we
do?” Luo Yunhai sighed.

For even Luo Yunhai to come out empty, it showed how truly desperate a
situation they were all in.

Chu Qingcheng turned to her two allies, “Have you brought your spiritual
beasts?”

Their eyes lit up, reminded how their houses provided them with some
high level spiritual beasts. They were pressed at every turn all this
time that they’d completely forgotten.

The two nodded.

Chu Qingcheng smiled and spoke heavily, “Use our trump cards. Release
the beasts and clear a path!”

Chapter 295 - Qiao’er’s Appearance

Chapter 295, Qiao’er’s Appearance

Shriek~

A bird cry pierced the sky, heralding the appearance of a snow white
beast and plunging the area into a freezer.

To the shock of everyone, they found a five meter large white eagle
looming overhead. It kicked up a snowstorm with each flap of its wings.
Biting cold winds pierced the enemies in their charge, slowing them and
freezing the hapless.

“5th level spiritual beast, Nether Wind Falcon!” Chu Qingcheng shouted.

Xie Tianshang and Long Xingyun weren’t slow either.

Roar!

The reverberating roar drew one’s attention to a ten meter golden
leopard. Its piercing eyes unnerved the staunchest of hearts, ready to
pounce on them and maul their flesh.

“5th level spiritual beast, Golden Cloud Leopard!” Xie Tianshang
shouted.

“And mine, 5th level spiritual beast, Heaven-seething Lava Serpent!”
Long Xingyun pointed at a fifty meter long python covered in rocks. Its
eyes shooting flames.

The descent of three 5th level mighty beasts struck fear in the hearts
of the enemy. Each one was equal to a Radiant Stage expert. With three
of them unleashed, the tri-house alliance’s power was greatly boosted.

Roar! Shriek! Sss!

The only sensible reaction in the face of such a display was to shirk
back. The three spiritual beasts started raining havoc within the enemy
lines, darting to and fro unhinged. Not even Profound Heaven experts
faced them.

As the cries of agony reached the sky, Chu Qingcheng’s team made a
breach, even if that gap was now littered with corpses.

“Yunhai, use the path to get us out!” Chu Qingcheng pointed at the
clearing.

Luo Yunhai was about to do just that but three cold laughs revealed You
Yushan and his two allies looking down on them still.

You Yushan only mocked them, “Chu Qingcheng, aren’t we all from the
seven houses? You think you’re the only ones with pets? Don’t take us
lightly. Our reserves aren’t the least bit weaker than yours!”

You Yushan snapped his fingers and revealed a blazing falcon thirty
meters long, “5th level spiritual beast, Scorching Eagle!”

“Mine as well, 5th level spiritual beast, Hundred Eyes Pestilence
Spider!”

Yan Bangui revealed a fifty meter long, black as night tarantula.

It spewed a thick miasma that cut off the path ahead.

Chu Qingcheng’s group found themselves back at a standstill.

Lin Xuanfeng snickered at their grave faces, “It’s time for you to feast
your eyes on my 5th level spiritual beast, Nine-clawed Wind Stoat!”

A sharp wind brushed by and revealed a short one meter long skunk
bearing its claws at them.

The six spiritual beasts started fighting, with no clear winner in
sight. The shockwaves blew away any poor soul too slow to react.

These were the ripples from six Radiant Stage experts’ attacks. Even a
Profound Heaven expert would be sent to his death.

The morale began to sink as fear set in. But the most feared were still
the seven houses.

Only the likes of them could dish out 5th level spiritual beasts that
could fight a Radiant Stage expert to a standstill!

The reveal of the six spiritual beasts only furthered the tug of war.
You Yushan’s side stayed back in fear of not being dragged into their
battle, but Chu Qingcheng’s group now had no way of breaking out either.

It now became clear that they were doomed to wait for Huangpu Qingtian
to come reap their lives.

Chu Qingcheng turned to the others, “This stalemate is the worst outcome
for us. Does anyone have a 5th level spiritual beast that can help?”

All she got was eye rolls.

[What do you take us for? You think we’re that well off to raise a 5th
level spiritual beast?]

Chu Qingcheng sighed in sorrow while You Yushan’s side was having a
field day at their expense.

The longer this dragged on the greater the danger.

Huangpu Qingtian glanced over satisfied, before turning to Zhuo Fan, “I
didn’t think they would use their trump cards so soon. A shame it
changed nothing.”

Zhuo Fan frowned and his hand trembled.

“Ha-ha-ha, worried? Then I will help you feel at ease by not making you
waste time on a bunch of soon to be corpses!” Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian
shouted, “Flaming Lion King, end them!”

Roar!

The imposing power pierced the hearts of everyone as a flaming winged
lion pounced on Chu Qingcheng’s army.

“6th level spiritual beast, Flaming Lion King!”

They all gasped in fear. None saw it coming, that Huangpu Qingtian’s
spirit animal would be a 6th level spiritual beast.

It was going to throw the stalemate in the enemy’s favor!

The tri-house alliance’s spiritual beasts shuddered from the lion’s
roar. Their power cut down, they were pushed back by the other three
spiritual beasts.

“We’re finished!”

Chu Qingcheng’s army was filled with despair and frustration as the
savage lion unleashed waves of flame in its path.

Even though they’d die either way. Up till now they at least had the
chance to take as many as they could down with them. With even some
Profound Heaven experts cherishing the faint hope of survival. But now
that the lion king was here, all hope was lost.

Their lives were now waiting for the flames of war to burn them to
cinders.

You Yushan’s side laughed. Zhuo Fan kept on shuddering. He didn’t get to
act as a twisted and maniacally voice grated his ears.

“If you leave, who’s to hold me back?

Huangpu Qingtian cackled. He was having a blast seeing Zhuo Fan so
conflicted. After suffering at his hand for so many times, he finally
had vindication. It felt good.

Taking a deep breath, Zhuo Fan found himself in a bind.

With two threats on a collision course with Chu Qingcheng’s group, he
could only pick one. It was such a nerve wrecking decision that he felt
lost regardless of what he picked.

But then, his Thunder Ring flickered. Zhuo Fan felt the impatience and
hatred within.

Qiao’er?

He was startled and perplexed at its impatience. But he soon knew why.

Flaming Lion King was the same beast who had killed his mother. Although
a different one, the thirst for revenge remained. Its hatred ran bone
deep for what it had done to its mother.

But how was the young Qiao’er going to fight against the Flaming Lion
King? It was only a 4th level spiritual beast.

The answer was picked for him as Qiao’er had reached its limit and the
Thunder Ring flickered stronger.

[Sigh, it’s not like it will change anything.]

Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, having made a decision, “Young master
Huangpu, I may not be able to split myself, but what you have, well so
do I!”

With a snicker, Zhuo Fan flourished, “Come, Qiao’er!”

In a flash of purple, a purple lightning shot for Flaming Lion King.
Qiao’er only had one thing on its mind, revenge.

“What is that?” You Yushan peered at the lightening glow.

Yan Bangui said, “It appears to be a Thunder Skylark, a 6th level
spiritual beast. But why is it purple?”

“What, 6th level spiritual beast? He has one too?” Lin Xuanfeng
panicked, “Won’t this end up in a standstill again?”

Yan Bangui took a closer look, before giving a deprecating shake of his
head, “Relax, that won’t happen. This Thunder Skylark is only a chick,
at the 4th level. It’s no match for an adult Flaming Lion King! Besides,
an adult Thunder Skylark would fare no better.”

Lin Xuanfeng laughed, “Ha-ha-ha, what’s up with Zhuo Fan then? Is he so
fed up with his useless spiritual beast that he wants to give it to the
lion king as a snack?”

That set the other two laughing.

While on Chu Qingcheng’s side, they were hopeful a treacherous man like
Zhuo Fan had to have an amazing spirit animal.

Only to feel their hopes crumble at the sight of a young Thunder
Skylark, a mere 4th level spiritual beast, and they resumed despairing.

Even Zhuo Fan felt how hopeless it was to even let such a meager support
out.

Ha~

With great hope came an equally great disappointment as they all sighed,
resigned to their fates…

Huangpu Qingtian wasn’t about to let this golden chance go and mocked
the chick as well, “Zhuo Fan, are you that desperate to even send your
useless spiritual beast to its death?”

“What can I say? If it wants to die, I can’t stop it!”

Shrugging, Zhuo Fan didn’t seem to care, but the worry in his eyes was
unmistakable. Even he didn’t know of Qiao’er’s power. Common sense
dictated that a 4th level spiritual beast wouldn’t be considered even a
side dish to a 6th level spiritual beast.

Qiao’er’s chances were between nil and infinitesimal.

Catching on to Zhuo Fan’s worry, Huangpu Qingtian capitalized on it to
put his own worries to rest. [The punk has no overt scheme in play at
all. He is on the ropes.] That last one made his day and he smiled from
ear to ear.

In the meantime, Qiao’er was already behind the Flaming Lion King.

It had everyone’s full attention. Even their breath was caught in their
throat at the imminent clash…

Chapter 296 - Purple Lightning’s Superiority

Chapter 296, Purple Lightning’s Superiority

Roar!

Flaming Lion King’s roar grated ears as it showed its dominance. The six
5th level spiritual beasts had long stopped to watch.

You Yushan’s group’s spiritual beasts bent a knee and bowed their heads
before the mighty lion king. While on Chu Qingcheng’s side, their
spiritual beasts knew when they were overpowered and shuddered as they
inched backward again and again.

It only worked to further let arrogance get to Flaming Lion King’s head,
showing a scornful smile. It escaped his notice or, better yet, it
brushed off Qiao’er’s existence entirely.

And it went the same for the other six spiritual beasts.

What could a 4th level spiritual beast possibly do in this hopeless
situation?

Chu Qingcheng’s side’s spiritual beasts were vexed. [It makes no
difference even if you come, fowl. You’re dead anyway.] While the
enemy’s beasts looked on with mockery.

Chu Qingcheng’s faction was plunged deeper in despair. If the purple
Thunder Skylark instilled a trickle of hope earlier, it was now
thoroughly squashed.

A spiritual beast’s senses were accurate. If they looked down on the
chick, then it was clearly worthless…

Shriek~

Not that Qiao’er cared what any of them thought of it. It only had eyes
for Flaming Lion King. It cried from behind to call out the lion king
with a gaze burning with hatred and thirst for battle.

Flaming Lion King swished his head back, glaring at Qiao’er, itching to
eat it and quench its anger.

[You dare challenge me?]

Qiao’er’s plumes flickered and purple sparks traveled all over it. If
that wasn’t clear enough, then the thick bloodthirst made it abundantly
obvious it wanted the lion king’s head on a platter.

The lion king was royally pissed when Qiao’er didn’t stop its cries.

[You wretched and filthy whelp, no Thunder Skylark can match me, but
you, a chick, thinks it can? For you to challenge my authority, the
punishment is death.]

Roar!

With another angry roar, Flaming Lion King started showing its violent
side. The frightened six spiritual beasts were already meek, not even
squawking. Qiao’er was the only exception, its eyes were fixed on the
bronze lion and its screeches never stopped taunting it.

The fully incensed Flaming Lion King opened its maw and spewed a three
meter big fireball.

Not even a Profound Heaven expert could block such a blow. He’d be
turned to ashes.

Everyone watched on edge, worried for the Thunder Skylark’s fate. Xue
Ningxiang was panicking, turning to Xie Tianyang, “Brother Tianyang, big
brother Zhuo’s bird looks so pitiful. Please save it!”

Ugh!

Cold sweat filled the silent Xie Tianyang. He turned to the unbearably
naive Xue Ningxiang with an aggrieved look, “Ning’er, if the bird is
pitiful, I am even more so! Have you forgotten our time in Allbeast
Mountain Range, of the fight between Flaming Lion King and Thunder
Skylark? Now you are asking me to save a 4th level spiritual beast when
I am nowhere near as strong as a 6th level spiritual beast?”

“But… it’s just so pitiful!” Xue Ningxiang was saddened.

Xie Tianyang shook his head, “Blame Zhuo Fan. He knows it too yet
insists on sending it to its death.”

His words got nods from all around him, puzzled as to why Zhuo Fan took
this reckless course of action.

Zhuo Fan himself tightened his fists from worry. [Qiao’er, you are the
embodiment of lightning and faster than Flaming Lion King. You must
dodge!]

Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “You must be thinking Flaming Lion King
can’t catch up to Thunder Skylark’s speed, right? Ha-ha-ha, have you
forgotten whose spirit animal the lion king is?”

Huangpu Qingtian gave Flaming Lion King a look.

Flaming Lion King nodded and flapped its wings.

A blazing tornado engulfed tiny Qiao’er, sealing all means of escape.
Just as the fireball approached.

With its biggest advantage sealed, its fate was without a doubt certain
death.

Zhuo Fan panicked inside, [How is the brash and overbearing Flaming Lion
King capable of such refined skill?]

“Ha-ha-ha, you have a spirit animal and you don’t know? Unlike spiritual
beasts, a master can teach and train its pet martial arts according to
their attributes. As I and Flaming Lion King are weak in speed, I
devised this move to deal with quick enemies.” Huangpu Qingtian
snickered.

Zhuo Fan’s anger swelled.

He had always been a lone wolf. And since he never raised spirit animals
before, he was oblivious to its implications. Now he didn’t even have
the time to regret.

This was Qiao’er’s decision and all he could do was support it. All
consequences were for it to bear.

This was the demonic path he treaded!

He hatched Qiao’er from a mere egg and was practically kin. Of course it
would walk the same path as him…

Boom!

The fireball exploded on Qiao’er. It combined with the fire tornado in a
tremendous bang, releasing a torrent of flames.

Xue Ningxiang clutched her ears, ducking behind Xie Tianyang in fear as
she observed the flaming explosion in dismay. The others sighed.

[Here lie the bones of an overconfident creature.]

Zhuo Fan gnashed his teeth, refraining from looking and clenched his
fists further.

Huangpu Qingtian beamed. He wasn’t in the habit of letting an opponent’s
weakness pass by, making sure to drive home as much hurt as he could
muster through his condescending, “Zhuo Fan, you truly are empty inside.
To even send that young spirit animal to its death…”

Boom!

A thunder cut his mockery short. It came from within the fiery blaze.
Purple lightning streaked the skies and pulverized the flames into
nothing. Qiao’er was revealed at the center of the purple lightning, its
eyes were raging as before, bent on killing the lion king where it
stood.

[How in god’s name is that possible?]

Shock and awe was prevalent down below. The worst off were the six 5th
level spiritual beasts. Not in a million years had they considered it
possible for a 4th level spiritual beast to survive the lion king’s head
on assault.

“W-what skill is that?” Huangpu Qingtian was no different, “Since when
did Thunder Skylark have such a skill?”

Zhuo Fan looked at the sky in frown. Only to see Qiao’er wrapped in a
purple cocoon of lightning. The errant purple lightning hammered the
flames and evaporated at mere touch.

Zhuo Fan was speechless. He found the purple shield familiar and
realized where it came from. It was the same as Lightning Canyon’s
protective barrier. [Is it…]

He didn’t complete his thought as Qiao’er was on the move again.

Shriek~

Qiao’er called out Flaming Lion King once again. But it wasn’t all talk
now, releasing its all in the upcoming clash.

Purple lightning snaked from its body, twisting space itself. The
pressure grew from such a mighty display, to the point it felt as if the
end of days was upon them.

The 5th level spiritual beasts weren’t the only ones terrified of the
imminent danger, even humans found Qiao’er dreadful.

[Why is a 4th level spiritual beast far more dangerous than a 6th level
one?]

Even Flaming Lion King squinted, moving backward with a grave face.

Who’d have thought the same Thunder Skylark he slighted would unleash
such power?

Long Xingyun’s side was dumbfounded. They were more than a little
familiar with Qiao’er’s power.

“Little Kui, Little Jie, don’t you find that lightning…” Long Xingyun
stared wide-eyed.

Long Kui nodded, “Yes, it’s Uncle Jiu’s purple lightning. But… far
stronger!”

Long Xingyun gasped, shocked to the extreme.

He had never dreamed he’d ever see the might of Godeye Long Jiu, the
power he was famed for, Purple Lightning God Eye, being displayed here,
and on a far greater scale and power. On a spiritual beast no less.

Huangpu Qingtian was completely floored, “Z-Zhuo Fan, t-that’s a Thunder
Skylark?”

“In the flesh. The one I reared myself!” Zhuo Fan grinned, sponging off
another’s achievements without even a twitch. He pointed at the lion and
barked, “Qiao’er, put an end to that eyesore!”

Ding!

Its pair of eyes shone with bloodthirst as Qiao’er’s sharp claws
glinted. With a flap of its lightning wings, it zoomed for Flaming Lion
King like a thunder god.

All eyes were on Qiao’er.

The next moment, the entire sky flashed purple and people’s heart’s
seized…

Chapter 297 - Turning the Tide

Chapter 297 - Turning the Tide

Translator: StarReader

Editor: Elitecoder

Roar!

This time people found the shout a bit off. One could feel the
haughtiness subside and even detect a hint of fear.

Flaming Lion King’s shaking body kept moving backwards as it stared at
incoming purple lightning. Franticness touched its eyes and it started
spitting fireballs and flapped its wings to keep the dreaded purple
lightning at bay.

Fireballs dozens of meters big flew out accompanied by blazing tornadoes
– anything to stop Qiao’er.

This power was enough to sunder earth and burn the sky. The six 5th
level spiritual beasts had long since cowered away in fear.

The power of a 6th level spiritual beast!

However, Qiao’er was relentless. Lightning streaked its body as it
slipped through the cracks in the flames, arriving five meters from the
Flaming Lion King and coming face to face with a firestorm. Its eyes
squinted and whirled. It charged through, with the purple lightning
wrapped around it acting as a drill, piercing the flames and rendering
them void.

Boom~

The struck fireballs exploded in a spectacular fashion. Flaming Lion
King was beside itself in fear and the next thing it knew was its
reflection in Qiao’er’s cold eyes!

Pff!

Qiao’er ran through Flaming Lion King’s chest before he could even think
about dodging. Scarlet blood gushed from the hole like a flood. Flaming
Lion King was watching its wound paralyzed.

It, a great 6th level spiritual beast, had actually found its end at the
claws of a young Thunder Skylark, a 4th level spiritual beast, in one
move!

Its eyes grew heavy, its body colder, evident from the flickering flames
over its body. Flaming Lion King felt itself slipping into the dark
abyss. Yet it still wanted to go on.

However, the hole in his chest was too great and he soon found his sight
go black before collapsing…

Sss~

Gasping, the crowd never saw it coming. A 4th level spiritual beast
killing a 6th level spiritual beast? Ridiculous!

Zhuo Fan was just as shocked.

Qiao’er had exceeded his expectations. Especially that killing blow. The
average Thunder Skylark didn’t have such skills.

Thunder Skylark was a mild 6th level spiritual beast. It only knew to
use its lightning to cover its body in defense, but never to focus it
into an attacking skill.

This was where Qiao’er differed from the norm. It used the 4th Heaven
purple lightning and even comprehended two skills, one for defense and
another for attack. It was uncontested proof of its sentience.

Other spirit animals, like Flaming Lion King, were trained in skills by
humans, while Qiao’er picked them up by itself. The difference was
obvious, like comparing heaven and earth.

And what did it mean if a spiritual beast gained sentience?

The chance to evolve into a sacred beast!

This had never happened among spiritual beasts, nor the appearance of
someone like Qiao’er either. A never before seen spiritual beast born
from purple lightning!

Zhuo Fan did not yet know where the purple lightning came from. He was
still debating if the Heavenly Emperor created it or obtained it
somehow.

But one thing he did know was, purple lightning wasn’t just sparkles to
instill such fear into even the likes of sacred beasts. Qiao’er had
bathed in this almighty power and had a high chance of evolving.

The last thought really got his blood flowing. [Am I going to have a
sacred beast spirit animal?!]

While he was in his own little world, the others were dazed – the six
5th level spiritual beasts included. They all looked wide eyed at the
purple figure.

Who knew a 4th level spiritual beast ever had it in him to kill a 6th
level spiritual beast? Surely not them. Not to mention it was overkill
how it happened.

[T-this is insane! Illogical, absurd!] It went beyond human and beast
comprehension alike, neither side was capable of staring truth in the
face.

Huangpu Qingtian was the prime example. Seeing his strongest spirit
animal killed like nothing, it had messed up the mind of this poor king.
[What the hell is that thing?]

Everyone was so out of it and looking at the slight figure in the air
until…

Shriek~

Qiao’er flapped its wings celebrating its conquest. The cry pierced
through the people’s haze but the fear still lingered.

[The little guy is Zhuo Fan’s equivalent in the spiritual beast world. A
monster!]

[Sigh, like master like pet.]

The people lamented, watching the purple figure in envy.

Zhuo Fan’s eyes shined, “Qiao’er, clear a path for them to break free!”

The crowd was in complete shock.

While only You Yushan’s side was panicking. [That thing is stronger than
a 6th level spiritual beast.] Clearing a path meant going through them.

Chu Qingcheng’s side was jubilant and Zhuo Fan’s image grew in their
hearts.

[That’s our Zhuo Fan. He always pulls through for us!]

Shriek~

Qiao’er complied with his order and dived. He began by peppering the
three 5th level spiritual beasts with purple lightning.

Boom~

The lightning smashed down like hail, forcing the spiritual beasts to
scatter to and fro in fear.

[Where did this freak come from? And why is this abnormality set on us?]

You Yushan’s side was nervous. It wouldn’t be long before their beasts
would be bombarded to pieces. All the crying in the world wouldn’t bring
them back then!

Robbed of any choice, in fear and anxiety, You Yushan’s side recalled
their spiritual beasts. As long as Qiao’er was looming overhead, no one
dared take their spirit animal out ever again.

Having lost its targets, Qiao’er flew around unhinged, releasing purple
lighting like a veritable thunderstorm and killing all in its path.

Cries of horror pierced the sky and the ears of You Yushan and his two
allies as they scattered for cover and their lives. Who the hell had the
time to keep Chu Qingcheng in a deadlock?

Luo Yunhai soon found their path cleared and just strutted out like the
enemy wasn’t even there.

Quite understandable when the same enemy was now screaming and running
for their lives.

The eyes on Qiao’er were that of awe, shock and fear. Looking at it
dominating the battlefield with its power and valor left them sighing.

[If Zhuo Fan’s spirit animal could turn the tides so easily, why didn’t
he take it out from the start?]

How were they supposed to know Zhuo Fan had no clue of Qiao’er’s true
might. You’d think he’d keep it stashed away instead of showing off
otherwise?

Xie Tianyang looked lost, his face stiff, “Ning’er, do you still find
the bird pitiful?”

With a veritable symphony of screams and wails gracing her ears, Xue
Ningxiang went beet red as she said, “Uh, no, but the men facing it sure
are.”

“Everything that Zhuo Fan throws out is insane. Not even his pet is
normal!” Xie Tianyang sighed.

Just how did he do it? How the hell did he raise such a monstrous
spiritual beast?

“Enough chatter! We need to get out of here first!” Chu Qingcheng
snapped, then gave a nod to Luo Yunhai who signaled, “Charge!”

With Qiao’er providing cover fire, they breezed through the enemy lines.
No one wanted to stop them either, not unless they wanted to be left
smoking and sizzling after a bath of purple lightning.

Huangpu Qingtian stared wide-eyed at the escaping prey and raved, “A
bunch of useless mongrels dare foil my plans? You have another thing
coming!”

“Ha-ha-ha, what if you include me?”

Whoosh!

Zhuo Fan popped up before him and kicked his face. Huangpu Qingtian
mocked, “Humph, you think you can stop me? The only reason you’ve lived
so far is because I was toying with you! You truly believe me to be this
weak?”

Huangpu Qingtian’s punch this time left the impression of a rock fifty
meters tall crashing down on Zhou Fan.

Bam!

Yet when the two attacks clashed, Zhuo Fan’s leg flickered purple. A
boom resounded as Huangpu Qingtian felt an incredible force stagger him.

Followed closely by Zhuo Fan’s evil grin, “Ha-ha-ha, who wasn’t?”

Boom!

Huangpu Qingtian was forced back five steps. Zhuo Fan didn’t let him
recover and punched this time, his hand wrapped in purple lightning.

“Young master Huangpu, we’re the same, you and I. None of us will use
our aces until the last moment.”

Squinting, Zhuo Fan’s smirk widened and he hammered Huangpu Qingtian’s
chest.

Huangpu Qingtian rushed his hand to defend.

Boom!

Another powerful blast revealed purple lightning streaking across the
ground, now disintegrated in a thousand meters range. His punch was not
one bit less than Huangpu Qingtian’s earlier strike…
