Chapter 298 - All’s Within My Grasp

Chapter 298, All’s Within My Grasp

As dust billowed, the boom traveled a thousand miles.

You Yushan’s side couldn’t pierce the veil of dust and were beside
themselves with shock. Who knew Zhuo Fan was capable of such power? So
much so that it almost overwhelmed Huangpu Qingtian!

The worry was prevalent in all, but none ventured forth to clarify it.
They were too afraid to interfere between Soaring Demonic Dragon and
Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord’s deathmatch.

When the dust settled all they saw was a mess. When they double checked
the two were nowhere in sight, they scrunched up the little courage they
had and investigated the disaster.

But the sudden explosion scared them back. Looking at the source, they
found Huangpu Qingtian shooting from the ground, wretched and dirty.

He may look unseemingly, but there was no apparent wound on him.

The shock was palpable at Huangpu Qingtian’s state. Taking into account
the force behind that fist yet him coming out unharmed in the least,
surged them with joy and admiration.

“Eldest young master, you’re ok!” You Yushan’s gang dashed over.

Taking a deep breath, Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes glinted coldly, but he
wasn’t looking at them, “Where’s Zhuo Fan?”

“Uh…”

The three were confused, until You Yushan came forth with a bow, “Eldest
young master, Zhuo Fan’s punch unleashed a cloud of smoke. Once the dust
finally settled we only saw the eldest young master appear. We saw no
trace of him. I suspect he has already fled.”

Brow shuddering, Huangpu Qingtian spread his Discerning Field for a more
precise investigation. Certain that Zhuo Fan was gone, he said, “And Chu
Qingcheng’s group?”

Blushing, the three hanged their heads, “Forgive us, eldest young
master! W-we let them escape!”

Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes flashed icily.

Reeling, the three broke out in sweat.

They wished for Huangpu Qingtian’s cursing so badly right now. At least
it would vent some of his anger. Anything was better than this eerie
silence. The fear of not knowing his thinking was only mounting.

One day Huangpu Qingtian may very well be so angry as to strike them
down!

The three shuddered in horror, trying to scour for a gesture, anything
that betrayed his state of mind.

Huangpu Qingtian kept silent for a long time before finally smiling,
“Let them run. It won’t change anything.”

The three were stunned, having never seen Huangpu Qingtian like this and
didn’t know how to react.

[Wait, is this the same cold-blooded eldest young master? Not only did
his scheme come apart at the seams, but he also lost a Brimming Sacred
Pill and a 6th level spirit animal. No to mention he invested so much
effort in this plan too, but even after gaining nothing from it, he
isn’t flying into a rage?]

[Am I dreaming?]

[Did he flip?]

Baffled by the sudden turn of events, they looked on at him in
bewilderment. Like he was a different man.

Easily picking up on their thoughts, Huangpu Qingtian showed a vague
smile, “Don’t forget our mission in this battle!”

“How can we? It’s the position as head of the seven houses!” Lin
Xuanfeng let it slip.

Having nothing but scorn for the man, Huangpu Qingtian shook his head,
“Regent Estate has been the head for a thousand years and not because of
this child’s play, but by raw power! We don’t need this insipid game to
prove anything. Not now, not ever!”

Huangpu Qingtian instilled fear in each one of them with his
declaration.

[That’s the Regent Estate we know, unchanged for a thousand years.]

“Is it for… Brimming Sacred Pills then?” You Yushan ventured.

Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian shook his head again, “Brimming Sacred Pill
is a rare 8th grade pill that even the Regent Estate covets. However,
that is hardly our goal!”

“Then please enlighten us, eldest young master!” Yan Bangui bowed.

Huangpu Qingtian’s eyes burst with coldness as he clenched his crackling
fist, “Zhuo Fan!”

[What?!]

The crowd was in complete shock.

Sure, Zhuo Fan was like a disease, but the Esoteric Debate was held once
a century to settle the power struggle between the clans. Yet he was
saying that Regent Estate only joined because of one man?

[Aren’t you overthinking things?]

His cold eyes swept the crowd, lingering longer on his three allies,
then Huangpu Qingtian clarified their doubts, “Do you believe Zhuo Fan
and Esoteric Debate to be two separate matters?”

Despite everyone avoiding his powerful and steady gaze, there were nods.

“Humph, ignorants!”

Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “Fools! You have that wretched mentality that
says he is only a talented cultivator, that you will sooner or later put
him down with the power of your houses. What if I tell you that as long
as he’s around, Luo clan will stand abreast the seven houses in ten
years, surpass us in twenty, and in thirty, it will be the strongest
clan in Tianyu that not even all seven houses together can oppose! Will
you still think this Esoteric Debate to be nothing but a boring game?”

[This can’t be…]

This was too much to bear. You Yushan was even denying it as he
second-guessed Huangpu Qingtian’s words, “Eldest young master, aren’t
you exaggerating? The legacy of the seven houses is a thousand years
old. He won’t reach our level in a century, not to mention decades!”

“Humph, exaggerate? Ha-ha-ha, if it was me saying that, your reaction
would be inexcusable, albeit understandable. However… ”

The crowd was hanging on every one of his words.

Huangpu Qingtian snickered, “What if it came from Sir Leng? Would you
doubt the words of a cunning man with ineffable plans like the Unwonted
Contriver?”

“What? Leng Wuchang said that?”

They just got the shock of their lives. For even Leng Wuchang to say
that, it meant the prediction had to be true!

They just couldn’t wrap their head around how Zhuo Fan being a monster
gifted with such godlike skills.

Huangpu Qingtian smiled at their skepticism, “Sir Leng said he is of
incredible talent, equal to Zhuge Changfeng. He only needs to grasp
power and he will soar beyond anyone’s reach. That is why we need to
clip his wings before he can fully spread them. Or the seven houses will
soon be no more. Shame Drifting Flowers Edifices, Veiled Dragon Pavilion
and Sword Marquise Abode are too blind to see it. They are playing with
fire standing behind him and will find one day robbed of everything!

“But the Luo clan is under the imperial family’s protection, and they
have Dugu Zhantian for support. We are without means to strike him down
in any other circumstances. The only way to eradicate him is to do it
within the bounds of the Esoteric Debate!”

Huangpu Qingtian turned his bloodthirsty eyes to them, “That is why our
main mission in the Esoteric Debate is to get Zhuo Fan’s head.
Everything else is secondary!”

The others turned grave, realizing Huangpu Qingtian had finally revealed
Regent Estate’s real objective for the Esoteric Debate.

But this was nigh impossible to achieve. Harder than gathering the
Brimming Sacred Pills and facing spiritual beasts.

After witnessing Zhuo Fan’s mystical abilities, they came to realize
that he was unrivaled beneath the Radiant Stage.

Even the Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord, the strongest of Six Dragons and
One Phoenix, had allegedly barely overpowered him. But when they thought
about ignoring him, that was an absolute no.

[Or Huangpu Qingtian would’ve turned him into a bloody damn smear by
now! Why waste so much time explaining it to us?]

“Uh, eldest young master, how are we to go about purging Zhuo Fan? Our
best chance was when we had everyone cornered and Zhuo Fan was forced to
stay. But now they will be on guard and make it even harder!” You Yushan
sighed.

Grinning, Huangpu Qingtian said, “That was our best chance? Ha-ha-ha,
merely bait. The punk has bit on it and all that is left is to wait for
the poison to take its effect.”

Everyone was clueless.

Ignoring them, Huangpu Qingtian turned towards where Chu Qingcheng’s
group was last seen, “Ha-ha-ha, they thought they’d escaped when in fact
they fell right for it! Not even the cunning Zhuo Fan has hope of
breaking out of Sir Leng’s personally designed master plan. Relax, all’s
within my grasp… “

The others shuddered, clueless as to what got into him.

And since Sir Leng intervened himself, then this should be a done deal.
Sir Leng was hailed as the number one schemer, with a zero fail rate.

The shadow tailing them was startled, [I’ve heard of Tianyu’s Unwonted
Contriver, but never imagined he will lower himself to deal with a
junior. Heaven-shaking Dragon Lord is talented and powerful, but now he
even has Leng Wuchang behind him. Zhuo Fan, you are up against peak
experts in both brawn and brains.]

“If you fail, it’s only fair I discard you. But if you win… you just
became a hot commodity, he-he-he…”

Chapter 299 - Array Map

Chapter 299, Array Map

Rustle~

A shadow streaked the sky, flashing in and out of view every mile.

When he finally stopped, he had crossed tens of miles, listening to the
ruckus a few miles out. He just gave a nod, more to himself, and was
gone again.

The final appearance was in the middle of the group.

“Who?” Xie Tianshang shouted, sword at the ready. He saw everyone look
on with joy, “Oh, you’re finally back.”

“Yeah, so what are you standing with your weapon drawn for? Put it away,
will you.” Zhuo Fan rolled his eyes.

Xie Tianshang shook his head as he did just that, “Brother Zhuo is
right. I wish to learn a lot from you in a spar, but it doesn’t seem
appropriate to do it in the middle of a crisis.”

Zhuo Fan’s face twitched.

[That’s a martial fanatic for you. His mind is ever skewed in thinking
fighting came first. At least he isn’t a lost cause and a complete
battle maniac, yet.]

Zhuo Fan’s return was met with jubilation all around. As if he had
become the true winner of that little skirmish back there. Even the
vassals forgot about their true masters and they looked up at him in
reverence.

It was only a matter of time. With the three houses now willing to
follow Zhuo Fan’s every word, it was obvious who the little clans would
choose.

Zhuo Fan’s earlier turning point was the crux. If not for his timely
help in clearing a path, they would’ve been mowed down.

They had witnessed it themselves. It was no wonder he was hailed as a
savior. Zhuo Fan’s image soared in their minds…

“Zhuo Fan, are you hurt?” Chu Qingcheng came over. She saw the light
scratches and spoke softly. Her face was calm, but the eyes spoke
volumes of the deep care and worry she had for him.

Zhuo Fan brushed it off and switched topics, “It’s fine. But Huangpu
Qingtian isn’t a pushover… Oh, what of Ning’er and my spirit animal?”

Chu Qingcheng dimmed, knowing he didn’t want to talk about it. She was
so aggrieved for not being able to make sense of his thinking.

Dong Tianba graced her with a thorough analysis of Zhuo Fan’s heart’s
ranking, but it was just that, guesswork. In the end, only Zhuo Fan knew
what he was thinking.

And this got Chu Qingcheng vexed the most. Any woman wished to know if
the one they love thought about her the most. Then there’s Zhuo Fan, who
was always so vague and dodgy that no one could get a single clue what
went on in that big brain of his…

“Brother Zhuo, your spirit animal is so fierce none of us dare even
approach. What is even stranger, it seems to have taken a particular
liking to young miss Xue and second young master Xie. Look for
yourself!” Long Xingyun smiled and pointed above.

Zhuo Fan was dumbstruck.

He saw a purple lightning drifting through the clouds. And on Qiao’er’s
back was a man and woman having a blast. Who else but Xue Ningxiang and
Xie Tianyang?

Zhuo Fan felt depressed at their entertainment. [A Thunder Skylark is a
high level spiritual beast, so what is it doing getting so attached to
strangers?]

But then it dawned on him.

Xue Ningxiang and Xie Tianyang wore Thunder Rings he refined from
Qiao’er’s mother. They held its mother’s scent.

Such an outcome was obvious.

Shaking his head, Zhuo Fan sighed, “Fate, I guess.”

That threw the others off. Qiao’er noticed Zhuo Fan and chirped
cheerfully. Seeing where they were flying, Xue Ningxiang waved, “Big
brother Zhuo, welcome back!”

Only Xie Tianyang’s mood sank. [Here comes the third wheel…]

Smiling, Zhuo Fan gestured for Qiao’er to come next to him. Xue
Ningxiang jumped off the bird and skipped over with rosy cheeks and a
sweet smile, “Big brother Zhuo, i-is it the same Thunder Skylark young
we found in Allbeast Mountain Range?”

“Yeah. I got it to hatch.” Zhuo Fan ruffled her hair.

Xue Ningxiang bobbed her head and treated Qiao’er as seeing an old
friend, “How adorable, just like its mother!”

Her words set the crowd off in a round of twitching. Zhuo Fan wasn’t
exempt.

If there was anyone among them who’d call Qiao’er adorable, then that
would be the ever naive Xue Ningxiang. They recalled with dread how
Qiao’er flew in a circle once and blasted experts to smithereens. [How
in hell is that adorable?]

They all went silent, having no clue how to break it.

Shriek~

Qiao’er’s sharp cry and piercing eyes raised everyone from their stupor
to demand, [You dare say I’m not? Go on, make my day…]

Shivering, they all bobbed their heads, completing the image with a
bright smile and a soaked back. Having got its wish, Qiao’er chirped and
gave Xue Ningxiang a smile.

Zhuo Fan shook his head at how fast the beast and girl had hit it off.
[Is Qiao’er taking Ning’er as its mother?]

Zhuo Fan’s cheeks went ablaze as his mind spun. He was Qiao’er’s dad and
Ning’er its mom. Then he and Ning’er…

“Oi, Zhuo Fan, how the hell have you been raising it? It’s no less
monster than you are. Mind… giving it to me?” Xie Tianyang showed his
greedy side.

That caught Xie Tianshang’s attention, looking at Zhuo Fan expectantly.

He wasn’t thinking what an asset such a strong spiritual beast would be
to Sword Marquise Abode. Oh no, he only saw the spiritual beast as an
endless sparring partner to hone his edge.

Martial fanatic. Did one need to say more?

Zhuo Fan arched an eyebrow, “What do you think?”

“Uh, no.” Xie Tianyang’s face twitched.

“Then cut the crap.” Zhuo Fan glared. [Who in their right mind would
give away a potential sacred beast?] He didn’t have a screw loose.

Xie Tianyang shrugged, “Just saying. Jeez, can’t you take a joke?”

Though the envy had yet to fade from his eyes every time he saw Qiao’er.
This spirit animal was just too damn overpowered! Just the fact that
Zhuo Fan had such an insane spirit animal was enough to spur Sword
Marquise Abode’s desires.

Xie Tianyang saw Xue Ningxiang cuddling Qiao’er and his heart sank.
Though no one noticed…

Once the pleasantries were over and done with, it was time to return to
the grim and bitter reality.

“Brother Zhuo, what do we do now?” Long Xingyun asked.

Zhuo Fan muttered, “Our main priority is to find the keys and exit
stones. To leave this place at once! We’ll just ignore Brimming Sacred
Pills, as life is far more precious. I can search for them myself if I
have to.”

The words cut deep and they sighed with hanged heads.

He didn’t need to be so blunt about it for them to understand. They were
dead weights, pure and simple. The earlier battle was proof enough. They
were the reason for Zhuo Fan’s limited actions. If he was alone he could
come and go as he wished.

They all turned bleak, but knew the truth in Zhuo Fan’s words. In this
battle, they had no advantage whatsoever and would sooner or later end
up as Huangpu Qingtian’s pawns in this damnable place if they lingered.

None spoke as they watched Zhuo Fan gloomily.

Xie Tianshang broke the silence with his sigh, “We still want to fight,
but brother Zhuo is right. With how weak we are, it’s better we leave.
Long Xingyun, take it out. We and brother Zhuo need to consult on the
best way to leave this place.”

Zhuo Fan looked at them puzzled. [Do they have a secret weapon?]

Easing a breath, Long Xingyun revealed a piece of silk, “I am a man
living in the present. I do not care as much about the Esoteric Debate
as brother Xie does. But going home in such a wretched state is not what
I want to see.”

Zhuo Fan unfolded the silk and cried, “Beast King Mountain’s array exit
map?”

On the detailed map, five points stood out, the five National Elemental
Stones meant to take them home. With the yin-yang metal keys, all they
had to do now was get to the metal exit and they’d be home free.

Zhuo Fan stared at the others, “Can it be trusted?”

Long Xingyun spoke seriously, “That’s what we would like to know by
consulting you.”

With a shout, some Profound Heaven experts were hoisting two scared
people over. At the sight of them, Zhuo Fan sported an odd look as he
said, “You again!”

The two were bitter and shuddered on the ground with lowered heads…

Chapter 300 - Battle of the Minds

Chapter 300, Battle of the Minds

“Cai Xiaoting, Sun Yufei, didn’t I tell you to beat it home? What are
you doing here, and captives again no less?” Zhuo Fan mocked them for
all their little worth.

The two kneeled there bitterly and wretched. Not once making eye contact
with Zhuo Fan.

Long Xingyun said startled, “Brother Zhuo, you know them?”

“Meet the Luo clan traitors. His father was an elder in the clan and
even close to the old Clan Head. Despite their transgression, Yunhai had
a good heart and spared them.” Zhuo Fan shrugged, “Oh, and why did you
capture them? Don’t you know killing them is far easier?”

Long Xingyun gasped then said solemnly, “To tell you the truth, we
stumbled upon them not long after we escaped the Killing Blood Marsh. I
wasn’t planning on sparing them, but we found this map on them as well
as two keys and a Brimming Sacred Pill…”

Ahe-he-hem!

Long Kui’s signal came a tad too late however. The damage was done.

Long Xingyun now realized the error of his ways. [Telling him about the
map and keys was enough. What was I thinking bringing up the Brimming
Sacred Pill?]

Zhuo Fan perked up at the mention of those three little words and his
eyes practically shined, “Brother Long, what of the vial?”

“Uh, we found it.”

“I realize that, but won’t it be safer with me?” Zhuo Fan’s demonic
smile came next, followed by a genial smile, “What if it were to fall in
Huangpu Qingtian’s hands? That would be awful. We can’t have everyone’s
interests be laid to waste because of one man, now do we?”

Zhuo Fan’s righteous speech didn’t forget to include the public
interest. Long Xingyun lost the moral high ground and handed the pill in
defeat.

He had hoped to enter the Radiant Stage with this pill, but now… That
ship had sailed!

Long Xingyun wished he could tear his running mouth off. How could he be
so stupid?

Xie Tianyang and Long Kui knew Zhuo Fan’s character the best and only
had sighs of pity. [Once it’s in Zhuo Fan’s clutches, there’s no getting
it back.]

With a gratified flash of light, Zhuo Fan tucked the pill in the safety
of his ring. He looked at the despondent Long Xingyun even more pleased.

With three Brimming Sacred Pills in the bag, uh, ring, only the last one
was left and he’d have milked the Esoteric Debate dry.

Finding two extra keys on Long Xingyun as well, were the icing on the
cake.

It just so happened that he had a pair of keys as well. He could already
open the fire and earth exits now!

He could now leave this place whenever he wished with his spoils.
Victory was at hand! The only problem was punching through Huangpu
Qingtian’s blockades.

Alone, he’d be home by now. But with so many people dragging their feet
behind him…

Zhuo Fan’s eyes landed on the kneeling duo, “Brother Long fears the map
may be a trap.”

“That is what I assume, yes.”

Long Xingyun brushed past Zhuo Fan’s open appropriation of his wealth
and said, “They say as early as two weeks ago, Huangpu Qingtian sent
them in search of the keys to have full control of the battlefield. But
I still feel this is too much of a coincidence. We just got out of
danger yet met with these two who had the map we wanted. The more I
think about it the more I suspect it. That is why I had them on a leash
until Brother Zhuo returned to discuss it.”

Zhuo Fan nodded inside. Long Xingyun was sloppy by nature, but he had a
good head on his shoulders at least.

The array map was clearly dubious, but for this fleeing group, it held
absolute interest. The odds for a trap waiting for them was most likely
certain.

Even if he absolutely knew about it being a trap, its value outweighed
the risks.

[This is one bait I can’t refuse.]

Zhuo Fan squinted at the pair, “You better answer my every question. If
I found out you’re lying, I’ll make it so even death would be your most
cherished wish!”

The two shuddered but nodded, the fear had them soaked in sweat.

Zhuo Fan began, “Did Huangpu Qingtian make you wait for us?”

“N-no. Like we said, we stumbled upon you as we searched for the exits.
There’s nothing else to it!” Cai Xiaoting blurted.

Zhuo Fan stared him down. The man was frantic, but finding no lies, he
continued, “Did you make this map after finding the arrays?”

“No, the arrays are too spread out. It’s impossible for us to find
them.” Cai Xiaoting shook his head. Fearing Zhuo Fan would find his
answer lacking, he rushed with, “There were five teams of us, each with
its own area to search. We used a jade slip to keep in touch and made
the map.”

“What of the two keys and pill?”

“We found them along the way. We used to have two pills, but a Profound
Heaven expert stole one to take the credit and you took the last one…”
Cai Xiaoting was heartbroken, his voice trailing off.

[How could we be so down on our luck? The two pills were our promise to
greatness.]

But at some point, their other Profound Heaven expert team member took
one for himself and when they thought the other was enough to get
something good, they ran into these guys.

[Forget about merits when we’re having enough trouble keeping our
heads!]

The two fell deeper in despair.

Zhuo Fan saw them squirm and nodded. Long Xingyun added, “Brother Zhuo,
what if this is a trap as well…”

“There’s no need to say it. They were once part of the Luo clan and
understand them enough to know if they lie.” Zhuo Fan’s eyes glinted.

Long Xingyun and the rest were overjoyed.

That validated the map as being genuine. They could survive this!

Zhuo Fan shook his head however, “Don’t be so quick to celebrate. The
map could still be fake.”

[What?!]

The crowd was stunned.

Grinning, Zhuo Fan revealed a deep gaze, “They are truthful, yes, but
that doesn’t guarantee Huangpu Qingtian was honest to them as well.”

Now they looked puzzled as to why Zhuo Fan was still smiling.

[Doesn’t that make this map useless?]

In another place, Huangpu Qingtian pointed at an identical map Zhuo Fan
had, “You Yushan, you will set up an ambush at the metal exit. Yan
Bangui, you will stake out the fire exit. Me and Lin Xuanfeng will be
watching the earth one. Remember what I said. Others do not matter but
one person has to breathe their last at all costs. Make sure they die in
excruciating pain and suffering.”

The three felt uneasy.

“Eldest young master, we understand your wish. But will killing this
person have any effect on Zhuo Fan?” You Yushan frowned, “With how we
handed the exits’ locations along with keys and even a Brimming Sacred
Pill, they can now flee without worry. Wouldn’t it have been better to
give them a fake map?”

With an evil grin, Huangpu Qingtian mocked, “Imbecile, you think you can
fool Zhuo Fan’s cunningness with a fake one?”

“But, isn’t he far too paranoid to believe even the real one?” Yan
Bangui frowned.

Huangpu Qingtian smiled, “All the more reason why we gave him
everything, to believe. Even the two prisoners are real. The two were
purposefully kept in the dark, limiting their knowledge to the array
map, keys and pill. It’s all because my men guided them from the
shadows. Their words are without a doubt genuine. He will never realize
we’d even lie to our men all so we could trap him. No matter how shrewd
he is, he will never get one falsity out of those two.”

The others lit up, with Lin Xuanfeng giving a thumbs up in his flattery,
“Eldest young master is wise. Versed in pen and sword!”

“Humph, this is part of Sir Leng’s plan. I have nothing to do with it.”
Huangpu Qingtian shook his head, holding the very last Brimming Sacred
Pill vial in his hand.

You Yushan looked at it with a sigh, “Of our three pills, we only have
one.”

“What are you so worried about? With Zhuo Fan’s greedy nature, he won’t
be satisfied with just three. He will want the last one as well! We just
have to deal with him and the others will be easy pickings!” Huangpu
Qingtian sneered, “Follow the plan and we will have the three vials as
well as his head. Ha-ha-ha…”

Huangpu Qingtian’s cackle got everyone excited.

The operation to eradicate Soaring Demonic Dragon was a go…
